title_en: Weak link tracking system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a weak link tracker, its characterized in that: the system comprises an online data sharing unit, wherein the online data sharing unit is connected with a data acquisition and monitoring control unit and is also communicated with a comprehensive data unit and a plurality of clients through a network. The utility model discloses an online data sharing platform save state estimation result, various modules directly acquire ripe data from online data sharing platform, compare with preceding mode, can avoid state estimation system's repeated construction and repeated maintenance, and various modules need not the repetition and carry out the state estimation and calculate, and the real-time is better.

title_en: State estimation method for high-accuracy nonlinear system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state estimation method for a high-accuracy nonlinear system. The method comprises the following steps in sequence: configuring a high-order sampling point which is consistent with nonlinear state transfer function probability distribution; calculating a state vector estimate; calculating a state vector error covariance estimate; configuring a high-order sampling point which is consistent with nonlinear state transfer observation function probability distribution; calculating the estimate of measurement; calculating a filtering gain; calculating a posteriori estimate of a state vector; calculating a state vector error covariance estimate. The method has the advantages that 1, the state estimation accuracy is high; 2, the converging speed is high; 3, resolution of a Jacobian matrix is avoided; 4, redundant weight coefficient debugging distribution is not needed; 5, the problem of dimension disaster is solved.
assignees: UNIV CIVIL AVIAT CHINA

title_en: Fuzzy-theory-based device for estimating real-time state of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fuzzy-theory-based device for estimating the real-time state of a power distribution network. The device comprises a power distribution network data receiving module, a data processing module, a data output module and data transmission channels, wherein both the power distribution network data receiving module and the data output module are connected with the data processing module through the data transmission channels. The device is reasonable in structure; a data storage region and a program storage region are separated, so that call and fast transmission of data are facilitated, independent operation of a program is facilitated, and disorder is avoided. The received data and the data needing to the output are stored in the data storage region and are not prone to loss, and repetitive computation is avoided. An operation platform is provided for fuzzy-theory-based estimation of the real-time state of the power distribution network. When the device is used, the calculation program designed according to a fuzzy-theory-based method for estimating the real-time state of the power distribution network is installed in the data processing module of the device, the device will run the program, and a state estimation value of the real-time state of the power distribution network is worked out according to the calculation program.

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method based on cooperative particle swarms
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network state estimation method based on cooperative particle swarms. The power distribution network state estimation method based on the cooperative particle swarms comprises the steps that firstly, a distribution network system and measurement configurations of the distribution network system are loaded; secondly, a main swarm M and a cooperation swarm set C are initialized; thirdly, whether the cooperation conditions are met or not is judged, if yes, the fourth step is executed, and if not, the sixth step is executed; fourthly, particles in the main swarm M is solved; fifthly, whether the convergence conditions are met or not is judged, if yes, state estimation is finished, and if not, the third step is executed; sixthly, the cooperation swarm set C is solved. The rear part and the imaginary part of node voltage serve as state variables, branch current, the branch head end complex power and the node injection complex power are calculated, an objective function is calculated through the least square method to measure the closeness degree between the calculation amount and the measurement amount, the state variables are updated based on the interaction among the particles and the optimizing capacity of the algorithm is improved based on the cooperation of the swarms. The experiment result shows that the power distribution network state estimation method based on the cooperative particle swarms has good adaptability and convergence performance.

title_en: Self-adaptive wind power prediction system and prediction method
abstract_en: Disclosed is an ultra-short-term blower fan output power prediction system for predicting the output power of target blower fans in multiple wind fields. The prediction system comprises a wind field information acquisition portion for acquiring wind measurement tower data and blower fan operation data of multiple wind fields and recording the data in an association mode in a database as historical information; a principal component analysis extraction portion for reading the historical information from the wind field information acquisition portion, executing principle component analysis and determining principle components according with predetermined conditions; and a nerve network portion which establishes an RBF nerve network by taking the principle components obtained from the principal component analysis extraction portion as input nodes and predicts the output power of the blower fans by use of the obtained RBF nerve network. The prediction system is characterized by further comprising an updating portion which performs online updating on the weight of the output layer of the nerve network by use of a Kalman filtering algorithm.

title_en: Method for setting measurement weight of state estimation of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for setting measurement weight of state estimation of a power system, which comprises the following steps: counting the outgoing line number alpha of each node according to the branch data j (ii) a Judging whether the current measurement is voltage amplitude value measurement or not; judging whether the current measurement is branch power measurement or not; judging whether the current measurement is the measurement of the node injection power; setting a type factor of the current quantity measurement to k wi ＝c/α j (ii) a Set the current measurement weight to Because the invention considers the measurement error and the measurement type when setting the weight, the type factor k of the node injection power measurement w Dividing the type factor of branch power measurement by the outgoing line number of the node. The embodiment shows that the method can obviously improve the accuracy of the state estimation of the power system. For an IEEE30 system, when each measurement has 1% error, the precision of state estimation is improved by 7.4% compared with the traditional method by adopting the calculation of the invention.

title_en: Soft power outage battery management system used for electric vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft power outage battery management system used for electric vehicles. The soft power outage battery management system includes a BMS (battery management system) controller 3 which is used for judging whether to perform charging and discharging control and system power outage management, a BMS charging and discharging triggering signal 4 which is used for triggering the BMS controller 3, and a power source on-off control module 1 which is used for controlling the switch-on or switch-off of power source input of the BMS the controller 3; in charging, the BMS charging and discharging triggering signal 4 can trigger the BMS controller 3 before the power outage of the system; and in discharging, the BMS controller 3 can realize time-delay control on the power outage of the BMS controller 3 itself through controlling the power source on-off control module 1. With the soft power outage battery management system used for the electric vehicles of the invention adopted, soft power outage of a BMS for the electric vehicles can be realized, and therefore, functions such as relay shutdown, power outage instruction transmission and real-time updated key parameter storage can be realized before the power outage of the BMS for the electric vehicles, and protection and management of the BMS for the electric vehicles and finished automobile systems can be better realized.

The method comprises the following steps of intelligent terminal user logging in, intelligent terminal index early warning, intelligent terminal index multi-dimensional mining and analyzing, intelligent terminal index querying, and intelligent terminal data real-time updating. According to the invention, the management decision makers can knoe the running condition of the power system accurately in real time, thereby realizing assisting decision making.

title_en: Grid integration state maintenance method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid integration state maintenance method. The grid integration state maintenance method comprises the following steps that (1) backbone networks of all provincial dispatch centers and prefectural dispatch centers are interconnected through a communication dedicated channel network to form a wide-area distributed provincial and prefectural integrated dispatching automation system; (2) a unified model is established for the provincial dispatch centers and the prefectural dispatch centers; (3) partition elimination and factory station measurement quality control are performed according to administrative divisions; (4) the real-time operation mode of a grid is obtained, measurement is performed, and state estimation calculation is performed; (5) partition statistics is performed on state estimation operating indexes and listed measurement results; (6) all administrative regions perform state estimation maintenance and model maintenance on factory stations in the respective responsibility regions. As the unified model of the provincial dispatch centers and the prefectural dispatch centers is established, improvement in calculation accuracy is facilitated. Meanwhile, by the aid of percent of pass statistics according to the regions and factory stations of the partition statistics function, the regions and even the factory stations poor in measurement quality can be positioned quickly and accurately; besides, due to the partition maintenance function, the response speed for processing the state estimation can be increased.

title_en: A kind of based on the PMU power system multizone distributed state estimation method measured
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of based on the PMU power system multizone distributed state estimation method measured, assume initially that measurement model is linear, to extend subregion method subregion, the subregion of extension contains the border bus of adjacent area, is all equality constraint mutually with the quantity of state of border bus, and WLS is optimization aim, ADMM is adopted to solve, all subregion only needs exchange border bus quantity of state information, it is not necessary to Central co-ordination side, remains the independence in each region; Subsequently bilinearity theory is expanded to and take into account PMU measurement, estimate to be converted into three stage problems by traditional non-linear WLS, first and third stage was that linear WLS estimates (all subregion is solved) by ADMM is distributed, and second stage is a step nonlinear transformation (all subregion can individual transform). title_en: Roll the multi-mode load dispatching method of renewal online based on coal consuming character

title_en: Intelligent-power-grid-oriented missing data filling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent-power-grid-oriented missing data filling method, which comprises the following steps that: firstly, partial incomplete data in a data set of a source system is returned to the source system, and the source system regenerates a dataset D; then, the regenerated data set D is divided into two parts, i.e., a complete data subset Dc and a missing data subset Di, and the entire data set D is clustered; and finally, the missing data subset Di is filled according to the clustering result, and a filling result Di<'> is obtained. The intelligent-power-grid-oriented missing data filling method has the advantages that under the condition that the noise and outliers exist, the space data is effectively clustered and is applied into the missing value filling, so that the data filling accuracy is improved, and the foundation is laid for intelligent management of service system data.

title_en: Power distribution network feeder line segment equivalent reduction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network feeder line segment equivalent reduction method, which belongs to the technical field of electric power system topology structure design. According to the method, firstly, a merging node rule base is built, and which nodes need to be merged is determined; the line outlet degree of reserving nodes is set to be 0, and the line outlet degree of merging nodes is still 2; then, the nodes with the line outlet degree of 2 are subjected to deep optimum searching, the nodes with the electric connection relationship are classified into one island, and each island is provided with only two nodes with the line outlet degree of 0; and the island with the on-island feeder line segment number greater than or equal to 2 is subjected to feeder line segment merging, a new feeder line segment is formed, and the two end points of the new feeder line segment are two nodes with the line outlet degree of 0 on the island; the nodes, except the nodes with the line outlet degree of 0, on each island are sequentially deleted; and all of the feeder line segments, except the new feeder line segment, on the islands are deleted. The power distribution network feeder line segment equivalent reduction method has the advantages that the system scale can be obviously reduced on the premise that the analysis precision is not reduced, so that the calculation efficiency of state estimation, tide and the like is indirectly improved, and the requirement of real-time calculation and dispatching can be met.

title_en: Three-phase unbalance factor probability assessment method based on state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-phase unbalance factor probability assessment method based on state estimation. The method comprises the steps that A, a network node three-phase admittance matrix of an actual electric system is calculated; B, an injection active power expression and a reactive power expression of a phase p of a node i in the electric system are calculated; C, the error between the measured quantity and the true physical quantity of the system is calculated through a state estimation method; D, a sampling process expression of a load power and n distributed power output powers is obtained; E, a state quantity estimated value is solved; F, a voltage unbalance factor is solved; G, a three-phase unbalance factor probability assessment is carried out. By the adoption of the three-phase unbalance degree probability assessment method based on state estimation, three-phase unbalance probability distribution and change characteristics of voltages of a power distribution system which a distributed power supply is connected into can be analyzed objectively and reasonably; the method has positive significance in reasonably utilizing renewable energy to generate electricity in a conventional power distribution system.

title_en: Real-time analysis assistant decision making system and information processing method for state estimation of power system

title_en: Cross-system ems status estimation method based on cim/e interaction
abstract_en: Disclosed is the field of energy management of an electric power system centre, and specifically related to is a cross-system EMS status estimation method based on CIM/E interaction. The method comprises the following steps: extracting a power grid calculation model from a source system and a power grid operation collection data profile at this time, and packaging into a CIM/E file the power grid data profile at the moment when a power grid device, topology description and the power grid calculation model are exported; periodically transmitting the CIM/E file to a target system through a dedicated dispatch data network; parsing the CIM/E file in the target system, and restoring the CIM/E file into a source system power-grid-shaped calculation model to conduct quasi real-time data collection; and conducting state estimation calculation in the target system, and outputting a calculation result. The present invention solves the problem that an EMS system can only calculate status estimation results of data directly collected or forwarded within the modeling range. A source-end power grid model is not required to be established in the target system, and real-time power grid data is not required to be collected or forwarded via a communication protocol in the target system, thereby realizing the state estimation calculation of cross-operating systems and EMS systems having heterogeneous system software platforms.

title_en: Data estimation method of power distribution
title_ko: 전력 계통의 데이터 추정 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a data estimation method of a power system, in which a data estimation method of a power system processes data obtained from the power system in real time and stably operates the power system by applying the obtained data to the analysis of the power system. The data estimation method of the power system comprises the steps of a) obtaining a measurement value to estimate a state including voltage (V), current (I), active power (P), and reactive power (Q) from the power system; b) calculating an objective function to minimize errors using errors, weighted values, and measurement values by enabling a current power system to have a feeding condition as a restriction condition and by applying a weight least square (WLS) method; c) calculating a feeding equation by applying an expected value corresponding to a real measurement value as a variable and by arranging a line exposure current amount expressed as a function with respect to a bus bar; d) deducting a result value including fault data or shortage data by applying a Newton-Raphson method by utilizing a technology optimized at the feeding equation; and e) calculating a final result value by estimating a state after removing the fault data or the shortage data in the result value from a function in which the WLS method is applied. Therefore, the present invention may obtain data integrity by optimizing a measurement value obtained from the power system by including fault data or shortage data and by converting the measurement value into a final result value which is able to be interpreted in the power system using the Newton-Raphson method.

title_en: Minimum mean square error-based optimal PMU layout method
abstract_en: The invention provides a minimum mean square error-based optimal PMU layout method and belongs to the power grid technical field, in particular relates to a minimum mean square error-based optimal PMU installation method applied to occasions when undetected attacks exist in a power grid. title_en: A kind of Power Plant Equipment state evaluating method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Power Plant Equipment state evaluating method, step includes：Power Plant Equipment layering is divided into unit, device cluster or system and equipment, and monitoring of equipment model is set up for equipment；Normal operation history data is filtered out from historical data base and obtains normal condition data set；The regression model based on generalized moment algorithm for estimating is set up, carrying out model training using normal condition data set obtains trained values；From real-time data base obtain monitoring of equipment supplemental characteristic and screened successively, state estimation, finally according to the hierarchical mode stratified calculation evaluation status value and state of monitoring of equipment model.The present invention can realize the state estimation of the equipment, system and unit of thermal power plant and the early warning of device object incipient fault change, and pass through the parameter state appraisal procedure based on different type of alarm, prompting causes the monitoring parameter of equipment, system and machine group alarm, helps thermal power plant's concern equipment early stage deterioration, analyzing failure cause and accumulation diagnostic experiences.

title_en: The systematization of low-voltage platform area distribution network voltage quality evaluation and optimization solves method
abstract_en: The invention discloses the systematization of a kind of low-voltage platform area distribution network voltage quality evaluation and optimization to solve method, including：Each taiwan area distribution topological structure, line parameter circuit value, the phase sequence of terminal temperature difference, load curve feature are acquired, establish the mathematical modeling of low-voltage platform area；User's electric quantity data in power supply enterprise's marketing system extrapolates the mean power or instantaneous power of user, using before pushing back magnitude of voltage that the active power of each section of circuit, line loss per unit and each node are calculated for formula Power Flow Calculation Methods For Distribution Network；Design and simulation analysis are optimized using transfer load, newly-increased circuit, replacing line footpath and adjustment phase ordered pair low-voltage platform area, realize that the synthesis of line loss per unit and cost of investment is optimal.The software platform that the inventive method is developed by it, the workload of low-voltage platform area line walking and modeling can be greatly reduced, with reference to some corresponding management means, it is possible to achieve basic unit's supply station (institute) improves the operation and maintenance level of low-voltage network to the real-time update of low-voltage platform area data.

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method based on firefly algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network state estimation method based on a firefly algorithm. The method comprises steps as follows: Step 1, generating a power distribution network node admittance matrix; Step 2, initializing fluorescein and dynamic decision domains of fireflies; Step 3, updating the fluorescein of the fireflies; Step 4, calculating the distance between the fireflies to acquire neighborhoods; Step 5, calculating the movement probability of the fireflies; Step 6, updating positions of the fireflies; Step 7, updating the dynamic decision domains of the fireflies; Step 8, judging whether a convergence condition is satisfied or not, if the convergence condition is satisfied, ending the process, executing Step 9, and otherwise, executing Step 3; Step 9, outputting an optimal solution. According to the method, node voltage is used as a state variable, the node injection power is calculated, an objective function value of the least square method is taken as a firefly fitness function value and converted into the fluorescein of the fireflies, the state variable is updated continuously, and the firefly position with the highest fluorescein is taken as the optimal state estimation result. Experiments indicate that the method has good accuracy and adaptability.
assignees: ZHANG HAILIANG

title_en: Digital power grid construction method based on on-line data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital power grid construction method based on on-line data. The digital power grid construction method comprises power grid basic data construction, power grid graph construction and power grid simulation calculation data construction based on the on-line data, namely power grid basic data and graphic and simulation calculation data of a digital power grid for simulation analysis are generated through conversion processing of generated power grid model data, graphic data and power grid data obtained after state estimation and maintenance of an on-line SCADA/EMS system. According to the technical scheme of the digital power grid construction method based on on-line data, construction of the power grid simulation data identical to the practical situation of on-line operation is achieved, and digital power grid construction based on the on-line data is achieved, so that the data basis is provided for simulation analysis of the on-line operation power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: A kind of meter and the power system state estimation method containing wind-power electricity generation of frequency change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of meter and the power system state estimation method containing wind-power electricity generation of frequency change, as large-scale wind power accesses power network, the fluctuation of wind power output can be made a significant impact on mains frequency, therefore traditional state estimation model is no longer applicable.The present invention simplifies in synchronous generator quasi steady state model, load quasi steady state model and asynchronous blower fan on the basis of RX models, it is incorporated into frequency departure as new quantity of state in state estimation procedure, and zero new injecting power is constructed to generator and load bus to measure, and finally establishes the state estimation model for considering frequency departure.Simulation Example result show the model can effectively count and system frequency departure, state estimation result precision is improved significantly.

title_en: A kind of wind power climbing event prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wind power climbing event prediction method, it is incorporated into frequency departure as new quantity of state in state estimation procedure, establishes the state estimation model for considering frequency departure.Then the frequency departure calculated is judged according to corresponding index, predicts whether that there occurs wind power climbing event.Proposed by the present invention is a kind of climbing event prediction method towards whole electric system, avoids the dependence defined to climbing event, has engineering application value.

title_en: Target plans power grid aid decision-making method when one kind is based on year
abstract_en: Target plans power grid aid decision-making method when the invention discloses one kind based on year, optimal power network planning scheme is selected suitable for electric system, the practical annual data of power grid before its step includes: 1, plans year by the EMS real-time data base acquisition of Energy Management System, the Probabilistic Load Flow of the whole network is calculated using the sequential Monte Carlo analogy method for becoming time interval sampling；2, the newly-built transformer station model in target year is designated as when establishing year；3, planning electric network model is carried out measuring mapping and state estimation: is designated as the planning year electric network model in target year when loading year, measure mapping and state estimation, fail-safe analysis is carried out later, and the programme of trend distribution rationality difference, deposit planning electric network database are eliminated in obtained data；4, it initialization planning grid net loss model and foundation the network loss statistical regions as given by user: 5, plans grid net loss analytical calculation, as a result imports network loss relational database；6, program evaluation substation builds up front and back decreasing loss benefit.

title_en: Power cable reliability estimation method based on time varying stress-intensity interference model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power cable reliability estimation method based on a time varying stress-intensity interference model. The method includes power cable cumulative degradation model establishment, power cable cumulative degradation and cumulative degradation threshold rate distribution parameter acquisition, power cable time varying stress-intensity interference model establishment and power cable reliability estimation based on the time varying stress-intensity interference model establishment. The power cable cumulative degradation model establishment and the power cable cumulative degradation and cumulative degradation threshold rate distribution parameter acquisition are performed firstly, the power cable time varying stress-intensity interference model is established, and the reliability of medium-high voltage cables can be estimated through the power cable time varying stress-intensity interference model; by the aid of the method, the problems that the accuracy and reliability of the power cable reliability estimation are low in the prior art are solved effectively, the medium-high voltage cable state estimation is more scientific and meets the actual engineering conditions better, and the high practical significance is provided.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV WUHAN;BEIJING FUJIAANDA ELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Power system abnormal data identifying and correcting method based on time series analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system abnormal data identifying and correcting method based on time series analysis. The power system abnormal data identifying and correcting method includes data preprocessing, time series modeling, abnormal data identifying and abnormal data correcting. Data preprocessing includes the step of identifying and correcting missing data in data to be detected and data suddenly changing to be zero. Time series modeling comprises the steps of conducting time series analyzing on the preprocessed data to be detected and establishing a model according to the time series, and a difference autoregression moving average model is used for modeling the data to be detected. According to abnormal data identifying, the fitting residual series of the established difference autoregression moving average model is analyzed, an error confidence interval is set, and abnormal data are identified. According to abnormal data correcting, a neural network method is used for establishing a prediction model for correcting the abnormal data, the data value of the moment when the abnormal data exist is predicted, and the abnormal data are corrected. The power system abnormal data identifying and correcting method is easy to implement and high in accuracy.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: A kind of active bad data identification and modification method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of active bad data identification and modification methods, belong to electric system energy management, monitoring field.Method includes the following steps: one, according to real-time network topology structure situation, generate network blocks rule or call corresponding network blocks rule online from database, female net is divided into a series of subnets；Two, according to node, the active information of branch telemetering configuration and acquisition, active data initialization is carried out to female net and each subnet, fills the active information of each node, branch；Three, in cloud environment, distributed data check and correction inspection is carried out to each subnet, corrects suspicious data using redundancy；Four, female net integrates each subnet correction result and to pool identification is carried out, and corrects remaining suspicious data.The present invention overcomes " residual contamination " and " residual error is flooded " or computationally intensive disadvantages existing for standing state estimation.

title_en: A kind of electric power scheduling automatization system multi-source data check method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electric power scheduling automatization system multi-source data check methods, which is characterized in that includes the following steps：S01：The ID of the unique designation of each measuring point in electric power scheduling automatization system is set, the parameter and information table of each channel are set, wherein, the data ID of the gathered data of different channel same observation stations is the ID of measuring point；S02：Based on data ID in system, difference of the same observation station data between different acquisition channel and state estimation is compared in real time, wherein, the data of the source of trouble are not involved in comparing；S03：Difference values of each measuring point ID between different data sources is recorded, then count is incremented by this measuring point data inconsistent when difference value meets the condition of setting, and the inconsistent warning information of current measuring point ID multi-source datas is then sent out when counting the condition that meets setting.The risk of error in data that a large amount of multi-source data switching may be brought effectively is solved, the data for improving system check efficiency.

title_en: Reliable information transmission system used in scene where spacecraft meets blackout
abstract_en: The invention provides a reliable information transmission system used in the scene where a spacecraft meets a blackout. The reliable information transmission system comprises a sheath reflected signal measuring module, a sheath channel state estimation module and a sheath channel self-adaption transmission module, wherein the sheath reflected signal measuring module is used for sampling sheath reflected signals in real time and detecting the amplitude and phase of the sheath reflected signals; the sheath channel state estimation module is used for working out the amplitude and phase of forward signals in a backstepping mode according to the relevance of the sheath reflected signals and the forward signals, and predicting the channel state at the next moment according to the amplitude and phase of the forward signals; the sheath channel self-adaption transmission module is used for adjusting the sending power, modulation mode and encoding structure of an information sending end according to the real-time sheath channel state to realize reliable information transmission. The reliable information transmission system can measure the dynamic state characteristics of a sheath channel, relieve the influences of the dynamic state and realize reliable information transmission in the blackout scene.

title_en: Capacitor switching bus voltage increment recursive resolving method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a capacitor switching bus voltage increment recursive resolving method, which utilizes mth capacitor switching on/off information, and adopts a recursive formula for calculating voltage increment, which is calculated according to the formula shown in the description, of a bus BUSN connected with a capacitor when an m+1th reactive out-of-limit event occurs. In the formula, Um1 represents a voltage of the bus BUSN after the mth capacitor switching on/off, Um0 represents a voltage of the bus BUSN before the mth capacitor switching on/off, Q[N (m+1)] represents a rated capacity of a capacitor to be controlled remotely which is decided by the m+1th reactive out-of-limit event preliminarily, Q[Nm] represents a rated capacity of an action capacitor in mth reactive out-of-limit event, and U (m+1)0 represents a voltage of the bus BUSN in the m+1th reactive out-of-limit event. The capacitor switching bus voltage increment recursive resolving method utilizes structure parameters of the power grid and real-time information during the operating process of the power grid, reflects the influence of the variables on bus voltage increment more accurately, reduces the dependence on entire grid measurement accuracy and entire grid state estimation qualified rate since all calculation variables are measured locally within a transformer substation, reduces calculation cost, and improves real-time performance of AVC control.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Method for interpolating missing data in electric power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite model for interpolating missing data in an electric power system. The technical scheme is as follows: firstly, original data sets from the electric power system are classified into complete data sets and incomplete data sets; new incomplete data sets are produced by means of the obtained complete data sets, data filling is performed on the newly produced incomplete data sets with the multiple interpolation algorithm based on chained equations and the interpolation algorithm based on the random forest respectively, and corresponding filling errors are calculated; weights of various algorithms are determined through linear combination and minimization combination of the errors obtained with the algorithms; finally, data interpolation is performed on the original data sets with the algorithms, and final filling values are obtained through combination of filling data with the weights of the corresponding algorithms. The composite model is high in operability and adopts the multiple interpolation algorithm based on the chained equations and the interpolation algorithm based on the random forest, and interpolation of the missing data in the electric power system is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Comprehensive electric energy metering device state assessment method integrating safety domain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive electric energy metering device state assessment method integrating a safety domain. The method comprises steps of: generating initial data; giving factors which may possibly influence the data acquisition correctness of a metering device and which have large influences on state estimation; performing metering device network integral processing on the errors of the metering device and network loss, and performing virtual load and virtual network loss; performing analysis based on a safety domain method in order to obtain overall state estimation reliability judgement; analyzing key influence factors by using an AHP method or the like and performing state estimation based on the key influence factors. The method considers the time metering mode of the data acquisition of the electric energy metering device, improves the data acquisition reliability of the resident electric energy metering device, integrates the safety domain method, and understands a security boundary while performing state assessment.
assignees: INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Meteorological early warning method of power transmission line icing gallop disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a meteorological early warning method of power transmission line icing gallop disasters. The method includes the following steps that: a temperature tester, a humidity tester, a wind speed tester and a wind direction tester are arranged in an area to be measured; minimum temperature, relative humidity, wind speed and wind direction in the area are measured, and a meteorological factor prediction field data matrix related to an icing gallop risk analysis model is established; icing gallop risk prediction is performed on a corresponding area with measuring points which satisfy conditions that minimum temperature ranges from -4.0 to 0.5 DEG C, relative humidity ranges from 70% to 100%, wind speed ranges from 5.8 to 13.7 meters per second and wind direction is northeast; the data of each prediction lattice point is circulated, so that gallop risk trend analysis data of all prediction measuring points at current time can be obtained. With the method of the invention adopted, whether icing gallop distribution exists in a prediction area can be judged, and real-time update can be realized by means of numerical value prediction data. The meteorological early warning method has the advantages of high accuracy, high practicability, high reliability and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;WUHAN REGION CLIMATE CT

title_en: Portable intelligent toll -gate equipment based on radio communication and video identification technique
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable intelligent toll -gate equipment based on radio communication and video identification technique, including camera, license plate discernment host computer, host communication module, a plurality of portable removal parasite aircraft and backstage command and control server. The technical effects of the utility model comprises, through high definition digtal camera and license plate discernment, continuously obtain license plate information, the automatic identification license plate. License plate discernment host computer not only has the wide -area network but also have the LAN, and backstage command and control server is connected to the wide -area network, and portable removal parasite aircraft is connected to the LAN, when having mobile communication network, can the real -time update blacklist to with suspicion vehicle informational announcement backstage commander control system, even if good or happen suddenly under the emergency situation at the signal at the wide -area network, when not having mobile communication network, also can inform the parasite aircraft through local WIFI with suspicion vehicle information, also can normally work, and the system also can use in power failure or field from electrified source.
assignees: HUNAN ZHIYUAN AIJIAN COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Optimal transformation method for eliminating leverage points
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system automatic scheduling and particularly relates to an optimal transformation method for eliminating leverage points. The method comprises the steps of building a measurement equation on the basis of power system parameter measurement to calculate a Jacobian matrix H of power system state estimation; setting nodes with outgoing line degrees greater than 3 as leverage points, and marking the columns in the Jacobian matrix H corresponding to the nodes as columns in need of rotation if the nodes have node injection power measurement; calculating optimal rotation matrices corresponding to the columns in need of rotation, and multiplying the matrices to obtain an optimal rotation matrix Q of the Jacobian matrix; and obtaining an optimal expansion matrix S through solving an optimization problem, and performing the optimal transformation of the Jacobian matrix to obtain an optimal Jacobian matrix H' which equals SHQ. The method can effectively eliminate the leverage points, so that state estimation calculation thereafter can effectively inhibit poor data of the leverage points, and thus the method has good engineering application prospect.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELEC POWER;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method and system for line loss abnormal reason data mining and analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for line loss abnormal reason data mining and analysis. The method includes: establishing a line loss reason analysis standard, obtaining line loss resource information, conducting a line loss resource information analysis according to the line loss reason analysis standard, building a line loss basic information model, obtaining power grid business data, performing line loss abnormal reason data mining and relative information characteristic analysis according to the power grid business data, the line loss resource information, and the line loss basic information model, finding a large-probability reason for line loss anomaly, according to the idea of EMS and DMS state estimation, performing metering bad data identification, thereby correcting the large-probability reason for line loss anomaly, and obtaining the large-probability reason for line loss anomaly after correction. In the whole process, mining and analysis of the power grid business data and the practical condition of power grid line loss resources are performed, and accurate analysis of the line loss abnormal reason is realized.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: The hyperbolic cosine type maximal index square Robust filter method of POWER SYSTEM STATE
abstract_en: The invention discloses the hyperbolic cosine type maximal index square Robust filter methods for the POWER SYSTEM STATE for belonging to dispatching automation of electric power systems field.This method is the hyperbolic cosine type maximal index square robust state estimation good based on Robustness least squares, computational efficiency is high；Include the following steps: that step A. extracts the active active and idle, branch of electric system node injection and reactive power and node voltage amplitude parameter；Hyperbolic cosine type maximal index square robust state estimation model is established with this；Step B. utilizes primal-dual interior point algorithm, solves to the hyperbolic cosine type maximal index square robust state estimation model.The present invention effectively inhibits multiple bad datas including consistency bad data, it is shown that good Robustness least squares, and have very high computational efficiency, it is used widely.

title_en: Partition decoupling based distributed parallel computing method and system for distribution network state estimation
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a partition decoupling based distributed parallel computing method and system for distribution network state estimation. The method comprises: decoupling and partitioning a distribution network by using full measurement configuration as a boundary, performing block segmentation processing on state estimation by using a partition as an independent analysis unit, and then performing state estimation on a single partition of the distribution network by using a measurement transformation technology based on a branch current, thereby making up for the defect that voltage measurement is unable to be used in measurement transformation; and meanwhile constructing a layered structure of distributed parallel computing, introducing message-oriented middleware ZeroMQ, realizing N-N efficient communication in a distributed system by using different types of socket combinations, and realizing distributed parallel computing of whole network state estimation on a distributed parallel computing platform by using partition state estimation as a subtask. According to the method, applications are not enabled to directly communicate but communicate with the message-oriented middleware, loose coupling integration of the applications is realized, elastic scaling among a plurality of threads, kernels and host cases are supported, a distributed system framework is supported, and communications including inter-thread communication are supported by a uniform interface.
assignees: ZHUHAI XUJIZHI POWER NETWORK AUTOMATION CO LTD;ZHUHAI XJ ELECTRIC CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of detection system and its cooperation communicating and positioning method suitable for disaster assistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of detection system suitable for disaster assistance and its cooperation communicating and positioning methods.Rescue network is established in emergency relief base station, induces mobile phone connection and Primary Location；Relaying and real-time auxiliary positioning are carried out by hand-held detecting terminal, hand-held detecting terminal passes through private communication channel and emergency relief base station communication, it holds detecting terminal reception induction signal simultaneously to amplify to communication blind district detection, after detection and amplification is sent to emergency relief base station；Emergency relief base station real-time broadcast cellphone information is sent to hand-held detecting terminal, and hand-held detecting terminal extraction mobile phone signal information uploads in real time with own location information；After emergency relief base station receives the data that all hand-held detecting terminals upload in real time, all mobile phones in disaster region are repositioned and broadcasted in real time, real-time update target mobile phones position.The method of the present invention can be in a wide range of interior implementation multiple target rescue task, and substantially low compared with mobile base station equipment cost, positioning accuracy is high, highly practical.

title_en: Power grid model sharing method applicable to distributed computation of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid model sharing method applicable to distributed computation of a power system. The method comprises: constructing a power grid physical model applicable to multi-stage scheduling integrated distributed computation; performing local and global verification on a distributed integrated power grid model sequentially; performing distributed storage and redundancy backup on the power grid model that passes the verification; enabling the power grid physical model that passes the verification; and integrating a large power grid distributed network topology analysis function and a distributed state estimation function to a model management center, and accessing to the power grid physical model and a computation model according to different demands of applications. According to the method, existing storage resources of distributed deployment of each scheduling center are fully used, and physical distributed storage and logic centralized management are performed on the power grid physical model and the computation model by using a distributed data deployment policy, so that the power grid model is constructed. Based on a distributed database technology and a distributed file system technology, full-network instant sharing of the power grid physical model and the computation model is implemented.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Processing control method for low-voltage data in distribution network
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a processing control method for low-voltage data in a distribution network. The method comprises: fusing power grid elements of a distribution GIS medium-voltage public network and a marketing system medium-voltage public network, a power grid element of a medium-voltage private network and a marketing user side element, and establishing a low-voltage element; forming a distribution network integrating production elements, geographical information resources and marketing management by means of cross-system fusion; establishing a low-and-medium-voltage transaction process control mechanism and a version control mechanism that are triggered by multiple sources, so as to guarantee real-time update of the distribution network; extending a distribution network information management control and transaction process coverage range to distribution automation and auxiliary devices, thereby improving the accuracy of fault researching, determining and positioning of a rush-repairing command platform, shortening processing time of distribution faults and solving real-time change of power grid topology and accounts; and performing low-and-medium-voltage and user-level version control in combination with a distribution GIS red black map mechanism and by using a version publishing service of the present scheme, so as to maintain the technical effect of instant power grid update.
assignees: CHENGDU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP;XIAMEN EPGIS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Photovoltaic power station solar energy resource assessment and electric energy production calculating system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power station and provides a photovoltaic power station solar energy resource assessment and electric energy production calculating system and a method thereof. The method is characterized in that firstly, the system collects optical measured data of an area to be measured according to an optical measured command; secondly, the system detects integrity of the collected optical measured data according to the optical measured command, detects a program according to a preset rationality, detects whether the optical measured data is reasonable and marks a missing part and an unreasonable part of the optical measured data; and then, the system supplements the program according to missing data and supplements the missing part and the unreasonable part of the optical measured data; finally, the system carries out photovoltaic power station solar energy resource assessment and electric energy production calculation on the supplemented optical measured data. Aiming at data of an optical measured tower, integrity statistics is performed. The rationality of the optical measured data is detected. Interpolation is performed on reasonable data or the missing data and the data after interpolation is corrected. The system and the method can be well applied to the photovoltaic power station solar energy resource assessment and electric energy production calculation and are suitable for the solar energy resource assessment.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHENGDU ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Power transmission equipment state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission equipment state estimation method. The method comprises the following steps: according to advice given by an expert group, screening factors affecting stable operation of power transmission equipment, and determining disturbance factors corresponding to the factors and disturbance coefficients of the disturbance factors; classifying the disturbance factors according to a technical operation index, a control function index, a system reliability index and a system maintainability index, and establishing an evaluation index system for the stable operation of the power transmission equipment;  according to the evaluation index system, establishing a nerve network model, solving the nerve network model, and calculating an operation state value of the power transmission equipment; comparing the operation state value with a preset stable operation threshold to obtain a stable operation grade which the power transmission equipment is at; according to the stable operation grade which the power transmission equipment is at, giving a state early warning, and providing a maintenance strategy; arranging maintenance personnel to perform maintenance according to the maintenance strategy; and analyzing the maintenance result and reevaluating the stable operation grade of the power transmission equipment.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID YUCHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Energy efficiency prediction method of photovoltaic power generation system
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy efficiency prediction method of a photovoltaic power generation system. The energy efficiency prediction method comprises: a photovoltaic power generation system is divided into a photovoltaic array assembly, a direct-current cable assembly, a photovoltaic combiner box assembly, and an inverter assembly, and an output power of the photovoltaic array assembly, a power loss of the direct-current cable assembly, a power loss of the photovoltaic combiner box assembly, and a power loss of the inverter assembly are calculated respectively; and according to the output power of the photovoltaic array assembly, the power loss of the direct-current cable assembly, the power loss of the photovoltaic combiner box assembly, and the power loss of the inverter assembly, the energy efficiency of the photovoltaic power generation system can be calculated. With the method, an energy efficiency prediction result can be provided for station building site selection for an inbuilt photovoltaic power station and can be used as a theoretical reference. For the photovoltaic power station working normally, the operation state estimation and fault diagnosis of the photovoltaic station can be realized based on comparison of monitoring data and theoretical calculation, thereby providing a basis for utilizing the energy generated by the photovoltaic array to the greatest extent.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;NORTH CN ELEC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Control method and system for electricity stealing detection of medium and low voltage hybrid power distribution network
abstract_en: A control method and a system for electricity stealing detection of a medium and low voltage hybrid power distribution network comprise the following steps: setting a set M comprising n nodes to be checked in a selected medium-low voltage hybrid power distribution network and selecting the nodes to be checked M i Measuring and obtaining the power index value of the medium and low voltage hybrid power distribution network, setting the weight of the measured value, and performing state estimation calculation on the medium and low voltage hybrid power distribution network to obtain M i An active load estimation value of; will M i Comparing the active load estimation value with the actual measurement value, judging that M is the difference between the active load estimation value and the actual measurement value and is larger than or equal to a preset detection threshold value i The existence of electricity stealing behavior; selecting another M in the set M i Repeating the above operation process until all M in the set M are finished i And stopping the flow after judging whether the electricity stealing behavior exists or not. The invention solves the problems that the electricity stealing analysis result is inaccurate and even the electricity stealing user cannot be found by the way of prompting by a meter device or carrying out manual inspection on the spot periodically.
assignees: TIANJIN TRANSENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system load prediction method using fuzzy decision-based neural network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system load prediction method using a fuzzy decision-based neural network model. The method includes the following steps that: the degree of membership mui of historical load samples is obtained by using the fuzzy decision-based neural network model, and a historical sample membership degree curve is drawn; historical sample data of which the degree of membership is smaller than mui are removed, processing is performed, and therefore, samples which contain missing data and data that vary sharply can be basically eliminated; and after data pre-processing, an appropriate neural network model is selected, and change rules are found out based on the historical data of power load, and a power load neural network prediction model is established. According to the power system load prediction method using the fuzzy decision-based neural network model of the invention, the advantages of fuzzy decision and neural networks are combined, so that the convergence precision and convergence speed of the method can be both improved, and dependence on an initial value can be decreased, and therefore, the accuracy of prediction can be improved.
assignees: MAINTENANCE BRANCH JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A method of intelligent grid is optimized using SDN technologies
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method optimized to intelligent grid using SDN technologies, intelligent electric meter sends user information to router；User information is sent to interchanger by router；Controller issues flow table to interchanger, extracts user information；User information is uploaded to marketing application by controller by northbound interface；Marketing is using real-time update user data and preserves, and this month user is calculated at the end of month need to pay the electricity charge, and being transmitted to controller by northbound interface issues hint instructions；Controller directly controls power supply unit switch and implements to power off to user if not paying the fees in 3 working days of user；If user is continuous to pay the electricity charge, sends instructions under application of marketing, restored electricity by controller.The present invention provides flexible open interfaces, and more easily platform is provided for the rapid development of power grid；Original single charge mode can be replaced, has great advantage to energy saving and balanced power grid power load, is conducive to the progress for pushing social work.

title_en: Medium voltage distribution network evaluation method of urban power supply network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medium voltage distribution network evaluation method of an urban power supply network. The method comprises steps of (1) establishing a medium voltage distribution network circuit access standard; (2) establishing a quantification evaluation sheet by combining an evaluation standard; (3) examining a comparison and selection scheme and using a comparison and selection optimal scheme as a finial application scheme; and (4) according to actual conditions of the power grid after the scheme is implemented, verifying the actual occurrence conditions of the power grid and the medium voltage distribution network circuit access standard after the engineering is implemented, carrying out grading according to actual verification conditions, and feeding back scheme implementation results. According to the invention, all professional technical schemes are quantified and absorbed; construction standards of the power grid are determined; problems existing around the power grid are all considered; leading functions of power distribution network plans in power grid development are well developed; and while the implementation results are evaluated, conditions of the power grid are analyzed again. Thus, real-time updating of weak loops of the power grid is achieved.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: The probabilistic active power distribution network of injecting power containing node measures Optimal Configuration Method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of probabilistic active power distribution network of injecting power containing node to measure Optimal Configuration Method, the uncertainty contributed using dynamic probability density function to extensive charging electric vehicle load and photovoltaic generating system is modeled analysis, network observability of the active power distribution network after injecting power containing node is uncertain is analyzed from state estimation angle, establish the probabilistic active power distribution network of injecting power containing network node and measure Optimal Allocation Model, Optimal Allocation Model is measured to the active power distribution network using a kind of adaptive covariance matrix evolution strategy and optimizes solution, the data collection point allocation optimum scheme in the case of the complete Observable of network is ensured can be obtained.One aspect of the present invention be compensate for ignoring charging electric vehicle randomness and the intermittent deficiency of photovoltaic system output in current power distribution network Situation Awareness program, and theory support is provided for active power distribution network next step security evaluation；On the other hand it can further improve the economy of active power distribution network safe operation and control.

title_en: A kind of didactic distribution network status estimation adjustment location fast Optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of didactic distribution network status estimation adjustment location fast Optimizations, belong to network optimization algorithmic technique field.This method comprises: determining initial real-time measurement set element and pseudo- measurement set element；Forming amount direction finding amount, measuring in vector includes pseudo- measurement and real-time measurement, and puppet, which measures, to be made of all node powers, and real-time measurement is then made of the branch power of initial measurement set；It carries out state estimation and obtains the estimated value of state vector, find least important branch and most important branch wherein；It updates and measures set；If the evaluated error that the number of iterations is less than given threshold value and iteration is greater than the evaluated error of last iteration, then then select and；Otherwise terminate optimization process.Precision of state estimation can be improved in the present invention, while also avoiding the high problem of time complexity；There is preferable performance in terms of estimated accuracy and time complexity using the state estimation real-time measurement device allocation plan that the present invention obtains.

title_en: Power grid state estimation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid state estimation method and device. The method comprises the following steps of dividing a power grid into a plurality of subsystems, and determining connection nodes and internal nodes; acquiring first remote terminal unit (RTU) measurement data and power management unit (PMU) measurement data of each internal node and each connection node to obtain first acquisition data, inputting the first acquisition data into a preset first measurement model, and obtaining first estimation voltage vectors of each internal node and each connection node by a least square method; acquiring second PMU measurement data and the first estimation voltage vector of each connection node to obtain second acquisition data, inputting the second acquisition data into a preset second measurement model, and obtaining a second estimation voltage vector of each connection node through linear estimation; and carrying out power grid state estimation according to the first estimation voltage vector of each internal node and the second estimation voltage vector of each connection node to obtain a power grid state estimation result. By the method, the power grid estimation calculation speed is increased, the requirement of real-time control on a power grid is met more, and the power grid state estimation result is more accurate.
assignees: HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID ZHENGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: System, method, and program for managing charging electric power to electric vehicle
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system, method, and program for managing charging electric power to an electric vehicle which predict the feature amount of charge to electric vehicles in a given district and accurately predict demand for electric power in the district, as well as heighten the utilization of natural energy electric power generation and contribute to improving the quality of a smart community.SOLUTION: A data input unit 9 inputs past operation performance data when EV2, 4 in a smart community 1 are practically used. An operation state estimation unit 11 estimates the state of how EV2, 4 are practically used, on the basis of the past operation performance data of EV2, 4. A charge amount prediction unit 14 predicts the amount of charges to EV2, 4 on a discretionary prediction day by simulating the practical use of EV2, 4 using the estimation result of the operation state estimation unit 11. A charging schedule creation unit 18 creates a charging schedule 19 for EV2, 4 on the prediction day so as to raise the utilization of photovoltaic power generation (PV).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP

title_en: Energy efficiency management service system of power distribution network area
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy efficiency management service system of a power distribution network area. Functional modules of the system mainly comprise six functional modules, namely a distribution network data acquisition and monitoring module, a power distribution network analysis and control module, a power distribution network automation module, an energy efficiency management module, a power distributing equipment evaluating module and an energy consumption optimization module. The energy efficiency management service system is characterized in that the distribution network data acquisition and monitoring module performs functions of data acquisition, data processing and service calculation; the power distribution network analysis and control module performs functions of network modeling and topology, state estimation, load prediction, power distribution network operation data statistics and analysis, micro-grid energy management and operation ticket management. The power distribution network automation module performs power distribution room automation and feed line automation. The energy efficiency management module performs energy consumption data acquisition, energy consumption data statistics, energy consumption data analysis, energy consumption data evaluation, energy consumption early-warning and energy consumption prediction. The system architecture of the energy efficiency management service system accords with a big data platform logic architecture and is a relatively good intelligent commodity power distribution network solution.
assignees: WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: A kind of evaluation method and device of natural gas pipe network gas supplying reliability
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of evaluation methods and device of natural gas pipe network gas supplying reliability, are related to natural gas transmission technical field.Method includes：Establish the Capacity-network of gas distributing system；It determines first failure probability of each piping unit under each default failure mode, and determines first state distribution of each piping unit in a preset time；It determines the second failure probability of each natural gas station unit, and determines second state distribution of each natural gas station unit in a preset time；Capacity-network described in real-time update；Each user supply into gas distributing system determines the supply situation information of each user；The average deficency amount of the reliability and each user supplied to each user is determined according to the supply situation information of each user.Can be with the supply reliability of accurate evaluation gas distributing system under disturbance factor by the present invention, the supply quality for solving the problems, such as current natural gas pipe network is difficult to confirm.

title_en: Distribution network state estimation method based on semi-definite programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network state estimation method based on semi-definite programming. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps of step 1 establishing a mathematical description of a WLS (Weighted Least Squares) estimation problem; step 2 establishing a semi-definite programming model of the WLS estimation problem; step 3 determining a coefficient matrix of the semi-definite programming model; and step 4 solving. The distribution network state estimation method based on semi-definite programming has super-linear convergence and good precision, a computed result thereof is consistent to a computed result of the general WLS method, the obtained solution can be guaranteed to be globally optimal, the storage efficiency is improved and the computation complexity is greatly reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;SHANGHAI SAILING INFORMATION TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for establishing quantitative relationship of general power line loss rate influencing factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for establishing quantitative relationship of general power line loss rate influencing factors, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining the original indicator data which influence the general power line loss rate; verifying and correcting the anomaly data and missing data in the original indicator data in and conducting a smooth and stable process to these data; verifying the processed data to determine a model; introducing an adjustment effect by regarding other variables except investment that affect the line loss rate as regulatory variables; using a panel data model to fit the data and using the significance of the variable coefficient as the judging criterion to discard variables that do not pass the significance test and to re-fit the remaining variables so that after several rounds of significance test, all variables pass the significance test; and after several times of fitting and screening, outputting the quantitative relationship between the general power line loss rate and various indicator data.
assignees: BEISE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD;HUBEI STATE GRID HUAZHONG TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network situation perception method based on multivariate time-space information modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power distribution network situation perception method based on multivariate spatio-temporal information modeling, which is used for perception of the situation of an intelligent power distribution network for the first time, and aims to deeply excavate and effectively utilize state information and measurement information of the power network in consideration of the development of potential connection and inherent characteristics of the power network; meanwhile, the node voltage amplitude and the node voltage phase angle with higher precision obtained by modeling are used as virtual measurement information, so that the measurement redundancy of the power distribution network is increased, the convergence speed and the convergence precision of state estimation of the power distribution network are improved, the state estimation time is shortened, and the possibility is provided for online estimation of the intelligent power distribution network; finally, safety and stability analysis is carried out on the real-time state and the future state of the power distribution network, potential risks of the power distribution network at the future moment are pre-judged, and reference is provided for system scheduling and system decision.

title_en: Main and distribution network integrated distributed state estimation method based on two-stage method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a main and distribution network integrated distributed state estimation method based on a two-stage method, which comprises the following steps: establishing a main and distribution network integrated state estimation model; decoupling a distribution network model of the integrated state estimation model of the main distribution network into a plurality of subsystems; establishing a linear relation between the state quantity of the main and distribution networks before decoupling and the state quantity in the decoupled subsystem; independently carrying out state estimation on the decoupled subsystems in a distributed mode; and establishing a state estimation model for state estimation by taking the linear relation of the state quantities of the main network and the distribution network before and after decoupling as a measurement equation to obtain the integrated state of the main network and the distribution network. The method provided by the invention reduces the calculated amount, effectively and accurately solves the problem of the disaster of the integrated state estimation dimension of the main network and the distribution network caused by the huge network scale of the distribution network, can obtain the consistent and accurate real-time state of the main network and the distribution network, provides basic data for the analysis and calculation of the integration of the main network and the distribution network, and further improves the operation reliability of the integration of the main network and the distribution network.

title_en: Hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the electric power system scheduling automation field, especially relates to a hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation method. The hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation method comprises the steps that a hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation basic model is established, and by using a primal-dual interior point algorithm, the hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation is solved. The hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation method is advantageous in that strong robust performance and high calculation efficiency are provided, and leverage point adverse data is inhibited, and a good engineering application prospect is provided.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: A kind of electric-thermal coupling multipotency flow network method for estimating state
