abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of calculation method of Power Network Status Estimation precision based on cloud SCADA big data, comprising steps of S1: establishing and obtains the deep neural network model of Power Network Status Estimation precision using the training of Adam algorithm；S2: the network system measurement z of Power Network Status Estimation precision to be calculated is acquired；S3: the network system measurement z of acquisition is brought into the deep neural network model that training obtains, the Power Network Status Estimation error predicted, that is, the Power Network Status Estimation precision predicted；The present invention is by establishing deep neural network model, with the trend section basis of actual electric network, generate the data set of system measurements and state estimation error, off-line training is carried out to deep neural network model, obtain the on-line prediction model of Power Network Status Estimation error, it solves the problems, such as that the true value of network system state variable is difficult to obtain to assess Power Network Status Estimation precision, can accurately learn the error of system state estimation, and computation complexity is lower.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Brainy remote terminal unit for flood forecast/warning and rainfall prediction method and fire/inundation related alarm transmission method using the same
title_ko: 홍수 예/경보를 위한 브레이니 rtu 및 이를 이용한 강우 예측 방법과 화재/침수 관련 알람 전송 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a brainy RTU for flood forecast/warning, a rainfall prediction method and a fire/flooding-related alarm transmission method using the same. The brainy RTU for flood forecast/warning comprises: an RTU-side measurement data reception module for receiving water level data and rainfall data measured in a water level and rainfall sensor; and a measurement data transmission module for transmitting the water level data and rainfall data received from the RTU-side measurement data reception module to a user terminal in real time for flood forecast/warning. According to the present invention, the brainy RTU is installed in a place where flooding or flood of dam, stream, lake, reservoir or the like easily occurs, thereby improving accuracy and speed of a flood forecast/warning for flood in a local area or place and being effective for management and maintenance of an RTU. In addition, the brainy RTU for flood forecast/warning is configured to manage water in real time by detecting water quality, weather and the like of reservoir or dam, thereby having an effect of checking reduction of the water quality or danger of water pollution in real time to take measures. In particular, the brainy RTU for flood forecast/warning can increase prediction accuracy of flood forecast/warning by predicting flood forecast/warning through communications data missing by a rainfall attenuation phenomenon during satellite communications, predicting rainfall by data analysis of a weather sensor, and predicting rainfall through analysis of an image of a CCTV camera. Also, the brainy RTU for flood forecast/warning is configured to transmit fire/flooding-related alarm based on fire data and flooding data, and to check whether a problem occurs in flood forecast/warning equipment including the brainy RTU by directly checking whether fire/flooding occurs through a CCTV camera, thereby contributing to stable operation of a flood forecast/alarm system.
abstract_ko: 홍수 예/경보를 위한 브레이니 RTU 및 이를 이용한 강우 예측 방법과 화재/침수 관련 알람 전송 방법이 개시된다. 수위 센서 및 우량 센서에서 측정된 수위 데이터 및 우량 데이터를 수신하는 RTU측 측정 데이터 수신 모듈; 상기 RTU측 측정 데이터 수신 모듈에서 수신된 수위 데이터 및 우량 데이터를 홍수 예/경보를 위해 사용자 단말로 실시간 송신하는 측정 데이터 송신 모듈을 구성한다. 상술한 구성에 의하면, 댐, 하천, 호수 또는 저수지 등의 침수나 홍수가 발생하기 쉬운 장소에 브레이니 RTU를 설치하고 이를 통해 국지적 지역이나 장소에서 홍수에 대한 홍수 예/경보의 정확성과 신속성을 높이고 RTU의 관리와 유지보수에도 효과가 있다.  또한, 저수지나 댐의 수질과 기상 등을 감지하여 실시간 물 관리를 하도록 구성됨으로써, 수질 저하나 수질 오염의 위험성을 실시간으로 확인하고 조치를 취할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 특히, 위성통신 시 강우 감쇠 현상에 의한 통신 데이터 결측을 통해 예측하고, 습도센서, 기상센서의 데이터 분석에 의해 강우를 예측하고, CCTV 카메라의 영상 분석을 통해 강우 예측을 하도록 구성됨으로써, 홍수 예/경보의 예측 정확도를 높이는 효과가 있다. 그리고 화재 데이터 및 침수 데이터를 기반으로 화재/침수 관련 알람을 송신하도록 구성하고, CCTV 카메라를 통해 화재/침수 여부를 직접 확인하여 브레이니 RTU를 포함한 홍수 예/경보 장비의 문제 발생 여부를 확인하여 홍수 예/경보 시스템의 안정적인 운영에 기여한다.
assignees: MIREROTACK CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method based on APSO-BP
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network state estimation method based on APSO-BP, which comprises the following steps: s1: calling power distribution network state data; s2: establishing a time sequence correlation data model; s3: constructing an APSO-BP network model; s4: and outputting the power distribution network state estimation result. The power distribution network state data comprise power distribution network historical data and power distribution network real-time measurement data, and a pseudo measurement model is established by respectively acquiring power distribution network operation information and line tidal volume measurement information from a historical database and branch power measurement data information from a real-time measurement database; by adopting the technical scheme, the voltage amplitude and the phase angle of the power distribution station area can be effectively estimated, voltage offset data support can be provided for the comprehensive evaluation index of the power distribution station area, and an effective reference voltage boundary is provided for operation risk pre-judgment, power sharing scheduling and related decision making.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG PINGHU POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Failure prediction method based on machine learning
abstract_en: Failure prediction method based on machine learning is related to power grid power supply and sets field, especially a kind of by data monitoring, adjustment, comparison, realizes that monitoring device voluntarily learns to adjust, the failure prediction method based on machine learning predicted line defct.The present invention includes data monitoring, comparing, failure prediction and prediction four modules of adjustment, the operation data of data monitoring module monitors supply network, it is analysed and compared by data comparing module, in comparison process, prediction data is corrected by prediction adjustment module, prediction data is analyzed, the exception that will be generated is sounded an alarm by failure prediction module.The present invention is by training supply network operation data to it, evolution algorithm is introduced simultaneously, realize analysis result being mutually authenticated with real-time running data, the error between analysis result and real time data for analyzing supply network data reaches tolerance interval, to use analysis modified result abnormal data or amended record missing data, the influence of data exception is solved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ubiquitous power Internet of things monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ubiquitous power Internet of things monitoring method, which belongs to the field of power grid control and comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time data of each unit in the ubiquitous power Internet of things by using data acquisition equipment; creating a corresponding digital twin model according to the real-time data; and comparing and interacting the digital twin model with a normal state, and monitoring the ubiquitous power Internet of things in real time. The invention can dynamically monitor the power Internet of things of each region in real time.

title_en: A kind of capacitance type equipment failure prediction method based on random forests algorithm
abstract_en: A kind of capacitance type equipment failure prediction method based on random forests algorithm of the disclosure of the invention, belongs to artificial intelligence field, especially power transformation, the failure prediction of capacitance apparatus.The present invention is extremely huge using data volume, cleans first to data, and by redundant data, repeated data is deleted, and carries out unification to data format, missing data is filled up, and wrong data is modified；Then data are encoded, using coding input prediction model, prediction model is trained, prediction target device in real time is carried out using trained prediction model.Precision of prediction of the present invention is high, and real-time is good.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA

title_en: Adaptive non-intrusion type load recognition methods based on random forest
abstract_en: Adaptive non-intrusion type load recognition methods based on random forest, including establish power load property data base；Required load characteristic is extracted from each handover event；After gained load characteristic is normalized, sample point needed for obtaining；Sample point is handled by unknown pattern identification module, distributes " known " label or " unknown " label for sample point；All labels are " known " sample point, obtain recognition result using random forests algorithm；All labels are " unknown " sample point, and by on-line talking resume module, if generating new cluster, user can choose whether class label distributing to cluster；The new cluster of tape label updates random forest by online updating module and unknown pattern identification module is updated existing knowledge;" unknown point " obtains recognition result by new random forest.The load of easy mistake classification can be identified as " unknown " by the present invention, and correctly identification is completed after obtaining new knowledge, may advantageously facilitate effective identification of unknown load pattern.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Methods and apparatus incorporating topology error estimation for management of an electric power system
abstract_en: An electric power system includes an energy management system configured to control a generated power output level of one or more electric generator resources, and a configuration of two or more high-voltage transmission lines, for efficient operation based, at least in part, on a topology error estimation using binary values corresponding to switch statuses. Increased accuracy of network topology estimates facilitates improved state estimation, which in turn enables production of more highly optimized control of electric generator resources and configuration of high-voltage transmission lines.
assignees: SIEMENS INDUSTRY INC

title_en: Private network mirroring
abstract_en: Techniques for private network mirroring are described. Users can select one or more existing private networks to be mirrored in the same or different network area. Any network configuration changes made in the selected private network (e.g., “master” private network) can be propagated automatically to the mirror private network. This enables users to utilize resources in another network area for disaster recovery, ensuring that the network configuration of the mirror private network is consistent with the master private network through real-time updates. Additionally, users managing infrastructure that includes multiple private networks can select one master private network and propagate configuration changes to other private networks, reducing management overhead incurred by these multi-private network installations.
assignees: AMAZON TECH INC

title_en: State estimation method based on SDAE-ELM pseudo-measurement model
abstract_en: The invention provides a state estimation method based on SDAE-ELM pseudo-metrology modeling, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data in the power system, and establishing and training to obtain an SDAE-ELM pseudo-measurement model; normally fitting the error between the output of the model and the real values of the real part and the imaginary part of the voltage, and establishing a pseudo-measurement error model to obtain a pseudo-measurement error variance; during state estimation, SCADA measurement data are obtained, power measurement of the SCADA measurement data is used as input of an SDAE-ELM pseudo measurement model, and output is used as a pseudo measurement value; converting PMU measurement data into real part and imaginary part forms under a rectangular coordinate system to be used as PMU virtual measurement; and inputting the pseudo measurement value, the pseudo measurement error variance and the virtual measurement of the PMU into a linear state estimation model. The method has higher fault-tolerant capability on the SCADA with poor measurement and higher state estimation precision result under the condition of ensuring the state estimation speed.

title_en: Monitoring data processing method for earthquake prediction, and earthquake prediction method and system
abstract_en: A monitoring data processing method for earthquake prediction, and an earthquake prediction method and system, relating to the field of disaster warning. Said method comprises: arranging monitoring points in a region to be monitored; monitoring the characteristics of the charged particles overflowing from the earth surface on the monitoring points, so as to obtain measurement data related to the characteristics of the charged particles; analyzing the measurement data; acquiring a statistic value according to the analysis result; comparing the current statistic value with a previous statistic value; and acquiring, according to the comparison result, a fluctuation characterizing the change in the measurement data, so as to realize earthquake prediction of the region to be monitored. It is innovatively proposed to realize full-day monitoring of earthquake and real-time updating of data by monitoring charged particles overflowing from the earth surface, and thus an earthquake prediction can be issued in a timely manner by means of the analysis of data. The present invention enables people in an epicentral region to begin to take measures against the danger in advance, reducing personal casualty and property damage to the public.
assignees: UNIV PEKING SHENZHEN GRADUATE SCHOOL

title_en: Electric-gas-thermal coupling network dynamic state estimation method based on Kalman filtering
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric-gas-thermal coupling network dynamic state estimation method based on Kalman filtering, belongs to the technical field of electric power system analysis and monitoring, and aims to solve the problems existing in the existing electric-gas-thermal coupling network dynamic state estimation. And the new heat load and temperature state quantities obtained by the dynamic state estimation of the heat energy network provide a new data source for the state estimation of the hydraulic network at the next time.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Power system false data detection method based on improved Kalman filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a false data detection method of a power system based on improved Kalman filtering, which belongs to the field of power system safety and comprises the following steps of evaluating different nodes of the power system by using a K-means clustering method according to stability: the measuring instrument collects the measurement value of the SCADA, dynamic state estimation is carried out on the measurement value by using an improved self-adaptive unscented Kalman filtering method, different detection schemes are adopted for different nodes, detection can be more targeted, the fading factor is changed in a self-adaptive mode by using the covariance of a residual sequence to adjust the measurement value, the influence of the previous measurement value and an inaccurate system model on prediction precision is reduced, the noise and the measurement noise covariance in the process of dynamic adjustment of self-adaptive rules are introduced on the basis to improve the filtering performance of the UKF algorithm, so that the prediction is more accurate, deliberately hidden false data are detected, bias detection is further carried out on the fragile nodes, and the detection result can be more reliable.

title_en: Electric power equipment planning assistance system
abstract_en: An electric power equipment planning assistance system according to the present invention is provided with an electric power equipment information acquisition unit, a maintenance history information acquisition unit, a tidal current calculation unit, a system information acquisition unit, an equipment-state estimation unit, and a system-state change unit. The electric power equipment information acquisition unit acquires information about specifications of electric power equipment. The maintenance history information acquisition unit acquires maintenance information about the electric power equipment. The tidal current calculation unit calculates tidal current information about an electric power system. The system information acquisition unit acquires measurement information indicative of a state of the electric power system. The equipment-state estimation unit estimates a deterioration state of the electric power equipment on the basis of the specification information, maintenance information, tidal current information, and measurement information. The system-state change unit changes, on the basis of an estimation result provided by the equipment-state estimation unit, the state of configuration of the electric power system such that a result different from said estimation result can be expected. In addition, the equipment-state estimation unit estimates a deterioration state of the electric power equipment in the electric power system every time the state of configuration is changed by the system-state change unit.
assignees: TOSHIBA KK;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEMS & SOLUTIONS CORP

title_en: Ubiquitous power Internet of things perception data missing repairing method based on matrix filling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a matrix filling-based ubiquitous power Internet of things perception data missing repairing method, which comprises the following steps: reconstructing the measured one-dimensional time sequence data into a matrix form through slice transformation; acquiring a low-rank strength index for verifying data recovery feasibility; the structural characteristics of different components of the measured data are considered, an optimization model for recovering missing data is established based on a low-rank matrix filling theory, various noises are restrained through a matrix norm, and the influence of the noises is eliminated; and obtaining an iterative calculation formula of the fast solving model by improving an alternative direction multiplier method, and realizing the recovery of the missing measurement data. Under the condition that the measured data are partially lost and various types of noises such as Gaussian noise, spike abnormal values and the like are mixed, the originally complete measured data are recovered based on the low-rank matrix filling theory, and further the completion of the lost data is realized.

title_en: Intelligent pipeline landslide monitoring pile assembly, monitoring network system and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent pipeline landslide monitoring pile assembly, a monitoring network system and a monitoring method. The pipeline landslide intelligent monitoring pile assembly comprises 1 mother pile and more than 1 subsidiary pile which are mutually communicated and connected, a communication device, a data acquisition instrument, a power supply device and other components are fixed on a mother pile mounting column, and all the components are in necessary circuit connection and communication connection; the mounting column of the sub-pile is a hollow part, a communication device, a data acquisition instrument, an angle sensor, a displacement sensor and the like are fixed on the outer wall of the upper section, and necessary circuit connection and communication connection are formed among all the parts. The intelligent monitoring component and the monitoring network are high in monitoring refinement degree and data availability, and the obtained data have the data characteristics of the distributed monitoring network. Pipeline landslide intelligent monitoring network system includes host computer and at least a set of pipeline landslide intelligent monitoring stake subassembly, female stake and host computer communication connection. The monitoring method utilizes a data assimilation platform to process and arrange monitoring data, adopts a two-step assimilation and classification label data processing method to convert two-dimensional monitoring data into a four-dimensional database of a monitoring slope body, more scientifically and comprehensively displays the geological change characteristics of the slope surface, and provides more decision information for disaster monitoring and prevention.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;SOUTH CHINA BRANCH OF SINOPEC SALES CO LTD

title_en: Disaster situation optimal escape path planning algorithm based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster optimal escape path planning algorithm based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: acquiring building related entrance and exit information by using a digital twin technology, wherein the building related entrance and exit information comprises entrance and exit position information, entrance and exit people flow information and building floor height, setting related entrance information as a state S, setting corresponding actions made in the state S as an action A, setting benefits brought by the corresponding actions made in the state S as an action R, and setting a benefit matrix R and analyzing an optimal route from the benefit matrix.
assignees: WENZHOU DESIGN ASSEMBLY COMPANY LTD;WENZHOU EXPLORATION&SURVEY INST

title_en: Bad data identification method for electric heating interconnection system based on Lagrange state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric heating interconnection system bad data identification method based on Lagrange state estimation, which comprises the following steps: (1) acquiring electric network information and heat supply network information of an electric-heat interconnection comprehensive energy system; (2) establishing and solving an electricity-heat interconnection comprehensive energy system Lagrange state estimation model considering equality constraint; (3) calculating a residual sensitivity matrix and a regularized residual of each measurement; (4) setting a maximum regularization residual threshold, judging whether the maximum value of the regularization residual exceeds the limit, and if so, judging that the measured position defective data is located and removing the measured position defective data; (5) and (5) returning to the steps (2), (3) and (4) until the maximum value of the regularization residual error is smaller than a set threshold value. The invention can reduce the number of key measurement in the system and effectively identify various bad data in the electric-heat interconnection comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Bad data detection method and system for distribution feeder voltage measurement data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bad data detection of power distribution network operation measured data, in particular to a system and a method for detecting bad data of power distribution feeder voltage measured data. The invention adopts a weighted least square method to estimate all node voltages on the power distribution feeder line, constructs pseudo measurement data for state estimation according to data requirements, and finds out the maximum deviation of a measured value and an estimated value to distinguish bad data in all node voltage measurement data of the feeder line. And then analyzing the voltage measurement data by adopting a multi-fractal detrending fluctuation analysis method, judging whether the voltage measurement data has long-term correlation, extracting data points with extremely small influence on the fluctuation of the voltage measurement data on the basis of judging that the voltage measurement data has the long-term correlation, and searching a steep change point of the fluctuation trend of the voltage measurement data as a bad data detection threshold value point. The invention can detect bad data in all node voltage measurement data in the distribution feeder line, and obtain node voltage distribution with smaller error.

title_en: Power grid data quality improvement method based on data correlation
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid data quality improving method based on data correlation, which comprises the steps of S1, obtaining data flow; s2, preprocessing the data; s3, judging whether the data have continuity in time, if so, jumping to S4, and if not, jumping to S5; s4, judging whether the data has regularity in time, if so, jumping to S6, and if not, jumping to S7; s5, judging whether the missing data scale of the data exceeds a preset threshold value, if so, jumping to S8, and if not, jumping to S9; s6, complementing the missing data with the corresponding data before by using the time correlation; s7, carrying out interpolation completion on the missing data by using the peripheral data of the missing data; s8, directly discarding the group of data; and S9, setting the missing data to zero. According to the power grid data quality improving method based on the data correlation, the quality of data acquired by the power internet of things terminal layer data sensing equipment can be improved, and therefore stability and controllability of data service are guaranteed.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NANJING AERONAUTICS & ASTRONAUTICS

title_en: Phase modulator remote diagnosis system based on ubiquitous power internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phase modifier remote diagnosis system based on a ubiquitous power Internet of things technology, which comprises an equipment ledger database, a standard database, a historical database, an evaluation model database, a fault diagnosis model database, a remote expert diagnosis database, online monitoring equipment, a workflow engine, a communication device and a management server. The invention takes the power grid as a hub, and constructs a data center through technologies such as a data warehouse, data replication and the like, thereby realizing the sharing and exchange of all information data; processing abnormal values, data standardization, data generalization and data aggregation are realized through data conversion, and then reasoning work of a fault diagnosis knowledge base is realized; the method has the advantages that various indexes in operation, production and management of the phase modulator are subjected to integrated index analysis by using a data warehouse and a data mining technology, a safety early warning evaluation system based on mass data is established, the healthy operation of the phase modulator can be guaranteed by combining a system operation state estimation technology, and refined prediction and coordination control are realized.
assignees: JIANGSU FANGTIAN POWER TECH CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for estimating the state of a power system, and belongs to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the following steps: calling a measurement prediction model to process the power data of the first node to obtain first measurement data; acquiring second measurement data of a second node; and calculating a power system state estimation value through a line state estimation algorithm according to the first measurement data and the second measurement data. The power data of the first node are processed by calling the measurement prediction model to obtain first measurement data, and the first measurement data are vector data used for indicating the voltage of the first node, so that the state estimation value of the power system can be obtained by calculating through a linear state estimation algorithm based on the first measurement data and the collected second measurement data, and the nonlinear equation does not need to be solved through multiple iterations, so that the calculation speed is increased.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Data integrity attack detection method in power system dynamic state estimation
abstract_en: The invention provides a data integrity attack detection method in power system dynamic state estimation, which comprises the steps of injecting an attack vector into measured data of a power system, training a deep circulation neural network by adopting the measured data containing the attack vector, mapping the input layer of the deep circulation neural network to the output of a middle layer to form a feature extractor, extracting the feature of the measured data and combining with a label of the measured data to optimize a constructed combined classifier, extracting the space-time feature of intelligent power grid measured information by utilizing the circulation neural network, and combining with a plurality of classifiers to jointly detect the data integrity attack of the power system.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Method for predicting medium and long term load of urban power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting medium and long term load of an urban power grid, which comprises the following steps: (1) calling historical load data of the urban power grid, and determining key influence factors of the urban power grid power load according to the change condition of the historical load data and the external influence condition at the change moment; (2) constructing a medium-term and long-term power load prediction model according to the key influence factors of the urban power grid power load determined in the step (1); (3) selecting training data from a historical power load database of the urban power grid; (4) performing preliminary data cleaning on the selected load sequence, wherein the preliminary data cleaning comprises sequence noise suppression, missing data repair and abnormal data correction; (5) the data are subjected to constraint processing, parameters of the power load prediction model are set, and the model is trained according to training data; (6) and according to a load prediction equation obtained after model training, performing medium-long term prediction on the power load of the urban power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Water affair decision auxiliary analysis system
abstract_en: According to the water affair decision-making auxiliary analysis system, the data receiving module receives water supply pump station operation parameter data and water level data of a water tower detected by corresponding sensors on site, abnormal data are corrected, missing data are processed by adopting a data interpolation method, the precision and the integrity of the data are improved, the processed data are quantized in a normalization mode, and then the data enter the trend prediction module, the change trend of the water supply quantity difference value and the change trend of the pump operation state are predicted by adopting a trend extrapolation method, the possibility of water leakage and water pump operation failure is predicted, and the water leakage and the water pump operation failure can be found conveniently in time; the decision auxiliary module corrects the power of the pump according to the water supply quantity difference of the water supply pipe network and the variation trend of the pump operation state, performs power loss analysis on the pump according to the variation trend of the pump operation state and performs water loss analysis according to the water quantity difference trend, and quantifies the maintenance or replacement of pipelines and pumps in currency units, thereby realizing the benefit maximization of equipment management.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU LITONG WATER CO LTD

title_en: Distributed state estimation method for active power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed state estimation method for an active power distribution network, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: partitioning the power grid based on the network topology structure of the power grid and the type of new energy power generation to obtain a plurality of expansion sub-areas; performing independent state estimation calculation based on a convolutional neural network on each subregion of the power grid; inputting real-time measurement data according to the trained convolutional neural network model to complete the state estimation of the current system; comparing the state estimation results of each important node in the boundary nodes; and integrating the state estimation results of all the sub-areas to complete the state estimation of the whole network. The advantages are that: the method can solve the problems of long calculation time, high hardware requirement and uncertainty of new energy power generation of the traditional least square estimation, and can well detect bad data of important nodes in the power grid by a distributed state estimation method.
assignees: JIAYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Secure distributed state estimation for networked microgrids
abstract_en: Systems, methods, techniques and apparatuses of networked microgrids are disclosed. One exemplary embodiment is a method for removing false data from a networked microgrid system including: calculating a first local state estimation with the microgrid control system; calculating a plurality of global state estimations with the microgrid control system and the plurality of microgrids; determining the plurality of global state estimations did not converge; detecting false data in a first global state estimation of the plurality of global state estimations calculated with the microgrid control system using the microgrid control system and the plurality of microgrids; and removing the first global state estimation from the plurality of global state estimations; and iteratively updating the remaining global state estimations of the plurality of global state estimations with the microgrid control system and the plurality of microgrids until the remaining global state estimations of the plurality of global state estimations converge.
assignees: ABB SCHWEIZ AG;HITACHI ENERGY LTD

title_en: Power distribution station energy-saving loss-reducing method based on load prediction and phase sequence optimization
abstract_en: A power distribution station energy-saving loss-reducing method based on load prediction and phase sequence optimization comprises the following steps: collecting data of a power distribution station area; filling missing data values by using an EM algorithm; using real data of phase modulation day and day, using three-phase current of an outlet of a distribution area as a daily load curve of each phase, and calculating the line load flow by using a forward-backward substitution method to obtain the theoretical line loss of the distribution area; based on historical data, predicting outlet three-phase current of a phase modulation day and daily electric quantity of each user in a power distribution station area by using an Elman neural network; establishing an optimal commutation mathematical model with the goals of lowest line loss of a power distribution station area and minimum commutation times in the commutation process, and solving by using a genetic algorithm to obtain phase sequences of each user after phase modulation; and comparing the line loss of the user before and after the phase sequence is adjusted with the three-phase unbalance degree change. The method can effectively predict the operation data of the power distribution station area and is applied to the phase sequence adjustment of the power distribution station area, so that the station area can realize energy conservation and loss reduction.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: PMU false data injection attack prevention method based on machine learning
abstract_en: A PMU false data injection attack defense method based on machine learning belongs to the technical field of intelligent power grid information security. The method comprises the steps of S01, constructing a minimum observable PMU distributed measurement configuration system according to the power grid topological structure and the line parameters; step S02, injecting malicious data into PMU measurement configuration in an attack mode, and constructing a PMU distributed measurement configuration system state estimation model to obtain a plurality of observation phasors; step S03, constructing a training set and a test set which are composed of observation phasors with security or attacked labels; step S04, machine learning is carried out on the training set, and a PMU defense false data injection attack detection model is obtained; step S05, inputting the data of the test set to the PMU for defending against false data injection attack detection model, and predicting whether the observed phasor is measured normally or under attack. The invention has the advantages of high detection speed, high detection precision and difficult omission detection and false detection.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Power distribution network electric energy transaction and verification method based on distributed account book and state estimation
abstract_en: According to the power distribution network electric energy transaction and verification method based on the distributed account book and the state estimation, the indirect measurement of the user electric energy is realized by adopting the high-frequency power distribution network state estimation calculation, and the electric energy transaction and verification method based on the distributed account book is established. The method does not depend on traditional metering equipment such as an intelligent ammeter and the like, and accurate user electric energy statistics is realized; based on an intelligent contract technology on a distributed account book, the reporting, transaction and verification of system and user electric energy data in an electric power market environment are realized, and the method has the characteristics of high safety and stability, no tampering, traceability of transaction and the like.

title_en: Short-term load prediction method for urban power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting short-term load of an urban power grid, which comprises the following steps: (1) calling historical load data of the urban power grid, and determining key influence factors of the urban power grid power load according to the change condition of the historical load data and the external influence condition at the change moment; (2) constructing a short-term power load prediction model according to the key influence factors of the urban power grid power load determined in the step (1); (3) selecting training data from a historical power load database of the urban power grid; (4) performing preliminary data cleaning on the selected load sequence, wherein the preliminary data cleaning comprises sequence noise suppression, missing data repair and abnormal data correction; (5) the data are subjected to constraint processing, parameters of the power load prediction model are set, and the model is trained according to training data; (6) and according to a load prediction equation obtained after model training, carrying out short-term prediction on the power load of the urban power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Constraint optimization-based missing energy consumption data filling method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power energy data, and particularly relates to a method for filling missing energy consumption data based on constraint optimization. According to the method, a KNN thought is utilized, DTW is used as similarity measurement, and the time sequence similarity curves of the front K pieces and the time sequence with missing data are extracted in unequal long-time sequence concentration; then, by minimizing the Euclidean distance between the filling value of the missing interval and the K similar curves, and taking the sum of the filling values equal to a fixed value as constraint, the problem is converted into a continuous equality constraint optimization problem; and finally solving by a Larre multiplier method to complete filling. The method can effectively fill up missing energy consumption data, reduce data blind areas and provide effective data reference for decision-making personnel; the filled missing energy consumption data meet the constraint that the sum of the intervals is fixed, so that the filled data are more accurate and reasonable.
assignees: UNIV FUDAN

title_en: Multi-objective optimization-based power generation equipment operation condition library construction method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for constructing a power generation equipment operation condition library based on multi-objective optimization, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical working condition data of power generation equipment; establishing a multi-objective optimization model by taking the minimum estimation error and the minimum estimation time as targets when the multi-element state estimation is carried out by utilizing a power generation equipment operation condition library; the multi-target optimization model is solved by using a multi-target genetic algorithm to obtain an optimal clustering class number, and then a power generation equipment operation condition library is obtained, wherein the power generation equipment operation condition library is obtained by using a data clustering algorithm to extract typical operation conditions of the historical operation condition data based on the optimal clustering class number, the number of the typical operation conditions in the power generation equipment operation condition library is equal to the optimal clustering class number, the extraction of the operation condition library can be completed from the angle of multi-target optimization by constructing the multi-target optimization model and using the multi-target genetic algorithm for optimization, and the estimation precision is high and the operation time is short when the multi-target optimization is carried out by using the operation condition library.
assignees: NORTH CN ELEC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Power load data interpolation method based on error feedback
abstract_en: The invention discloses an error feedback-based power load data interpolation method, which relates to the technical field of missing data interpolation in a power system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method and system based on information matrix sparse solution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for estimating the state of a power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring telemetering and remote signaling data of primary equipment of the power system in real time; constructing a node branch model of the power system; determining non-zero element distribution of an active Jacobian matrix according to the node branch model, and determining non-zero element distribution of an active information matrix; performing node optimization numbering based on active information matrix non-zero element distribution; calculating an active Jacobian matrix and a reactive Jacobian matrix according to the new node sequence to obtain a new active information matrix and a new reactive information matrix, and performing factorization by adopting a Gaussian elimination method to obtain an active information matrix factor table and a reactive information matrix factor table; and estimating the state of the power system based on the active information matrix factor table and the reactive information matrix factor table. By utilizing the method and the device for solving the information matrix and estimating the state of the power system, the memory operation in the solving process can be reduced, the calculation load is reduced, and the calculation efficiency of the power grid state estimation is improved.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NARI GROUP CORP;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Optical power prediction method based on self-adaptive classification strategy and hybrid optimization SVR
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical power prediction method based on a self-adaptive classification strategy and a hybrid optimization SVR (singular value decomposition), which comprises the following steps of: s1, preprocessing data, namely removing abnormal samples in historical samples by adopting a non-dimensionalization processing method and an outlier algorithm based on density, and reconstructing or directly deleting missing data by adopting an interpolation algorithm; s2, selecting samples, and screening out historical samples which are highly similar to meteorological data at the prediction moment through a self-adaptive classification strategy; and S3, model training and numerical prediction, training a prediction model by adopting a quantum particle swarm algorithm and a grid method hybrid optimization SVR algorithm, and inputting meteorological data at a prediction moment to obtain a power prediction value. The method can reduce the adverse effect of error data and missing data on the prediction precision, can screen out historical samples which are highly similar to the meteorological data at the prediction moment according to the meteorological data at the prediction moment, and improves the generalization capability of the model by adopting the quantum particle swarm and grid method to mix and optimize the hyperparameter of the SVR algorithm.

title_en: Power grid mountain fire satellite monitoring image assimilation modeling method and system based on tetrahedral model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tetrahedral model-based power grid mountain fire satellite monitoring image synchronization modeling method and system, wherein 4 facets are used for respectively describing basic attributes, data characteristics, disaster characteristics, original images and other elements of unstructured data of a power grid disaster satellite monitoring image and describing internal relations among the elements, and structured data synchronization operation is carried out on multi-time satellite images, so that rapid retrieval of power grid disaster data in multi-time satellite remote sensing monitoring images is realized. The method is clear in thought, convenient to operate and high in practicability, can provide a technical basis for unified storage and associated operation of power grid disaster multi-source monitoring data, and achieves multi-source heterogeneous data assimilation modeling in power grid disaster monitoring.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Construction method of collapse rock particle size calculation model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a collapse rock particle size calculation model, which is suitable for comprehensively monitoring highway slope protection, tunnel entrance and exit treatment and the like, can provide data support, and has a good engineering application effect; the method can be used for early warning and pre-judging the collapse rock threat of mountain roads and tunnel entrances and exits, can classify the risk of the collapse rock disasters according to the calculation result, and provides different treatment methods according to different grades and damage degrees, thereby being a scientific and effective collapse rock pre-judging method, realizing real-time updating and data sharing and being a mountain road protection core technology.

title_en: Five-component marine natural gas hydrate intelligent sensing node
abstract_en: The invention provides a five-component intelligent sensing node for ocean natural gas hydrate, which comprises a titanium alloy cabin, an information acquisition unit, an integrated control chip and a power supply module, wherein the titanium alloy cabin is provided with a plurality of sub-cavities; the integrated control chip comprises an intelligent computing unit and a transmission unit; the intelligent calculation unit is used for extracting the quality monitoring index of the marine natural gas hydrate in a characteristic value extraction mode, and transmitting the quality monitoring index to monitoring equipment on the sea surface through the transmission unit by using the characteristic value in sparse expression. The method overcomes the problem that the current blind mining cannot monitor the quality in time, ensures that the working state of the submarine node is in a controllable range, obtains complete and non-missing data information, can well perform unconventional energy exploration such as deep sea hydrate and the like, and has important practical application prospect and value in the aspects of oil and gas resource exploration, geological disaster prevention and evaluation and the like.
assignees: OCEAN UNIV CHINA

title_en: Distribution network load missing data recovery method based on approximate low-rank matrix completion
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network load missing data recovery method based on approximate low-rank matrix completion, which comprises the following steps: s1, load history data is divided into two types of data loss vectors and data complete vectors; s2, forming an original matrix; s3, interpolating the missing elements to form a primary recovery matrix; s4, obtaining a pearson correlation coefficient matrix for the preliminary recovery matrix, and screening out vectors with high correlation with the data missing vectors; s5, the vector which originally contains the data loss is subjected to the vector screening by the pearson correlation coefficient matrix; s6, restoring and complementing the missing elements in the restoring matrix by using a singular value threshold contraction algorithm; s7, taking out the next vector with data loss, and repeating the steps. Compared with the traditional low-rank matrix complement algorithm, the improved algorithm of the application obtains better overall recovery effect and stability, and has more excellent application in complement of the load missing data of the power distribution network.

title_en: Phase identification method based on clustering algorithm and network search
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a phase identification method based on a clustering algorithm and network search, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting data, and collecting data of the phase recognition model; s2, data processing is carried out, data deletion or completion is carried out on missing data in sample data, and 3 sigma criterion is adopted to remove abnormal values on abnormal data; s3, establishing a phase recognition model, judging the connectivity among samples from the angle of sample density based on a density-based clustering algorithm DBSCAN, and forming a cluster based on the connectable samples to obtain a final cluster; and S4, model evaluation and prediction, wherein the phase recognition model evaluation is used for carrying out cross validation on the data set, the optimal parameters of the model are found, and a new data set is added into the model for carrying out model prediction. The invention solves the problems of unbalanced three phases and inaccurate line loss calculation of the conventional electric energy meter.
assignees: CHINA POWER TELECOMMUNICATION (BEIJING) TECH CO LTD

title_en: GEP optimization-based smart power grid data anomaly effective identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GEP optimization-based intelligent power grid data anomaly effective identification method, which belongs to the field of electric power system information safety and aims to solve the problem of data anomaly identification under an intelligent power grid; power system state estimation is an important component of modern energy management systems, and its measurement data may contain bad data in addition to normal measurement noise. By using the method, abnormal data which cannot be completely detected by the traditional method can be made up, so that bad data in the power grid can be quickly and effectively identified. The method solves the problem of identifying data abnormity under the intelligent power grid by combining the idea of node energy based on the noise data processing capability of a supervisory machine learning model constructed by GEP, trains according to a large amount of data in the current active power distribution network, and effectively identifies the data abnormity under the power grid by comparing the data change modes before and after attack by using the reactive power optimization comprehensive index on the basis of residual detection, thereby ensuring the safe and reliable operation of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Power load prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power load prediction method based on a long-short term memory neural network and external auxiliary information, which comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring and summarizing historical energy consumption data, meteorological data and holiday information according to a determined research object to form an initial sequence data set; then, cleaning the summarized data set, eliminating time sequence data strips at missing moments, interpolating small-range missing data, and normalizing the data to form a time sequence data pool; and then constructing a long-short term memory neural network model, and training the model based on the time sequence data pool. The method inspects and combines the coupling relation of the power energy consumption and the weather and holiday information on the basis of the long-term and short-term memory neural network, has the characteristics of high model precision and flexible prediction period, and is beneficial to the application of dispatching, analyzing and the like of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID SUZHOU URBAN ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for improving quality of time sequence data of centralized heat supply pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the quality of time sequence data of a centralized heat supply pipe network, which comprises the following steps: establishing a heat supply network model; the method specifically comprises the steps of representing a complex network by using graph theory, establishing a network equation of a system in a matrix form, establishing a static model of the heat supply network and establishing a dynamic model of the heat supply network. Estimating the state of the heat supply network; the method specifically comprises the steps of selecting state quantity, establishing a heat supply network state estimation iteration equation, simplifying calculation of heat supply network state estimation and detection and correction of bad data of the heat supply network state estimation. Example verification was performed.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: 5-Layer based Smart Digital-Energy-Twin architecture for sustainable for smart energy citye
title_ko: 지속가능한 스마트에너지시티 구현을 위한 5-Layer 기반 스마트 에너지 디지털 트윈 아키텍쳐법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a 5-Layer based smart energy digital twin architecture method for realizing a sustainable smart energy city. According to the present invention, a 5-Layer based architecture comprises: a digital layer (layer 1); a home/buildings layer (layer 2); a mobility layer (layer 3); an infrastructure layer (layer 4); and a virtual layer (layer 5).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트에너지시티 구현을 위한 5-Layer 기반 스마트 에너지 디지털 트윈 아키텍쳐법을 개시한다.
assignees: UNIV CHUNG ANG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Distribution network voltage data missing filling method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a distribution network voltage data missing filling method and a distribution network voltage data missing filling device, and the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the acquired historical section data to obtain a dimensionless section data set; clustering analysis is carried out on the dimensionless section data set by adopting an Euclidean distance algorithm or a log-likelihood distance algorithm to obtain a first clustered data set after clustering is successful; checking the first clustering data set through a strong association rule framework constructed according to a preset Apriori algorithm to obtain a second clustering data set; constructing a time sequence group according to the second clustered data set and the current missing data, wherein the time sequence group comprises a historical data sequence and a current missing data sequence; and filling the current missing data by the optimal historical data sequence selected according to the similarity determined by the time sequence group. The application solves the technical problems that the existing power grid voltage data missing filling technology is too complex and has no actual pertinence, and the power grid development requirement cannot be met.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Load prediction method based on meteorological similar days
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load prediction method based on meteorological similar days, which belongs to the technical field of power load prediction and comprises the following steps: s10, counting actual measurement load data and corresponding meteorological data; s20, preprocessing data, including removing missing data and abnormal data; carrying out data normalization on the load data after the elimination; s30, clustering, namely dividing load days into different categories according to meteorological data to form meteorological similar days; s40, establishing a support vector machine prediction model based on each moment of known load in the class to which the weather similar days belong; s50, training a support vector machine prediction model; s60, inputting the meteorological data of the day to be predicted into a support vector machine prediction model after training is completed, and obtaining the load prediction of the day to be predicted. On the basis of cluster analysis, the invention builds a regression prediction model by using the support vector mechanism, optimizes punishment parameters and kernel function parameters of the model based on the idea of cross validation, reduces prediction errors and improves prediction precision.

title_en: Design method of pipeline digital twin system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pipeline safety and life cycle management, and particularly relates to a design method of a pipeline digital twin system, which consists of a pipeline digital twin body, a pipeline monitoring system, a pipeline inside/outside nondestructive detection database, a pipeline design/operation maintenance database and a pipeline data mining analysis system, wherein the pipeline digital twin body forms a higher-level co-intelligence twin body through information exchange with a geological disaster twin body. The modeling of the pipeline digital twin body adopts a global-local method, takes a real-time displacement acquisition value of a pipeline monitoring system as a displacement boundary condition, and takes a strain/temperature value of a detection optical fiber as verification and correction data. The pipeline data mining analysis system is applied to promote the evolution of a pipeline digital twin body. The pipeline digital twin system can display a high-risk area of a pipeline in real time, propose internal detection requirements, recommend supplementary monitoring points, identify the falling position of a detection optical fiber, evaluate the safety margin of the pipeline, recommend a reinforcing method and predict reinforcing effects.

title_en: Model prediction control-based power system equipment overload correction control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model predictive control-based power system equipment overload correction control method, which is applied to power system equipment overload real-time correction control, and is used for judging the equipment overload amount based on measurement data of an SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) system of a dispatching control center, acquiring the running state of the system within a period of time in the future from ultra-short-term dispatching plan, load prediction and new energy power prediction data, calculating the control sensitivity of a conventional unit and a new energy unit by adopting state estimation data, solving an objective function comprehensively considering the minimum control cost and the maximum new energy consumption to realize the online rolling optimization of a control strategy sequence for 15min in the future, and taking a first group of control measures of the control strategy sequence to be issued and executed by an AGC (automatic gain control) system. The method realizes the automatic control of the real-time correction of the overload of the power system equipment based on model predictive control, and greatly improves the dynamic performance, stability and robustness of the control.

title_en: Second-order cone planning robust state estimation method and system for electric heating comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a second-order cone planning robust state estimation method of an electric heating comprehensive energy system, which comprises the steps of obtaining measurement of the electric heating comprehensive energy system, inputting the measurement into a pre-built second-order cone planning state estimation model of the electric heating comprehensive energy system to obtain an estimated value of node voltage amplitude of an electric power system, an estimated value of node phase angle of the electric power system, an estimated value of node pressure of a thermodynamic system, an estimated value of node heat supply temperature and an estimated value of node heat regeneration temperature, wherein the measurement of the electric heating comprehensive energy system comprises measurement of the electric power system and measurement of the thermodynamic system.

title_en: Double-layer robust state estimation method and system for electric heating comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-layer robust state estimation method of an electric heating comprehensive energy system, which comprises the following steps: acquiring measurement of an electric power system quantity and measurement of a thermodynamic system quantity of an electric heating comprehensive energy system; the thermodynamic system quantity measurement comprises hydraulic network quantity measurement and thermodynamic network quantity measurement; measuring the quantity of a power system and the quantity of a hydraulic network, inputting the measured quantities into a hydraulic network state estimation model of the power system, and obtaining a state variable estimation value and a hydraulic network state variable estimation value of the power system, and branch flow and node injection flow estimation values of the hydraulic network; the method comprises the steps of measuring branch flow of a hydraulic network, estimated value of node injection flow and a thermal network quantity, inputting a thermal network state estimation model, and obtaining estimated value of state variable of the thermal network.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network D-PMU optimal configuration method considering node differences
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network D-PMU optimal configuration method considering node difference, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a node-branch adjacency list of the power distribution network based on breadth-first search, and calculating four single node vulnerability indexes of node degree, node cohesion degree, node betweenness and node compactness of the power distribution network; acquiring comprehensive weight of indexes based on objective weight and subjective weight obtained by an entropy method and an analytic hierarchy process; solving a node comprehensive vulnerability index by adopting the TOPSIS-grey correlation degree, and taking the node comprehensive vulnerability index as a node weight in an optimized configuration model; adopting self-adaptive genetic calculation to satisfy a completely considerable D-PMU optimal configuration scheme of the system at one time; calculating the unobservable depth by adopting a depth-first search and Dikostricke combined method; sequencing the one-time schemes according to the importance degree of the nodes, and reducing the unobservable depth stage by stage to obtain a staged D-PMU configuration scheme; and D-PMU equipment is configured stage by stage according to the priority order according to the configuration scheme, so that the maximum measurement redundancy is obtained, and the precision of the state estimation of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Power electronic circuit fault diagnosis method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power electronic circuit fault diagnosis method based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of firstly, collecting a load voltage signal of an actual power electronic circuit to be detected, and establishing an initial digital twinning model according to the working principle of the actual power electronic circuit to be detected and nominal component parameters; mapping the collected load voltage signal and the running state of the actual power electronic circuit to be tested to the initial digital twin model to obtain a residual expression and an error square sum target function of the load voltage of the actual power electronic circuit to be tested and the initial digital twin model, optimizing the target function by using a least square algorithm to update the initial digital twin model, finally realizing component parameter estimation of the actual power electronic circuit to be tested to obtain a parameter estimation value, analyzing the parameter estimation value to diagnose a fault position, and finally realizing fault diagnosis of the actual power electronic circuit to be tested.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power system state determination method, device, computer medium and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of computers, in particular to a method and a device for determining the state of a power system, a computer medium and a storage medium, wherein the method for determining the state of the power system comprises the following steps: acquiring system measurement data, system topological network information and a node admittance matrix and establishing a power system state estimation model; processing a system state quantity equation according to an ensemble filtering algorithm, and establishing a time updating ellipsoid; processing a system quantity measurement equation according to a self-adaptive algorithm; and determining a measurement update ellipsoid. According to the method for determining the state of the power system, provided by the embodiment of the invention, the state estimation is carried out on the system state quantity equation through the collective filtering algorithm, and the collective filtering algorithm is combined with the adaptive algorithm program, so that the non-Gaussian noise distribution can be better adapted, meanwhile, the adaptive algorithm is utilized to process the system quantity measurement equation, the data processing sequence in the system quantity measurement equation can be adjusted, the redundancy of the measured data is fully utilized, and the numerical precision is further improved.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Electric power missing data identification method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a power missing data identification method and a related device, a clustering set is obtained by clustering and analyzing historical voltage data at a certain voltage position, multidimensional correlation analysis is carried out by utilizing voltage data correlation attributes, data with the maximum attribute comprehensive weighted value in the historical voltage data are taken as a substitute value of the certain voltage position, and abnormal point judgment is carried out on the substitute value based on a nuclear clustering analysis method, so that the substitute value finally filled to the voltage missing position is determined, the missing data filling accuracy is improved, the existing technical problem that power grid data quality is reduced due to power grid data missing and inconvenience is brought to information development of a smart power grid is solved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Abnormal operation data processing method for wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for processing abnormal operation data of a wind turbine, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing data: for wind speed-power abnormal data with wind speed greater than cut-in wind speed and less than cut-out wind speed and power less than or equal to zero, eliminating the data of the part; the preprocessed wind speed-power abnormal data is firstly identified and removed by using a Thompson tau method; performing secondary identification and elimination on the wind speed-power abnormal data after the primary identification and elimination by using a quartile method; adopting a four-point interpolation subdivision algorithm to carry out interpolation reconstruction on the misdeleted and missing data; the method solves the technical problems that the abnormal operation data processing of the wind turbine generator is inapplicable under the condition of more wind power plant fan types, the dependence on available data of adjacent wind power plants is too high, the error is gradually increased along with the increase of the distance of the fans, the accuracy is reduced, the reconstruction result depends on the correlation degree of the wind power plants, the model solving is complex when the data quantity is more, and the like.

title_en: Power system dynamic security assessment method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: A dynamic safety assessment method for a power system based on a generation countermeasure network comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing an initial sample set containing a large number of operation variables and transient stability margin safety indexes; step 2: constructing an efficient sample set containing key characteristic data and TSMs (short range switches) labels; and step 3: obtaining a GAN model and a dynamic security assessment model which can accurately fill up missing data; and 4, step 4: detecting the integrity of the PMUs data in real time through an intelligent system, and if the data are complete, directly inputting the data into a DSA model to perform DSA of the power system; and if the data are missing, inputting incomplete data acquired by the PMUs into a GAN model to fill the missing data, and inputting the filled complete data set into a DSA model to perform DSA of the power system. The invention provides a power system DSA method based on GAN, which can quickly and accurately fill up missing data and carry out DSA on the system aiming at the problem of data loss of the power system, is beneficial to electric power operators to quickly take control measures and avoids faults and economic loss.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Fire prediction method, storage device and processor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire prediction method, a processor and a storage device, wherein the fire prediction method comprises the steps of obtaining a fire-fighting monitoring object and fire-fighting equipment associated with the fire-fighting monitoring object; acquiring the relative position of the fire fighting equipment relative to the corresponding fire fighting detection object, and binding the fire fighting equipment with the relative position; establishing a digital twin system with the state vector and relative position relation of the fire fighting equipment at each moment; predicting values of state vectors of all fire fighting equipment associated with the fire fighting monitoring object at a certain moment; and calculating the probability that the value of the state vector of all the fire fighting equipment associated with the fire fighting monitoring object is possibly a fire disaster, and multiplying the probabilities corresponding to all the fire fighting equipment associated with the fire fighting monitoring object to obtain the probability that the fire fighting monitoring object generates the fire disaster at a certain moment. The method can predict the probability of fire at a certain time in the future, eliminate the hidden fire danger in advance, reduce property loss and improve the safety of buildings.
assignees: GREE ELECTRIC APPLIANCES INC ZHUHAI

title_en: MIMO radar target tracking method based on parallel segmentation particle filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MIMO radar target tracking method based on parallel segmentation particle filtering, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining MIMO radar trace data; s2, initializing particle filter parameters: step 3, calculating the target number and the target state of the MIMO radar trace data based on a potential probability hypothesis density filtering algorithm at the moment when k = 1; s4, calculating the target number and the target state of the MIMO radar trace data by adopting a parallel segmentation particle filtering algorithm based on potential probability hypothesis density filtering at the moment that k is larger than 1; and S5, repeatedly executing the step S4 to finish the target tracking of the MIMO radar. Compared with the existing particle filter target tracking algorithm based on the potential probability hypothesis density, the method can solve the problem that dimensionality disasters are easy to occur in the prior art, and has obvious performance advantages in target number and state estimation accuracy.

title_en: Dynamic assessment method for air conditioner load demand response capability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic assessment method for air conditioner load demand response capability, which is applied to real-time dynamic assessment of the capability of an air conditioner cluster participating in power grid auxiliary service through demand side response; the method is realized by depending on an intelligent terminal ST deployed in a load local, a management terminal MT deployed in a dispatching center and a bidirectional communication infrastructure between the intelligent terminal ST and the management terminal MT; the method comprises the steps that a local intelligent terminal ST identifies load characteristic parameters based on operation data of an air conditioner, a parameter model and a real-time operation state are adopted to solve response capacity indexes, and the required data are periodically uploaded to a management terminal MT; the management terminal MT receives data uploaded by each intelligent terminal ST in the jurisdiction range, combines an operation state estimation algorithm to obtain high-time-precision air conditioner response capability information, considers two capability indexes of response power and response duration to complete response capability aggregation of an air conditioner cluster, and can realize response capability evaluation of different update frequencies by adjusting an iteration period lambda.

title_en: Power system prediction auxiliary state estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for estimating a prediction auxiliary state of an electric power system, which comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic model for predicting the state of the electric power system; calculating the state estimator of the dynamic model by using a nonlinear Kalman filter; judging whether an abnormality occurs based on the number of counted new information, performing abnormality detection, and distinguishing an abnormality caused by a plurality of bad data from sudden load changes which unevenly affect all new information; identifying bad data by using a maximum innovation method according to the detected abnormal type, identifying nodes with sudden load change, and identifying nodes removed after a fault; if any bad data is identified, deleting the bad data and returning to the anomaly detection step, if any sudden load change is identified, refusing to predict and executing static estimation; if any branch is identified as a broken line, prediction is rejected, topology is updated and static estimation is performed. The invention can accurately detect and identify three abnormal types and identify abnormal positions under different power system operation conditions.

title_en: Full-period power battery management system applying digital twinning technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-period power battery management system applying a digital twin technology, which can effectively reduce the experimental amount in the early development process and shorten the development period compared with the prior art. The on-line end and the cloud end respectively adopt algorithms with different time scales, so that the real-time performance of on-line end processing can be guaranteed, and meanwhile, higher calculation accuracy is realized at the cloud end.
