The invention combines the BIM technology and the Internet of things technology and is applied to the specific problem of how to generate an escape path when a building is in a fire; compared with the prior art that the fire disaster personnel evacuation is guided by adopting a manual indicating method, the fire disaster personnel evacuation guiding method has the advantages of high efficiency and low error rate, and can greatly reduce casualties brought by fire disasters.
assignees: SHANGHAI JIN WEI INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic ontology model-based power grid equipment digital twin construction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic ontology model-based power grid equipment digital twin construction method and a dynamic ontology model-based power grid equipment digital twin construction device, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: loading a logic model and an ontology model of the power grid equipment; performing internal data alignment and synchronous processing on the body model and the logic model to generate a current logic model of the power grid equipment; collecting source service system data, updating internal logic data of the current logic model by combining the source service system data, and generating an initialized digital twin model of the power grid equipment; and analyzing and judging the real-time state change of the initialized digital twin model based on a composite event processing technology, and driving the internal body model to update by triggering of related events to generate the digital twin model of the power grid equipment. According to the embodiment of the invention, the construction of the digital twin model can be realized by introducing a digital modeling prototype of the power grid equipment and combining the relevant characteristics of the body and the relevant technology, the full life cycle of the power grid equipment is monitored in real time, and the decision auxiliary support is provided.

title_en: Disaster state estimation apparatus, display system, disaster state estimation method, method of generating disaster estimation model, and program
abstract_en: To provide a disaster state estimation apparatus which estimates a disaster state by using information reported from a plurality of information sources.SOLUTION: A disaster state estimation apparatus according to the present invention has an estimation unit for, when acquiring a disaster report information reported from a plurality of information sources, estimating a disaster state of an actual disaster at an estimation scheduled time based on an estimation model for outputting information indicating a state of the disaster and on the report information regarding the disaster from the plurality of information sources until the predetermined scheduled estimation time.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: MITSUBISHI HEAVY IND LTD

title_en: Low-voltage transformer area missing data completion method based on matrix completion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage transformer area missing data completion method based on matrix completion, which comprises the following steps of: collecting user electricity utilization data in a low-voltage transformer area at set sampling intervals and sampling periods; filtering the power utilization data of the users in the low-voltage distribution area by adopting a wavelet denoising method; establishing a user electricity utilization data matrix based on user electricity utilization data in the low-voltage transformer area, and directly recording corresponding position elements as missing elements aiming at the missing data; and establishing a low-rank matrix completion target function, and completing missing elements by searching the minimum rank of the monthly electricity data matrix of the user by combining an SVT algorithm to obtain a completion matrix of the missing data matrix of the low-voltage distribution area, namely completing the missing data. The low-voltage distribution area missing data completion method based on matrix completion considers the periodicity and the time sequence of the low-voltage distribution area data, can directly complete missing data sets through the matrix completion method, does not need to learn complete data sets, and is small in completion error and high in practicability.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Park electricity utilization information analysis method and device based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a park electricity utilization information analysis method and device based on digital twins. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring park electricity utilization information; constructing a long-short term memory network model as an original model, training the park electricity utilization information according to the long-short term memory network model, obtaining a training result, and performing iterative correction on the original model to obtain a second-generation model; constructing a correction factor algorithm, correcting the second-generation model through the model correction factor, and obtaining a final model as a digital twin model; and acquiring the electricity utilization information of each equipment in the park in real time, predicting the electricity utilization information of each equipment through a digital twin model, and acquiring a park electricity utilization analysis report. According to the method, the original model is built through the long-term and short-term memory network model, the second-generation model is subjected to continuous correction iteration through the correction factor algorithm to obtain the final digital twin model, and then the electricity utilization information is predicted, so that the prediction accuracy can be improved, a user can conveniently manage electricity utilization data, and the management efficiency is improved.

title_en: Management method, device, equipment and storage medium of smart power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management method and a management device of a smart grid, electronic equipment and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of smart grids, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring low-frequency data of a specific meter, wherein the low-frequency data is initial data acquired to the smart grid according to a set sampling frequency; reconstructing the collected low-frequency data by utilizing a neural network based on a preset super-resolution perception model to obtain reconstructed target high-frequency data; and performing state estimation on the smart grid by using the target high-frequency data so as to manage the smart grid. According to the scheme, low-frequency data in the smart grid are collected, the neural network is used for reconstructing the low-frequency data to obtain target high-frequency data based on a preset super-resolution perception model, state estimation is further carried out on the smart grid based on the target high-frequency data, the smart grid is managed according to a state estimation result, more hidden problems in the smart grid are discovered in time, and therefore safety and operation efficiency of the system are improved, and reliability and stability are achieved.
assignees: UNIV CHINESE HONG KONG SHENZHEN

title_en: Short-term electricity price prediction method based on long-term and short-term memory network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term electricity price forecasting method based on a long-term and short-term memory network, which comprises the following steps: carrying out periodic preprocessing on abnormal data and missing data in the original electricity price; constructing a long-term and short-term memory network model; carrying out long-term and short-term memory network model training, selecting model parameters, and establishing a short-term electricity price prediction model; and predicting the short-term electricity price, and performing inverse normalization processing on the prediction result data to obtain an actual electricity price prediction value. According to the electricity price prediction method, the historical electricity price data are preprocessed through mean interpolation and wavelet transformation, so that the noise of a training set is reduced; based on the long-short term memory network prediction model, the short-term electricity price prediction is carried out by taking historical influence electricity price factor data as a test set, and reasonable trading decisions are carried out on market participants so as to reduce cost, avoid risks and improve profit margin significance.
assignees: ZHEJIANG POWER EXCHANGE CENTER COMPANY LTD;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Server and method for estimating used amount of missed data in advanced metering infrastructure system
title_ko: 누락된 데이터의 사용량을 추정하는 ami 시스템의 서버 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A method for estimating the usage of missing data of an AMI system that remotely meter-reads energy usage in real time using a wired/wireless communication and exchanges bidirectional information according to the present invention comprises: a first step of collecting and storing power usage data of customers at each preset collection cycle; a second step of classifying and grouping the stored data according to a predetermined criterion; a third step of measuring the similarity for each customer within the group and storing the result; a fourth step of determining whether missing data occurs at each preset missing data determination period and estimating and storing data based on the similarity for each customer stored in the third step when missing data occurs; a fifth step of determining whether the power usage data is past data; a sixth step of detecting, when the power usage data is past data, estimated data corresponding to an instrument time of the power usage data; and a seventh step of replacing the estimated data with the power usage data. Therefore, when data is missing in the AMI system, the present invention estimates power usage for missing data of a target customer by referring to a power usage pattern of a similar customer detected in advance, thereby minimizing an estimation error for missing data even when the power usage pattern changes due to national holidays or irregular holidays.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 유/무선 통신망을 이용하여 원격에서 에너지 사용량을 실시간으로 검침하고, 양방향 정보를 교환하는 AMI 시스템의 누락된 데이터 사용량 추정 방법에 있어서, 미리 설정된 수집주기마다 고객들의 전력 사용 데이터를 수집하여 저장하는 제1 단계; 상기 저장된 데이터들을 소정 기준에 따라 분류하여 그룹핑하는 제2 단계; 상기 그룹 내에서 고객별 유사도를 측정하고, 그 결과를 저장하는 제3 단계; 및 미리 설정된 누락데이터판단주기마다 누락데이터 발생 여부를 판단하고, 누락데이터 발생시 상기 제3 단계에서 저장된 고객별 유사도에 기초하여 데이터를 추정하여 저장하는 제4 단계; 상기 전력 사용 데이터가 과거 데이터인지여부를 결정하는 제5 단계; 상기 전력 사용 데이터가 과거 데이터인 경우, 상기 전력 사용 데이터의 계기시간에 대응된 추정데이터를 검출하는 제6 단계; 및 상기 추정데이터를 상기 전력 사용 데이터로 대체하는 제7 단계를 포함한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 AMI 시스템에서, 데이터의 누락이 발생한 경우, 미리 검출한 유사 고객의 전력 사용 패턴을 참고하여 대상 고객의 누락 데이터에 대한 전력 사용량을 추정함으로써, 국경일 또는 비정기 휴일로 인해 전력 사용 패턴이 달라진 경우에도 누락 데이터에 대한 추정 오차를 최소화하는 장점이 있다.
assignees: KEPCO KDN CO LTD

title_en: Ionized layer TEC assimilation modeling method based on Beidou GEO
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ionized layer TEC assimilation modeling method based on Beidou GEO, which comprises the following steps: an assimilation method: carrying out a data assimilation experiment by using a gradual correction method, taking an IRI model as prior information, and gradually correcting by using Beidou GEO ionized layer TEC data; extracting the Beidou GEO ionized layer TEC; extracting a TEC grid value of an international reference ionosphere model IRI, and assimilating the Beidou GEO ionosphere TEC value into the IRI model by using an improved stepwise correction method; and (5) evaluating the accuracy of the assimilation model. The method assimilates the ionized layer into an international reference ionosphere model IRI by an improved gradual correction method, and carries out comparative analysis with a global ionosphere map GIM and Beidou GEO ionosphere TEC values which do not participate in modeling to evaluate the precision of the ionized layer IRI. The method has important application value in GNSS navigation positioning accuracy improvement and disaster reduction and prevention capability in space environment.
assignees: UNIV EAST CHINA JIAOTONG

title_en: Wind power tower inclination angle missing data supplementing method based on SSA-LSTM model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power tower inclination angle missing data supplementing method based on an SSA-LSTM model. Firstly, carrying out cubic spline interpolation on a collected tower barrel inclination angle signal containing a missing value, and simultaneously acquiring a missing data point index; secondly, performing wavelet threshold denoising on the interpolated signal, and removing the influence of environmental factors such as noise and the like; thirdly, dividing the signals by using a sliding window, constructing a training set and a testing set of the LSTM model, and constructing the LSTM model with a deep layer structure; then, performing iterative optimization on parameters of the LSTM model by using SSA; and finally, constructing an LSTM model according to the optimal parameters, finishing the training of the LSTM model by using a training set, and verifying the performance of the model by using a test set. The missing data supplementing method can realize accurate recovery of the missing data of the inclination angle of the tower drum, and lays a data foundation for later detection of tower drum toppling.
assignees: GANSU JINGYUAN AEROSPACE WIND POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power transmission line maintenance method based on state evaluation
abstract_en: The invention provides a power transmission line intelligent maintenance method based on state evaluation, relates to the technical field of power transmission line operation and inspection, solves the problems of low accuracy and low intelligent level of the existing power transmission line state evaluation and maintenance method, overcomes the defect of large workload of manpower, firstly carries out data reflux synchronization on a power grid large data platform based on power transmission line state evaluation influence factors, sets reflux frequency to realize real-time update of the power transmission line state evaluation influence factor data, designs a power transmission line intelligent maintenance strategy model based on state evaluation, automatically acquires the power transmission line state evaluation influence factor data of a database and calculates the data, and determining a maintenance strategy according to the calculation result, so that the defect of manually developing evaluation workload is avoided, the accuracy of the state evaluation result of the power transmission line is improved, and the safe and stable operation of equipment is ensured.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Forest fire spreading data assimilation method and device based on unmanned aerial vehicle video
abstract_en: The application discloses a forest fire spreading data assimilation method and device based on unmanned aerial vehicle video, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring meteorological data, basic geographic information data and a fire wire state analysis value at the K-1 moment of a fire disaster place; inputting the information into a forest fire spreading model, and acquiring fire line predicted position information at the K moment; acquiring a fire scene area thermal imaging video shot by an unmanned aerial vehicle, and acquiring fire wire observation position information at the moment K; judging whether parameter adjustment needs to be carried out on the model or not according to the fire line predicted position and the observed position at the moment K; and if needed, adjusting the model parameters according to the fire wire predicted position and the observation position at the moment K, recalculating the fire wire predicted position at the moment K, and obtaining the fire wire state analysis value at the moment K. The method and the device are low in cost, can dynamically iterate the forest fire spreading model, obtain the accurate fire wire prediction position, and strive for precious time for forest fire rescue.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;BEIJING GLOBAL SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transformer fault diagnosis positioning system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer fault diagnosis positioning system based on digital twins, which belongs to the field of fault diagnosis of power equipment and comprises the following components: the communication perception module is used for transmitting the bottom monitoring data acquired from the equipment entity to the system supporting module; the system supporting module is used for receiving and preprocessing bottom layer monitoring data and storing various data, models and expert systems; the dynamic twinning module is used for analyzing the multidimensional probability condition of equipment faults, constructing dynamic degradation modeling of different health states, and realizing model correction through man-machine interaction, real-time measurement and dynamic update in the follow-up process; the decision diagnosis module is used for constructing a digital twin body of data to be diagnosed and realizing diagnosis and positioning of the health state; and the user interface module is used for displaying the diagnosis result and the related information through a UI interface and providing further decision and man-machine interaction. The method can realize accurate cognition and closed loop optimization of fault diagnosis positioning, and improve the economy and reliability of the transformer equipment.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Power management system based on internet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internet-based power management system, which relates to the technical field of power management systems and comprises a login module and a user management module, wherein the output end of the login module is electrically connected with an internet management platform, the output end of the internet management platform is electrically connected with a monitoring module, and the output end of the monitoring module is electrically connected with a fault monitoring unit, a fault alarm unit, a fault analysis unit, a fault feedback unit, a fault processing unit and a calculation module. According to the invention, through the low electric quantity data transmission unit, the normal electric quantity data transmission unit, the high electric quantity data transmission unit and the risk electric quantity data transmission unit, the corresponding classified transmission of the user data without electric quantity can be realized, the real-time updating of the user electric quantity can be realized, meanwhile, the data transmission efficiency is improved, the condition of faults in the system data transmission process is effectively reduced, and the use continuity and effectiveness of the power management system are ensured.
assignees: LISHUI XINBEILEI TECH CO LTD

title_en: State estimation device, state estimation program, and state estimation method
abstract_en: To provide a technique capable of estimating a state of a system to which power or the like is supplied, with high accuracy.SOLUTION: A state estimation device comprises: a first state estimation part that estimates a state of a system based on a plurality of pieces of system information indicating the state of the system to which any one of power, gas, and liquid is supplied, and measured at a plurality of measurement points, respectively, and a model obtained by simulating the system; a determination part that determines whether the plurality of pieces of system information are abnormal based on the plurality of pieces of system information and an estimation result obtained by estimation of the first state estimation part; and a second state estimation part that estimates second system information of at least a measurement point determined to be abnormal among the plurality of measurement points, based on a plurality of pieces of data each indicating the state of the system previously stored in a storage part, and first system information measured at a measurement point determined not to be abnormal among the plurality of measurement points, when it is determined that the plurality of pieces of system information are abnormal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6
assignees: FUJI ELECTRIC CO LTD;UNIV MEIJI

title_en: Event-driven natural catastrophe modeling and model refinement for insurance and risk management
abstract_en: A system and method for event-based modeling and model refinement for natural catastrophe related risks, including but not limited to fires, floods, earthquakes, and hurricanes/tornados. The system and method feature simultaneous simulation of a plurality of industry models using a variety of risk information, including but not limited to real-time data, recent and historical event data, hypothetical data, and crowd-sourced data. The system and method use a variety of data sources in conjunction with machine learning to continuously and in real-time update and tune the simulated models performance and sensitivity to provide useful risk assessment and risk management data. Based on these model assessments, the system can produce notifications that can be made to enable automated and human actions.
assignees: QOMPLX INC

title_en: Method and system for predicting line loss of power distribution network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for predicting line loss of a power distribution network, which are used for acquiring and cleaning time sequence data of each line and each area in the power distribution network, detecting and eliminating abnormal data of the time sequence by adopting an outlier detection method, establishing a random forest model with improved interpolation, and filling missing data of the time sequence. Calculating the maximum mutual information coefficient of each feature and line loss data according to the change rule of each time sequence feature, and selecting the feature with the maximum correlation with the line loss as the input feature of the line loss prediction model; clustering line loss data with similar characteristics by adopting a k-means clustering method according to the time sequence data of the line loss of each area, dividing each type of line loss data set, establishing a long-period memory neural network prediction model, inputting a training sample to train the long-period memory neural network, and obtaining a line loss prediction model; the accuracy of the short-term line loss prediction of the power distribution network can be improved, and the purposes of guiding the loss management and the synergistic operation of the power distribution line are achieved.

title_en: Method and system for complementing measured data of power distribution system, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for complementing measured data of a power distribution system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on the characteristics of the power distribution system, the active line characteristics are converted into active node characteristics, and the active node characteristics and the voltage node characteristics are normalized linearly to the interval [0,1 ]]Obtaining the original high-resolution measured value characteristic L v And L p And the original low resolution measurement feature F v And F p (ii) a Inputting the characteristics of the original low-resolution measured value into a graph convolution network to obtain a fitting value of a high-resolution label; and based on the fitting value of the high-resolution label, performing state estimation by using redundant measurement data to obtain a high-resolution true value of the power distribution system. According to the invention, under the condition that some node data are completely lost, space-time transformation can be carried out, which is beneficial to improving the situation perception capability of the distributed network, thereby being beneficial to improving the operation efficiency of the power distribution network and reducing equipment faults.

title_en: Online updating method and system for power grid mobile application software page
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for updating a power grid mobile application software page on line, and belongs to the technical field of power grid automatic mobile application. When a page editor develops a page, a file is uploaded to a file version management server, after the file is uploaded, a client mobile application is started, and the mobile terminal can start a background file downloading service. When the file downloading is completed, the file structure is automatically checked. The mobile application can automatically refresh the current interface without manual operation after the check is passed, and an efficient updating mode of downloading, previewing and testing is realized; uploading the page file compression package passing the test to a file version management server; downloading the page file compression package of the formal version by the mobile application client; and after the downloading is successful, the interface is automatically refreshed to a new interface effect. According to the method, the page is previewed, and the interface is formally refreshed after the requirement is met, so that the development is more convenient and efficient.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: State estimation method of thermoelectric coupling system suitable for extremely cold natural disasters
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a state estimation method of a thermoelectric coupling system, which is suitable for extremely cold natural disasters, and comprises the following steps: under the condition of an extremely cold natural disaster, a state estimation model of the thermoelectric coupling system is constructed by using a least square method based on the quantity measurement in the thermoelectric coupling system, the state estimation quantity corresponding to the quantity measurement and a weight matrix; decomposing the state estimation model based on a first-order KKT condition, converting the state estimation model into a nonlinear equation set to solve a state estimator, and obtaining the running state of the thermoelectric coupling system; wherein the weight matrix is determined by a measurement accuracy of a metrology device used to measure the measurements. The embodiment of the invention tracks and measures the real running state of the thermoelectric coupling system under the extremely cold natural disaster through a state estimation method, and obtains the real running state of the system in real time; the weighting strategy aiming at different types of measuring equipment under the extremely cold natural disaster environment is provided, and the accuracy of the estimation result is improved from the algorithm level.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: State estimation method and device for extra-high voltage flexible direct current transmission system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state estimation method for an extra-high voltage flexible direct current transmission system, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: extracting all parameter data for evaluating the running state of the extra-high voltage flexible direct current transmission system; step two: constructing a data frame: step three: processing the missing original parameter data; step four: amplifying the training matrix; step five: sampling and generating a specific decision path; step six: and removing the part which does not reach the convergence state, deducing the required predicted value, and estimating the state of the extra-high voltage flexible direct current transmission system. The invention utilizes the known measurement data in the system to establish a mathematical model for estimating other unknown parameters and system states, can more accurately acquire the system states according to the estimation results, purposefully and selectively regulate and control power and voltage, can more accurately acquire the system states even under the condition of data loss of partial measurement units, and effectively prevent direct current outage or equipment damage accidents caused by measurement faults.

title_en: Automatic history fitting dominant channel parameter prediction method based on depth self-encoder
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic history fitting dominant channel parameter prediction method based on a depth self-encoder, which comprises the following steps: s1, representing the dominant channel in the oil reservoir by using a straight line, and establishing an oil reservoir dominant channel numerical simulation model; s2, combining the prior information of the dominant channel oil reservoir, and generating a learning sample library by using different distribution functions; s3, training the depth autoencoder by combining a neural network layer-by-layer training and fine-tuning method; s4, performing dimensionality reduction reconstruction on the prior sample data based on the encoding and decoding properties of the depth self-encoder; s5, establishing a history fitting objective function of the dominant channel oil reservoir according to the Bayesian theory; s6, updating parameters and minimizing an objective function by using a multiple data assimilation set smoothing algorithm (ES-MDA). Compared with the prior art, the method and the device realize inversion of the oil reservoir model with the dominant channels with different scales, and provide reference for automatic history fitting of the oil reservoir with the large-scale dominant channels.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA

title_en: Heat supply pipe network hydraulic calculation method based on big data analysis technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a heat supply pipe network hydraulic calculation method based on big data analysis technology, which comprises the following steps: step one, establishing a network topology of a heat supply pipe network system: step two, establishing a digital twin relation: step 201, establishing a pipeline characteristic equation: step 202, establishing a transmission and distribution analysis model: step 203, establishing a characteristic model of the regulating and controlling equipment: step 204, establishing a hydraulic joint debugging model based on big data: setting a topological relation, a transmission and distribution analysis model and a regulation and control equipment characteristic model in a topological graph of a simultaneous heat supply pipe network system, setting an operation boundary condition and a big data analysis mode, and establishing a hydraulic joint debugging model; step three, running simulation based on the digital twin relation: and fourthly, carrying out iterative analysis on the data. The method provided by the invention has the advantages that the passive regulation mode of the traditional urban heat supply pipe network system is changed into the active regulation mode, so that the favorable basis is provided, the hydraulic working condition stability of the system is improved, and the operation efficiency is improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI ALLSENSE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for predicting generated power
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting generated power, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (a) acquiring weather forecast data of a target area at any moment; (b) measuring actual meteorological data of the target area at any moment; (c) performing data assimilation processing on the weather forecast data by using the actual weather data to acquire corrected weather forecast data of the target area at any time; (d) predicting weather forecast data of the target area in a preset time period from the any moment according to the corrected weather forecast data of the target area at the any moment; (e) and inputting the predicted weather forecast data into a power prediction model of the wind generating set in the target area so as to output the generated power of the wind generating set in the target area within a preset time period from the any moment.
assignees: BEIJING JINFENG HUINENG TECH CO LTD;JIANGSU GOLDWIN SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, medium and equipment for assimilating complex multi-source heterogeneous data of nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a medium and equipment for assimilating complex multi-source heterogeneous data of a nuclear power plant, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: performing Delaunay triangulation on a plurality of discrete monitoring point positions in a designated area to obtain a Delaunay triangulation network; s2: carrying out space-time grid division on the designated area to obtain coordinate values of a plurality of monitoring point positions; s3: calculating the weight from the interpolation point location to each monitoring point location of the triangle according to the coordinate values of each monitoring point location and the interpolation point location by adopting a triangle interpolation method; s4: and acquiring the monitoring data of the fused interpolation point positions through a data fusion algorithm according to the radiation emergency monitoring data and the weight of each triangular monitoring point position at a certain moment. The invention can comprehensively analyze various radiation emergency monitoring data and carry out rapid and reliable data assimilation on the result evaluation result of the nuclear accident, thereby making more accurate prediction and providing practical and feasible nuclear emergency decision technical support for a decision maker.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD;CHINA NUCLEAR POWER DESIGN CO LTD SHENZHEN;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: System and method for predicting failure in a power system in real-time
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a system (100) and a method (300) for predicting failure in a power system (102) in real-time. The method comprises obtaining, by a processing unit (204), state estimation data corresponding to electrical quantities of the power system (102) received from one or more sources in real-time, extracting a feature vector from the received state estimation data based on contingency analysis information using a trained machine learning model, wherein the feature vector corresponds to one or more parameters pertaining to the power system (102) in real-time, determining a security index for the received state estimation data based on the extracted feature vector using the trained machine learning model and, predicting a failure of the power system (102) based on the determined security index.
assignees: SIEMENS AG

title_en: Time sequence data processing method based on variable window mode identification
abstract_en: A time sequence missing value filling method based on window-changing mode identification comprises the following steps: selecting a wind turbine generator power correlation variable based on an operation mechanism; selecting a wind turbine generator power correlation variable selected based on the data characteristics; matching a window-changing mode aiming at the multidimensional correlation variable of the active power of the wind turbine generator; multiple filling of active power continuous missing data blocks of the wind turbine generator based on a similar mode; evaluating and confirming multiple filling results; aiming at the widely existing and common continuous data missing conditions of the industrial Internet of things, the method can efficiently and accurately realize the filling of high-proportion missing data, greatly improve the effective data quantity, and lay an important data foundation for the implementation and application of data-driven algorithms such as machine learning, artificial intelligence and the like.
assignees: BEIJING HUANENG XINRUI CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: AI-based intelligent power distribution room operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power distribution room operation method based on AI and digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: sensors are arranged on each device on the site of the power distribution room and on the site; signal data acquisition and monitoring are carried out on the power distribution room site and each device on the site through a sensor; the artificial intelligence module reads the signal data in the database and analyzes the unstructured data to carry out structured processing; the big data calculation module reads the structured data from the database and analyzes the fault reason; and the intelligent monitor reads the fault reason in the data air and carries out linkage scheduling control through the command scheduling center equipment according to the fault reason. The invention installs sensors on the power distribution room site and on-site equipment, thus realizing data monitoring and control of the Internet; the association is formed among the devices, and the consent management is achieved; data acquisition and monitoring are carried out through various sensors, intelligent analysis is carried out, abnormity is discriminated, and the monitoring accuracy is improved.

title_en: Digital twin information synchronization method, system, readable storage medium and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power data generation and data comparison, and provides a digital twin information synchronization method, a system, a readable storage medium and equipment. The digital twin information synchronization method comprises the steps of partitioning tested data into blocks, and generating a request instruction set for acquiring data from an interface of a simulation system and a test system based on data content contained in each block of data; according to the data request instruction set, correspondingly requesting block digital twin simulation data and block test data from the simulation system and the test system interface in a multithreading mode; respectively constructing a Merkle Tree based on the digital twin simulation data and the test data which are acquired by the request; wherein all subtrees of the Merkle Tree are complete binary trees; and (3) comparing the Merkle Tree of the digital twin simulation data with the root node and each child node of the Merkle Tree of the test data in a difference manner so as to realize the rapid consistency check of the digital twin information.

title_en: Fuzzy logic strong tracking method for load modeling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power load modeling, and provides a fuzzy logic strong tracking method for load modeling. The tracking method comprises the steps of monitoring the change of a voltage amplitude and an innovation and determining a noise covariance matrix; the innovation is the difference between the output predicted load characteristic value and the actual measured load characteristic value of the current load model; adaptively adjusting a noise covariance matrix by utilizing fuzzy logic, and determining an fading factor of the strong tracking filter to keep the process parameters of the strong tracking filter consistent with the current load model parameters; carrying out state estimation on the current load model by using a strong tracking filter, judging whether the innovation reaches preset precision, if so, outputting a corrected model, and predicting load characteristics by using the model; otherwise, continuing to modify the load model until the innovation reaches the preset precision.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Short-term building power load prediction method and system based on intelligent electric meter data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term building power load prediction method and a system based on intelligent electric meter data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) data input: taking total table load data and internal load data as input data, wherein the internal load data comprises each sub table load data and unmeasured load data; 2) data processing: filling missing data, correcting abnormal values, and reserving internal load data with a correlation coefficient larger than a set value according to a correlation analysis result carried out in advance; 3) and (3) load prediction: inputting the time sequence formed by the internal load data and the total table load data obtained in the step 2) into a pre-trained stable time convolution network, and performing short-term prediction on the building power load at the target future time. According to the method, the building power load is predicted in a short term by adopting the time convolution neural network, and compared with the traditional method, the time for training to reach stability is obviously shortened, the error is obviously reduced, and the prediction performance is better.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE WUHAN EFFICIENCY EVALUATION COMPANY LIMITED;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network historical state estimation method and system based on hybrid measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network historical state estimation method and system based on hybrid measurement. According to the method, the power distribution network hybrid measurement state estimation model in the form of the quadratic equation under the rectangular coordinate system is constructed, decoupling of state estimation modeling and algorithm is achieved, the existing mature state estimation algorithm can be adopted for solving, and the power distribution network hybrid measurement state estimation efficiency and reliability are improved.

title_en: Auxiliary decision-making method and system for urban rail transit network operation emergency
abstract_en: The invention relates to an auxiliary decision method and an auxiliary decision system under the condition of urban rail transit network operation emergency.A simulation model is established by means of a digital twinning technology, and a plurality of simulation models are combined to establish a digital twinning rail transit network; according to historical passenger flow data of an urban rail transit network, carrying out data simulation and prediction, and analyzing emergency situations under possible conditions; according to the emergency situation, the trend of the train and the passenger flow is deduced in the simulation model, the communication between the urban rail transit system and the digital twin simulation system is established, and the real-time train analysis and the interaction between the passenger flow data and the simulation data are realized; analyzing the degree of harm and the development condition of the received and reported emergency, determining the early warning level, carrying out quantitative and qualitative evaluation on the effect after the emergency treatment measures are implemented, providing the simulation process and the result to a dispatcher of a network control center in a graph-text mode, and assisting the dispatcher in carrying out strategy optimization.
assignees: ITONGKONG RES INSTITUTE ANHUI CO LTD

title_en: System state estimation with asynchronous measurements
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides techniques for estimating network states using asynchronous measurements by leveraging network inertia. For example, a device configured in accordance with the techniques of the present disclosure may receive electrical parameter values corresponding to at least one first location within a power network and determine, based on the electrical parameter values and a previous estimated state of the power network, an estimated value of unknown electrical parameters that correspond to a second location within the power network. The device may further cause at least one device within the power network to modify operation based on the estimated value of the unknown electrical parameters. The leveraging of network inertia may obviate the need for probabilistic models or pseudo-measurements.
assignees: ALLIANCE SUSTAINABLE ENERGY;UNIV COLORADO REGENTS

title_en: Control tower and enterprise management platform for value chain networks
abstract_en: A value chain system that provides recommendations for designing a logistics system generally includes a machine learning system that trains machine-learned models that output logistics design recommendations based on training data sets that each respectively defines one or more features of a respective logistic system and an outcome relating to the respective logistics system; an artificial intelligence system that receives a request for a logistics system design recommendation and determines the logistics system design recommendation based on one or more of the machine-learned models and the request; and a digital twin system that generates an environment digital twin of a logistics environment that incorporates the logistics system design recommendation, and one or more physical asset digital twins of physical assets. The digital twin system executes a simulation based on the logistics environment digital twin, the one or more physical asset digital twins.
assignees: STRONG FORCE VCN PORTFOLIO 2019 LLC

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for processing bad data of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for processing bad data of a power distribution network, which are used for acquiring measurement data in a preset time period in the power distribution network; inputting the measured data into a preset identification model for data classification, and outputting the measured data as normal data or bad data; determining the occurrence time t of bad data in the measured data based on the identification result, and inputting a preset number of normal data before the occurrence time t of the bad data into a preset data correction model to obtain predicted data at the time t; and replacing the bad data at the time t with the predicted data at the time t to obtain corrected measurement data. The method solves the technical problems that after the bad data are identified by adopting a convolutional neural network model, the rejected bad data are not supplemented or corrected, so that the data are incomplete, the observability of a power distribution network system is influenced, and the reliability of a power distribution network state estimation result is reduced.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Heating system optimization method based on Bayesian optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the fields of heating system analysis and hydraulic calculation, and discloses a heating system optimization method based on a Bayesian optimization algorithm. The measurement data selected by the invention are carried out at each valve, so that the implementation possibility is effectively ensured, and the operation cost is reduced. Through mathematical modeling, the relevant physical principles and the numerical statistics are fully utilized, and the network management state estimation is optimized. Aiming at the characteristics of non-convex error function, multi-peak error function and high evaluation cost, a Bayesian optimization method is used for the optimization method, so that the solving feasibility is ensured. Compared with the traditional genetic algorithm and the pso particle swarm algorithm, the method has the advantages of small calculation error and short running time.

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network load state estimation method and device and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for estimating the load state of a low-voltage distribution network and terminal equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical load power data of a low-voltage distribution network; determining the probability of the current state of the load of the power distribution network at the current moment and a state transition matrix of the load of the power distribution network at the current moment according to the historical load power data; determining the duration of the load of the power distribution network in the current state based on the state transition matrix of the load of the power distribution network at the current moment; and determining the state of the power distribution network load at the next moment based on the probability that the power distribution network load at the current moment is in the current state, the state transition matrix of the power distribution network load at the current moment and the duration of the power distribution network load in the current state. The method, the device and the terminal equipment for estimating the load state of the low-voltage distribution network can realize the estimation of the load state of the low-voltage distribution network, and can effectively support the uncertainty trend analysis of the load of the distribution network and the planning of the distributed high-power electric equipment to be connected into the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI POWER CO LTD SMART DISTRIB NETWORK CENTER;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV YANSHAN

title_en: Power distribution network prediction auxiliary state estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network prediction auxiliary state estimation method, which belongs to the technical field of power distribution networks and is used for acquiring measurement data of the power distribution network; judging whether the measured data is missing or not, if so, obtaining a predicted value of the state quantity by using a pre-trained LSTM model, obtaining pseudo measurement by combining load flow calculation, and obtaining a state estimation result through particle filtering after the missing measured data is supplemented. If the measured data are not missing, judging whether the measured data are abnormal or not through an isolated forest algorithm, if the measured data are normal, replacing the abnormal measured data with pseudo measurement if the measured data are abnormal, and then obtaining a state estimation result through particle filtering. The method is not limited by a system measurement noise model, and accurate estimation under the influence of non-Gaussian noise is realized; the measurement missing and abnormal data can be accurately identified, the abnormal data is replaced by the pseudo measurement generated by PFC through the predicted value obtained by the LSTM, and the robustness is improved; after the network topology structure is changed, the state estimation accuracy can be ensured.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Data calculation method and system for digital twin simulation of urban rail power supply system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a data calculation method and a data calculation system for digital twin simulation of an urban rail transit power supply system. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting real data of load and tide states of a traction power supply system; step 2, performing power flow simulation on the traction power supply system model by adopting a hybrid driving mode of data driving and model driving according to the load and the real data to generate a simulation result of a power flow state; step 3, generating an error index Modelerror of the model according to the simulation result of the tidal current state and the real data; step 4, judging whether the error index ModelError is larger than a preset threshold value or not, and generating a comparison result; step 5, when the comparison result is yes, outputting the traction power supply system model; and 6, otherwise, automatically correcting parameters of the traction power supply system model, generating an updated traction power supply system model, and turning to the step 1. The invention can improve the accuracy of the model.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Method for estimating state of comprehensive energy microgrid park system
abstract_en: Compared with the single power grid state estimation method, the invention introduces more quantity measurement and improves the system redundancy, thereby reducing the average error of state estimation and improving the accuracy of data. In addition, the decoupling estimation reduces the dimensionality of the network, can effectively relieve the calculation pressure, and further improves the calculation efficiency of state estimation due to the fact that the network scale is small, and the speed of state estimation, bad data and topology error detection and identification is high.

title_en: Unified data metering and collecting system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin-based unified data metering and collecting system, which solves the technical problem that unified metering data acquisition management cannot be applied to multiple services. The invention realizes the unified setting of the type and frequency of the collected information under the multi-application scene by using a digital twin technology; the digital twin auxiliary information system simulates and operates a multi-service data model, and dynamically adjusts sampling parameters based on the comprehensive analysis of the operation result of the model, so that the acquisition system can master the requirements of the application system in real time. The system designed by the invention is subjected to field test work in a metering center of a power grid company, the scheme of the system is verified to have multi-service comprehensive acquisition and be suitable for second-level acquisition capacity, the load prediction and spot transaction service are taken as examples, the prediction precision and the electricity purchasing cost are taken as indexes, the operation result is analyzed, the acquisition time interval is adjusted, and the optimal acquisition frequency is finally determined, so that the corresponding load prediction average absolute percentage error is limited to an allowable threshold, and the electricity purchasing cost deviation value of an electricity selling party is limited.
assignees: HU SHUKAI

title_en: Electric energy metering data recovery method based on collaborative fitting
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of analysis and processing application of power consumption data, and particularly relates to an electric energy metering data recovery method based on collaborative fitting. The method comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a binary tree data model by taking accurate historical data of electric energy metering as a reference; s2: searching m nearest neighbors of a target user; s3: generating a matrix X containing missing entries * ∈R (m+1)×N (ii) a S4: randomly generating a submatrix A ∈ R k×(m+1) And B ∈ R k×N (ii) a S5: alternately optimizing the matrixes A and B by taking the generalized function as a target function; s6: and calculating an approximate matrix to realize missing data recovery. In order to solve the problem of recovery of missing data in electric energy measurement, the invention provides a data recovery algorithm based on cooperative fitting, which is used for solving the problem of recovery of missing data in electric energy measurementThe method can meet wider business application, and support the internal management requirements of power grid enterprises, the comprehensive energy efficiency management requirements of power users and the major analysis and decision requirements of governments. The algorithm can effectively reduce the complexity of the algorithm and improve the data recovery precision.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for avoiding divergence in multi-area power grid state estimation
abstract_en: Divergence of state estimation solutions for multi-area power grids typically occurs due to a single anomaly in the measurement set or network model, yet will cause failure of the state estimator to provide the solution for the entire system. Disclosed herein are methods and systems that allow detection, identification and isolation of the anomaly during the state estimation solution so that a large percentage of the system states can still be estimated, while isolating the anomaly that is causing the divergence for the estimator.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster forecasting method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an agricultural meteorological disaster forecasting method, device, equipment and storage medium. The agricultural meteorological disaster forecasting method can realize real-time updating of the crop database by constructing the crop database. The corresponding meteorological disaster types are obtained according to the crop codes and the crop areas, the corresponding meteorological disaster algorithms are obtained according to the crop codes and the crop areas and the meteorological disaster types respectively corresponding to the crop codes, the accuracy of meteorological disaster algorithm selection is guaranteed, a unified meteorological disaster algorithm calling mode is formed, relevant codes do not need to be modified after the meteorological disaster algorithms in the crop database are updated, and the flexible expansion of the meteorological disaster algorithms is guaranteed. And then, acquiring the index type required by the meteorological disaster algorithm according to the meteorological disaster algorithm, and acquiring meteorological forecast data in the crop area according to the index type. And judging whether the weather disasters exist in the crop areas corresponding to the crop codes according to the weather forecast data and the weather disaster algorithm.
assignees: SINOCHEM MODERN AGRICULTURE CO LTD

title_en: Data feature extraction and data compression method and device for urban rail power supply system digital twins
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for extracting digital twin data characteristics and compressing data of an urban rail power supply system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring actual waveform data and deduced waveform data acquired by an urban rail power supply system; the waveform data includes: ac side waveform data and dc side waveform data; step 2, compressing the actual waveform data and the derived waveform data; step 3, analyzing the compressed actual waveform data and the deduced waveform data, and extracting key characteristic information values of the actual waveform data and the deduced waveform data; and 4, judging whether the urban rail power supply system has a fault according to the difference value between the key characteristic information values of the actual waveform data and the deduced waveform data, and generating a judgment result.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Method, device and equipment for filling missing data of user
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for filling missing data of a user, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting power data from an original power data matrix to be filled through a preset sliding time window to form a time window data matrix; pre-filling missing data in the time window data matrix based on an interpolation algorithm to obtain a pre-filled matrix; determining a first user in the pre-populated matrix, wherein the first user is a target user for which there is missing power data; for each first user, searching a plurality of second users similar to the power data of the first user in a pre-filling matrix, forming the power data of the first user and the power data of the plurality of second users into a similar matrix corresponding to the first user, determining filling values of missing data of the first user in the similar matrix corresponding to the first user based on a singular value threshold algorithm, and filling the filling values into corresponding positions in an original power data matrix, so that the filling precision of the missing data of the users can be improved.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for graded early warning of leakage events of community water supply network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for graded early warning of a community water supply network leakage event based on abnormal state estimation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring inlet flow data of a water supply network of a community, preprocessing the acquired data, and repairing a missing value and an abnormal value; judging whether the data at the moment to be detected is an outlier or not, mapping the detection result to be the input state of a Kalman filter KF, and estimating and judging the possibility of leakage events through a self-adaptive abnormal state; and outputting different early warning levels according to the possibility of the leakage event. Compared with the prior art, the method, the device, the equipment and the medium for the graded early warning of the community water supply network leakage events based on abnormal state estimation can specifically identify the community water supply network leakage events according to the flow change rule of the community water supply network leakage events, reduce the false alarm caused by factors such as random user water consumption and monitoring errors, and realize more accurate early warning of the leakage events.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Communication system apparatus
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기술을 기반으로 한 스마트그리드 시스템의 최적화 관리장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a smart grid is an intelligent power grid system capable of increasing efficiency by allowing a supplier and a consumer to interact with each other through electricity product, transfer and consumption procedures combined with information communication technology (ICT). A system apparatus for communication between electric power units is introduced based on real-time data employing digital twin technology to build an optimal intelligent power grid system. A communication system, which is necessarily demanded, applies data of a physical space to a virtual space based on the digital twin technology to simulate a virtual smart grid facility, and then, reapplies the same data to real-time driving on the smart grid facility, thereby enabling intelligent driving considering real-time information about optimized installation for building a smart grid facility, and the supply and demand of electric power as well as state information about facilities such as generation, transmission/distribution, and storage facilities and the like at the same time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트그리드는 전기의 생산, 운반 소비과정에 정보통신기술(ICT)을 접목하여 공급자와 소비자가 상호작용함으로서 효율성을 높이는 지능형 전력망 시스템이다. 최적의 지능형 전력망 시스템을 구축하기 위하여 디지털 트윈기술을 적용한 실시간 데이터를 기반으로 전력 기기 간 통신 시스템 장치를 도입한다. 물리적 공간의 데이터를 디지털 트윈 기반의 가상공간에 적용하여 가상 스마트그리드 시설을 시뮬레이션하고, 다시 그 데이터를 스마트그리드 시설에 대한 실시간 운전에 적용함으로써 스마트그리드 시설 구축을 위한 최적화 설치, 전력의 공급과 수요에 대한 실시간 정보뿐만 아니라 발전, 송배전, 저장 시설 등의 설비에 대한 상태 정보를 동시에 고려한 지능화된 운전이 가능하도록 하는 통신 시스템이 필수적으로 요구된다.
assignees: GRIDA ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Power time sequence data abnormity detection method and filling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power time sequence data abnormity detection method, which comprises the steps of obtaining electric power time sequence data to be analyzed and judging missing values; filling missing data and judging abnormity; and finally, performing power time series data abnormity detection according to the abnormity judgment result. The invention also discloses a filling method comprising the power time sequence data abnormity detection method. The method judges whether the data needs to be filled according to the missing condition of the power time series data, and fills the data by using a moving average method of daytime data; meanwhile, whether the filled data is filled abnormally is considered, and abnormal point detection is carried out by adopting an abnormal detection method of combining a transverse short-term ring ratio with a dynamic threshold and combining a longitudinal same-ratio amplitude with a static threshold; finally, correcting the data with abnormal detection by using a moving average method of data in the day; therefore, the method can realize the abnormal detection and filling of the power time sequence data, and has the advantages of stability, reliability, high accuracy and higher efficiency.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: User electricity stealing behavior detection method, system, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for detecting electricity stealing behavior of a user, which are used for acquiring electricity consumption data of flat electric quantity, valley electric quantity and total electric quantity, screening out extreme abnormal data and deleting the extreme abnormal data, and carrying out internal interpolation on the time dimension to complement the missing data; constructing a user electricity consumption characteristic vector; constructing a supervised extreme gradient lifting decision tree, learning the distribution of the power consumption characteristic vectors from the training set, and performing parameter tuning and performance inspection to obtain an extreme gradient lifting decision tree classification model; and judging the characteristics in the characteristic vector of the electricity consumption of the user through each judging node in the classification model, obtaining the importance of each characteristic according to the proportion of the characteristics in the judging nodes, feeding back to the characteristic vector of the electricity consumption of the user for optimization, and completing the detection of the electricity stealing behavior of the user. Meanwhile, a terminal and a system are provided. The invention provides a basis for the targeted ground gate check of the power supply enterprise, thereby greatly reducing the workload of the power supply enterprise and improving the working efficiency.

title_en: Power distribution network prediction auxiliary device and prediction state estimation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network prediction auxiliary device and a prediction state estimation method thereof, wherein the power distribution network prediction auxiliary device comprises the following steps: the box, the left front bolt in box top has the controller, the left back bolt in box top has the host computer, all the bolts all around at box top have the support column, the top bolt of support column has the detection platform, detect the left front in platform top and placed the keyboard, it has the display to detect the left back bolt in platform top, the bottom on display right side is from last to inserting in proper order down and being equipped with the connecting wire. According to the invention, through the matching of the through grooves, the servo motor, the rotating rod, the driving gear, the driven gear, the lead screw, the threaded sleeve, the moving seat and the universal wheel, the box body can be moved, stood and fixed according to the actual requirements of a user on site, so that the user can conveniently and rapidly perform prediction operation on power distribution network equipment, the prediction efficiency of a power distribution network is accelerated, and the long-time work waiting of the power distribution network is avoided.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Power system state estimation edge server configuration method and system based on plant station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power systems, and provides a station-based power system state estimation edge server configuration method and system. The method comprises the steps of forming a block matrix network diagram according to a station geographical wiring diagram and measurement configuration; according to the least principle of injection edges, carrying out station numbering on the partitioned matrix network graph to form a directed factor graph; constructing a weighted directed factor graph by taking the directed factor graph as a basis; the point weight is the local calculation task amount of each station, and the edge weight is the data transmission amount; forming a calculation road tree by the weighted directed factor graph, obtaining all preselected partition schemes based on the road tree, and screening a partition scheme with the minimum time consumption from all the preselected partition schemes to serve as a final partition scheme; based on the final partitioning scheme, one edge server is configured for each partition of the power system for parallel estimation of power system state within the current partition.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Topology identification and state estimation of power grids
abstract_en: A method involves receiving power data measurements at nodes of an electrical power grid, the electrical power grid having multiple buses. For a first bus of the electrical power grid, an objective function is repeatedly minimized using the received power data measurements to determine estimated admittances between the first bus and other buses of the electrical power grid. The minimization of the objective function is linearly constrained by a repeatedly estimated sum of conductances and susceptances connected to the first bus. A minimum value of the objective function for the first bus is determined that corresponds to a maximum value of the estimated sum of conductances and susceptances. A topology of the electrical power grid associated with the first bus is determined based on the estimated admittances that correspond to the minimum value of the objective function and to the maximum value of the estimated sum of conductances and susceptances.
assignees: TOPOLONET CORP

title_en: Parallel estimation method and system for power system state
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power systems, and provides a power system state parallel estimation method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an electrical wiring diagram and measurement configuration of the power system, constructing a corresponding block information matrix network diagram, numbering the block information matrix network diagram by adopting a minimum length algorithm, and forming a directed factor diagram by taking a minimum injection element as a target; constructing a road tree according to the directed factor graph, and dividing nodes with the same depth in the road tree into the same parallel task; and based on the measurement equation of the power grid state estimation and the divided parallel tasks, iteratively solving the power system state corresponding to the subtasks in each parallel task.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method and system for estimating comprehensive state of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for estimating the comprehensive state of a power system, wherein the method for estimating the comprehensive state of the power system comprises the following steps: determining a power system state estimation basic model based on power system measurement data; determining a set of suspicious branch regions in the power system network based on the power system base model; at least three items of residual errors corresponding to the head end voltage, the tail end current, the branch forward current and the branch reverse current related to the suspicious branch exceed corresponding preset threshold values; relaxing the line parameters of all the suspicious branches into state variables, and determining a comprehensive state estimation model of the power system; the line parameters include: resistance, reactance and susceptance; and solving the power system comprehensive state estimation model based on the suspicious branch region set, and determining the target power system comprehensive state estimation. The comprehensive estimation of the state value, the topology and the parameters of the power system can be simultaneously carried out, and the effectiveness and the real-time performance of the state estimation of the power system are improved.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: IoT based power equipment remote monitoring and control system and method of the same
title_ko: 사물인터넷 기반 전력설비 원격감시제어 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electrical grid management system for managing a distributed power map and an operation method thereof. According to one embodiment, a power facility remote-monitoring control system includes: a collection server collecting data made by measuring a power amount flow of power measured for a predetermined time from a meter installed in a power facility; an FEP server performing a control operation such that the collected data is classified and recorded by meter, while identifying missing data from the measured data, and performing a control operation such that the identified missing data is replaced with preset data to be recorded as supplemented data; and a database server recording the data with the supplemented missing data in a database.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 분포된 전력도를 관리하는 전력망 관리 시스템 및 동작 방법에 관한 것으로서, 일 실시예에 따른 전력설비 원격감시제어 시스템은 전력설비에 설치된 계측기로부터 일정시간 동안에 측정한 전력의 전력량 흐름을 측정한 데이터를 수집하는 수집 서버, 상기 수집된 데이터를 계측기별로 구분하여 기록하도록 제어하되, 상기 측정된 데이터에서 결측 데이터를 식별하고, 상기 식별된 결측 데이터를 기설정된 데이터로 대체하여 결측 데이터를 보완하여 기록하도록 제어하는 FEP 서버, 상기 결측 데이터가 보완된 데이터를 데이터베이스에 기록하는 데이터베이스 서버를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV NAT MOKPO IND ACAD COOP GROUP;NYINFOTECH CO LTD

title_en: Energy Management System for Redox Flow Battery
title_ko: 레독스 흐름전지용 에너지관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an energy management system for a redox flow battery, and more specifically, to an energy management system for a redox flow battery which can manage the state information of a battery management system that manages the charging and discharging of the redox flow battery and an inverter which converts the power generated from the redox flow battery by interconnecting the same. The energy management system for a redox flow battery, according to an embodiment of the present invention: detects the flow rate, temperature, level, state of charge, etc. of a redox flow battery, and efficiently manages the detected information and the operation information of the power change device, that is, an inverter product, by collecting protocol information and transmitting the same to a remote location. In addition, the present invention can operate a protection relay between the inverter and the redox flow battery during overcharge and overdischarge according to the charging and discharging state of the redox flow battery, estimate the state of charge, and provide an integrated monitoring and energy integrated control environment by a server. In addition, the present invention collects information about the amount of solar power charged by time and period for each local site, analyzes the energy usage information of an energy storage module by hour, month, and year, and collects the abnormality of each module of the energy storage module for each local site. In addition, the present invention monitors real-time charging power and power consumption for each local site, and inquires and modifies various kinds of information in real time through a mobile app.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 레독스 흐름전지용 에너지관리시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 레독스 흐름 전지의 충전 및 방전을 관리하는 배터리관리시스템의 상태정보와 레독스 흐름전지에서 발생하는 전력을 변환하는 인버터를 상호 연계하여 관리할 수 있는 레독스 흐름전지용 에너지관리시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 레독스 흐름전지용 에너지관리시스템은 레독스 흐름전지의 유량, 온도, 레벨, 충전상태 등을 검출하고, 검출된 정보 및 전력변화장치 즉 인버터 제품의 운영정보를 프로토콜 정보를 수집하여 원격지로 송출하여 관리를 효율적으로 할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 레독스 흐름전지의 충전 및 방전 상태에 따라 과충전 및 과방전 시 인버터와 레독스 흐름 전지 사이의 보호릴레이를 동작시킬 수 있고, 충전상태 추정이 가능하며, 서버에 의한 통합 모니터링 및 에너지 통합 관제 환경을 제공할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 로컬 사이트별로 태양광 전력 충전량을 시간별, 기간별 정보를 수집하고, 에너지저장모듈의 에너지 사용량정보를 시간별, 월별, 연별 단위로 분석할 수 있으며, 로컬 사이트별로 에너지저장모듈의 각 모듈별 이상 유무를 수집할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 로컬 사이트별로 실시간 충전 전력량 및 소비 전력량을 파악할 수 있도록 모니터링하고, 모바일 앱을 통해 각종 정보를 실시간 조회 및 수정할 수 있다.
assignees: CERES

title_en: Adaptive robust state estimation method for power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive robust state estimation method of a power system, which carries out estimation according to time sequence, firstly, a suspicious measurement area is positioned on the power system through a fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm, if the suspicious measurement does not exist in a current time measurement set, the current time measurement is estimated based on a weighted least square method (WLS), if the suspicious measurement exists in the current time measurement set, after a power grid is dynamically partitioned based on the space distribution of the suspicious measurement, a least square estimation criterion and a minimum absolute value estimation criterion are respectively selected for a normal measurement area and the suspicious measurement area, and the state estimation problem of the power system is solved based on an alternative multiplier (ADMM) decoupling coordination algorithm. Aiming at the problems of low state estimation precision and long calculation time of a large-scale power system, the method selects different estimation criteria aiming at a suspicious measurement area and a normal measurement area by considering respective characteristics and adaptability of different estimators, and ensures the estimation precision and the calculation efficiency.

title_en: Method and system for mapping and mapping maintenance of off-line and on-line equipment of power grid
