abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for mapping and mapping maintenance of off-line and on-line equipment of a power grid, and belongs to the technical field of power system simulation. The invention is used for realizing the mutual mapping of the power grid online SCADA system and the offline analysis PSDB system on the equipment main key, and the specific method comprises the following steps: determining a mapping relation between the off-line equipment and the on-line equipment, acquiring mapping data, establishing a database aiming at the mapping relation, and establishing the mapping between the off-line equipment and the on-line equipment in the database; storing the mapping data to a PSDB dictionary table; acquiring online updating data of the power grid equipment, analyzing the updating data, storing the analyzed updating data into a PSDB dictionary table in a preset updating mode, updating the effective state of the PSDB dictionary table and counting updating information and logs; and maintaining mapping data and updating data stored in the PSDB dictionary table and the dictionary table. The invention facilitates the maintenance personnel to check and maintain the mapping information.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twin body construction system for precise monitoring of sunlight greenhouse
abstract_en: The utility model provides a digital twin structure system for sunlight greenhouse accurate monitoring, includes intelligent monitoring control edge node, intelligent network deployment transmission node, high in the clouds storage calculation node and the digital twin sunlight greenhouse platform that links to each other in order, visual control terminal node with digital twin sunlight greenhouse platform links to each other, and the expansion module node is connected intelligent network deployment transmission node. The invention can realize the automatic real-time acquisition, display and modeling analysis of multi-environment element data, and support the automatic linkage regulation and control according to the early warning rule, thereby achieving the effects of improving the crop yield, reducing the operation and management cost, improving the disaster risk resistance, optimizing the management mode and enhancing the automatic management and control capability of the greenhouse.
assignees: Langfang Meteorological Bureau

title_en: Mountain torrent forecasting and early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent forecasting and early-warning method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the forecasting and early-warning method comprises the following steps of constructing a digital twinning database; constructing a digital twin drainage basin; on the basis of collecting multisource precipitation forecasting products, generating future aggregate average precipitation forecasting results by adopting a geometric averaging method, and forming precipitation aggregate forecasting together with a single precipitation forecasting product, and updating future precipitation data in a digital twin database in real time; coupling rainfall set forecasting with the digital twin river basin to realize mountain torrent rolling forecasting; based on the mountain torrent forecasting result, the mountain torrent risk grade is intelligently identified according to the early warning grading standard, an early warning decision is generated, and early warning information is sent. The advantages are that: the method solves the problem that the existing mountain torrent forecasting and early warning method cannot accurately describe and reflect the current and future conditions of the river basin at the same time, and can accurately provide mountain torrent disaster early warning information, dynamically evaluate risk grades and automatically issue early warning decisions so as to smoothly develop mountain torrent disaster defense work.

title_en: Prediction method of energy power based on data processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a data processing-based energy power prediction method, which is based on a hybrid integrated prediction model of a data processing and robust variational echo state network. Firstly, a wind speed time sequence with the maximum influence coefficient on wind power output is determined by utilizing a mutual information method, then, historical wind power and wind speed time sequences are fitted by adopting a Gaussian algorithm, error or missing data in original wind power are corrected and supplemented, meanwhile, the time sequences influencing wind power output, namely wind speed, wind direction, temperature, air pressure and air density time sequences, are processed by adopting a Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA) method, principal components capable of reflecting most characteristics of the original time sequences are extracted, and redundancy of the data is eliminated. And finally, taking the processed data as an input training prediction model of the robust variational echo state network to obtain an output weight of the model, thereby obtaining a short-term prediction method of wind power.

title_en: Flood control scheduling method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood control scheduling method based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a digital twinning body of a flood control scheduling system; s2, tracking and updating the digital twin bodies of the flood control dispatching system to acquire the digital twin bodies of the flood control dispatching system in real time and synchronization; s3, a digital twin body of the flood control dispatching system based on real-time synchronization is utilized to develop weather and hydrologic set forecast by utilizing a weather model and a plurality of hydrologic models, the flood control dispatching process of a week in the future of the target reservoir is predicted, analysis and judgment are carried out on flood control situations according to the prediction result, and an adjustment scheme of the current dispatching rule of the reservoir is provided. The advantages are that: the method overcomes the defects that the existing flood control scheduling method cannot comprehensively reflect real-time information of flood control scheduling, the weather hydrologic forecast is short in effective forecast period and low in forecast accuracy, can accurately provide information of a flood control scheduling process, dynamically evaluates flood control risks, and is convenient for smoothly carrying out flood disaster defense work.

title_en: Power load missing data restoration method based on power utilization mode decomposition and reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load missing data restoration method based on power consumption mode decomposition and reconstruction, and relates to the field of analysis and processing of large power data. The method comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring power load data of a power consumer, and dividing a data set into a complete load data set and a load data set to be repaired; based on the sparsity and diversity of the user power load, a K singular value decomposition dictionary learning algorithm is adopted to extract a base vector dictionary matrix representing the user power electronic mode from the complete load data set; decomposing and coding the load curve to be repaired based on the basis of the base vector dictionary matrix, and determining the load curve to be repaired to be composed of electronic modes; and finally, reconstructing the load curve according to the coding vector of the load curve to be repaired based on the base vector dictionary matrix, and filling and repairing the data of the missing part of the power load. The method can be applied to multi-day load data loss or load data loss repair in continuous time periods.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Method and program for managing measurement data of IoT-based power facilities
title_ko: 사물인터넷 기반 전력설비의 계측 데이터를 관리하는 방법 및 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for managing measurement data during power grid management. According to an embodiment, the method for managing measurement data comprises: a step of loading measurement data stored in a database after recording it for a predetermined time by a minute unit; a first step of reading instantaneous data from the loaded measurement data by an N hour and minute unit; a second step of comparing the read instantaneous data with field data to determine whether there is wrong measurement; a third step of compensating for the wrong measurement in the N hour and minute unit when there is wrong measurement as a determination result; and a fourth step of repeating the first to third steps by increasing the N hour and minute unit within the predetermined time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력망 관리 중 계측 데이터를 관리하는 방법에 관한 것으로서, 일 실시예에 따른 계측 데이터를 관리하는 방법은, 일정시간 동안 분 단위로 기록 후 데이터베이스에 저장된 계측 데이터를 로딩하는 단계, 상기 로딩된 계측 데이터에서 N시분단위에서의 순시 데이터를 독출하는 제1 단계, 상기 독출된 순시 데이터와 현장 데이터를 대비하여 결측 여부를 판단하는 제2 단계, 상기 판단 결과 결측된 경우에 상기 N시분단위에서의 결측 데이터를 보완하는 제3 단계, 및 상기 일정시간 내에서 상기 N시분단위를 증가시켜 상기 제1 내지 제3 단계를 반복하는 제4 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV NAT MOKPO IND ACAD COOP GROUP;NYINFOTECH CO LTD

title_en: Completion method for missing daily freezing data of electric energy meter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for complementing missing day freezing data of an electric energy meter, belongs to the technical field of electric power marketing electric quantity monitoring and analysis, relates to a method for complementing missing data of the electric energy meter, and particularly relates to a method for complementing missing data of the electric energy meter, which is used for complementing the missing data of the electric energy meter with missing day freezing data and certain days freezing data. The method comprises the steps of obtaining basic information of a user and relevant characteristic factors of electricity utilization; forming an electric energy data time series characteristic diagram; dividing the training set, the verification set and the test set; transmitting the electric energy data time series characteristic diagram to an input layer of the LSTM network; training and modeling the LSTM network by using the training set data to obtain an LSTM model; inputting the verification set into an LSTM model to determine the optimal parameters of the model; testing the LSTM model; restoring data of the date missing date of the daily freezing data; and outputting a daily freezing data restoration result of the missing date. The method fills data loss, improves the data quality of power supply enterprises, improves the recovery accuracy of the lost data, and has high missing completion accuracy.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHENJIANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Method and device for identifying abnormal data of power system and intelligent chip
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and an intelligent chip for identifying abnormal data of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data to be tested of a power system and an actual state estimation value corresponding to the data to be tested; acquiring a state estimation value prediction model; the state estimation value prediction model is obtained by training a cyclic neural network by adopting at least one group of sample data groups of the power system, wherein each group of sample data groups comprises sample data and a pre-labeled state estimation value; calling the state estimation value prediction model to output to obtain a prediction state estimation value according to the data to be detected; and identifying abnormal data of the power system based on the actual state estimation value and the predicted state estimation value. The scheme of the invention can improve the accuracy of identifying the abnormal data of the power system.

title_en: Power distribution network gridding management method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network gridding management method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out detrending fluctuation analysis on the recorded load sequence in the grid and the predicted load sequence in the grid to obtain a first singular index sequence, a second singular index sequence and a second difference coefficient; constructing a first obstruction graph and a second obstruction graph according to the first singular exponent sequence and the second singular exponent sequence; obtaining a first difference coefficient, a third difference coefficient, a fourth difference coefficient and a fifth difference coefficient according to the first and second obstruction graphs; evaluating and researching a power supply grid region to obtain the importance of a power distribution system in the region; and obtaining the grid load importance of the power distribution network according to the first, second, third, fourth and fifth difference coefficients and the importance of the power distribution system. The load importance data of the grids are guaranteed to have strong timeliness and reliability, the power supply grids are selected according to the importance for state estimation, the state estimation calculated amount is saved, and effective management of the power distribution grid is achieved.
assignees: JIANGSU DIANBAIDA INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system dynamic state estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for estimating a dynamic state of a power system, and relates to the technical field of power system analysis. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring measurement data at the moment k; wherein the measurement data is PMU/SCADA mixed measurement data; according to the load vector in the state space at the moment before the moment k, performing state prediction on the moment k to obtain a predicted state quantity; obtaining the zero injection power at a zero injection node to obtain high-precision static measurement; according to the predicted state quantity, performing measurement prediction on the k moment to obtain a measurement predicted value; and according to the measurement data, the static quantity measurement and the measurement predicted value, carrying out filtering updating on the predicted state quantity to obtain a dynamic state estimation result at the k moment. The invention can replace the processing method of directly performing linear extrapolation on the state quantity in the traditional algorithm by introducing a Dynamic Load Prediction (DLP) model, and simultaneously improves the zero injection node to improve the estimation precision of the dynamic state.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: New energy power generation scene data migration method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention provides a new energy power generation scene data migration method based on a generation countermeasure network, which takes a new energy power station with large-scale missing historical data as a target power station, takes an adjacent new energy power station with complete historical data as a source power station, learns a scene data mapping relation between the source power station and the target power station by generating a countermeasure network model, and further generates target power station scene data according to the source power station scene data, wherein the generated data accords with a real scene data distribution rule. Only a C-DCGAN model is needed to be established to learn the mapping relation between the data of the target power station and the data of the source power station, the data of the source power station can be processed and then transferred to the target power station, missing data of the target power station is supplemented, data supplementation can be completed more efficiently, and the algorithm flow is simplified; the stability of the C-DCGAN model is improved by introducing Wasserstein distance and a gradient penalty function; the accuracy of data migration is improved, meanwhile, the time for constructing the target model is reduced, and the economic cost and the time cost are reduced.

title_en: Digital twin body construction method for precise monitoring of sunlight greenhouse
abstract_en: A digital twin body construction method for precise monitoring of a sunlight greenhouse comprises the following three steps: the method comprises the following steps of firstly, preparing, carrying out early-stage information acquisition and making a digital twinning sunlight greenhouse scheme; secondly, constructing a digital twin sunlight greenhouse, wherein the digital twin sunlight greenhouse comprises a digitization process, a standardization process and an intellectualization process; and thirdly, operation and maintenance are carried out, and expansion, feedback and optimization are carried out on the constructed digital twin body. The invention can realize the automatic real-time acquisition, display and modeling analysis of multi-environment element data, and support the automatic linkage regulation and control according to the early warning rule, thereby achieving the effects of improving the crop yield, reducing the operation and management cost, improving the disaster risk resistance, optimizing the management mode and enhancing the automatic management and control capability of the greenhouse.
assignees: Langfang Meteorological Bureau

title_en: Emergency dispatching system and emergency dispatching method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency dispatching system and an emergency dispatching method based on a digital twin technology, wherein the emergency dispatching system comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time operation data of data center infrastructure; the data analysis module is used for analyzing and processing the operating data by utilizing a prestored algorithm model to obtain an analysis result and obtaining an abnormal node and an abnormal influence range according to the analysis result; and the digital twin display module is used for displaying the abnormal nodes, the abnormal influence range, the processing suggestions and the emergency scheduling scheme, and the emergency scheduling scheme is obtained by adopting an automatic routing algorithm based on the abnormal nodes, the abnormal influence range, the processing suggestions and the available resource information. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of effectively improving the efficiency, high performability and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI BAOSIGHT DATA CO LTD

title_en: Private cloud-based intelligent power safety control platform
abstract_en: The power safety intelligent management and control platform based on the private cloud is built based on technologies such as Internet of things, big data, artificial intelligence, digital twinning, image recognition and personnel positioning, can be deployed in local, branch or group level data centers, and managers check the safety risk condition of a power plant in real time, predict future risks, guide to rapidly manage and control high risks and guarantee that the power plant is in a safety state. The private cloud-based intelligent power safety management and control platform is embedded with various intelligent positioning devices, intelligent acquisition devices, edge computing devices, a GIS system, a customized three-dimensional platform, a customized AI algorithm model, a wireless communication module and the like, can realize 3D visualization, personnel positioning, electronic fence and violation management, is communicated with data of a two-ticket system, an SIS system, an OA system, an ERP system, a safety training system and an access control system, forms an integrated intelligent power safety management and control platform, and provides support for managers.
assignees: RUOPU AUTOMATION TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network dynamic state estimation algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network dynamic state estimation algorithm, which firstly controls the distribution of Sigma sampling points by adaptively adjusting a proportional correction factor of unscented transformation and introduces an evanescent factor to adjust Kalman filtering gain on line to improve the quality of an importance density function, then realizes state estimation by using a particle filtering theory, and the improved unscented Kalman filtering algorithm UKF is combined with a particle filtering PF algorithm to form a power distribution network state estimation algorithm with stronger robustness and higher filtering precision; when the system has bad measurement data, the system can quickly sense the bad measurement data, and the prediction covariance is corrected by introducing an fading factor so as to adjust the filtering gain, so that the robustness of the algorithm is enhanced.
assignees: UNIV GUIZHOU

title_en: Method for constructing switch cabinet equipment state evaluation system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for constructing a switch cabinet equipment state evaluation system based on digital twins, and relates to the technical field of the method for constructing the switch cabinet equipment state evaluation system. The method for constructing the switch cabinet equipment state evaluation system based on the digital twinning comprises the following steps: s1, model mapping; s2, behavior mapping; s3, state mapping; and S4, applying the clothes in the cloud edge coordination mode. The method for constructing the switch cabinet equipment state evaluation system based on the digital twin is constructed through three dimensions of model mapping, behavior mapping and state mapping, and application service is realized in a cloud edge cooperation mode; the model mapping is divided through a hierarchical network, and digital models of a power grid, a switch cabinet and a component hierarchy are established; the behavior mapping abstracts the switch on-off process in the switch cabinet into behaviors, improves timeliness, comprehensiveness and safety of switch cabinet equipment monitoring, and facilitates operation scheduling strategies from the overall angle of a full power grid or a local power grid.
assignees: ZIBO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Active power distribution system state estimation method considering distributed power supply access
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active power distribution system state estimation method considering distributed power supply access, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a dynamic model of an active power distribution network system containing a distributed power supply; step 2, obtaining the measurement quantity in the power distribution network, screening the measurement data according to a dynamic event trigger mechanism, and transmitting the data meeting the conditions to an active power distribution network state estimator; step 3, constructing an active power distribution network state estimator based on a dynamic event trigger mechanism; and 4, solving the filter gain, and substituting the solved filter gain into the active power distribution network state estimator to obtain an active power distribution system state estimation value. The method reduces the data transmission quantity on the premise of ensuring the state estimation precision, effectively relieves the communication pressure of the power distribution network, can estimate the running state of the distributed power supply accessed into the active power distribution system, and expands the state estimation range.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Converter variable digital twinning model construction method considering space charge
abstract_en: The invention requests to protect a converter variable digital twin model construction method considering space charge. Firstly, determining the distribution position of a sensing device according to the operation condition of a transformer, and correcting a sensing system by a gradual elimination method to obtain a converter transformer sensing network; a converter transformer geometric dimension model is constructed by adopting a BIM technology, and a converter transformer panoramic model is obtained by utilizing an oblique photogrammetry technology; and mapping the sensing data to the conversion flow model. Schottky injection is used as the only source of free particles, and an electric-thermal-force multi-field coupling calculation model under microscopic particles is obtained based on the derivation of space charges. Finally, separating information contained in the BIM based on the API, storing the geometric information into a JSON file model area, and storing the material and attribute information into a JSON file information area; setting a unified identifier associated with a real scene model and a multi-physical field model, and realizing the fusion of the two models by calling key information mutually to finally obtain a complete conversion current transformer twin model.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Transformer equipment management evaluation system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transformation equipment management evaluation system based on a digital twinning technology, which comprises a data conversion device, a data acquisition server, a visualization server and a Hadoop cluster, wherein the Hadoop cluster is constructed with a digital twinning model, the data conversion device, the data acquisition server, the visualization server and the Hadoop cluster are respectively connected to an Ethernet through a firewall, the data acquisition server acquires data from each data source through the Ethernet and sends the data to the data conversion device, the data conversion device converts the received data into a form required by the Hadoop cluster and then sends the form to the Hadoop cluster, the Hadoop cluster is used for storing and accessing mass data and obtaining a power transformation equipment management evaluation result by adopting the digital twinning model to calculate and analyze the data, and the power transformation equipment management evaluation result is sent to the visualization server, and the visualization server presents the power transformation equipment management evaluation result; the intelligent operation and inspection management and control system has the advantages of effectively supplementing and expanding the current popular PMS system of the power grid and the intelligent operation and inspection management and control system of the power grid in continuous construction.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Multi-region parallel state estimation method and system for power system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a multi-region parallel state estimation method and a multi-region parallel state estimation system for a power system, which solve the problem that the existing multi-region state estimation method is inconsistent with the centralized estimation result due to the fact that regions need to be coordinated. The method can be consistent with a centralized estimation result by utilizing the principle of parallel computing, has no problem that the prior method needs to be coordinated, and has advantages in computational efficiency. Particularly, a power system is divided into a plurality of areas, and an information matrix is expressed into a form of a block matrix; determining the order of node elimination calculation and data to be shared among subsystems according to the calculation factor directed graph on the basis of the calculation process of the sparse matrix; and (3) adopting a synchronous iterative parallel state estimation method for storing shared data by a Zookeeper system. The method provides the steps of the configuration of the Zookeeper storage nodes and the multi-region parallel computation after the power system is partitioned, provides a theoretical basis for the parallel state estimation of the power system, enables the state estimation result of the power system to be more accurate, greatly improves the efficiency and the reliability, and is beneficial to large-range popularization and application.
assignees: UNIV JINAN

title_en: Power distribution network short-term load prediction method based on deep neural network combination model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network short-term load prediction method based on a deep neural network combination model, which comprises the following steps: carrying out data preprocessing on the collected user load data in the power distribution network, identifying missing data and abnormal data, correcting and carrying out normalization processing, and constructing a power distribution network user load data set; establishing a self-organizing mapping SOM neural network clustering model, inputting the processed data set, and obtaining a classified user load data set according to the load curve of each user in the power distribution network on the same day; establishing a BP-DNN load prediction model and an LSTM neural network load prediction model, and selecting models with different network structures for short-term load prediction aiming at different types of user loads; and (3) adopting a least square method to combine the prediction results of the two models by taking the optimal weight to perform short-term prediction. According to the invention, respective prediction models are established for different types of power distribution network users, so that the accuracy of short-term load prediction and the engineering applicability are effectively improved.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCI & TECH

title_en: Electric quantity prediction method of online self-adaptive OSELM-GARCH model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric quantity prediction method of an online self-adaptive OSELM-GARCH model, which comprises the steps of carrying out STL time series addition decomposition on electric quantity data subjected to data cleaning, and respectively carrying out model building on each component; performing time sequence decomposition on a group of newly added real-time electric quantity data, updating the parameters of the trend item model by using an ELM (element-to-metal) online updating algorithm, calculating by using a gradient descent idea to obtain the optimal value of the random parameters of the current model, and storing the optimal value; judging the generalization level of the initial GARCH model to new data based on white noise inspection, and determining whether to retrain the GARCH model according to the adaptability of the model; merging the subentry results to obtain an integral prediction frame; and evaluating the prediction performance and updating the overall prediction framework. The method establishes the online prediction model which is effective in real time and can reflect the evolution rule of the time sequence, realizes the adaptivity of the algorithm, and improves the online prediction capability of the power system and the anti-noise capability of the model.
assignees: TAIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Digital twin distribution network fault-based diagnosis method and related device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a diagnosis method and a related device based on a digital twin distribution network fault. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring bottom layer monitoring data, wherein the bottom layer monitoring data comprises monitoring data of temperatures of an overhead line, an underground cable and a switch cabinet; constructing a digital twin model according to the bottom monitoring data; inputting the acquired running parameter information of the temperatures of the overhead line, the underground cable and the switch cabinet into a digital twin model to acquire data to be diagnosed; and generating a diagnosis result of the equipment operation state corresponding to the operation parameter information by combining a fault prediction processing digital twin database, wherein the fault prediction processing digital twin database is a database formed by processing according to the past data and the real-time operation parameters. Because the bottom monitoring data is integrated into the digital twin model, the fault conditions of all links are integrated to obtain the diagnosis result, so that the research and judgment of the faults of the power distribution network are accurate, and the fault first-aid repair efficiency is improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Real-time synchronization method and device for digital twins of transformer substation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a real-time synchronization method and a real-time synchronization device for a transformer substation digital twin, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, a twin background of a transformer substation receives real-time detection data of measuring points of at least one transformer substation; step 2, the transformer substation twin background sends the measuring point real-time detection data to a transformer substation web front end, so that the transformer substation web front end displays the measuring point real-time detection data in real time; the transformer substation twin background is connected with the transformer substation web front end in a Websocket mode. The invention can avoid meaningless network connection.
assignees: CLOUDWISE BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Voltage missing data identification method based on improved random forest algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voltage missing data identification method based on an improved random forest algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of a power grid, selecting all corresponding associated attributes of missing data, and dividing different attributes; obtaining a learning sample set through attribute comprehensive weighting calculation; repeatedly sampling the learning samples to obtain a plurality of similar sample sets; taking the similar sample set as input, and training a random forest regression model; improving the prediction precision of random forest regression; and taking the final prediction mean values of all the decision trees as filling results, evaluating the filling results, and completing filling when the filling results are in a tolerance range. The method and the device improve the identification precision of the missing data, thereby improving the filling precision of the power grid missing value.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Pipe network management system for managing pipe network of waterworks and method of the same
title_ko: 분포된 상수도를 관리하는 관망 관리 시스템 및 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pipe network management system for a distributed water supply and an operation method. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the pipe network management system comprises: a collection server that collects data measuring flow of water measured for a certain period of time from a measuring instrument installed in a block; an FEP server that controls collected data for recording the collected data separately for each instrument, identifies missing data from measured data, and replaces identified missing data with preset data to supplement and record the missing data; and a database server that records data supplemented with the missing data in the database.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 분포된 상수도를 관리하는 관망 관리 시스템 및 동작 방법에 관한 것으로서, 일 실시예에 따른 관망 관리 서버 시스템은 블록에 설치된 계측기로부터 일정시간 동안에 측정한 상수의 유량 흐름을 측정한 데이터를 수집하는 수집 서버, 상기 수집된 데이터를 계측기별로 구분하여 기록하도록 제어하되, 상기 측정된 데이터에서 결측 데이터를 식별하고, 상기 식별된 결측 데이터를 기설정된 데이터로 대체하여 결측 데이터를 보완하여 기록하도록 제어하는 FEP 서버, 상기 결측 데이터가 보완된 데이터를 데이터베이스에 기록하는 데이터베이스 서버를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: NYINFOTECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent dam management system based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 지능형 댐 안전 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital twin-based intelligent dam safety management system. According to the present invention, considerable improvements can be achieved in speed, accuracy, efficiency, and so on through dam infrastructure safety inspection and facility management technology advancement. The present invention includes: a digital twin generation module for building 3D dam modeling with respect to a dam where measuring means is installed at a facility based on an image captured by at least one of a drone and imaging means, subdividing the 3D dam modeling by management region, and displaying at least one of facility information and measurement information of the measuring means on the 3D dam modeling; a 3D modeling mapping module mapping the 3D dam modeling with an image captured by a thermal imaging camera-equipped drone and storing certain flight path information by management region and enabling the confirmation of dam water leakage or efflorescence change through a thermal imaging orthoimage while comparing and expressing the pre- and post-mapping 3D dam modeling; and a concrete crack identification module for performing concrete crack identification by deep learning analysis of a dam concrete structure image captured by the drone.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 댐 안전 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 댐 인프라 안전점검 및 시설관리의 기술 고도화를 통해 신속성, 정확성, 효율성 등을 대폭적으로 개선할 수 있는 디지털 트윈 기반 지능형 댐 안전 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은, 시설물에 계측수단이 설치된 댐에 대해 드론 및 촬영수단 중 적어도 어느 하나 이상으로 촬영한 이미지에 기초하여 3D 댐 모델링을 구축하고, 3D 댐 모델링을 관리영역 단위별로 세분화하며, 3D 댐 모델링상에 시설물 정보 및 계측수단의 측정정보 중 적어도 어느 하나 이상을 표시하기 위한 디지털 트윈 생성모듈과; 상기 관리영역 단위별로 일정 비행경로 정보가 저장되고 열화상 카메라가 장착된 드론이 촬영한 이미지를 3D 댐 모델링에 매핑하고, 매핑 전후 3D 댐 모델링을 비교 표출하면서 열화상 정사영상을 통해 댐의 누수 또는 백태 변화를 확인 가능하도록 하는 3D 모델링 매핑모듈과; 상기 드론이 촬영한 댐 콘크리트 구조물 이미지를 딥러닝 방식으로 분석하여 콘크리트 균열을 판별하기 위한 콘크리트 균열 판별모듈;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: LEE YONG

title_en: Airport emergency drilling method and system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of computers, and provides an airport emergency drilling method and system based on digital twins, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring airport operation data, wherein the operation data comprises positions, operation data, signals, coupling relations of all equipment and buildings and quality information reflecting the operation states of the equipment and the buildings; establishing an emergency drilling digital twin model according to airport operation data; the emergency drilling data are input into an emergency drilling digital twin model to obtain an emergency drilling result, the emergency drilling digital twin model is established according to airport operation data, the airport operation data contain a coupling relation and can represent the damaged propagation relation of equipment and a building in an emergency state, the finally obtained emergency drilling result can reflect the space and the time sequence of the propagation of accident disasters, and corresponding countermeasures can be formulated according to the damaged propagation relation.
assignees: UNIV CIVIL AVIATION CHINA

title_en: Multi-element pregnant disaster digital twin intelligent perception identification early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal ore production, and discloses a multivariate pregnant disaster digital twin intelligent perception identification early warning system and a multivariate pregnant disaster digital twin intelligent perception identification early warning method. The multivariate pregnancy disaster digital twin intelligent perception identification early warning system and method can effectively avoid errors of detection data of detection equipment caused by equipment failure, and simultaneously improve the safety of work in a roadway.
assignees: SINOSTEEL MAANSHAN GENERAL INSTITUTE OF MINING RES CO LTD

title_en: Novel estimation method and device for topological structure matrix of power grid system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel estimation method for a topological structure matrix of a power grid system, which comprises the following steps of: step S10, establishing a power grid model, and obtaining an original measurement data set and a state variable set from a power grid system; step S11, estimating a topological structure matrix of the power grid system by adopting a least square method or a least mean square error method according to the original measurement data set and the state variable set; step S12, generating a state estimation value according to the topological structure matrix of the power grid system; and step S13, calculating an extreme value according to the state estimation value, comparing the extreme value with a set threshold value, judging whether the current measured data is bad data according to a comparison result, and screening out the bad data. The invention also discloses corresponding equipment. The method has the advantages of less collected sample data, simple calculation and accurate estimation result.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: GMM-based power system digital twin parameter correction method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a GMM-based method and a device for correcting digital twin body parameters of a power system, which relate to the technical field of power systems and comprise the following steps: firstly, acquiring a target physical quantity, and determining a parameter combination of the digital twin body according to the target physical quantity; generating original simulation data based on the parameter combination, and selecting target simulation data meeting preset requirements from the original simulation data; establishing a target GMM model according to the target simulation data; and finally, searching out an optimal characteristic quantity value by using a simulated annealing algorithm, and determining an optimal value of the parameter combination based on the optimal characteristic quantity value and the target GMM model. According to the invention, by introducing the target GMM model and the simulated annealing algorithm, on one hand, the local optimization can be avoided, and on the other hand, the accurate mapping from the characteristic quantity to the parameter combination can be realized, so that the optimal value of the parameter combination determined according to the value of the optimal characteristic quantity can ensure the consistency of the digital twin and the entity product of the power system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SICHUAN ENERGY INT RES INST TSINGHUA UNIV;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Scheduling method of cross-river basin water-transfer engineering based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The dispatching method of the cross-basin water diversion project based on the digital twin technology comprises the following steps of 1, accurately predicting water demand of each user in a water receiving area of the cross-basin water diversion project, 2, calculating key section control indexes of the cross-basin water diversion project based on the digital twin theory, 3, accurately generating a multi-reservoir combined dispatching scheme of the water diversion area, 4, sensing data of the cross-basin water diversion project and real-time interaction of the data with a virtual digital environment, and 5, predicting safety conditions of a system and generating future dispatching countermeasures. The invention achieves the aim of accurately supplying water to each water taking factory by combining the water supply area reservoir and the distribution water pipe network, can accurately simulate the running process of the whole link of the cross-basin water distribution project, accurately pre-judge the potential risk in the project running, generate corresponding countermeasures and plans, realize the emergency management under sudden accidents, and has obvious advantages compared with the conventional simulation scheduling model.

title_en: Intelligent mine scene oriented digital twin evolution mechanism and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machine vision, computer simulation and Internet of things, and discloses a digital twin evolution mechanism for an intelligent mine scene. The digital twin evolution mechanism and method for the intelligent mine scene are characterized in that a conventional mathematical simulation model is distinguished by a digital twin technology, the digital twin model emphasizes interaction between reality and can be updated and dynamically evolved in real time, so that dynamic real mapping of a physical world is realized, an immersive visualization technology can help a user to know mine disasters more clearly, more thoroughly and more abundantly, a three-dimensional virtual space can be simulated by applying a visual display component based on a 3R interaction technology, physical equipment in an intelligent energy system is displayed in front of the user in an almost real state, and the operation and control of a physical entity, an information network and a simulation model are indirectly realized through the operation and control of a virtual body.
assignees: SINOSTEEL MAANSHAN GENERAL INSTITUTE OF MINING RES CO LTD

title_en: Regional power distribution network load demand hybrid prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a load demand hybrid prediction method for a regional power distribution network, which comprises data collection, data processing, prediction by different methods and comprehensive calculation of prediction results by different methods. The data preprocessing combines the collected data to process abnormal values, missing data and the like in the data information. The combined prediction method comprises three prediction methods of multiple linear regression, gray prediction and support vector machine prediction, and prediction deviations of different methods are calculated by combining sample collection. The weight determination of the combined prediction method result is to apply a coefficient of variation method and finally determine the weights of different methods according to the prediction deviation. The combination method effectively avoids interference and influence of irrelevant data and abnormal data, and meanwhile combines the combination application of different methods and corresponding prediction error effects to determine the weight of the calculation result of each method, so that the accuracy degree of the prediction result can be effectively improved, and the accurate prediction of the power demand of the regional power distribution network is realized.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Electric vehicle cluster controllability determining method, scheduling method and system
abstract_en: A method for determining the adjustable and controllable capacity of an electric automobile cluster, a scheduling method and a system comprise the following steps: at each scheduling moment, according to the remaining charging duration, the current SOC and the target SOC of each EV, calculating the available charging/discharging capacity and the available charging/discharging power of each scheduling moment of the electric vehicle by using the single electric vehicle controllability evaluation model; superposing the available charging/discharging capacity and the available charging/discharging power at each scheduling moment of each electric automobile to determine the adjustable and controllable capacity of each scheduling time period of the electric automobile cluster; respectively distributing power of each electric automobile in the electric automobile cluster at each moment in a scheduling period by taking supply and demand balance as a target based on the power grid demand and the adjustable and controllable capacity of the electric automobile cluster at each moment; by adopting the scheme of the patent, the controllability of the EV cluster can be accurately evaluated, the real-time updating of the EV cluster power and capacity boundaries is realized by reasonably distributing power to the EVs in different states, and the method has important significance for balancing load power and making a real-time scheduling plan by a power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID ELEC VEHICLE SERVICE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Recursively corrected hybrid linear state estimation method
abstract_en: The application discloses a recursion correction hybrid linear state estimation method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a topological structure, network parameters and measurement data of a power system; calculating SCADA complex pseudo-measurement relative to a reference node according to the SCADA measurement data, and estimating a rough system state; performing recursive correction on the rough system state according to PMU measurement data to obtain the accurate system state; according to the acquired accurate system state, performing weight recurrence correction; carrying out correction region adjustment by using a correction region adjustment algorithm; and establishing a multithreading processing framework based on stream calculation, splitting the estimation process of the rough system state and the precise system state into a plurality of processes which are executed in parallel, and obtaining the final precise system state output. The application improves the estimation precision and the calculation efficiency of the state estimation, improves the frequency of state quantity update and the real-time performance of the state estimation, can be executed in parallel, ensures the feasibility of the algorithm, and ensures the estimation performance to be more stable.

title_en: Hull stress monitoring system using digital twin and prediction method for fatigue fracture of ship
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용한 선체응력 모니터링 시스템 및 이를 이용한 선박의 피로 파괴 예측 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hull stress monitoring system using a digital twin and a prediction method for fatigue fracture of a ship using the same, which are able to measure the stress of a hull by using one or more stress sensors placed on the hull, measure the corrosion degree of an outer plate of the hull by using an electric conductivity, add an environmental outer force information based on the measured stress and corrosion degree of the hull, and predict the fatigue fracture possibility of the ship after a simulation. Accordingly, the present invention is able to monitor the status of the ship in real time, collect various data in real time, constantly and simultaneously measure the data, make a database with the collected data, make it possible to perform the integrated management in accordance with the measuring point, perform a simulation of the collected data, and notify a user to perform the prevention and repair for a stress on the hull greater than a limit value or a measured region where corrosion occurs so that the user can take an immediate action. In addition, the present invention is able to predict the stress and the corrosion degree on the hull for a planned path for navigation through a simulation, prevent the fatigue fracture such as a crack or a cut which could occur on the hull, prevent a disaster on the sea, and extend the life of the ship.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 트윈을 이용한 선체응력 모니터링 시스템 및 이를 이용한 피로 파괴 예측 방법에 관한 것으로, 선체에 구비된 적어도 하나 이상의 응력 센서를 이용하여 선체의 응력을 측정하고, 전기 전도도를 이용하여 상기 선체의 외판의 부식 정도를 측정하며, 측정된 선체의 응력 및 부식 정도를 기초로 환경외력 정보를 추가하여 시뮬레이션 후 선박의 피로 과괴 가능성을 예측하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이것에 의해, 선박의 상태를 실시간으로 감시하고 각종 데이터를 실시간으로 수집함으로써, 데이터의 연속적이고 동시적인 측정을 할 수 있고, 수집된 데이터를 데이터베이스화하여 측정지점에 따른 통합관리가 가능해지며, 수집된 데이터를 시뮬레이션 함으로써 선체에 가해지는 응력이 한계값 보다 큰 경우나 부식이 일어나고 있는 측정 지역에 대해서 예방 및 수리를 진행할 수 있도록 사용자에게 알림으로 즉각적인 조치가 가능하다. 
또한, 운항 예정 경로에 대하여 선체에 가해질 응력과 부식 정도를 시뮬레이션을 통해 예측하여 선체에 발생할 균열 또는 절단과 같은 피로 파괴를 방지하여, 해난을 방지할 수 있으며 선박의 수명을 연장할 수 있는 효과를 가진다.
assignees: KOREA MARITIME UNIV IND ACAD

title_en: Rapid assessment method and system for state of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for rapidly evaluating the state of an electric power system, comprising the following steps of S1, acquiring electric power system information and converting the electric power system information into a preset format; the power system information at least comprises system parameter information, system topology information and system quantity measurement information; step S2, recognizing the power system information through a preset graph convolution neural model to obtain a characteristic value of the power system information; step S3, combining the characteristic values of the power system information to obtain a power system state quantity; and performing state evaluation on the power system according to the state quantity of the power system to obtain the state of the power system. The method converts the iterative process in the traditional state estimation into forward calculation, greatly improves the operation speed, fully utilizes the advantage of high-efficiency calculation of the neural network, solves the problems of low operation efficiency and low speed of the traditional model, and has stronger robustness.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Power cable management method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power cable management method based on digital twins, which establishes an intelligent power cable management architecture based on digital twins, and comprises a real cable material management point, a twins cable material management point, cable twins data, a data service platform and a cable management and control system; on the basis of realizing real-time monitoring of position information and cable states, the Euclidean distance algorithm and the Markov method are adopted, and scheduling of the cable is realized by building the combined action of a real distribution point, a twin distribution point and a cable management and control system. The feasibility of digital twin-based cable management and control is verified, and the cable management and control capability is improved by real-time monitoring and management of the real assembly points, the twin assembly points and the cable management and control system.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd

title_en: Smart grid false data injection attack vulnerability detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a false data injection attack vulnerability detection method for a smart power grid, which is characterized in that a deep neural network is established, a vulnerability detection party utilizes reinforcement learning without predicting network topology, and the data quantity injected into each electric meter is continuously optimized by adopting a trial and error method according to feedback information such as power reading of the electric meter, vulnerability detection success times, mean square error of power grid state estimation, the number of electric meters needing to be operated and the like. By implementing the method and the device, the vulnerability can be detected without knowing the network topology of the power grid in advance, the vulnerability detection performance can be improved, and the calculation cost of a vulnerability detection party is reduced.

title_en: Method for determining an optimal placement of measurement units for estimating the state of a physical power distribution grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for determining an optimal placement of measurement units for estimating the state of a physical power distribution grid. The method comprises a step of searching for measurement-unit placements that are compatible with a State Estimation method that is performed in two stages, first, a Minimum Norm formulation, followed by a Weighted Least Square one.
assignees: KRAKENFLEX LTD

title_en: Short-term electricity sales amount prediction method based on generalized cross-correlation entropy gating circulation unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term electricity sales amount prediction method based on a generalized cross-correlation entropy gating circulation unit, which comprises the following steps: collecting data, and supplementing missing data in historical electricity consumption data; taking the historical hourly power consumption and the temperature corresponding to the historical hourly power consumption as a training sample set of a prediction model, and constructing feature input of the prediction model; data standardization; the method comprises the steps that a gated cycle unit model is selected for predicting the hourly power consumption, and a generalized maximum correlation entropy criterion corresponding to a generalized cross-correlation entropy is used for replacing a mean square error criterion in a gated cycle unit to serve as a cost function of a prediction model; optimizing parameters lambda and alpha of the gate control cycle unit model by a K-fold cross validation and grid optimization method; and predicting the electricity selling amount in the hour time scale, and evaluating the prediction result by selecting the RMSE index. The power selling amount prediction method has good prediction performance under the condition that the power selling amount data has outliers or noises and under the condition that the power selling amount data is distributed in a non-Gaussian manner.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: SOH prediction calculation method for single battery in energy storage scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction and calculation method for SOH of a single battery in an energy storage scene, which is used for researching the internal change trend of a lithium ion battery in the aging process and the change rule of a capacity increment curve and analyzing the change rule of the capacity increment curve and the internal change rule of the battery; extracting and estimating the characteristic parameters of the battery health state by using the capacity increment curve data, analyzing the change rule of the capacity increment curve, and selecting key characteristic parameters capable of representing the battery health state estimation according to the correlation analysis result; a lithium ion battery SOH estimation model based on the characteristic parameters of the capacity increment curve is established, the characteristic parameters in the capacity increment curve are determined to be used as model input quantity, the battery residual capacity is used as model output quantity, and the estimation of the battery SOH is realized by utilizing a neural network model.
assignees: WANKE ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Adaptive partition state coordination estimation method for high-capacity battery energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive partitioning state coordination estimation method of a high-capacity battery energy storage system, which comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out equivalent substitution on battery boxes with the same functions in the system to form a simplest element topological graph; partitioning the battery energy storage system on the simplest element topology according to a partitioning principle; aiming at the online monitoring data of the battery management systems in different partitions, overcoming random error terms of the different partitions based on a weighted least square method and carrying out state estimation; traversing each partition of the simplest element topological graph, and performing iterative computation to obtain a state estimation value of each partition of the system; based on the deviation degree of the partition common boundary, dynamically integrating the monitoring data of each partition, and calculating an output power correction value; and performing iterative calculation based on the deviation coefficient matrix and the output power correction value to realize the coordination state estimation of the whole system. The invention solves the problems of high redundancy and low reaction speed of the existing partition state estimation technology, and avoids system power scheduling unbalance and state misjudgment possibly caused by the traditional method.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Wind power ultra-short term prediction method considering fan state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for wind power ultra-short term prediction considering a fan state, which comprises the following steps: acquiring original fan operation data, and performing missing data processing on the fan operation data to obtain fan operation data; performing correlation analysis on the fan operation data by utilizing grey correlation analysis, and selecting parameters with strong correlation as data sources for evaluating fan states; evaluating the state of the wind power plant to obtain the state of the wind power plant, and then recombining the processed wind power plant operation data according to the state of the wind power plant to obtain recombined experimental data of the wind power plant; and training the XGboost model by using the recombination experimental data, and optimizing the model parameters to obtain a wind power prediction result. The evaluation model avoids excessive human subjective factors, so that the evaluation result can accurately reflect the real output state of the fan; and the evaluation result is introduced into a power prediction model, so that the power prediction model can keep higher prediction accuracy under any wind condition.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Updating method and terminal for power grid slice
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a terminal for updating power grid slices, which are used for acquiring change records of power grid equipment, merging slice geographic blocks of the change records by adopting a pyramid slicing algorithm, and acquiring index change data of the slice geographic blocks, wherein a display image layer can be determined according to the slice geographic blocks, slice data related to the power grid equipment before and after data change can be calculated in real time according to the index change data and the display image layer, incremental slice data can be obtained, an incremental slice file is generated by the incremental slice data according to a file storage model of the pyramid algorithm, and updating of the power grid slices is performed based on the incremental slice file, so that generation and pushing of vector slice files are dynamically and online completed, the online updating of a slice map service is realized, the problem that the conventional slice map service needs to perform offline slicing and release according to the latest full amount of power grid data regularly is solved, and the real-time updating of the power grid slice file is realized.

title_en: Method and device for analyzing abnormal archive information of power consumer and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for analyzing abnormal archive information of a power consumer, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining actual power utilization data of a target power consumer from an acquisition domain according to the archive information of the power consumer; when the actual power utilization data are detected to be incomplete, determining a corresponding load rate calculation mode according to missing data in the actual power utilization data, and determining the load rate of a target power consumer; and determining the power utilization condition of the target power consumer according to the load rate. By adopting the method, the abnormal power consumer can be accurately positioned.
assignees: CSG DIGITAL POWER GRID RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Energy Data Preprocessing Platform System based on Deep Learning Algorithm
title_ko: 딥러닝 기반의 데이터 전처리 알고리즘이 적용된 에너지 플랫폼 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an energy platform system to which a data preprocessing algorithm based on deep learning is applied. The energy platform system comprises: a data collection unit that collects power usage data, weather information data, and date information data; a data storage unit that stores the data collected by the data collection unit; and a data refining unit that pre-processes the data stored in the data storage unit, fuses the pre-processed data, and refines missing data by using the fused data. According to the present invention, by using a deep learning-based model as the core of a pre-processing platform, the characteristics and patterns of data are learned through self-learning. Thus, the present invention has an effect of showing strength in restoring data with large losses.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 딥러닝 기반의 데이터 전처리 알고리즘이 적용된 에너지 플랫폼 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 전력 사용 데이터, 기상 정보 데이터 및 날짜 정보 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부, 상기 데이터 수집부에서 수집한 데이터를 저장하는 데이터 저장부 및 상기 데이터 저장부에 저장되어 있는 데이터를 전처리하고, 전처리한 데이터를 융합하고, 융합한 데이터를 이용하여 결측 데이터를 정제하는 데이터 정제부를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 의하면, 딥러닝 기반의 모델을 전처리 플랫폼의 핵심으로 사용함으로써, 자가학습을 통해 데이터의 특성과 패턴을 학습하여 손실이 큰 데이터를 복원함에 있어서 강점을 보인다는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Group level KKS coding intelligent mapping recommendation method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin-based intelligent mapping recommendation method for group-level KKS codes, which comprises the following steps: constructing a digital twin body based on the whole power production flow; constructing a professional dictionary according to the obtained digital twin body; and acquiring codes under the original coding rule and codes under the new coding rule by using acquisition equipment to construct a KKS coding data set. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the invention systemizes a complex power generation process, constructs a digital twin body based on a power full production process, and instantiates a group digital twin technology; the invention also constructs a KKS generation model based on the attention stacking network, excites the vitality of the original digital infrastructure of the power plant, opens the island of data, breaks the information barrier, promotes the real-time fusion between the physical space and the information space, and realizes the intelligent mapping task under various KKS coding systems.

title_en: Data-driven-based electric-thermal comprehensive energy system state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data-driven-based state estimation method of an electric-thermal comprehensive energy system, which is characterized in that historical state estimation data are arranged to obtain historical measurement data and historical state variable data, and nonlinear transformation is carried out on the historical state variable to obtain a historical auxiliary state variable; classifying according to different systems to respectively obtain historical data of an electric power system and a thermodynamic system; transforming the nonlinear state estimation model into a linear state estimation model, and respectively carrying out regression learning of the linear state estimation model on historical state estimation data of the electric power system and the thermodynamic system by utilizing partial least one multiplication and least one multiplication to obtain an electric-thermal comprehensive energy system state estimation model based on data driving; and finally, taking the current quantity as the input of the model, obtaining the output of the model, and carrying out linear and nonlinear transformation on the model to finally obtain the state variable estimated value.

title_en: Simulation method based on GIS system and modelica digital modeling and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a simulation method and a related device based on a GIS system and modelica digital modeling. The method comprises the steps that a mine model is obtained through modelica digital modeling based on digital information stored in a GIS system, wherein the mine model at least comprises a three-dimensional model of a mine, and the three-dimensional model of the mine is used as a preset constraint condition in a simulation process; carrying out digital modeling according to data acquired by a sensor of the mine, structural mechanics data of the mine and a three-dimensional model of the mine to obtain a preset simulation model; and inputting data acquired by the sensors of the mine into the preset simulation model to obtain the digital twin mine system. The technical problem that an effective rescue scheme cannot be obtained in a simulation mode in the current system is solved. The digital twin mine-based rescue analysis prediction method and system provide rescue analysis prediction when underground mine disasters occur.
assignees: SUZHOU TONGYUAN SOFTWARE & CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power system informatization and digitization linkage simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an informationized and digitalized linkage simulation platform for an electric power system, which belongs to the technical field of electric power system management and comprises a platform digitalized processing unit, an operation equipment management unit, a data transmission module, a transmission detection module, a platform auxiliary management unit, a system state estimation unit and a load flow calculation unit, wherein the platform digitalized processing unit comprises a power grid application module and a data calculation module. This electric power system information ization and digital linkage simulation platform, through the digital upgrading to primary equipment and secondary equipment, not only reduced signal cable's use amount, realize data sharing through communication network, the resource optimal configuration ability that the structure is simplified still greatly improves the electric wire netting promotes the service ability of electric wire netting by a wide margin, and calculate the weak link of electric wire netting in electric power system under the current condition through the tide current and deduce, improve the ability that the system handled the accident, electric power system's operational mode is formulated scientifically and reasonably.

title_en: Power distribution network power supply reliability evaluation method, equipment and medium based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, equipment and a medium for evaluating power supply reliability of a power distribution network based on digital twins, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic data of a distribution line and head and tail end operation data of the distribution line; constructing a digital twin power grid based on a digital twin technology and the basic data and the operation data, and acquiring the distribution network reliability index score of a distribution line, wherein the distribution network reliability index comprises a power supply radius, overhead line contact, overhead line segmentation, a fuse wire branch capacity, a mixed line, a cable ring network node, a combined pole line, a switching station automatic switch configuration, an outgoing line splicing bin, a weak network frame, a line section and a load rate; and determining the power supply reliability of the power distribution network to be evaluated based on the weighted fusion result of the reliability index scores of the power distribution network. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of high efficiency, comprehensive information, accurate reliability result and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;ZHENGZHOU DAFANG SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Mine disaster early warning method and device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine disaster early warning method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the steps of acquiring initial data in the GIS system; inputting updating data of the GIS system in the process of mine operation into a preset digital twin mine system, wherein the preset digital twin mine system is obtained through modelica digital modeling based on initial data of the GIS system, and the modelica is used for simulating mine disaster based on the preset digital twin mine system; and early warning the possible mine disasters according to the simulation result of the preset digital twin mine system. The technical problem that real-time monitoring and management and control cannot be carried out on mine disaster early warning is solved. Through the application, the safety monitoring and early warning of mine disasters are realized.
assignees: SUZHOU TONGYUAN SOFTWARE & CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and tool for adjusting tidal current output and load of simulation power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a tool for adjusting tidal current output and load of a simulation power grid, wherein the adjusting method comprises the following steps: step S1, receiving application number information, and acquiring a real-time or historical power flow data section of state estimation according to the application number information; step S2, calling a power flow output load adjusting tool interface of the power system application software PAS, and triggering output load adjustment; step S3, according to the selected type, searching a single generator or a power plant, determining the generator to be regulated, and setting the output of the generator; step S4, retrieving and determining the transformer substation to be adjusted, and setting the load of the transformer substation; and step S5, calling a load flow calculation tool to perform load flow calculation according to the set generator output adjustment quantity and the set transformer substation load adjustment quantity, and writing the calculation result into a hierarchical library and a real-time library. The method greatly shortens the time for the analyst to adjust the output force and the load of the tidal current section, and improves the convergence of the tidal current analysis.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Cable test digital twinning system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning system for a cable test and a working method thereof, and relates to the field of cable tests. At present, the cable test cannot give consideration to both reliability and test effect, and cannot predict test faults. The invention comprises a perception layer, a network layer, a platform layer and an application layer; the platform layer comprises a digital twin service platform, a PaaS platform service module and an IaaS infrastructure service module; the digital twin service platform comprises a data acquisition module, a twin processing module and a twin data storage module, and the digital twin service platform acquires data obtained by the sensing layer through the data acquisition module, inputs the data into simulation data obtained by the twin processing module in real time, processes and fuses the obtained simulation data, and brings the simulation data into a knowledge base and an experience base of the twin data storage module. The technical scheme enables the test process to be visual, and once a problem occurs, the test process is immediately interfered, so that the test process is more controllable; and the reliability and the test effect of the cable test are both considered, and the fault can be predicted.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHOUSHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;ZHEJIANG ZHOUSHAN MARINE POWER TRANS RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based virtual-real interaction wind power plant wind power monitoring system and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual-real interaction wind power plant wind power monitoring system based on digital twinning and application thereof, wherein the system comprises: entity sensor array: the wind power generation system is used for collecting wind power data of each wind turbine in the wind power plant in real time; virtual sensor array: one-to-one matching correspondence with the entity sensors in the entity sensor array; and (3) an interaction platform: the method is used for carrying out association mapping on the physical sensor and the virtual sensor, and comprises abnormality diagnosis on wind power data of the physical sensor, prediction and setting of virtual wind speed of the virtual sensor. Compared with the prior art, the virtual sensor technical architecture based on measurement-sharing-correlation-diagnosis-prediction-check can complete abnormal diagnosis and wind speed mapping of the wind speed sensor, and the fault diagnosis strategy based on group cooperation can rapidly and accurately locate and sense abnormal states, so that accurate and reliable wind speed variation of the input unit control system under the condition of missing or misalignment of wind measurement data of the wind speed sensor is ensured.

title_en: Digital twin operation driven power distribution network planning method and device and terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and a terminal for planning a power distribution network driven by digital twin operation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time power grid data from a data layer of the digital twin power distribution network; according to the real-time power grid data, a line planning scheme set and an operation scene data set of the digital twin power distribution network are constructed; according to the line planning scheme set and the operation scene data set, a load evaluation objective function, a line loss evaluation objective function, an economic evaluation objective function and constraint conditions of the operation of the digital twin power distribution network are constructed; and determining the optimal planning scheme in the line planning scheme set according to the load evaluation objective function, the line loss evaluation objective function, the economic evaluation objective function and the constraint conditions.
