The method can drive the planning of the power distribution network by using the actual operation data of the digital twin power distribution network, and preferably selects a power distribution network planning scheme under the real-time operation environment of the digital twin power distribution network, thereby comprehensively considering the operation balance and the economy and meeting the demand of the planning diversification of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI POWER CO LTD SMART DISTRIB NETWORK CENTER;QINHUANGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV YANSHAN;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-unit thermal power plant heat supply mode and parameter online optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unit thermal power plant heat supply mode and parameter online optimization method, which comprises the following steps: s1, setting a multi-heating mode combination scheme when the heating unit participates in deep peak shaving cooperative operation; s2, constructing a digital twin model of the unit in multi-heating mode cooperative operation by adopting a mechanism modeling and data identification method; s3, constructing a unit multi-mode collaborative operation evaluation model; step S4, processing historical operation data of the heat supply unit by adopting an intelligent algorithm to obtain a heat load demand and an electric load demand; step S5, calculating the economic index and peak regulation capacity under the combination of the power plant level multi-heating mode; and S6, carrying out optimization analysis and optimization calculation of multiple heating modes aiming at peak regulation capacity, economic indexes and evaluation indexes under different operation schemes of the multi-mode peak regulation of the heating unit, preferably optimizing a multi-mode cooperative operation mode and a multi-mode peak regulation cooperative operation optimal combination scheme, and guiding the unit to optimize power generation and heating operation on line.
assignees: HANGZHOU ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution transformer data cleaning and repairing method and system for distribution internet of things edge side
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for cleaning and repairing distribution transformer data at the edge side of a distribution Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps: deleting abnormal data in distribution transformation time sequence data at the edge side of the power distribution Internet of things to be cleaned to obtain first distribution transformation time sequence data; determining a missing degree based on missing data in the first distribution transformation time sequence data; according to the missing degree, filling the missing data by utilizing the first distribution transformation time sequence data or selecting the data with the highest correlation from the complete historical distribution transformation time sequence data for filling; according to the invention, different interpolation methods are adopted according to the data loss degree, the mean value interpolation method based on the least square method is simple and easy to implement, the load characteristic curve of similar daily data can be well reflected by the interpolation mode based on the data correlation coefficient, and the problem of data mutation caused by the mean value interpolation method can be effectively avoided. Therefore, the method has the advantages of higher precision, stronger practicability and simple use, and is suitable for cleaning and repairing the distribution transformer data at the edge side of the distributed distribution Internet of things.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HEBI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power transformer online state monitoring method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for monitoring the online state of a power transformer based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a digital twin body of a physical entity of the power transformer; the digital twin comprises a geometric model, a physical model, a behavior model and a rule model; modifying the digital twin body in a first time interval based on a comparison between real-time data of a physical entity of a power transformer and output information of the digital twin body; determining and correcting the dynamic error of the physical entity of the power transformer in a second time interval based on the error between the physical entity of the power transformer and the real-time output signal of the digital twin; and predicting the state of the physical entity of the power transformer in a third time interval according to the dynamic error between the digital twin body and the physical entity of the power transformer. According to the method, the state evaluation and prediction of the power transformer under the condition of no power outage are realized by constructing the digital twin body of the physical entity of the power transformer.
assignees: WUHAN GLORY ROAD OPTIC ELECTRIC TRANSF CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for selecting high-voltage main network transformer based on Internet of things, product and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid load flow calculation extension splicing model and a method thereof, belonging to the technical field of power grid load flow calculation. The invention comprises the following steps: s1: exporting a state estimation result of the provincial dispatching regulation system; s2: and (3) local tone side external network equivalent file management: the method comprises the following steps: s21: state estimation, S22: acquiring a real-time state estimation section and model, S23: acquiring a historical state estimation section and a historical state estimation model; s3: splicing detailed models of the provincial provinc; s4: application analysis on the tone side: the method comprises the following steps: s41: dispatcher flow, S42: static security analysis. According to the method, the QS files which are derived by provincial regulations and contain the whole-network equipment model and the measured QS files are spliced with local models of local regulating power networks of various regions in a whole-network model splicing mode to form an equivalence system of the regional power network containing the external network detailed model, so that the calculation errors of elements near the boundary are reduced, and the calculation accuracy of the boundary line model is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method based on improved generalized maximum likelihood estimation
abstract_en: The method for estimating the state of the power distribution network based on the improved generalized maximum likelihood estimation has the advantages that the complexity of an identification program of bad data needs to be increased by a basic weighted least square estimation method, and the robustness of an estimation model is enhanced by adopting GM estimation. The improved GM estimation method is used in state estimation by analyzing and improving the weight function used by the objective function in GM estimation and using adaptive mapping statistics. The characteristics of the traditional measurement system and the phasor measurement system in terms of different technologies in terms of measurement channels and instrument sampling rates are considered, and the phasor measurement data are fully utilized to carry out state estimation on two different estimation modules on the basis of the traditional state estimator. And carrying out fusion processing on the obtained estimation result by utilizing a multi-sensor data fusion theory so as to obtain an optimal estimation value. The effectiveness and reliability of the improved GM estimation and estimation fusion system are verified by performing simulation analysis based on the improved IEEE 14 node power distribution network system. The method can effectively improve the estimation precision of the state distribution network.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Method and device for constructing digital twin data model of low-voltage distribution transformer area
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for constructing a digital twin data model of a low-voltage distribution transformer area. The method provided by the application is based on an entity object in a target low-voltage power distribution area, the characteristic data of the entity object is collected, then the association relation is established for different characteristic data according to the characteristic association information corresponding to different characteristic data by taking the characteristic data of the entity object as a basis and combining the preset corresponding relation between the type of the characteristic data and the characteristic association information, and finally a platform area digital twin model corresponding to the target low-voltage power distribution area is established based on the associated characteristic data.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD SHANWEI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Short-term power load interval prediction method based on nonparametric Bootstrap error sampling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a short-term power load interval prediction method based on nonparametric Bootstrap error sampling, and belongs to the technical field of short-term power load prediction. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing original time sequence data by adopting a sliding window method, wherein the sliding window method is a technology aiming at real-time updating of the time sequence data and aims to construct a characteristic data set for model training; establishing an ELM-AdaBoost model to fit and determine the load predicted value of the point; carrying out interval division on the actual load value, and sampling the error in each interval by adopting a nonparametric Bootstrap method to obtain a confidence interval of a predicted error; establishing related statistics, and converting the confidence interval of the error into a prediction interval of the load value; the model reduces the uncertainty of load prediction and the prediction error thereof, and has certain applicability.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM

title_en: High-altitude base station cluster auxiliary edge calculation method used in emergency communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-altitude base station cluster auxiliary edge calculation method for emergency communication, which is characterized in that the number and the position deployment of unmanned aerial vehicles are solved by adopting an AK-means method for accurately obtaining a K value, a moving target area is comprehensively covered, a certain number of high-altitude balloon terminals provided with MEC (media independent center) servers are deployed in the air in order to prevent the occurrence of insufficient power supply of the unmanned aerial vehicles or other unexpected weather conditions, the unmanned aerial vehicles are assisted to provide communication and calculation services for ground mobile user equipment, a digital twin network is introduced to feed back information such as geographic positions and calculation resources of the mobile user equipment, the unmanned aerial vehicles and the high-altitude balloon terminals in real time, a DDQN (distributed maximum likelihood) algorithm in deep reinforcement learning is applied to solve unloading decisions of the mobile user equipment, a calculation resource distribution strategy of the mobile user equipment, the unmanned aerial vehicles and the high-altitude balloon terminals is obtained by utilizing an RO (RO) algorithm, the energy consumption of the whole system is effectively reduced, and the service experience of the mobile user equipment is improved.

title_en: Unmanned on duty material warehouse system of electric power thing networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power Internet of things unattended goods and materials warehouse system which comprises an intelligent access control module, an intelligent monitoring module, an intelligent goods and materials cabinet, an intelligent operation client, a data center, a central control module and a network communication module, wherein a plurality of storage boxes are arranged on the intelligent goods and materials cabinet, and intelligent pressure sensor equipment and an intelligent three-dimensional indicating lamp belt are arranged on the storage boxes. The invention can realize real-time update calculation of the material quantity, and the material counting does not need manual statistic check; in the link of getting the materials, the specific positions of the cabinet and the storage box of each single product of the selected materials are indicated by flashing of the indicator lamps, so that the staff are guided to finish the goods getting quickly; be equipped with the voice broadcast unit on the storage tank of intelligence goods material rack, when the staff took out or put into the material, name, the quantity of the automatic voice broadcast material of system were received, and the help staff realizes accurate warehouse entry and exit operation, avoids taking by mistake the action such as misplacing, many leads few leads.
assignees: HUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive state evaluation method and system of power grid equipment based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive state evaluation method and a comprehensive state evaluation system of power grid equipment based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting basic data operated by a physical entity in real time; acquiring content associated information on an entity associated data platform in real time; fusing the basic data and the content associated information based on the ontology model to form comprehensive equipment state data, and constructing a digital twin model; constructing an evaluation tree knowledge structure for the equipment comprehensive state data based on the digital twin model; performing map analysis and event analysis based on the evaluation tree knowledge structure to obtain comprehensive state evaluation and fault prediction information; and outputting a maintenance demand prediction and maintenance strategy based on the comprehensive state evaluation and the fault prediction information. According to the embodiment of the invention, the comprehensive state evaluation of the digital twin is obtained by performing inspection, on-line monitoring, key information of the equipment, operating conditions and off-line tests on the equipment through data integration, knowledge fusion and complex and dynamic behavior analysis.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Sulfur hexafluoride material management and control method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sulfur hexafluoride material management and control method and system based on big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, performing data analysis by using a distributed dynamic state perception model based on sulfur hexafluoride gas full-period data, and establishing a large information control database of the sulfur hexafluoride gas full-life period, which comprises full-chain multi-dimensional information; s2, establishing a sulfur hexafluoride gas material accounting model based on the information control big database; s3, establishing a sulfur hexafluoride gas quantity prediction model based on the information control big database and by adopting a neural network algorithm, predicting the sulfur hexafluoride demand, and verifying the sulfur hexafluoride gas quantity prediction model on a sulfur hexafluoride digital twin model; and S4, establishing a sulfur hexafluoride gas comprehensive analysis and digital visual system based on the block chain technology, and performing material control on the whole process of source, flow and confluence conversion of sulfur hexafluoride gas. Compared with the prior art, the method realizes the material management and control of the whole process of source, flow and confluence conversion of the sulfur hexafluoride gas.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and system based on multi-data model fusion
abstract_en: A photovoltaic power generation power prediction method with multiple data models fused comprises the following steps: step 1: preprocessing data, namely detecting and eliminating abnormal values by adopting a Local Outlier Factor (LOF) algorithm; filling the missing data by adopting a multi-layer perceptron regression algorithm; step 2: feature selection, namely selecting representative features from a plurality of features through feature selection, and reducing irrelevant feature information; step 3: training the submodel, namely dividing the data into a training set, a verification set and a test set, training a support vector machine regression model, a multiple linear regression model and a Bayesian ridge regression model in the training set, verifying the model obtained by training in the verification set, and respectively selecting the optimal model as the submodel; step 4: and (3) carrying out fusion prediction on the multiple data models, predicting the data in the test set by using each optimal sub-model obtained through training, and fusing the prediction results of each sub-model by using a Q-learning algorithm. The invention further comprises a system for implementing the photovoltaic power generation power prediction method with the fusion of the multiple data models.

title_en: Fault determination method and device for electric power metering automatic production equipment and terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault determination method, a device and a terminal of electric power metering automatic production equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring overhaul operation data corresponding to an overhaul operation task of the electric power metering automatic production equipment; determining a target overhaul operation type corresponding to the overhaul operation data according to the overhaul operation data and a preset clustering algorithm; determining an initial fault corresponding to the type of the overhaul operation according to the type of the target overhaul operation and a preset digital twin model; and determining a target fault according to the initial fault. The invention can improve the accuracy of the target obstacle and avoid the problems that the hidden trouble can not be found in time due to the failure of the inspection, thereby causing the interruption of the electric power metering production business and even causing major production accidents.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Distribution network planning method based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for integrating digital twin and power grid data and planning lines. The method for integrating the power grid comprises the following steps: scene building and data integration; the scene building comprises the following steps: scene information acquisition, model integration conversion, model construction and model information hanging; the data integration comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of low-voltage distribution network data access and management in an online power grid, low-voltage distribution network data access and management in a power grid GIS, and low-voltage distribution network equipment archive data access and management in a data center. By the method, the invention solves the problem that the whole technical problem of distribution network planning based on the digital twin cannot be met due to less consideration factors in the method for realizing the distribution network planning in the digital twin.
assignees: BOTONG NETWORK INFORMATION BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Short-term prediction application software and method for output power of wind power and photovoltaic power generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term prediction application software and a method for output power of a wind power and photovoltaic power generation system, wherein the short-term prediction application software and the method are based on an association rule and a BP neural network, abnormal and missing data are processed, an improved k-means clustering algorithm is adopted to perform clustering analysis on temperature/wind speed meteorological data, an Aprior algorithm is used to mine an association rule between the output power of a wind power plant and meteorological factors, and the association rule is applied to the BP neural network, the maximum relative error, the minimum relative error and the average relative error of the method are all minimum, the method can improve the accuracy of the output power prediction of the wind power plant and has effectiveness, the main functions of the software comprise engineering data import, radiant quantity calculation, correction parameter calculation and user management, and the effectiveness and the accuracy of the software can be further improved through software design, the popularization of renewable energy sources is increased.
assignees: XINYI WEIZHITU ELECTRIC ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method for generating online power grid fault plan considering steady-state power flow state
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for generating an online power grid fault plan considering a steady-state power flow state, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring power grid state estimation section data or offline typical mode data to form data of an initial operation mode; setting faults of a plurality of devices, and bringing the faults into an online plan fault set; performing medium-long time domain simulation analysis by combining data of an initial operation mode and a predetermined fault set to obtain a steady-state power flow and a steady-state frequency after the fault, calculating a safety margin and a power flow transfer ratio from a simulation result, acquiring safety control action information after the fault, and judging whether the safety margin meets the requirement; if the safety margin does not meet the requirement, calculating measures according to the fault reasons and the whole network equipment, and enumerating and combining the measures to form an adjusting measure sequence according to the measure control performance indexes, and obtaining a disposal main point after the fault, which has the minimum control cost and meets the safety requirement, from the adjusting measure sequence; and if the safety margin meets the requirement, forming an E file.
assignees: EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Block chain-based distributed state estimation method for comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed state estimation method of a comprehensive energy system based on a block chain, which comprises the following steps: establishing a block chain network of the comprehensive energy system, collecting measurement values of all energy subsystem nodes, establishing a comprehensive energy system model comprehensively considering the energy coupling relation, establishing a state estimation model of the comprehensive energy system, realizing distributed state estimation and realizing real-time control and optimized operation of the comprehensive energy system; according to the distributed architecture based on the block chain, the industry barriers of all energy systems in the comprehensive energy system are broken through, on the premise that the credibility of information is guaranteed, the distributed solving method is combined, a large amount of measurement data in each subsystem does not need to be transmitted to the dispatching center, the information transmission quantity among nodes is reduced, the state estimation speed and efficiency are improved, meanwhile, the information privacy of all energy subsystems is protected, the measurement sampling values of different time scales are selected for each system of electricity, heat and gas to carry out state estimation, and the accuracy of the state estimation is improved.

title_en: Power distribution network load redistribution attack detection method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for detecting load redistribution attack of a power distribution network. Meanwhile, the invention provides that the alternating current state estimation of the feeder lines is carried out while the reactive power adjustment of each feeder line is carried out, whether the state estimation residual exceeds a threshold value or not is checked to reduce the detection range of the attack, and whether the load redistribution attack exists on the feeder lines or not is judged. The detection of the load redistribution attack can be completed by only utilizing the existing reactive compensation device and the bad data detector without inputting special detection equipment such as a phasor measurement unit.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Method, system and device for estimating interval robust state of power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system state evaluation, and discloses a method, a system and a device for estimating a robust state of a power system interval. When the established interval constraint model is solved, an initial value is determined according to the obtained state variable interval value approximate solution, the state variable feasible region output after the solving process is finished is taken as constraint, the relative deviation minimization of a measuring point on a certain confidence level is taken as a target function, a corresponding state estimation model is established, and then the state estimation model is optimized and solved to obtain a state estimation result; according to the method, the feasible domain of the state variable is taken as the constraint, the initial value is set by the feasible domain of the state variable, the load flow calculation result is not required to be taken as the initial value, the solving range and the interval range of the state variable can be effectively reduced, the calculated amount is reduced, and therefore the calculating efficiency and the convergence speed are improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Event-driven model refinement for insurance and risk management
abstract_en: A system and method for event-based modeling and model refinement, for natural catastrophe related risks, including but not limited to fires, floods, earthquakes, and hurricanes/tornados. The system and method feature simultaneous simulation of a plurality of industry models using a variety of risk information, including but not limited to real-time data, recent and historical event data, hypothetical data, and crowd-sourced data. Tire system and method use a variety of data sources in conjunction with machine learning to continuously and in real-time update and tune the simulated models performance and sensitivity to provide useful risk assessment, and risk management data. Based on these model assessments, the system can produce notifications that can be made to enable automated and human actions.
assignees: QOMPLX INC

title_en: Lightweight characterization method for digital twins of substation equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system intellectualization, and provides a lightweight characterization method of a digital twin body of substation equipment, which comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a three-dimensional wire frame model of a transformer substation according to a design drawing; step 2, constructing a transformer substation equipment entity model based on the three-dimensional wireframe model; step 3, the three-dimensional wireframe model and the entity model of the digital twin body of the substation equipment are stored in a partitioned and structured manner; and 4, adopting an entity model for electrical equipment in the neighborhood of the mouse pointer, and adopting a wire frame model for the rest equipment to realize lightweight representation of the digital twin body. The method can realize the lightweight representation of the digital twin body on the premise of meeting the use function and the model precision of the model, effectively reduce the consumption of the digital twin body of the substation equipment on computer resources, accelerate the running speed of the digital twin body model, and further be beneficial to realizing the real-time visual monitoring of the substation equipment.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING JINGYAN ELECTRIC POWER ENG DESIGN CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-unit multi-mode heat supply power plant operation comprehensive evaluation method based on fuzzy analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method for multi-unit multi-mode heat supply power plant operation based on fuzzy analysis, which comprises the following steps: s1, setting a multi-heating mode combination scheme when the heating unit participates in deep peak shaving cooperative operation; s2, constructing a digital twin model of the multi-mode depth peak regulation of the unit; s3, establishing a multi-mode deep peak regulation evaluation model of the heat supply unit at least comprising an economic evaluation index, an environmental protection evaluation index and a multi-dimensional constraint condition; s4, constructing a judgment matrix among the evaluation indexes, determining a weight vector of each evaluation index to unit peak regulation, and establishing a fuzzy decision matrix between each multi-heating mode combination scheme and each evaluation index; and step S5, fuzzy calculation is carried out on the weight vector and the fuzzy decision matrix by adopting a fuzzy decision algorithm. The invention evaluates the units with different heat supply mode combination schemes, realizes the optimization of the unit transformation technical combination scheme, and realizes the plant-level intelligent quantitative operation scheduling decision of the peak-shaving thermal power plant.
assignees: HANGZHOU ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin transformer substation misoperation prevention system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-misoperation system of a digital twin transformer substation, which comprises an equipment monitoring unit, a personnel monitoring unit, an Internet of things base station and a management background, wherein the monitoring unit is used for collecting power equipment data, environment data, live-action data and image data of a plurality of monitoring points in real time; the personnel monitoring unit collects the movement path, identity recognition and vital sign related data of personnel in the transformer substation in real time; the base station of the Internet of things is used for receiving and transmitting real-time data streams; and the management background is used for butting and processing the acquired data stream, judging whether the electrical equipment of the transformer substation is abnormal in operation, and can establish a 3D model, divide a working area and a non-working area and generate operation ticket information. The invention forms the unified management of the monitoring of the integrity, carries out training simulation on personnel, plans the working route of the personnel, has low operation and maintenance cost, can display the anti-misoperation in a layered way, promotes the five-prevention capability of the transformer substation, protects the electrical equipment and personal safety, and ensures the stable and safe operation of the power grid.

title_en: Small and medium-sized enterprise growth assessment method and system based on electric power marketing data
abstract_en: A method and system for evaluating the growth of small and medium-sized enterprises based on electric power marketing data comprises a method for constructing an enterprise growth division model based on electric power marketing data and fusion business data, and comprises the steps of firstly, based on enterprise industry classification in the electric power marketing data and the operating range in the business data, completing business portrait and classification of the enterprises by adopting methods such as NLP (non line segment) and clustering; secondly, based on the power consumption data of the enterprise, based on discrete coefficients, improved seasonal ARIMA and other methods, the stability and the growth trend of the power consumption of the enterprise are calculated, and an enterprise power growth component model is formed after the integration. The electric power growth score model constructed by the invention is based on the characteristics of reality, accuracy, real-time updating and the like of the enterprise power consumption data, the methods of clustering, time sequence models and the like are comprehensively applied, the time sequence model is improved, the enterprise growth score can be generated more accurately from two aspects of duration and comparability, and the defect of strong subjectivity of the traditional expert experience model is overcome.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Electric power material dispatching and distributing system based on material demands
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a power material dispatching and distributing system based on material demands, and belongs to the field of power material dispatching systems. The dispatching and delivering system comprises a dispatching bin; the at least one goods shelf is arranged in the dispatching bin and can update and display the quantity of the materials in real time; the dispatching bin gate is arranged on one side of the dispatching bin; the dispatching platform is arranged on one side of the dispatching bin gate; the at least one distribution vehicle is arranged on the outer side of the dispatching platform; through above-mentioned technical scheme, the goods shelves can show the quantity of electric power material, when needs dispatch delivery, takes out electric power material from the goods shelves, and the goods shelves can be to the quantity real-time update of electric power material, and then can indicate the warehouse management personnel in dispatch storehouse, the condition of electric power material disappearance appears when avoiding the dispatch delivery, and then has improved dispatch delivery system's stability.
assignees: SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for repairing abnormal missing of distribution power low-voltage measurement data of service center
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for repairing abnormal missing of distribution power low-voltage measurement data of a service center, which comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a power consumption data matrix; step 2, recording a position set of missing data in the electricity data matrix; step 3, constructing a pre-filling model, and pre-filling the missing data in the electricity data matrix in the step 1; step 4, clustering the electricity utilization data matrix pre-filled in the step 3; step 5, establishing a low-rank electricity data restoration model of matrix kernel norm and L  1  norm joint optimization; and step 6, solving a matrix nuclear norm and L  1  norm combined optimized low-rank electricity consumption data restoration model to obtain a secondary restored electricity consumption data matrix. The invention can obtain higher-precision recovery data through low-rank matrix recovery, and effectively improve the data quality of the information acquisition system of the power distribution service center station.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation power prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power generation power prediction method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring meteorological data and historical power generation data of a photovoltaic power station in a certain area at the same moment, supplementing missing data and eliminating abnormal data; and analyzing and quantifying the predicted solar-air condition factors and the historical power, and unifying the corrected data dimension by adopting data normalization. Constructing a combined SVM model; and constructing an isolated forest model. And comparing the predicted power output by the model with the theoretical power, outputting a predicted result when the error is within an allowable range, and performing iterative correction when the error does not meet the requirement until the error meets the requirement. And inputting the training set and the test set of the historical power into a power generation prediction model to obtain the predicted power. The invention can reduce the prediction error, improve the prediction precision, and effectively improve the photovoltaic power generation utilization rate and has stronger generalization capability.

title_en: Quality control method for environmental element data of surface layer of ocean buoy
abstract_en: A quality control method for environmental element data on the surface layer of an ocean buoy relates to the ocean field. And (3) carrying out format sorting on the data, selecting different quality control methods for all observation element data, separating correct data, unavaluated data, suspicious data, error data and missing data, and carrying out data quality identification on different types of judgment data. The quality control method comprises blank value test, time test, position test, equipment log test, threshold test, Grubbs test, Dixon test, kurtosis test, triple standard deviation test, gradient test, runt value test, visual test and the like. The method has the advantages that a set of standardized data quality control method is established for the environmental element data on the surface layer of the ocean buoy, the ocean buoy data can be effectively controlled, a data identification corresponding to the original data after quality control is formed, the process is clear, the use is easy, the expandability is strong, and the method can serve social development, ocean economic construction, disaster prevention and reduction, emergency management, national defense safety and the like.
assignees: UNIV XIAMEN;FUJIAN MARINE FORECASTS

title_en: Digital twin power grid system and method based on three-dimensional map
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grids, in particular to a digital twin power grid system and a digital twin power grid method based on a three-dimensional map. The system comprises: the power grid map drawing unit is configured for acquiring node data and line data of a power grid system and generating a power grid three-dimensional map based on the acquired node data and line data; the power grid map layering unit is configured and used for segmenting the power grid three-dimensional map based on a preset layering number to obtain a plurality of layering maps; and the hierarchical map feature extraction unit is configured to extract features of each hierarchical map to obtain hierarchical map features. The method realizes digital twin-based control on the power grid by constructing the virtual map of the power grid, and meanwhile, the power grid is controlled by using a layering and feature extraction mode when the virtual map is constructed, so that the efficiency of power grid control is improved.
assignees: SHANDONG HANLIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Network and data facilities of control tower and enterprise management platform with adaptive intelligence
abstract_en: A value chain system that provides recommendations for designing a logistics system generally includes a machine learning system that trains machine-learned models that output logistics design recommendations based on training data sets that each respectively defines one or more features of a respective logistic system and an outcome relating to the respective logistics system; an artificial intelligence system that receives a request for a logistics system design recommendation and determines the logistics system design recommendation based on one or more of the machine-learned models and the request; and a digital twin system that generates an environment digital twin of a logistics environment that incorporates the logistics system design recommendation, and one or more physical asset digital twins of physical assets. The digital twin system executes a simulation based on the logistics environment digital twin, the one or more physical asset digital twins.
assignees: STRONG FORCE VCN PORTFOLIO 2019 LLC

title_en: Smart battery management system for fire prevention
title_ko: 화재 예방을 위한 스마트 배터리관리시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a smart battery management system (S-BMS). According to an embodiment of the present invention, the S-BMS for integrally managing one or more batteries comprises: a battery state estimating module for estimating a state-of-charge (SOC) of a battery using a hybrid Kalman filter (HKF), and predicting R and C values of the battery which are state variables input to the HKF using a deep learning technique; a fire prevention information collecting module for collecting the temperature of a cell of each battery, a fire safety check item signal, and a relay contact signal; and a power control module for controlling charge/discharge of the battery by synthesizing signals from the battery state estimating module and the fire prevention information collecting module. Therefore, a fire of a battery can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 스마트 배터리관리시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 스마트 배터리관리시스템은 하나 이상의 배터리를 통합 관리하는 스마트 배터리관리시스템(Smart Battery Management System, S-BMS)에 있어서, 하이브리드 칼만필터(Hybrid Kalman Filter, HKF)를 이용하여 배터리 상태(State Of Charge, SOC)를 추정하되, 상기 하이브리드 칼만필터에 입력되는 상태변수인 배터리의 R, C 값을 딥러닝 기법으로 예측하는 배터리 상태 추정모듈; 상기 각 배터리의 셀의 온도, 화재 안전점검 항목 신호, 릴레이 접점 신호를 수집하는 화재 예방정보 수집모듈; 및 상기 배터리 상태 추정모듈 및 상기 화재 예방정보 수집모듈의 신호를 종합하여 배터리의 충/방전을 제어하는 전력제어모듈;을 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KERI KOREA ELECTROTECHNOLOGY RES INST

title_en: Smart grid state estimation method, system and storage medium based on topology analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart grid state estimation method, a system and a medium based on topology analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a substation state estimation model based on grid structure data; collecting measurement data, performing topology analysis on the measurement data, dividing a plurality of topological islands, performing state estimation on each topological island based on a transformer substation state estimation model, and recording mature data generated by a state estimation result into a real-time library. The intelligent power grid state estimation method based on the topology analysis carries out multi-measurement by dividing the topology island, so that the intelligent power grid state estimation method has the characteristics of small network scale, high calculation speed, reliable implementation and the like, solves the problem of accuracy of redundant data in the substation, and sends the cooked data generated by the in-substation state estimation to a dispatching center, thereby providing high-efficiency, reliable and stable data for the whole network.

title_en: Power demand probabilistic prediction online integration method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an online integration method, a system and equipment for probabilistic prediction of power demand, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring new energy power demand data; dividing data into a training set, an authentication set and a test set; respectively training four single-point prediction models through a training set; determining integration weight of quantile points through quantile regression average algorithm, and constructing an integrated probabilistic prediction model; constructing an integration weight oriented online optimization model; solving an integration weight-oriented online optimization model, determining an integration weight online updating rule, and updating a probabilistic online integration prediction model in real time; and based on the test set, realizing the probabilistic online integration prediction of the power demand. The method can provide theoretical basis and technical support for power demand prediction in a novel power system with new energy as a main body, and can also track the evolution law of the load characteristic of the power system with the new energy as the main body in real time, thereby ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power system and the consumption level of the new energy.
assignees: STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID QIANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;CLEAN ENERGY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;GUONENG TONGHUI BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: DNN-based rapid state estimation method and medium for electric heating comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a DNN-based quick state estimation method and medium for an electric-thermal integrated energy system. And performing feature extraction by utilizing correlation analysis among the parameters of the sub-networks, dividing a data set according to a feature extraction result, simulating actual quantity measurement by superposing Gaussian white noise on the quantity measurement in the data set, and training and testing the deep neural network. And extracting actual quantity measurement according to the correlation analysis result, and inputting the actual quantity measurement into the rapid state estimation model to obtain the state quantity. The rapid state estimation model of the electric-thermal integrated energy system can effectively improve the state estimation precision, reduce the state estimation time and provide real-time and accurate operation data for the scheduling of the electric-thermal integrated energy system.
assignees: SUZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF SOUTHEAST UNIV

title_en: System and method for publishing power grid information
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for publishing power grid information, belonging to the technical field of intelligent power grids, wherein the system comprises: the information service module is used for acquiring subscription requirement information and acquiring corresponding power grid information at intervals of first preset time according to the subscription requirement information, wherein the subscription requirement information comprises the power grid information which a user wants to know; the information updating module is used for receiving subscription requirement information from the information service module when a power grid event or power grid maintenance occurs, automatically updating the corresponding power grid information according to the subscription requirement information, and returning the updated power grid information to the information service module; and the information issuing module is used for receiving the power grid information from the information service module and issuing the received power grid information. The invention can realize real-time update and release of massive power grid operation data, and can realize global perception of data subscription information through a release and subscription mechanism, so that related professionals can arrange work more reasonably, orderly and efficiently.
assignees: CHANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Control device and control method for GIM engineering project
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a control device for a Grid Information Model (GIM) engineering project, the control device including: the decompression device is used for decompressing and analyzing the GIM compressed file so as to obtain a GIM level and a GIM equipment model; the analysis device is used for analyzing the GIM levels step by step so as to obtain the nesting relation between the GIM levels and the GIM equipment model; calculating means for calculating a GIM equipment model instance by using the GIM equipment model and a nesting relationship of the GIM hierarchy and the GIM equipment model; and the restoration device is used for restoring the three-dimensional engineering scene based on the GIM equipment model instance. Embodiments of the present disclosure also relate to a control method, a control apparatus, a storage medium, and a program product for a GIM engineering project. The invention simultaneously supports a control platform end and a Web end and supports lightweight display of a large-volume model item level. By the method and the device, hierarchical management display can be performed on the three-dimensional design GIM result of the power engineering, editing and repairing of the three-dimensional result based on the GIM format are realized, and a bottom foundation is established for subsequent national network GIM three-dimensional application and even digital twins.
assignees: BEIJING GOULI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power system robust state estimation method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for estimating robust state of a power system based on deep learning, which are used for acquiring operation parameter data of the power system; carrying out abnormity and/or deficiency judgment on the obtained operation parameter data; when abnormality and/or deficiency exist, obtaining a robust state estimation result according to the acquired operation parameter data and the kernel ridge regression model; when abnormality and/or deficiency exist, performing weight screening on the operation parameter data by adopting a convolutional neural network of an attention mechanism, and obtaining a robust state estimation result according to the long-term and short-term memory neural network; the method solves the problems of non-Gaussian noise, low prediction precision and poor timeliness of quantity measurement in the state estimation of the power system, and improves the accuracy of robust state estimation.
assignees: QINGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power system state estimation method, power system state estimation program, storage medium with power system state estimation program stored thereon, and power system state estimation device
abstract_en: To provide a method for estimating a state of a power system without using an expensive measuring apparatus or a complicated simulator, a program, a storage medium and a device for estimating the state of the power system.SOLUTION: A power system state estimation device 1 comprises: a pattern generation step of generating a number of system state patterns indicating states at respective points; a measurement step of collecting present or future measurement values from one or more locations in a power system; and a pattern selection step of selecting a system state pattern similar to a pattern of the present or future measurement values. In the pattern generation step, a random number according to a correlation of the measurement values at the respective points is generated on the basis of system performance data which are past measurement values of a plurality of dates and times at two or more N points in the power system.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: User electricity consumption behavior analysis method considering missing data completion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user electricity consumption behavior analysis method considering missing data completion, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring archive data of a user, meter electric quantity data and environment temperature and humidity data; preprocessing the acquired data (first data recovery), classifying the preprocessed data, extracting power utilization characteristics, and performing segmentation storage according to different user types; performing aggregation and reclassification on the preprocessed complete data, and acquiring a convergence center where a user with the missing data is located and a second data recovery value corresponding to the missing data moment on the convergence center; calculating the average value of the two data recovery values as a final data recovery value and performing secondary data recovery; and analyzing the power utilization behavior of the user by using the recovered complete data. According to the user electricity consumption behavior analysis method considering missing data completion, the missing data is completed twice, so that overlarge errors can be avoided, and the metering data of the power system can be more complete and accurate.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid digital twin body data embedding method and system
abstract_en: According to the method, sensing information can be sent to a corresponding digital twin body according to the matching degree of the digital twin body scene semantic attribute and the sensing equipment scene semantic attribute based on service requirements, so that the corresponding digital twin body can automatically embed sensing data in the sensing information into a data set corresponding to a relevant service function, flexible self-adaptive mapping between the sensing information and the digital twin body is realized, automatic matching and access of various sensors (including newly added sensors) or mobile sensing equipment are ensured, the adaptation capability of the sensing information and the digital twin body is improved, the problem of insufficient virtual-real mapping interaction capability caused by manual point-to-point setting is avoided, and development of various electric power application services based on the power grid digital twin body can be effectively promoted.

title_en: Power system robust state estimation method based on exponential function
abstract_en: The invention provides a robust state estimation method of a power system based on an exponential function, which comprises the steps of firstly, calculating to obtain a node admittance matrix according to a topological structure of the power system and branch impedance parameters; according to a sensor layout strategy, installing PMUs at corresponding nodes of a power system to form a measurement matrix H; reading a node measurement value z (k) at the current moment, wherein the node measurement value comprises a node voltage phasor and a branch current phasor, and k represents the sampling moment; constructing an exponential function-based robust state estimation algorithm of the power system, and judging a convergence condition to obtain an exponential function-based robust state estimation of the power system; the method provided by the invention can automatically adjust the weight value obtained by calculating the partial derivative based on the target function of the exponential function according to the measurement residual error, is beneficial to inhibiting the influence of bad data, non-Gaussian noise and the like, and has the advantages of high robustness of the algorithm, strong anti-interference capability of state estimation precision and good robustness.
assignees: UNIV XIAMEN

title_en: Hybrid measurement state estimation method considering adjustable load influence and load uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid measurement state estimation method considering adjustable load influence and load uncertainty, which comprises the following steps: step 1: selecting an uncertain load reference value, constructing a distribution model of uncertain loads, selecting a plurality of possible values of uncertain loads from the distribution by adopting a Monte Carlo (Monte Carlo) algorithm, and respectively taking the possible values as initial values of uncertain loads to participate in Optimal Power Flow (OPF) calculation; step 2: the method comprises the steps that adjustable loads in the power network are regarded as generator nodes with negative power, and initial values of the adjustable loads in the current power network are obtained through optimal load flow calculation; and step 3: taking the optimal power flow calculation result as an actual value of the power network, and superposing the actual value of the network with normal deviation to simulate a measurement initial value of the state estimation of the power system; and 4, step 4: and carrying out operation of SCADA/PMU mixed measurement state estimation based on the initial measurement value to obtain a mixed measurement result. The method of the invention can effectively reduce the measurement error of the power system.
assignees: HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Power grid state detection method and system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium for detecting the state of a power grid, which comprises the steps of obtaining the measurement value of a target power grid and the state variable corresponding to the measurement value, forming all the measurement values into an original measurement data set, and forming all the state variables into a state variable set; determining a Jacobian matrix corresponding to the target power grid through a preset measurement model of the power system according to the original measurement data set and the state variable set; calculating the state estimator of the target power grid according to the Jacobian matrix corresponding to the target power grid; determining an extreme value of the state estimator according to the state estimator; comparing the extreme value of the state estimator with a preset judgment threshold value, and judging whether the measured data is normal data; and when the measured data is normal, evaluating the target power grid as stable. The invention detects and screens the measured data, ensures the accuracy of state estimation and further realizes the stable and safe operation of the power system.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method of gate control graph neural network based on data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network state estimation method of a gate control graph neural network based on data fusion. Firstly, performing pseudo measurement and measurement transformation based on an MLP and ARIMA model, and providing a fusion method for PMU/SCADA hybrid measurement; then, a rapid state estimation method of the power distribution network based on GGNN network structures is provided, the method extracts power distribution network state information from two dimensions of time and space, takes a historical data structure fusion data set as input, takes node voltage phasors as output, extracts power grid topological structure information by utilizing a graph network structure, captures variation trend of time sequence information by utilizing a gate control unit, measures mapping relation of state quantity by deep layer architecture fitting quantity, and can efficiently perform power distribution network state estimation based on a GGNN network obtained through training. The invention takes IEEE33 system and IEEE118 system as examples to give detailed algorithm description, and designs a mapping experiment and a robustness experiment to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

title_en: Power coal price index rolling prediction method based on multi-factor feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rolling prediction method for a power coal price index based on multi-factor characteristic extraction, which comprises the following steps: step S1, collecting data; step S2, preprocessing data; step S3, data mining and feature variable extraction; step S4, modeling by using an artificial neuron network; and step S5, repeating the steps S3 and S4 as time goes by, updating the model and carrying out short-term rolling prediction on the price of the power coal. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of comprehensive consideration factors, strong real-time updating degree, high prediction precision and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI MINGHUA ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for estimating running state of distributed comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for estimating the running state of a distributed comprehensive energy system, wherein the method establishes a linear relation between the quantity measurement and the state quantity of an electric power system, a natural gas system and a coupling node, establishes a three-stage state estimation model of a gas network, a power grid and the coupling node, converts the coupling node among different subsystems into a consistency equation constraint in the state estimation model, and finally realizes the staged comprehensive energy system state estimation by a distributed state estimation solving method. The method can fully utilize the information of each subsystem and improve the solving efficiency.

title_en: Smart power grids power consumption end short-term energy consumption prediction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term energy consumption prediction system for a power utilization end of a smart power grid, and belongs to the field of power consumption testing of the power utilization end of the smart power grid; the intelligent power grid power consumption terminal short-term energy consumption prediction system comprises a data cleaning module, a characteristic extraction module and a data prediction module; the data cleaning module firstly divides the feature vectors, then inputs the divided data set into the Kalman filtering module for data cleaning, screens out error data, fills in missing data and smoothes a data curve, thereby achieving the purpose of improving prediction accuracy. Then, the characteristic extraction is carried out on the input data by using a residual LSTM network group, meanwhile, the extreme value in the data is judged by using a weighted loss function, the accuracy of extreme value prediction is improved, and then, the characteristic information of the obtained data is put into a well-defined prediction model for prediction; and finally, judging by adopting redefined judging indexes, and analyzing an extremum predicting result.

title_en: Power transmission line management system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission line management system based on digital twins, which comprises a digital bottom plate layer, a data sensing module, a background service center, a local processing center and a display layer, wherein the data sensing module is used for sensing the data of a power transmission line; according to the invention, through the processing of an autonomously learned multi-system data fusion algorithm, a three-dimensional establishment model of facility equipment such as a power transmission line, a transformer substation and the like, data and various subsystems are interconnected, real-time interaction and accurate correspondence of the data are realized on a constructed digital twin platform, management of multiple application systems on a unified 'one picture' is realized, accurate position service is provided for fault alarm, inspection personnel and the like, through the interaction and cooperation of the multi-system data, the possible fault and accident events are realized, quick response and timely scientific and reasonable treatment are realized, and strong platform support is provided for the work such as safety monitoring, line inspection and the like.
assignees: PINGDINGSHAN TIANAN COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent deduction method of electric power metering production plan based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent deduction method of an electric power metering production plan based on a digital twin, which comprises the following steps of firstly, collecting production parameters of the current electric power metering production, then sorting the collected parameters, inputting the parameters one by using a parameter input module after sorting, completing the receiving of the parameters from the parameter input module by a data transmission module, transmitting the received data to a deduction control chip in a parameter deduction terminal, reading operation deduction system parameters from the deduction parameters of the deduction control chip by a digital twin module in the parameter deduction terminal, starting system deduction, and generating deduction data of a deduction object; the derived objects are generally divided into three parts: time of electricity metering production, production amount of electricity metering production, and production plan of electricity metering production. The invention generates a relatively accurate deduction result and can fully reflect the current power metering production plan.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID HEBEI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY;STATE GRID HEBEI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power system modeling method and system, readable storage medium and server
abstract_en: A power system modeling method, a system, a readable storage medium and a server, the method comprising: constructing a single equipment external characteristic model based on a feedback type fusion mode; connecting all the devices according to the topological structure of the power grid and the line parameters to form a power system wiring diagram; constructing a power system model driven by mechanism data fusion based on a single device external characteristic model of each device connected by a power system wiring diagram; and performing system simulation by using the fusion-driven power system model and performing online updating according to real-time data. The method fully utilizes rich physical knowledge accumulated in the development process of the power system and huge historical data accumulated since the digital construction of the power grid, breaks through the defects of contradiction between complexity and accuracy, lack of interpretability and the like existing in a single modeling method, can construct the power simulation system corresponding to the physical entities one by one through the running data acquired by the sensor, and can realize the purpose of predicting and detecting faults and problems existing in the physical system more quickly and accurately.
assignees: CHINESE ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Wind turbine generator power prediction modeling method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a wind turbine generator power prediction modeling method and device. The method comprises the following steps: initializing various parameters and states, including reward mechanism R, decay factor γ; a learning rate α; a greedy factor epsilon; q table; state S ═ S 0 (ii) a A pi strategy; according to the epsilon-greedy strategy pi ε Performing operation a ═ pi ε (S); obtaining an instant prize R according to a calculation method of a prize mechanism R t (ii) a Updating the Q table with the newly calculated evaluation function Q and setting the current state to S t ＝S t+1 (ii) a Repeating the steps until an iteration termination condition is met, and obtaining a wind turbine power prediction reinforcement learning model; based on digital twin technology, the power prediction reinforcement learning model of the wind turbine generatorAnd performing real-time updating. The accuracy of the power prediction model is effectively improved through a reinforcement learning algorithm. By means of a digital twin technology, the power prediction precision of the wind turbine generator is improved.
assignees: BEIJING HUAENAN NEW SHARP CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power system simulation scheduling method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system simulation scheduling method and system based on reinforcement learning, which belong to the technical fields of digital energy, internet of things, deep learning and reinforcement learning, and the technical problem to be solved by the invention is how to effectively utilize the reinforcement learning technology to simulate the real environment through virtual simulation of a power system, so as to form an accurate and efficient scheduling strategy of a power system scheduler, assist the power scheduler in decision-making and avoid adverse effects caused by scheduling errors, and the adopted technical scheme is as follows: the method comprises the steps of collecting data from each participating power system unit of a power system through a power system cloud data center, forming a power system simulation environment by utilizing a digital twin technology, designing a reinforcement learning power system dispatcher decision model pi, and then according to the situation of an actual power system dispatcher, interacting with the power system simulation environment by adopting an A3C training method to finally form an optimal execution strategy, wherein the optimal execution strategy is used for assisting the power system dispatcher in executing decisions.

title_en: Workshop intelligent fault diagnosis early warning method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a workshop intelligent fault diagnosis early warning method based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a deep convolutional neural network model; secondly, the generalization capability of the deep convolutional neural network model is improved; acquiring data generated in the operation process of various production equipment in a workshop and real-time data of a workshop environment based on a digital twin technology, and identifying the positions and behaviors of workshop personnel based on a graph convolution network to obtain the real-time data of the positions and behaviors of the personnel; inputting real-time data into a deep convolutional neural network model, wherein the output of the deep convolutional neural network model is used for analyzing and evaluating the safety condition of a workshop and the health condition of equipment; and fifthly, when the model is abnormal, making a safety early warning, storing corresponding abnormal data to an industrial database as training set data for updating the optimization model, and feeding the safety early warning back to the physical space to execute a corresponding solution. The invention can provide assistance for personnel management and control, equipment monitoring and man-machine interaction in the workshop production process, thereby reducing the occurrence of safety accidents and improving the industrial production efficiency.
assignees: UNIV SUZHOU

title_en: Power distribution station management method, system and device based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution station management method, a system and a device based on a digital twin technology. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a corresponding digital twin model according to physical entities of each device in the power distribution area; acquiring real-time running state data of each device in a power distribution station area, and inputting the real-time running state data into a digital twin model to obtain data to be diagnosed/optimized; processing data to be diagnosed/optimized by combining a pre-constructed optimization algorithm model to obtain the operation result of each device, and realizing monitoring, diagnosis, prediction and scheduling management of a physical entity; the optimization algorithm model is an index range obtained by processing the historical operating state data and the real-time operating state data of each device and comprises a data monitoring optimization algorithm submodel, a fault diagnosis optimization algorithm submodel, a load prediction optimization algorithm submodel and an intelligent power distribution optimization algorithm submodel. The invention can realize the fine management of the power distribution area and ensure that the power distribution area maintains a good operation state.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF LIAONING PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Short-term power prediction method for photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention provides a short-term power prediction method for a photovoltaic power station, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation. The short-term power prediction method of the photovoltaic power station specifically comprises the following steps: constructing a twin model of a photovoltaic power generation power prediction system based on the operation data of the photovoltaic power generation system; and the twin model carries out knowledge interactive learning with the photovoltaic power generation system through GINs so as to transfer the relation knowledge from the photovoltaic power generation system to the twin model and guide the photovoltaic power generation system to carry out short-term power prediction. The method applies a digital twinning technology to the photovoltaic power station, constructs a digital twinning body by mapping field operation data to a virtual space, can reflect the operation condition of the photovoltaic power station with high fidelity, adopts an information interaction network to complete information interaction learning between the field of the photovoltaic power generation system and a digital twinning model of the photovoltaic power generation system, completes real-time updating of the digital twinning model, and accurately predicts the ultra-short-term power of the photovoltaic power station in real time.
assignees: BEIJING HUAENAN NEW SHARP CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid data visual display method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, and particularly discloses a power grid data visual display method which comprises the following steps of power grid data acquisition, data synchronization and integration, primitive generation, power grid data scene graph generation and power grid data scene graph display. According to the invention, the power grid topology information can be acquired through the power grid service center database, the real-time power grid operation data can be automatically acquired, the data synchronization arrangement is carried out by using a satellite time service method, a power grid data scene graph is generated, a three-dimensional power grid data scene image is displayed by using color collocation, contour line and other modes, a power grid data set is generated according to the real-time power grid data, the power grid data scene graph is refreshed according to the real-time updated power grid data set, the three-dimensional power grid data scene image is further displayed by using color collocation, contour line and other modes, a higher real-time power grid operation condition is provided for working personnel, and the efficiency and the quality of the operation management and the fault maintenance of the power grid are improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HEBEI POWER CO LTD;BEIJING BOYIHUAKE SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Comprehensive energy collaborative management and control system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electricity, and discloses a comprehensive energy collaborative control system, which comprises: the system comprises an optimized scheduling layer, a service layer and a service layer, wherein the optimized scheduling layer comprises a cloud platform, an energy management system, a digital twin system, a user side virtual power plant and an external interaction system; the system comprises a coordination control layer, a central coordination control system, a regional coordination controller, a grid-connected interface device and a thermal coordination control system, wherein the regional coordination controller is in communication connection with an energy management system; and the perception automatic control layer is in communication connection with the regional coordination controller and sends the data acquired by the perception automatic control layer to the regional coordination controller, so that the regional coordination controller formulates and outputs a cooperative control strategy according to the data acquired by the perception automatic control layer. The system solves the technical problem of poor resource energy efficiency caused by the fact that the existing network architecture cannot realize the management and control of each energy source.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID SHANDONG POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent park fault early warning platform based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent park management, in particular to a digital twin-based intelligent park fault early warning platform, which aims at solving the problems that the prior art still has defects in detection and early warning and is difficult to effectively monitor and early warn water, electricity and environmental parameters in an intelligent park, and provides the following scheme.
