The system comprises an acquisition platform, a processing platform and a warning platform, wherein the acquisition platform is connected with the processing platform, the processing platform is connected with the warning platform, the acquisition platform comprises a sensor, an information screening system, a storage system and a monitoring system, the sensor is connected with a water acquisition system, an air acquisition system, a temperature acquisition system, an electric power acquisition system, a humidity acquisition system and a respirable particulate matter acquisition system, the sensor is used for acquiring, screening, storing, classifying and analyzing hydropower environment information in a smart park, and warning execution work is carried out, and the warning effect is ensured through a feedback system.
assignees: SCIENTIFIC AND TECH CONSULTATION LIMITED COMPANY OF ZHONGZHI

title_en: Optimal regulation and control method for virtual power plant participating in multi-market transaction based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimal regulation and control method for a virtual power plant to participate in multi-market trading based on digital twins, which comprises the following steps: the data management layer of the virtual power plant regulation and control platform realizes data acquisition, storage and transmission through a high-performance sensor; after a modeling calculation layer of a virtual power plant regulation and control platform reads data through a high-bandwidth optical fiber technology, a dynamic combination mode and response regulation and control capacity of the virtual power plant under different time scales are considered, a three-stage optimization regulation and control model of the virtual power plant participating in multi-market transaction in the day-ahead, in-day and real-time is established, and the model is solved to obtain an optimal strategy; and after a digital twin functional layer of the virtual power plant regulation and control platform issues regulation and control instructions to various resources in the virtual power plant according to the regulation and control plan, monitoring the regulation and control process, recalculating the resource response regulation and control capability in the virtual power plant, and feeding back the recalculated resource response regulation and control capability to the modeling and calculation layer in real time for optimizing the regulation and control plan in the next stage. The invention improves the economic benefit of the virtual power plant and promotes the consumption of renewable energy sources.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL POWER GRID RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: System and method for judging and automatically repairing integrity of multi-source measurement data of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method for judging and automatically repairing the integrity of multisource measurement data of a power grid, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of power distribution and utilization multi-source measuring devices and a power grid service resource center platform; the power distribution and utilization multi-source measuring devices are respectively connected with the power grid service resource center station and used for outputting power distribution and utilization multi-source measuring data to the power grid service resource center station; and the power grid service resource middle platform is used for carrying out integrity judgment and automatic restoration on the power distribution and utilization multi-source measurement data uploaded by the power distribution and utilization multi-source measurement device and then uploading the power distribution and utilization multi-source measurement data to the master station. According to the invention, the integrity of the power distribution and utilization multi-source business measurement data is deeply researched, and the missing data is accurately and effectively repaired.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID TIANJIN UTILITY ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: State-based energy digital twin body construction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of a state-based energy digital twin body, wherein an energy digital twin model comprises a physical space and a digital space, the physical space comprises physical equipment and an edge database, and the digital space comprises a data fusion module, an energy model for simulating or predicting energy consumption behaviors, a data-driven hybrid Petri network, a Gaussian kernel limit learning machine and a digital twin database; according to the method, a Gaussian kernel extreme learning machine is adopted to fit the instantaneous emission speed of continuous energy consumption transition, meanwhile, the energy behavior of the physical equipment is predicted by combining with the data-driven hybrid Petri network, the distortion of the energy behavior of an energy model in simulation or prediction is corrected, and the effects of energy consumption calculation, abnormal energy consumption positioning, energy efficiency index evaluation, energy related parameter optimization and energy efficiency improvement are achieved.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for filling missing data of fan operation, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for filling missing data of fan operation, electronic equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an actual measurement operation data sample of the wind power plant; extracting similar operating conditions of the wind power plant by using the residual data aiming at continuous missing data needing to be filled; training by adopting a k-fold cross validation method to obtain k1 GPR data filling models, filling missing data, calculating the average value of k1 GPR data filling values, obtaining the GPR data filling average value and calculating the standard deviation of the GPR data filling average value; training by adopting a k-fold cross validation method to obtain k2 LSTM data filling models, filling missing data, calculating the average value of k2 LSTM data filling values, obtaining the LSTM data filling average value and calculating the standard deviation of the LSTM data filling average value; and the standard deviation of the GPR data filling average value and the standard deviation of the LSTM data filling average value are weighted to obtain a filling result, continuous missing data is filled, and the filling precision of missing values is high under the condition of large-range continuous data missing.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;HUA ENERGY GROUP TECH INNOVATION CENTER LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Critical infrastructure protection blueprints generation and utilization in an interdependent critical infrastructure architecture
abstract_en: Critical infrastructure (CI) protection blueprint generation in an interdependent CI architecture includes constructing a digital twin of a heterogeneous collection of CI elements associated with respectively different services provided to a common community. Thereafter, hypothetical sensor data is specified in the digital twin for a target CI element in the hierarchy. In response, sensor data is read for other CI elements dependent upon the target CI element so as to identify impacted CI elements. For each impacted CI element, additional sensor data is read for further CI elements in the hierarchy dependent upon the impacted CI elements and the process repeats until no additional impacted CI elements are identified. A listing of all impacted CI elements is written to a blueprint for the hierarchy in association with the hypothetical sensor data in order to define a cascading effect of the hypothetical sensor data upon the hierarchy within the digital twin.
assignees: Inlecom Group BV

title_en: Rendering processing method and system in power distribution network by adopting digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rendering processing method in a power distribution network by adopting a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: the rendering server acquires data of a display frame, divides the data into a plurality of pieces of small picture data, determines a rendering task for each piece of small picture data, and then assigns the rendering task to a corresponding rendering node; each rendering node receives the rendering task, performs rendering processing, and uploads the small picture data subjected to the rendering processing to the large screen controller; and the large screen controller combination obtains the data after the display frame rendering and transmits the data to the large screen display for display. The invention also discloses a corresponding system. By implementing the method, the ultrahigh-resolution rendering effect is obtained, and meanwhile, the smoothness of operation can be ensured.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU LTD COMPANY

title_en: Waterlogging prediction method, waterlogging prediction system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydrologic prediction technology, in particular to a waterlogging prediction method, a waterlogging prediction system and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic data, carrying out basin and hydraulic facility generalization, and calibrating model parameters; constructing an SVM model, and predicting the urban inland inundation space-time range and inland inundation depth; constructing a pipe network hydrodynamic model of a research area as an AGswmm model, and simulating waterlogging conditions of the research area by combining terrain data; training an SVM (support vector machine) model by using simulation result data generated by the AGswmm model, realizing model coupling and obtaining an urban inland inundation rainfall runoff prediction model; and data assimilation, namely calculating the prediction model by taking actual measurement and predicted rainfall as input conditions, carrying out error analysis on the actual measurement data and the prediction data of the prediction model to obtain a residual error, correcting the residual error, and obtaining a prediction result which is closest to a true value. The method reduces model errors, ensures the waterlogging simulation precision, and shortens the processing and calculating time of massive hydrological data.
assignees: AMBERG SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster evacuation control and management system based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 재난 대피 제어 및 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital twin-based disaster evacuation control and management system, which comprises: a disaster detection device installed in a designated place within a building or facility and using a plurality of sensors to detect the occurrence of a disaster damaging the building or facility; an evacuation control device controlling operations of a plurality of evacuation equipment to safely evacuate people existing in the building or facility according to the occurrence of the disaster detected by the disaster detection device; a terminal location tracking device detecting a radio signal transmitted from at least one user terminal wirelessly communicating within the building or facility to detect location tracking information of each user terminal; and a central control center receiving information on the occurrence of the disaster detected from the disaster detection device and the location tracking information of each user terminal detected from the terminal location tracking device to identify the type and location of the disaster on the basis of disaster prevention management information and evacuation control information for response to each disaster stored in a separate database and the location tracking information of each user terminal, performing a disaster prevention simulation on the basis of a preset digital twin to generate a specific control signal according to disaster prediction result information for the disaster so that the plurality of evacuation equipment equipped in the building or facility operate, and transmitting the control signal to the evacuation control device. Accordingly, when a disaster occurs, an optimal evacuation route for people is predicted and various types of safety-related facilities and related facilities that have already been installed are controlled/regulated, thereby providing an effect of minimizing damage to human life and property.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반의 재난 대피 제어 및 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건물 또는 시설 내의 지정된 장소에 설치되며, 복수의 센서를 이용하여 해당 건물 또는 시설 내의 피해를 줄 수 있는 재난사고 상황의 발생을 감지하는 재난발생 감지장치와, 재난발생 감지장치로부터 감지된 재난사고 상황의 발생에 따라 해당 건물 또는 시설 내에 존재하는 사람들을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있도록 복수의 대피장비들의 동작을 제어하는 재난대피 제어장치와, 해당 건물 또는 시설 내에서 무선 통신하는 적어도 하나의 사용자 단말로부터 송출되는 무선신호를 감지하여 각 사용자 단말의 위치 추적정보를 검출하는 단말위치 추적장치와, 재난발생 감지장치로부터 감지된 재난사고 상황의 발생정보 및 단말위치 추적장치로부터 검출된 각 사용자 단말의 위치 추적정보를 제공받아 별도의 데이터베이스(DB)에 기 저장된 재난사고 상황별 대응을 위한 방재관리정보 및 재난대피 제어정보와 함께 각 사용자 단말의 위치 추적정보를 바탕으로 재난사고의 종류 및 발생 위치를 파악함과 아울러 기 설정된 디지털 트윈 기반의 재난사고 방재예측 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 해당 재난사고 상황에 대한 방재예측 결과정보에 따라 해당 건물 또는 시설 내에 구비된 복수의 대피 장비들이 동작되도록 특정의 제어신호를 생성하여 상기 재난대피 제어장치로 전송하는 중앙 관제센터를 포함함으로써, 해당 재난사고 발생 시 사람들의 최적 대피 경로를 예측하고, 여러 종류의 안전 관련 시설물 및 기 설치된 관련 시설물에 대한 제어/통제를 진행하여 인명 및 재산 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: ELSOLTEC;LEE SO YOUNG

title_en: Office building electricity utilization network optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an office building power utilization network optimization method and system, belongs to the field of power utilization network optimization, and is used for solving the technical problems that the existing office building power utilization network is inconvenient to regulate and control, and the energy-saving optimization efficiency is low. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a corresponding digital twin system based on building information and historical electricity utilization data of each electricity utilization area in an actual electricity utilization system; the digital twin system comprises digital twin subsystems corresponding to the electricity utilization areas; inputting initial optimizing parameters of each digital twin subsystem based on a preset time interval; determining an optimization strategy of each digital twin subsystem based on the initial optimization parameters; evaluating the optimization strategies of all the digital twin subsystems respectively; after the evaluation is passed, according to an optimization strategy, obtaining a region control signal of each power utilization region, and feeding the region control signal back to each power utilization region in the actual power utilization system, so that each power utilization region adjusts the operation parameters of each power utilization device according to the region control signal.
assignees: SHANDONG DAWEI INT ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network form support degree index evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network form support degree index evaluation method. In order to meet the requirement of local consumption of high-proportion renewable energy sources of a power distribution network, a distribution network form support degree index system for the consumption of the renewable energy sources is constructed. The invention adopts a digital twinning technology to establish a digital model of the intelligent power distribution network; the system comprehensively establishes a distribution network form support degree index evaluation system by combining the virtual distribution network index and the real distribution network index; and determining the index weight of the distribution network morphological support degree index evaluation, and carrying out distribution network morphological support degree index evaluation according to the set index grade and the index weight corresponding to the index grade to obtain an evaluation result. The method has the advantages that the digital twin technology is adopted to establish the digital model of the intelligent power distribution network, the original power distribution network can be predicted, the comprehensive condition of the power distribution network can be analyzed in advance, and the evaluation result is more accurate.
assignees: JIAXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: Hospital building earthquake damage prediction method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hospital building earthquake damage prediction method and system based on digital twin, relates to earthquake damage prediction technical field, lacks the problem that is used for the method of judging the building earthquake damage condition after the earthquake among the prior art, and this application can the quick prediction earthquake response result: a hospital finite element model is established based on Openses software, seismic motion is input to obtain seismic response data, 90% of the data is used as a training set and 10% of the data is used as a verification set in combination with a deep neural network, the intelligent prediction seismic response model is trained and verified, and when new seismic motion is input into the intelligent prediction seismic response model, a response result of a hospital building under the earthquake can be quickly given.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Electric power system state estimation method based on width learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a width learning-based power system state estimation method, which comprises the following steps: screening out known operating parameters strongly related to the operating parameters to be estimated by combining a known operating parameter database of the power system and utilizing a Spearman correlation coefficient, and constructing a training set and a testing set of a state estimation model; building a power system state estimation model with three parts, namely an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer, based on a width learning theory; and iteratively training the state estimation model on the training set for multiple times, determining the weight coefficients from the input layer to the hidden layer, from the characteristic node to the enhancement node and from the hidden layer to the output layer in the model, and performing precision test on the state estimation model on the test set to realize the precise estimation of the to-be-estimated operation parameters of the power system. Compared with the traditional state estimation method based on the physical model, the state estimation method based on the physical model greatly improves the state estimation speed under the condition of ensuring the estimation precision, and better meets the application requirements of a large-scale complex power grid.
assignees: ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;SHAOXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: Line loss calculation method based on data prediction filling and global dynamic model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line loss calculation method based on data prediction filling and a global dynamic model, which belongs to the technical field of line loss detection and comprises the following steps: step 1: determining abnormal data, enumerating line loss data types, and inputting main reasons of data abnormality as cluster number; step 2: clustering and grouping, namely performing data grouping on abnormal data by using a neighbor propagation algorithm, and repeatedly iterating to enhance the accuracy; and step 3: missing data prediction filling, adopting a DNN algorithm to respectively train and learn each type of data, and predicting by using the data outside the package; and 4, step 4: and theoretical line loss calculation, namely associating operating equipment in the power grid with line loss, and establishing a global network dynamic model, so that the accuracy of line loss calculation can be enhanced, and the accurate positioning of the abnormal line loss defect can be assisted.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF LIAONING PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Lithium battery health state estimation method based on secondary differential temperature characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power lithium battery application, in particular to a lithium battery health state estimation method based on secondary differential temperature characteristics, and provides the following scheme aiming at the problem of low estimation accuracy of the current lithium battery SOH estimation method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: acquisition and calculation, S2, data processing, S3: curve processing, S4: linear fitting, S5: equivalent voltage acquisition, S6: prediction is performed, S7: the invention aims to provide a lithium battery health state estimation method based on secondary differential temperature characteristics, accurately and efficiently reflects the aging trend of a lithium battery by a method for calculating second-order finite difference of temperature, increases the diversity of SOH estimation model health characteristics, and improves the accuracy and convenience of the SOH estimation method based on data driving.

title_en: Data-driven wind power system twinning method and system based on deep learning network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data-driven wind power system twinning method and system based on a deep learning network, belonging to the technical field of digital twinning, firstly generating a physical entity static model based on a monocular vision three-dimensional reconstruction method, then constructing a dual deep learning network model, obtaining a dynamic operation simulation process of a physical entity in a wind power system by using the dual deep learning network model, constructing a long-time and short-time memory neural network rule model for predicting the power generation power of the wind power system, predicting the power generation power by using the long-time and short-time memory neural network rule model, and finally combining the dynamic operation simulation process of the physical entity in the wind power system, the predicted power generation power and the physical entity static model by using a digital twinning platform to realize the three-dimensional visualization of the physical entity in the wind power generation system, realize the remote monitoring and management of wind power system equipment and improve the operation and maintenance level thereof, and short-term wind power prediction is realized.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Multi-time scale coordinated AC/DC power grid dynamic safety early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-time-scale coordinated alternating-current and direct-current power grid dynamic safety early warning method and system, wherein a key power transmission section is used as a key object of dynamic safety early warning, and meanwhile, the maximum power transmission capacity taking multi-attribute dynamic safety constraint into account is used as a dynamic safety index of the system; according to the types of countermeasures required for ensuring the system safety, the safety situation of the AC/DC power grid is divided into blue early warning, yellow early warning and red early warning; a dynamic safety early warning frame with multiple time scales of 6 hours, 1 hour and 15 minutes is constructed, and countermeasures of different action time sequences are coordinated and matched; and (3) online updating the maximum transmission capacity assessment model based on incremental learning by utilizing the dynamically added sample data, so that the accuracy of the early warning result is improved.

title_en: Power transmission line vulnerability assessment and online monitoring based on multi-factor dynamic interaction graph
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of generating generalized fault chain data, constructing a strategy of the multi-factor interaction diagram, dynamically evaluating the interaction diagram and carrying out on-line monitoring, specifically, providing a concept of the generalized fault chain, increasing the number range of the initial line capable of triggering cascade faults, enabling the interaction diagram constructed based on the fault chain theory to be applicable to a power system under any N-K criterion, introducing key parameters capable of influencing the vulnerability evaluation accuracy of the power transmission line into the interaction diagram through principle analysis, providing a strategy of adopting real-time updated parameters, improving the accuracy and effectiveness of vulnerability evaluation by utilizing the interaction diagram, providing a principle of sequentially replacing uninterrupted data flow and sliding windows, solving the difficult problem of dynamic static interaction diagram which is difficult before, and enabling the interaction diagram to meet the accuracy requirement of carrying out the vulnerability evaluation of the power transmission line under high permeability, thereby realizing the on-line monitoring function.

title_en: Multi-energy system stability discrimination method based on digital twinning technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for judging stability of a multi-energy system based on a digital twin technology, and relates to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of collecting running state data of a photovoltaic power station, a wind power station, a thermal power plant and an energy storage device in a multi-energy system, and obtaining influence factors of the energy output; the method comprises the steps that a multi-energy system is operated in different states through a digital twin technology, the operation of key equipment is taken into consideration, and influence factors of the output of each energy of the multi-energy system after the digital twin are calculated; calculating stability influence factors of the multi-energy system through influence factors of the output of each energy after digital twinning; and judging the stability of the energy system according to the calculated stability influence factors of the multi-energy system. According to the method, the stability influence factor of the multi-energy system is calculated through the influence factor of the output of each energy source after the digital twin, and then the stability of the multi-energy system is judged through the stability influence factor.
assignees: MAINTENANCE BRANCH COMPANY OF EASTERN MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD OF STATE GRID;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Digital twin distribution network operation portrait construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin distribution network operation image construction method and system, which comprise the steps of constructing a distribution network evaluation index cloud data set based on acquired digital twin distribution network load data, calculating membership of a distribution network evaluation index cloud model according to the distribution network evaluation index cloud data set, calculating hamming distances between the distribution network evaluation index cloud data set and a label template fuzzy power set based on preset distribution network evaluation index label template fuzzy power sets and membership of the distribution network evaluation index cloud model, calculating hamming distances between the distribution network evaluation index cloud data set and the label template fuzzy power sets based on preset distribution network evaluation index label template fuzzy power sets and the hamming distances between the distribution network evaluation index cloud data set and the label template fuzzy power sets, and calculating weighted scores of the distribution network evaluation index cloud data sets as operation images of the digital twin distribution network.

title_en: Power distribution network load characteristic classification method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system analysis, and particularly relates to a power distribution network load characteristic classification method. The method is based on the subordinate relation between the distribution network feeder and the transformer substation, the distribution network load power is calculated by adopting a distribution network accurate state estimation method, the distribution network feeder load distribution of various characteristics is analyzed by adopting a weighting method by combining the distribution network load characteristics and the distribution network load power supply path, and the transformer substation load characteristics are counted and summarized in a classified mode. According to the method, according to the load characteristic classification proportion of the power distribution network, under the current situation that the measurement and acquisition coverage of the power distribution network is low, the accurate load estimation method of the power distribution network is combined, so that the accurate division of the load characteristics of a feeder line of the power distribution network and even a transformer substation is achieved, the problem of insufficient fineness of the load characteristic division in the existing power distribution network load characteristic classification method is remarkably improved, and finer data support is provided for advanced applications such as load representation of the power distribution network.

title_en: Nuclear power station digital twin visualization instrument control electrical operation regulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a nuclear power station digital twin visualization instrument control electrical operation regulation method, which comprises the following steps: performing corresponding visual presetting on the procedure steps and real equipment in a digital twin virtual form, wherein the visual presetting at least comprises the following steps: target device identification presetting based on device coding consistency judgment; virtual marking image presetting based on target component identification and arrangement/column position identification in target equipment; and identifying and presetting actions based on the target component region pointing judgment and corresponding target component preset actions; the target component at least comprises an idle opening, a clamping piece and a wire end, and the preset action at least comprises pulling out/inserting the clamping piece, closing/opening the idle opening, pulling out and inserting the wire end; and executing the visual presetting based on the virtual reality equipment to finish the instrument control electrical operation regulation. The invention also provides a system for realizing the method. The method and the system can effectively avoid instrument control and electrical events of the nuclear power station caused by misoperation.
assignees: NINGBO EUROPEAN SAFETY TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Optimized configuration method of micro synchronous phasor measurement unit considering state estimation error
abstract_en: A method for optimizing and configuring a micro synchrophasor measurement unit (PSCU) by considering state estimation errors comprises the following steps: 1) forming a node admittance matrix and a node-branch model according to the node connection mode and branch impedance of the power distribution network; 2) installing mu PMUs at all nodes of the formed admittance matrix and node branch models to read measurement values and obtain measurement models; 3) carrying out t distribution fitting on the measurement noise according to the measurement value historical data; 4) constructing a maximum likelihood estimator based on the measurement model, and obtaining a state estimation error calculated based on the maximum likelihood estimator according to the influence function IF; 5) and incorporating the sum of the state estimation errors and the maximum value of the state estimation variance into the constraint condition of the mu PMU optimization configuration. The invention considers the precision of the subsequent link (state estimation result) in the optimized configuration, is beneficial to the design and the upgrade of the measurement system and has good application prospect.
assignees: XIAMEN UNIV SHENZHEN RESEARCH INSTITUTE;UNIV XIAMEN

title_en: Small-quantity power measurement and distribution network state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a state estimation method of a small quantity measurement power distribution network, which carries out measurement transformation of measurement, converts the measurement into corresponding power measurement, expresses the relation between the measurement and state variables through a measurement function, carries out corresponding measurement weight processing, analyzes an electric power system by adopting two estimation methods to reduce the influence of pseudo measurement, introduces two estimation methods of weight function synthesis, improves the estimation precision, and carries out the state estimation of the small quantity measurement power distribution network based on branch power according to a tabu search method; the state estimation algorithm provided by the invention has strong poor tolerance and good application prospect, and the adopted optimization algorithm has good guiding function on the configuration of the measuring device.
assignees: SHENYANG ENG COLLEGE;INSPECTION AND DETECTION CERTIFICATION CENTER IN LIAONING PROVINCE

title_en: Method and system for filling missing data of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for filling missing data of a power system, which comprises the steps of collecting power load data of each group of users in a target park according to a preset time interval, and calling a randomly generated missing value to obtain a power load sample set; respectively carrying out data filling on the power consumption load sample set data by adopting a preset mean value filling method, an EM filling method and a regression filling method to obtain a corresponding first filling sequence, a second filling sequence and a third filling sequence; respectively determining a first mean square error, a second mean square error and a third mean square error which correspond to each other; screening according to preset screening conditions to obtain a screening result; and calculating a filling weight according to the screening result, and performing data filling on the electric load sample set data according to the filling weight to obtain a filling sequence. The invention constructs a hybrid data filling method, which has more universality and stability than a single filling method on the basis of ensuring smaller error.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU LTD COMPANY

title_en: Crop growth remote sensing monitoring system and method based on crop model and assimilation technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of crop detection, and discloses a crop growth remote sensing monitoring system and a method based on a crop model and a assimilation technology, wherein the crop growth remote sensing monitoring system based on the crop model and the assimilation technology comprises: the system comprises a remote sensing data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a data transmission module, a central control module, a model construction module, a crop growth condition monitoring module, a growth condition parameter extraction module, a growth condition parameter assimilation module, a data storage module and an updating display module. The crop growth remote sensing monitoring system based on the crop model and the assimilation technology effectively improves the crop monitoring precision, is simple and convenient, and is easy to popularize and apply in a large area. Meanwhile, the data assimilation can effectively improve the monitoring precision of the monitoring model, reveal the growth change rule and ensure the stability and reliability of the result; the precision of crop monitoring and disaster damage assessment is obviously improved, and the method has an important application prospect.
assignees: AGRICULTURAL REMOTE SENSING AND INFORMATION RES INSTITUTE OF HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SC

title_en: Digital twin-assisted 5G power distribution network resource scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin-assisted 5G power distribution network resource scheduling method, and belongs to the technical field of communication. The invention aims to provide a digital twin-assisted 5G power distribution network resource scheduling method. By jointly optimizing terminal scheduling, terminal computing resource allocation, power control and server computing resource allocation, on the premise of guaranteeing the long-term constraint of terminal energy consumption and access priority, the DT construction accumulated iteration time delay and the terminal energy consumption are reduced, and DT precision and security are improved.

title_en: Power system state estimation method for preventing singular transformation matrix
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state estimation method for preventing transformation matrix singularity, which comprises the following steps: reading telemetering and remote signaling data of the power system to form a node branch model, constructing a weighted Jacobian matrix related to a voltage vector according to the node branch model, assigning an initial value to the voltage vector, and setting the iteration times and the state vector correction quantity to zero; starting iterative computation: adding one to the iteration times, judging whether the iteration times are out of limit or not, if not, carrying out voltage vector correction to solve a weighted Jacobian matrix according to the current voltage magnitude, carrying out matrix singularity prevention rotation axis selection and Givens transformation of a row interchange strategy to obtain a matrix Q, and then obtaining a state vector correction quantity delta x according to the matrix Q; and judging whether the delta x is converged, if the delta x is not converged, continuing the next iterative calculation, and if the delta x is converged, calculating a measurement result according to the current voltage magnitude value to obtain the current power system state. The method improves the effectiveness of the state estimation of the power system.
assignees: ORIENTAL ELECTRONIC STOCK CO LTD

title_en: Industrial load decomposition method based on factor hidden Markov model
abstract_en: The invention relates to an industrial load decomposition method based on a factor hidden Markov model, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing an industrial load model based on FHMM; step 2, analyzing the data of the application scene, and improving the industrial load model established based on the FHMM in the step 1; step 3, training total active data of the load by using an EM algorithm, and estimating parameters of the improved industrial load model established in the step 2 based on the FHMM; step 4, solving a load state estimation problem by using a Viterbi algorithm based on the industrial load parameter model based on FHMM obtained in the step 3 to obtain a working running state sequence of the load; and 5, after the working operation state sequence of the load in the step 4 is obtained, estimating the output active power sequence of each load. The invention can solve the problems of industrial load state identification and accurate electric quantity estimation.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;URBAN AND EASTERN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY OF STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: State estimation method, device, equipment and computer storage medium for power system
abstract_en: The application discloses a state estimation method, a device, equipment and a computer storage medium of a power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring parameters of the power system in a distributed file system corresponding to the power system; under a Spark framework, taking parameters of the power system as input variables, and calculating a preliminary state estimation result of the power system through a minimum absolute value algorithm; and under a Spark framework, taking the preliminary state estimation result as an input variable, and calculating a target state estimation result of the power system through a weighted least square algorithm. The method solves the technical problem that the practicability of state estimation is influenced because the calculation speed and the calculation precision are difficult to be considered in the state estimation method in the conventional power system.

title_en: Equipment state evaluation and operation and maintenance strategy formulation realization system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based equipment state evaluation and operation and maintenance strategy formulation implementation system which comprises a station-level equipment digital twinning body and a data center, wherein the station-level equipment digital twinning body is used for obtaining a first equipment state evaluation result of equipment according to acquired equipment information and sending the equipment information and the first equipment state evaluation result to the data center, and the data center is used for obtaining a second equipment state evaluation result of each station-level equipment digital twinning body according to the equipment information and the first equipment state evaluation result of each station-level equipment digital twinning body, determining operation and maintenance grade and operation and maintenance strategy of each station-level equipment digital twinning body and sending the operation and maintenance strategy to each station-level equipment digital twinning body so as to enable each station-level equipment digital twinning body to adjust an operation and maintenance scheme. The invention does not need to consume a great deal of manpower resources and time, can improve the accuracy of equipment state evaluation and operation and maintenance strategy formulation of the power equipment, and improves the state evaluation efficiency of the power equipment.

title_en: Method for forming measurement Jacobian matrix of rapid decomposition state estimation transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forming a measured Jacobian matrix of a fast decomposition state estimation transformer, which adopts a transformer equivalent circuit with a nonstandard transformation ratio k positioned at a first node i side and an equivalent impedance positioned at a last node j side, and when the first quantity is measured as the reactive quantity of the first node i of the transformer flowing to the last node j, a Q-U constant Jacobian matrix B r Row i column element B r.li Multiplying by (3-2k) on the basis of a conventional method; when the quantity of the reactive power measured by the transformer tail node j flowing to the head node i is measured, B r Row i and column j element B r.lj Multiplication by(3-2/k). The invention improves the calculation method of the transformer reactive power measurement Jacobian matrix for fast decomposing state estimation by multiplying the element of the transformer reactive power measurement Jacobian matrix by a coefficient, and can effectively improve the convergence of the state estimation. The embodiment shows that the method can obviously improve the convergence and obviously reduce the iteration times of the state estimation of the power system.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN MARITIME

title_en: Method for forming measurement Jacobian matrix of power transmission line by fast decomposition state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forming a measurement Jacobian matrix of a rapid decomposition state estimation power transmission line, when the type of the first quantity measurement is the measurement of the reactive power flowing from a head end node i to a tail end node j of the line, a Q-U constant Jacobian matrix B r Row i column element B r.li Adding 3 times of the ground-to-earth capacitance value of each side of the power transmission line on the basis of a conventional method; when the measurement type is the measurement of the reactive power of the tail end node j of the line flowing to the head end node i, B r Row i and column j element B r.lj Plus 3 times the power line per side to ground susceptance value. The invention improves the rapid decomposition state by modifying the Jacobian matrix of the reactive power measurement of the transmission lineThe calculation method of the jacobian matrix for measuring the reactive power of the power transmission line based on the state estimation can effectively improve the convergence of the state estimation and improve the calculation speed. The embodiment shows that the method can obviously improve the convergence and obviously reduce the iteration times of the state estimation of the power system.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN MARITIME

title_en: Historical data-based power system bad deviation identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying bad deviation of an electric power system based on historical data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring original measurement data of the power system within a preset time period; processing the original measurement data of the power system by adopting a state estimation model to obtain a plurality of presumed deviation values; and identifying the plurality of presumed deviation values to remove invalid deviation values and preset acceptable deviation values to obtain bad deviation. The method provided by the invention can realize the identification of the bad deviation of the power system state, and has higher identification accuracy.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY SHAANXI PROVINCE;XIANCHANG INTELLIGENT SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for identifying measurement errors of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying measurement errors of a power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) sorting and selecting measured data of the power system; 2) constructing an error measurement residual error screening method based on a least square state estimation method; 3) identifying a measurement error based on a historical measurement residual and a hypothesis testing method; 4) based on the identification of the metrology errors, the state estimation is used to iteratively calculate errors that correct the metrology error induced measurements and the system state estimates. The electric power system measurement error identification method or system based on the historical measurement residual error is simple to implement and low in calculation complexity, can greatly reduce resource overhead of real-time calculation by secondarily utilizing historical data, and improves accuracy and stability of an electric power system state estimation result.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY SHAANXI PROVINCE

title_en: Method for constructing digital twin model of power equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a digital twin model of power equipment. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: a power equipment entity; acquiring a physical association equipment entity physically associated with the electric equipment entity; acquiring an electrical association equipment entity electrically associated with the electrical equipment entity; constructing an attribute twin submodel based on attribute data of the equipment entity; constructing a state twin submodel based on the state data of the equipment entity; and fusing the attribute twin submodel and the state twin submodel of the power equipment entity, the physical association equipment entity and the electrical association equipment entity to obtain the digital twin model of the power equipment. The method solves the technical problem that the attribute information and the operation information of the power equipment cannot be comprehensively and accurately reflected by the digital twin model of the power equipment due to the fact that the influence of physical associated equipment and electrical associated equipment on the construction of the digital twin model of the power equipment is ignored when the digital twin model of the power equipment is constructed by the prior art only by considering the power equipment per se.
assignees: HUAKOV ANNOI BEIJING INFORMATION SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Historical building fire monitoring method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring a fire disaster of a historical building based on a digital twin technology, wherein the method for monitoring the fire disaster comprises the following steps: building data are received to create a historical building model, and the historical building model is displayed visually; receiving real-time video data obtained by monitoring the historical building, carrying out fire identification on the real-time video data, carrying out visual processing on ignition point information obtained by fire identification, and then simulating and displaying the information in the historical building model; and carrying out influence analysis on the simulated fire condition in the historical building model to obtain a fire influence range, determining an optimal fire fighting route according to the fire influence range and pushing a fire message to a corresponding rescue placement point. The invention analyzes and simulates the fire condition, calculates the optimal rescue scheme through the simulation result, and informs related personnel to process in time, so as to discover the possibility of possibly damaging the historical building in time.
assignees: GUANGZHOU EUCLIDEAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: User electricity behavior analysis method based on density peak clustering of shared neighbor and attraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user electricity behavior analysis method based on density peak clustering of shared neighbors and attractions, which comprises the steps of preprocessing electricity load data of a user, interpolating missing data and removing invalid data; performing dimension reduction on the load data by adopting PCA technology, calculating a feature matrix, and extracting main components of the feature matrix; clustering by using the distribution strategy of the local density and the attraction degree of the shared neighbors of the DPC-SNA algorithm by taking the data subjected to dimension reduction as input; and analyzing the clustering result, reconstructing a power load curve of the user, and analyzing the power consumption behavior of the user. The invention constructs the sample similarity measurement rule definition local density of the shared neighbor similarity, and discards the influence of the cut-off distance threshold on the local density; and the rest samples are distributed by means of the attraction matrix, so that the electricity utilization behavior characteristics of different users are effectively distinguished, the load peak time periods of the users of the corresponding types are given, and reasonable intelligent power grid planning suggestions are given to the electricity utilization behavior characteristics of the different users.

title_en: Digital twinning technology-based infrastructure operation data communication method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin technology-based infrastructure operation data communication method, which comprises the following steps: the infrastructure operation data is communicated; and (4) evaluating the penetration of the infrastructure operation data. The basic construction operation data link comprises the geometrical transformation of the basic construction three-dimensional model and the material optimization of the basic construction three-dimensional model. The geometric transformation of the capital three-dimensional model comprises section extrusion type component transformation and cable or hose type component transformation. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of universal adaptability, convenience, universality, standardization, unification, systematization and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: Digital twin-based relay protection equipment digital simulation system
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin-based relay protection equipment digital simulation system which is characterized by comprising a twin data acquisition module, a digital twin modeling module and a digital twin simulation deduction module. The twin data acquisition module is used for acquiring primary system data information. The digital twin modeling module is used for establishing a digital twin model of the secondary protection equipment, and input data of the digital twin modeling module is primary system data information. And the digital twin simulation deduction module is used for constructing a power grid system operation fault simulation model, carrying out simulation analysis on the relay protection equipment based on the digital twin model of the secondary protection equipment, and predicting the next protection action. The method has the advantages of high reusability, low digital cost of subsequent equipment, strong mode portability, realization of inversion of historical state data, construction of an equipment state early warning model for equipment early warning, and prediction of possible action conditions of next protection by simultaneously simulating protective action behaviors in various complex operating environments.
assignees: WENZHOU ELECTRIC POWER CONSTRUCTION LTD COMPANY;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Power distribution network big data restoration method based on countermeasure game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network big data repairing method based on a countermeasure game, which relates to the technical field of electrical engineering, and adopts the technical scheme that a sample class label is obtained; building a generator frame; building a discriminator frame; training a network; and generating the missing data of the power distribution network according to the trained network. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the scheme adopts a mutual confrontation game model between a generator and a discriminator which are composed of a deep neural network. The generator tries to generate samples that are consistent with the true data distribution, and the discriminator discriminates as far as possible the samples generated by the generator, and the two networks advance together in an amount that is a trade-off between each other. The method can be used for establishing a conditional countermeasure game model with gradient punishment optimization to guide the generation process of the multi-class missing samples and overcome the problem of unstable training of the original countermeasure game model, so that the data missing problem caused by the influences of measurement faults, distributed energy and the like in the power distribution network can be solved.
assignees: CHINESE PETROCHEMICAL INDUSTRY LTD COMPANY;TECH DETECTION CENTER OF SHENGLI OIL FIELD BRANCH COMPANY OF CHINA PETROCHEMICAL INDUSTRY LIMITED CO;SHENGLI OILFIELD DETECTION EVALUATION RES LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Park energy storage planning method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an energy storage planning method and device of a park energy system based on a multi-dimensional digital twin technology, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the energy storage planning method comprises the following steps: predicting the electrical load of the park; constructing a mathematical model of the equipment based on a multi-dimensional digital twinning technology; and optimizing the energy storage mode of the park energy system according to the power load and the equipment mathematical model. According to the invention, the factors considered by the energy storage planning are more comprehensive, and the planning is more reasonable.
assignees: QINGHUA SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Power distribution network typical service scene early warning method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network typical service scene early warning method based on a digital twin body, which relates to the field of electrical engineering, and adopts the technical scheme that multi-source data is generated and fused based on a countermeasure thought; building a digital twin system framework of the power distribution network; building a power failure early warning prediction model; constructing a line loss calculation and early warning model; and inputting the collected power grid data, and carrying out early warning through a digital twin system. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the method not only can repair missing data and fuse multi-source data by adopting an anti-game idea from a data source, retains the measured time sequence characteristics and correlation in the power system, but also can achieve the purpose of analyzing and solving the mechanism of the physical system and finely depicting the information-physical fusion characteristics in modeling and simulation of an actual scene with high integration level, strong mixed type and rich information links.
assignees: CHINESE PETROCHEMICAL INDUSTRY LTD COMPANY;TECH DETECTION CENTER OF SHENGLI OIL FIELD BRANCH COMPANY OF CHINA PETROCHEMICAL INDUSTRY LIMITED CO;SHENGLI OILFIELD DETECTION EVALUATION RES LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Method and system for acquiring power grid structured data mart
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for acquiring a power grid structured data mart, wherein the method for acquiring the power grid structured data mart comprises the steps of issuing data requirements in a service description mode and acquiring a data result set based on a constructed data directory; comparing the data result set with the data requirement to obtain a missing data set; checking a data directory based on the missing data set, and determining the state of the data object in the missing data set; updating the data directory according to the state of the data object in the missing data set; acquiring a data result set again by using the updated data directory; and issuing the data set according to the re-acquired data result set. According to the method, the data objects which do not meet the data requirements are screened out by acquiring the missing data set, and the data directory is further updated according to the states of the data objects, so that the correctness and the integrity of the data objects in the data directory are ensured. The problem that business personnel can not effectively use the data which are not in accordance with the business specification when using the packaged data is solved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;ZHAOQING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Power distribution network layered and partitioned state estimation system based on hybrid measurement
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network layered and partitioned state estimation system based on hybrid measurement, which comprises the following components: the input unit is used for acquiring node data, distribution network branch data, PMU configuration data and other measurement device configuration data in the distribution network; the power distribution network layered partition unit divides the power distribution network into a plurality of sub-areas based on the data input by the input unit, defines a contact line area by using the boundary nodes and the contact line nodes, and establishes a power distribution network layered partition model; the measurement data fusion unit is used for fusing the state estimation value and the estimation variance of the sub-region processed by the power distribution network layering partition unit by taking the measured phase angle information of the PMU nodes in the partitions as partition phase angle reference; the dynamic state estimation unit fuses all sub-areas to realize the full-network dynamic state estimation in a parallel computing mode; and the output unit is used for storing the processing data and outputting the overall dynamic state estimation result of the power distribution network. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving the precision, being fast to operate and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI ZHONGSHEN HYDROPOWER SUPPORTING PROJECT LTD COMPANY

title_en: Short-term electric quantity prediction method based on cross-correlation entropy gating circulation unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term electric quantity prediction method based on a cross-correlation entropy gating circulation unit, which comprises the following steps: data preprocessing, namely constructing a training sample set after supplementing missing data in historical power consumption data, constructing characteristic input of a prediction model, and finally performing data standardization; selecting features by utilizing a maximum correlation minimum redundancy algorithm; the method comprises the steps that a gated cycle unit GRU model is selected to predict the hourly power consumption, and a maximum correlation entropy criterion MCC corresponding to cross-correlation entropy is used for replacing a mean square error criterion in a gated cycle unit to serve as a cost function of a prediction model; optimizing a key parameter p and a kernel width theta of the cross-correlation entropy gating circulation unit model by a K-fold cross validation and grid optimization method; and predicting the electricity sales amount of the hour time scale by using a cross-correlation entropy gating circulation unit prediction model to obtain a prediction result. The method adopts two indexes of the root mean square error and the average absolute percentage error as the evaluation indexes of the model.
assignees: XIAN SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING UNIV

title_en: Digital twin program generating flexible demand resource data
title_ko: 유연 수요 자원 정보를 생성하는 디지털 트윈 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital twin program and, more specifically, a digital twin program that can calculate flexible demand resource information, which is information about power consumption that market participants in an electricity trading market can change, to demand management operators, according to demand increase and decrease orders, tune a calculation method according to a successful bid result, continuously update accurate flexibility demand resource information, and provide it.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 프로그램에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는 전력 거래시장에 참여하는 시장 참여자가 수요관리 사업자에게 수요 증감 주문에 따라 자신이 변화시킬 수 있는 전력 사용량에 관한 정보인 유연 수요 자원 정보를 계산하고 낙찰결과에 따라 계산방법을 튜닝하여 정확한 유연 수요 자원 정보를 지속적으로 갱신하여 생성할 수 있는 디지털 트윈 프로그램에 관한 것이다.
assignees: RAONFRIENDS CO LTD

title_en: Method of replacing missing value in smart meter and control system of smart meter using the same
title_ko: 스마트 미터의 결측치 대체 방법 및 이를 이용하는 스마트 미터 제어 시스템
abstract_en: Provided are a method of replacing a missing value in a smart meter and a smart meter control system using the same. The method of replacing the missing value in the smart meter comprises: a step of selecting a similar user having sameness with a propensity score based on the propensity score of a user in which the missing value occurs; a step of generating the amount of electricity consumption of the similar user; a step of normalize the pattern to be generated into a vector; and a step of calculating a replaced value replacing the missing value by using the vector.
abstract_ko: 스마트 미터의 결측치 대체 방법 및 이를 이용하는 스마트 미터 제어 시스템을 제공한다. 스마트 미터의 결측치 대체 방법은, 결측치가 발생한 사용자의 성향 점수(propensity score)에 기초하여, 성향 점수와 동일성을 갖는 유사 사용자를 선정하는 단계, 유사 사용자의 전력사용량 패턴을 생성하는 단계, 패턴을 정규화하여 벡터로 생성하는 단계, 및 벡터를 이용하여 결측치를 대체하는 대체값을 계산하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA RES & BUS FOUND

title_en: Scene analysis and hybrid energy storage based optimal scheduling method for thermoelectric combined system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of thermoelectric combination, and particularly relates to a thermoelectric combination system optimal scheduling method based on scene analysis and hybrid energy storage, which comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of the combined heat and power system; setting a hybrid energy storage device in a combined heat and power system to absorb an operation strategy of abandoned wind; generating wind power output scenes corresponding to a plurality of wind power simulation errors and corresponding scene probabilities by adopting a scene analysis method, and then performing scene reduction to generate wind power output random scenes; establishing an upper-layer capacity optimization model: establishing an energy storage device capacity configuration optimization model by taking the minimum input cost and the minimum system operation cost of the hybrid energy storage device in all random scenes as an objective function; establishing a lower-layer scheduling optimization model: establishing a low-carbon economic operation model for the combined heat and power system to absorb the abandoned wind by taking the maximum income of the system under all random scenes as an objective function; and the upper layer model and the lower layer model are interactively solved to obtain the optimal operation scheme of the combined heat and power system and the optimal configuration capacity of the energy storage device.
assignees: ZHEJIANG BINJIANG POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Short-term power load prediction method based on VMD-CNN-LSTM
abstract_en: A short-term power load forecasting method based on VMD-CNN-LSTM comprises the following steps: acquiring power load data of a certain area, and reserving date and daily power consumption data in the power load data to form an original data set; preprocessing a data set, including complementing missing data in an abnormal data set, correcting deviation data in the abnormal data, decomposing the abnormal data into a plurality of components through a VMD algorithm, performing normalization processing, and dividing the abnormal data into a training set, a verification set and a test set according to a certain proportion; constructing a short-term power load prediction model based on the VMD-CNN-LSTM, wherein the short-term power load prediction model based on the VMD-CNN-LSTM comprises an input layer, a convolutional neural network layer, an activation layer, a long short-term memory network layer, a full connection layer and an output layer; the obtained training set is used for training a VMD-CNN-LSTM-based short-term power load prediction model to obtain a short-term power load prediction model in a moderate fitting state; and predicting the short-term power load by using the obtained power load prediction model. The invention also includes a power load prediction system.
assignees: Zhejiang Industrial Univ

title_en: Mine personnel positioning method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine personnel positioning method based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional model, acquiring rough positioning data by a linear frequency modulation spread spectrum technology, calculating positioning data of mine personnel from the ground, estimating and optimizing position data, and mapping and displaying the positioning of the mine personnel based on the digital twinning technology; according to the method, the underground ore layer is positioned and detected through the electromagnetic induction principle to establish the three-dimensional model, then the linear frequency modulation spread spectrum technology is used for detection, the positioning data of mine personnel can be accurately calculated by combining the attenuation of spread spectrum signals, the positioning data is optimized, and then accurate positioning mapping is realized based on the digital twinning technology and the three-dimensional model, so that the limitation of the traditional positioning method is effectively avoided, the positioning is accurate, and certain help is provided for mine disaster rescue.
assignees: YANG BANGHUI

title_en: Digital twin disaster management system customized for underground public areas
abstract_en: Provided is a digital twin disaster management system customized to keep safety for urban underground tunnels, including: a sensor sub-system configured to detect environmental information, status information and image information in the urban underground tunnels; a digital twin model management sub-system configured to create and update a virtual space corresponding to the urban underground tunnels using information provided from the sensor sub-system and 3D space, insert various types of attributes into the virtual space, detect tagging information, predict the spread of each disaster, and infer a degree of risk of a management facility; a disaster management sub-system having a control function of conducting centralized supervision by displaying information about components installed in the urban underground tunnels in the metaverse space and recording a situation; and a network sub-system configured to provide the virtual space to a user terminal of an external inspector.
assignees: ELECTRONICS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS RES INST

title_en: Power grid electric power reliability operation and maintenance algorithm based on digital twinning technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid electric power reliability operation and maintenance algorithm based on a digital twinning technology, which comprises the following steps: s1, performing research on branch management operation of a management system of the power distribution network, and performing collection and off-line analysis on historical data; s2, realizing feeder feedback by using the historical data and an automatic matching system, and realizing automation of the feeder; s3, automatically dividing duties in feeder automation, and deploying practical work for related feeders; s4, importing the deployed data into a system for operation and maintenance calculation, and performing curve calculation on the obtained data; the off-line data acquisition and analysis system is scientific and reasonable in structure and safe and convenient to use, and by organizing the off-line data acquisition and analysis by the national network operation inspection department, historical data of the distribution automation master station is extracted and analyzed off-line regularly, and is checked with daily operation records mutually, so that a strict operation and maintenance index control system is formed, and better data maintenance is realized.
assignees: NANJING LESAIL ELECTRICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid infrastructure ledger visualization system and method based on digital twinning technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin technology-based power grid infrastructure ledger visualization system and method, belonging to the field of power grid data processing; the data acquisition module acquires power data of power grid infrastructure; the database stores the electric power data acquired by the data acquisition module; the data processing module processes the power data in the database to obtain data of each power grid infrastructure and relevant data of other power grid infrastructures, and the data are stored in the database; and the data visualization module generates a digital twin model according to the data and the associated data so as to visually display the power data and the interconnection relation of the power grid infrastructure to a user. According to the scheme, the electric power data of the power grid infrastructure can be automatically screened and displayed to the user in a digital twin model mode. The method is visual and vivid and can quickly obtain the electric power data of the related power grid infrastructure.
assignees: BEIJING XINYI CONSTANT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-type load joint prediction method and system for multi-energy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-energy system multi-type load joint prediction method and system. The scheme comprises the steps of obtaining historical meteorological data and load measurement data, and after abnormal time series data and complete missing data are removed, carrying out individual normalization processing on the data to generate a time series sample set; acquiring time division nodes of seasons, dividing the time sequence sample set according to the seasons, calculating coupling correlation of each season, and generating input data of a multi-functional prediction model; building a bidirectional long-short term memory neural network load prediction model of each season, inputting training samples to perform prediction model learning training and adjusting and optimizing model parameters; and inputting the test sample into the load prediction model of the bidirectional long and short term memory neural network to generate cold, hot and electric load prediction results. According to the scheme, load coupling association in different seasons is considered, the load change rule is fully excavated, and the load prediction performance of the multi-energy system is improved.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN

title_en: Load scheduling and distributing method and platform for multi-furnace multi-machine complex production system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load scheduling and distributing method of a multi-furnace multi-machine complex production system, which comprises the following steps: a digital twin model of a multi-furnace multi-machine complex production system is established by adopting a mechanism modeling and data identification method; optimizing boundary parameters of a source side heat supply main pipe of the multi-furnace multi-machine system based on the acquired heat load demand of a heat user and heat storage and hysteresis parameters of a heat supply network; based on optimized boundary parameters of a heat supply main pipe, establishing an objective function with maximum profit of a whole plant, minimum pollutant emission and minimum total energy consumption of operation equipment according to the cost, income and adjustable load ranges and load change rates of different furnace types and energy consumption differences of different equipment of the same furnace type, setting corresponding constraint conditions of a multi-furnace multi-machine system, and establishing a multi-furnace multi-machine load scheduling distribution model; optimizing by adopting a multi-objective optimizing algorithm to obtain an optimal load distribution parameter; and sending a boiler instruction and a steam turbine instruction based on the optimized optimal load distribution parameters.

title_en: Digital twin disaster management system customized for underground public areas
title_ko: 지하공동구 맞춤형 디지털트윈 재난 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital twin disaster management system customized for an underground public area. The present invention comprises: a sensor sub-system (SSS) provided in an underground public area to sense environmental information and image information of an underground public area; a digital twin model management sub-system (TMS) which creates and updates a virtual space corresponding to the underground public area using the image information provided from the SSS, inserts various attributes and search tagging information into the virtual space, predicts the spread of each disaster, and infers the risk of management facilities; a disaster management sub-system (DMS) having a central monitoring control function by displaying information about configurations installed in the underground public area on a situation board and recording situations; and a network sub-system (NSS) providing the created virtual space to a user terminal of an external inspector. The present invention can minimize damage due to disasters.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하공동구 맞춤형 디지털트윈 재난 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명은 지하공동구내에 구비되어, 지하공동구의 환경정보 및 영상정보를 센싱하는 센서 서브 장치(SSS); 센서 서브 장치로부터 제공되는 영상정보를 이용하여 지하공동구에 대응되는 가상공간을 생성 및 갱신하고, 가상 공간에 각종 속성 삽입 및 검색 태깅 정보, 재난별 확산 예측, 관리 시설의 위험도 추론하는 디지털트윈 모형 관리 서브 장치(TMS); 지하공동구에 설치된 구성에 대한 정보를 상황판에 표출 및 상황을 기록하여 중앙에서 감시하는 관제 기능을 갖는 재난관리 서브 장치(DMS); 및 생성된 가상공간을 외부 점검자의 사용자 단말에 제공하는 네트워크 서브 장치(NSS)를 포함한다.
assignees: ELECTRONICS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS RES INST

title_en: Power grid infrastructure process control method, system and medium based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a medium for managing and controlling a power grid infrastructure process based on a digital twinning technology, wherein the method for managing and controlling the power grid infrastructure process based on the digital twinning technology comprises the steps of collecting real-time three-dimensional characteristic points of each equipment building in a target project under the current construction progress; and comparing the real-time three-dimensional characteristic points with the three-dimensional characteristic points of the space-time sequence digital twin established for the target project according to the construction plan so as to manage and control the infrastructure process. The method has the advantages of being practical and feasible in engineering, low in cost, accurate and reliable, and capable of managing and controlling the progress of the power grid infrastructure process, providing timely and accurate early warning prompt information, reducing labor intensity and safety risks of manual on-site progress checking, and ensuring that the power grid infrastructure site can be constructed according to plans.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF HUNAN POWER CO LTD OF STATE GRID;STATE GRID CORP CHINA
