title_en: State evaluation method and system based on transformer sensing information and digital twins
abstract_en: The invention requests to protect a state evaluation method and system based on transformer sensing information and digital twins, and realizes visual, real-time and high-precision evaluation of the running state of a transformer based on the transformer sensing information and the digital twins technology. The digital twin body can accurately mirror the physical entity, so that the twin body must generate massive operation data, and key characteristic parameters need to be extracted, thereby ensuring the evaluation precision, improving the calculation speed, avoiding dimension disaster and improving the calculation efficiency. Moreover, based on the established sensing network and the digital twin body of the transformer, the transformer can be subjected to predictive maintenance, and the aim of judging the abnormal state of the transformer based on a digital twin model is fulfilled.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;MAINTENANCE BRANCH COMPANY OF EASTERN MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD OF STATE GRID;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Energy storage EMS system implementation method based on Websocket and http communication
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of energy storage systems, and particularly discloses an implementation method of an energy storage EMS system based on Websocket and http communication. Aiming at the defects of low HTTP polling efficiency and waste of network resources, the invention provides the method for using the Websocket as a data acquisition communication medium in the application, adopts a combined form of HTTP + Websocket, commonly requests to go through HTTP, acquires and sends the Websocket, meets the requirements of conventional web requests, meets the real-time requirement of data acquisition, ensures the real-time update of the data of the energy storage power station, ensures the safe production, improves the overall operation efficiency, realizes the improvement of project income and increases the income of enterprises.
assignees: AMPEX SHANGHAI NEW ENERGY LTD COMPANY

title_en: Graph neural network-based power system missing data reconstruction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for reconstructing missing data of a power system based on a graph neural network. The method comprises the steps of constructing missing power system operation data at the current moment into a matrix and inputting the matrix into a trained graph neural network to obtain the reconstructed complete power system operation data at the current moment; the missing power system operation data in the matrix is represented by a fixed value far away from a normal value; the graph neural network is trained using historical operating data collected based on the power system. The invention learns the complex time-space correlation between the measured data from the historical data by using the graph neural network, thereby accurately and efficiently reconstructing the missing power system data. The method considers the reconstruction of the missing data of the power system and has important significance for guaranteeing the safe and stable operation of the power system.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Power acquisition system missing data multiple interpolation method based on user quantitative evaluation
abstract_en: The invention provides a multiple interpolation method for missing data of an electric power acquisition system based on user quantitative evaluation, which comprises the steps of acquiring file data and curve data of a user ammeter to form a user group set for subdividing an application scene, intercepting a part which does not contain the missing data in the curve data of the user group, which is used as an original training data set of the user group, combining a missing mode, relying on the original training data set to generate a simulation data set which comprises simulated missing data, combining real data corresponding to the simulation data set, sorting each algorithm according to fitting accuracy to generate an algorithm set aiming at a data subset of the user group, and then applying an optimal multiple interpolation model algorithm to the real and real data to finish interpolation of the real data. The invention can realize the subdivision of the interpolation scene from two dimensions of user quantitative evaluation and data deletion mode, and then the interpolation algorithm optimization is completed by depending on the simulation deletion experiment in the subdivision scene.

title_en: Power distribution network second order cone planning robust state estimation method considering multi-source measurement
abstract_en: According to the robust state estimation method for planning the second-order cone of the power distribution network by taking multi-source measurement into consideration, a robust state estimation method for solving the second-order cone planning method under a weighted minimum absolute value objective function is constructed, PMU measurement data, SCADA measurement data and AMI measurement data in the power distribution network are comprehensively considered, node voltage state variables, line state variables and node injection current amplitude state variables are introduced, and the second-order rotating cone planning method is adopted for solving, so that the solving speed of state estimation is increased, and the identification of measurement bad data in the estimation process is realized; and multi-time-section PMU measurement data is introduced in the solving process, and bad data identification performance is further improved on the basis of state estimation of the traditional weighted minimum absolute value objective function.

title_en: Power distribution automation anti-misoperation method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twins, and discloses a power distribution automation anti-misoperation method based on digital twins, which comprises the steps of selecting a power distribution network area to be subjected to digital twins, extracting a network topology model of the area to be subjected to operation, and constructing a power distribution automation operation area digital twins model based on actual physical area mapping of a power distribution network; generating a digital twin distribution network region intelligent operation ticket based on a distribution automation anti-misoperation five-prevention expert rule; developing intelligent scheduling operation ticket simulation verification based on a digital twin model in a distribution automation operation area; executing an intelligent scheduling operation ticket in the physical system; and acquiring running data in the physical system after executing the intelligent scheduling operation order simulation, and optimizing data acquisition results of the data twin and the physical system. Compared with the prior art, the power distribution automation anti-misoperation digital twin body is constructed by mapping, closed-loop management of automatic generation, verification and iteration of operation tickets is carried out on the basis of the digital twin body, and the power distribution automation anti-misoperation level is improved.
assignees: HUAIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY OF JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: Intelligent substation digital twin system knowledge graph based creation and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for creating and using a knowledge graph based on an intelligent substation digital twin system, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a structured knowledge base around equipment components by taking the equipment components as objects; step 2, generating a database from the structured knowledge base; and 3, storing the graph database in a graph data network to form a chain type associated knowledge graph. The knowledge graph based on the intelligent substation digital twin system created by the technology has very high matching degree between the presented effect and the actual service requirement, when the equipment gives an alarm, the reason and the occurrence probability value of the alarm can be automatically pushed through the knowledge graph network, and the operation and maintenance personnel further investigate and discover the defect diagnosis accuracy according to the guidance suggestion given by the system, so that the problem of the defect is timely solved by using the knowledge graph, and the safe and stable operation of the substation equipment is ensured.

title_en: Method for constructing digital twin monthly electric energy flow network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a digital twin monthly electric energy flow network model, which comprises the following steps: data preprocessing: data cleaning is carried out on the related source layer data, abnormal information in the source layer data is processed, and dirty data are converted into data meeting data quality and application requirements; constructing a model: determining and removing repeated arcs by constructing a vertex main data set, constructing an arc set and a weight set, constructing a packing line and a T-connection, and constructing a directed graph loop; and (3) model verification: the method comprises integrity verification of a monthly electric energy flow network model and accuracy verification of the monthly electric energy flow network model. The invention can accurately depict the monthly tidal current network from the Internet to the terminal power supply users of various types of electric energy of the provincial power transmission and distribution network by utilizing the characteristics of the provincial power transmission and distribution network based on the data center, thereby realizing the lean management of a power grid company.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER INFORMATION TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Coal mine rock burst disaster monitoring and early warning system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine rock burst disaster monitoring and early warning system based on digital twins, which comprises the following components: the monitoring system comprises a stress sensor, a local data storage center, a computer processing center, a cloud information storage center, a PC user information input client, a mobile device client, an alarm system and an alarm device, wherein the monitoring objects are the stress condition, the working face impact danger and the support stress condition of the coal rock mass in the current coal mining area. The invention applies a digital twin technology and combines a traditional numerical simulation method, overcomes the defect of the limitation of a monitoring area of the traditional stress monitoring method, can realize real-time monitoring of the stress condition of the coal rock mass in a mining area according to the monitoring data generated by a stress sensor at a specified position, evaluates the impact risk of a working face, pre-warns the occurrence of rock burst disasters, and provides support for safe mining.
assignees: LIAONING ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY UNIV

title_en: Distributed Ledger for Additive Manufacturing in Value Chain Networks
abstract_en: An information technology system for a distributed manufacturing network includes an additive manufacturing management platform with an artificial intelligence system configured to learn on a training set of outcomes, parameters, and data collected from a set of distributed manufacturing network entities and execute simulations on digital twins of the set of distributed manufacturing network entities to make classifications, predictions, and optimization-related decisions for the set of distributed manufacturing network entities. The information technology system includes a distributed ledger system integrated with a digital thread and configured to provide unified views of workflow and transaction information to the set of distributed manufacturing network entities.
assignees: STRONG FORCE VCN PORTFOLIO 2019 LLC

title_en: Multi-zone thermoelectric coordination control method for multi-agent reinforcement learning and double-layer strategy distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-zone thermoelectric coordination control method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning and double-layer strategy distribution, which comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of a multi-zone combined heat and power system; creating a plurality of regional agents and establishing a communication mechanism among the regional agents; designing a multi-zone balance controller based on a multi-agent balance learning algorithm, wherein the multi-zone balance controller comprises the selection of a reward function, a balance selection function and an eligibility trace; after state estimation, qualification track updating, reward value observation and state-action value function updating are carried out on each area through the multi-area balance controller, interaction of partial information of a plurality of areas is carried out, and an optimal balance master control strategy of each area is sought on line; and taking each unit in the regional combined heat and power system as a unit intelligent agent, taking the climbing time of each unit as a consistency variable, and distributing the regional master control strategy to each unit by adopting a consistency algorithm to realize the coordination control among the units in the region.
assignees: ZHEJIANG BINJIANG POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid planning method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power planning, and discloses a power grid planning method based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps of 1, establishing a power grid planning frame based on the digital twin technology; and step 2, establishing a power grid planning trigger mechanism based on an index system, and step 3, establishing a power grid planning model and solving by utilizing a digital twin platform. The invention builds a digital twin-based power grid planning framework, provides a trigger mechanism taking an index system as a core, builds a power grid planning model in a market environment, and solves the problems of slow response, poor precision and the like of the power grid planning in the current market environment by utilizing a digital twin platform, thereby promoting the conversion of the power grid planning from on-time planning to on-demand planning.

title_en: System for cooperative interaction of electric automobile and active power distribution network and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy and energy conservation, and particularly discloses a system for cooperative interaction of an electric vehicle and an active power distribution network and an operation method thereof, wherein the system comprises a resource equipment layer, a resource sensing and controlling layer, a system information layer, an energy management layer and a man-machine interaction layer which are sequentially connected; the resource equipment layer comprises a dispatchable electric automobile and an active power distribution network system; the resource sensing and control layer comprises a data acquisition and transmission unit and a resource equipment control unit; the system information layer comprises a data processing module and an information storage module; the energy management layer comprises an energy management system and a digital twin system; the human-computer interaction layer comprises a human-computer interaction interface and a configuration platform. The method and the device build a digital twin body based on a data driving technology, perform simulation operation on the digital twin body, verify and improve the scheduling instruction of the energy management system, improve the rationality and the performability of a scheduling scheme, and solve the problems that the conventional collaborative mutual-assistance system lacks the overall simulation of the system, has less man-machine interaction and is not perfect in an optimized scheduling model.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network partition harmonic responsibility evaluation method and system based on limited measurement
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of harmonic responsibility division, and provides a power distribution network partition harmonic responsibility evaluation method and system based on limited measurement, wherein a node of harmonic responsibility to be evaluated is selected as a focus node, and a Norton equivalent model is established by taking the focus node as a center; judging whether sections on two sides of the concerned node contain other measuring nodes or not based on the Norton equivalent model, if so, taking a measuring point adjacent to the concerned node in the section, establishing a new Norton equivalent model in the section by taking the adjacent measuring point as a center, evaluating the harmonic responsibility of the sub-section divided by the concerned node by utilizing the harmonic voltage component projection, and selecting a corresponding evaluation scheme according to the type of the sub-section by utilizing the harmonic responsibility of the sub-section; otherwise, the responsibility evaluation results of all sections on the concerned nodes are output, and compared with a harmonic wave state estimation method, the calculation workload is greatly reduced.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Problem data processing method and system for distribution network engineering management
abstract_en: The invention provides a problem data processing method and system for distribution network engineering management, which specifically comprise the following steps: determining a problem information transmission path corresponding to the first power monitoring information in the digital twin distribution network model, and taking each node in the problem information transmission path as a target screening node; acquiring all other distribution network equipment connected with the target screening node in the problem information transmission path to generate a twin node topological graph, taking all other distribution network equipment as auxiliary screening nodes, classifying the auxiliary screening nodes corresponding to the target screening nodes according to the twin node topological graph, and acquiring a verification screening set corresponding to each target screening node; sequentially traversing each target screening node in the node screening sequence, and screening according to a verification screening set corresponding to each target screening node to obtain the problem data; and processing the problem data based on an information cascade strategy and a preset twin strategy database to obtain corresponding processing data.

title_en: Transformer area state classification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution room state classification method, which comprises the following steps: data normalization: eliminating abnormal data, performing data completion on the missing data, and then standardizing the power supply quantity and the line loss quantity of the transformer area to make the power supply quantity and the line loss quantity conform to a normal distribution sequence between (-1, 1); and (3) kernel density clustering: performing kernel density clustering processing on the data subjected to the standardization processing; and (3) station area state identification: further operating the data subjected to the kernel density clustering processing, and identifying the station area state; and (3) abnormal point identification: judging the abnormal point of the transformer area state; and (4) classifying the station areas: and finally classifying the states of the transformer area. According to the method for classifying the station areas, the whole running state of the station areas is distinguished by combining the long-term state and the short-term state, the station area state can be accurately positioned, the station areas needing to be rectified and improved can be quickly positioned, the field working efficiency of a basic layer is greatly improved, and the method has good practical value and good prospect.
assignees: HANGZHOU ZHICHENG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for forecasting electric power demand using convolutional neural network, recording medium and device for performing the method
title_ko: Cnn을 이용한 전력수요 예측 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 기록 매체 및 장치
abstract_en: A power demand predicting method using a CNN comprises the following steps of: collecting data of meteorological factors for power demand prediction from an API, wherein the data of meteorological factors is online public data; supplementing missing data of the collected data; selecting prediction factors to be reflected to the power demand prediction for each section by analyzing a correlation between the prediction factors through a CNN, which is a convolutional neural network that takes supplemented data as an input; and selecting a final power demand with higher accuracy for each section through a parallel structure of a CNN-LSTM and a CNN-GRU. Accordingly, it is possible to accurately predict a power demand.
abstract_ko: CNN을 이용한 전력수요 예측 방법은, 온라인 공공 데이터인 API로부터 전력수요 예측을 위한 기상요소들의 데이터를 수집하는 단계; 수집된 데이터의 결측 데이터를 보완하는 단계; 보완된 데이터를 입력으로 하는 합성곱 신경망인 CNN을 통해 예측인자간 상관관계를 분석하여 각 구간별로 전력수요 예측에 반영할 예측인자를 선택하는 단계; 및 CNN-LSTM과 CNN-GRU의 병렬 구조를 통해 각 구간별로 더 높은 정확도를 가지는 최종적인 전력수요를 선정하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 정확한 전력수요를 예측할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV KEIMYUNG IACF

title_en: Scene perception system and method for digital twin power metering intelligent vertical warehouse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scene sensing system for a digital twin power metering intelligent vertical warehouse, which comprises a sensing terminal, a cloud platform and an abnormity feedback terminal, wherein the sensing terminal is wirelessly connected with the cloud platform, the cloud platform is connected with the abnormity feedback terminal through the Internet, the sensing terminal comprises a warehouse-out idle busy sensing module, a warehouse-in and warehouse-out quantity sensing module, a warehouse-in and warehouse-out capacity sensing module, a microprocessor, a data processing module, a wireless communication module, a result storage module, a result display module and an abnormity alarm module, the warehouse-out idle busy sensing module, the warehouse-in and warehouse-out quantity sensing module and the warehouse-in and warehouse-out capacity sensing module are respectively connected with the input end of the microprocessor, and the data processing module, the wireless communication module, the result storage module, the result display module and the abnormity alarm module are respectively connected with the control end of the microprocessor. The invention can feed back the abnormity to a responsible person in time after abnormity, and the abnormity is processed in time without influencing the operating efficiency of the intelligent vertical warehouse.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Wind measurement data interpolation method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a wind measurement data interpolation method, a wind measurement data interpolation device and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring complete historical wind speed data of a target anemometer tower and a similar anemometer tower adjacent to the target anemometer tower in the same time period; training a neural network by learning the corresponding relation between the historical wind speed data of the target anemometer tower and the historical wind speed data of the similar anemometer tower so as to finally obtain a neural network model of the wind speed changing along with the position and the time; and predicting actual missing wind speed data of the target anemometer tower by using the neural network model. The embodiment of the invention can interpolate the missing data so as to obtain complete anemometry data.
assignees: Shanghai electric wind power group co ltd

title_en: Method and system for experimental simulation of dumping disasters in high slope digital twinning technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for simulating dumping disasters in a high slope digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: arranging a simulation system, completely aligning the crack between the high disaster body parent rock part and the dumping deformation part, and filling gas in the air bag; secondly, shooting initial photos of a high-position disaster body mother rock part and a high-position disaster body dumping deformation part; thirdly, releasing the gas in the air bag according to a preset proportion; fourthly, shooting real-time photos of the high disaster body mother rock part and the toppling deformation part; fifthly, repeating the third step and the fourth step until the toppling deformation part of the high disaster body falls down from the inclined support plate; and sixthly, taking the shot initial picture and the shot real-time picture as materials for machine learning. Therefore, the method constructs a test system for realizing the slope disaster body dumping instability, and realizes the simulation of the dumping disaster in the high slope digital twin technology. The application also discloses a system for simulating dumping disasters in the high slope digital twin technology.
assignees: HUANENG GANSU HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine power supply system fault early warning method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine power supply system fault early warning method based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring electric quantity data of each node of a power supply network under normal and fault conditions; constructing a spiking neural network, wherein the spiking neural network comprises an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer; training the impulse neural network based on the acquired electric quantity data to obtain the trained impulse neural network; constructing a digital twin model of the power supply network by the network through the trained pulse spirit; and early warning the power supply system fault through a digital twin model. The method comprises the steps of acquiring electric quantity data under normal operation and fault conditions on actual coal mine power supply network nodes, sending the electric quantity data into a plurality of pulse neural networks, training output neurons and hidden neurons according to a proposed formula so as to construct a digital twin model of the coal mine power supply network, and realizing real-time early warning of faults of a coal mine power supply system based on the model.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Network source data compliance verification method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network source data compliance verification method, device and system, belonging to the technical field of data verification, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring related files which are input or uploaded from a power plant in advance, performing OCR text image recognition on the related files, extracting network source data information and storing the network source data information into a database; extracting network source data information to be checked from the database; performing verification rule configuration on the network source data information; carrying out compliance verification according to the verification rule information, and screening out non-compliance data; performing data verification on the data subjected to the verification, and generating a verification result table for operation and maintenance personnel to review the verification result and prompt the power plant to correct the problem; inputting the non-compliance data into a pre-constructed modification scheme model to generate a new modification scheme; according to the invention, the new rectifying and modifying scheme is provided for the selection of the client by rapidly positioning the missing data and the non-compliance data, so that various data compliance problems in the network source coordination operation and maintenance can be well found and solved.

title_en: Intelligent fire identification method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and in particular, to an intelligent fire identification method, apparatus, computer device and storage medium, applied to an edge server, including: analyzing video stream data sent by a camera to obtain an image frame sequence; identifying images in the image frame sequence by using a fire characteristic identification model to obtain a fire characteristic identification result; calculating the similarity of the image frames of the image frame sequence in a preset time window to obtain an image similarity recognition result; respectively giving different weights to the fire characteristic identification result and the image similarity identification result, and calculating to obtain a fire identification score; outputting a fire identification result according to the fire identification score and a preset alarm threshold value; and sending the fire identification result to a platform for centralized display. The fire disaster identification of the scheme improves the real-time performance of fire disaster early warning. The time, scene and other multi-dimensional information of the image are fused, so that the false alarm and missing data are greatly reduced, and the method can be better suitable for complex application scenes.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CORP

title_en: Multidimensional time sequence prediction method based on self-attention mechanism and graph convolution network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a multidimensional time sequence prediction method based on a self-attention mechanism and a graph convolution network, which comprises the steps of preprocessing multidimensional time sequence data recorded by each sensor in an industrial production scene, and complementing time sequence missing data; then, dividing the completed time sequence data to obtain a training set, a verification set and a test set; training a pre-constructed multidimensional time sequence prediction model based on an attention mechanism and a graph convolution network by using the obtained training set, verifying the training effect and adjusting network parameters by using a verification set, testing the model prediction effect by using a test set when the multidimensional time sequence prediction model is trained to meet a preset convergence condition, and taking a model with the optimal test effect as a final multidimensional time sequence prediction model; and inputting historical data of the industrial time sequence to be predicted into the obtained multi-dimensional time sequence prediction model, and predicting the change trend of the time sequence data so as to predict the operation condition and the abnormal risk of the equipment.
assignees: OCEAN UNIV CHINA

title_en: MES and data fusion-based robust state estimation method for power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robust state estimation method of an electric power system based on MES and data fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly utilizing Lu Bangma's distance detection system outliers and distributing proper weights to selected PMU buffer quantity measurement, then utilizing the weights to filter PMU measurement noise which is not Gauss based on an MES estimator to generate a group of state estimation results, simultaneously, processing received SCADA measurement containing unknown measurement noise based on the MES estimator to generate another group of state estimation results, and fusing the estimation results from two independent MES estimators based on a data fusion theory for obtaining a final optimal estimation result.

title_en: High-permeability new energy power distribution network evaluation method and device based on multiple intelligent algorithms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-permeability new energy power distribution network evaluation method and device based on multiple intelligent algorithms. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, designing a power distribution network state estimation function for target optimization, and modifying the difference weight in the power distribution network state estimation function by using a genetic algorithm to obtain a first power distribution network state estimation value; modifying the difference value weight in the power distribution network state estimation function by using a longicorn optimization algorithm to obtain a second power distribution network state estimation value; and determining the weight of the first power distribution network state estimation value and the weight of the second power distribution network state estimation value, and performing weighted calculation to obtain a power distribution network state estimation value. By adopting the method and the device, the power distribution network state estimation value obtained by the two algorithms is subjected to weighted fusion, and the high-precision power distribution network state estimation value is quickly obtained.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Alternating current-direct current power distribution network alternating iteration state estimation method based on deep neural network pseudo-measurement modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alternating current-direct current power distribution network alternating iteration state estimation method based on deep neural network pseudo measurement modeling. Firstly, establishing a steady-state model of a voltage source converter and a real-time measurement model of an alternating current and direct current distribution network; then, offline training is carried out on DNN by using historical measurement data, and a pseudo measurement model of load node injection power is established; and finally, performing alternate iteration state estimation on the alternating current region and the direct current region, exchanging estimated values of the VSC branch state quantities among the regions in an alternate process, and ensuring the consistency of the boundary state quantities. The method can improve the calculation precision of the state estimation of the alternating current-direct current power distribution network, accurately estimate the state of the alternating current-direct current power distribution network during low redundancy measurement configuration, and has the advantages of low calculation complexity, high convergence speed and easiness in program expansion.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Modeling and implementation method for 5G urban comprehensive energy Internet digital twin system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy management systems, and discloses a modeling and implementation method of a 5G urban comprehensive energy Internet digital twin system, which includes the following steps of recording various energies into an urban energy management platform to implement urban-wide energy continuous dynamic management: 1) collecting various energy data of a city; 2) carrying out data transmission on various energy data through a 5G energy physical network; 3) establishing an energy storage computing center; 4) extracting characteristic values of the energy data through an energy storage computing center; 5) respectively establishing energy machine learning system models aiming at different energy types, and continuously training and simulating the system models by using energy data characteristic values; 6) simulating simulation data by using a trained energy machine learning system model; 7) and establishing energy cloud management modules at all levels according to the administrative levels. The invention provides a feasible technical scheme for solving the problems of unified network access, high-efficiency interconnection and multi-energy cooperation of various urban energy sources.
assignees: DU MINGFANG

title_en: Operation control method of comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation control method of a comprehensive energy system, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of 1, establishing a comprehensive energy system full life cycle multi-time space scale five-dimensional self-adaptive digital twin model based on a microscopic mechanism, 2, establishing a comprehensive energy system multi-layer collaborative optimization target system, 3, establishing a multi-time space scale distributed collaborative control method of the whole life cycle of the comprehensive energy system based on self-adaptive digital twin model prediction based on the comprehensive energy system multi-layer collaborative optimization target system, and 4, establishing a comprehensive energy system multi-granularity index comprehensive evaluation method. In step 1, the comprehensive energy system comprises a cold-hot electric network, energy conversion equipment, energy storage equipment and building load.

title_en: Bi-GAN-based power system missing value filling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Bi-GAN based power system missing value filling method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent power systems and comprises the following steps: step 1: collecting power data containing missing values, firstly carrying out normalization preprocessing and special value processing on the data, and constructing a missing position coding vector; step 2: the bidirectional confrontation generation confrontation network Bi-GAN is a generative model, can generate a new sample which follows the distribution of an original data set, mainly comprises a generator G, a discriminator D and an encoder E, when the preprocessed data are transmitted into the Bi-GAN network, a complete data set which has the same distribution as the original data set is finally generated through the game between the generator G and the discriminator D; and step 3: using a loss function to reduce the difference between the newly generated sample G (e (x)) and the original data x; and 4, step 4: a fill loss function is used to fill in missing data in the power system.
assignees: UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Energy storage power supply state evaluation method, platform and equipment based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy storage power supply state evaluation method, an energy storage power supply state evaluation platform and energy storage power supply state evaluation equipment based on digital twins. The scheme comprises the steps of obtaining on-line twin source data of an energy storage power supply and off-line twin source data of the energy storage power supply, and packaging and storing the data into first twin body data of the energy storage power supply; constructing an energy storage power supply digital simulation twin body according to the data of the first twin body of the energy storage power supply; simulating the running health state of the energy storage power supply in running in real time according to the energy storage power supply digital simulation twin; predicting the potential hazard and risk level of the energy storage power supply in the future according to the energy storage power supply digital simulation twin; and carrying out analog improvement simulation state comparison according to the energy storage power supply digital simulation twin body to generate an optimal improvement scheme. According to the scheme, the simulation twin body based on real-time data is established by utilizing the state monitoring data and the off-line data, the simulation model parameters are optimized, the production of the energy storage power supply is optimized, and the state monitoring and predicting capability of the energy storage power supply is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU HEWANGYUAN ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Big data-based accurate identification method for electric power larceny and electric power larceny prevention system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system management, in particular to a power stealing accurate identification method based on big data and a power stealing prevention system. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a power utilization management and control mechanism; identifying and evidence obtaining the electricity stealing behavior based on video monitoring and an AI identification technology; GPS positioning of the electricity stealing position is carried out; the electricity consumption data is intelligently collected; the electricity consumption analysis and control are carried out by constructing an electricity larceny prevention diagnosis model; carrying out online analysis, study and judgment and intelligent early warning on electricity stealing behaviors; establishing an electricity stealing user behavior feature library; and establishing an electricity safety big data analysis library. The intelligent electricity utilization data acquisition device can realize intelligent electricity utilization data acquisition, and improves the accuracy of electricity stealing behavior research, judgment and positioning; based on mass data, the state estimation method detection method is used, so that the scientificity and reliability of research and judgment are improved, the detection accuracy is high, and the application cost is low; the efficiency of electricity utilization inspection and auditing is improved; the whole process of electricity inspection and panoramic control can be realized; and is favorable for later evidence collection.

title_en: Tunnel fire advanced prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting a fire disaster in a tunnel in advance, which comprises the following steps: establishing a fire model, and acquiring fire data under different working conditions according to the fire model; processing fire data under different working conditions, and establishing a fire database according to the processed fire data under different working conditions; establishing a fire prediction model, and dividing fire data under different working conditions in a fire database into a training set, a verification set and a test set so as to train the fire prediction model according to the training set and the verification set to obtain a trained fire prediction model; inputting the test set into a trained fire prediction module to obtain prediction data; establishing a data assimilation model, and performing data fusion on the prediction data and the real-time observation data according to the data assimilation model so as to correct the prediction data and obtain the optimal state estimation of the real-time fire; therefore, the method can be used for predicting the tunnel fire in advance, so that the real-time performance and the accuracy of the prediction of the tunnel fire are improved.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Robust dynamic state estimation method for electromechanical transient process of generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robust dynamic state estimation method for an electromechanical transient process of a generator, which is suitable for dynamic state estimation when the noise of the generator and model parameters are uncertain. The method comprises the following specific implementation steps: firstly, establishing a four-order generator state estimation model; secondly, constructing a model uncertainty constraint criterion according to an H infinity filtering theory, and constraining a boundary range; by combining a robust control theory and particle filtering and utilizing an unscented transformation method to calculate an important density function, the particle swarm increasingly approaches to the actual posterior probability distribution; finally, a novel estimation error covariance updating strategy is designed, and real-time dynamic adjustment can be carried out according to model uncertainty. The example analysis shows that compared with the traditional generator state estimation method, the method has the advantages and the practicability, can monitor the internal state information of the synchronous generator in real time, and further meets the requirement of safe operation of an actual power grid.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Photovoltaic output decomposition method based on minimum mutual information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic output decomposition method based on minimum mutual information, which comprises the following steps: building a photovoltaic load mixing model: the load in the platform area is divided into two types of photovoltaic load and non-photovoltaic load; constructing a photovoltaic output decomposition algorithm; output estimation based on Kalman filtering: the optimal unbiased estimation of the photovoltaic multiplying power is carried out by adopting a Kalman filtering algorithm, the state estimation of the photovoltaic multiplying power is carried out, and a one-dimensional Kalman filtering is adopted by a photovoltaic load mixed model and is divided into two processes of prediction and correction; and introducing a photovoltaic multiplying power dynamic variable a, and calculating to obtain a real-time output expression at the moment t. The invention can realize algorithm decomposition based on the total table measurement and the photovoltaic output curve profile, does not need to install additional measurement, and is easy to popularize; the algorithm starts from the physical characteristics between the load and the photovoltaic, has better precision when the load characteristics change, and has certain universality.

title_en: Heat supply secondary network regulation and control method based on intelligent balancing device and reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat supply secondary network regulation and control method based on an intelligent balancing device and reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of the heat supply secondary network unit building by adopting a mechanism modeling and data identification method; an intelligent balancing device, an electric regulating valve and a heat meter for improving the circulation flow in a unit building are connected in front of the unit building with unfavorable circulation flow characteristics; acquiring historical heat supply operation data, weather data and indoor temperature based on a digital twin model of a heat supply secondary network unit building, and calculating to obtain the heat required in the unit building through a hybrid prediction model and a model weight value; when the required heat in the unit building is unchanged and the circulation flow is insufficient, calculating by adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm to obtain a regulation and control strategy of the intelligent balancing device and the electric regulating valve, and improving the circulation flow in the unit building; and based on the digital twin model of the heat supply secondary network unit building, issuing and executing the regulation and control strategy after the regulation and control strategy is verified and subjected to energy-saving analysis.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for telemetry analysis of a digital twin
abstract_en: A method for telemetry analysis of a digital twin includes analyzing network traffic sent or received by a host network. Entities exchanging data with the host network are identified. A plurality of applications within the host network used for sending or receiving the exchanged data may be identified. A digital twin of the host network is developed based upon the identified entities exchanging data with the host network and the applications within the host network used for sending or receiving the exchanged data. Stimuli may be applied to the digital twin, and the likelihood of a change in state within the host network is assessed based upon the applied stimuli.
assignees: BROADSTONE TECH LLC

title_en: Method for establishing demand response dynamic resource pool based on matrix decomposition method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power demand response, and particularly relates to a demand response dynamic resource pool establishing method based on a matrix decomposition method. Aiming at the defects that the repolarization power utilization or load transfer behaviors exist before and after the existing non-direct control type demand side response user participates in demand side response and the power grid supply and demand tight balance situation at peak time can be emphasized, the invention adopts the following technical scheme: a demand response dynamic resource pool establishment method based on a matrix decomposition method comprises the following steps: step S1: selecting a user load resource label facing to the response of the demand side; step S2: establishing an initial demand side response dynamic resource pool related to a user load resource label according to existing data; step S3: and calculating and complementing the missing data of the dynamic resource pool based on the correlation among the labels. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the behavior of the user can be well predicted, scientific theoretical support is provided for a power grid company to implement demand side response scheduling, and therefore the peak clipping potential of the demand side response resources of the power grid is well exerted.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power grid running state acquisition method and system based on multi-source data integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for acquiring the running state of a power grid based on multi-source data integration, which integrate PMU measurement data and RTU measurement data with faster update data on the basis of a state estimation result, calculate remote measurement, correct remote signaling quantity according to the remote measurement, thereby realizing the acquisition of the running state of the power grid, and improving the real-time performance of the acquisition of the running state of the power grid compared with the existing method; in addition, when the data are integrated, the historical PMU measurement errors and the historical RTU measurement errors are considered, and the accuracy of the integrated data is ensured.

title_en: Natural gas transmission pipe network simulation method and device based on approximate state space structure neural network
abstract_en: A natural gas transmission pipeline network simulation method and device based on an approximate state space structure neural network transmit data to a distributed server cluster by receiving real-time monitoring quantity of each node in a long-distance natural gas transmission pipeline network system in real time, distribute and execute computing tasks of a plurality of pipeline sections through a distributed computing architecture of the server cluster, achieve state estimation of an online training neural network and a pipeline network system, and return estimated parameters and online simulation results. The invention realizes the rapid parameter identification and online simulation of the long-distance natural gas pipeline network in a data driving mode, realizes the real-time communication with a monitoring system of the long-distance natural gas pipeline network, obtains the real-time environmental conditions and the system boundary of the long-distance natural gas pipeline network, realizes the online simulation, estimates the key unmeasured parameters of the pipeline, has good environmental compatibility, and has the advantages of simple and convenient environmental deployment of the device and the algorithm, strong transportability and low maintenance cost.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Important user power-saving emergency aid decision-making method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an important user power protection emergency aid decision-making method based on digital twins, which comprises the steps of inputting pre-acquired important user data, a power transmission and distribution network equipment model and section data, and acquiring a local power grid digital model related to an important user through an important user related model extraction algorithm; inputting pre-acquired power generation prediction and load prediction result data, outputting important users with power supply risks under a future section through a transmission and distribution cooperative risk analysis algorithm, and providing a risk elimination scheme; the method comprises the steps of inputting pre-acquired equipment reliability parameters, carrying out fault simulation based on a Monte Carlo sampling method, outputting important users with power supply risks, and providing a risk elimination scheme.
assignees: NARI RELAYS ELECTRIC CO LTD;NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH

title_en: A Method for Inspection of Digital Twin-Based AR Water Treatment Facilities and Localization of Solutions
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 수처리시설 점검 및 솔루션 국산화를 위한 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a water treatment autonomous control system and a method using machine learning capable of supporting non-expert decision-making through digital twin. The method is largely composed of three fields, but the purpose is to introduce a digital inspection system, secure water industry technology infrastructure, and create added value of water management data. The water treatment autonomous control system using machine learning comprises: a past data storage unit storing the past data obtained from a water treatment measuring device; a machine learning unit including a control-machine learning unit and a prediction-machine learning unit and learning each of the control-learning model and the prediction-learning model through the past data; a real-time data collection unit collecting a real-time measurement data including real-time water level data, real-time pressure data, real-time flow rate data and real-time water quality data from measurement sensors including water level gauges, pressure gauges, flow meters and water quality gauges, and collecting real-time operation data from various driving devices; a digital twin part supporting decision-making by non-experts by predicting the future by inputting control command obtained by inputting the real-time measurement data collected by the real-time data collection unit to the control-learning model and the real-time measurement data to the prediction-learning model; and a real-time control unit inputting real-time measurement data to the control-learning model to generate real-time control commands.
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈을 통한 비전문가의 의사결정을 지원할 수 있는 기계학습을 이용한 수처리 자율 제어 시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 이에 대한 방법은 크게 3가지 분야로 구성을 하되 디지털 점검 시스템 도입 물 산업 기술 인프라 확보, 물 관리 데이터 부가가치 창출을 목적으로 한다. 이에 대한 세부 내용으로 기계학습을 이용한 수처리 자율 제어 시스템은, 수처리 계측장치로부터 획득된 과거 데이터를 저장하는 과거 데이터 저장부 제어-기계학습부와 예측-기계학습부를 포함하고, 상기 과거 데이터를 통해 제어-학습모형 및 예측-학습모형 각각을 학습시키는 기계학습부 수위계, 압력계, 유량계 및 수질계를 포함하는 계측센서류로부터 실시간 수위 데이터, 실시간 압력 데이터, 실시간 유량 데이터 및 실시간 수질 데이터를 포함하는 실시간 계측 데이터를 수집하고, 각종 구동장치로부터 실시간 구동 데이터를 수집하는 실시간 데이터 수집부 상기 실시간 데이터 수집부에 의해 수집된 실시간 계측 데이터를 상기 제어-학습모형에 입력하여 얻은 제어명령과 상기 실시간 계측 데이터를 상기 예측-학습모형에 입력하여 미래 시점을 예측하여 비전문가의 의사결정을 지원하는 디지털 트윈부 및 실시간 계측 데이터를 상기 제어-학습모형에 입력하여 실시간 제어명령을 생성하는 실시간 제어부를 포함한다.
assignees: SM IT KOREA CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin evacuation platform that provides safe evacuation route information in case of fire or disaster through digital twin
title_ko: 디지털트윈을 통한 화재나 재난시 안전한 피난동선 정보를 제공하는 디지털트윈 피난 플랫폼
abstract_en: A digital twin evacuation platform of providing safe evacuation route information in case of fire or disaster through digital twin comprises: a plurality of sensor units disposed in each area inside a building and detecting temperature, smoke, carbon monoxide, and slope; a fire reception unit monitoring detection data detected by the plurality of sensor units; a plurality of personal location detection units disposed in each area inside the building and periodically and wirelessly exchanging data with a portable terminal of a user to determine a personal location identification value of each portable terminal; and a cloud server identifying a fire propagation trend based on the detection data received from the fire reception unit and pre-stored data on an internal structure of the building, and then providing each portable terminal of a user with 3D graphics reflecting an individual evacuation route on the internal structure of the building based on the personal location identification value of each portable terminal. The digital twin evacuation platform can provide evacuation information to individuals residing in the building when detecting anomalies in the building.
abstract_ko: 디지털트윈을 통한 화재나 재난시 안전한 피난동선 정보를 제공하는 디지털트윈 피난 플랫폼은  건축물 내부의 각 영역마다 배치되어 온도, 연기, 일산화탄소 및 기울기를 감지하는 복수의 센서부와, 복수의 센서부에서 감지한 감지 데이터를 모니터링 하는 화재 수신부와, 건축물 내부의 각 영역마다 배치되며 사용자의 휴대용 단말기와 무선으로 데이터를 주기적으로 교환하면서 각 휴대용 단말기의 개인위치 식별값을 파악하기 위한 복수의 개인 위치감지부와, 화재 수신부로부터 수신된 감지 데이터와 미리 저장된 건축물의 내부구조에 대한 데이터를 토대로 화재전파경향을 파악한 후, 각 휴대용 단말기의 개인위치 식별값을 기준으로 개인별 피난동선이 건축물의 내부구조에 반영된 3차원 그래픽으로 각 사용자의 휴대용 단말기에 제공하는 클라우드 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: AHN SANG JIK

title_en: Flood emergency rescue method and virtual command system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood emergency rescue method and a virtual command system based on a digital twin technology, which specifically comprise the following steps: s1, collecting relevant data of each river channel and the periphery of the river channel, wherein the relevant data comprises the height of a river bed, the type of the river channel, the width of the river channel and the cross section shape of the river channel; the invention relates to the technical field of aircraft simulation deduction platform support. According to the flood disaster emergency rescue method and the virtual command system based on the digital twin technology, by combining the specific characteristics of flood disasters, including strong burstiness, short rescue time and the like, a virtual command system frame is constructed, the frame mainly comprises seven modules, namely a physical module, a theoretical module, a task editor, a model editor, a driving engine, an aircraft performance evaluation module and a reinforcement learning module, and the seven modules are scientifically and reasonably arranged, so that command decision-making personnel can efficiently make emergency rescue decisions without professional flood disaster knowledge and can master rescue conditions in real time.
assignees: UNIV ZHONGSHAN

title_en: Digital twin full life cycle management platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin full-life-cycle management platform which comprises a basic layer, a data layer, a supporting platform layer, a business application layer and a user layer, wherein the basic layer is used for providing a hardware environment and a network environment for the operation of the whole platform, the basic layer comprises a server, a storage system, a backup disaster recovery module, an operating system and network equipment, the data layer is used for monitoring and detecting various data, and the data layer comprises a business database and a model database. The invention discloses a digital twin full-life-cycle management platform, which is based on the existing computer hardware and network platform, establishes application service and supervision systems on objects such as enterprises and the like, forms a series relation among business data, and finally forms an intelligent platform integrating supervision service display and remote monitoring data dynamic update so as to design a data resource center on the basis of determining the content of data resources.
assignees: SHANGHAI QIHANG DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban underground pipe network early warning system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a city underground pipe network early warning system based on a digital twin technology, which comprises a pipeline database module, a model establishing module, an acquisition monitoring module, a processing module and an early warning module, wherein the pipeline database module is used for storing a plurality of data; the pipeline database module stores basic parameters of urban underground pipelines; the acquisition monitoring module is used for monitoring the urban pipelines; the model establishing module is used for establishing an urban pipe network twin model based on the stored basic parameters of the urban underground pipelines and the monitoring point positions of the acquisition monitoring module; the processing module is used for processing the data acquired by the acquisition monitoring module to obtain a processing result. The invention can utilize the existing flowmeter to monitor the gas supply, water supply and water discharge pipelines, and process the monitoring data to obtain the early warning result, so as to solve the problems of large monitoring input force or insufficient monitoring early warning of the existing urban pipe network.
assignees: CHENGFA INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-region cooperative heat supply scheduling method based on multi-agent adjustment cost consistency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-region collaborative heat supply scheduling method based on multi-agent adjustment cost consistency, which comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a multi-region collaborative heat supply system by adopting a mechanism modeling and data identification method, wherein one region is responsible for tracking a heat supply total scheduling instruction in the multi-region collaborative heat supply system, each region exchanges information with an adjacent region, setting the multi-region collaborative heat supply system as a corresponding agent, establishing a consistency collaborative communication topological graph of a multi-agent system, establishing a low-carbon economic scheduling model of the multi-region collaborative heat supply system, solving the low-carbon economic scheduling model of the multi-region collaborative heat supply system by adopting a multi-agent consistency algorithm when the total load demand changes to change heat supply output power, and obtaining optimal increment cost and heat supply output power.

title_en: Water conservancy monitoring and disaster deduction method based on digital twin
abstract_en: A digital twinning-based water conservancy monitoring and disaster deduction method comprises 1) modeling water conservancy site topography by utilizing a three-dimensional model tool according to actual demands, finely modeling water conservancy monitoring equipment, guiding the water conservancy monitoring equipment into a illusion engine so as to construct a vivid reservoir site model, 2) acquiring sensing data acquired by the water conservancy site water conservancy monitoring equipment by using a database, 3) constructing a twinning model and a deduction model of the water conservancy monitoring equipment, mapping the real sensor data of the water conservancy monitoring equipment into the water conservancy monitoring equipment model through mapping of the data, and 4) quickly constructing a water conservancy site simulation scene according to actual conditions of a water conservancy site so as to complete corresponding water conservancy site water conservancy monitoring and disaster deduction work.

title_en: Distributed intelligent sponge monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed intelligent sponge monitoring system which adopts a distributed power supply and signal communication mode and comprises a plurality of subarea RTU upright posts, a plurality of subarea PLC control cabinets, a cloud server and a digital twin-based sponge city operation and maintenance display platform based on data operation on the cloud server. The invention can monitor the sponge city facility parameters, and can compile customized control programs to realize automatic and interlocking control of equipment such as water pumps, valves and the like. Meanwhile, the distributed power supply and signal acquisition mode reduces the laying of cables to the maximum extent and avoids the damage to the established sponge facility. Based on a data sharing and transferring mode of the cloud platform, coordinated scheduling among distributed subsystems can be achieved. Based on an interaction and display mode of a digital twin technology, the water storage and drainage processes of the sponge plots are visually displayed, a digital model of each plot is established, and decision support is provided for waterlogging disasters.
assignees: WISDRI URBAN DESIGN & CONSTRUCTION COMPANY;WISDRI ENG & RES INC LTD CO

title_en: Sea state estimation device using vertical accelerometer and disc buoy and sea state estimation method using thereof
title_ko: 수직 가속도계와 원판 부이를 이용한 해상등급 추정장치 및 이를 이용한 해상등급 추정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sea state estimation device and method. According to the present invention, provided are the sea state estimation device using a vertical accelerometer and a disc buoy and a sea state estimation method using the same. To solve the problems of sea state estimation devices and methods in prior art with a limitation to the fact that changes in sea or weather conditions that change from time to time cannot be reflected in real time and a problem in which the overall process and configuration are complicated and the error increases because the sea state is estimated by integrating the measured value of an accelerometer sensor twice and comparing a displacement, a vertical accelerometer powered by a solar battery is installed on a disc buoy, so the sea state is estimated by calculating an acceleration spectrum from a measured acceleration and comparing a pre-stored wave acceleration spectrum for each sea state with the calculated acceleration spectrum. Accordingly, the present invention can improve the accuracy of sea state estimation with simple configuration and low cost and can be operated for a long time in various weather conditions.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해상등급(sea state) 추정장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면, 수시로 변화하는 해상이나 기상 상황의 변화가 실시간으로 반영되지 못하는 한계가 있고, 또한, 가속도계 센서의 측정값을 두 번 적분하여 변위를 비교하는 것에 의해 해상등급을 추정하도록 구성됨으로 인해 전체적인 처리과정 및 구성이 복잡해지고 오차가 커지는 문제가 있었던 종래기술의 해상등급 추정장치 및 방법들의 문제점을 해결하기 위해, 태양광 배터리로 구동되는 수직 가속도계를 원판 부이에 설치하여, 계측된 가속도로부터 가속도 스펙트럼을 산출하고 미리 저장된 해상등급별 파랑 가속도 스펙트럼과 산출된 가속도 스펙트럼을 비교하는 것에 의해 해상등급을 추정하도록 구성됨으로써, 간단한 구성 및 저렴한 비용으로 해상등급 추정의 정확도를 향상시키고 다양한 기상 환경에서 장기간 운용 가능하도록 구성되는 수직 가속도계와 원판 부이를 이용한 해상등급 추정장치 및 이를 이용한 해상등급 추정방법이 제공된다.
assignees: NAT UNIV CHANGWON IND ACADEMY COOP CORPS

title_en: Power distribution network distributed state estimation method considering multi-source data uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network distributed interval state estimation method considering multi-source data uncertainty, which comprises the steps of firstly defining an equivalent electrical distance concept of a three-phase unbalanced power distribution network, and reasonably dividing the power distribution network into a plurality of sub-regions by using an algorithm; then, forming an interval expression form of local multi-source measurement data according to the measurement data in the sub-area, uniformly converting the multi-source measurement data into system injection current data by using an interval measurement transformation technology, and establishing a power distribution sub-area interval state estimation model considering double uncertainties of the measurement data and line parameters; and finally, solving the local interval state estimation model by adopting an improved interval optimization method, and finishing the interaction of boundary state information between adjacent sub-areas, thereby outputting a power distribution network global interval state result. Compared with the existing method, the method has certain advantages in the aspects of estimation result precision and efficiency, and can effectively track the influence of multiple uncertain variables of the system on the state estimation result.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Digital twin-based watershed monitoring and early warning method and simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based watershed monitoring and early warning method and a simulation platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time watershed monitoring data, transmitting the real-time watershed monitoring data to a pre-constructed three-dimensional model, and building a three-dimensional virtual simulation watershed scene with synchronous data according to the three-dimensional model; a three-dimensional virtual simulation watershed is simulated and demonstrated based on a digital twin technology and a visual large screen; obtaining real-time early warning data through a pre-constructed early warning system based on the real-time watershed monitoring data, and judging and analyzing the danger degree of the real-time early warning data to obtain a solution corresponding to the danger degree; and carrying out scheme analysis by combining a solution corresponding to the danger degree and a simulation demonstration three-dimensional virtual simulation basin to obtain a final decision scheme corresponding to the danger degree. The invention can realize scene simulation, improve early warning efficiency, early warn in time and reduce hazard of disasters.
assignees: HUNAN XIANGYINHE SENSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution project information management platform for power system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution project information management platform and a power distribution project information management method for an electric power system, wherein the power distribution project information management platform comprises a data acquisition module, a main server and a Web server group, the main server receives various data acquired by the data acquisition module in a power grid and updates the data for one time, the updated data is displayed to operation and maintenance personnel and management personnel through client application, the operation and maintenance personnel and the management personnel update the data for the second time after maintaining the data, and the updated data is transmitted to the Web server group through a network in real time and displayed to each department. The management platform of the invention not only facilitates the management platform to analyze the power grid data information in time, but also facilitates the timely management and maintenance of fault information by processing the data in a normalization way and dispersedly displaying the real-time updated data in a tree-shaped distribution way.
assignees: ZHANGZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for analyzing bearing capacity of regional multi-energy system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for analyzing the bearing capacity of a regional multi-energy system and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing system operation simulation of the system in a given evaluation period based on the digital twin model, and calculating the maximum reverse load rate of the system according to a simulation result; judging whether the maximum reverse load rate is greater than a preset threshold value or not; when the maximum reverse load rate is greater than a preset threshold value, the system runs with risks, and the distributed power supply is not recommended to be accessed; when the maximum reverse load rate is less than or equal to a preset threshold value, obtaining the short-circuit current, the voltage deviation, the harmonic wave and the three-phase unbalance rate of each bus of the system according to the simulation result, and according to whether the short-circuit current, the voltage deviation, the harmonic wave and the three-phase unbalance rate of each bus meet corresponding preset limit value requirements or not, if the short-circuit current, the voltage deviation, the harmonic wave and the three-phase unbalance rate meet the corresponding preset limit value requirements, the distributed power supply can be normally connected to the grid, and the capacity output of the newly added distributed power supply of the system is calculated; the economy and the power supply quality of the regional multi-energy system are improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Lean control digital twin system of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention provides a lean control digital twinning system for a transformer substation, which comprises: the three-dimensional visualization module is used for acquiring three-dimensional information of buildings in the transformer substation and generating standard models of the buildings at different construction stages; acquiring a plurality of images of a building in the transformer station from different viewing angles in the construction process to obtain a reconstruction model of the building; the three-dimensional measurement module is used for acquiring original point clouds of the power transmission line and the power transmission tower, and calculating the sag angle of the power transmission line and the inclination angle of the power transmission tower after the point clouds of the power transmission line and the point clouds of the power transmission tower are separated independently; the anomaly detection module is used for inputting a power line image to be detected or a power equipment image to be detected as an original image into a depth neural network based on an attention mechanism to obtain a prediction boundary frame and a prediction type of a target in the original image; and the remote assistance module is used for obtaining the holographic labeling scene. The intelligent linkage of digital holographic research and judgment of the transformer substation construction is realized.
assignees: UNIV JINAN

title_en: Hydraulic engineering dam flood discharge dissolved gas supersaturation early warning regulation and control system
abstract_en: The specification discloses a water conservancy project dam flood discharge dissolved gas supersaturation early warning regulation and control system, can carry out timely accurate early warning to the water gas supersaturation state of low reaches in-process of discharging floodwater. The system comprises: the flood discharge body digital module is used for acquiring multi-scale data of a flood discharge process and comprises a flood discharge basin data unit, a flood discharge influence factor unit and a basin physicochemical monitoring unit; the flood discharge digital twin module is used for constructing a flood discharge digital twin according to the multi-scale data and comprises a dam digital twin unit and a downstream watershed digital twin unit; the data interaction prediction module is used for predicting the supersaturated state of the dissolved gas and comprises a data interaction unit, a machine learning unit and an intelligent prediction unit; and the early warning protection module is used for generating early warning information according to the predicted dissolved gas supersaturation state and carrying out protective scheduling on water organisms of the downstream watershed.

title_en: A Sensor Fault-Tolerant Accident Diagnosis System
title_ko: 센서 결함에 강인한 사고 진단 시스템
abstract_en: Emergency situations in nuclear power plants involve automatic shutdown of a reactor, placing a heavy workload on plant operators under stressful conditions. Diagnosis of an incident that has occurred is an essential sequence for optimal incident outcome mitigation. However, incident identification results are also an important source of error, as the incident identification results determine the workflow linked to all subsequent operations. To support nuclear power plant accident identification, recent recurrent neural network (RNN)-based approaches have shown excellent performance. However, despite these achievements, the robustness of RNN models is not promising as it has been shown that incorrect inputs degrade the performance of RNNs more than other methods in some applications. In this embodiment, an accident diagnosis system that is tolerant of sensor failures was developed based on the existing RNN model and tested with expected sensor failures. After receiving and processing sensor defect information, an accident is diagnosed using a GRU algorithm.
abstract_ko: 원자력 발전소의 비상 상황은 자동 원자로 정지를 수반하므로 스트레스가 심한 조건에서 발전소 운전원에게 큰 작업 부담을 준다. 발생한 사고의 진단은 최적의 사고 결과 완화를 위한 필수 순서이다. 그러나 사고 식별 결과가 모든 후속 작업에 연결된 작업 흐름을 결정하기 때문에 오류의 중요한 원인이기도 하다. 원자력 발전소 사고 식별을 지원하기 위해 최근 순환 신경망(RNN, Recurrent Neural Network) 기반 접근 방식이 뛰어난 성능을 보여주었다. 그러나 이러한 성과에도 불구하고 RNN 모델의 견고성은 일부 애플리케이션에서 잘못된 입력이 다른 방법보다 더 많이 RNN의 성능을 저하시키는 것으로 나타났기 때문에 유망하지 않다. 본 실시예는 기존 RNN 모델을 기반으로 센서 고장에 강한(tolerant) 사고 진단 시스템을 개발하고 예상되는 센서 결함으로 테스트하였다.
assignees: ULSAN NAT INST SCIENCE & TECH UNIST

title_en: Fire extinguishing system using sprinkler
title_ko: 스프링쿨러 소화시스템
abstract_en: A fire extinguishing system using a sprinkler is provided to more effectively and reliably prevent fire extinguishment from becoming impossible due to inoperability of the entire system when a sensor failure occurs in a single-interlocked system. The fire extinguishing system using a sprinkler includes a fire-fighting pump; a power supply unit for supplying power; a sprinkler receiving a fluid through a flow path from the fire-fighting pump; a pre-action valve installed on the flow path to be involved in the flow of the fluid; a control module receiving the power from the power supply unit and controlling the operation of the pre-action valve; and a monitoring module for monitoring an abnormality in at least one of the control module and the power supply unit.
