abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy optimization scheduling, and provides a digital twin-based multi-energy coupling optimization scheduling method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical operation data, equipment constraint conditions and initial states of the multi-energy-flow comprehensive energy system, and predicting similar daily load and power generation data based on a deep neural network; correcting the coefficient of the virtual space twin model corresponding to the multi-energy flow comprehensive energy system according to the predicted similar daily load and the predicted power generation data; and performing multi-objective optimization decision based on the maintenance cost function, the transaction cost function and the environmental protection cost function according to the electricity price and the equipment constraint condition of each time period to obtain an optimal solution set, and finally determining the charge and discharge power of the energy storage device, the output power of each unit and the power of a connecting line.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Self-adaptive integrated load prediction method for power distribution network facing edge calculation
abstract_en: An edge-computing-oriented power distribution network self-adaptive integrated load prediction method comprises the following steps: inputting relevant information of a region governed by a power distribution network edge computing device; respectively carrying out standardization processing on a load historical data set and an environment temperature historical data set in an initial training set to obtain training sets; reducing the dimension of the echo state variable of the reserve pool; obtaining an integrated echo state network prediction model of day 1; obtaining the load prediction result of the nth day; obtaining an integrated echo state network prediction model of the (n + 1) th day; judging whether the long-term prediction day identification is less than or equal to the long-term prediction day identification; and obtaining a new model weight coefficient. The method not only gives play to the advantages of generalization of the integrated learning model, but also avoids redundant calculation of the integrated learning model; further reducing computing and storage resources during online updating; the self-adaption problem of the edge side load prediction model is solved, and the complexity of the model is reduced to the maximum extent by covering the whole prediction period.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Subway deep foundation pit construction safety early warning and auxiliary decision making method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a subway deep foundation pit construction safety early warning and auxiliary decision-making method and system, comprising the steps of obtaining physical data of a subway deep foundation pit; the physical data comprises foundation pit entity information, foundation pit state information and foundation pit environment information, a clustering algorithm is applied to partition a subway deep foundation pit based on the physical data, a CSA-BPNN neural network is applied to each partition, geological parameter inversion is conducted by combining simulation data output by a digital twin model of the subway deep foundation pit, geological parameter predicted values, foundation pit entity simulation information and foundation pit environment simulation information obtained based on the digital twin model of the subway deep foundation pit are input into a foundation pit state predicted model, foundation pit state predicted values of each partition are obtained, and construction safety pre-warning and auxiliary decision are conducted. Based on refinement subregion is carried out to the foundation ditch to can carry out the state prediction to each subregion, improve the accuracy of state prediction and then more accurate safety precaution and the auxiliary decision of carrying out.

title_en: Method and system for analyzing loss correlation degree of active power distribution network
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for analyzing loss correlation degree of an active power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting N groups of operating parameters of each electrical device in the active power distribution network; performing data cleaning on the collected operating parameters of each group of electrical equipment, filling missing data by adopting a K-NN method, and removing abnormal data by adopting a K-means clustering method; calculating to obtain the total loss and the subsection loss of the active power distribution network corresponding to each group of parameters; and respectively calculating the association degrees between the total loss and the subsection loss and the operation parameters of each electrical device by adopting a Pearson correlation coefficient method. According to the embodiment of the application, the loss reason of the active power distribution network can be simply and efficiently globally analyzed.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method and system for complementing collected data of power utilization area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for complementing collected data of a power utilization area. The method for complementing the acquired data of the power utilization area comprises the following steps: s1, historical power consumption data of electric energy meters at all ports of an electric power station area and corresponding acquisition time are obtained, and a data historical curve is established. S2, acquiring the station area information of the current day of the power utilization station area; the station zone information comprises the equipment number and the port information of the electric energy meter, and the starting value and the cutoff value of the electric energy meter on the current day. And S3, judging whether the starting value and the stopping value of the electric energy meter at the same port are missing or not at the same day, and completing the missing data. And S4, calculating the electric quantity Er of the current day according to the initial value and the cutoff value of the current day, further judging whether the electric quantity data of the corresponding electric energy meter is normal, and correcting. According to the invention, the problem of failure of analysis algorithm models such as distribution room curves and line losses caused by data loss abnormality is solved by compensating and correcting data loss or abnormality acquired by the distribution room.
assignees: ANHUI NANRUI ZHONGTIAN ELECTRIC POWER ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power plant digital engineering platform
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent power plant digital engineering platform, which comprises: the two-dimensional data analysis module is used for accessing the third-party system data of the power plant and providing two-dimensional data service; the digital twinning module is used for carrying out three-dimensional digital twinning operation and maintenance management by taking the three-dimensional model as a carrier; and the coupling module is respectively connected with the two-dimensional data analysis module and the digital twin module, and is used for coupling the two-dimensional data analysis module and the digital twin module pushed by the pixel stream through a WEB browsing end, so that a user can simultaneously perform two-dimensional data service and three-dimensional digital twin operation and maintenance management through the WEB browsing end. From this, through coupling module with two-dimensional data analysis and three-dimensional digital twin fortune dimension management combine together, both have the advantage that digital twin system is directly perceived, the integration nature is strong, have two-dimensional fortune dimension high efficiency, convenient advantage again, the promotion of the intelligent power plant fortune dimension efficiency of being convenient for can realize the fortune dimension of intelligent power plant more succinctly, high-efficiently.
assignees: EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP

title_en: Electric power spot market test system and method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a power spot market test system, method and electronic device, the power spot market test system comprising: an integrated mirror module; mirror simulation for the electric power spot market based on digital twinning techniques; a real-time data synchronization module; the system comprises a mirror image module, a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the mirror image module is used for acquiring the electric power spot data of an electric power spot market; a power spot market simulation module; the method is used for constructing a current spot market testing simulation platform and a real-time spot market testing simulation platform based on the electric power spot data. The present market test simulation platform includes: the system comprises a physical model access and management unit, an economic model access and management unit, a plan type and declaration type data access and management unit, a multi-day reliability unit combination unit, a day-ahead electric energy market unit, a day-ahead standby market unit and the like. The real-time spot market test simulation platform comprises: the system comprises a spot real-time market data management unit, a case creation unit, a clearing unit, an analysis unit and a real-time security check unit.
assignees: TRAINING CENTER STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Optimized operation method of renewable energy-containing multi-heat-source networked heating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized operation method of a renewable energy-containing multi-heat-source networked heating system, which comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of a multi-heat-source networked heating system containing renewable energy; setting a system operation control mode according to the energy distribution characteristics of the system region; establishing a multi-heat source networking heating system operation model with a multi-objective function with the minimum system comprehensive cost, the minimum carbon emission and the maximum energy consumption satisfaction degree and setting system constraint conditions; converting a multi-heat-source networked heating system operation model into a Markov decision process; and (3) improving a deep reinforcement learning algorithm: the method comprises the steps that a current network is set to comprise two critic value networks and an operator strategy network, each network is provided with a corresponding target network, the optimal action is selected through the operator strategy network in the current network, and the optimal action selected through the strategies is evaluated and analyzed through the two independent critic networks in the target networks, so that the optimal operation strategy of the system is obtained.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network harmonic state estimation method based on cooperation of PQM, TTU and SM measurement data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network harmonic state estimation method based on measurement data cooperation of PQM, TTU and SM. The method overcomes the defect that the traditional power distribution network harmonic state estimation method needs a large amount of same-type measurement data, can estimate the probability distribution of node injection harmonic current, realizes high-frequency estimation of node harmonic voltage, and improves the accuracy of estimation results.

title_en: Transformer substation management method and system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation management method and system based on digital twins. The method comprises the following steps: determining model information of the digital twin substation; constructing a digital twin model of the transformer substation according to the model information; acquiring operation and maintenance data of the transformer substation; and managing the transformer substation through the digital twin model according to the operation and maintenance data. According to the scheme provided by the invention, the key technology of the digital twin power grid is developed, the processes of equipment deployment, data collection and analysis are automated, the working efficiency of workers is improved, and the normal and healthy operation of the power station is ensured.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;QINGYUAN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Method and system for constructing digital twin body of power grid equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a digital twin body of power grid equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: aiming at typical equipment in a target power grid, constructing a digital twin body standard model of the equipment; establishing a mapping relation between a device real object and the digital twin standard model; according to the mapping relation, mapping from a device real object to the digital twin body standard model is achieved; constructing a three-dimensional virtual scene of the digital twin body standard model by taking a city as a basic geographical background, and displaying the real-scene information of the target power grid through the three-dimensional virtual scene; providing a visual rendering style of the digital twin body standard model under different scales through a distribution network topological graph; and realizing three-dimensional visualization of the distribution network rack through the digital twin body standard model so as to reflect the running state of the power grid in real time. The construction, networking, updating and display of the digital twin body of the power grid equipment are completed automatically on line, and the quality and efficiency of power grid management are promoted.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Pretreatment method for missing data in water quality evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water quality evaluation, in particular to a method for preprocessing missing data in water quality evaluation, which adopts segmented multiple interpolation and introduces a maximum overlapping discrete wavelet transform threshold contraction method to perform noise reduction processing on the interpolated data, and the processed data of four situations are respectively used as the input of a long-term and short-term memory LSTM neural network model; compared with the prior art, the invention carries out noise reduction processing on the interpolated data by adopting the segmented multiple interpolation and simultaneously introducing a maximum overlapping discrete wavelet transform threshold contraction method, and carries out interpolation on the data set by utilizing a long-short term memory LSTM neural network model, thereby realizing the function of preprocessing the data loss in the water quality evaluation process and providing good reference value for water quality evaluation.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Loss calculation method, device, equipment and storage medium for direct current transmission system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a loss calculation method, a loss calculation device, loss calculation equipment and a loss calculation storage medium for a direct-current power transmission system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing an initial bidirectional mapping digital twin loss model based on a fully constructed mask mechanism and an encoder-decoder framework; training and optimizing the initial bidirectional mapping digital twin loss model according to a migration algorithm to obtain a transitional bidirectional mapping digital twin loss model; based on a knowledge distillation algorithm, carrying out lightweight transformation on the transitional bidirectional mapping digital twin loss model to obtain a target bidirectional mapping digital twin loss model; and calculating the loss of the actual direct current power transmission system according to the target bidirectional mapping digital twin loss model. The loss calculation method, the loss calculation device, the loss calculation equipment and the loss calculation storage medium of the direct current transmission system realize bidirectional mapping by a fully constructed mask mechanism and an encoder-decoder framework, and improve the calculation accuracy and the feature extraction capability by a migration algorithm and a knowledge distillation algorithm.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Thermal stability emergency control strategy optimization method and system suitable for dispatching center station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal stability emergency control strategy optimization method and a system suitable for a dispatching center station, and (3) uploading data in real time according to the security control device, and correcting the state estimation data to form emergency control basic mode data. And determining a thermal stability emergency control strategy optimization fault set according to the overload margin of the power grid after the safety control action under the fault, obtaining an emergency control adjustment space according to the increasable and reducible output and the load cutting quantity of the unit sent by the safety control device, calculating comprehensive performance indexes according to the sensitivity of tide, measure control performance indexes, the control cost of equipment and the like, and carrying out unit increasable and loweraoutput adjustment and load adjustment according to the comprehensive performance indexes to obtain a final emergency control strategy optimization scheme. The advantages are that: the invention improves the accuracy of the basic data of the emergency control, avoids the power unbalance of the power grid caused by the traditional emergency control cutting machine and load cutting measures by preferentially adjusting the lifting measures of the sending and receiving end units, reduces the loss of the load and improves the applicability and the economy of the emergency control measures.

title_en: Techniques for generating one or more scores and/or one or more corrections for a digital twin representing a utility network
abstract_en: Techniques are provided for generating score(s) and/or correction(s) for a digital twin representing a utility network. One or more bridges transform data, from a plurality of system and associated with a utility network, to a different format, e.g., relational database format. A process generates a digital twin of the utility network utilizing the data in the different format. A data quality service (DQS) performs evaluations and/or analyses of the digital twin to generate a baseline score and an updated score representing a state of the digital twin if corrections are applied. If the updated score meets or is above a threshold value, the DQS automatically applies and save the corrections to the digital twin. If the updated score does not meet the threshold value, the DQS presents a failure notification and one or more graphical representations of the utility network such that incremental corrections can be made.
assignees: BENTLEY SYS INC

title_en: Discrimination method for consistency of power grid enterprise risk and management and control measures
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging the consistency of the risk and the management and control measures of a power grid enterprise, which comprises the steps of collecting equipment data and preprocessing the equipment data; constructing a digital twin model by utilizing the preprocessed data; real-time object data are mapped to the data to construct a digital twin model, and early warning is given out on faults occurring in the real-time object data. The data transmission delay is low, and the edge server is deployed at the side of the user terminal, so that the data transmission delay is greatly reduced; the intelligent fault processing method is based on a digital twin technology, a physical object can be mapped to a virtual object in real time during operation and is displayed to a control center through a visualization technology, and the type and the place of a fault can be accurately judged; the invention can reduce equipment loss and avoid test risk by carrying out simulation test on the virtual object.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ECONOMIC & TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method, device and equipment for acquiring generated energy prediction data and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for acquiring power generation capacity prediction data, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly acquiring temperature change prediction data; then preprocessing the air temperature change prediction data to obtain preprocessed air temperature change prediction data; and finally, inputting the preprocessed temperature change prediction data into a power consumption prediction digital twin model to obtain power generation amount prediction data output by the power prediction digital twin model. Therefore, the generated energy prediction data is determined through the air temperature change prediction data and the electric quantity prediction digital twin model, so that the generated energy prediction data can be close to the actual generated energy data, and the accuracy of the generated energy prediction data is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHILIAN E COMMERCE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin system for ocean nuclear power platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin system for an ocean nuclear power platform, which comprises a prototype monitoring subsystem of a real platform and a health management subsystem of a twin platform. The prototype monitoring subsystem of the real platform comprises a data acquisition module, a data integration module and a data remote transmission module; the health management subsystem of the twin platform comprises a real-time data access module, a three-dimensional dynamic display module and an intelligent structure analysis module. The system can realize full-life-cycle automatic, digital and intelligent state data analysis, fault diagnosis, prediction and operation and maintenance management, highly-visualized synchronous dynamic display of the operation and maintenance process of the nuclear power platform, real-time feedback of the health state of the nuclear power platform and guarantee of safe operation of the nuclear power platform.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH;NINGBO INSTITUTE OF DALIAN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Electric power missing data complement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power missing data complement method which comprises the steps of obtaining original power data, dividing the original power data into a complete data set and a missing data set, determining a dynamic time regular distance by adopting a dynamic time regular algorithm, constructing a neighbor data matrix according to the dynamic time regular distance of an electric energy sequence by adopting a K-neighbor algorithm, carrying out distribution optimization on the weight of the neighbor data matrix to obtain a first complement value, calculating an attribute correlation influence coefficient according to the neighbor data matrix to serve as a second complement value, determining the complement value of the electric energy sequence in the missing data set according to the first complement value and the second complement value, removing the complemented electric energy sequence from the missing data set, and adding the electric energy sequence into the complete data set. The invention can accurately complement the missing data in the electric power data, effectively repair the missing value by the complement method, truly reflect the actual electricity consumption condition of the user, and provide complete and effective basic electric power data for researching the relevant electricity consumption behavior analysis of the user.

title_en: Large-scale energy storage power station abnormal battery identification method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage system analysis and control, in particular to a method, equipment and a storage medium for identifying abnormal batteries of a large-scale energy storage power station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting battery data of a large-scale energy storage power station, identifying and deleting noise data existing in the battery data, and supplementing missing data by using a Newton interpolation method; extracting deep features of the abnormal battery by using a time convolution attention mechanism network, and introducing a typical working condition sequence for storing feature data of all charging sections subjected to dimensionality reduction; based on the characteristics of the battery charging section, a deletion mechanism is combined with a deep clustering algorithm, and an outlier detection algorithm for improving the deep clustering is utilized to identify abnormal batteries in the large-scale energy storage power station. According to the invention, the accuracy and precision of the data are improved; by combining the deletion mechanism with the outlier detection method of deep clustering, the problems of battery inconsistency and fault state evaluation under the conditions of low volatility and unequal dimensional space are solved.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Scalable, data-driven digital marketplace providing a standardized secured data system for interlinking sensitive risk-related data, and method thereof
abstract_en: Proposed is a scalable, data-driven digital market place and system providing a standardized data aggregator by a central digital platform for interlinking sensitive risk-related data, the scalable data-driven digital market place providing controlled data-driven and/or process-driven cross-data interaction between different units of the scalable data-driven digital market place and the central digital platform. The digital market place platform is based on an automated digital process for users centered around six areas with modular core and premium add-on processes. The first area provides automated loss analytics and automated programme optimization facilitating the understanding of loss trends and automated deriving of an optimized risk-transfer structure and/or programme. The second area provides automated property exposure management and automated visualization of property portfolio and risk exposures. The third area provides employee health risk-transfer structures and/or programmes facilitating automated analysis of complex impact of risks on employee health programs and/or risk-transfer structures. The forth area provides automated policy and/or certificate and/or exposure and/or claims management, inter alia, providing automated capturing and automated managing of risk-relevant data and documents. The fifth area provides automated supply chain resilience by automatically creating digital twins of production and supplier networks to be covered and/or fenced by risk mitigation. The sixth area provides automated sustainability solutions and/or automated compiling of sustainability metrics and tracking against NetZero.
assignees: Swiss reinsurance co ltd

title_en: Digital twin identification method and management system for hidden cable pipe network facilities
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin recognition method and a management system for hidden cable pipe network facilities, which are used for carrying out virtual reality control on an underground electric power pipe network by applying Beidou reference calibration and intelligent perception technology accurate positioning and digital twin technology, a terminal device establishes a model element library database management program unit, the terminal device locates and inputs geographic and underground electric power cable pipe network facility data to generate a 3D model, the 3D model is stored to the terminal device, the terminal device calls the 3D model of the cable pipe network facility hidden by project data according to the located geographic data during operation and maintenance or reconnaissance and displays the model on a real-time video front layer, and simultaneously calls sensor data to display the operation condition of the model, thereby establishing the digital twin system for the hidden cable pipe network facility, so that the hidden huge cable facility is mapped on an internal network client in real time through the site and the virtual 3D technology, and the hidden cable facility is visualized as an overhead electric power line and is always in real-time control.
assignees: Zhejiang zhengyuan electric power equipment co ltd

title_en: Method, apparatus and medium for analyzing power communication transmission network based on digital twin
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure relates to an analysis method of a power communication transmission network based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model for the power communications transmission network based on physical attribute data of physical devices in the power communications transmission network; acquiring real-time operation data of the entity equipment, inputting the real-time operation data into a digital twin model, and simulating the real-time operation state of the power communication transmission network; analyzing to obtain twin fault events corresponding to the fault events in the power communication transmission network based on the simulation constraint conditions; and outputting the twin fault event to realize early warning of the fault event of the power communication network. By the method, the real scene of the power communication transmission network can be simulated, the simulation fault reason can be analyzed, and the early warning of the fault event of the power communication network can be realized so as to help operation and maintenance personnel to quickly solve the fault problem.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Offshore ecological environment numerical forecasting method and system
abstract_en: An offshore ecological environment numerical forecasting method, comprising: collecting various marine related data to obtain satellite remote sensing sea surface temperature, chlorophyll a concentration, observation data and other marine data, and utilizing the related data to manufacture a driving field, an open boundary and an initial field; according to the sea area optimization parameter schemes, the physical mode and the ecological mode are optimized, the physical mode and the ecological mode are coupled by a driving field, an open boundary and an initial field, a data assimilation correction mode initial field is developed to obtain a physical mode simulation forecasting result and an ecological mode simulation forecasting result, interpolation layering, marine disaster and environment analysis, checking and archiving are carried out on the physical mode simulation forecasting result and the ecological mode simulation forecasting result to obtain a static forecasting image, interpretation application analysis results and checking and archiving results, and the offshore ecological environment with environment difference and model uniformity can be more comprehensively and pertinently described, including a nitrogen, phosphorus, silicon, oxygen and carbon multisource bioelectrochemical circulation process (especially phosphorus circulation) so as to be beneficial to improving the definition of the offshore ecological environment description.

title_en: Electric power system missing data repairing method based on improved space-time generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system missing data repairing method based on an improved space-time generation countermeasure network, which comprises the steps of generating measurement data by using a generator based on an improved TCAN network; inputting the generated and real data into a discriminator for discrimination; training the generator and the discriminator based on the loss function; and fixing the parameters of the generator and the discriminator, and generating reconstruction data according to the reconstruction loss to realize data restoration. The invention uses the improved TCAN to replace the CNN in the DCGAN, better extracts the time sequence characteristics in the time sequence data, can calculate in parallel, and has high calculation speed and good effect; and replacing a self-attention mechanism in the TCAN with a GAU attention unit to effectively extract data space features. The method can effectively extract the time-space characteristics of the data, quickly and accurately repair the data on the basis of the missing measurement data, and improve the reliability and observability of the power system.
assignees: UNIV YANSHAN

title_en: Novel power supply optimal planning method for electric power system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel power supply optimal planning method for an electric power system based on digital twins, which solves the load fluctuation of a power grid and improves the absorption capacity of the power grid by proportioning the power supply capacity. The strategy solves the problem of uncertainty of new energy output by establishing a five-dimensional new power system model and modeling wind power and photovoltaic units by using a mechanism-data driven hybrid model, establishes a structure planning model and a system planning model of a virtual power system, simulates the system planning modeling by digital twins, feeds back a calculation result to a planning main body to guide planning decision, realizes automatic updating iteration of model structure and parameters by real-time communication and interaction of sensors and physical entity information, verifies the effect of a planning scheme by combining indexes such as system planning cost, wind curtailment quantity and the like, provides detailed information of operating points of the power system, and searches for the optimal occupation ratio of each type of power supply by using multiple times of simulation after updating parameters.
assignees: UNIV HUBEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power grid energy management method and system based on digital twinning and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid energy management method, a system and terminal equipment based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out data acquisition on power grid equipment of a power grid system to obtain operation data of the power grid equipment, carrying out virtual modeling according to the operation data of the power grid equipment to obtain a virtual power grid system, generating an initial scheduling scheme according to the operation data of the power grid equipment, sending the initial scheduling scheme to the virtual power grid system for operation to obtain an initial operation result, evaluating an evaluation model, adjusting the initial scheduling scheme according to the evaluation result to generate a final scheduling scheme, and controlling the power grid equipment according to the final scheduling scheme; the initial scheduling scheme is sent to the virtual power grid system to operate, an initial operation result is obtained, the initial operation result is sent to the evaluation model to be evaluated, an evaluation result is obtained, whether the initial scheduling scheme needs to be adjusted or not is judged according to the evaluation result, and therefore the final scheduling scheme is determined, and accuracy of the scheduling scheme can be improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method, device and equipment for generating basin flood beach disaster relief scheme based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for generating a basin flood beach disaster relief scheme based on digital twins. The method comprises the following steps: determining a corresponding flood plain area in the flow field based on a digital twin simulation model; determining a disaster risk level corresponding to the flood plain area based on the flood plain area water flow corresponding to the flood plain area; and determining a disaster relief scheme corresponding to the flood plain area based on the disaster risk level corresponding to the flood plain area through the digital twin simulation model. The method and the device solve the technical problem that the flood beach disaster relief scheme cannot be quickly and accurately generated based on the real-time condition in the related technology.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Micro-grid group self-healing decision method and system based on state estimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of micro-grids, and discloses a micro-grid group self-healing decision method and a system based on state estimation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a micro-grid group model, acquiring the running state of a micro-grid in the micro-grid group model, if the running state of the micro-grid is a fault state, establishing a plurality of target optimized power supply path recovery models by taking minimum voltage deviation, minimum load loss and minimum distributed power loss as targets, and determining constraint conditions, solving a plurality of target optimized power supply path recovery models to obtain an optimal solution, and taking the optimal solution as a corresponding micro-grid expert self-healing strategy to recover power supply operation of the micro-grid in a fault state according to the micro-grid group expert self-healing strategy, thereby improving the power supply reliability of the micro-grid group, minimizing distributed power supply loss and improving the energy utilization rate of the micro-grid group.

title_en: Power grid load prediction method based on GRU-TCN model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid load prediction method based on a GRU-TCN model, which comprises the following steps: s1: load data of each device in the power grid on the forecast day are collected to form a load data group with time as a sequence S2: normalizing the collected load data to enlarge the load data group Obtaining a normalized load prediction data set; s3: the load prediction data set is input into the GRU-TCN model,outputting a load predicted value of each time interval of the power grid; s4: establishing a digital twin power grid, inputting a load predicted value into the digital twin power grid, and outputting a real load value; and correcting the control parameters of the digital twin power grid. The invention integrates a Time Convolution Network (TCN) and a Gated Recursion Unit (GRU) network to design a GRU-TCN prediction model, and high-dimensional data characteristics extracted by the TCN network model are input into the GRU network for prediction, so that a high-precision prediction result can be obtained.
assignees: INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Distributed state estimation method, system and device for power distribution network and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a device and a storage medium for estimating a distributed state of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: calculating the electrical distance between nodes of the target power distribution network to generate an electrical distance set; partitioning a target power distribution network by a clustering algorithm based on an electrical distance set to generate sub-regions, and determining in-region nodes of each sub-region, wherein the in-region nodes comprise region adjacent nodes and non-region adjacent nodes; obtaining the quantity measurement of the nodes in each sub-area, inputting the quantity measurement into a pre-constructed state estimation model, and performing iterative solution to obtain the state variables of the nodes in the area; in the iterative solution process, the state variables of the area adjacent nodes of each sub-area obtained by each iteration are interacted, and the state variables of the area adjacent nodes are updated; the invention can effectively improve the precision and speed of state estimation.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Wind power plant wind power prediction method
abstract_en: A wind power plant wind power prediction method collects historical wind speed, air temperature and air humidity data of a wind power plant, abnormal data and missing data in a database are processed by adopting a differential algorithm, and accuracy and integrity of the data are improved. And introducing optimized meteorological data such as wind speed, air temperature and air humidity of the wind power plant as input of the combined prediction model, and effectively improving the wind speed prediction precision by combining the combined prediction model with the insect-saving optimization algorithm. The wind power is obtained by introducing the wind speed value and combining with a standard power characteristic curve of the wind turbine generator, the wind power is calculated according to the standard power characteristic curve corresponding to the specific fan model, the wind power values of the wind power field are obtained by accumulating the power of each fan of the wind power field, and the short-term wind power prediction precision is improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance system based on digital twins, which takes a BIM (building information modeling) model of a transformer substation as input and simulates a three-dimensional model and panoramic monitoring data of the transformer substation through a digital space in computer software; the intelligent operation and maintenance system comprises a data acquisition server connected with the monitoring system, the auxiliary control system and the remote inspection system; the data acquisition server performs associated measurement and monitoring on the transformer substation subjected to simulation through the monitoring system, the auxiliary control system and the remote inspection system, establishes a twin object matched with a physical power grid in a digital space, constructs a service scene model comprising power grid resources, equipment assets, spatial information and typical operation and inspection in the twin object, and outputs the service scene model to each stage in a form of one-figure multi-state power grid one-figure. The method can be applied to realizing the universe perception of the transformer substation, the universal object interconnection, the popular calculation, the intelligent control and the data driving.
assignees: SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD;XIONGAN NEW AREA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Power grid fault analysis method, system, equipment and medium based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid fault analysis method, system, equipment and medium based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical fault data under different fault types in the power grid operation process, and constructing a power grid digital twinning system framework; training a convolution cyclic neural network model by using historical fault data based on a power grid digital twin system framework until the model is converged, and generating a fault prediction model; and inputting the power grid operation data to be predicted into the fault prediction model, outputting a fault prediction result, and matching different fault processing schemes according to the fault grade of the fault prediction result. The method is based on a power grid digital twin system framework, a fault prediction model is trained on the basis of a convolution cyclic neural network, and the accuracy of a fault prediction result is improved; by providing different fault treatment schemes for the supervisory personnel according to different fault levels, the efficiency of fault treatment is improved, and the safety and the stability of the operation of the power grid are maintained.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-dimensional comprehensive benefit evaluation method and system for intelligent power distribution network and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating multi-dimensional comprehensive benefits of an intelligent power distribution network, and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a coordination control strategy of new energy and controllable resources of the power distribution network; determining a first operation model corresponding to the first equipment and a second operation model corresponding to the second equipment; monitoring the target load voltage of the power grid in real time and determining a voltage global optimal control strategy through a power grid state estimation algorithm; according to a new energy and controllable resource coordination control strategy and a voltage global optimal control strategy of the power distribution network, equipment operation state information and comprehensive benefit information of the power distribution network are displayed in an integrated mode, and data acquisition and equipment layout strategy information is generated according to the equipment operation state information and the comprehensive benefit information of the power distribution network. The invention integrates two different control strategies, determines the comprehensive benefit information of the power distribution network from multiple dimensions, and reduces the fault probability of the power distribution network equipment in actual operation and the operation efficiency of the power distribution network equipment.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network typical fault risk sensing method, power distribution network, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network typical fault risk perception method, a power distribution network, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network risk assessment. The invention comprises the following steps: acquiring historical monitoring data and real-time operation data of a power distribution network regulation background information system; performing wavelet transformation on the acquired historical monitoring data and real-time operation data, and extracting fault characteristics; creating a typical fault set according to the extracted fault characteristics, and constructing a digital twin intelligent brain fault judgment body; and inputting the measured data of the power distribution network into the constructed digital twin intelligent brain fault judgment body, and extracting the characteristics of the digital twin intelligent brain fault judgment body to obtain a fault diagnosis result. The invention realizes the risk perception of the power distribution network, effectively improves the benefit of planning and maintaining the operation of the power distribution network, ensures the stable operation of the power distribution network and reduces the power failure loss and the equipment loss.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Online updating method for parallel local model of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides an online updating method of a parallel local model of a power system, which comprises the following steps: (1) Judging whether a certain moment needs to be updated or not based on the matching degree index; (2) Judging the updating mode of the parallel local model for a certain operation scene to be evaluated; (3) The method for the key sampling of the performance of the machine learning model in the key area is improved, and the method for efficiently supplementing the samples based on the softening samples and the countermeasure generation network GAN is provided. When the machine learning evaluation model is applied online and needs to be updated, the method can improve the generation efficiency of the sample, so that the online updating efficiency of the data-driven model is accelerated.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Digital twin simulation system and method of power network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin simulation system and a method of a power network, wherein the system comprises: the sensing module is used for collecting real-time monitoring data of a physical entity of the universe of the power grid; the modeling module is used for constructing a digital twin model by combining model driven modeling and data driven modeling according to the real-time monitoring data; the simulation module is used for inputting the real-time monitoring data and the historical monitoring data into the digital twin model, and performing simulation analysis on the real-time monitoring data and the historical monitoring data by adopting a machine learning algorithm to obtain the predicted running state data of the physical entity; and the regulation and control module is used for comparing the predicted operation state data of the physical entity with preset standard operation state data, generating an operation control strategy of the power network according to a comparison result, and performing operation control management on the power network by using the operation control strategy. The invention can effectively improve the operation scheduling efficiency of the power network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Transformer area abnormal line loss identification method based on Pix2Pix network and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a station area abnormal line loss identification method based on a Pix2Pix network and deep learning, and relates to the field of low-voltage power distribution; the method comprises the steps that double-layer model recognition is adopted, an upper layer model aims at a distribution network system with incomplete observation data, a generated countermeasure network is improved as a core, and a platform area active power distribution recognition model is constructed and used for detecting abnormal line loss events; after the abnormal line loss event is confirmed, calling a lower layer model according to the event property to further identify the electricity consumption data of the users under the nodes, and judging which users in the lower layer area have electricity stealing behaviors; and finally, integrating the recognition results of the upper layer model and the lower layer model to obtain an abnormal line loss recognition result.
assignees: ZHANGYE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent completion method and device for power grid missing data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrical engineering, and particularly relates to an intelligent complement method and device for power grid missing data. The method comprises the steps of extracting complete sample data, carrying out random deletion processing, marking a deletion area, constructing a global deletion data set and a complete data set, obtaining a local deletion data set based on the marking ranges of the global deletion data set and the deletion area, carrying out global complementation on the deletion area based on the global deletion data set to obtain global complementation data, carrying out local complementation on the deletion area based on the local deletion data set to obtain local complementation data, inputting the global complementation data and the local complementation data into a discriminator for identification, alternately training a global generator, a local generator and a discriminator to generate a global-local generation countermeasure network, and carrying out complementation on the power grid deletion area based on the global-local generation countermeasure network. According to the invention, a local complement branch is added into the traditional countermeasure generation network, so that the accuracy and continuity of complement are improved.

title_en: Digital twin-based watershed flood beach disaster risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based method and a digital twin-based device for evaluating risks of flood area flood beach disasters, and relates to the technical field of evaluation of simulation disaster risks of flood area flood beach. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical hydrological information and real-time hydrological information of a drainage basin; processing historical hydrological information based on a digital twin simulation model to obtain N flood plain point positions of a drainage basin; determining the risk probability of the N overflowing beach point positions with overflowing beach disasters based on the water level overflowing beach influence factors of the N overflowing beach point positions; determining target flood plain point positions according to the risk probability to generate corresponding flood plain paths, and determining flood plain time corresponding to each target flood plain point position based on real-time hydrologic information; and evaluating the flood beach disaster risk level of the drainage basin based on the flood beach path, the flood beach time and the facility information corresponding to the flood beach path. The method solves the technical problem that the prior art cannot accurately evaluate the flood beach disaster risk level of the drainage basin.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG HYDROLOGY AND WATER RESOURCES BUREAU

title_en: Intelligent generation management system for power grid operation ticket based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent generation of power grid operation tickets, and particularly discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent generation management system of power grid operation tickets. The intelligent generation management system for the power grid operation ticket based on the digital twin comprises a substation digital twin model construction module, a substation steady-state temperature analysis module, a substation basic operation data acquisition module, a substation operation data simulation module, a substation equipment operation assessment analysis module, a power information base and a substation operation ticket automatic generation feedback module; the method effectively solves the problem that the current operation ticket generation mode lacks analysis on the level of operators and the level of operation sequence, realizes double analysis on the level of operation sequence and the level of operators, ensures the operation standardization and the operation smoothness of the equipment required to be operated by the appointed transformer substation, and simultaneously ensures the operation effect and the operation accuracy of the follow-up equipment required to be operated.

title_en: Real-time sensing and online evaluation method and system based on wide area measurement data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system automation, and relates to a real-time sensing and online evaluation method, system and readable medium based on wide area measurement data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring wide-area measurement synchronous phasor data, preprocessing the synchronous phasor data, and acquiring effective synchronous phasor data; the contact state of each node of the power grid is obtained through power grid topological structure analysis, and the real-time comprehensive state evaluation of the power grid is carried out by combining the power grid topological structure analysis, so that dynamic load flow calculation based on the power grid topological structure analysis and the comprehensive state evaluation is realized; and evaluating the steady state of the regional voltage according to the result of the dynamic power flow calculation. The system acquires wide area measurement data of the power grid PMU equipment in real time, preprocesses the real-time measurement data and judges the data quality; and further realizing real-time dynamic load flow calculation of topology analysis and comprehensive state estimation, and performing transient voltage safety and stability state evaluation through load flow calculation data.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Transformer substation control cabinet humidity monitoring and risk early warning system based on digital twinborn
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transformer substation control cabinet humidity monitoring and risk early warning system based on digital twins, which comprises a data acquisition module and a risk assessment module, wherein the data acquisition module comprises an in-cabinet humidity acquisition module and an out-cabinet humidity acquisition module, the in-cabinet humidity acquisition module is used for acquiring an in-cabinet humidity value of a transformer substation control cabinet, and the out-cabinet humidity acquisition module is used for acquiring an out-cabinet humidity value of the transformer substation control cabinet; the risk assessment module includes: a communication module; the parameter setting module is used for acquiring and setting the operation parameters of the whole system; the risk evaluation module is used for substituting the humidity value in the cabinet and the humidity value outside the cabinet into a risk evaluation model to simulate and calculate the humidity state, the dehumidifier state and the dehumidifier performance of the substation control cabinet; and the early warning feedback module is used for sending early warning information according to the calculation result of the risk assessment module. Compared with the prior art, the alarm device can flexibly give an alarm to workers, and has the advantages of low power consumption, wide coverage, high capacity, low cost and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Generator state estimation method suitable for non-Gaussian noise
abstract_en: The invention discloses a generator state estimation method suitable for non-Gaussian noise based on a self-adaptive Cauchy kernel correlation entropy loss criterion, which comprises the following steps: (1) Initializing each parameter of the generator state estimation; (2) Constructing a DOS network attack model and judging whether the DOS network attack occurs or not; (3) Calculating state prediction values Sum error covariance matrix (ii) a (4) Calculating the measurement prediction value Sum cross covariance matrix (ii) a (5) Calculating state gain and state estimation value And state estimation error covariance (ii) a (6) And (5) carrying out iterative calculation of the next moment according to the steps (3) to (5) until the loop is ended, and outputting a state estimation result. According to the method, a Cauchy's nucleus correlation entropy loss criterion (CMC) is combined with a Cubature Kalman Filtering (CKF) framework, and the defects of low estimation precision and low robustness of a traditional state estimation method in a non-Gaussian noise environment and DOS network attack are overcome.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Hydraulic balance management method based on Internet of things and edge computing technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic balance management method based on the Internet of things and an edge computing technology, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: classifying hot users in a grouping mode, interconnecting all units through a 5G technology, and performing data intercommunication and calculation on all units by taking 0 as a reference; the flow of an inlet and an outlet and the temperature difference of indoor and outdoor environments are monitored in real time, and the flow of an inlet and an outlet regulating valve under the condition of different temperature differences is corrected through a PID control algorithm; the method comprises the steps that local storage and cloud storage functions are designed by taking a group as a unit, comparison is carried out on the local calculation result and a cloud database, the group is taken as a unit, a plurality of groups are connected in series to realize a regional digital management model based on the heat supply range of a pump station, the actual production quantity of the single group is matched with the calculated quantity of the regional digital model, and the digital twin technology and the local actual management data are combined to realize the matching of the output power of the pump station and the use power of a user. The invention can solve the problem of networking calculation among multi-floor and multi-user hot user groups.
assignees: JIANGSU CHENGGONG VALVE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Deep learning-based large-scale wind power cluster oscillation source positioning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale wind power cluster oscillation source positioning method and device based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining PMU data of each wind power cluster and state estimation data based on the PMU as input data; converting input data into a two-dimensional image; constructing a sample set and a sub-sample set according to the two-dimensional image; and constructing and training a coarse-grained and fine-grained hierarchical convolutional neural network according to the sample set and the sub-sample set, and positioning the wind power cluster oscillation source. The method considers the phenomenon of instability of the wind power grid-connected system caused by dynamic interaction among a plurality of wind power clusters, can identify and accurately position a plurality of oscillation sources, and is suitable for complex and changeable operation scenes of the wind power grid-connected system.
assignees: JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Robust state estimation method for electrical comprehensive energy system based on MES
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric comprehensive energy system robust state estimation method based on MES, which adopts a power grid state estimation SE method to respectively establish a steady state model for a power grid, a gas grid and a coupling element, takes a power grid node voltage modulus value, a phase angle and a gas grid node pressure square as state quantities, establishes an electric-gas coupling network state estimation SE model based on the MES on the basis of the MES estimation method and in consideration of zero injection constraint and boundary constraint of the power grid and the gas grid, and carries out global unified coordination state estimation SE on the electric-gas coupling network, and has the advantages that: the electric-gas coupling network can realize global unified coordination SE, obtain global consistent solution of the electric-gas coupling network, and has better effect than single estimation; and at the coupling boundary of the power grid and the gas grid, the bad data of the boundary node can be effectively identified by utilizing the coupling relation.
assignees: JINGMEN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV

title_en: Riverbed change simulation deduction method, device and equipment based on three-dimensional scene model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river bed change simulation deduction method, a device and equipment based on a three-dimensional scene model, and relates to the field of river basin digital twin, wherein the simulation deduction method comprises the steps of collecting river basin data of a target river basin, establishing the three-dimensional scene model based on the river basin data, carrying out river bed change deduction by adopting the three-dimensional scene model based on river sand siltation volume change data established by hydrologic data monitoring information, and adjusting river bed height parameters in the three-dimensional scene model according to siltation volume parameters in the river sand siltation volume change data under the condition of river bed change deduction. The method solves the technical problem that in the related art, a three-dimensional scene model capable of dynamically deducting the change of the river bed cannot be established, so that timely early warning of disasters cannot be carried out.

title_en: Power load prediction model construction method and construction device based on digital twins
abstract_en: Provided herein are a method of constructing a prediction model of an electric power load and a construction apparatus based on a digital twin, wherein the method includes: acquiring historical influence factors of a target area; carrying out normalization processing on historical influence factors; substituting the processed historical influence factors into a preset coupling model to obtain coupling data; inputting the coupling data into a neural network model to obtain a predicted value of the neural network model; establishing a target function and a constraint condition of the target function according to the predicted value and the corresponding power load actual value; optimizing the objective function through an optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal solution of the objective function; respectively taking the weight and the bias corresponding to the optimal solution as the optimal weight and the optimal bias of the neural network model; and determining the optimized neural network model as a prediction model of the power load according to the optimal weight and the optimal bias. The future power load condition of the power system can be predicted by the aid of the built prediction model.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twin system of new equipment on-line commissioning base
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grids, and discloses a new device grid-connected commissioning base digital twin system, which comprises: the acquisition module is used for acquiring various data of the base, including satellite remote sensing data and base point cloud data of the surrounding environment; the digital twin module comprises a data storage unit, a data processing unit, a modeling unit and a digital twin unit, wherein the data processing unit is used for processing various collected data, including processing base point cloud data to form 3DMAX refined model data; the modeling unit is used for constructing a BIM model and a new equipment model; the digital twin unit is used for forming a base three-dimensional digital model; the personalized operation module comprises a map marking unit and a viewpoint navigation unit; the system improves the accuracy of data acquisition and can acquire and monitor various relevant data of the base more comprehensively.

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method based on data dimension reduction and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network state estimation method based on data dimension reduction and a related device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing dimensionality reduction processing on the high-dimensional measurement data of the power distribution network by adopting a preset elastic network algorithm, and selecting the dimensionality reduction measurement data; respectively constructing a measurement correlation function and a pseudo measurement correlation function according to the dimension reduction measurement data based on the measurement error; constructing a measurement data filling cost function according to the measurement correlation function and the pseudo measurement correlation function based on a weighted least square method, and filling the dimension reduction measurement data according to the measurement data filling cost function to obtain filling measurement data; adopting a preset neural network to carry out mapping training on the filling measurement data to obtain optimized measurement data, wherein the preset neural network comprises a complexity optimization function; and (4) taking the optimized measurement data as an initial condition, and estimating the state of the power distribution network by a Gauss-Newton iteration method to obtain a state estimation result. The method and the device can solve the technical problems that the dimensionality of the measured data is too high in the prior art, and the traditional method cannot meet the current requirements.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Artificial intelligence efficient recovery and completion method for earthquake missing signals
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence efficient recovery and completion method for earthquake missing signals, which comprises the following steps: s1, making a training data set by using the existing seismic data; s2, building a Transformer network for processing the pixel value; s3, training the network by using the data set in the step 1, outputting the accuracy and the related evaluation standard after each epoch is trained, storing the model updating result, and finally evaluating the effect of the model; and S4, using the trained model for completing missing data, wherein in the completing process, the source data needs to be cut into small blocks with the size of 48x48, and finally the cut data can be spliced to the corresponding position of the original data.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RES INSTITUTE UESTC HUZHOU;UESTC

title_en: Intelligent data management platform based on multidimensional engine, construction method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent data management platform based on a multidimensional engine, a construction method and application, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of establishing information acquisition equipment to acquire real-time analysis data in the fields of rail transit, national power grids, smart cities and natural environment monitoring; a data processing module is constructed, and multidimensional processing is carried out on real-time analysis data in the fields of rail transit, national power grids, smart cities and natural environment monitoring; and sequentially building a digital twin engine group, a behavior analysis engine group, an object detection engine group and an environment monitoring engine group. The invention utilizes the multidimensional engine to construct the intelligent data management platform, can cover multidimensional data, has wide data comprehensiveness, and further ensures that the constructed data management platform has wide applicability and strong mobility.
assignees: CHENGDU CHINA METRO TRACK EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Charging terminal equipment health state evaluation method based on width learning and K-means
abstract_en: The method for evaluating the health state of the charging terminal equipment based on width learning and K-means comprises the following steps of 1) configuring a charging terminal network by utilizing an electric energy acquisition terminal; 2) Establishing a health state evaluation model of the charging terminal equipment for the charging battery; 3) Performing dynamic self-learning adjustment of the model according to the equipment data; 4) Establishing a health evaluation model of the charging terminal equipment; 5) And (3) calculating the health level of the charging terminal equipment according to the K-means evaluation model, finding out a charging terminal node corresponding to the health level through the configuration model in the step (1), and giving different processing suggestions according to different health levels. The configuration number of the electric energy acquisition terminals is reduced through the electric energy acquisition terminal configuration model, the cost is saved, the health state of the rechargeable battery is evaluated through width learning, meanwhile, a weighting network is introduced to realize real-time updating of the width learning model, and finally, the health evaluation model of the rechargeable terminal equipment is established through the K-means model.
assignees: YANCHENG ZHONGKE GAOTONGLIANG COMPUTING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Nonferrous metal industry electric carbon data matching early warning method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nonferrous metal industry electric carbon data matching early warning method based on a BP neural network; which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of (1) obtaining elements influencing carbon emission in the nonferrous metal industry; (2) Preprocessing the obtained input sample data, supplementing missing data, rejecting abnormal data, and manually labeling labels, wherein the labels are divided into normal and early warning types; (3) Dividing the obtained sample data influencing the carbon emission of the nonferrous metal industry in the region into a modeling set and a prediction set by using an SPXY method; (4) establishing a BP neural network based on a newff function; (5) Training and predicting power data samples used by different parameter backgrounds by using a BP neural network; (6) Inputting new parameters, early warning carbon emission data of the nonferrous metal industry in the region by applying the technical scheme, and starting early warning when the carbon emission data predicted by the model exceeds a certain set value.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive energy state estimation method and system based on KNN algorithm
abstract_en: A comprehensive energy state estimation method and system based on a KNN algorithm comprises the following steps: acquiring measurement data based on network topology information and line parameters in the comprehensive energy system; filling the quantity measurement missing in the comprehensive energy system by adopting a KNN algorithm based on the quantity measurement data to obtain complete quantity measurement data; inputting the complete quantity measurement data into a pre-constructed comprehensive energy state estimation model to obtain the state quantity of the comprehensive energy system; the comprehensive energy state estimation model is constructed based on a comprehensive energy network energy flow model and a comprehensive energy multi-energy flow coupling equipment model in combination with a weighted least square algorithm; the network topology information includes: topology of the grid, heat supply network and gas network; according to the method, more precise data missing and filling are established, the guarantee is provided for the safe and reliable operation of the comprehensive energy system, the state estimation of the comprehensive energy system is considered from the perspective of measuring data sources, and the data accuracy and the overall tolerance of the system are improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Operating state display system, control method, and program
abstract_en: To grasp an overall image of a recovery target from the beginning of disaster.SOLUTION: An operating state display system (100) includes: a target facility state acquisition unit (10) that acquires an operating state automatically collected from a monitored facility which is an elevator facility that can be remotely monitored; a non-target facility state acquisition unit (11) that acquires an operating state manually input which is an operating state of a non-monitored facility which is an elevator facility that cannot be remotely monitored; a non-target facility state estimation unit (52) that estimates an operating state of the non-monitored facility; and a display control unit (12) that displays on a display unit a display screen (700) in which an operating state of the elevator facility is superimposed on a map of an area including a location of the elevator facility. The operating state includes at least normal operation and stopping. The display control unit displays, in a distinguishable display mode, a case where the operating state indicates normal operation, a case where the automatically collected operating state indicates stopping, a case where the manually input operating state indicates stopping, and a case where the estimated operating state indicates stopping.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 22
assignees: FUJITEC KK

title_en: A digital twin system for predicting response of structures to natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a computer-based digital twin system for predicting the response of a structure (200) to natural disasters.
