Accordingly, it is characterized in that it comprises a plurality of structure sensors (210) to detect at least one structure parameter of the multiple components; at least one environmental sensor (220) to measure at least one environmental parameter; an information processing device (100) configured to receive the signals generated regarding the measurements made by the said environmental sensor (220) and the said structure sensors (210); the said information processing device (100) comprises an information processing device (100) configured to access a virtual structure model (500) of the structure (200) and simulate the responses of the components of the said structure (200) in the real world according to the said structure parameters and environmental parameters in the said virtual structure model (500); the said information processing device (100) is configured to access a trained machine learning model using the environmental parameter measurements and the structure parameters measurements at the time these parameters are measured; to apply the test environment parameter values, which are in magnitude measured when the natural disaster occurs and are predetermined, to the machine learning model as input and to determine the damage status of the structure (200) according to the response structure parameters of the machine learning model to this and to simulate the response structure parameters in the virtual structure model (500).
assignees: EROL EDA

title_en: Digital twin-based intelligent power grid deduction system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a because of digital twin wisdom electric wire netting deduction system, relates to wisdom electric wire netting's technical field, and its structure is: the system comprises a 3D visual power grid monitoring subsystem, a power grid deduction intelligent judgment subsystem and a voice command intelligent checking subsystem. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the method comprises the steps of three-dimensional information presentation, service integrated management and multi-dimensional auxiliary management, panoramic coverage of different levels of a power grid is realized, specific service requirements of power grid lines, management adjusting equipment, load properties, trend of power flow, power grid planning and the like are met, the working efficiency is improved, a digital twin system can support the power grid dispatching management more accurately, comprehensively and intelligently, meanwhile, requirements of voice order adjustment error correction, personnel training improvement and the like in work are digitally upgraded, the working efficiency is improved, the working accuracy is improved, and the method is combined with the digital twin system to realize unified management of digital twin.
assignees: HAIBEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Low-voltage transformer area line loss estimation method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage transformer area line loss estimation method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of firstly, collecting historical operating data of a transformer area, carrying out multi-dimensional relevance analysis on a data set, and obtaining an optimal characteristic parameter set; then constructing a multi-port GRU network structure capable of extracting time sequence data characteristics and a ResNet structure capable of deeply extracting data characteristics to form a deep neural network model, and defining a fitting target of the deep neural network; training by using a training data set constructed based on the optimal characteristic parameter set, and testing by using a test data set; and finally deploying and putting into use. The method can accurately estimate the theoretical line loss of the low-voltage transformer area with untimely and incomplete observation information, and improve the calculation speed and the calculation accuracy; meanwhile, feature extraction is carried out on the collected historical data, data dimension reduction is achieved, and calculation cost is reduced.
assignees: ZHANGYE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Power utilization management method and system based on MEC edge intelligent gateway
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electricity management method and system based on an MEC edge intelligent gateway, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting power utilization information of a user based on a power management system of the user side; transmitting the electricity utilization information to an MEC edge intelligent gateway, and analyzing the electricity utilization information by the MEC edge intelligent gateway by adopting a user electricity utilization behavior model to obtain electricity utilization behavior characteristics of a user; the MEC edge intelligent gateway constructs a user model according to the electricity utilization information and the electricity utilization behavior characteristics, and synchronizes the user model to the cloud end through a digital twinning technology; the cloud end classifies user behaviors according to all the user models, manages the same power utilization strategy for the users with the same attribute, and transmits the corresponding power utilization strategy back to the power management system of the user end. And the electricity utilization condition of the user is divided in a fine-grained manner based on the electricity utilization behavior characteristics of the user, so that the electricity utilization requirement of the user is accurately optimized.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ROBUSTEL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent agent and power grid environment interactive learning system and method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an interactive learning system and method for an intelligent agent and a power grid environment and a storage medium. The method can effectively reuse high-level application software such as state estimation, dispatcher load flow calculation and the like in the regulation and control system, reduces modeling complexity, enables an intelligent agent training environment to be closer to a real power grid environment, and improves accuracy.
assignees: JINZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for identifying upstream and downstream hydrologic stations of river channel based on existing GIS data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying upstream and downstream hydrologic stations of a river channel based on existing GIS data, and belongs to the field of hydrologic information digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of searching any number of stations on the upstream and downstream of a river channel corresponding to a given station according to the coordinate GIS data of the hydrological station and a river network vector diagram, displaying a topological relation diagram of the upstream and downstream stations of the given station, judging whether other stations are located on the upstream of the given station and in the upstream river basin main stream and the downstream river basin tributary, and storing the topological relation of the upstream and downstream stations and the river network side table in a text file for subsequent analysis. According to the invention, only two layer files are constructed based on the existing GIS data, namely, the upstream and downstream hydrologic stations of the river channel can be identified, the workload of manually searching the upstream and downstream hydrologic stations of the specific station can be greatly saved, and the method has high accuracy and high running speed for large-scale river networks and station layer diagrams and can be used as a favorable foundation for river network digital twinning.

title_en: Contact net galloping monitoring method and system based on digital twin simulation model
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for monitoring galloping of a contact net based on a digital twin simulation model, which comprises the following steps: arranging a plurality of sensors and image acquisition devices on the contact network, and acquiring environmental data and video data of the conducting wire; acquiring the position of the central outline of the wire, and calculating the actual dominant frequency and amplitude of the wire waving; constructing a digital twin simulation model, simulating to obtain theoretical main frequency and amplitude of conductor galloping, and correcting parameter setting of the digital twin simulation model based on actual values of the main frequency and the amplitude; and inputting the amplitude into a digital twin simulation model to obtain an arrangement scheme of the anti-galloping device, and installing the anti-galloping device on the contact net. The application also discloses a system for monitoring the galloping of the contact net based on the digital twin body simulation model. The invention can monitor the galloping state in real time, predict the galloping state of the contact net according to the weather forecast, and give alarm information if the monitoring data and the prediction result exceed the warning value, so that processing measures are made in advance to avoid causing serious influence.
assignees: CN RAILWAY SIYUAN SURVEY & DES

title_en: Coal mine disaster data processing method, device and system
abstract_en: The application provides a coal mine disaster data processing method, a device and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring original data, and filtering the original data to obtain filtered original data; screening the filtered original data to obtain a disaster data set; and processing the disaster data set by adopting the optimized particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain missing data, wherein the missing data is data corresponding to the ongoing disaster and the imminent disaster which are not existed in the disaster data set but are on the coal mine site. The accuracy of prediction of subsequent missing data can be improved through filtering, the processing amount of subsequent disaster data sets is reduced through screening, the disaster data sets are processed through the optimized particle swarm optimization algorithm, the missing data are obtained, and therefore the problem that the accuracy of prediction of the missing disaster data in the prior art is low is solved.
assignees: GUONENG WUHAI ENERGY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;CHN ENERGY WUHAI ENERGY CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Wind power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method and a wind power prediction system, and belongs to the technical field of new energy power generation prediction. Deleting abnormal data, filling missing data, performing cluster analysis on preprocessed data by using a hierarchical clustering method, inputting the data subjected to cluster analysis into a long-term and short-term memory neural network, performing autonomous training on the long-term and short-term memory neural network, and adjusting weights of the neural network by using an improved Adam-SGD method to obtain an ultra-short-term power prediction model based on the long-term and short-term memory neural network. According to the method, the rapid convergence of the calculation example can be realized by improving the Adam method, and then the global optimum point can be effectively searched by improving the SGD method, so that the generated energy can be more accurately predicted, and the learning and prediction can be effectively carried out according to the historical information, so that a better prediction effect is obtained, the power prediction precision is improved, the new energy consumption is promoted, and the abandoned wind is reduced.
assignees: GD WIND POWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin engine, information physical system and equipment management method
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin engine, an information physical system and a device management method, which relate to the field of electric power.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA POWER INF TECH

title_en: Switching operation identification method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric power, and provides a switching operation identification method and device based on digital twins, computer equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product. According to the method and the device, the accuracy and the efficiency of the switching operation identification result of the determined equipment can be improved. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a device switching operation signal, determining an operation signal source device corresponding to the device switching operation signal, using a target image acquisition device corresponding to the target device as a target device, acquiring an image of the target device, performing image identification on the image to obtain a switching operation image identification result of the target device, and determining the switching operation identification result of the target device according to measuring point information of the target device and the switching operation image identification result.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CORP EXTRA HIGH VOLTAGE POWER TRANS CO KUNMING BUREAU

title_en: Load prediction method for key industrial equipment based on BI-LSTM
abstract_en: The invention relates to a load prediction algorithm of key industrial equipment based on BI-LSTM, which comprises the following steps: acquiring power data of key industrial equipment as input of a neural network model structure; preprocessing historical data, removing abnormal data and supplementing missing data; normalizing the preprocessed data; setting parameters of Dropout, and randomly neglecting a set proportion characteristic detector; building a bidirectional long-short term memory neural network structure, and optimizing by updating and adjusting various parameter settings; and performing data evaluation on the prediction result, and quantitatively analyzing the prediction result. The invention can effectively filter the noise and adverse effect components of the data set, effectively realize the prediction of the power of the important industrial equipment and improve the prediction precision by pre-preprocessing the power data of the important industrial equipment and based on the BI-LSTM model structure of the improved traditional LSTM structure.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent risk emergency disposal method and system, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a risk intelligent emergency disposal method, a system, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring emergency risk information of a corresponding line or a plant station according to real equipment fault information based on a topological structure of a digital twin power system; updating a historical risk plan of an emergency risk library by using the emergency risk information; acquiring equipment operation monitoring data, and calculating the real-time fault probability and the probability grade of the equipment as a fault result; and matching the fault result with an emergency risk library to generate an intelligent emergency disposal scheme and intelligently issue real-time risks. According to the method and the device, a risk assessment real-time scheme is generated based on the fault probability, the risk emergency disposal of the extreme event caused after large-scale new energy grid connection is considered, the application range is wide, the intelligent degree is high, the emergency efficiency is improved, and the emergency disposal energy efficiency is enhanced.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power system inertia continuous evaluation method considering uncertainty system identification
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps that an uncertainty system identification-considered power system inertia continuous evaluation method is used for preprocessing frequency and power data in a real-time acquisition system based on a phasor acquisition unit (PMU) and establishing an evaluation data set; according to a frequency dynamic characteristic equation, establishing a system inertia identification model by adopting a traditional output error model; aiming at the inertia parameter problem of the established system inertia identification model, the uncertainty of input and output data is considered, and the system inertia identification under the condition of uncertain input and output data is realized by adopting robust model optimization solution. The power system inertia continuous evaluation method considering the uncertainty system identification better processes the uncertainty of the identification data, the real-time update model result is closer to the actual value, and the identification precision is ensured.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: New energy automobile charging pile background rapid management system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy automobile charging pile background quick management system and a method thereof, and particularly relates to the technical field of data processing of a management system, wherein the system comprises a new energy automobile charging pile GIS networking module, a wireless communication Bluetooth connection user mobile phone module, a data encryption management and control module, an encrypted data transmission cloud server management module, a visual digital twin model module for constructing new energy automobile charging pile networking through cloud computing, a cloud storage user data and new energy automobile charging pile background operation data module, and a visual data feedback mobile phone display module; the method adopts the mode that the Bluetooth of the new energy automobile charging pile is wirelessly connected with the mobile phone of the user to carry out small program charging, positioning and information recording, replaces the modes of reading, initializing and information writing of an IC card, achieves the purposes of saving the operation cost of a background quick management system of the new energy automobile charging pile and improving the efficiency of data reading.
assignees: ANHUI POWERVENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Online state estimation and topology identification using advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) measurements
abstract_en: A computer system provides online state estimation (SE) and topology identification (TI) using advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) measurements in a distribution network. The computer system obtains input data including the AMI measurements, a network configuration, and line parameters; solves an SE and TI problem formulated from the input data and power equations of the distribution network; and periodically updates states and topology of the distribution network during power system operation. To solve the SE and TI problem, the computer system constructs a mixed-integer convex approximation programming (MICP) model to obtain an initial topology; generates neighboring spanning trees according to the MICP model and the initial topology; evaluates performance of each neighboring spanning tree with a matching index that is an indication of power flow performance; and chooses a tree topology of a neighboring spanning tree having a minimum matching index as a final network topology of the distribution network.
assignees: BIGWOOD TECH INC

title_en: Utilization state estimation device, control method for utilization state estimation device, and program
abstract_en: To estimate the utilization state of a photovoltaic power generation facility without using a solar radiation amount sensor.SOLUTION: A utilization state estimation device estimates a utilization state of a photovoltaic power generation facility. The utilization state estimation device includes: a calculation formula storage section for storing a calculation formula intended to calculate an estimation value of a power generation amount of a photovoltaic power generation facility from meteorological data of prescribed kinds containing a solar radiation amount; a meteorological data acquisition section for acquiring meteorological data; a first index value calculation section for calculating a first index value expressing a level of deviation between an estimation value and an actual value, on the basis of an estimation value of a power generation amount of the photovoltaic power generation facility in a first period that is calculated using the meteorological data and the calculation formula, and an actual value of the power generation amount of the photovoltaic power generation facility in the first period, in each first period; a determination value calculation section for calculating an average value and a standard deviation of the first index value in a prescribed period of the past, to calculate a determination value on the basis of the average value and a standard deviation; and a utilization state estimation section for estimating a utilization state of the photovoltaic power generation facility on the basis of a comparison result of the first index value and the determination value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: CHUGOKU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC

title_en: Intelligent sensing method and system for power distribution network operation state of high-proportion new energy access
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent sensing method and system for the running state of a power distribution network with high-proportion new energy access, and belongs to the technical field of sensing of the running state of the power distribution network; the problem that the traditional single subjective and objective weighting method is incomplete in sensing result of the running state of the power distribution network is solved; the method comprises the following steps: establishing a random output mathematical model of a distributed wind turbine and a photovoltaic power station and a novel load mathematical model, and extracting representative typical scenes from mass original time sequence scenes of the wind turbine and the photovoltaic power station through an improved forward clustering algorithm; acquiring multisource fusion measurement data, and respectively carrying out linear and nonlinear state estimation on a power distribution network accessed by high-proportion new energy; establishing an evaluation index system of the running state of the power distribution network accessed by high-proportion new energy; weighting evaluation indexes of the running states of the power distribution network accessed by the established high-proportion new energy by utilizing an improved approach ideal solution ordering method; the invention is applied to the power distribution network.

title_en: Grid bad parameter identification and correction method based on synchronous phasor measurement
abstract_en: The invention provides a grid bad parameter identification and correction method based on synchronous phasor measurement, which can realize high-resolution real-time detection and state evaluation on a grid based on PMU (phasor measurement Unit) measured state estimation, researches a theory and a method for realizing unified identification and correction of bad parameters and bad measured values by adopting a regularized Lagrange multiplier and a residual error aiming at the problem that parameter errors and bad measured values are difficult to distinguish and identify in the PMU state estimation of a power system, and provides an improved strategy for improving the identifiability of the bad parameters.
assignees: UNIV FUZHOU;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Individualized accurate maintenance strategy based on transformer equipment operation situation perception analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an individualized accurate maintenance strategy based on operation situation perception analysis of power transformation equipment, which comprises the steps of establishing a power grid operation situation evaluation basic frame, situation understanding phase prediction and situation prediction phase prediction. The method comprises the steps of acquiring monitoring information of main and auxiliary equipment, establishing association rules among a plurality of equipment states and defects by combining regulations and expert experience and based on image recognition, intelligent reasoning, big data and other intelligent analysis technologies, and constructing a multi-physical-quantity-sensing-based active transformer equipment defect early warning mechanism by utilizing a transformer equipment state real-time early warning model, an equipment defect automatic analysis model, an equipment defect processing strategy and the like. According to the invention, the calculation result obtained by performing index analysis on the load flow calculation result has larger deviation with the true value, but the data processing and correction by adopting state estimation greatly improve the calculation precision, and the operation state of the system can be truly reflected.
assignees: PINGLIANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Highway side slope monitoring and early warning system and equipment based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a highway side slope monitoring and early warning system and equipment based on digital twinning. The system comprises: the system comprises a physical entity module, a virtual model module, a service module, a twin data module and a connection module. The real-time state of the highway side slope is efficiently reflected through the virtual digital twin body, the simulation of the whole catastrophe process, the early warning information publication and the prevention and control decision pre-modeling planning are realized, the visualization of the whole catastrophe evolution process of the three-dimensional highway side slope can be realized, the risk prediction precision of the side slope disaster is improved, and the risk prevention and control level of the highway side slope engineering is obviously improved.

title_en: Coordinated control method for gas generator set and whole gas pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coordinated control method of a gas generator set and a whole gas pipe network, which comprises the steps of establishing a basic digital twin model of the gas pipe network in a computer, introducing parameters to the basic model, correcting by adopting a multi-parameter BP neural network, judging the readiness of correction by actual measurement value and predicted value errors, obtaining a high-precision digital twin model through long-period training, measuring the total gas consumption of the gas generator set, carrying out smooth optimization on the total gas consumption to obtain the total gas consumption of the smooth gas generator set, constructing load optimization distribution of a plurality of gas generator sets by taking the total gas consumption after the smooth optimization as a reference, and constructing self-adaptive coordinated control of the gas generator set by taking the gas consumption distributed by the plurality of gas generator sets as a stable target by taking the gas pipe network pressure as a target, so as to avoid great fluctuation of the gas pipe network pressure and improve the comprehensive benefit of the gas generator set.

title_en: Thermal power generation coordinated control monitoring method and system based on slow state deviation characteristic
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermal power generation coordination control monitoring method and a system based on state deviation slow characteristics, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a regulation model and a state deviation slow characteristic model of a thermal power generation coordination control system, determining a regulation and control monitoring threshold value, inputting historical state data of an acquired unit set into the regulation model to obtain current state estimation data, inputting current state estimation deviation obtained according to acquired current state real data and current state estimation data into the state deviation slow characteristic model to obtain current state deviation slow characteristics, obtaining a normal working condition change statistical index and a real abnormal statistical index according to the current state deviation slow characteristics, and obtaining a coordination control monitoring result according to the normal working condition change statistical index, the real abnormal statistical index and the regulation and control monitoring threshold value. The invention effectively realizes global state monitoring of coordination control, automatically and accurately judges normal working condition change and real process abnormality, and provides reliable guarantee for thermal power generation.

title_en: Power system situation sensing method based on graph digital twins
abstract_en: A power system situation perception method based on graph digital twins, in particular to a novel power system graph learning situation perception method based on the digital twins, aiming at solving the problems of power system stability prediction or lower accuracy of multi-component fault location of the existing situation perception method; processing data of the energy Internet by using a graph digital twin model, and converting the processed data into a graph to obtain graph structured data; aiming at the problem of the fault of the energy Internet, a situation perception model I based on a graph neural network is constructed; aiming at the stability problem of the energy Internet, a situation awareness model II based on a graph neural network is constructed; processing the graph structured data by using a situation awareness model I based on a graph neural network to obtain the fault and the position of the energy Internet; and predicting the stability of the energy internet after the fault by using a situation perception model II based on a graph neural network according to the fault and the position and the graph of the fault.
assignees: STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HEILONGJIANG

title_en: System and method for fault diagnosis of fuel cell energy management system based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용한 연료전지 에너지 관리시스템의 이상진단 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and method for diagnosing failure in a fuel cell system which operates using a fuel cell (FC). According to the present invention, a system and method for diagnosing problems in a fuel cell energy management system using a digital twin are provided in order to solve problems of energy management systems (EMS) of a conventional art in which there are no devices or methods for immediately detecting and responding to an error or breakdown when the error or breakdown occurs in the EMS of a fuel cell system using a hybrid power source such as a fuel cell-battery-supercapacitor (FC-BAT-SC). By using digital twin (DT) technology, data obtained under normal operating conditions of an actual physical system is transmitted to a cloud to build a digital twin model. If it is determined that an error or failure occurs by comparing calculated values and actual measured values for each FC, BAT, and SC subsystem, a warning message is generated and the error or failure is notified to preset contacts. Accordingly, when the error or failure occurs in the EMS, the error or failure can be immediately detected and handled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 연료전지(Fuel Cell ; FC)를 이용하여 동작하는 연료전지 시스템의 고장을 진단하기 위한 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면, 연료전지-배터리-슈퍼커패시터(FC-BAT-SC)와 같은 하이브리드 전원을 사용하는 연료전지 시스템의 에너지 관리시스템(Energy Management System ; EMS)에 오류나 고장이 발생할시 이를 즉각적으로 감지하여 대처할 수 있도록 하는 장치나 방법이 제시된 바 없는 한계가 있었던 종래기술의 EMS들의 문제점을 해결하기 위해, 디지털 트윈(Digital Twin ; DT) 기술을 이용하여, 실제 물리적 시스템의 정상 동작조건에서 얻어진 데이터를 클라우드(Cloud)로 전송하여 디지털 트윈 모델을 구축하고, 각각의 FC, BAT, SC 서브시스템에 대한 계산값과 실제 측정값을 비교하여 오류나 고장이 발생한 것으로 판단되면 경고메시지를 발생하고 미리 설정된 연락처에 해당 사실을 알리는 처리가 수행되도록 구성됨으로써, 에너지 관리시스템(EMS)의 오류나 고장 발생시 이를 즉각적으로 감지하고 대처할 수 있도록 구성되는 디지털 트윈을 이용한 연료전지 에너지 관리시스템의 이상진단 시스템 및 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: UNIV ULSAN FOUND IND COOP

title_en: Power grid modeling method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid modeling method based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: splitting a power grid into a plurality of functional units according to a single functional principle to form a power grid physical entity model; establishing a virtual model of a physical entity; carrying out service encapsulation on various data, models, algorithms, simulation and results, establishing a service model, supporting functional services of digital twin internal function operation and realization by using tool components, middleware and module engines, and meeting business services of different users and different business requirements by using application software; establishing a data model comprising physical entity data, virtual model data, service model data, knowledge data and fusion derivative data; and establishing a connection model of the entity model, the virtual model, the service model and the data model. The invention can establish a power grid twin model conforming to power grid management operation maintenance service, establish a foundation of a power grid digital twin system and improve the power grid operation maintenance level and the intelligent level.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation power prediction method based on combined machine learning model and application thereof
abstract_en: The photovoltaic power generation power prediction method based on the combined machine learning model and the application thereof comprise the following steps: preprocessing photovoltaic output data; analyzing the characteristics of photovoltaic output data, and extracting intrinsic mode vectors and residual terms of the power data of the photovoltaic system by adopting an Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) algorithm; calculating sampling entropy SE of each eigenmode vector of the photovoltaic output data; distinguishing a trend item and a fluctuation item of the photovoltaic data, setting a threshold value by analyzing the sampling entropy of the whole photovoltaic output sequence, and superposing the eigenvector sampling entropies larger than the threshold value as the fluctuation item and superposing the eigenvector sampling entropies smaller than the threshold value as the trend item; predicting the trend item by adopting a long-short term memory (LSTM) method; and predicting the fluctuation items by adopting a Support Vector Regression (SVR) method to construct a digital twin model for photovoltaic power generation power prediction, and calculating and updating the superposition weight of the prediction data of the photovoltaic trend items and the fluctuation items in real time by using a PSO algorithm in combination with the actual power data of the photovoltaic system.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;NANJING SUYI IND CO LTD

title_en: Confined state estimation device, dispatch planning system, confined state estimation method, control method, and program
abstract_en: To estimate an occurrence state of confinement of a passenger in an elevator facility when a disaster occurs in order to support restoration work.SOLUTION: A confined state estimation device (8) includes an operation state estimation unit (81) estimating an operation state of a caution-requiring elevator facility when a caution-requiring disaster occurs according to location information showing a location of the elevator facility and disaster information including the degree of the disaster at the location, a boarding state estimation unit (82) estimating a boarding state in the caution-requiring elevator facility when the caution-requiring disaster occurs according to operation result information of the caution-requiring elevator facility before the occurrence of the caution-requiring disaster, and a confined state estimation unit (83) estimating a confined state of a user in the caution-requiring elevator facility when the caution-requiring disaster occurs based on the operation state and the boarding state of the caution-requiring elevator facility.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: FUJITEC KK

title_en: Evaluation recommendation method and device for fusion of digital twin data of power grid station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation recommendation method and device for fusion of digital twin data of a power grid station, which are used for acquiring data and measurement data of a digital twin model; calculating a time dimension score, a space dimension score, an effectiveness score, an integrity score and a business support score of the digital twin model according to the data and the measurement data of the digital twin model; calculating an importance evaluation score of the digital twin model according to the time dimension score, the space dimension score, the effectiveness score, the integrity score and the business support score of the digital twin model; the method is convenient for designers and engineering application personnel to evaluate, check and perfect the digital twin design, so that the digital twin data fusion level of the station equipment is improved, and the digital twin multi-service application of the power grid is supported.
assignees: EHV BRANCH STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;XUCHANG XJ SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Disaster reacting and management system based on digital twin and artificial intelligent
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 및 인공지능 기반의 재난 대응 및 운영 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response and operation system based on digital twin and artificial intelligence. The disaster response and operation system comprises: a disaster occurrence detection device; a sensor information collection device; a disaster environment simulation device; and an artificial intelligence learning device. According to the present invention, damage to life and property can be minimized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 및 인공지능 기반의 재난 대응 및 운영 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건축물 내/외부의 지정된 장소에 설치되며, 복수의 감지센서를 이용하여 해당 건축물의 내/외부에 피해를 줄 수 있는 재난사고 상황의 발생을 감지하는 재난발생 감지장치와, 재난발생 감지장치에 구비된 각 감지센서로부터 기 설정된 감지센서 고유식별정보를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 해당 건축물 내/외부의 층별 및 위치별로 각 감지센서 고유식별정보를 그룹화화여 감지센서 그룹화 ID를 생성하고, 상기 생성된 감지센서 그룹화 ID와 각 감지센서로부터 감지된 현재의 각 센싱 정보를 전송하는 센서정보 취합장치와, 재난 또는 비재난 상황에서 센서정보 취합장치로부터 전송된 감지센서 그룹화 ID와 각 감지센서로부터 감지된 현재의 각 센싱 정보를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 관리자의 선택에 따라 생성된 가상의 재난환경에 대하여 해당 건축물의 디지털 트윈 환경에서 기 설정된 디지털 트윈 기반의 가상 재난환경 시뮬레이션을 단계별로 수행하는 재난환경 시뮬레이션 장치와, 재난환경 시뮬레이션 장치로부터 수행되는 각 단계에서 생성되는 시뮬레이션 결과정보를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 기 설정된 인공지능(AI) 기반의 기계 학습방법을 통해 해당 관리자의 선택에 따라 생성된 가상의 재난환경에 대한 재난발생 예측 또는 시계열적 재난확산 예측을 학습하여, 해당 관리자의 선택에 따라 생성된 가상의 재난환경에 대한 재난발생 예측정보 또는 시계열적 재난확산 예측정보를 생성하기 위한 인공지능 학습모델을 구축하는 인공지능 학습장치를 포함함으로써, 해당 재난사고 발생 시 사람들의 최적 대피 경로를 예측하고, 여러 종류의 안전 관련 시설물 및 기 설치된 관련 시설물에 대한 제어/통제를 진행하여 인명 및 재산 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: KEPCO ENG & CONSTR CO INC;ELSOLTEC

title_en: Cloud-based ESS remote safety management system using gateway
title_ko: 게이트웨이를 이용한 클라우드 기반 ess 원격 안전관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cloud-based ESS remote safety managing system using a gateway capable of allowing the gateway to collect sensing values from IoT sensors of an energy storage system (ESS) of a field through a first communication unit having various protocols; transmitting the sensing values collected through a second communication unit of an LTE Cat.M1 standard to a safety management cloud server; building a safety managing cloud server based on cloud and predicting fire by analyzing the sensing values at the same time; remotely facilitating data collection and management and effectively preventing the fire of the ESS in advance by predicting and replacing similar values when occurring missing data; facilitating an interface with power sensor/equipment of various ESSs of the field using a single gateway; and reducing costs for installation, management, and maintenance of sensors/equipment.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 게이트웨이가 다양한 프로토콜을 구비한 제1 통신부를 통해 현장의 에너지저장시스템(ESS, Energy Storage System)의 IoT센서들로부터 센싱값을 수집하며, LTE Cat.M1 표준의 제2 통신부를 통해 수집된 센싱값들을 안전관리 클라우드 서버로 전송하며, 안전관리 클라우드 서버가 클라우드(Cloud) 기반으로 구축됨과 동시에 센싱값들을 분석하여 화재를 예측하며, 누락데이터 발생 시, 유사값을 예측하여 대체하도록 구성됨으로써 원격에서 데이터 수집 및 관리가 가능할 뿐만 아니라 에너지저장시스템(ESS)의 화재를 미연에 효과적으로 방지할 수 있으며, 단일 게이트웨이를 이용하여 현장의 다양한 에너지저장시스템(ESS)의 전력 센서/설비와의 인터페이스가 가능하여, 센서/설비의 설치, 관리 및 유지보수 비용의 절감의 효과를 창출할 수 있는 게이트웨이를 이용한 클라우드 기반 ESS 원격 안전관리시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: T FACTORY CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for expanding safety and stability emergency control offline strategy of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for expanding a safety and stability emergency control offline strategy of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving state estimation data, stability system data and the like in real time to obtain a current offline control strategy and form a series of online operation modes and a candidate perturbation cut set section set; on the basis, an interactive influence factor matrix of the transmission power of each perturbation cut set section on the stability margin of the system is formed by calculating the influence sensitivity of each cut set section power change perturbation on the stability margin of the dominant instability mode system; by checking the transient stability of the online operation mode, taking into account the actual difference of each section in the instability mode and the adjacent stability mode, excavating the characteristic sequence influencing the change of the stability margin, combining the strategy control quantity of online calculation, and completing the extension of the offline strategy after time domain simulation checking.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Distributed robust estimation method of electric-gas comprehensive energy system based on time domain model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-gas comprehensive energy system distributed robust estimation method based on a time domain model. The method comprises the steps of firstly deducing a simplified gas network state space model taking node pressure as a state quantity based on a time domain model, then establishing a power grid state space model and a coupling element model taking a gas turbine and electric hydrogen as a representative, and finally carrying out distributed robust state estimation by using a distributed estimation strategy with limited boundary information interaction and a process noise and measurement noise self-adaptive correction algorithm based on a Kalman filtering algorithm. The invention can solve the communication privacy problem of a management main body between the electric subsystem and the gas subsystem, effectively improve the state estimation precision and inhibit bad data influence by adaptively correcting the time-varying noise parameters, remarkably improve the calculation efficiency after simplifying the gas network model and provide real-time data support for the operation control of the comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Electric power management information platform based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power management information platform based on digital twins, which comprises: the system comprises a data layer, a capability layer and a service layer, wherein the data layer collects power management information data through a data collection module and integrates and uniformly sends the data to the capability layer, the capability layer constructs a three-dimensional virtual power information working platform through a three-dimensional simulation module and carries out chart statistics on monitored data in the platform, observation is facilitated, and the space situation of the real-time virtual power information working platform is mastered. According to the invention, the real three-dimensional virtual power information working platform is constructed by collecting the power management information in real time, integrating according to the information, so that the power management information is visible, manageable, controllable and searchable in real time, real-time energy monitoring, energy statistical analysis and key energy consumption equipment monitoring are realized, the management can accurately master the energy cost proportion and the development trend, and a targeted energy-saving strategy is formulated.
assignees: NANJING SINO DEVICE CLOUD INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Basin modeling method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based watershed modeling method, which comprises the following steps of: step S1: acquiring geographic data of an area where a drainage basin is located, processing the geographic data in modeling software Unity, determining a curved surface fitting function of a terrain surface, and obtaining curved surface information of the terrain surface; step S2: drawing a target river grid on the curved surface of the topographic surface obtained in the step S1; and step S3: and adding a shader to the target river grid to simulate a target river basin. According to the method, through coordinate change, grid division, spline curve fitting, spline surface adding, shader adding and the like, in the current watershed simulation process, the terrain generated in the GIS plug-in can be well matched with the river, so that the river can be accurately displayed in the corresponding terrain area. The invention completes the modeling of the riverbed terrain and generates good interaction with water. And a foundation is laid for realizing flood inundation and rain condition forecast and early warning in the follow-up process.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY MINI OF WATER RESOURCES P R C

title_en: Multi-dimensional data fusion perception model and maintenance optimization method for power transformation equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of state monitoring and fault diagnosis of power transformation equipment, and particularly relates to a multidimensional data fusion perception model and a maintenance optimization method of the power transformation equipment. Extracting characteristic information of multi-dimensional state information of the power transformation equipment, performing state estimation on the multi-dimensional multi-scale state information of the power transformation equipment by adopting a Gaussian mixture model, constructing a hidden Markov chain-deep learning network model, performing fusion perception on the multi-dimensional multi-scale information (mechanical, electrical and environmental state information) of the power transformation equipment, calculating loss values under different inputs through convolution, pooling, flattening and connection, realizing the fusion perception of the multi-dimensional state information of the power transformation equipment, and diagnosing fault information of the power transformation equipment on line; and a maintenance optimization strategy of the multi-dimensional state information fusion perception of the power transformation equipment is provided, and intelligent early warning and diagnosis of the power transformation equipment are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV COMPANY;UNIV EAST CHINA JIAOTONG;DONG WENTAO

title_en: Digital twinning-based large-scale energy storage power station collaborative management and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based large-scale energy storage power station collaborative management and control method and system, and belongs to the technical field of power system control. The method comprises the following steps: managing physical entities and operation logic in a physical space, collecting operation data and environment monitoring data of an energy storage power station in real time, and executing an upper instruction to realize multi-scene application of the energy storage power station; the method comprises the steps of storing and transmitting multi-source heterogeneous data in real time through a data pipeline, and constructing a data real-time bidirectional flow channel between a physical space and a digital space; and realizing resource virtualization in the digital space through edge calculation, maintaining and updating different mechanism models and data driving models, collocating and combining the models to form different functional modules, and sending down instructions to feed back to the physical space to realize multi-scene application of the energy storage power station. The method can verify the operation effect of the large-scale energy storage power station in real time on the premise of not influencing the normal operation of physical entities, improves the production efficiency, and ensures the real-time collaborative management and control of distributed resources in the jurisdiction of the large-scale energy storage power station.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for monitoring working state of power transmission and transformation equipment based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power transmission and transformation equipment monitoring, in particular to a method for realizing the monitoring of the working state of power transmission and transformation equipment based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of receiving a working instruction of power transmission and transformation equipment, starting a sensor system, wherein the sensor system reflects the working state of the power transmission and transformation equipment, operating the sensor system, collecting monitoring real-time data of the power transmission and transformation equipment, collecting the monitoring real-time data to obtain a monitoring real-time data stream, establishing a sliding window model based on a digital twin technology, calculating to obtain a corresponding variance value of the monitoring real-time data stream, screening the monitoring real-time data stream to obtain a monitoring abnormal data stream of the power transmission and transformation equipment, performing data cleaning on the monitoring real-time data stream to obtain a cleaned data stream sample of the power transmission and transformation equipment, transmitting the monitoring abnormal data stream and the cleaned data stream sample to an initiator of the working instruction of the power transmission and transformation equipment, and completing the monitoring of the working state of the power transmission and transformation equipment. The invention can improve the speed of detecting the abnormal state of the power transmission and transformation equipment.
assignees: SICHUAN HANGYANG POWER ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Power grid state estimation method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid state estimation method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of determining the configuration mode of each measuring equipment of a target power grid by acquiring measurement configuration information of the target power grid; acquiring power grid state measurement information corresponding to each key node in the target power grid according to the measurement configuration information of the target power grid; generating an information matrix corresponding to each key node according to the power grid state measurement information corresponding to each key node so as to represent node state information corresponding to the corresponding key node; decomposing the information matrix corresponding to each key node, and determining the information matrix calculation task corresponding to each key node; then, parallel operation is carried out on the information matrix calculation tasks corresponding to the key nodes, and state estimation information corresponding to any node in the target power grid is obtained; the calculation difficulty of the state estimation of the target power grid is simplified, the calculation speed of the state estimation is improved, and the processing efficiency of the target power grid data is further improved.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power information system based on data twinning and operation and maintenance method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electric power and digital twinning, in particular to an electric power information system and an operation and maintenance method based on digital twinning, comprising the following steps of S1, collecting operation data of power transformation equipment, S2, carrying out network transmission and storage on the operation data of the power transformation equipment through a unified standard protocol; s3: establishing an electric power operation and maintenance database based on the stored operation data, combining the electric power operation and maintenance database data with historical operation data, and evaluating and predicting the state of the equipment to generate alarm information; s4: and receiving the alarm information and carrying out data interaction with an application layer to generate an overhaul strategy.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Mobile energy storage access decision method based on digital twin cloud edge fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mobile energy storage access, and particularly relates to a mobile energy storage access decision method based on digital twin cloud edge fusion; step 1, establishing a mobile energy storage configuration model, and determining an optimal grid-connected position of a mobile energy storage system; step 2, establishing a mobile energy storage operation optimization model; step 1 includes the steps of determining key factors influencing a mobile energy storage configuration model in step 11 and determining a mobile energy storage access strategy based on digital twin cloud edge fusion in step 12; step 2 includes determining an objective function of a mobile energy storage operation optimization model in step 21 and determining constraint conditions of a mobile energy storage system in step 22, and performing optimization solution on a mobile energy storage configuration model by adopting a particle swarm algorithm; the invention can determine the optimal grid-connected position of the mobile energy storage system, and after disaster occurs, determine the optimal mobile energy storage configuration scheme and operation optimization scheme, thereby improving the safety, stability and economy of the system.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Digital twinning-based virtual power plant collaborative management and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual power plant collaborative management and control method and system based on digital twinning, and belongs to the technical field of power system control. The method comprises the following steps: various physical entities, various operation logics inside the physical entities and among the physical entities are managed in a physical layer, and an upper-layer instruction is executed to realize multi-type power application; real-time acquisition, storage and transmission of multi-source heterogeneous data in a data layer, and establishment of a real-time bidirectional data channel of a physical space and a digital space; maintaining an updating mechanism model and a data driving model at a model layer, and realizing resource virtualization, data pre-analysis, on-site monitoring and fault diagnosis through edge calculation; and various mechanism models and data driving models are combined in a cloud-edge cooperative matching mode at the functional layer to form different composite functional modules, and the issued instruction is fed back to a physical layer entity to realize multi-type power application. The method can improve production efficiency and ensure real-time collaborative management and control of distributed resources in the jurisdiction of the virtual power plant.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Reservoir flood control optimization scheduling method considering forecast uncertainty based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir flood control optimal scheduling method considering forecast uncertainty based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of constructing a digital twinning scene of a reservoir flood control scheduling system, acquiring physical data of the flood control scheduling system and virtual data in the digital twinning scene, updating the digital twinning scene in real time based on the physical data, constructing a flood forecast model based on the digital twinning scene of the flood control scheduling system updated in real time by combining a plurality of machine learning algorithms, constructing a reservoir flood control optimal scheduling model by combining the forecast result uncertainty of each flood forecast model, solving to obtain a flood control optimal scheduling strategy, constructing a flood risk assessment system, analyzing and assessing flood control risks according to the forecast result and the flood control optimal scheduling strategy, and guiding actual flood control scheduling. The invention reduces the risk brought by the scheduling strategy generated under the uncertain flood forecast condition, ensures the safety of the upstream and downstream of the reservoir, and can effectively reduce the flood risk.

title_en: Power grid digital twin model modeling method and device based on hybrid driving model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a power grid digital twin model modeling method and device based on a hybrid drive model. The method comprises the following steps: based on a physical rule among parameters of the power system, setting corresponding boundary conditions, and generating a power grid mechanism model; based on the input and output information of each element of each power system respectively read from the power grid area, training and generating a power grid data driving model; and dynamically weighting the mechanism model and the data driving model to generate a hybrid driving model serving as a power grid digital twin model. In this way, a high-quality and high-efficiency digital twin model of the power grid can be established, the digitization and the intellectualization of the power grid are realized, and the purposes of state detection, intelligent scheduling, fault early warning, feedback optimization and intelligent decision of the power grid are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Combined user missing electric quantity fitting method and system based on typical load curve
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of electric power marketing, and in particular relates to a combined user missing electric quantity fitting method and system based on a typical load curve, comprising the following steps: acquiring electricity utilization information of a user; obtaining a typical load curve of the user electricity consumption according to the obtained user electricity consumption; judging the number of the missing electric quantity in the obtained typical load curve; selecting a fitting method of the missing data according to the number of the obtained missing electric quantity to obtain a fitting proportionality coefficient; and according to the obtained fitting proportionality coefficient, fitting the missing electric quantity of the combined user is completed.
assignees: JINAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY MARKETING SERVICE CENTER METRIC CENTER

title_en: Mass data management method and system for power system time sequence production simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a mass data management method and system for time sequence production simulation of a power system, comprising the following steps: when new energy time sequence power generation data is imported, checking the validity of the new energy time sequence power generation data; if the legal checking result is that illegal or missing data exists, correcting the new energy time sequence power generation data based on the pre-stored historical meteorological resource data of each region, and storing the corrected new energy time sequence power generation data into a plurality of file type relational databases in a distributed mode; otherwise, the new energy time sequence power generation data are stored in a plurality of file type relational databases in a distributed mode; the method and the system are used for solving the problem that the conventional big data management cannot screen and correct illegal and missing data, and reducing data errors and data missing caused by the problems of network operation, equipment operation and the like in the actual power grid operation process. By checking and correcting the data for the user, the workload of manually correcting the data is reduced, the data entry efficiency is improved, and the integrity and usability of the data are ensured.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO;ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin foundation development platform oriented to energy consumption of park
abstract_en: The utility model provides a digital twin basis development platform towards garden energy consumption, through carrying out three-dimensional visual modeling to whole garden reality physical scene, power consumption building/equipment, the complete real energy consumption equipment of describing whole garden and energy consumption use trend, through multisource energy consumption data acquisition technology, big data depth excavation algorithm, the digital twin visual technology based on JARI.JS, realize the management to the whole flow of energy data from gathering to storage excavation analysis, and concentrate visual presentation to data through the mode of digital twin visual, use the energy when optimizing the energy configuration of garden, reduce the energy cost of garden, reduce greenhouse gas emission and other relevant environmental impact, improve its energy performance and the competitive advantage of garden.
assignees: JIANGSU JIERUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Garbage incineration power generation production efficiency and health evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a garbage incineration power generation production efficiency and health evaluation method, which comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin body aiming at power plant power generation main and auxiliary equipment, wherein the digital twin body comprises a system, a subsystem and a production structure of equipment hierarchy; establishing a specific evaluation model for a digital twin body of the equipment based on the two dimensions of efficiency and health; determining the weight of each level of the production structure according to the information entropy, the fuzzy primitive model and the dynamic weight mechanism; obtaining the scores of all levels of the production structure through weighted summation; the model has comprehensive framework, high automation degree and wide application range, can master the running conditions of the garbage incineration power plant system and equipment in real time, guide a special worker to adjust the running state of the equipment, and ensure that the equipment is in a high-efficiency and healthy state.
assignees: LUCULENT SMART TECH CO LTD

title_en: Operation risk assessment method and system based on power grid fault rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation risk assessment method and system based on a power grid fault rate, and the method and system specifically comprise the steps of collecting fault data information, detecting the fault information, carrying out data processing on the collected data and the fault information, and storing a processing result; the invention provides an operation risk assessment method based on a power grid fault rate, which is used for pointedly strengthening a power grid system, improving the abnormal condition resistance of the power grid conveniently and reducing the power grid fault rate; the invention also provides an operation risk assessment system for the power grid faults, which is convenient for calculating the fault rate of each position fault through the fault rate calculation module, and can carry out targeted maintenance on the position with higher fault rate according to the data calculated by the fault rate calculation module, thereby reducing the fault rate of the position with easy fault, reducing the overall fault rate of the power grid, and carrying out real-time update on the fault rate of each position through the fault rate calculation module, so that maintenance personnel can observe the change condition of the fault rate in time.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for providing solutions for managing solar power plants based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 태양광 발전소 관리 솔루션 제공 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for providing digital twin-based solar power plant management solutions, which is performed by a server, comprises: a step a) of constructing and storing actual data of a power plant including a plurality of solar panels based on previously collected power plant data; a step b) of collecting status data of each panel from a sensing module attached to each panel at a preset period; a step c) of determining a preset amount of power generation loss per unit time based on the power plant data and the status data of each panel; and a step d) of analyzing a plurality of loss factors for the power generation loss and the contribution to the plurality of loss factors, and providing the analysis result to a manager terminal, wherein the period is the number of times the sensing module measures the status data of the panel per unit time. According to the present invention, power generation loss at a random point of time can be predicted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르는, 서버에 의해 수행되는, 디지털 트윈 기반 태양광 발전소 관리 솔루션 제공 방법은, a) 기 수집한 발전소 데이터에 기초하여 복수의 태양광 패널을 포함하는 발전소의 실제 데이터를 구축하고 저장하는 단계; b) 기 설정된 주기마다, 각 패널에 부착된 센싱모듈로부터 각 패널의 상태 데이터를 수집하는 단계; c) 상기 발전소 데이터 및 상기 각 패널의 상태 데이터에 기초하여 기 설정된 단위시간 당 발전량 손실분을 파악하는 단계; 및 d) 상기 발전량 손실분에 대한 복수의 손실 요인 및 상기 복수의 손실 요인에 대한 기여도를 분석하고, 분석 결과를 관리자 단말로 제공하는 단계;를 포함하되, 상기 주기는 상기 단위시간 당 센싱모듈이 패널의 상태 데이터를 측정하는 횟수이다.
assignees: CONALOG CO LTD

title_en: Transformer collaborative management method and system based on power grid digital twin model
abstract_en: The invention provides a transformer collaborative management method and system based on a power grid digital twin model. The transformer collaborative management method comprises the following steps: establishing an initial digital twin model corresponding to each transformer according to initial parameters of the transformers; setting a monitoring period of self-adaptive change, and updating the initial digital twin model according to the operation parameter data of the transformers after each monitoring period is finished to obtain updated digital twin models corresponding to each transformer; and setting the corresponding continuous running time and running buffer time according to the updated digital twin model corresponding to each transformer. The system comprises modules corresponding to the method steps.
assignees: BEIJING GUOWANG FUDA SCIENCE & TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Pseudo-fidelity model building, derivatizing and remolding method of power grid digital twin model
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method for establishing, derivatizing and remolding a simulated fidelity model of a digital twin model of a power grid. The method comprises the steps of establishing a mimicry-fidelity model based on a variability function, a high-fidelity function and a self-adaptive change function, processing operation and maintenance models and process data of different original scenes, deriving the mimicry-fidelity model, collecting operation and maintenance data of a target scene, and remolding the mimicry-fidelity model. The simulation modeling method utilizes the simulation phenomenon of organisms, establishes a simulation fidelity model on the basis of a digital twin model, can be analogized into a basic simulation system, enables the complete digital twin model to generate a highly reduced information copy, establishes a mirror image virtual model for observation, prediction and control of a management and control object, and is applied to a power grid security control system to improve the strain capacity of the digital twin model of a power grid and promote the digitization and the intellectualization of the power grid.

title_en: Distribution network feeder line measurement configuration method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for measuring and configuring feeder lines of a power distribution network, which are used for establishing a linearization relation between feeder line measurement configuration and state estimation errors of the power distribution network according to least square method state estimation, carrying out state estimation by using measurement information to obtain a state estimation value of the power distribution network, obtaining state estimation total square errors of all nodes according to the linearization relation and the state estimation value, determining a measurement configuration scheme of the power distribution network according to the state estimation total square errors of all nodes, realizing optimal configuration of feeder line measurement of the power distribution network, effectively considering the state estimation precision problem of the power distribution network, reducing the state estimation errors of the power distribution network, and improving the accuracy of scheduling control, thereby improving the efficiency and the accuracy of measurement configuration.

title_en: Digital twin platform for intelligent building
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin platform towards wisdom building. The digital twin platform facing intelligent building comprises: the intelligent building model building system is used for generating a building model to be monitored through a digital twin technology; the data acquisition system is used for acquiring real-time monitoring data of the real building to be monitored; the monitoring database comprises at least one preset time and a monitoring item group, wherein one monitoring item group corresponds to one preset time; the time acquisition module is used for acquiring the current time, wherein the intelligent building model building system is used for acquiring the current time, comparing the current time with the preset time, acquiring a corresponding monitoring project group, and selectively acquiring real-time detection data acquired by the data acquisition system according to the monitoring project group. According to the method and the device, different monitoring project groups can be acquired for monitoring according to different times, so that the digital model does not need to need a large amount of calculation power at any time, and the waste of electric power is caused.
assignees: BEIJING BEITOU SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic capacity analysis method based on digital twin data center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic capacity analysis method based on a digital twin data center, which comprises the following steps of; acquiring real-time operation values of the infrastructure of the data center by using a collector; loading the real-time operation value obtained in the step 1 into a memory database; the digital twin platform acquires real-time operation values from the memory database and performs real-time analysis; and predicting the acquired real-time operation value, and displaying the capacity view. According to the invention, the real-time operation value of the data center infrastructure is obtained from the memory database through the digital twin platform and is analyzed in real time, whether the real-time operation value is changed or not is judged in time, and the service supply capacity of energy is analyzed and predicted in real time, so that the device and the method help us to find whether the energy supply meets the service requirement or not in time, and whether adjustment is needed or not, thereby effectively avoiding faults and rationalizing and utilizing the capacity. Furthermore, the capacity analysis of all the supply links can effectively help maintenance personnel to find that capacity has problems in time.
assignees: SHANGHAI BAOXIN DATA CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional visual safety supervision method based on Redbat positioning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional visual safety supervision method based on a Redbat positioning system, which comprises the steps of building a BIM model based on a 3D digital factory database; the three-dimensional model and the power plant entity system are subjected to data association in the BIM model in a database integration mode; and carrying out real-time updating display on the BIM model after the data association through a digital 3D graph. According to the invention, the equipment is positioned and managed through the BIM model, and is linked with the personnel positioning system, so that the safety control level is improved, the digital model of the on-site safety management of a thermal power enterprise is solved, the on-site personnel positioning, the equipment positioning and the building BIM industrial Internet infrastructure construction are realized, and the on-site safety accurate control is realized through a digital means.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA DABAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid data acquisition method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a digital twinning-based power grid data acquisition method, a digital twinning-based power grid data acquisition device, digital twinning-based power grid data acquisition equipment and digital twinning-based power grid data acquisition media. The method comprises the steps of obtaining initial acquisition data; the initial acquisition data are initial data acquired by the edge side nodes according to an initial preset acquisition rule; classifying and evaluating the initial acquisition data based on a preset algorithm to obtain an evaluation result; optimizing the initial preset acquisition rule based on the evaluation result; sending the optimized acquisition rule to a corresponding edge side node so that the edge side node performs data acquisition according to the received acquisition rule; and repeating the process until the evaluation result meets the preset condition, and storing the corresponding acquisition rule as an initial preset acquisition rule for new data acquisition. In this way, the data collection quality and the data sharing efficiency of the micro-grid data can be improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twinning-based wind farm cost-optimal current collection line planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based wind power plant cost-optimal current collection route planning method, which comprises the following steps: s1, grouping fans; s2, respectively calculating shortest paths of all routes under the grouping scheme of the overhead line fans according to the grouping scheme; s3, calculating the positions of towers of the overhead line fans in groups; s4, analyzing the current-carrying capacity of each section of line: calculating the actual current carrying capacity of each section of line according to the actual current flowing direction, wherein the current carrying capacity of any section of line=the current accumulation of each section of line from which the current is sourced, and the current carrying capacity of the fan side=the single fan capacity; s5, matching the most reasonable cable specification according to the current-carrying capacity of each section of line; s6, loading the line selection result into the digital twin scene. According to the invention, the route planning analysis of the collecting circuit is carried out by adopting computer operation, so that the power transmission circuit route selection result with optimal project area cost can be rapidly output, the time required by the whole collecting circuit design process is greatly shortened, and the efficiency of the collecting circuit design is improved.
assignees: CHENGDU HANTAO TIANTU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin model platform implementation method and device based on middle-stage architecture
