abstract_en: New energy power system state estimation method and system based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: step 1, providing a new energy power system state estimation method and system based on improved DNN; step 2, predicting RTU data based on BILSTM in the step 1, generating pseudo measurement by utilizing the Spline interpolation, and fusing the pseudo measurement with PMU measurement measured by the node; step 3, based on the fusion data set obtained in the step 2, providing a combined space-time FC mechanism based on compatibility measurement and a BILSTM data identification technology; step 4, based on the data identification technology proposed in the step 3; removing bad data in the data by carrying out deep identification on the data, and reserving fluctuation data so as to obtain an original data set; and 5, establishing a new energy power system state estimation model according to the original data set obtained in the step 4. The method improves the precision and the speed of the state estimation of the new energy power system on the basis of keeping the original characteristics of the new energy measurement data, and is more suitable for the development requirement of the new power system.
assignees: UNIV XINJIANG

title_en: Industrial control system security threat response treatment method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for handling safety threat response of an industrial control system based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps: when the industrial control system is detected to be under the network attack, determining the current state of the industrial control system and the attack type of the network attack; searching a target response strategy corresponding to the attack type from a preset strategy library; if the corresponding target response strategy is not found, carrying out network information safety detection and industrial control equipment function safety detection on a plurality of preset risk assessment methods by using an industrial control digital twin system from low risk value to high risk value; and taking the first risk assessment method through network information safety detection and industrial control equipment functional safety detection as an emergency response strategy, and executing the emergency response strategy. The invention constructs a twin system covering the network space and the physical space, realizes the digital twin of the industrial control network and the digital twin of the industrial field, provides a high-fidelity scene meeting the cross-domain detection and verification for the industrial control response treatment, and can be widely applied to the field of network security.
assignees: UNIV GUANGZHOU;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin layered modeling method for evolution of Natech event of oil and gas major infrastructure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin layering modeling method for evolution of a Natech event of an oil and gas major infrastructure, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: step 1: the method comprises the steps of carrying out scene demand analysis, wherein modeling demands are real-time analysis and prediction on different links of equipment domino effect evolution, probability and accident results thereof in a Natech event scene caused by natural disasters of an oil gas storage major infrastructure; step 2: agent-based scene multi-scale multi-dimensional decomposition; step 3: modeling based on unit attribute and state twinning of multi-source data mechanism fusion; step 4: demand-oriented visualization and interaction. The accident scene is mirrored virtually, a Natech accident twinning scene of an oil gas storage and transportation major infrastructure is constructed, the probability and the accident result of accidents of each unit under multi-disaster coupling can be conveniently analyzed, domino accident risk assessment under multi-disaster coupling is conveniently carried out, daily risk assessment and accident emergency decision are guided, and the power assisting is reduced.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Ai-based autonomous control integrated building automatic control system
title_ko: Ai 기반의 자율제어 통합 빌딩 자동제어 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is an AI-based autonomous control integrated automatic building control system which comprises: a measurement sensor measuring the operation of building equipment in real time to generate building equipment measurement values; an automatic building control server monitoring the power use status of the building equipment, generating automatic control values for the building equipment on the basis of the building equipment measurement values generated by the measurement sensor, and using the generated automatic building equipment control values to automatically control the building equipment; and a user terminal displaying the power use status of building equipment monitored by the automatic building control server. Accordingly, the AI-based autonomous control integrated automatic building control system is configured to use digital twins to implement the operation and efficiency of a building's energy use in the near future, thereby providing effects of increasing the efficiency of the building's power use and preventing abnormalities, excessive consumption, or waste related to power use.
abstract_ko: AI 기반의 자율제어 통합 빌딩 자동제어 시스템이 개시된다. 빌딩 설비의 동작을 실시간 계측하여 빌딩 설비 계측값을 생성하는 계측 센서; 상기 계측 센서에서 생성된 빌딩 설비 계측값에 기반하여 상기 빌딩 설비의 전력 사용 상황을 모니터링하고 빌딩 설비 자동 제어값을 생성하며, 생성된 빌딩 설비 자동 제어값을 이용하여 상기 빌딩 설비를 자동 제어하는 빌딩 자동제어 서버; 상기 빌딩 자동제어 서버에서 모니터링되는 빌딩 설비의 전력 사용 상황을 표시하는 사용자 단말을 구성한다. 상술한 AI 기반의 자율제어 통합 빌딩 자동제어 시스템에 의하면, 디지털 트윈을 이용하여 건물의 에너지 사용에 관한 가까운 미래 시점의 동작과 효율을 미리 구현하도록 구성됨으로써, 빌딩의 전력 사용의 효율을 높이고 전력 사용에 관한 이상 현상이나 과도한 소비나 낭비를 미연에 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: DONG YANG E&C CO LTD

title_en: Small hydropower station cluster power generation power prediction method based on BP-SVM multi-model fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small hydropower station cluster power generation power prediction method based on BP-SVM multi-model fusion, which comprises the steps of collecting radial flow small hydropower station original data, repairing the original missing data, extracting power generation characteristics, cluster classification, carrying out normalization pretreatment and eliminating data dimension differences; constructing a self-adaptive small hydropower station fusion prediction model, constructing a BP neural network prediction model and constructing an SVM support vector machine prediction model; fusion optimization prediction is carried out on the generated power; and adopting RMSPE root mean square percentage error to analyze, check and correct the error of the fusion prediction model prediction result. According to the method, the prediction model is constructed through extraction of the hydropower station cluster output and factor correlation characteristics, proper algorithm training is selected, the prediction precision of the power generation power of the radial hydropower station is improved, and the accurate prediction of the power generation power of the radial hydropower station is realized.
assignees: LISHUI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power station parametric modeling method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a power station parameterized modeling method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining outline data of first target equipment in an energy storage power station, wherein the first target equipment comprises at least one of the following: the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional model of first target equipment based on outline data by using a preset illusion engine, exporting and deploying an engineering file of the three-dimensional model, loading the engineering file to an energy storage power station digital twin scene displayed by a client in a pixel streaming mode in response to a display request sent by the client, and constructing the digital twin scene of the energy storage power station by using the illusion engine, so that the working efficiency of operation and maintenance personnel is improved.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: Digital twin method and device for power grid facilities and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a digital twinning method and device for power grid facilities and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-angle physical entity images and motion video sequences of power grid facilities, and constructing a static model of the power grid facilities; then determining the corresponding relation between the static model and each frame in the motion video sequence to obtain a dynamic model of the power grid facility; combining the OPC UA technology and the MQTT technology to acquire power grid facility data and constructing a situation database and a physical object database; and finally, constructing a logic model of the power grid facility based on the situation database and the physical object database, and constructing a virtual entity of the power grid facility based on the static model, the dynamic model and the logic model. The invention realizes the real-time mapping and analysis of the data of the power grid facilities, and improves the remote intelligent monitoring and management level and the new energy consumption level of the power grid facilities.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid peak load and loss evaluation method based on load mode reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating peak load and loss of a power grid based on load mode reconstruction, which relates to the technical field of load prediction of a power system and comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of load data acquired by acquisition equipment in a period to be predicted; carrying out subinterval segmentation and subinterval load missing data calculation on a period to be predicted of a plurality of load data; fitting the load prediction data of each subinterval through a preset fitting function, and performing data splicing on the fitting data of each subinterval to construct a target prediction function, wherein the load prediction data comprises load data and load missing data in the same subinterval; and solving the peak load and the network loss of the power grid based on the target prediction function. According to the method, the data integrity can be enhanced by predicting the load missing data and performing data splicing, the network loss error caused by the missing data is reduced, the prediction accuracy of the target prediction function is improved, and finally the accuracy of power grid peak load and power grid loss evaluation is higher through the target prediction function.
assignees: YONGKANG GUANGMING POWER TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD;YONGKANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid fault hidden danger management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based power grid fault hidden danger management system and method, and belongs to the technical field of digital twinning. Carrying out digital twin mapping on power grid equipment, and establishing a digital twin fault database to avoid the grid system breakout caused by imperfect processing operation; constructing a historical fault event library, and analyzing the flow change condition of fault processing operation; capturing core fault processing operation and analyzing the association relation of power grid equipment; constructing an troubleshooting randomized iteration model, analyzing hidden danger evasion degree of a fault troubleshooting sequence table, and selecting a corresponding fault troubleshooting sequence table when the hidden danger evasion degree is maximum; the fault hidden danger range can be further solved, the condition that the definition is unclear is avoided, repeated work is avoided, more hidden danger fault events can be covered as much as possible when each fault is detected, the limited working time can be maximally utilized, the working efficiency is improved, and the overall hidden danger of a power grid system under each detection is maximally guaranteed to be minimized.

title_en: Transformer digital twin full period management method integrating data and mechanism model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of digital twin technology and power transformer management, in particular to a transformer digital twin full period management method integrating data and mechanism models, which comprises the following specific steps: s1, performing characteristic analysis on a power transformer; s2, collecting real-time monitoring data of the power transformer; s3, constructing a digital twin model formed by fusing two heterogeneous modes of a data model and a mechanism model; s4, optimally designing the power transformer through a digital twin model; s5, inputting key elements of the optimal design into a digital twin model for simulation verification; s6, inputting the data monitored in real time into the digital twin model to predict the real-time performance; s7, taking operation and maintenance measures according to the prediction result; s8, updating and optimizing the model; s9, carrying out full period management through a digital twin technology. The invention realizes the support of the whole period management of the power transformer by the digital twin technology and can effectively improve the reliability of the power transformer.
assignees: JIANGSU HUACHEN TRANSF CO LTD;UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Reliability evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium for electric power optical communication network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for evaluating reliability of an electric power optical communication network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting operation state data of an electric power optical communication network; calculating a state layer score; constructing a state layer fuzzy judgment matrix and calculating the element weight of the state layer; calculating the scores of the elements of the index layer based on the scores of the state layer and the weights; constructing an index layer fuzzy judgment matrix, and calculating element weights of the index layer; calculating the scores of all elements of the evaluation layer based on the scores of the index layer and the weights; constructing an evaluation layer fuzzy judgment matrix, and calculating element weights of the evaluation layer; calculating a reliability score of the power optical communication network based on the evaluation layer score and the weight, and determining a reliability grade; predicting future reliability of the power optical communication network by using the trained digital twin model; and determines device abnormality information. The invention can predict the future reliability of the power optical communication network and effectively improve the reliability evaluation accuracy of the power optical communication network.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic monitoring and disaster early warning system for earth-rock dam seepage safety based on digital twin technology and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic monitoring and disaster early warning system for earth and rockfill dam seepage safety based on a digital twin technology and a construction method thereof, wherein the system comprises a physical layer, an information layer, a service layer and an application layer; the physical layer and the information layer comprise a monitoring system for digital twin bottom plate construction; the service layer comprises a prediction system, an early warning system and a plan release system for data fusion processing; the application layer includes a previewing system for digitized scene construction. The built system can better serve engineering practice, monitor various index data of the earth and rockfill dam in real time, predict the seepage security risk of the earth and rockfill dam in real time, and realize real-time dynamic simulation of seepage state of the earth and rockfill dam and seepage disaster automatic early warning plan.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power system transient stability evaluation method based on Bayesian convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system transient stability evaluation method based on a Bayesian convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring and processing PMU measurement data of a power system, acquiring transient process time sequence data of the power system, and constructing a data set based on the transient process time sequence data of the power system; constructing an uncertainty transient stability evaluation model of the power system based on a Bayesian convolutional neural network, and training and testing the model based on the data set to obtain a final model; and performing online transient stability evaluation of the power system by using the final model, and obtaining a transient stability state prediction result of the power system and uncertainty estimation of the prediction result. The model constructed by the method has stronger robustness against noise data and feature missing data, has stronger adaptability to small data sets and can be set by operators according to specific requirements so as to improve the prediction result.
assignees: UNIV GUIZHOU

title_en: Intelligent power failure management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power management, in particular to an intelligent power failure management method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting a time window and acquiring historical data of a time window before the current time; deleting abnormal values of the historical data, filling the missing data in the historical data, and constructing a model historical electricity utilization data set; performing cluster division on all users according to the model historical electricity consumption data set; manually marking each cluster, namely giving electricity utilization priority to each cluster; determining a user range needing to provide necessary continuous electricity consumption according to the electricity priority, and providing necessary continuous electricity consumption for users needing to provide necessary continuous electricity consumption according to the reported data; the invention can grade users according to historical electricity consumption information, scientifically cut power for users with different levels, and reduce great social loss caused by power cut.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM

title_en: Safety protection device based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The utility model provides a digital twinning-based safety protection device which comprises a protection blocking net, a protection barrel and a communicating pipe, wherein an opening is formed in the center of the protection blocking net, the protection barrel penetrates through the opening, a clamping groove and a spray hole are formed in a side plate of the protection barrel, an elastic rod and a sealing film are respectively arranged in the clamping groove and the spray hole, the communicating pipe is inserted into the end face of the protection barrel, a flame-retardant slurry is filled in an area between the protection barrel and the communicating pipe, a partition plate is fixed on the inner wall of the protection barrel, a piston plate is sleeved on the communicating pipe, the rear end of the communicating pipe is connected with a spray head, fireproof cloth is bound on the elastic rod, and a fixed cavity is formed between the fireproof cloth and the protection barrel. The utility model solves the problem that the prior art is provided with the blocking net-shaped protection device, when special conditions such as fire disaster, leakage and the like occur in a production workshop, the blocking effect of the protection net is limited, and the danger source is diffused outwards.
assignees: CCCC JIANSHI DIGITAL TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Wind-solar-load combined prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar-load combined prediction method, which comprises the steps of constructing a wind-solar-load sample set through multi-source heterogeneous data assimilation, constructing and optimizing to generate a wind-solar-load high-dimensional feature set through high-dimensional features, and acquiring a new energy prediction typical scene identification model based on the wind-solar-load high-dimensional feature set and cost sensitive learning; based on a Stacking deep learning combination model and a typical scene recognition model, realizing the refined modeling of the new energy station, and upscaling the power prediction result of the station to a provincial cluster by an improved statistical upscaling method; realizing provincial load prediction based on wind power, photovoltaic provincial cluster power and provincial power load historical data; and carrying out joint prediction on the wind-light load power of each station, each cluster and each provincial cluster by a B/S structure-based wind-light load joint prediction system. According to the wind power load prediction method, wind power load fine modeling and combined prediction under different typical scenes can be realized, the wind power, photovoltaic and load prediction precision is improved, and the method has certain popularization value.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Monitoring-free distributed photovoltaic output power estimation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a monitoring-free distributed photovoltaic output power estimation method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, observing the existing polymer and a low-voltage distributed power supply, constructing an estimated point of the low-voltage distributed power supply, and determining a low-voltage distributed power supply partition or polymer according to the geographic position or feeder line of the estimated point; step 2, estimating parameters by adopting a linear estimation model based on consistency of correlation between distributed power supply electric quantity data and power data; and step 3, judging whether to carry out aggregation solution and state estimation parameter calculation again according to the accumulated electric quantity error, and carrying out rolling correction on the state estimation strategy. The invention can solve the problem of low-voltage unsupervised photovoltaic output estimation without real-time data, reduces the calculation complexity in the form of a polymer, improves the estimation efficiency, and simultaneously combines the output curve correction to ensure the accuracy of photovoltaic output power estimation.
assignees: INST ELECTRICAL ENG CAS

title_en: Acousto-optic-electric collaborative inspection method and device based on digital twin transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acousto-optic-electric collaborative inspection method and device based on a digital twin transformer substation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out semanteme and objectification treatment on the virtual power transformation equipment to obtain a digital model of the power transformation equipment; calibrating the acousto-optic-electric sensing equipment in a digital twin model of the transformer substation to obtain an acousto-optic-electric virtual sensing model; performing association mapping on the digital twin model and the acousto-optic virtual perception model of the transformer substation; positioning the space position of the inspection equipment in a digital twin model of the transformer substation, and constructing a virtual inspection equipment model; acquiring sensing data and space position information of inspection equipment, and carrying out registration fusion with a digital model of the power transformation equipment; analyzing the perception data to determine the spatial position of the abnormal point; and detecting the spatial position of the abnormal point in the digital twin model of the transformer substation, generating a cooperative task control signal according to the detection result, and sending the cooperative task control signal to an actual transformer substation for corresponding cooperative control.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD TAIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twin three-dimensional dynamic modeling method for auxiliary equipment of coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of real-time 3D modeling, in particular to a digital twin three-dimensional dynamic modeling method for auxiliary equipment of a coal-fired power plant. According to the invention, the ultrasonic wave is transmitted to penetrate and scan the auxiliary equipment to be studied, and on the basis of obtaining the characteristic sizes of the surface and the internal structure of the auxiliary equipment, the corresponding coordinate data is obtained and converted by establishing a coordinate system, so that the virtual three-dimensional comprehensive modeling of the auxiliary equipment is realized. Meanwhile, aiming at the actual running process of auxiliary equipment, the tracer particles are adsorbed on the internal dynamic structure of the auxiliary equipment through a system which is designed and built by self, on the basis of tracking the space coordinates of the particles, a corresponding sub-time model is built, and finally, the sub-time model is fused with a virtual three-dimensional model built by an ultrasonic scanning technology, so that dynamic and fine three-dimensional modeling is realized.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent cleaning unmanned aerial vehicle, system and cleaning method for photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent cleaning unmanned aerial vehicle for a photovoltaic panel, a system and a cleaning method. The invention has the advantages of high efficiency, intelligence and low cost, and solves the problems of poor flexibility, poor environmental adaptability, high cost and the like of the conventional cleaning of the photovoltaic panel; the invention cleans the photovoltaic panel and simultaneously has the functions of flaw detection and digital twin management service system, thereby providing more intelligent management service for the photovoltaic power station; the invention has the advantage of being applicable to various scenes, and is applicable to various large photovoltaic power stations or photovoltaic panels which are difficult to reach by manpower, such as roofs, water surfaces and the like; the invention can reduce the waste of water sources and the labor cost and the risk of manual operation.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Electric power network refined electric carbon tracking method and device based on graph data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graph data-based power network refined electric carbon tracking method and device. In the method, three sub-methods of electric power network electric carbon graph data construction, electric power network refined electric carbon tracking calculation and electric power network electric carbon tracking result generation are adopted, so that the electric power network electric carbon tracking problem can be converted into the graph searching problem, the complex matrix construction and calculation are avoided, meanwhile, the influence of energy storage equipment on electric power network carbon emission distribution is considered, the electric power network refined time-space scale electric carbon tracking can be realized, and the electric power network refined time-space scale electric carbon tracking method can be combined with the technical depths of electric power network topology identification, state estimation and the like, and has good robustness, expansibility and practicability.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Filling method, device, equipment and storage medium for terminal acquisition data missing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a filling method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for missing data of terminal acquisition, which are used for searching the missing data of the acquired data after executing a data acquisition task; when the missing data is identified and the missing data is not a single or continuous data item of the last acquisition time, analyzing causal features of the missing data by adopting a pre-trained causal Bayesian network, and associating the missing reason with a low-voltage station area fault to perform fault positioning; and adopting the complete data of the missing data set with the data missing as initial data, and filling the missing data according to various filling algorithms. And the corresponding data are filled by adopting a multiple filling method, so that the stable and reliable operation of the electricity consumption information acquisition system is ensured, and the acquisition operation and maintenance efficiency is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Power grid fault prediction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid fault prediction method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of power grid fault prediction, wherein whether a parameter sequence has a data missing position or not is judged by acquiring a parameter sequence of a target power grid generated by operation and maintenance personnel based on a parameter template; if the global feature corresponding to the parameter sequence exists, acquiring the global feature corresponding to the parameter sequence and the local feature of the data missing bit; completing the parameter sequence according to the global features and the local features to obtain a complete parameter sequence; carrying out weight distribution on each parameter in the complement parameter sequence according to the parameter source to obtain a weight parameter sequence; and inputting the weight parameter sequence into a pre-trained attention prediction model to obtain fault prediction information corresponding to the target power grid. The method and the system can solve the problem that the existing power grid fault prediction model is difficult to process the data to be predicted with missing data.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Substation secondary equipment fault prediction method and device based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The application discloses a transformer substation secondary equipment fault prediction method and device based on multi-source data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a multi-source data set of secondary equipment of a transformer substation; carrying out three-dimensional modeling processing according to the multi-source data set to obtain a digital twin model; performing state evaluation processing on secondary equipment of the transformer substation according to the digital twin model to obtain equipment state data; performing data comparison processing on the equipment state data according to a preset reference value to obtain abnormal data; acquiring a working ticket of the secondary equipment of the transformer substation through a power grid management platform, and comparing the working ticket with an image recognition result acquired by a video monitoring system to acquire comparison data; and carrying out fault prediction according to the comparison data and the abnormal data to obtain a fault prediction result. According to the method and the device for predicting the faults of the secondary equipment of the transformer substation, the faults of the secondary equipment of the transformer substation are predicted through the multi-source data, the cost and the complexity of model construction are reduced, and the method and the device can be widely applied to the technical field of fault prediction.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Optimization method, terminal and storage medium for park-type virtual power plant group
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of virtual power plants, and particularly provides an optimization method, a terminal and a storage medium of a park type virtual power plant group, which comprise the steps of constructing a park type virtual power plant group frame, wherein the park type virtual power plant group frame is configured with a first stage upper model, a first stage lower model and a second stage model; acquiring output data of each period of time before the day of each park-type virtual power plant in each park-type virtual power plant group; the real-time planning is carried out on the overall running dynamics of the virtual power plant cluster step by step through multiple time scales composed of different time periods, so that the friendliness and the external consistency are always kept in participation in market transactions; in addition, the invention adopts a minute time scale through the second stage model, accurately corrects the single day plan by utilizing real-time updated data in a buffer range, and minimizes unbalanced cost of the daily market and the real-time market.
assignees: LAIWU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network dynamic state estimation method based on robust adaptive Kalman filtering
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a dynamic state estimation method of a power distribution network based on robust adaptive Kalman filtering, and relates to the field of dynamic state estimation of power distribution networks. Constructing a mathematical model of dynamic state estimation of the power distribution network according to the topology structure of the power distribution network and the type of measurement data, and realizing the dynamic state estimation of the power distribution network by using a volume Kalman filter; the modeling error is classified into unknown system noise by introducing a fault-tolerant noise estimator, so that the original constant unknown system noise is changed into time-varying unknown system noise, then noise estimation is carried out at each time section by the fault-tolerant noise estimator, and the statistical characteristics of the noise are adjusted at all times. When the power distribution network has rough differences, the Kalman filtering gain is corrected by introducing an anti-difference enhancement factor so as to achieve the effect of correcting the state estimation value. According to the invention, the fault-tolerant noise estimator and robust enhancement are introduced into the volume Kalman filter, so that the estimation accuracy and robust performance of the dynamic state estimation of the power distribution network are improved.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Automatic generation method of power failure plan of power distribution network dispatching accident
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic generation method of a power failure plan of a power distribution network dispatching accident, which comprises the following steps: s1, basic data collection, namely acquiring a topological connection relation of a power distribution network, technical parameters of each electrical device and real-time measurement data from a power grid dispatching system, S2, performing state estimation on the power distribution network dispatching system according to the acquired basic data to acquire part of unknown electrical quantity information, and calculating by adopting a Newton Lafson method to acquire active power and reactive power of a node; s3, when the main transformer of the transformer substation fails to cause the load on the bus of the main transformer to lose electricity, transferring the lost electricity load to other buses which normally work; and S4, counting and displaying the power-losing load name, the power-losing load power, the load transfer path, the main transformer and the load rate information of the branch circuit according to the load transfer optimization result. The automatic generation method of the power distribution network accident power failure plan effectively improves the rationality of the load transfer scheme and greatly improves the scheme generation efficiency.
assignees: CHANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric power emergency plan deduction method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power emergency plan deduction method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of building a digital twin geographic power grid wiring model and a power grid control node model; acquiring real monitoring data and control information of network control nodes in a real geographic power grid, independently extracting data when the real monitoring data is abnormal and the control information of the corresponding power grid control nodes to form power grid accident information, and generating a digital twin drilling script model and a standard drilling result model corresponding to the drilling script model; and obtaining the countermeasure input by the user, and generating emergency resource setting information. The method is applied to a server based on the electric power emergency plan deduction system, various emergency situation scene library models are continuously built, and the deduction function of the deduction system is perfected; the ability to provide emergency resource setting information; generating an exercise evaluation result; the method for deducing the power emergency plan is vivid and professional.
assignees: HAIBEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power supply path tracing method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based power supply path tracing method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a digital twin model of each device in a power-preserving place to be traced; processing the digital twin model according to preset fineness parameters to generate hierarchical models with different fineness degrees; and tracing the power supply path of the important load by using the hierarchical model, and displaying the tracing result. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the digital twin model can be automatically constructed, the real-time monitoring of the power supply range is realized, and the time cost and the labor cost are saved.
assignees: HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ZHEJIANG DAYOU INDUSTRIAL CO LTD HANGZHOU TECH DEVELOPMENT BRANCH;VANGO TECHNOLOGIES INC;BEIJING YOUNUO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon disaster risk assessment and dynamic forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster risk assessment and dynamic forecasting method, which comprises the following steps: selecting a prediction index: at least comprising a risk index, a vulnerability index and an exposure index; extracting dangerous indexes: extracting the maximum rainfall, the process rainfall and the average maximum wind speed of a plurality of preset time lengths in administrative areas of each county; correlation analysis: carrying out pearson correlation analysis on the selected prediction index and the loss level; and (3) principal component analysis: reducing the dimension of the dangerous index related to the rainfall; dividing a sample set; constructing a machine learning model; training and testing a machine learning model; and (3) obtaining a forecast result: and dynamically updating the dangerous indexes input by the machine learning model, thereby realizing the real-time updating and forecasting of the typhoon disaster risk. The machine learning model updates the dangerous index input by the machine learning model by using the weather data of actual measurement and prediction, so that the real-time update and prediction of each county is realized.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Transformer substation scene construction method based on live-action three-dimensional digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system digitization, and discloses a transformer substation scene construction method based on live-action three-dimensional digital twinning, which comprises the following steps: s1, building a civil engineering facility and electrical equipment three-dimensional model library of a digital twin body of a transformer substation, wherein the model library comprises 5 sub-libraries of a basic three-dimensional graphic library, a basic three-dimensional unit library, a functional unit structure library, a spatial position library and a facility equipment texture library; s2, splitting the civil engineering of the transformer substation and each electrical device into a functional unit structure according to the design drawing of the target transformer substation. According to the method for constructing the scene of the transformer substation based on the live-action three-dimensional digital twin, the civil engineering facilities and the electrical equipment of the transformer substation are divided into a plurality of functional unit structures according to functions, the functional unit structures are constructed by a plurality of basic three-dimensional units, and the basic three-dimensional units are generated by basic three-dimensional graphics through rotation, translation and scaling, so that the multiplexing of the model is realized, and the modeling efficiency is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Unbalanced distribution network state estimation attack detection method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of attack detection of power distribution networks, and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for detecting state estimation attack of an unbalanced power distribution network, which divide a large-scale power distribution network into a plurality of subareas based on a community discovery method and a subarea scale uniformity principle; then, carrying out prediction auxiliary state estimation based on a square root unscented Kalman filter in a power distribution network subarea, converting a filtering step of the prediction auxiliary state estimation into a redundant linear regression form, applying PS to detect abnormal values, and applying a weighted minimum estimator to the regression form; secondly, calculating dynamic time warping distances of a reference sequence and a test innovation sequence, constructing hypothesis verification based on binary generalized likelihood ratio detection, verifying a verification variable and outputting a sub-region state; and finally, the subregion gathers information and outputs the information to the situation of the attack of the global system. The invention provides a method for the network security problem of the actual distribution network system, which is serious.
assignees: NARI GROUP CORP;NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment monitoring data processing method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for processing monitoring data of power equipment, which relate to the technical field of electric data processing, wherein similarity matrix construction of grouping and data group is carried out on monitoring time sequence data, data cluster analysis and abnormal value division are carried out, replacement of missing data and abnormal data is carried out based on a cluster centroid mean value, data optimization is completed and the data is transmitted to a user terminal, the technical problem that the processing of the monitoring data of the power equipment in the prior art needs to depend on a large number of data samples, the data processing results do not conform to the individual scene of the power equipment due to the difference of the samples is solved, similarity analysis and matrixing processing are carried out on the acquired monitoring time sequence data, so that the cluster centroid is determined to be simplified and efficiently grouped, abnormal data identification is carried out based on the centroid mean value, data processing analysis is carried out based on the monitoring data, and equipment scene suitability of the data processing results is guaranteed.
assignees: BEIJING TIANHENG ANKE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based emergency simulation method and system for flood and drought disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based method and a digital twinning-based system for emergent simulation of a paddy and dry disaster, which are used for extracting data to be simulated of the paddy and dry disaster; determining a simulation model according to the data to be simulated of the flood and drought disasters to obtain simulation model data, and performing underwater topography simulation analysis to obtain emergency simulation data; dividing into different historical arid areas and historical flood areas; obtaining the features and feature vectors of the terrains and underwater terrains of each region; analyzing the difference value of the characteristic vector of each different region; attributing the historical arid regions and the historical flood regions which are smaller than the threshold value to approximate regions; extracting historical underwater topography data values of the similar region; obtaining a verification index through a historical underwater topography data value; and obtaining emergency simulation data through the verification indexes and the underwater topography simulation emergency simulation. The scheme can effectively carry out accurate simulation prediction on the conditions of the flood and drought disasters in all areas, fully considers the characteristics of underwater topography, and accurately predicts the flood and drought disaster prevention and control strategies in the areas.
assignees: HUIJIE DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: SOCP-based robust state estimation method for electric-thermal integrated energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating the robust state of an electric-thermal integrated energy system based on SOCP, which belongs to the technical field of dispatching automation of the electric-thermal integrated energy system, and comprises the following steps: performing bilinear transformation on the state variable, and transforming the nonlinear state estimation model into a linear state estimation model; and constructing an SOCP-based distributed robust state estimation model of the electric-thermal integrated energy system, solving by using an ADMM method, and obtaining a final state variable estimated value by linear transformation and nonlinear transformation of the obtained result. The method is suitable for the distributed state estimation of the comprehensive energy system, and the calculation example analysis shows that the distributed high-precision and high-calculation-efficiency state estimation can be carried out on the electric-thermal comprehensive energy system, the second-order cone constraint of the auxiliary state variable of the electric power system is added, the measurement redundancy loss is compensated, and the estimation precision of the state variable of the electric power system is extremely high; meanwhile, the calculation result verifies that the method has better poor resistance.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;UNIV QINGHAI;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Emergency pretreatment system and emergency treatment twin system for tank farm
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an emergency pre-treatment system and an emergency treatment twin system for a tank farm, and belongs to the technical field of safety engineering. The emergency pre-treatment system comprises: the tank field digital twin model corresponds to the tank field entity structure and is used for simulating the full life cycle process of the tank field; the system comprises a twin application module, a disaster simulation module and a control module, wherein the twin application module is configured with an accident simulation module and is used for simulating tank farm accident data by applying a tank farm digital twin model so as to predict accident evolution, and the disaster simulation module is configured with a disaster simulation module and is used for simulating the predicted accident evolution so as to predict various disaster scenes in the accident evolution; and a plan determining module for determining an emergency pre-treatment plan matched with the predicted disaster scene from a preset emergency treatment plan library. The application predicts various disaster scenes in the accident evolution of the tank farm by utilizing the digital twin model, and further can pertinently determine the emergency pre-treatment plan corresponding to the predicted disaster scene.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RESEARCH INSTITUTE SAFETY ENGINEERING CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Distribution network digital twin visualization method and device based on equipment model library
abstract_en: The application relates to a distribution network digital twin visualization method and a device based on an equipment model library, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a distribution network entity three-dimensional model library aiming at the entities involved in the distribution network; obtaining line topology information and equipment coordinate path information from a power grid resource service center station, and performing containerization classification conversion to generate distribution network line visual imaging data; analyzing the visual imaging data of the distribution network line, acquiring a corresponding model file from the three-dimensional model library of the distribution network entity based on an analysis result, and constructing a visual rendering model according to the model file, the connection relation among devices and the phase information. The application can rapidly realize three-dimensional imaging of the distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target optimal configuration method and system for metering points of direct-current power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for multi-objective optimal configuration of a metering point of a direct-current power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting system parameters of the direct-current power distribution network and establishing a state estimation model of the direct-current power distribution network, calculating a node voltage estimation error rate according to the state estimation model and corresponding measurement values, taking the maximized node voltage estimation error rate as a first evaluation index and taking the minimized first evaluation index as a first optimization target, taking the configuration quantity of a direct-current electric energy meter as a second evaluation index, taking the minimized second evaluation index as a second optimization target, establishing a multi-objective optimal configuration model according to the first optimization target and the second optimization target, carrying out joint solution on the multi-objective optimal configuration model according to a genetic algorithm and a secondary constraint quadratic programming algorithm, obtaining optimal configuration of the metering point of the direct-current power distribution network, and reducing configuration cost of the metering point of the direct-current power distribution network while improving metering resolution of the direct-current power distribution network.

title_en: Power distribution network state structure estimation method and system under condition of few measurement samples
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems and automation thereof, and discloses a power distribution network state structure estimation method and system under the condition of few measurement samples, and power distribution network state structure estimation and meshing; determining a topological structure and load nodes of the distributed power supply nodes and the grid; collecting a power distribution network measurement unit; inputting the acquisition quantity of each measuring unit of the power distribution network, and finishing calculation of error values and measurement error matrixes between nodes of the grid and other measuring units which do not exist; calculating state variables among grids; calculating the grid loss and voltage deviation in each grid and the state estimation value error value of the new sample; the method is characterized in that the principle that the overall network loss of the power distribution network is minimum and the voltage deviation is minimum is adopted, and the state estimation value error of a new sample is used as weight to optimize the topological structure diagram of the power distribution network. The invention provides a solution for panoramic power grid topology construction and data fusion of the distributed new energy access power distribution network, thereby improving the reliability of urban power distribution network regulation and control and power supply.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RES INSTITUTE UESTC HUZHOU

title_en: Power distribution network fault classification method based on ensemble learning and longhorn beetle whisker algorithm
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network fault classification method based on an ensemble learning and longhorn beetle whisker algorithm, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of the measured gas content from the oil chromatograph of the transformer sample, and marking the gas content and the fault type; preprocessing data, filling missing data by using a mean value method, and analyzing by using a correlation index; training a sub-learner according to the existing history data; adopting a longhorn beetle whisker optimization algorithm to intelligently adjust and optimize parameters of a plurality of machine learning algorithms; and calling the integrated learning prediction model which is completed with training to conduct transformer fault classification prediction. The power distribution network fault classification method based on the integrated learning and longhorn beetle whisker algorithm provided by the application has the advantages that the calculation speed is high, the method is suitable for different data set scenes under the action of an integrated learning network for completing training, and a foundation and a basis are provided for the online prediction and classification of faults of the transformer.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-drive-based micro-grid multi-agent coordination optimization control strategy
abstract_en: According to the digital twin-drive-based micro-grid multi-agent coordination optimization control strategy, economic benefits of a micro-grid group system are considered, a mathematical model is built on the basis of the micro-grid group level at the upper layer, a single micro-grid is taken as a research object at the lower layer, and constraint conditions such as power balance, distributed power supply output, energy storage charge and discharge and the like are considered, so that a multi-target mathematical model of the single micro-grid is built. The invention uses the digital twin-drive-based micro-grid multi-agent coordination optimization control strategy to improve the renewable energy utilization rate, reduce the standby capacity of the micro-grid and reduce the investment cost.
assignees: UNIV NANJING AERONAUTICS & ASTRONAUTICS

title_en: Mountain photovoltaic installation operation digital twin system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain photovoltaic installation digital twin operation system and a method, wherein the system comprises a physical entity layer, a twin virtual layer, a twin data layer and a twin decision layer; according to the system, the operation state data and the operation site environment information of each operation equipment in the physical entity layer are collected in real time, the data in the twin data layer are updated in an iterative manner, the operation process is optimized through the twin decision layer, each operation equipment in the physical entity layer and a twin model corresponding to each operation equipment in the twin virtual layer are driven in an interactive manner, and the information management and the automatic operation of mountain photovoltaic transportation and installation are completed, so that the intelligent management and the control of the mountain photovoltaic installation operation process and the visual supervision of the operation site are realized, the mountain photovoltaic installation operation efficiency is improved, and the technical level of mountain photovoltaic power station construction is improved.
assignees: HEFEI INST PHYSICAL SCI CAS

title_en: Data complement method and system for baseline data of virtual power plant
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of industrial big data, in particular to a data complement method and system for baseline data of a virtual power plant; the method comprises the following steps: s1: judging and classifying the missing data types; s2: if the power load data of the response baseline of the working day is missing, supplementing the missing data by adopting a first supplementing method; s3: if the baseline electricity load data is lost for the Saturday or legal holidays, supplementing the lost data by adopting a second supplementing method; s4: and if the baseline electricity load data is in real time response, supplementing the missing data by adopting a third supplementing method. And dividing all power consumption days into working days, saturday days, legal holidays and real-time power consumption according to the power consumption load characteristics, judging the type of the missing data, adopting a complementing method corresponding to different power consumption load characteristics according to the judged type of the missing data, and carrying out secondary correction on the predicted data of the working day sampling points, thereby effectively improving the accuracy of data complementing.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for constructing digital twin model of power transformer based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a digital twin model of a power transformer based on big data, which relates to the technical field of power transformer monitoring and comprises the following steps: collecting data information of the power transformer under normal working conditions and fault working conditions; collecting a time stamp of an update state of the power transformer, uploading the time stamp to a big data platform, and dynamically mapping a virtual object of the power transformer; after the uploaded collected data is subjected to an ETL process, the program updates the attribute state through a hash mapping tag; the beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the three-dimensional visualization of the power transformer can be realized by constructing a digital twin standard model, and the running state of the power transformer can be reflected in real time; data information of the power transformer under normal working conditions and fault working conditions is collected and uploaded to a large data platform, so that various data sources and types can be monitored, and the range and accuracy of the built digital twin model can be monitored are higher.
assignees: WUHAN ELECTRIC POWER TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: GM estimation-based electric heat comprehensive energy system decomposition coordination robust state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GM estimation-based electric heat comprehensive energy system decomposition coordination robust state estimation method, which comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing an IES measurement model; secondly, the IES decomposes and coordinates the construction of a state estimation model; thirdly, the IES decomposition coordination state estimation algorithm sequentially solves decomposition coordination SE of the electric, thermal and natural gas subsystems until the final estimation result meets the global convergence condition, and the IES robust estimation process is finished, and the method has the advantages that: the provided decomposition and coordination SE method has the advantages that the effectiveness of the SE method can be improved, enough calculation precision can be met and the calculation efficiency can be remarkably improved under the condition that the electric, gas and heat subsystems require business privacy and confidentiality and complete real-time network data cannot be shared.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Reservoir water condition forecasting simulation method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy informatization and flood control and disaster reduction, in particular to a reservoir water regime forecasting simulation method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining geographic, remote sensing, topography, engineering characteristics and engineering structure series data of a specific reservoir engineering research area, and constructing a reservoir three-dimensional twin scene by combining a three-dimensional modeling technology; acquiring reservoir characteristic data, modeling the reservoir characteristic data by using a preset hydrological model construction mode, and constructing a reservoir storage forecast model; acquiring reservoir historical flood data, and performing data rating on a reservoir storage forecasting model by utilizing the reservoir historical flood data to acquire an accurate reservoir storage forecasting model; constructing a big data model according to the historical flood data of the reservoir, and constructing a big data warehouse-in flow forecast model; based on the coupling forecasting results of the two models, an interactive interface is developed, and dynamic simulation of the forecasting flow water level result in the reservoir twinning scene is realized.

title_en: Digital twin deduction simulation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deduction simulation and discloses a digital twin deduction simulation system which comprises a system module assembly, wherein the system module assembly comprises a data acquisition module, a data analysis module, a digital twin display module, a decision management and control module, an emergency dispatch module and a signal transmission module, wherein the data analysis module is pre-stored with an algorithm model, the data analysis module comprises an algorithm analysis module, an alarm discrimination module, an abnormal merging module, a data fusion module and an output module, and the data acquisition module is connected with a data acquisition gateway, an internet of things platform, a display module and a fault diagnosis module. The application of the digital twin platform of the three-dimensional technology intuitively and three-dimensionally displays the running condition of the data center infrastructure, improves the efficiency of emergency dispatch processing, realizes the unification of the entity equipment and the virtual display of the data center, and can truly restore emergency measures and effects through a deduction model algorithm.
assignees: JIANGSU LINGU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Lunar electric quantity data expansion method of wind power plant and device using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind farm month electric quantity data expansion method based on daily electric quantity rolling accumulation, which comprises the following steps: s1: supplementing missing data in the original data; s2: processing overrun data in the original data; s3: corresponding interval accumulation is carried out on the data processed in the previous two steps, so that daily wind power output and wind speed data are obtained; s4: screening and replacing abnormal data in the daily weather-electric quantity data; s5: rolling integration is carried out on the daily electric quantity data, and rich and coherent rolling month electric quantity data are obtained through expansion; the invention is constructed in matlab2020b software through a train tool box by a BP neural network, wherein the maximum training times of the network are 2850-3150, the learning rate is 0.0095-0.0105, and the invention solves the problem of insufficient data in the middle-long-term electric quantity prediction process of the month distribution prediction of the annual electric quantity of the wind power plant.
assignees: DALIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV DALIAN TECH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent digital twin management system for railway subgrade deformation monitoring and disaster early warning
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent digital twin management system for railway subgrade deformation monitoring and disaster early warning, which is particularly suitable for permafrost regions, and can be popularized to the construction of emergency early warning systems of other highways, railways and the like. The method comprises the steps of railway subgrade deformation monitoring and early warning, multiple data monitoring and analysis, a railway subgrade deformation prediction model, disaster early warning index control, a digital twin 3D visual data interaction model, cross-platform application and early warning and forecast information transmission. According to the invention, the digital twinning, deep learning and other technologies are adopted to establish the visual interaction model along the 3D railway, so that the accurate synchronous visual display of the monitoring data, the early warning information, the on-site image and the 3D model is realized, and the relevant responsible person can conveniently grasp the relevant data along the railway more intuitively and rapidly. Meanwhile, the invention can realize all-weather, large-scale and high-precision railway subgrade deformation monitoring and real-time disaster early warning for the railway line in the difficult region of the high-cold and high-altitude frozen soil region.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-element load data complement method based on artificial mask convolution self-encoder
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-element load data complement method based on an artificial mask convolution self-encoder, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of electric, cold and heat loads of an IES, and step two: and (5) remolding the multi-element load data and obtaining a missing position matrix. Step three: and carrying out normalization processing on the multi-element load data. Step four: and building an AML-CAE model to realize missing data interpolation of multiple loads. Step five: AML-CAE was trained. Step six: AML-CAE is achieved by reducing L  aml  The distribution of non-missing values is learned, and a trained AML-CAE model can be obtained after AML-CAE iteration is completed. The invention adopts a convolution self-encoder as a deep learning network structure, combines an updating strategy of an artificial missing position mask and an initialization method of linear interpolation, and is used for interpolating missing values in IES multi-element load data. The method adopts a self-supervision learning strategy and does not depend on a complete data set, so that the method has higher practicability and application meaning.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI;HANGZHOU QIANTANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Disaster Safety Management Platform using Digital Twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 적용 재난 안전 관리 플랫폼
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide a platform which is capable of preventing, in advance, a disaster about an object more quickly and conveniently by building a digital twin city and analyzing and comparing objects in a city with pre-built digital twin city information using artificial intelligence. To this end, a disaster safety management platform using a digital twin for public safety is provided. The disaster safety management platform using a digital twin comprises: a drone which generates and transmits video data; and a disaster safety management system which builds a digital twin city using the video data received from the drone, selects a specific object among objects constituting the digital twin city when a specific event occurs, obtains video data on the corresponding object from the drone, determines whether a disaster has occurred for the object through artificial intelligence, and notifies a manager of the corresponding object of the determined result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 시티를 구축하고 도시내의 객체를 인공지능을 이용하여 미리 구축한 디지털 트윈 시티 정보와 비교 분석함으로써 보다 빠르고 편리하게 객체에 대한 재난을 미리 예방할 수 있는 플랫폼을 제공하는 것이 목적이다. 이를 위해서, 공공 안전을 위한 디지털 트윈 적용 재난 안전 관리 플랫폼에 있어서, 영상데이터를 생성하여 전송하는 드론; 및 상기 드론으로부터 수신한 영상 데이터를 이용하여 디지털 트윈 시티를 구축하고, 특정 이벤트 발생시 상기 디지털 트윈 시티를 구성하는 객체 중에서 특정 객체를 선정하고, 상기 드론으로부터 해당 객체에 대한 영상 데이터를 획득하여 인공지능을 통해 상기 객체에 대한 재난 발생 여부를 판단하여, 이를 해당 객체의 관리자에게 통보하는 재난 안전 관리 시스템;을 포함하는 디지털 트윈 적용 재난 안전 관리 플랫폼을 제공한다.
assignees: RAINBOWTECH

title_en: Digital twin based virtualization system for electrical equipment maintenance
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 설비 유지보수 가상화 시스템
abstract_en: According to the embodiment of the present invention, provided is a digital twin-based facility maintenance virtualization system. According to the present invention, the maintenance system minimizes the loss of power generation and is more stable and efficient by rapidly and conveniently solving a problem by considering the characteristics of a renewable energy industry field. Also, a problem can be rapidly and efficiently solved and a predictive maintenance work is allowed through prediction on the basis of artificial intelligence (AI) analysis of accumulated big data while virtualization of facilities, such as a power converter and the like through the use of a digital twin technology. In addition, a failure case database for the maintenance of a power converter, which is core equipment of a renewable energy power plant can be constructed. Also, a digital twin prototype of a power converter based on augmented reality can be implemented and a real power converter and digital space data can be virtualized in real time. Accordingly, a maintenance system for a renewable energy power plant can be efficient.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 디지털 트윈 기반의 설비 유지보수 가상화 시스템에 의하면, 신재생에너지 산업분야의 특성을 고려한 신속하고 편리한 문제 해결을 통해 발전손실을 최소화하고 보다 안정적이고 효율적인 유지보수 시스템을 제공할 수 있고, 디지털 트윈 기술의 활용을 통해 전력변환기 등의 설비 가상화와 더불어 축적된 빅데이터의 인공지능(AI) 분석을 기반으로 하여 문제점의 신속하고 효율적인 해결은 물론 사전 예측을 통한 예지보전 작업을 가능케 해 줄 수 있는 유지보수 시스템을 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있으며, 신재생에너지 발전소 핵심장비인 전력변환기 유지보수를 위한 고장사례 데이터베이스 구축이 가능하며, 증강현실 기반의 전력변환기의 디지털 트윈 시제품 구현 및 전력변환기 실물과 디지털공간 데이터의 실시간 시각화 구현이 가능하고, 이를 통해서 신재생에너지 발전소 유지보수 시스템의 효율화가 가능한 효과가 있다.
assignees: DESTINPOWER INC

title_en: Photovoltaic digital twin method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a photovoltaic digital twin method, which comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a basic model for reflecting the relation between the first photovoltaic output and irradiance and temperature, and obtaining the first photovoltaic output according to the irradiance and the temperature; s2: establishing a neural network prediction model of the relation between the second photovoltaic output and irradiance, temperature, humidity, wind speed, pm2.5 and the first photovoltaic output, and predicting to obtain the second photovoltaic output according to the input irradiance, temperature, humidity, wind speed, pm2.5 and the first photovoltaic output; s3: and multiplying the second photovoltaic output by the photovoltaic panel area coefficient and the photovoltaic panel efficiency coefficient to obtain a third photovoltaic output. According to the application, higher modeling precision can be obtained and the complexity of the model is reduced through hierarchical model modeling, so that the output state of the photovoltaic can be accurately mastered, and the operation stability of the photovoltaic incorporated into the power grid is improved.
assignees: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;INST ELECTRICAL ENG CAS;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twin panoramic management and control system and method for urban cable
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin panoramic management and control system and method for urban cables, and relates to the technical field of power systems, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises an acoustic wave monitoring module, a temperature monitoring module, a circuit monitoring module, a video monitoring module, a data processing module and a panoramic display module, wherein the acoustic wave monitoring module is used for generating acoustic wave characteristic information; the temperature monitoring module is used for generating a temperature early warning signal; the circuit monitoring module is used for generating power data; the video monitoring module is used for generating a damage early warning signal; the data processing module is used for generating running state data according to the sound wave characteristic information, the temperature early warning signal, the electric power data and the damage early warning signal and transmitting the running state data to the panoramic display module; the panoramic display module is used for carrying out digital processing on the running state data and carrying out three-dimensional panoramic display on the processed running state data. The invention realizes the comprehensive control of the cable related information, so that the cable related information is orderly and clear, the cable fault judging accuracy is improved, and the maintenance efficiency is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Disaster avoidance path dynamic planning method, system and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster avoidance path dynamic planning method, a disaster avoidance path dynamic planning system and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first position and a second position in a digital twin space corresponding to a target place; taking the first position as a starting point and the second position as an ending point, and carrying out path planning based on the passing cost of the sub-path between the first position and the second position to obtain the passing cost of a plurality of candidate paths; a target path is determined among the plurality of candidate paths based on the traffic cost for each candidate path. The distance of each candidate path and the influence degree of each candidate path on safety accidents are comprehensively considered, and the time spent and the risk faced by different candidate paths are weighed based on the passing cost of a plurality of candidate paths, so that a target path which accords with the actual production operation environment is dynamically planned, the personnel evacuation efficiency is improved, and the casualties are reduced.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE SHANGHAI INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD;CMIM NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent water plant integrated management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based intelligent water plant integrated management system, which comprises a building module, an updating module, a generating module and a predicting module, wherein the building module, the updating module, the generating module and the predicting module can build a three-dimensional model of a target water plant, update parameters of the three-dimensional model according to real-time equipment information and sensing information of water plant equipment, and can receive roaming instructions and control instructions of users and predict control results. Therefore, the invention can provide more intelligent and more visual water plant management for water plant management users by means of a three-dimensional technology and a neural network algorithm technology, and improves the efficiency and effect of water plant management.

title_en: System and method for conveniently storing, classifying and inquiring massive daily clear electric quantity data
