abstract_en: The application provides a system and a method for conveniently storing, classifying and inquiring massive solar clear electric quantity data, which relate to the field of data processing methods and comprise a data processing module, wherein the data processing module is configured to: processing the collected solar clear electric quantity data, including fitting missing data, to obtain electric quantity data with different types of time stamps; a data storage module configured to: the distributed database HBase is utilized, a chain type storage mode is adopted, and electric quantity data are stored; a data query module configured to: multidimensional inquiry is carried out on the stored electric quantity data; based on the HBase technology, the application constructs a distributed data storage and inquiry system through chained storage, realizes the rapid storage and inquiry of the daily clear electric quantity data, and helps the staff of the electric power company to rapidly inquire the daily clear electric quantity data, thereby realizing the tracking and predictive analysis of the daily clear electric quantity and the monthly junction electric quantity data.

title_en: Data-intensive rain-type intelligent identification and urban rainfall scene data set construction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a data-intensive rain intelligent identification and urban rainfall situation data set construction method. The construction method mainly comprises the following steps: 1) Generating a city scene rainfall sample data set; 2) Generating urban rain-type intelligent classification and a rain-type data set; 3) Standard rain type identification of each rainfall station in the city; 4) Calculating a rainfall process of the scene design; 5) And generating a city rainfall scene data set. The urban rainfall scenario data set constructed by the invention not only comprises historical scene rainfall but also comprises each rainfall type design rainfall with different guarantee rates, covers the urban possible rainfall process, and can provide rainfall scenario for the construction of a digital twin urban flood control system.
assignees: UNIV JILIN

title_en: Electric power data analysis method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power data analysis method based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of power data analysis, and comprises the following steps: the server collects power data under the Internet of things; the server pre-processes the collected power data to remove abnormal data, and specifically comprises the following steps: generating missing data and processing data generating distortion; the server transmits the preprocessed power data to upload to the upper computer, and the upper computer analyzes and processes the power data; establishing a power demand prediction model influenced by comprehensive weather, seasons and holidays; the power demand prediction model displays a prediction result in a segmented mode according to the set time granularity; and the upper computer performs visual display on the analyzed power data and the history data. And the electric power data analysis is performed based on the Internet of things, so that the data transmission delay is reduced, the calculation rate is accelerated, and the support for real-time monitoring, connection and acquisition is provided for the electric power data analysis.

title_en: Method for forecasting flood of medium and small river based on digital twin and AI technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster forecasting, and discloses a method for forecasting medium and small river floods based on digital twinning and AI technology, which comprises the following steps: screening out local river areas with high risk marks and medium risk marks; performing comprehensive evaluation analysis processing based on the high-risk marks and the medium-risk marks to acquire first output data; carrying out regression analysis processing on the historical river data by utilizing a pre-constructed flood regression model to obtain second output data; performing simulation analysis processing on the actually measured river data by using a pre-constructed river digital twin model to obtain third output data; taking the actually measured river data and the first output data as a first sample set, taking the historical river data and the second output data as a second sample set, and taking the actually measured river data and the third output data as a third sample set; constructing a flood prediction model based on the first sample set, the second sample set and the third sample set; and carrying out prediction analysis on the medium and small rivers by using a flood prediction model.

title_en: Power system load prediction system and method based on cyclic neural network and tensor decomposition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system load prediction system based on a cyclic neural network and tensor decomposition, which is suitable for a short-term prediction system of power grid load. The data set after deleting the outliers is obtained through data cleaning. The recorded time series data is divided into a plurality of time slices by selecting a proper basic time window, and the time slices are spliced into a two-dimensional tensor. The missing data is interpolated using a Singular Value Thresholding (SVT) algorithm, wherein an optimal solution of an interpolation matrix is obtained using an alternating iterative approach, the matrix being used as the completed sample data. Then, a distance matrix between different power utilization sequences is calculated by using dynamic time sequence regulation (DTW), a time sequence with high similarity is used as one type of data, and load prediction is carried out on each type of data through a supervised improved LSTM algorithm. The invention can better cope with the unbalance problem of power supply and demand, effectively assist the safe and economic operation of the novel power system and improve the stability and reliability of the power system.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Intelligent safety management method and system for electric power work
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance of an electric power system, in particular to an intelligent safety management method and system for electric power work, which are used for collecting dynamic data of the working process of a worker, wherein the dynamic data of the working process of the worker comprises the working data of the worker, natural data of the working environment where the worker is positioned and real-time monitoring data of electric power monitoring equipment, the dynamic data of the working process of the worker is substituted into a preset dynamic evaluation model of the worker to obtain dynamic safety data of the worker, the dynamic safety data of the worker is displayed in a digital twin model to obtain a safety evaluation result of the worker, and the problems that the existing intelligent safety technology for electric power work cannot evaluate the safety state of the worker and provide safety early warning information are solved.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGTUO XINYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data monitoring method and device based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application discloses a data monitoring method and device based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of respectively acquiring holographic data in each application scene; constructing a digital twin model to be optimized according to a preset training sample set and a test sample set; optimizing the digital twin model to be optimized based on a preset time dimension weight, a space dimension weight and a history dimension weight; inputting the holographic data into the target digital twin model to cause the target digital twin model to output an associated processing result. According to the digital twin-based data monitoring method and device provided by the embodiment of the application, the digital twin model is optimized through the time dimension weight, the space dimension weight and the history dimension weight, so that a more accurate digital twin model processing result can be obtained, and further, the actual fault equipment can be monitored in real time, the fault cause of the fault equipment can be accurately analyzed, the overhaul efficiency of the fault equipment is improved, and the stable operation of the power grid equipment is ensured.
assignees: HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;BEIJING HUAKE ZHIXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method of linear state estimation of a distribution network from synchronous smart meter and line sensor
abstract_en: A system for determining a linear state estimation of a power distribution network The system includes a plurality of metering devices, a plurality of power sources, each of the plurality of power sources coupled to a respective metering device, and a plurality of collection devices, each of the plurality of collection devices in electronic communication with a respective metering device. The plurality of collection devices measure an Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) dataset and calculate a phase angle of the power source coupled to the metering device. The system includes a host device in electronic communication with the plurality of collection devices. An electronic processor of the host device receives the AMI dataset and the phase angle of the plurality of metering devices, determines the linear state estimation of the power distribution network based on the phase angle and the AMI dataset, and identifies information associated with the power distribution network.
assignees: ACLARA TECH LLC

title_en: Scheduling method for virtual power plant to participate in electric power market transaction based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides a dispatching method for participation in electric power market transaction of a virtual power plant based on digital twinning, which obtains the overall adjustable capacity of the virtual power plant by evaluating the adjustable capacity of an adjustable energy source participating in the electric power market transaction in the virtual power plant; the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin simulation model, establishing a day-ahead and day-in two-stage optimization scheduling model of a virtual power plant participating in electric power market transaction, and solving to obtain an optimal scheduling strategy by combining a receiving scheduling system to issue scheduling demands and based on a prediction result of each adjustable energy source; the optimization of the control strategy is realized, and meanwhile, in the day-ahead and day-in two-stage optimization scheduling, the day-ahead scheduling stage takes the maximum operation income of the virtual power plant as an objective function; and in the intra-day scheduling stage, the minimum operation cost and the minimum power fluctuation of the virtual power plant system are taken as objective functions, and the overall economic benefit of the virtual power plant is maximized on the basis of reasonably distributing self resources.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue plan method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a fire rescue plan method and system based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of fire rescue, the method includes: inputting the obtained building basic information, fire-fighting power data and a preset fire scene into a fire-fighting rescue plan analysis model, and performing rationality evaluation to generate a fire-fighting rescue plan; based on a digital twin system, carrying out three-dimensional visual simulation on the fire-fighting rescue plan to obtain the fire-fighting rescue visual plan; the application can effectively improve the visual degree of the fire-extinguishing rescue plan through a digital twin technology, solves the problems of low efficiency and precision of the programming of the fire-extinguishing rescue plan of a high-rise building, and provides practical data support and guidance for fire-extinguishing rescue actions, thereby realizing the effect of improving the efficiency and precision of the fire-extinguishing rescue actions.
assignees: CHINA FIRE AND RESCUE INST

title_en: Area disaster prevention system and method using digital twin, and computer-readable medium thereof
abstract_en: To provide an area disaster prevention system and method using a digital twin, and a computer-readable medium thereof.SOLUTION: An area disaster prevention system includes a plurality of smart building devices and a smart city management platform. The plurality of smart building devices each transmit a plurality of pieces of building environment information of a corresponding building, and the smart city management platform receives the plurality of pieces of building environment information and determines whether or not a disaster has occurred in the building. According to the present invention, when a disaster occurs in the building, it is possible to effectively assess the extent of the impact of the disaster, notify the public and disaster prevention related organizations of the occurrence of the disaster in real time, and ensure the safety of people's lives.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: CHUNGHWA TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Power plant production risk point twinning visual method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power plant risk visualization, in particular to a power plant production risk point twinning visualization method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring electric quantity data of a power plant in a working state, and establishing a corresponding digital twin model of the power plant; setting a plurality of monitoring points in a power plant, and collecting operation data in the monitoring points; carrying out risk analysis on the electric quantity data through a digital twin model of the power plant to obtain a preliminary risk coefficient; determining risk monitoring points through the operation data, adjusting the preliminary risk coefficients according to the operation data in the risk monitoring points to obtain final risk coefficients, and carrying out early warning according to the final risk coefficients. According to the invention, whether a power plant has risk points or not is judged according to the preliminary risk coefficient obtained by carrying out risk analysis on electric quantity data by the digital twin model of the power plant, the risk monitoring points are determined according to the operation data acquired by the monitoring points, and early warning prompt is carried out on the monitoring points with risk of the power plant to remind workers of timely maintenance.
assignees: GUIZHOU JINYUAN CHAYUAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;BEIJING ZHONGAN RUILI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system dynamic state estimation observability evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the observability of dynamic state estimation of a power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring characteristics, connection topology and measurement data of all electrical nodes in the power system; classifying all the electrical nodes according to the properties of the electrical nodes; clustering all the electrical nodes according to the quantity of measured data of each electrical node according to the condition that the dynamic state estimation has observability, obtaining full data, first type of data and second type of data, combining the electrical node connection topology, and determining an observability area, a processed observability area and an unobservability area of the dynamic state estimation by carrying out dynamic state estimation and data complementation based on the types of the electrical nodes. The invention can determine the dynamic state estimation partition of the observability more quickly and accurately, can realize the observability estimation of the dynamic state estimation of the area and the maximization of the area of the observability area, and helps to better estimate the running state of the distribution network.

title_en: Oil-filled submarine cable body state evaluation method and evaluation system
abstract_en: The application discloses an oil-filled submarine cable state evaluation method and system, which are used for solving the existing problems of the state evaluation of the existing new energy power equipment and the lack of related oil-filled submarine cable state evaluation method in the intelligent operation and maintenance field. Aiming at the characteristics of the built-in oil duct of the oil-filled submarine cable and long-distance cross-sea monitoring, the application constructs an oil-filled submarine cable state evaluation index set of distributed temperature strain monitoring, oil pump system real-time monitoring data and operation maintenance data; aiming at different state evaluation indexes, determining index weights by adopting an analytic hierarchy process and a principal component analysis process; a weight dynamic adjustment method is provided for abnormal data and missing data. Compared with the traditional buckling method and the analytic hierarchy process, the method for evaluating the state of the oil-filled submarine cable, constructed by the application, can effectively highlight the influence of faults and abnormal data on the oil-filled submarine cable, and objectively and accurately reflect the actual running state of the oil-filled submarine cable.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Construction method and system of distribution network digital twin body
abstract_en: The method and the system for constructing the distribution network digital twin body are characterized by comprising the following steps: step 1, constructing a digital twin model of power grid equipment, displaying the real-time state of the equipment on the basis, and realizing the spatial layout of twin objects by utilizing GIS+point cloud constraint; step 2, adding the topological association relationship into a digital twin object of the power grid facility based on a topological package in a general model description specification (CIM/E) of the power grid; and 3, checking whether the space layout and the topological connection meet the specifications according to the design specifications of the power grid in the digital twin space. The application meets the requirements of the scene modeling method on accuracy and fidelity, and greatly improves the efficiency of distribution network design and scene analysis of designers in digital twin space.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network observability analysis method based on linear rotation transformation, electronic equipment and readable medium
abstract_en: The application provides a power distribution network observability analysis method based on linear rotation transformation, electronic equipment and a readable medium, belonging to the technical field of power distribution network observability analysis and state estimation, comprising the following steps: carrying out power distribution network observability analysis based on voltage phase angle measurement and voltage amplitude measurement, and judging whether the power distribution system is considerable or not; and carrying out linear rotation transformation on measurement data of a considerable distribution system or a considerable island of node voltage to realize multiphase state estimation of the distribution network. The line parameters are used as the input of the observability analysis module and are embodied in the form of a rotation transformation matrix, so that the decoupled numerical observability analysis method is applied to the power distribution network, and the solving speed is increased while the estimation accuracy is improved.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Distributed power supply access and panoramic management and control application method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a distributed power supply access and panorama management and control application method and a system, comprising the following steps: treating user load data and distributed photovoltaic data; analyzing the correlation between the missing data of the distributed photovoltaic and the output of each adjacent distributed photovoltaic, and restoring and completing the missing data; predicting the load and the photovoltaic output in advance and monitoring and counting the photovoltaic output in real time; integrating the operation state and the photovoltaic output condition of the equipment on the line according to the voltage level, and combining with geographic information to display the operation state; constructing multiple layers to monitor new energy facilities, evaluating the bearing capacity of a distributed power supply, and balancing the load and the distributed energy output; and the safety is improved by adopting a load control mode of the cooperation of the main and the distribution network. The application realizes the functions of user load and distributed photovoltaic data management and operation supervision, the assessment of the carrying capacity of the distributed power supply in the area and the cooperation of the main distribution network, and the accurate and rapid load control function of the cooperation of the main distribution network, and improves the monitoring and controlling level of the distribution network.
assignees: BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: Tunnel tunneling disaster monitoring and early warning system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunneling, in particular to a digital twinning-based tunneling disaster monitoring and early warning system. Comprising the following steps: the system comprises an inversion learning operation module, a tunnel construction entity module, a twin digital model and a twin database. The invention establishes a digital twin model based on the real development environment of the tunnel and the underground space, simulates the whole development process of the tunnel and the underground space, visualizes the whole construction state, gives early warning to the disasters about to happen, and can update and optimize the model according to the on-site construction, thereby developing the driving protection for the traffic country construction and the underground space in China.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION 3RD ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY INVEST CONSTRUCTION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Method and apparatus for energy data service using energy non-identifiable data
title_ko: 에너지 비식별 데이터를 이용한 에너지 데이터 서비스 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and an apparatus for an energy data service using energy non-identifiable data. An embodiment of the present invention provides the method for an energy data service using energy non-identifiable data comprises the steps of: receiving, from a user terminal, a user's energy personal information including energy usage data measured through remote metering; generating energy non-identifiable information by pseudonymizing or anonymizing the received energy personal information; transmitting the generated energy non-identifiable information to an energy analysis service device; provide the user terminal with installation information of a solar power generation facility and a method for utilizing solar power generation energy based on an energy usage analysis result analyzed by the energy analysis service device; and providing an energy data service selected by the user terminal based on an energy alarm event of the energy analysis service device. Therefore, the present invention can provide a method for operating a platform that provides an infant community near the user based on a digital twin by using the user's location information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 에너지 비식별 데이터를 이용한 에너지 데이터 서비스 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예는 사용자 단말로부터 원격 검침을 통해 검침된 에너지 사용량 데이터가 포함된 사용자의 에너지 개인 정보를 수신하는 단계, 상기 수신된 에너지 개인 정보를 가명화 또는 익명화하여 에너지 비식별 정보를 생성하는 단계, 상기 생성된 에너지 비식별 정보를 에너지 분석 서비스 장치에 전송하는 단계, 상기 에너지 분석 서비스 장치에서 분석된 에너지 사용량 분석 결과를 기초로 하여 태양광 발전 설비의 설치 정보와 태양광 발전 에너지의 활용 방식을 사용자 단말에 가이드하는 단계, 및 상기 에너지 분석 서비스 장치로부터의 에너지 알람 이벤트를 기초로 하여 상기 사용자 단말에 의해 선택된 에너지 데이터 서비스를 제공하는 단계를 포함하는, 에너지 비식별 데이터를 이용한 에너지 데이터 서비스 방법을 제공한다.
assignees: NURIFLEX CO LTD

title_en: Distributed power supply evaluation method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power systems and digital twinning, and discloses a distributed power supply evaluation method and a distributed power supply evaluation system based on digital twinning. According to the method, short-circuit current, harmonic verification, voltage deviation and voltage fluctuation calculation are carried out on the basis of carrying out load flow calculation and electromagnetic transient analysis on the distributed power supply, so that the problem that an existing distributed power supply access point electric energy quality evaluation system cannot comprehensively evaluate a distributed power supply grid-connected strategy in advance, and a more reasonable grid-connected scheme cannot be determined is solved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: State estimation method and system for power distribution network with distributed power supply
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid operation and maintenance, and discloses a state estimation method and a state estimation system for a power distribution network with a distributed power supply based on a chaos azalea search algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining an objective function; initializing a population; calculating an objective function value according to the selected wave band subset in the bird nest discrete position, and recording a local optimal solution of each bird nest and a global optimal solution of the population; sequencing objective function values, performing chaotic disturbance on m positions with better quality, and updating the existing bird nest positions of the rest positions according to a azalea search algorithm; comparing the random number r epsilon [0,1] with the probability p that the host bird finds an external bird egg, and if r > p, randomly generating a new position as the existing bird nest position; comparing the position of the previous generation of bird nest with the position of the existing bird nest, and if the position of the existing bird nest is better, updating the position of the existing bird nest into the current position of the bird nest; judging whether the circulation meets the termination condition, if so, ending the algorithm operation, and outputting the global optimal bird nest position, otherwise, continuously updating the bird nest position.
assignees: SIPING POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID JILINSHENG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Reservoir group multi-target optimal scheduling simulation method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir group multi-target optimal scheduling simulation method and system based on digital twinning, and belongs to the technical field of reservoir group optimal scheduling. The existing multi-objective optimal dispatching scheme for reservoir groups has the defects of long searching time, possibility of occurrence of local suboptimal solutions and the like, thereby influencing the overall comprehensive benefits of optimal dispatching of the reservoir groups. According to the reservoir group multi-objective optimization scheduling simulation method based on digital twinning, the reservoir group is subjected to multi-objective optimization scheduling simulation by constructing the initial flood discharge scheduling model, the density calculation model, the fitness calculation model and the optimization scheduling model, the diversity of flood discharge schemes is maintained by using the density, and the flood discharge schemes are prevented from being gathered in certain areas of a target space, so that the defects of local suboptimal solution and the like can be effectively avoided, the searching time can be effectively shortened, global optimization of reservoir group scheduling problems can be realized, and the overall comprehensive benefit of reservoir group optimization scheduling can be effectively improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUANSUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Filling method of resident customer payment information missing data based on matrix decomposition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resident electric power payment work order data cleaning, in particular to a payment work order missing data filling method based on matrix decomposition. The invention adopts SVT algorithm, which is an algorithm based on matrix threshold decomposition, and uses the low rank property of matrix to complete matrix. Firstly, preprocessing acquired resident payment work order data, converting text data into numerical data through coding, and setting a missing value to be 0; then, collecting the observed value to form a new matrix omega, wherein the element of the new matrix omega is 0 or 1; finally setting parameters required by SVT algorithm, iterating to obtain a new low-rank matrix, which can well fill the missing value of the original matrix, and decoding the text data after filling to obtain a final result. The method has high calculation speed, can effectively complement a large-scale sparse matrix, can well complement missing data of resident electric power payment work orders, and has high practical value.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Wire icing simulation forecasting method based on data assimilation and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a wire icing simulation forecasting method based on data assimilation and artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps: step 1, forecasting meteorological elements influencing ice coating generation of a power transmission line; step 2, adjusting an initial field of weather mode prediction, and optimizing the result of numerical mode prediction in the step 1; step 3, performing deviation correction processing on the numerical mode forecast result obtained after optimization in the step 2; step 4, judging whether ice coating is generated or not, and marking the geographical position where the electric wire ice coating is likely to occur to form an ice coating space distribution information field of the concerned area; and 5, outputting an early warning result of the ice coating thickness of the area. According to the invention, the artificial intelligent integrated constraint model is used for correcting the weather forecast data field, the corrected weather information is obtained, the mathematical method is used for calculating to obtain the icing spatial distribution field, the icing thickness forecast result is output, and the wire icing early warning problem is assisted to be solved.
assignees: NANJING SANYUN TECH CO LTD;HUANENG NANJING JINLING POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network state determining method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for determining a power distribution network state and electronic equipment, and can be applied to the technical field of power distribution network state estimation. The method comprises the following steps: responding to a power distribution network state determining request, and acquiring a measurement value sequence of each of a plurality of nodes included in the power distribution network; for each of the plurality of time sections, determining system time information corresponding to the time section; determining a target measurement value of each of the plurality of nodes from a measurement value sequence of each of the plurality of nodes based on the system time information; obtaining measurement data of the power distribution network under the time section based on the target measurement values of each of the plurality of nodes, and obtaining a plurality of groups of measurement data related to the plurality of time sections; inputting a plurality of groups of measurement data into a Gaussian process regression model to obtain a plurality of groups of state estimation data; and determining the voltage state values of each of a plurality of nodes included in the power distribution network based on the evaluation results of the plurality of groups of state estimation data.

title_en: Nuclear power live-action twin platform construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nuclear power live-action twin platform construction method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: importing a panoramic view of the pre-configuration information; introducing a digital twin body of a nuclear power plant; identifying a panoramic icon identifier and a digital twin identifier according to a preset rule; and obtaining an association result according to the panoramic image identifier and the digital twin body identifier, and completing association. By implementing the invention, the states of various equipment data, complex association, easy occurrence of data island and the like in the original system are broken, and various scenes and equipment data in the prior nuclear power are associated in a manner of combining a twin body and panorama, so that the nuclear power equipment is more visually presented.
assignees: FUJIAN NINGDE NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for driving energy storage power station scene based on real-time meteorological data
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for driving an energy storage power station scene based on real-time meteorological data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: creating an energy storage power station digital twin scene corresponding to an energy storage power station, creating an energy storage power station digital twin scene corresponding to the energy storage power station under different weather types based on the energy storage power station digital twin scene and the weather types, determining real-time meteorological data of the energy storage power station, determining a target energy storage power station digital twin scene corresponding to a target weather type from candidate energy storage power station digital twin scenes corresponding to various weather types which are created in advance based on the target weather types corresponding to the real-time meteorological data, and displaying the target energy storage power station digital twin scene. Therefore, the current weather condition of the energy storage power station can be rapidly known by the management operation staff through the weather effect in the digital twin scene of the energy storage power station by displaying the digital twin scene of the energy storage power station with the weather effect, and the efficiency of knowing the real-time weather condition of the energy storage power station is improved.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: BP neural network-based data enhancement method for pseudo measurement of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to a data enhancement method for pseudo measurement of a power distribution network based on a BP neural network, which comprises the following steps: step 1, calculating the average value of measurement data of each node; step 2, determining bad data; step 3, finishing data prediction on a time sequence by using the trained BP neural network through historical data; regarding the node where the identified bad data is located, taking the predicted current time value as a correction value of the bad data, thereby completing bad data identification; step 4, obtaining measurement data to be complemented; step 5, determining missing data nodes and missing number; step 6, complementing the missing data; step 7, calculating state estimation based on a current matching method; step 8, a plurality of groups of measurement data meeting convergence conditions are used as training sets; and 9, completing the measurement data filling work of the missing measurement node. The application can complete the work of data prediction and data completion by applying the optimized BP neural network.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY CHENGDONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Simulation modeling method and device for energy storage power station and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an energy storage power station simulation modeling method, an energy storage power station simulation modeling device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining modeling data of the energy storage power station, wherein the modeling data at least comprise geometric data, physical data, behavior data and rule data, constructing a simulation model of the energy storage power station based on the modeling data, obtaining actual operation data of the energy storage power station, constructing a digital twin model of the energy storage power station based on the simulation model and the actual operation data, analyzing the operation mode of the energy storage power station based on the digital twin model, accurately building the simulation model for the energy storage power station based on the various data such as the geometric data, the physical data, the behavior data and the rule data, constructing the digital twin model based on the simulation model, and analyzing the operation of the energy storage power station based on the digital twin model, so that the operation benefit of the energy storage power station is improved.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: Water conservancy monitoring method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based water conservancy monitoring method and system, which relate to the technical field of water conservancy monitoring, wherein rainfall conditions in a monitoring area are monitored, a rainfall condition set is established, a rainfall condition coefficient is generated, if the rainfall condition set is larger than a condition threshold value, current flood related parameters are collected in a first sampling area, a first water surface parameter set is established after summarization, and a first risk coefficient is generated; setting a data acquisition point in a second sampling area, acquiring current flood state parameters, and establishing a second risk coefficient; generating a comprehensive risk coefficient by the first risk coefficient and the second risk coefficient, and establishing a digital twin water conservancy model covering the monitoring area; and carrying out simulation analysis on the flood change in the monitoring area to obtain the flood characteristics in the monitoring area, and matching with a corresponding flood drainage strategy. And compared with monitoring the flood risk through single data acquisition or monitoring equipment, the flood risk monitoring system has wider coverage range.

title_en: Liquid heating equipment with prevent dry combustion method device fault detection function
abstract_en: The invention relates to liquid heating equipment with a dry-heating prevention device fault detection function, which comprises a heating container, a dry-heating prevention device, a fault judging unit and a controller, wherein the dry-heating prevention device and the fault judging unit are electrically connected with the controller, the fault judging unit is used for detecting the working state of the dry-heating prevention device and judging whether the dry-heating prevention device breaks down or not, and the dry-heating prevention device comprises a bottom liquid level sensor arranged at a position, close to the bottom, of a liquid heating chamber, a top liquid level sensor arranged at a position, close to the top, of the liquid heating chamber, and a liquid supplementing device connected with a liquid supplementing port. According to the invention, the fault judging unit can timely find out when the dry-burning prevention device breaks down, so that safety protection is provided when the dry-burning prevention device breaks down, the product quality problem caused by device failure is reduced, and serious safety accidents such as scald, fire disaster and the like caused by liquid level sensor failure of the liquid heating equipment can be obviously reduced or even stopped.

title_en: Efficient processing method and system for electric power data based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a digital twin-based efficient power data processing method and system. The method comprises the steps of extracting a trend sequence to be fitted by decomposing and eliminating seasonal items of a power data time sequence; obtaining a fitting window of a trend sequence to be fitted and screening out outliers; the jump degree is obtained by analyzing the local jump property and the neighborhood jump property of the outlier, so that the abnormal sensitivity degree is obtained and the abnormal sensitive point is screened; dynamically adjusting a fitting window according to the abnormal sensitivity degree and the position condition of the abnormal sensitive points to obtain a trend curve; and correcting the seasonal curve and the residual curve by utilizing the trend curve, and further inputting the seasonal curve and the residual curve into a trained digital twin model for analysis and monitoring. According to the invention, the accurate trend curve is obtained by self-adaptively adjusting the size of the fitting window, so that the seasonal curve and the residual curve are corrected, and the analysis and the monitoring of the digital twin model on the electric power data are more efficient and accurate.

title_en: Method and system for calculating available transmission capacity of electric-gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of comprehensive energy systems, and discloses a method and a system for calculating the available transmission capacity of an electric-gas comprehensive energy system, wherein data driving and model driving are fused at first, information hidden in massive state data is fully mined, and therefore the iterative calculation process of a traditional physical model is simplified, and the calculation time is shortened; secondly, constructing a digital twin model to process continuously updated state quantity data in the comprehensive energy system in real time, realizing online calculation of maximum power transmission capacity and extracting characteristics of the running state of the system; and finally, performing ATC calculation of the comprehensive energy system by using the extracted features. The invention provides a digital twin concept application form aiming at ATC calculation in EGIES by analyzing the applicability of digital twin in EGIES. The method can be used for calculating the real-time value or the predicted value of other indexes reflecting the current running state of the system, and lays a foundation for establishing an evaluation system taking EGIES safety evaluation as a target.
assignees: SIPING POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID JILINSHENG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Photovoltaic power station short-term power intelligent prediction method based on TXP-MTGNN neural network model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation prediction, in particular to a photovoltaic power station short-term power intelligent prediction method based on a TXP-MTGNN neural network model, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing missing data and abnormal data in the active power data and the meteorological factor data to obtain target active power data and target meteorological factor data; constructing a data set of a TXP-MTGNN photovoltaic power station short-term power prediction model according to the target active power data and the target meteorological factor data; constructing a TXP-MTGNN photovoltaic power station short-term power prediction model, and inputting a training data set into the TXP-MTGNN photovoltaic power station short-term power prediction model for training; inputting the verification data set into the first prediction model to obtain a first prediction result and verifying the accuracy of the first prediction result; and carrying out value compensation processing on the second prediction result according to the self characteristics of the photovoltaic power station. The method improves the accuracy of the short-term power prediction result of the photovoltaic power station.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Method and system for repairing historical output missing data of wind farm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for repairing wind power plant historical output missing data, which comprise the following steps of identifying a wind power plant historical output missing value and a position thereof in a corresponding time sequence in a wind power plant historical characteristic database, extracting characteristic data of the wind power plant historical output missing value based on the missing value and the position thereof in the corresponding time sequence in the wind power plant historical characteristic database, supplementing other characteristic data based on a characteristic matching mechanism, taking each characteristic in the characteristic data after supplementing the other characteristic data as a Graph node, constructing a characteristic Graph based on Graph theory, training a basic model through the characteristic Graph, establishing nonlinear mapping from Graph data to wind power output power values, and training to obtain a wind power plant historical output missing data repairing model. The method for repairing the historical output missing data of the wind power plant can effectively improve the repair accuracy of the missing data.

title_en: Underground space cluster intelligent tour inspection system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to an underground space cluster intelligent tour inspection system based on digital twinning. The intelligent inspection system comprises a mobile robot entity cluster and a mobile robot entity cluster digital twin system terminal, wherein the mobile robot entity cluster is formed by a plurality of mobile robot entities, virtual-real synchronization is realized through a digital twin technology, the life cycle of the intelligent inspection system of the cluster can be predicted, underground disasters can be early warned in time, the defects existing in the traditional manual inspection are overcome, and the inspection operation efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Construction method of photovoltaic power generation high-fidelity digital twin body model
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of a photovoltaic power generation high-fidelity digital twin body model, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring an environment variable and a real-time output parameter of a photovoltaic power generation entity; s2, transmitting the acquired environment variable and the real-time output parameter of the photovoltaic power generation entity to an upper computer server through an FPGA by using a UDP communication protocol; s3, analyzing the working principle and physical characteristics of photovoltaic power generation, and establishing a mechanism model; s4, based on actual operation data, a data driving model is established, and the data driving model is updated according to a sliding time window method; s5, based on DS evidence theory, fusing the mechanism model and the data driving model to construct a digital twin model. The method can simulate the real-time running state of the entity photovoltaic in the digital space, is used for predicting the photovoltaic power generation power, further improves the photovoltaic utilization rate, realizes photovoltaic absorption, optimizes power grid dispatching and ensures safe and stable running of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN MARITIME

title_en: Digital twinning-based gearbox fault diagnosis method and diagnosis system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin dynamics simulation, and discloses a digital twin-based gearbox fault diagnosis method, which comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a digital twin body of the gear box; s2: predefining fault types and verifying analysis; s3: and diagnosing faults of the gear box. The fault diagnosis system of the digital twin gearbox comprises a simulation model module; a diagnostic output module; and a display module. The model construction and simulation of the actual gear box are carried out by constructing a digital twin body and utilizing virtual reality, so that the operation simulation of the normal state and each fault type state of the existing gear box is formed, the collected operation parameters of the existing gear box are led into the model, whether the gear box has a fault and the fault type can be obtained in a countercheck mode, the working state of the gear box can be timely and effectively judged, the parts with the fault or potential faults can be timely replaced, and the disaster and economic loss caused by the fault can be reduced to a certain extent.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI DIANJI

title_en: Ground pressure disaster prediction method and device based on multitasking learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a ground pressure disaster prediction method and device based on multi-task learning, which are applied to the technical field of data analysis and prediction and comprise the following steps: extracting microseism time sequence data from parameter data of a microseism focus; preprocessing microseismic time sequence data to obtain an input vector, wherein the preprocessing comprises data resampling, missing data processing and data normalization; and inputting the input vector into a pre-trained ground pressure disaster prediction model to obtain the predicted event number, the accumulated energy, the accumulated apparent volume and the energy index, and performing ground pressure disaster prediction. The method can remarkably improve the efficiency and the precision of ground pressure disaster prediction, and can also reserve the real microseismic data characteristics.

title_en: Intelligent fire control water supply data processing system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an intelligent fire control water supply data processing system based on the Internet of things, which comprises the following steps: collecting a real-time flow signal and a historical flow signal time sequence; decomposing a frequency spectrum signal of the historical flow signal time sequence into a plurality of IMF component signals, and determining all independent noise components of the historical flow signal time sequence according to the distribution of the cut-off probability of all IMF component signals belonging to the independent noise components; and determining a noise sequence according to the distribution of all the amplitudes reserved by all the independent noise components, taking a covariance matrix of the noise sequence as a noise covariance matrix of the Kalman filtering, and denoising the real-time flow signal through the Kalman filtering to realize the processing of intelligent fire water supply data. The application provides more accurate state estimation results when denoising the flow signals of the fire-fighting water supply network through Kalman filtering, and improves the water supply control precision of intelligent fire-fighting.
assignees: XINLING ELECTRICAL CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power plant primary loop pipeline fatigue analysis and damage management method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for analyzing and managing fatigue of a primary loop pipeline of a nuclear power plant based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps of a) classifying and managing the primary loop transient of the nuclear power plant based on occurrence frequency, (a.1) a transient-A type transient generated by primary loop equipment, (a.2) a transient-B type transient generated by a non-common branch system connected with the primary equipment, (a.3) a transient-C type transient generated by a common branch system connected with the primary equipment, B) performing fatigue analysis on each type of transient respectively, (b.1) adopting fatigue rapid assessment based on design statistics, (b.2) adopting real-time assessment based on-line monitoring of operation parameters, and (b.3) adopting conservative assessment based on accumulated occurrence time or crack expansion of the transient, C) optimizing operation control of the nuclear power plant based on digital twinning, and providing an operation control strategy which is beneficial to reducing fatigue damage of the primary loop pipeline of the nuclear power plant based on real-time monitoring of operation parameters and classification management of the transient.

title_en: Digital twinning-based power equipment online state monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, in particular to a digital twinning-based power equipment on-line state monitoring system. The system acquires an operation data curve of the power equipment in real time, and acquires an associated data curve segment of a data point in a preset neighborhood range; in the associated data curve segment, acquiring the importance degree of the data point according to the change trend of the data point; screening the marking points according to the importance degree, and obtaining the distribution characteristics of the marking points in the operation data curve; acquiring a regulation threshold value of each data point according to the importance degree of the data point and the distribution characteristics of the marking points; based on the Douglas algorithm, the operation data curve is thinned by the obtained regulation threshold value, and a simplified data curve is obtained; and predicting the simplified data curve by using a digital twin model, and carrying out early warning and running state evaluation on abnormal conditions. According to the invention, the operation data curve of the power equipment is analyzed and processed, the data redundancy degree is reduced, and real-time monitoring and intelligent prediction and evaluation are realized.

title_en: Ground network underground paving structure identification method, equipment and storage equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a ground net underground laying structure identification method, equipment and storage equipment, which comprises the steps of S1, obtaining detection data of a ground net, carrying out normalization, double-tone and sample interpolation processing on the detection data, complementing scattered and missing data into uniformly distributed response data, S2, carrying out wavelet noise reduction processing on the response data, reducing the influence of noise of underground complex environments and stray currents on the response data, S3, obtaining structure data points with different shapes according to the underground laying structure characteristics of the ground net, and S4, carrying out elimination of the scattered structure data points by setting a threshold value of a communication area according to the obtained structure data points, so as to obtain a final ground net underground laying structure identification result. An identification device and a storage device for an underground laying structure of a grounding grid are used for realizing the identification method for the underground laying structure of the grounding grid. The method has the beneficial effects of solving the problem of complex ground network corrosion discrimination algorithm and realizing the identification of the ground network underground paving position of any paving structure.

title_en: Parallel asynchronous state estimation method, device and equipment for transmission and distribution interconnected power grid
abstract_en: The application relates to a parallel asynchronous state estimation method, a device and equipment of a transmission and distribution interconnected network, wherein the parallel asynchronous state estimation method of the transmission and distribution interconnected network improves the data use frequency of a key power distribution network with great influence on the state estimation result of the transmission and distribution interconnected network through selecting the key power distribution network, can reduce the sensibility of an algorithm to preset parameters of a user, and improves the calculation speed and convergence of a program; the state estimation computing convergence is improved by adopting synchronous preprocessing in the state estimation process of the power distribution network and the power transmission network, the state estimation computing speed is improved by adopting an execution thread parallel mechanism, and the computing time of the state estimation of the power transmission network and the power distribution network is also reduced; the state estimation results between the transmission network and each distribution network are mutually transmitted, and the state estimation results are updated, so that the problems of low convergence speed, long calculation time and low calculation accuracy of the existing state estimation method of the transmission and distribution interconnected network under the condition that data barriers and communication delays exist objectively are solved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: User power distribution control method and system according to power utilization characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user power distribution control method and a system according to electricity utilization characteristics, which relate to the technical field of vehicle gesture detection, and the method comprises the following steps: extracting a plurality of electricity utilization periods of a target area user through a power grid data center table to acquire electricity utilization identification data; retrieving second electricity utilization data in the big data, and determining first electricity characteristics; based on a power grid digital twin technology, constructing a power digital twin model of a control target area power grid; obtaining user simulation power distribution data; calculating the deviation value of the user simulation distribution data and the user actual distribution data, and obtaining a power grid evaluation result; and carrying out power distribution control on users in the target area in a plurality of time periods according to the power grid evaluation result, determining a plurality of power distribution control strategies, solving the problem that the system is complex and cannot be controlled and regulated in time due to insufficient rigor and insufficient intuitiveness of power distribution work in the prior art, and realizing reasonable and accurate regulation and control on the power distribution control of the users.

title_en: Water network data supervision system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water network data supervision system and method based on digital twinning, and belongs to the technical field of digital twinning. The geographical position range is divided into unit grids, and the digital twin technology is combined to carry out coverage mapping on the water area range and the monitoring station range, so that the grids of an abnormal area are conveniently marked, an abnormal drainage basin grid set and an abnormal station report grid set are distinguished, the abnormal water condition monitored by a monitoring station is conveniently analyzed and compared with the actual water condition fed back by the water area network, and further, the construction of a solidified data management link is completed; according to the solidified data management link, analyzing abnormal dangerous grid areas in the range of the river basin related to different channels when different historic monitoring water conditions, so as to analyze abnormal frequency of unit grids; and then, the digital twin digital display of the water regime is realized, the comprehensive integrity of water regime data monitoring is ensured, and the safe and stable operation monitoring capability of the hydraulic engineering is improved.

title_en: Method and device for estimating dynamic state of heat supply network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for estimating a dynamic state of a heat supply network, and belongs to the technical field of operation and control of comprehensive energy systems. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a heat supply network dynamic state estimation model corresponding to each pipeline and based on a physical information neural network; training the heat supply network dynamic state estimation model corresponding to each pipeline according to a preset training mode based on the pipeline parameters and the measurement result of the heat supply network system in each time window to obtain the heat supply network dynamic state estimation model trained in the current time window; and carrying out state estimation of the current time window on each pipeline of the heat supply network system by using the trained heat supply network dynamic state estimation model. The invention can realize more accurate dynamic state estimation of the heat supply network, accurately sense the temperature change condition in the pipeline of the heat supply network, facilitate the real-time state sensing and the flexibility calculation of the heat supply network, and provide an accurate data basis for the optimal scheduling of the heat supply network.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Measurement data filling method and system based on correlation and generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The method and the system for filling the measurement data based on the correlation and the generation countermeasure network extract a multidimensional characteristic data set of the power grid measurement target data by using a correlation analysis method; obtaining a dimension reduction characteristic data set by using a kernel principal component analysis method; the method comprises the steps that a data filling network comprising a generator and a discriminator is built based on a generated countermeasure network, the generator inputs a dimension reduction characteristic data set and a random noise data set and outputs a prediction data set, the discriminator extracts a strong correlation sample by a correlation analysis method and calculates the distance between the prediction data set and the strong correlation sample by a Wasserstein distance loss function, missing data in power grid measurement target data is filled by the prediction data set when the distance is smaller than a threshold value, the data filling network is trained by the prediction data set and the strong correlation sample when the distance is not smaller than the threshold value, and missing data in the power grid measurement target data is filled by the trained prediction data of the data filling network when the distance is smaller than the distance threshold value. The method and the device improve the filling accuracy of the power grid missing data.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;NANJING INST TECH;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID ENERGY RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Novel operation method, device, equipment and medium of digital twin system of power system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid simulation operation, and discloses a novel power system digital twin system operation method, device, equipment and medium, wherein based on real-time acquisition data, a data-driven model is calculated to convolve a Riemann curvature approximation of a plurality of Riemann manifolds in a final-layer high-dimensional feature space, so as to obtain an optimal Riemann measurement; constructing a geodesic cutting cluster based on a Riemann manifold by utilizing an optimal Riemann metric, judging whether the Riemann manifold is complete in geodesic, if so, adopting a digital twin system as a stable system, and adopting digital twin deduction operation based on complete in geodesic, otherwise, adopting a digital twin system as an unstable system, and adopting digital twin deduction operation based on a minimum action quantity principle to obtain a deduction operation result; the deduction operation result is converted into a feature cluster of a low-dimensional feature space, so that the deduction operation capability of the multi-scale digital twin system is realized through the deduction operation method of the novel digital twin system of the power system main equipment.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Operation and maintenance inspection method and system based on electric power scene model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power engineering and provides an operation and maintenance inspection method and system based on a power scene model. The method comprises the following steps: extracting multi-layer historical power data based on the power grid data center station to construct power scene information; traversing a plurality of power devices in a target area, and determining a plurality of power information of the target area; constructing an initialized power scene model; performing data analysis and regulation on the initialized power scene model to determine a power scene model; determining power operation and maintenance data; and carrying out operation and maintenance inspection on the power grid in the target area according to the power operation and maintenance data to obtain power inspection data. The method and the device solve the technical problems that the operation and maintenance inspection of the power grid is difficult and the manpower and material resources are consumed in the prior art, and achieve the purpose of constructing the power scene model based on the digital twin technology to improve the operation and maintenance inspection efficiency of the power grid.

title_en: Multi-energy network digital twin real-time simulation system and method based on full pure embedding
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-pure-embedding-based multi-energy network digital twin real-time simulation system and method, wherein a full-pure-embedding method is adopted to develop a plurality of energy network digital twin bodies based on real-time simulation, full-pure-embedding models and convergence radius models of a plurality of energy networks are provided, convergence information of the full-pure-embedding models is obtained through the convergence radius models, and the convergence radius is determined by simplifying power series coefficient items of an unbalanced function of a time-varying dynamic process of a state variable of the multi-energy network, so that the calculation performance of the full-pure-embedding models is enhanced, and real-time standards are achieved.

title_en: Power transmission line icing thickness prediction method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for predicting the icing thickness of a power transmission line based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: collecting transmission line data; carrying out parameterized modeling according to the power transmission line data, and constructing a digital twin model of the power transmission line; numerical simulation, constructing a preliminary icing prediction model; and combining the digital twin model to construct an icing thickness prediction model. The method for predicting the icing thickness of the power transmission line based on the digital twin technology builds the power transmission line icing prediction model, and improves the prediction precision of the icing model. The icing thickness prediction model constructed by the method can accurately predict the icing thickness of the power transmission line, and has important significance for reducing icing disaster loss and improving power supply reliability.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power transmission line tower type disaster-resistant deduction system and deduction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based power transmission line tower-type disaster-resistant deduction system and a digital twinning-based power transmission line tower-type disaster-resistant deduction method, and belongs to the field of power transmission line towers. The power transmission line tower type disaster-resistant deduction system based on digital twinning comprises a risk collection module, a risk prediction module, a disaster deduction module and a disaster-resistant test module. The invention solves the problems that the prior patent cannot comprehensively judge the disaster of the power transmission line and detect and adjust the disaster resistance of the power transmission line in the actual use process and has low practicability, ensures that the tower type disaster resistance deduction of the power transmission line is more comprehensive, improves the operation reliability level of the tower type of the power transmission line, ensures the accuracy of detecting the tower type disaster resistance of the power transmission line, improves the tower type strength of the power transmission line, avoids the damage or the failure of the tower type of the power transmission line caused by the disaster, not only causes economic loss, but also influences the normal use of the tower type of the power transmission line.
assignees: STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO ANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Safety risk identification method and system based on equipment maintenance digital twin scene
abstract_en: The safety risk identification method and system based on the equipment overhaul digital twin scene are characterized by comprising the following steps: step 1, acquiring equipment overhaul live-action videos, and analyzing the live-action videos by adopting a quantum depth neural network algorithm to extract safety risk targets; step 2, marking the safety risk target as a safety risk video feature tag based on the azimuth and the range of the equipment overhaul live-action video in the digital twin scene; step 3, tracking the live-action video based on a target tracking algorithm, removing useless frames, and reserving relevant frames so as to realize the concentration of the live-action video; and 4, collecting equipment running state data and power grid environment data based on the time information and the space information in the concentrated live-action video, and realizing trace identification of safety risk behaviors. The method solves the problem of poor safety risk detection and identification effect, and improves the risk identification force and the safety control level.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Panoramic display method and system for power transmission and transformation equipment based on digital twin base
abstract_en: A panoramic display method and a system for power transmission and transformation equipment based on a digital twin base are characterized in that the method comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting operation information of power transmission and transformation equipment, and extracting space positioning information, semantic feature information and temporal change information on space attribute features of the power transmission and transformation equipment from the operation information; step 2, preprocessing the various information acquired in the step 1 to realize unification of the various information on a time reference and a space reference; step 3, carrying out visual expression in a two-dimensional or three-dimensional space on the various information subjected to pretreatment in the step 2 by adopting symbolized data so as to realize panoramic display of all elements of the power transmission and transformation equipment; and 4, analyzing the running state, time evolution and space evolution of the single equipment in the power transmission and transformation equipment by adopting a machine algorithm, generating an analysis report, and adding a data tag into the panoramic display for the single equipment.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Energy efficiency and carbon emission diagnosis method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy efficiency and carbon emission diagnosis method, an energy efficiency and carbon emission diagnosis system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of carbon emission analysis. Deleting abnormal data and repeated data from the historical operation parameter data of the power plant, complementing the missing data, discarding unsteady data, and realizing data cleaning; aiming at the parameter choosing and rejecting problem, a screening method for fusing subjective experience and objective data information is provided, and the data accuracy is improved; a machine learning algorithm is adopted, and an energy efficiency and important operation parameter relation model or a carbon emission and important operation parameter relation model is established; and finally, obtaining the influence condition of each parameter on the energy efficiency or carbon emission of the system from the global perspective through global sensitivity analysis.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Slope height calculation method of geological disaster slope unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope height calculating method of a geological disaster slope unit, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring vector data of a slope unit and raster data of a digital elevation model; s2, correcting missing data of the digital elevation model; s3, filling depressions in the grid data of the digital elevation model to realize noise data filtration; s4, extracting a digital elevation model which is corrected and filtered in the range of the slope unit; and S5, calculating the slope height of the slope unit according to the corrected and filtered digital elevation model. The method solves the problem that the traditional method can not accurately calculate and acquire the slope height of the slope unit, and realizes the accurate calculation of the slope height based on the slope unit. The method solves the problem that the traditional method is influenced by the data loss and noise of the digital elevation model when calculating the slope height. The field measurement is not needed through additional auxiliary equipment, and the investment of manpower and material resources is reduced.

title_en: Electric energy scheduling method and device based on energy storage system
abstract_en: The application discloses an energy scheduling method and device based on an energy storage system, which are applied to the energy storage system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring electric energy scheduling data of an energy storage system; determining the electric energy scheduling data as training data to obtain an electric energy digital twin model; external condition information is obtained, and the electric energy digital twin model is previewed according to the external condition information to obtain the predicted discharge capacity within preset time; determining an electric energy scheduling scheme according to the predicted discharge quantity; and carrying out electric energy scheduling according to an electric energy scheduling scheme to supply power for the electric loads. According to the method, the electric energy digital twin model is built, the electric energy scheduling is carried out on the predicted electric quantity obtained by previewing the electric energy digital twin model according to the external condition information, the actual situation of an actual scene is met, the humanized requirement is met, the calculated quantity of the energy storage system is reduced, and therefore the calculation pressure is relieved.

title_en: Active power distribution network prediction auxiliary robust state estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of prediction auxiliary state estimation, and provides a method and a system for active power distribution network prediction auxiliary robust state estimation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: traversing all abnormal data, searching a plurality of pieces of measured data closest to the abnormal data in a data set for the abnormal data, and if the number of normal data in the plurality of pieces of measured data closest to the abnormal data is larger than the number of the abnormal data, putting the abnormal data into a dangerous set; traversing all samples in the dangerous set, selecting a plurality of abnormal data closest to the sample from all abnormal data for a certain sample, randomly extracting the selected abnormal data, generating a new sample based on the randomly extracted abnormal data, adding the new sample into the data set, removing normal data in all Tomek-Links pairs in the data set to obtain a balanced data set, and carrying out output prediction. The aim of improving the output prediction precision is fulfilled.
