assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Intelligent water service partition metering system based on Internet big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource management systems, in particular to an intelligent water service partition metering system based on internet big data analysis. According to the invention, the water affair data collected in real time through the Internet of things technology and the sensor equipment is more accurate and timely, a plurality of algorithms and models such as a neural network, a random forest and a time sequence are adopted, more accurate water pressure adjustment, water quality prediction and water resource trend analysis can be performed, the simulation environment is more real by combining the digital twin technology, more effective test and optimization of the strategies by a manager are allowed, the comprehensive water affair analysis of the system from a plurality of angles is also ensured by the fusion of the multi-source data, and the decision is more comprehensive and scientific.
assignees: SHANDONG CHENZHI ELECT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric automobile charging path planning information platform based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging path planning information platform based on a digital twin technology, and belongs to the field of digital simulation. The platform comprises a semantic library, a data warehouse, a scene visualization model, various network interfaces and other components. The electric vehicle charging path planning strategy needs to fully consider geographic information, traffic network, distribution network, vehicle information, charging pile information and the like of urban traffic, and the information of different networks has the conditions of unsmooth interfaces, data delay and the like. To build a charging path planning digital twin system, firstly, information integration coding is realized, a semantic library is unified, semantic rules among different networks are standardized, a network interface is set, and the multi-source heterogeneous data and multi-dimensional information are inherited and loaded into a data warehouse. Constructing a virtual platform model of a scene, performing simulation modeling on the physical world scene, analyzing, predicting and visualizing data by utilizing a digital twin technology through information and the virtual model in a data warehouse, feeding back a target scheme to a real scene, and optimizing the real scene according to a feedback result to achieve the goal of path planning system construction.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Automobile charging pile distribution planning system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile charging pile distribution planning system based on a digital twin technology, and belongs to the field of digital simulation. The system comprises a semantic library, a data warehouse, a charging pile data monitoring model, a scene visualization model, a feedback information processor, various network interfaces, a sensor and the like. The distribution planning strategy of the charging piles of the automobiles needs to consider the geographic information of urban traffic, the distribution and configuration information of existing charging piles, the feedback information of users of the electric automobiles, the brand information of the automobiles and the like, and the conditions of unsmooth interfaces, data delay and the like of the information of different networks exist. To build the digital twin system of the charging pile distribution planning, firstly, the information integration coding is realized, the semantic library is unified, the semantic rules among different networks are standardized, a network interface is arranged, and the multi-source heterogeneous data and the multi-dimensional information are inherited and loaded into a data warehouse. And constructing a virtual platform model of the scene, performing simulation modeling on urban geographic information and distribution positions of the charging piles, and performing system correction on other information in the data warehouse in real time by a digital twin means. The optimal charging pile construction scheme can be fed back to municipal departments and charging pile paving enterprises, and early warning signals are sent to abnormal charging piles according to novel analysis of charging pile data, so that the aim of building a charging pile distribution planning system is fulfilled.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Low-voltage visual pre-judging method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-voltage visual pre-judging method and a system for a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: the method comprises the steps of obtaining data, namely obtaining use data from a main network OCS system, a distribution network OCS system, a GIS system, a marketing system and a metering automation system respectively; s2: splicing the main matching model: performing integrated graph and model splicing treatment to obtain an integrated model; s3: data mapping, wherein the data mapping is realized by each system in the integrated model, and all the systems are integrated to form an integrated panoramic model; s4: state estimation, namely establishing a state estimation analysis fruit tree; performing bad data detection and identification on the panoramic model according to the state estimation analysis result tree; s5: tracking a power supply point; s6: and judging and alarming the low voltage range, and judging and alarming the equipment in the low voltage range according to the voltage value of the equipment on the power point tracking path. The invention can provide a low-voltage treatment pre-judging scheme with stronger operability for technicians.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power supply service lifting method and system based on diversified calculation force fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply service lifting method and a power supply service lifting system based on diversified computing power integration, and relates to the technical field of power supply, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out calculation power deployment analysis on a power supply service area based on the power layout attribute information, carrying out dynamic simulation on the power layout attribute information and a deployed regional calculation power deployment endpoint network by utilizing a digital twin technology, generating a power supply area digital twin model, carrying out calculation power analysis on the power supply area digital twin model to obtain terminal calculation power demand parameter information, carrying out calculation power configuration according to the terminal calculation power demand parameter information, carrying out power supply data acquisition, edge calculation and fusion analysis based on the configured distributed calculation power resource nodes to obtain regional power supply service analysis information, and further carrying out regulation and control service management on the power supply service area. The method achieves the technical effects of realizing the power supply service power resource allocation by utilizing a digital twin technology, ensuring the power resource distribution rationality, improving the power fusion efficiency and further improving the power supply service quality.

title_en: Visual rendering method for digital twin flood flow field
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood flow field rendering, in particular to a digital twin flood flow field visual rendering method, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring a flood grid model, and carrying out light weight distribution on data in the flood grid model; s2: according to the data in the lightweight flood grid model, performing visual rendering on the multi-mode flood flow field; s3: and designing an interactive mode of the multi-mode flood flow field in visual rendering. According to the method, the high-resolution flood inundation numerical model and the flood three-dimensional visual rendering technology are coupled, the GPU cluster optimization strategy is fully exerted, the visual expression of the multi-type flood flow fields is realized, meanwhile, the multi-dimensional interactive design fully expresses flood details, the accuracy of flood simulation is ensured, the simulation precision and the visual effect of the flood simulation are improved, and the information bearing capacity of the flood simulation scene is widened.
assignees: PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC RES INST PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;BEIJING GUOYAO XINTIANDI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster risk prevention and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster prevention and control, in particular to a flood disaster risk prevention and control method and system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring risk real-time update data; performing risk factor evaluation, appointed administrative region evaluation and potential risk evaluation on the risk real-time updated data, and performing risk level statistical analysis on the evaluation result data to obtain a risk evaluation result data statistical table; drawing the risk density of the risk assessment result data statistical table to obtain a risk assessment display diagram; performing flood disaster risk prevention and control management on the risk assessment display diagram to obtain flood disaster risk prevention and control management data; and carrying out standardized construction self-evaluation and system construction self-evaluation on flood disaster risk prevention and control management data, checking and checking to obtain a prevention and control management scoring table, and uploading the prevention and control management scoring table to an industry plan data document. The invention can lay a foundation for standardized accurate prevention and control management of flood risk information.

title_en: Digital twin-based power distribution network power supply reliability calculation method and system
abstract_en: The present application provides a digital twin-based power distribution network power supply reliability calculation method and system. The method comprises: obtaining basic data and operation data of a power distribution line; constructing a digital twin power grid on the basis of the digital twin technology as well as the basic data and the operation data; obtaining scores in respect of power distribution network reliability indexes of the power distribution line on the basis of the digital twin power grid, wherein the power distribution network reliability indexes comprise an element reliability index, a load point reliability index, a system reliability index, a series system reliability index, and a parallel system reliability index; and on the basis of a weighted fusion result of the scores of the power distribution network reliability indexes, determining the power distribution network power supply reliability to be calculated. The present application solves the problem that current methods for analyzing the power distribution network power supply reliability relate to treating entire power distribution networks as research objects and implementing manual sorting, and thus are time-consuming and labor-intensive, are difficult to ensure the accuracy of calculation results, and fail to conduct statistical analysis for weak links in the network distribution networks.
assignees: LINCANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based energy storage power station full life cycle monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full life cycle monitoring system and method of an energy storage power station based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of energy storage power station management, and are used for acquiring indication information of performance degradation of power equipment in the energy storage power station, setting the power equipment with the indication information as first detection equipment, setting equipment which causes the first detection equipment to generate the indication information as source equipment, calculating a first characteristic evaluation value of the first detection equipment by analyzing stable characteristics and trend characteristics of data change relation of historical operation records with time, acquiring an output function of an output end of a digital twinning body corresponding to the first detection equipment, comparing the similarity of the output function and the historical operation records generated by a first detection equipment entity, judging the direction of the source equipment, acquiring next detected equipment from the connection relation of the power equipment according to the direction of the source equipment, and collecting source equipment in all source equipment directions to obtain a performance degradation equipment list.

title_en: Intelligent park energy management method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent park energy management method and system based on a digital twin technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: data acquisition, data preprocessing, principal component analysis, random forest prediction model construction, back propagation neural network prediction model construction, combined model prediction analysis and digital twin model construction. The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin, in particular to an intelligent park energy management method and system based on a digital twin technology.
assignees: UNIV SHENZHEN TECHNOLOGY;SHENZHOULONG SPACE TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Demand response capacity prediction method and system based on factor importance degree ordering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a demand response capacity prediction method and a demand response capacity prediction system based on factor importance ranking, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical data of a power grid user, preprocessing missing data of the historical data, and constructing a baseline load influence factor index data set according to the preprocessed historical data; wherein the historical data includes historical baseline load time series data and historical weather time series data; performing relevance-based influence factor importance ranking screening on the baseline load influence factor index data set to obtain important influence factor data influencing the baseline load; carrying out regression prediction on important influence factor data influencing the baseline load to obtain a power grid baseline load predicted value; and calculating the capacity of the actual power load of the user and the predicted value of the baseline load of the power grid to obtain the demand response capacity of the user. The embodiment realizes accurate prediction of the capacity of the user participating in the demand response, and improves the reliability and accuracy of the identification result of the baseline load.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Novel power distribution network harmonic power flow calculation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel power distribution network harmonic power flow calculation method and system, which relate to the technical field of operation management of power distribution networks and power utilization systems, and comprise the steps of importing network frame CIM of the power distribution network to form a harmonic penetration relation and constructing power balance constraint; solving a nonlinear matrix equation in a combined way to obtain power flow data, and introducing power balance constraint and the power flow data into a harmonic penetration relation to obtain harmonic state estimation; and (5) preparing corresponding indexes according to the harmonic state, and forming a loss formula and a duty ratio formula. Compared with the single-node harmonic wave calculation method and the large-scale harmonic wave negative sequence power flow calculation method of the power distribution network in the prior art, the method can calculate the large-scale complete harmonic wave power flow of the power distribution network, and provides support for safe operation and management decision of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Gray correlation analysis-based power load influence factor method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic technology of a power system, in particular to a power load influence factor method based on gray correlation analysis, which utilizes gray correlation analysis to study the correlation degree between power load prediction and influence factors thereof, and evaluates the influence degree of different condition changes on the power load prediction so as to determine the factors mainly influencing the power load prediction. Seasonal variations are selected for analysis and their effect on the voltage and frequency of the electrical load is analyzed. The method selects a reference sequence and a comparison sequence, performs dimensionless treatment, and eliminates the influence of units. And calculating the minimum difference and the maximum difference, and obtaining the association coefficient. And calculating the average value of each column of association coefficients to obtain an association degree result. The method overcomes the ambiguity of data, processes uncertainty and randomness, and improves the accuracy of analysis; incomplete information can be processed, and modeling analysis can be carried out on missing data or incomplete data; the main factors which have the most significant influence on the power load are determined, and important references are provided for decision making.
assignees: XIAOGAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Data interconnection interaction platform based on electric power artificial intelligence and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data interconnection interaction platform based on electric artificial intelligence and digital twinning, a management end and an interaction end in communication connection with the management end, wherein the management end comprises a data repository, a model building unit and a data extraction unit. According to the invention, the digital twin master model is established and arranged at the interaction end, so that convenience is brought to follow-up extraction of relevant power parameters, and the data transmission efficiency is effectively improved; the calculation type extraction of the data at the management end through the digital twin master model effectively avoids blockage caused by direct transmission of a large amount of data, and achieves low delay; meanwhile, a plurality of virtual machines can be adopted to analyze and process the calculation model in the digital twin master model at the same time, so that high-efficiency information interaction is realized; and variable comparison analysis is carried out according to the tree diagram, and then a reference target is determined to be extracted, so that the data extraction unit can rapidly extract effective parameters, and the acquisition efficiency of the system is effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;AOSTAR INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state estimation method, a system, equipment and a medium, which comprise the following steps: expressing a topological structure of a power system as an undirected graph, and acquiring embedded vectors of all nodes in the undirected graph; splicing the embedded vector of each node with the state information of the node; the spliced result is input into the trained convolutional neural network to perform power system state estimation, and the method, the system, the equipment and the medium can accurately estimate the power system state, and are high in robustness and accuracy.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Digital twinning-based power equipment management method and system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a digital twinning-based power equipment management method and a digital twinning-based power equipment management system, and relates to the technical field of power equipment management, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring equipment composition structure and equipment operation data of target ultra-high voltage power equipment in a target area; constructing a target digital twin model; obtaining vibration intensity data; obtaining temperature distribution data; obtaining corona discharge data; obtaining a seed point set; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an abnormal identification point, managing an insulating layer of a target ultra-high voltage power device, solving the technical problems that in the prior art, the management monitoring dimension of the insulating layer of the ultra-high voltage power device is single, and further defect management accuracy and management efficiency of the insulating layer are poor, realizing defect identification of the insulating layer of the ultra-high voltage power device, improving the defect management efficiency of the insulating layer of the ultra-high voltage power device, and further guaranteeing the safe operation of the ultra-high voltage power device.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital system for energy Internet allocation management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digitalized system for energy Internet allocation management, wherein an energy subsystem consists of entity equipment and non-entity twin equipment; the data acquisition subsystem comprises an acquisition node and a data collection layer; the data comprises voltage, current, active power, reactive power and power angle; the entity equipment and the non-entity twin equipment are both provided with acquisition nodes; the data optimization subsystem comprises a data transmission layer and a data processing layer; and the digital twin fusion subsystem is used for splicing spliced data of the spliced entity equipment and the spliced non-entity twin equipment, so that the data linkage of the entity equipment and the non-entity twin equipment is realized. The digitalized system for energy Internet allocation management disclosed by the invention collects the data of the entity equipment and the twin non-entity equipment, improves the real-time performance and uniformity of the data, and performs splicing and fusion on the data of the entity equipment and the data of the twin non-entity equipment to realize the data linkage of the entity equipment and the non-entity twin equipment.
assignees: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;INST ELECTRICAL ENG CAS;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for discriminating abnormal electricity consumption of low-voltage charging pile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for discriminating abnormal electricity consumption of a low-voltage charging pile, which comprises the following steps: A. acquiring electricity consumption data of the charging pile, cleaning abnormal data, and fitting out missing data through a curve fitting algorithm to obtain a complete electricity consumption curve of the charging pile; B. the k-means clustering algorithm is utilized to circularly cluster all charging pile electricity utilization curves, distances between each point on the charging pile electricity utilization curves and the respective mass centers are calculated and summed, the cluster number of each charging pile electricity utilization curve cluster is determined through the distances and the sum, and then the charging pile electricity utilization curves suspected to be abnormal are preliminarily screened out by combining a preset cluster number threshold; C. and (3) performing curve fitting on every two points on the screened suspected abnormal charging pile power curve by using a sliding method, further screening suspected illegal power consumption behaviors by combining a preset slope threshold value, and listing the suspected illegal power consumption behaviors in an investigation list of subsequent field power consumption inspection. The method can effectively screen abnormal electricity utilization behaviors of the low-voltage charging pile.
assignees: PUTIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based construction method of water leakage risk prevention and control information system of tobacco plant pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a water leakage risk prevention and control information system of a pipe network of a tobacco plant based on digital twinning, which provides a set of targeted strategies for constructing a visual intelligent pipe network system of the tobacco plant, displays the risk level and the early warning condition of the pipe network through three-dimensional modeling and digital twinning technology, realizes the water leakage early warning and the history maintenance and recording functions of pipe network equipment through data analysis at the system level, effectively improves the coping capability of the water leakage risk, and ensures the energy supply of the tobacco plant. On the premise of ensuring the safety of the data and the information of the tobacco enterprises, the invention realizes basic information display, risk monitoring and prediction, three-dimensional visual operation management and control and information pushing of various energy supply pipe networks and accessories thereof on the production site, is convenient for intuitively knowing the maintenance history, maintenance plan, history faults and pipe network risk grades of the pipe networks and accessories thereof, effectively predicts and detects the abnormality such as leakage, metering equipment faults and the like existing in the pipe networks, and is convenient for timely checking and taking corresponding measures to ensure stable production.
assignees: CHINA TOBACCO ZHEJIANG IND CO

title_en: Intelligent test system for hydraulic engineering safety and disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of engineering prevention and control experiments, and provides a hydraulic engineering safety and disaster prevention and control intelligent test system, which comprises a construction hydraulic engineering intelligent physical model test system, a flood disaster formation mechanism and prediction and safety evaluation numerical simulation system and a drainage basin digital twin service support platform; according to the invention, by constructing an engineering entity prototype, a laboratory physical model and a digital twin model into a three-in-one intelligent test system for water engineering safety and disaster prevention, in the intelligent test system, powerful system software and a mathematical model are used for simulating, analyzing and researching the safety operation and disaster prevention of the water engineering, and decision support is provided under the visual condition, so that the scientificity and predictability of decision making are enhanced, the accuracy of experiments is further enhanced, and the intelligent test system for water engineering safety and disaster prevention is more comprehensive in operation mode, can be well adapted to various places and improves the adaptability of the water engineering test.
assignees: CHANGCHUN INST TECH;UNIV HOHAI;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Power grid power quality on-line state estimation method based on wavelet change and convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid power quality on-line state estimation method based on wavelet change and convolutional neural network, which adopts wavelet change to extract power quality monitoring data characteristic values, generates typical power quality disturbance random data samples, and divides training samples and test sample proportions; performing wavelet transformation on the training sample and the test sample respectively, and extracting a plurality of characteristic values of the power quality disturbance according to the power quality characteristic model; and finally, the automatic data classification and the on-line state estimation of the power quality are finished by a convolutional neural network method.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV QINGHAI;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Distribution network digital twin body optimization method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distribution network digital twin body optimization method, a distribution network digital twin body optimization device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the following steps: and optimizing the simulation function of the distribution network digital twin body system through a distribution network simulation engine. Based on the distribution network simulation engine and combined with the distribution network model, the distribution network digital twin body is optimized to provide a model and a self-defining function of distribution network equipment. And distinguishing the distribution network steady-state simulation data set, the distribution network steady-state simulation scheme and the distribution network steady-state simulation calculation scheme according to the data set class, so as to realize the multi-mode management of the distribution network steady state. And carrying out visual display on the sensing and analysis results of the running state of the power distribution network based on the digital twin center. And the distribution network source load prediction function based on the data-driven neural network algorithm simulates and deduces source load power prediction data. Based on multi-element operation history data and a scheduling control strategy library, and combining the distribution network model prediction and risk prediction results, the operation states of the distribution network in different time periods are simulated and deduced.
assignees: HANGZHOU LVTENG SHUZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission and distribution line tree obstacle prediction method and device based on digital twin system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission and distribution line tree obstacle prediction method based on a digital twin system, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of detecting and generating a plurality of groups of video monitoring data according to unit height in the height direction of a pole tower; performing data processing on a plurality of groups of video monitoring data to generate a data group, performing characteristic data identification on the data group, acquiring data of a power transmission line and tree, and constructing a digital twin model according to the data of the power transmission line and the tree; determining a line safety threshold based on the power transmission line, and determining a tree growth model in the unit space based on tree data; according to the current tree height and the tree growth model, calculating the predicted tree height of the tree in the monitored unit space after a preset time period, and alarming when the predicted tree height exceeds a line safety threshold, wherein the power transmission and distribution line tree barrier prediction method improves the accuracy of the tree growth model and the prediction accuracy according to the tree growth environment.
assignees: LIAONING SENQIAO WULIAN INFORMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster digital twin live-action display method based on physical calculation result
abstract_en: A geological disaster digital twin live-action display method based on a physical calculation result belongs to the field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and specifically comprises the following steps: constructing a landslide deformation characteristic family library; constructing a crack extraction module; constructing a live-action display module; obtaining physical information and physical parameters of a target landslide body and crack distribution of the target landslide body; establishing a landslide geological model for forming a landslide area according to the physical information and physical parameters of the target landslide body; screening calculation parameters and establishing a calculation model; inputting expected working conditions into the calculation model, obtaining a finite element calculation result cloud picture, and obtaining a crack system under the expected working conditions by utilizing the crack extraction module; and according to the landslide geological model of the landslide region of the target landslide body and the crack system under the expected working condition, utilizing the live-action display module to display digital twin live-action based on a physical calculation result.
assignees: BEIJING YUNLU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster-pregnancy state early warning system based on coal seam disaster-pregnancy dynamic physical field digital twin body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-pregnancy status early warning system based on a digital twin body of a dynamic physical field of a coal bed disaster-pregnancy, which is used for displaying a coal bed stress field, a gas concentration field and a coal rock damage intensity field in a tunneling process of a tunneling working face, predicting and updating the three dynamic physical fields in real time through an ARIMA algorithm, predicting and comparing the disturbance status of each dangerous index of the twin body of the disaster-pregnancy by utilizing a difference judgment criterion of the ARIMA algorithm and a dangerous threshold value, realizing real-time analysis of the disaster-pregnancy process of the coal bed, early warning when an outstanding danger appears, marking the disaster-pregnancy position in a three-dimensional digital model of the working face, and providing emergency treatment suggestions. The invention can realize the generation and anomaly monitoring of the digital twin bodies of the physical field of the dangerous indexes at the future moment of the outburst of coal and gas, and can improve the visual degree and the intelligent level of accident prediction.

title_en: Medical self-help information interaction system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a medical self-help information interaction system and a medical self-help information interaction method, and relates to the technical field of mountain disasters. In the method, a medical query model is constructed based on a digital twin technology to update and store the space dimension and the time dimension of the patient and the common question-answer information in real time, and query types are distinguished based on the identity information and the query information of the patient, and the method is divided into secret-related query related to personal privacy information and common query not related to the personal privacy information, and the secret-related query information is encrypted to solve the problems of privacy protection of the patient information, safety in data transmission and the like in the process of data interaction.
assignees: WEIHAI WANWEIDA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric quantity prediction method based on LightGBM
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric quantity prediction method based on a LightGBM, which comprises the following steps: collecting data; extracting characteristics of the acquired data; dividing the characteristic data; training the parameters of a LightGBM model; evaluating a LightGBM model; and carrying out electric quantity prediction after the evaluation passes. The missing data is processed, the data acquisition efficiency is optimized, the data characteristics are extracted by using a cyclic neural network, the data are divided into a training set, a verification set and a test set, then the training is carried out to obtain a LightGBM model, and the electric quantity is predicted after the lightning GBM model is qualified by root mean square error evaluation, average absolute error evaluation and average absolute percentage error evaluation, so that the histogram algorithm and the GOSS technology are realized, and the problem of large-scale data prediction is solved.
assignees: HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Comprehensive energy control system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based comprehensive energy control system, which comprises an enterprise real-time acquisition module, an enterprise history acquisition module, an Internet acquisition module, a model construction module, a data processing module and an information sending module; the enterprise real-time acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time enterprise information, the enterprise history acquisition module is used for acquiring enterprise history information, the Internet acquisition module is used for importing enterprise type information into a preset Internet database, and acquiring enterprise information of other enterprises of the same type, namely other enterprise information, from the preset Internet database; the real-time enterprise information comprises gas consumption, power consumption, water consumption, gas consumption equipment number, power consumption equipment number and water consumption equipment number of the enterprise in a preset time period. The invention can more comprehensively control the comprehensive energy of enterprises and meet different use requirements.
assignees: XIWAN WISDOM GUANGDONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring and early warning method based on substation operation safety clear distance calculation model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring and early warning method based on a substation operation safety clear distance calculation model, which comprises the following steps: s1, pre-acquiring data information of a substation building, layout, environment and states of all power equipment, and realizing substation modeling; s2, mapping the complex weather environment change and the condition data information of each power equipment in the transformer substation in real time in a transformer substation model; s3, dynamically adjusting an operation safety clear distance calculation model according to complex weather, voltage level and operator condition change in the transformer substation; and S4, carrying out operation task safety monitoring and early warning based on the steps and visualizing in real time in a three-dimensional digital twin model of the transformer substation. According to the invention, the operation safety clear distance calculation model is dynamically adjusted through the digital twin transformer substation model, so that the operation task safety early warning monitoring and real-time visualization are realized, and the safety and the effective early warning performance of operators are ensured to a greater extent.
assignees: SHANGHAI INST TECH

title_en: Application method and system for predicting safety state of nuclear power plant equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an application method for predicting the safety state of nuclear power plant equipment, which comprises the following steps: and (5) preprocessing data. Sampling the data to obtain the power of a transmitter; aligning the sampling frequency, and supplementing the missing data forward by using the later data; respectively calculating the power difference of each transmitter in the same pump; calculating the maximum value, the minimum value, the average value and the sum of the daily power data of each transmitter in the data set to obtain the power statistical data of the current day; and (3) calculating the maximum value, the minimum value, the intermediate value and the sum of the diff of each transmitter every day in the data set to obtain the difference statistical data of the current day. The invention also provides a system for predicting the safety state of the nuclear power plant equipment, which comprises a data preprocessing module, an equipment safety state prediction model training module and an equipment safety state prediction module. The invention greatly reduces the difference of the prediction amplitude, and early warning is carried out on the early degradation of the equipment performance in real time, thereby reducing the analysis time of business personnel.
assignees: JIANGSU NUCLEAR POWER CORP

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation prediction system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power generation prediction system based on digital twin, which belongs to the technical field of renewable energy management and photovoltaic power generation optimization, and comprises a system, wherein the system collects operation data of a photovoltaic power station in real time through sensors and monitoring equipment, wherein the operation data comprises environmental parameters such as solar radiation, temperature, humidity, wind speed and the like, and equipment parameters such as current, voltage, output power and the like of a photovoltaic panel, the data are transmitted to a data center through a communication network for storage and processing, and the data processing comprises operations such as data cleaning, denoising, correction and the like so as to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the data.
assignees: HUANENG DONGGUAN GAS TURBINE THERMOELECTRICITY CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power transmission line bird detection method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power transmission line monitoring, and in order to solve the problems of time consumption, limited position and the like in the existing power transmission line bird detection, a digital twinning-based power transmission line bird detection method, a digital twinning-based power transmission line bird detection system, digital twinning-based medium and digital twinning-based power transmission line bird detection equipment are provided, bird identification is carried out on acquired image data, and behavior habits of different birds are respectively simulated by solid modeling according to the identified bird types; carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction of a power transmission line scene according to the point cloud data of the bird activity area to obtain a digital model; integrating the entity modeling results of different birds into a digital model under the same scene to obtain a digital twin model; inputting bird activity data under the same scene acquired in real time into a digital twin model for real-time updating; based on the virtual reality technology, data in the digital twin model are converted into a visual virtual environment, so that visual prediction of bird behaviors is realized. Therefore, manual subjective judgment is reduced, bird damage faults of the power transmission line are reduced, and efficiency is improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;TSINGHUA SHENZHEN INT GRADUATE SCHOOL;WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;DONGYING POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Grid-connected scheduling management method and system constructed by combining knowledge graph
abstract_en: The application provides a grid-connected dispatching management method and system constructed by combining a knowledge graph, and relates to the technical field of grid-connected dispatching management, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a power information knowledge graph, then acquiring real-time power data of target power, fusing the two groups of data, predicting an operation state based on a digital twin model, generating the most value constraint of a dispatching task cluster, then carrying out multidimensional balance screening, generating a grid-connected dispatching plan, and carrying out grid-connected dispatching management of a power system. The method mainly solves the technical problems that the power data cannot be known in real time, the intelligent and automatic level is not high, and the effect of distribution network scheduling management is weakened. And constructing a knowledge graph through real-time power information, then screening out a grid-connected scheduling plan in a multidimensional balance manner, and managing according to the plan. Grid-connected scheduling management of the target power system can be effectively executed, and stable, safe and efficient operation of the power system is ensured.

title_en: Power communication network digital twin modeling method and system based on hybrid model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid model-based digital twin modeling method and system for an electric power communication network, comprising the following steps: acquiring multi-station and multi-level three-dimensional point cloud data based on a high-precision three-dimensional laser scanner, and adopting ResPointNet++ for semantic segmentation of the scanning point cloud so as to identify power communication network resource components; in the semantic segmentation process, decoding is carried out through an improved deep kernel extreme learning machine algorithm to recover space information; establishing an objective and accurate mechanism model reflecting dynamic characteristics of a power communication network and a power grid coupling network, and acquiring an operation mechanism between each pair of components in a physical model; and constructing a data driving model, and driving the physical model to reversely control the physical network layer by utilizing the characteristic fitting capability of the data model so as to realize synchronous operation of the physical network and the twin system. The invention ensures the accurate mapping of the twin network to the physical network of the backbone communication system of the large power grid in three aspects of geometric shape, physical attribute and operation logic.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION BRANCH;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Dynamic cleaning method and system for abnormal power consumption data of power consumer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic cleaning method and a system for abnormal data of electricity consumption of an electric power user. The method comprises the following steps: calculating the size of an abnormal factor of all data points; clustering is carried out aiming at the local abnormal factor value, and the local abnormal factor value on the boundary line between the sample normal data point and the sample abnormal data point obtained by self-adaptive clustering is used as an abnormal judgment threshold; judging abnormal data, removing all abnormal data to form blank missing data points, and inputting the blank missing data points and the original data into a missing data dynamic filling program; taking blank missing data points as local missing types; filling data points of the local missing type data by adopting a least square regression model prediction result; and filling the long-term missing type data interval by adopting a random forest model prediction result. And evaluating the dynamic cleaning effect of the original data. The method and the device can be used for rapidly and effectively cleaning the abnormal power consumption data of the power consumers, and meet the cleaning and use requirements of the current multi-source big data of the power distribution network.
assignees: State Grid Tianjin Electric Power Company Marketing Service Center;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent generation and execution method for scheduling operation instruction ticket of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for intelligently generating and executing a scheduling operation instruction ticket of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: leading in a device maintenance and service stopping application form electronic file in a power grid dispatching automation system, analyzing operation devices, and obtaining operation sub-devices; analyzing all transfer strategies and priority levels corresponding to downstream equipment of each operation sub-equipment in different running modes of cold conduction and heat conduction according to the current power grid model topological structure, equipment parameter information and whole-network state estimation section data based on the power grid model; integrating the transfer strategy and the priority level with the information of the operation equipment in the equipment maintenance and outage application form to generate an operation instruction ticket meeting the allocation requirement; in the case of manual monitoring, the work content in the operation instruction ticket is intelligently executed in a single step or multiple steps automatically. The invention can solve the problems of manual writing, manual execution of operation tickets and low efficiency, realize the online circulation of business, lighten the working pressure of distribution network operators and regulation and control personnel, and further improve the work efficiency of distribution network.
assignees: NANJING VOCATIONAL UNIV OF INDUSTRY TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Water conservancy model construction method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a water conservancy model based on digital twin, which relate to the technical field of water conservancy projects, collect data by a collection point positioned in a detection area, and establish a water conservancy digital twin model by using a convolutional neural network model; and (3) carrying out data analysis on a plurality of groups of monitoring data obtained from monitoring points, obtaining a data quality set, generating a stability coefficient by the data quality set, screening out target data, taking the target data as input, obtaining corresponding prediction data by using the trained water conservancy digital twin model, generating a corresponding error coefficient according to the deviation degree of the prediction data and actual data, and if the error coefficient exceeds an error threshold value, selecting a corresponding correction scheme according to the parameter characteristics and algorithm characteristics of the abnormal module to correct the water conservancy twin model. Can foresee in advance when having the water conservancy risk, reserve relatively more process time, reduce the potential safety hazard to a certain extent.
assignees: ANHUI JINHAI DIER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Energy storage battery recycling management method and system based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an energy storage battery recycling management method and system based on a block chain technology: creating a battery recycling management blockchain network by utilizing a blockchain technology; based on service business chain data, acquiring factory data of the energy storage battery, and constructing a digital twin model of the energy storage battery, wherein the digital twin model comprises a physical model, a dynamic model and a health management model; the authorization terminal performs identity verification by providing a digital certificate, accesses a battery recycling management blockchain network through an access interface, and updates a digital twin model of the energy storage battery according to real-time data; and the manufacturer is utilized to access the battery recycling management blockchain network through an access interface according to the authority granted by the intelligent contract owner, acquire the state and information of the energy storage battery based on the digital twin model of the energy storage battery, and ensure the credibility of the data through a data verification mechanism. The invention integrates the digital twin model and the blockchain technology, effectively improves the recovery efficiency and transparency of the energy storage battery, reduces the recovery cost and reduces the resource waste.
assignees: FUJIAN ZHONGKE XINGTAI DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Micro-grid group information interaction and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro-grid group information calculation and interaction system and method, wherein the system comprises a physical layer, a network layer, a service layer and a service layer, wherein the physical layer is used for describing an interconnection topology structure forming a micro-grid group, the network layer is used for abstracting a corresponding information interaction object into proxy nodes based on the interconnection topology structure forming the micro-grid group, acquiring local measurement data of the micro-grid group through the proxy nodes, carrying out data interaction through private data negotiation and carrying out anomaly identification through consensus anomaly perception, and meanwhile, generating a control strategy for carrying out energy scheduling on the micro-grid group based on the local measurement data, and the service layer is used for realizing information interaction with the network layer and obtaining required anomaly identification information, state estimation information and control strategy information. The method and the device have the advantages that privacy is protected, meanwhile, only boundary values are exchanged and stored, transmission and storage requirements are reduced, flexibility and economy of micro-grid operation control are effectively improved, micro-grid potential is exerted, and a foundation is laid for energy management and scheduling of follow-up micro-grid groups.

title_en: Power distribution network scheduling management method and system based on digestion capability evaluation
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network scheduling management method and system based on digestion capability evaluation, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the power grid consumption coefficient, the target regional power grid is subjected to consumption evaluation, the power absorption data and the power transportation data are subjected to data twinning according to the consumption evaluation result, N data twinning layers are constructed according to the data twinning space, the N data twinning layers are coupled through a data coupling module, power grid dispatching adaptation is performed in the power digital twinning network, a power grid dispatching adaptation data set is obtained for dispatching optimization, and the power distribution network is dispatched and managed according to the optimization result.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin flood inundation range verification method and system based on remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin flood inundation range verification method and system based on remote sensing, comprising river geographic space information extraction and release; constructing a digital twin platform; a GIS engine is adopted, webGL and a geographic information technology are combined, and a flood inundation range verification system based on remote sensing images and a digital twin platform is established; modeling a data base plate and a river; dynamically updating and rendering the river; carrying out inundation analysis prediction accuracy verification on the updated digital twin scene in the system; and (5) data storage. According to the image data, the method extracts the river shp file, the DEM and the DOM texture file, dynamically models the river, and locally updates the spatial and geographic information of the digital twin bottom plate; performing superposition comparison according to the latest water surface area of the river and the inundation analysis water surface obtained by calculation of the mechanism model, verifying the prediction precision of the model, and providing data support for model parameter adjustment; the engineering applicability is strong, the specific drainage basin is not relied on, and the method has good popularization value in the digital twin field.
assignees: NANJING NARI WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid equipment operation state prediction and optimization method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting and optimally controlling the running state of power grid equipment based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: acquiring equipment information; constructing a digital twin model of the equipment; constructing a digital twin hybrid model of power grid equipment; processing equipment information data; obtaining a comprehensive evaluation result; the running state of the equipment is comprehensively visually perceived; predicting and optimally controlling the state of power grid equipment; correcting the digital twin model; and (5) optimizing and controlling the state of the power grid equipment. The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid operation, and particularly provides a method for predicting and optimally controlling the operation state of power grid equipment based on a digital twin technology, which has the following advantages: (1) The comprehensive visual sensing capability of the running state of the equipment is improved; (2) The accuracy of real-time prediction and optimization control of the running state of the power grid equipment is improved; (3) And the accuracy of equipment fault early warning and the emergency decision handling capability of operation and maintenance personnel are improved.
assignees: NANJING HANYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Economical efficiency estimation device and economical efficiency estimation method using charge-discharge curve of secondary battery
title_ko: 축전지의 충방전 곡선을 사용한 경제성 추정 장치 및 경제성 추정 방법
abstract_en: To estimate a charge-discharge curve and estimate an efficiency degradation state for various secondary batteries to perform charge prioritization for optimizing economical efficiency for an aggregate of the plurality of secondary batteries.SOLUTION: An economical efficiency estimation device derives an approximate curve of an initial open end voltage function and an initial impedance function to set a prior estimation function to measure a charge-discharge voltage and a charge-discharge current. A state estimation unit uses a Kalman filter to estimate state parameters including an SOC value, a polarization voltage and internal impedance. The device uses the state parameters to determine an estimation error between a prior estimation voltage and an actual measurement voltage, determines a post estimation value with a correction formula according to a Gaussian function using the calculated estimation error, a learning ratio set for the current and a correction width as a term, adjusts the prior estimation function based on the post estimation value, and sets a new prior estimation function to estimate a charge-discharge curve. The device estimates an economical index on the basis of a charge-discharge power amount of a secondary battery estimated from the charge-discharge curve.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Intelligent operation platform for urban green body
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation platform of an urban green body, which comprises the following components: the intelligent carbon strategy sub-platform is used for setting a target view consisting of carbon emission evaluation and a carbon emission reduction scheme; the carbon control sub-platform is used for controlling carbon emission; the low-carbon scene distributed management sub-platform is used for constructing a green factory network; the carbon reduction technology application sub-platform is used for carrying out carbon reduction technology application of urban green bodies. The intelligent operation platform of the urban green body further comprises a water service clouding digital twin intelligent body, wherein the water service clouding digital twin intelligent body comprises: the system comprises a business element fusion twin module, a machine intelligent derivative evolution module and a water business enterprise intelligent operation module; the intelligent operation platform of the urban green body further comprises an intelligent carbon system for raw water dispatching and integrated comprehensive dispatching of the plant, the net, the river, the lake and the sea. The invention also discloses the urban green body comprising the intelligent operation platform, so that the urban green body can be managed in a lower-carbon environment-friendly system mode.
assignees: SHENZHEN WATER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power communication model building method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power communication model establishment method, which belongs to the technical field of power communication and comprises the following steps: collecting various performance data and equipment information of power equipment and systems, and obtaining data suitable for model training through data cleaning and normalization operation; training a digital twin model according to the collected data using a neural network or regression analysis algorithm to digitally simulate various parameters and performance indicators of the power equipment and system. By collecting and processing data in real time, the method can improve the efficiency and accuracy of power equipment and systems. The digital twin model can simulate and predict the state and behavior of equipment, so that problems can be found in advance and corresponding measures can be taken; the digital twin model can predict the energy demand, so that the energy scheduling and distribution are optimized, and the energy conservation and emission reduction are realized. By means of real-time monitoring and optimization of the power equipment and the system, the method can reduce energy consumption and environmental pollution.
assignees: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Digital power grid system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital power grids and discloses a digital twin-based digital power grid system which is characterized by comprising a central processing unit, a data acquisition module, a monitoring device, a twin modeling module, a data transmission module, a scene display module and a mobile terminal, wherein the central processing unit is respectively connected with the data acquisition module, the twin modeling module and the data transmission module, the data acquisition module is also connected with a sensor group, the twin modeling module is also connected with the scene display module, and the data transmission module is also connected with the mobile terminal. The digital power grid system based on digital twin provided by the invention adopts the accurate space-time service and the digital twin technology provided by the Beidou, and provides the digital power grid system based on the Beidou and the digital twin technology, so that the efficient management and maintenance of the power grid operation are realized.
assignees: HAIDONG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Computing power resource allocation optimization method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a computing power resource allocation optimization method and system based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of computing power resource allocation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: combining with a digital twin to construct an area integrated calculation network; collecting and acquiring a local power network; mapping and associating a local power network and an area integrated computing network; determining a target processing task; determining a target calculation force configuration point; and based on the target calculation power configuration point, aiming at a target processing task, carrying out power data calling and processing by combining network association, and determining a task processing result. According to the power system management method and the power system management device, the technical problem that the power data center responds to lower power and power demand rate due to lower power resource allocation and data processing efficiency in the traditional power system in the prior art can be solved, the purpose of improving the power resource allocation and data processing efficiency in the power system is achieved, and the technical effect of improving the power data center responds to the power and power demand rate is achieved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fault identification method, system, medium and equipment of substation equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent substations, and discloses a fault identification method, a system, a medium and equipment of substation equipment, wherein the fault identification method comprises the following steps: constructing a fault identification model comprising a gating network and a plurality of different expert networks, wherein the gating network identifies equipment categories in an input image, and the input image classified by the gating network is input into the corresponding expert network according to the identified equipment categories to obtain fault category identification results under different categories; when a new fault class occurs in a certain class of equipment, a neuron is newly built at an output layer of the expert network corresponding to the equipment, and the updated expert network is retrained by combining the new fault image sample, the old fault image sample and the normal image sample corresponding to the new fault, so that the real-time updating of the fault identification model is realized. The invention can identify fault types in a layered manner, realize real-time updating of the whole model, and increase the accuracy of the model while accelerating the identification speed of the model.
assignees: JINAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;INST AUTOMATION CAS

title_en: ICSA-CNN-based coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine dynamic disaster prediction, in particular to a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction method based on ICSA-CNN. Firstly, acquiring influence index data of a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster, and identifying and eliminating abnormal data by using an isolated forest method iForest; RF is selected as an estimator of a chained multiple interpolation method MICE to interpolate the missing data; then, an initial model framework of a convolutional neural network CNN is built, a Tent chaotic mapping improved crow searching algorithm CSA is used for obtaining ICSA, and super parameters of the model are optimized, so that prediction accuracy is improved; and finally, training a model, establishing a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction model based on ICSA-CNN, and verifying the model accuracy by using a test set. The invention combines the superior optimizing capability of ICSA with the strong characteristic learning capability of CNN, and can realize the accurate prediction of the coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Digital twin power grid power station management information platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin power grid power station management information platform, which relates to the technical field of power grid power stations and comprises a data acquisition module, a data storage and management module, an operation monitoring and fault diagnosis module and a visualization and decision support module, wherein the output end of the data acquisition module is connected with the input end of the data storage and management module and is used for storing acquired data in the data storage and management module for management analysis, the output end of the data storage and management module is connected with the input end of the operation monitoring and fault diagnosis module, the operation monitoring and fault diagnosis module extracts data in the data storage and management module and performs real-time monitoring and fault diagnosis, and the operation monitoring and fault diagnosis module is electrically connected with the visualization and decision support module. The invention can optimize the power grid operation mode, improve the energy utilization efficiency, and can be interconnected and intercommunicated with other intelligent devices and systems to realize the functions of electric power market transaction, energy scheduling and the like.
assignees: HAIDONG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Stratum pregnancy disaster digital twin perception identification system
abstract_en: The invention provides a stratum pregnancy and disaster digital twin perception identification system, which belongs to the technical field of stratum analysis and comprises the following components: drilling a plurality of main pipes at the center of the calibration area, and drilling a plurality of secondary pipes at a position which is separated from the main pipes by a certain distance. And feeding the information related to the transmitter and the receiver back to the upper computer in real time, and presuming the specific position and the specific range of the stratum defect area by changing the positions and the angles of the transmitter and the receiver and reinforcing the defect area on the ground. The replacement of gas and the transmission of material data are realized through the main pipe and the secondary pipe; when an accident occurs, the transmitter is taken out of the main pipe and personnel rescue is carried out. The stratum pregnancy digital twin perception identification system provided by the invention can be used for fully detecting the stratum, so that the replacement of gas and the transmission of material data are realized, the integration level of the whole system is improved, the construction safety is improved, and the stable construction is ensured.
assignees: UNIV HAINAN;THE 13TH CONSTRUCTION CO LTD OF CHINA NAT CHEMICAL ENGINEERING

title_en: Digital twinning-based photovoltaic system design model system and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic system design model system based on digital twin and a use method thereof, and particularly relates to the technical field of photovoltaics, wherein the system comprises a digital twin energy planning platform overall, and the digital twin energy planning platform overall comprises: a data layer, a platform layer and an interaction layer. According to the invention, geographic and meteorological parameters are collected through the design of the photovoltaic system, the influence of sunlight hours and shielding shadow of shielding obstacles is analyzed, the arrangement form of the photovoltaic array is determined, the continuity, uniformity and maximization of the received solar radiation are comprehensively considered, the installation inclination angle and azimuth angle of the photovoltaic module are designed, and the maximum optimal effect of installed capacity and power generation is achieved.
assignees: CHINA TIESIJU CIVIL ENG GROUP CO LTD;ELECTRICAL ENG CO LTD OF CTCE GROUP

title_en: State evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium of energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state evaluation method, device and equipment of an energy storage power station and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring current state data of the energy storage power station at least two moments, and calculating a current state estimation value vector corresponding to the current state data at each moment; acquiring a comparison set of the energy storage power station on a state evaluation index; the control sets include a positive control set and a negative control set; calculating the association degree between the current state estimation value vector and the comparison set; the association degree includes: a first degree of association between the current state estimate vector and the positive control set, and a second degree of association between the current state estimate vector and the negative control set; drawing a state vector diagram of the energy storage power station according to the first association degree and the second association degree corresponding to the current state data at each moment; and estimating the state change of the energy storage power station according to the vector displacement between the state vectors at each moment on the state vector diagram, thereby realizing the global estimation of the state change trend of the energy storage power station from the time dimension.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid fault control method based on digital twin
abstract_en: By collecting real-time power grid operation data and equipment information, a digital twin model is constructed, and the model can accurately reflect the state and the operation condition of an actual power grid. And the sensor and the monitoring equipment are used for collecting parameters such as voltage, current, frequency and the like of each node of the power grid in real time, and feeding the data back to the digital twin model. In the digital twin model, potential fault hidden dangers such as equipment overload and unstable voltage and the like existing in the power grid are identified through analyzing real-time data. And carrying out risk assessment on the detected fault hidden danger, determining the influence degree of the fault hidden danger on the safety and stability of the power grid, and classifying the fault hidden danger into high, medium and low risk grades. And (5) formulating a corresponding control strategy according to the risk level of the hidden trouble. After the control measures are implemented, the state of the power grid is continuously monitored, and the real-time feedback of the control effect to the digital twin model is ensured.
assignees: BEIJING JINGNENG CLEAN ENERGY POWER CO LTD INNER MONGOLIA BRANCH

title_en: Intelligent wind power equipment management and control method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent wind power equipment control method and system based on a digital twin technology, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the following steps: testing to obtain a plurality of blade characteristic parameter sets, constructing query conditions, acquiring historical homogeneous pitch data records, constructing a wind power pitch twin model, acquiring current external wind direction information and wind speed information, carrying out twin simulation by combining the pitch angles of the current blades to obtain simulated pneumatic torque and pneumatic power, judging according to a threshold value, if the current wind direction information and the wind speed information are not met, not managing and controlling, constructing constraint conditions and objective functions, carrying out adjustment and optimization to obtain an optimal pitch angle, adopting the optimal pitch angle to combine the wind direction information and the wind speed information, carrying out twin simulation, carrying out verification, carrying out pitch change when the verification is successful, and completing management and control. The method solves the technical problems that the traditional method lacks comprehensive prediction and optimization capability, and cannot comprehensively consider all influence factors, so that the optimal pitch angle cannot be determined.
assignees: YUNNAN DIANNENG SMART ENERGY CO LTD;YUNNAN POWER INVESTMENT GREEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Probability photovoltaic power generation prediction method for comprehensive missing data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a probability photovoltaic power generation prediction method for comprehensively deleting data, which belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation and comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring historical photovoltaic power generation data and constructing a training data set; s2, constructing a long-term and short-term memory network through a recurrent neural network based on the training data set; s3, constructing a long-term memory network model based on the long-term memory network; s4, acquiring missing data, determining an incomplete data set based on the missing data, and training a long-period memory network model based on the incomplete data set to acquire a photovoltaic power generation prediction model; and S5, acquiring a photovoltaic power generation predicted value based on the photovoltaic power generation predicted model.
