abstract_en: The invention discloses a grading assimilation method of a mine digital twin model, which comprises the steps of establishing digital twin models with different scales step by using the grading assimilation method, monitoring data of a whole mine, assimilating and establishing a primary digital twin model; then, a stress field of a primary digital twin model is utilized for a certain mining face, and a secondary digital twin model is established after simulation mining and assimilation treatment; finally, a stress field of a secondary digital twin model is utilized for a certain roadway of the mining face, and a tertiary digital twin model is established after simulation excavation and assimilation treatment; therefore, time and calculation process required by building each model are effectively reduced, different model precision criteria are designed according to different research scales, so that the operation speed is matched with the model precision, and finally ground stress distribution data similar to actual tests can be obtained through simulation under the condition of the precision required by different research objects, so that data support is provided for preventing abnormal dynamic disasters.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Short-circuit parameter library maintenance method and system based on short-circuit capacity real-time measurement technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-circuit parameter library maintenance method and a short-circuit parameter library maintenance system based on a short-circuit capacity real-time measurement technology, which relate to the technical field of short-circuit parameter library maintenance and comprise the steps of collecting power grid operation parameters and historical data; constructing a short circuit analysis model, judging the short circuit condition and updating the short circuit parameters to a short circuit parameter library in real time; predicting the short circuit risk of the power grid through the short circuit parameter library data and taking risk countermeasures; and (5) carrying out safety protection measures on the short-circuit parameter library and carrying out data backup regularly. According to the invention, the power grid short circuit type is analyzed by collecting the power grid operation parameters so as to construct the power grid short circuit analysis model, so that the real-time update and maintenance of the power grid short circuit parameter library are realized, the prediction algorithm is adopted to predict the future short circuit risk of the power grid, the safety and stability of the power grid are effectively improved, and the accuracy and the real-time performance of data are greatly improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Energy storage power station supervisory systems based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of energy storage power stations, in particular to an energy storage power station supervision system based on digital twinning. The utility model provides an energy storage power station supervisory systems based on digit twin, includes intelligent monitoring system and control system, control system includes three-dimensional visual control system and on-the-spot control module, intelligent monitoring system connects three-dimensional visual monitoring system and on-the-spot control module, on-the-spot control module with three-dimensional visual monitoring system connects. The intelligent safety system has the advantages of intelligence, high safety, high efficiency, quick response and convenience.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network state characterization method based on graph mask reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power distribution network state characterization method based on graph mask reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of S1, modeling a topological structure of a power distribution network as an abnormal graph; S2, reconstructing a path through a path mask predictor, S3, reconstructing node attributes through a node attribute mask predictor, and S4, optimizing the model. The power distribution network state calculating method based on the heterogeneous graph mask modeling can accurately model topological relation and state variables of the power distribution network, the model can capture complex graph structures containing semantics, node attributes and edges of a more efficient predictive graph, the state of the power distribution network can be rapidly and accurately calculated through a pre-trained graph neural network model, power distribution topological data of the power distribution network are abstracted into heterogeneous graph structures, and the method has high efficiency, intuitionistic and flexible performance data and higher accuracy in a state estimation task compared with a back propagation network and a convolution neural network.

title_en: Method and system for improving power system state estimation robustness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for improving the robustness of power system state estimation, which relate to the technical field of power system state estimation and comprise the steps of obtaining a power grid model and measurement data, carrying out cluster analysis on the power grid measurement data by using self-organizing map SOM, and clustering the power grid measurement data into k clusters; calculating a center for each cluster; calculating the distance between each piece of measurement data of the power grid and the center of the measurement cluster by using an improved Sigmoid function, and adjusting a threshold delta according to the distance; initializing state estimation, and calculating weight according to a Huber loss function by using the obtained self-adaptive threshold delta; updating the state estimation and judging whether the convergence condition is satisfied. The invention can improve the state estimation robustness and estimation accuracy under the condition that a great amount of noise and abnormal values exist in measurement.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Library position dynamic recommendation method and device based on electric power storage digital twin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power storage, and provides a method and a device for dynamically recommending library positions based on power storage digital twinning. The electric power warehouse digital twinning-based library position dynamic recommendation method comprises the steps of inquiring whether electric power materials to be warehoused exist belonging projects or not from an electric power material information database according to names and order numbers of the electric power materials to be warehoused, and determining corresponding flat warehouses and corresponding storage library areas in the flat warehouses; according to the determined flat warehouse and the corresponding storage warehouse area in the flat warehouse, a grid warehouse model of the corresponding flat warehouse is called; based on the grid type warehouse model of the flat type warehouse and the size of the electric power materials to be warehoused, in the corresponding storage warehouse area of the grid type warehouse model, the electric power materials to be warehoused are put by adopting an attempt putting algorithm, and storable warehouse positions are dynamically recommended.
assignees: STATE GRID INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid componentization mapping method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power grid componentization mapping method, which relates to the technical field of power grid components and is characterized in that the method comprises the following steps: obtaining damage information of a power grid component for power distribution of a residential building, analyzing, mapping and judging whether power distribution faults occur in the residential building of the digital twin power grid component; if the inside of the residential building has a power distribution fault, acquiring damage type information of a power grid component for power distribution of the residential building, basic information of residents in the residential building and influence information of residents in the residential building; judging the type of accessories required to be replaced by the power grid component according to the damage type information of the power grid component for the distribution of the residential building, and acquiring the type information of accessories carried by staff near the distribution fault in the residential building; the effect is that the staff changes in time the electric wire netting subassembly accessory of damage.
assignees: CHINA NAT INST STANDARDIZATION

title_en: Flood control four-pre-platform application system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin flood control four-pre-platform application system, which adopts a B/S mode, relies on a digital twin hydraulic intelligent center, builds a transverse fusion layer infrastructure, a data base plate, a model platform and a knowledge platform, and a standard guarantee system and a network letter safety guarantee system which longitudinally penetrate through the layers, determines a digital twin flood control four-pre-platform, and builds four-pre-scene application based on the digital twin flood control four-pre-platform, wherein the four-pre-scene application comprises a user layer, a portal layer, a service layer and a service layer. The invention can realize the precise forecast and early warning of flood disaster defense and intelligent scheduling decision.
assignees: NANJING ZHONGYU SMART WATER RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Construction scheme management method, system and computer product based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application relates to a target construction scheme management method, system and computer product based on digital twinning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring project information of a construction project in the electric power system, and acquiring a project model corresponding to the construction project according to the project information and a digital twin technology, wherein the project information comprises a plurality of project flows and processing time corresponding to each project flow; determining a target project flow constructed at the current moment based on the project model, acquiring target processing time corresponding to the target project flow, and determining construction efficiency of the target project flow according to the target processing time, wherein the target processing time comprises theoretical processing time and actual processing time; planning project flows of the construction projects according to the construction efficiency to obtain a target construction scheme, and managing the construction projects according to the target construction scheme. By adopting the method, the fine management can be realized, the management effect is improved, the actual state of the project can be obtained in real time, and the data instantaneity and the management efficiency are improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Improved non-invasive real-time carbon emission accounting method and device for electric power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved real-time carbon emission accounting method and device for a non-invasive power system. The method comprises the following steps: monitoring the power consumption of each device in the power system in real time by using a sensor and monitoring equipment; calculating the direct carbon emission of each device in the power system by using a pre-trained device running state estimation model based on the power consumption condition; calculating the real-time node electrical carbon emission intensity of each device in the power system in real time by adopting an improved carbon emission flow model; according to the node electric carbon emission intensity, calculating the indirect node electric carbon emission amount of each device in the electric power system; and integrating the direct carbon emission and the indirect node electric carbon emission of each device in the electric power system to determine the real-time total carbon emission of the electric power system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Sewerage asset management method using digital twin based mixed reality
title_ko: 디지털트윈 기반 혼합현실을 이용한 하수도 자산관리 방법
abstract_en: Prior digital twin and virtual reality convergence technologies, including Patent No. 2366293, were developed primarily for simulation or remote management of factory facilities. The present invention comprises: a step of updating a VR database (21); a step in which an external program on a mobile terminal (11) detects location direction information and transmits it to a VR server (20) via a wireless network (10); a step in which the VR server (20), having received the location direction information, queries the VR database (21) to generate MR object (53) information and AR object (52) information reflecting aging information, and transmits the generated AR object (52) information and MR object (53) information to the mobile terminal (11); a step of outputting on the same screen; a step in which the external program generates inspection information based on the input of the user of the mobile terminal (11) and transmits the generated inspection information to the VR server (20), and the VR server (20) transmits the inspection information to an asset server (40); and a step in which the asset server (40), having received the inspection information, updates an asset database (41). The present invention has the effect of dramatically improving reliability in the construction management and maintenance of sewer facilities by utilizing screenshots, a unique feature of the operating system of the mobile terminal (11), to verify the actual presence of the on-site inspector.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 하수도 시설의 자산관리 방법에 관한 것으로, 하수도 자산에 대한 디지털트윈(Digital Twin) 기반 CPS(Cyber Physical System)모델(31)이 CPS서버(30)와 연결, 구축되어 관로 및 맨홀 등 하수도 시설물의 물리정보가 CPS모델(31)로부터 추출되고, 노후정보를 비롯한 하수도 자산에 대한 자산정보가 수록된 자산데이터베이스(41)가 자산서버(40)와 연결되어 구축되며, 무선망(10) 접속 모바일단말(11)에는 외업프로그램(fieldwork program)이 탑재되어 VR서버(20)에 접속되되, 상기 CPS서버(30)와 자산서버(40)가 VR서버(20)와 연결되어, 물리정보 및 노후정보를 기초로 VR데이터베이스(21)가 갱신됨으로써, 물리정보 및 노후정보가 반영된 혼합현실 자산관리 서비스가 하수도 시설에 대하여 제공되는 것이다. 
본 발명을 통하여, 하수도 시설물에 대한 디지털트윈 기반 가상현실 서비스를 제공함에 있어서, 자산관리 기법 및 혼합현실과 증강현실 기술이 복합되어 접목됨으로써, 지하 매설 시설물에 대한 신속하고 정확한 정보 전달이 가능하며, 이로써 점검정보의 정확하고 간편한 수집 및 관리를 통한 효율적인 자산관리가 가능하다.
assignees: TAESUNG S&I CO LTD

title_en: Method for estimating the three-dimensional location of an event in an image in a forest environment
title_ko: 산림 환경에서 영상 속 이벤트의 3차원 위치 추정 방법
abstract_en: A method for estimating the three-dimensional location of an event in an image in a forest environment is provided. The method for estimating an event location according to an embodiment of the present invention includes constructing a field environment as a digital twin in a virtual space, receiving a field event video, which is a video taken of an event that occurred in the field, generating a virtual camera for a field camera that captured the field event video in a virtual space, synchronizing the vision of the virtual camera with the vision of the field camera, and identifying the location of the event occurrence using the virtual video acquired by the virtual camera. As a result, the field environment is constructed as a digital twin in a virtual space, and the three-dimensional location where the event occurred is quickly and accurately estimated through location search in the virtual space, thereby enabling a quick response to a disaster situation where initial response is important.
abstract_ko: 산림 환경에서 영상 속 이벤트의 3차원 위치 추정 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 이벤트 위치 추정 방법은, 현장 환경을 가상 공간에 디지털 트윈으로 구축하고 현장에서 발생한 이벤트를 촬영한 영상인 현장 이벤트 영상을 수신하며, 현장 이벤트 영상을 촬영한 현장 카메라에 대한 가상 카메라를 가상 공간에 생성하고, 가상 카메라의 비젼을 현장 카메라의 비젼에 동기화시키며, 가상 카메라에 의해 획득된 가상 영상을 이용하여 이벤트 발생 위치를 특정한다. 이에 의해, 현장 환경을 가상 공간에 디지털 트윈으로 구축하고, 가상 공간에서의 위치 탐색을 통해 이벤트가 발생한 3차원 위치를 빠르고 정확하게 추정함으로써, 초동 대응이 중요한 재난 상황에 대해 빠른 대응을 가능하게 한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Renewable energy based village unit microgrid operation system
title_ko: 신재생 에너지 기반 마을 단위 마이크로그리드 운영 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a village-level microgrid operation system, including: a distributed power supply system which supplies power to each household and shared facilities in the village; a living culture community-type microgrid integrated operation platform which analyzes and manages energy by type of energy in the cloud and ICT-based living culture community; an energy management system; and a digital twin safety management service platform based on a digital operation and maintenance platform. The present invention integrates and manages distributed power generation data centered on local villages and consumption data by household, establishes a monitoring system, and builds an integrated energy management platform for generation/consumption data of households and village shared facilities for independent and autonomous power grid operation at the village level, and enables continuous operation through energy service revenue linked to the platform.
abstract_ko: 마을 단위 마이크로그리드 운영 시스템에 관한 것으로, 마을 단위 각 세대와 공동 이용 시설에 전원을 공급하는 분산 전원 공급 시스템, 클라우드 및 ICT 기반 생활 문화 공동체의 에너지 유형별로 분석하여 에너지를 관리하고 운영하는 생활 문화 공동체형 마이크로그리드 통합 운영 플랫폼, 에너지 관리 시스템 그리고 디지털 운영 및 유지보수 플랫폼 기반 디지털 트윈 안전 관리 서비스 플랫폼을 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 지역 단위 마을 중심의 분산발전 데이터와 세대별 소비 데이터의 통합 관리하고, 모니터링 체계를 구축하여 마을 단위의 독립적이고 자율적인 전력망 운영을 위하여 세대와 마을 공동시설의 발전/소비 데이터의 통합 에너지관리 플랫폼을 구축하고, 플랫폼 연계의 에너지 서비스 수익을 통해 지속적인 운영을 가능하게 할 수 있다.
assignees: HERIT CORP

title_en: New energy missing data estimation method and system considering space fluctuation propagation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy power prediction, and provides a new energy missing data estimation method and a new energy missing data estimation system considering space fluctuation propagation, which are used for acquiring photovoltaic power sequences of a plurality of distributed new energy sites; extracting a fluctuation process and a stable process by using an empirical mode decomposition method; aiming at the fluctuation process, extracting a time sequence corresponding to fluctuation by using a derivative dynamic time regulation method, extracting fluctuation speed among stations, carrying out interpolation estimation on a target station, and acquiring a standard power sequence by adopting local weighted regression based on an interpolation estimation result; performing interpolation calculation by using a static interpolation algorithm aiming at a stable process to obtain an interpolated power sequence; the two sequences are summed to obtain the final result. The invention can extract the fluctuation transfer process more accurately and improve the accuracy of interpolation estimation.

title_en: Electric power facility operation cost prediction method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting the running cost of an electric power facility based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of electric power cost prediction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring input power data, output power data and power consumption data; acquiring first geographical position data and second geographical position data, and further acquiring a digital twin model of the electric power facility of the area; determining a transformer loss coefficient of the transformer in the transformer area according to the input power data and the output power data; determining an ammeter cluster according to the second geographic position data; determining a power loss coefficient according to the ammeter cluster, the electricity power data, the output power data, the first geographic position data and the second geographic position data; determining predicted power data; and obtaining the predicted running cost according to the predicted power consumption data, the loss coefficient and the power loss coefficient. According to the invention, the loss of the transformer in the transformer area and the loss in the transmission process can be considered during cost prediction, so that the accuracy of the operation cost prediction of the electric power facilities is improved.

title_en: Long-distance diversion water pump station group management and control system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application provides a group control system of a long-distance diversion water pump station based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following components: the infrastructure construction layer is used for perfecting physical layer informatization infrastructure construction and realizing the coordination of the cloud computing platform, the fog computing platform and the edge computing platform; the digital twin layer is used for integrating a dynamic data base plate resource system and a collection mechanism, establishing a fusion mode of data, models, knowledge and visual scenes, and realizing interaction between the virtual scenes and the real scenes; the business layer is used for realizing basic support, intelligent monitoring, intelligent diagnosis, operation control and safety management by taking the pump station self-prediction self-diagnosis model as a basis and the operation knowledge of the pump stations and the pump station group as a drive; the application layer is used for realizing the operation control of the pump station group by applying a digital twin pump station operation control frame system based on a closed-loop feedback control theory of perception-simulation-feedback-control. The application can better evaluate the running state of the target system and provide scientific basis for related decisions.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Method and device for calculating future state power flow of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for calculating future state power flow of a power grid, wherein the calculating method comprises the following steps: acquiring state estimation results derived by the network modulation control system and the provincial modulation control system; splicing and constructing an external network model according to the state estimation results of the network modulation control system and the provincial modulation control system; acquiring operation boundary data of a provincial power grid, and generating future-state power grid topology by adopting the external network model in combination with the state estimation data; carrying out load flow calculation based on the future state power grid topology to obtain the future state power flow of the power grid; according to the invention, by splicing the provincial and network-modulated power grid calculation model and the planning data, more accurate future state whole network model mode data is obtained, and finally, the accuracy of a tide calculation result is effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for diagnosing key fault problems of photovoltaic power generation system in complex mountain scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for diagnosing key fault problems of a photovoltaic power generation system in a complex mountain scene, which comprises the steps of collecting corresponding data and preprocessing the data; establishing a digital twin model of the photovoltaic power generation system according to the preprocessed data, and fusing the topographic features, the equipment characteristics, the operation and management data; constructing a multi-level data system by utilizing multi-source data, and optimizing a digital twin model by using a multi-level data system; preparing a routing plan and a navigation scheme of the photovoltaic power station, analyzing the light resource distribution differences of different blocks of the photovoltaic system, analyzing the energy efficiency among the blocks according to the light resource differences, and identifying the blocks with low performance; and analyzing the influence of multiple environmental factors on the faults of the photovoltaic system, developing a fault intelligent diagnosis algorithm based on the environmental factors, and performing iterative optimization. According to the method, by analyzing the influence of the light resource distribution difference and the environmental factors of different blocks, more accurate maintenance strategies and fault diagnosis are realized.
assignees: MAMAYA PHOTOVOLTAIC BRANCH OF GUIZHOU BEIPANJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network digital twin body aggregation mapping method and device based on electrical topology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power information, and discloses a distribution network digital twin body aggregation mapping method and device based on electric topology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the distributed source network charge storage topology model is constructed based on the distributed source network charge storage topology model, the distributed source network charge storage twin aggregation model is obtained by carrying out distributed network digital twin aggregation according to the distributed source network charge storage topology model, the distributed source network charge storage twin aggregation model is mapped on line by fusing on-line operation states, the distributed source network charge storage twin aggregation model is obtained by carrying out digital twin aggregation by fusing the distributed source network charge storage topology, when the operation states of equipment change, only the on-line operation states are required to carry out on-line mapping change on the distributed source network charge storage twin aggregation model, global topological islands do not need to be regenerated, the state change efficiency of the distributed network digital twin is improved, and the change is convenient and quick.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Pollution and carbon reduction assisting method and device based on large data of electric power-economic data characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pollution and carbon reduction assisting method and device based on electric power-economic data characteristic big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining entropy weight local outlier factors of each original data point with electric power, economy, environment and energy dimension based on an improved local outlier factor method, constructing a missing data filling model based on a K average-improved mean interpolation method based on data with outlier elimination, dividing the data with outlier elimination into a complete data set and an incomplete data set, clustering the complete data set by adopting a K average clustering algorithm, calculating the missing value by adopting the improved mean interpolation method by adopting the incomplete data set, and combining the results of the two to obtain the complete data set with the missing value filling; and when the complete data set reaches the precision or the maximum iteration number, the output data set with abnormal values removed and the missing values filled is applied to data analysis of pollution reduction and carbon reduction, so that pollution reduction and carbon reduction are assisted. The device comprises: a processor and a memory.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Construction method, recording medium and system of photovoltaic power generation project cost model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, and particularly relates to a construction method of a photovoltaic power generation project cost model, wherein quotation is layered, a meta module is introduced, the calculation amount of the generation cost is greatly reduced, project characteristics and design parameters are reserved as input items, the depth of engineering application is reached, and the reliability of output data is improved; the method combines the real-time updating of the information of the monovalent library, improves the accuracy and timeliness of the generation of the manufacturing cost result, and is particularly suitable for engineering practice under the background of continuous development and change of the photovoltaic technology. The invention also provides a non-transient readable recording medium storing the program of the method and a system comprising the medium, and the program can be called by a processing circuit to execute the method.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for coupling and visualizing one-dimensional hydrodynamic section and two-dimensional river network of river channel
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for coupling and visualizing a one-dimensional hydrodynamic section and a two-dimensional river network of a river channel, wherein the method comprises the following steps: crossing the river channel region boundary with the river channel section to obtain new vertex data; constructing a Delaunay triangle network with constraint aiming at the boundary vertex set; carrying out local optimization on each triangular net to serve as a dissected river net data set; assigning the river elevation value to the vertex of the river network; intersecting the river network center line with the river cross section, and establishing an index relationship between the river cross section and the river network center line; calculating the weight and index relation between the river network vertex and the river cross section to form a coupling file of the one-dimensional river cross section and the two-dimensional river network model; driving the updating of the river network vertex through the one-dimensional section calculation result; and performing visual rendering on the programmed grid body. The invention meets the application requirements of efficiently simulating two-dimensional river network inundation analysis through one-dimensional river section under digital twin scenes and dynamically displaying the water level and the water depth of the river based on time sequence.

title_en: Reservoir informatization management method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of reservoir informatization management, and particularly discloses a reservoir informatization management method based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring monitoring reservoir parameter information, establishing a digital twin model, synchronizing real-time data, verifying and optimizing the model, and carrying out real-time monitoring and early warning; according to the invention, the data of the relevant parameters of the reservoir are collected in real time, and are analyzed and predicted by combining the digital twin model, so that the abnormal condition of the reservoir in operation can be timely found, the flood risk is reduced, the safety of the reservoir is ensured, scientific decision support is provided for reservoir management staff by combining the real-time data and the digital twin model, the reservoir operation strategy is optimized, the comprehensive benefit and operation safety of the reservoir are improved, the comprehensive analysis and optimization are carried out on the reservoir operation state by combining the digital twin model, the parameters such as the water level, the water quality and the flood discharge amount of the reservoir can be accurately controlled, the operation efficiency and the resource utilization rate of the reservoir are improved, and the manual operation and management cost is reduced.
assignees: HEBEI WATER CONSERVANCY PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Power grid dynamic partitioning method and system considering electrical characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic partitioning method and a dynamic partitioning system for a power grid, which take electrical characteristics into consideration, and relates to the technical field of power system automation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a power grid model and state estimation data, and constructing a node branch model; setting node types and forming a full-network full-augmentation jacobian matrix; calculating a sensitivity coefficient matrix S of active power and reactive power injected into the node by the node voltage according to the jacobian matrix; calculating the electrical distance between nodes, initializing power grid partitions and calculating initial modularity indexes of all the partitions; combining all the nodes outside the computing partition to form a new partition, computing the index variation of the partition module, and selecting the node with the largest index variation to form the new partition; checking the connectivity of the region, repeating the partition dividing process, and obtaining the optimal partition dividing result after the region cannot be combined. The invention comprehensively considers the electrical factors such as power generation, load, grid structure and the like in the power grid, can support new energy to generate and consume, and is suitable for the grid structure of the main grid and the distribution grid.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power equipment fault detection method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a power equipment fault detection method and system based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing simulation modeling according to intermediate values of a plurality of environment neighborhoods and basic information of the power equipment, and constructing an equipment twin model library; matching to obtain an adaptive equipment twin model for synchronous operation, obtaining actual operation data and synchronous simulation operation data for deviation comparison, and predicting equipment faults based on deviation comparison results to generate predicted fault types and predicted occurrence nodes; obtaining an associated fault type set according to the predicted fault type; and determining an equipment overhaul window according to the predicted occurrence node, and executing equipment fault overhaul. The method and the device can solve the problem of poor equipment operation stability caused by incapability of timely and effective treatment of potential fault threat due to low accuracy and comprehensiveness of power equipment fault prediction, and can improve the accuracy and comprehensiveness of fault prediction, thereby achieving the effect of guaranteeing the equipment operation stability.
assignees: PENGPAI SHUZHI BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based photovoltaic flexible support whole-station stress early warning method and system
abstract_en: A photovoltaic flexible support whole station stress early warning method and system based on digital twinning comprises the following steps: collecting real-time stress data of a single photovoltaic array, photovoltaic bracket attributes and weather forecast data of the whole photovoltaic power station, cleaning and preprocessing the data, and extracting features; combining the real-time stress data, weather forecast data and bracket attribute of the single photovoltaic array after data cleaning and preprocessing to establish a digital twin model; training a digital twin model by using historical data, inputting real-time stress data of a single photovoltaic square matrix into the trained digital twin model, and predicting the stress variation trend of a flexible support of the whole photovoltaic power station; and analyzing whether potential safety hazards exist in the flexible support of the whole photovoltaic power station according to the prediction result. The establishment of the digital twin model utilizes a neural network method, and has higher prediction accuracy and stability; potential safety hazards can be found in time, and the safety and stability of the photovoltaic power station are improved.
assignees: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Digital twinning-based flood season water level real-time analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy and hydropower, in particular to a digital twinning-based real-time flood season water level analysis method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting reservoir dispatching basic data, and accessing real-time dispatching operation data and future rainfall flood forecast data from a digital twin system; analyzing whether the reservoir meets floating operation conditions or not, and determining a reservoir scheduling strategy in a foreseeing period; setting a reservoir water level control target, and calculating a water reservoir scheduling process in a foreseeing period; according to the rainfall forecast in the extension period, a future warehousing flood process is assumed; taking the water level at the end of the forecast period as the starting water level, carrying out flood regulation calculation and analyzing the flood discharge risk of the reservoir area submerged and the middle and downstream river channels; the control water level is corrected at the end of the foreseeing period until the risk is within an acceptable range. The invention combines a digital twin system, realizes the rapid previewing of flood control scheduling, improves the real-time operability of reservoir floating operation, fully utilizes flood resources and effectively improves the analysis capability of subsequent flood control risks.

title_en: Power grid digital twin cloud rendering method and device and power grid digital twin system
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for rendering a digital twin cloud of a power grid and a digital twin system of the power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring effective real-time data and effective historical data of a power grid; performing time stamp alignment on the effective real-time data and the effective historical data by using time stamp precision to obtain optimized real-time data and optimized historical data; constructing a digital twin three-dimensional model by using a cloud rendering engine according to the optimization real-time data and the optimization historical data, wherein the digital twin three-dimensional model is a three-dimensional model generated by digitally modeling the power grid entity equipment and the power system by using a digitizing technology; and dynamically distributing cloud computing resources according to the digital twin three-dimensional model, and rendering at the cloud according to the distributed cloud computing resources. The method solves the problems of resource waste and rendering performance degradation caused by unreasonable resource allocation in the prior art.
assignees: JIANGMEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Railway disaster risk prevention and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway disaster risk prevention and control method and a system, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster risk early warning and acquire real-time meteorological disaster data and image data of railway monitoring points; displaying the state of the railway monitoring point, the risk value and the early warning information after disaster simulation evaluation; performing risk assessment and deduction prediction on railway disasters based on the monitoring data to obtain risk classification states of monitoring points and disaster follow-up development information; and pushing corresponding strategies according to the risk states of the monitoring points, performing strategy previewing and efficiency previewing on different pushed prevention and control or emergency strategies to obtain an optimal strategy for risk prevention and control, and guiding and optimizing emergency resource deployment. The invention applies digital twinning, and the Internet of things, state information, algorithm model, simulation deduction and the like form effective monitoring, simulation and prediction on physical entities through virtual-real data interaction, thereby realizing the functions of super-real-time state sensing and automatic emergency response linkage, and having good application and popularization values.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for predicting electric energy use efficiency
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for predicting the use efficiency of electric energy, wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps: establishing a state estimation equation and a covariance estimation equation; establishing a multiple regression equation of the power dimension; acquiring power consumption of a first time period; determining a first predicted value of power consumption for a second time period; determining an estimated dimension error matrix corresponding to the second time period; determining a second predicted value of the power consumption in a second time period by using the power deviation parameter in the multiple regression equation; determining fusion parameters; according to the fusion parameters, fusing the first predicted value and the second predicted value; and determining the power utilization efficiency value of the data center in the second time period according to the target predicted value of the power consumption of the second time period. The embodiment of the application can reduce the requirement of sample data on the aspect of data quantity or data accuracy, and can improve the accuracy of the prediction result of the power consumption of the target equipment and the prediction result of the electric energy use efficiency.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Method and system suitable for power monitoring historical data missing completion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a missing completion method and system suitable for power monitoring historical data, which relate to the technical field of missing data filling and comprise the following steps: collecting data and preprocessing; taking a substation busbar measurement data set as an input of a DBO-RF algorithm; searching the missing values in the data set, carrying out missing value index, and constructing a missing number sequence; optimizing the number of decision trees and the minimum leaf number of the random forest model by using a DBO algorithm; and supplementing the missing value in the electric power data set through the optimized follow-up forest regression prediction model. The golden sine algorithm is adopted, the disturbance amplitude is restrained by the sine function, and the original dung beetle algorithm is optimized in a form of a piecewise function, so that the searching capability of the dung beetle algorithm is effectively improved, and the range is narrowed. And the random forest model is optimized based on the dung beetle algorithm to fill in missing values of the large electric power data, so that the data integrity is improved, the data integrity is ensured, and a foundation is provided for the optimized operation of the transformer substation.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Digital contracture system for urban flood control command and dispatch
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban flood control dispatching, in particular to a digital contracture system for urban flood control command dispatching, which comprises a bottom plate and a power supply, wherein the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a command dispatching host, the front surface of the command dispatching host is provided with a display, the upper surface of the command dispatching host is provided with an operation panel, the upper surface of the bottom plate is provided with a server, the upper surface of the command dispatching host is provided with a wireless signal transceiver, the upper surface of the bottom plate is provided with a groove, the inside of the groove is provided with a hydraulic rod, and the output end of the hydraulic rod is fixedly connected with a fixed plate. According to the invention, the flood control scheduling model can be established by matching the digital twin body establishment module and the digital twin calibration module, so that a worker can observe flood control more clearly, and the comparison analysis can be carried out on urban reservoir information and the scheduling model by matching the flood control scheduling model establishment module and the reservoir scheduling information acquisition unit, so that the scheduling accuracy is improved.
assignees: XUZHOU CITY TONGSHAN DISTR WATER CONSERVANCY BUREAU

title_en: Industrial automation wind-resistant fireproof rolling shutter door control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rolling shutter door control, in particular to an industrial automatic wind-resistant fireproof rolling shutter door control system. According to the invention, an environment risk network constructed by the risk assessment module is matched with a real-time updated risk level, a solid data support is provided for emergency response, the response strategy optimization module automatically adjusts the rolling door operation through an optimization algorithm, the response flexibility and effectiveness are improved, the combination of the linkage control module and dynamic path optimization ensures that the emergency operation is executed in an optimal sequence, the disaster prevention and reduction capability of the system is obviously improved, and meanwhile, the emergency response execution module can ensure the rapid and accurate execution of control instructions, the safety protection is enhanced, and the safety protection capability under emergency conditions is effectively improved.
assignees: SHANXI CONSTR ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Deep learning-based digital twin gas monitoring method and platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of gas network monitoring, and discloses a gas digital twin monitoring method and a platform based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a corresponding network topology static model and a corresponding equipment dynamic model according to network basic data of the gas network; constructing a corresponding equipment fault diagnosis data model by using a deep learning algorithm; constructing a corresponding equipment fault positioning data model by using a deep learning algorithm; integrating a network topology static model, an equipment dynamic model, an equipment fault diagnosis data model and an equipment fault positioning data model to construct a corresponding gas digital twin model; and (3) using a gas digital twin model to monitor a gas network in real time and obtaining a corresponding real-time monitoring result. The invention solves the problems of high cost, low efficiency, lack of comprehensive and accurate monitoring and low safety and practicability existing in the prior art.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST PETROLEUM

title_en: Electric power safety control system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power safety control system based on digital twin, which belongs to the technical field of digital twin, and comprises the following components: the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring the operation data of each device in the power system; the data processing unit is used for processing the received operation data; a digital twin model construction unit; real-time monitoring unit: the digital twin model is used for monitoring the digital twin model of the power system in real time; a failure prediction unit; and an intelligent control unit: the intelligent control strategy is formulated according to a digital twin model of the power system. According to the invention, the digital twin technology is adopted to realize real-time monitoring, fault prediction and intelligent control of the power system, so that the safety performance of the power system is improved; the comprehensive monitoring and intelligent control of the power system are realized through the cooperative work of the data acquisition unit, the data processing unit, the digital twin model construction unit, the real-time monitoring unit, the fault prediction unit and the intelligent control unit.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGKE YUNMO VISION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Uncertainty-considered heterogeneous energy coupling unit interval state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous energy coupling unit interval state estimation method considering uncertainty, which comprises the following steps: analyzing the energy conversion process of the electric-thermal coupling unit, and constructing a dynamic coupling unit energy conversion model; establishing an electric coupling module state space model and a thermal coupling module state space model; taking the influence of uncertainty on a system into consideration, constructing a system model containing interval numbers; a Guerbet estimator is proposed for a system model containing interval numbers, and positive representation conversion is carried out on the Guerbet estimator; processing the interval number of the estimator after the positive representation to obtain a coupling unit estimator capable of realizing interval state estimation; and realizing the electric-thermal cooperative state estimation of the energy coupling unit by using a neural network model. The invention can realize the interval dynamic state estimation of the energy coupling unit of the electric-thermal integrated energy system under the condition of uncertainty, and provide reliable data for the energy management system and the safety control system of the system.
assignees: UNIV NANJING NORMAL

title_en: Power transformation data processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a power transformation data processing method, a power transformation data processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation data of each power transformation device at the current moment; inputting the operation data of each power transformation device into a pre-established digital twin model, and carrying out data analysis on the operation data of each power transformation device through the digital twin model to obtain an analysis result; and visually displaying the operation data and analysis results of each power transformation device. According to the method, comprehensive and real-time data monitoring and fault analysis can be performed on the power transformation equipment according to the operation data through the established digital twin model, so that the efficiency and accuracy of fault analysis of the power transformation equipment are improved. The operation data and the analysis result are visually displayed, so that a user can conveniently operate and interact with the power transformation equipment, and the operation efficiency and stability of the power transformation system are improved.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Feature selection-based wind power prediction method and device for light gradient elevator
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting wind power of a light gradient elevator based on feature selection, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: extracting data acquired by a data acquisition system in a fixed time period; checking a data set, filling the missing data, detecting the abnormal data by adopting a clustering method with noise based on density, and replacing the abnormal data; dividing a training set and a testing set; taking temperature, wind speed and the like in a training set as input data, taking actual power as output data, training a light gradient elevator model, and obtaining feature importance scores of the input data; eliminating the features with low importance scores by using the recursive features, and updating the input data of the training set; performing feature selection on the input data of the test set; predicting by using the trained light gradient elevator; and correcting the prediction result. The method can detect the abnormal value by using the clustering method based on the density, improves the prediction precision by eliminating the recursion characteristic, and has feasibility.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Energy management method and system of temperature-controlled logistics using digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용하는 정온 물류 센터 에너지 관리 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a system for managing energy of a constant-temperature logistics center in which a distributed power source and an energy storage device are installed by using a digital twin. The disclosed method for managing energy of a constant-temperature logistics center using a digital twin comprises the steps of: predicting demand power of the constant-temperature logistics center and generated power of the distributed power source by using a digital twin for a constant-temperature logistics center in which a distributed power source and an energy storage device are installed; comparing a difference value between the predicted demand power and the predicted generated power with threshold power; and determining a load control strategy of the constant-temperature logistics center and a discharge strategy for the energy storage device of the constant-temperature logistics center according to the comparison result.
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용하여, 분산 전원 및 에너지 저장 장치가 설치된 정온 물류 센터의 에너지를 관리하는 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 개시된 디지털 트윈을 이용하는 정온 물류 센터 에너지 관리 방법은, 분산 전원 및 에너지 저장 장치가 설치된 정온 물류 센터에 대한 디지털 트윈을 이용하여, 상기 정온 물류 센터의 수요 전력 및 상기 분산 전원의 발전 전력을 예측하는 단계; 상기 예측된 수요 전력과 상기 예측된 발전 전력의 차이값과 임계 전력을 비교하는 단계; 및 상기 비교 결과에 따라서, 상기 정온 물류 센터의 부하 제어 전략 및 상기 정온 물류 센터의 에너지 저장 장치에 대한 방전 전략을 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: IUCF HYU

title_en: System and method for diagnosing and managing water pumping and reservoir system based on digital twon
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 양배수장 진단 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital twin-based drainage plant diagnosis and management system. the digital twin-based drainage plant diagnosis and management system is connected to a sensor device through a network to receive sensor data transmitted from the sensor device, generates and manages a digital twin model based on the sensor data and drainage plant facility information, and diagnoses abnormal signs of a drainage plant or facilities and equipment of the drainage plant through simulation of the digital twin model based on the sensor data and the drainage plant facility information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반의 양배수장 진단 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 네트워크를 통해 센서 장치와 연결되어 센서 장치로부터 전달되는 센서 데이터를 수신하고, 센서 데이터 및 양배수장 시설 정보에 기초하여 디지털 트윈 모델을 생성 및 관리하며, 센서 데이터 및 양배수장 시설 정보에 기초한 디지털 트윈 모델의 시뮬레이션을 통해 양배수장 또는 양배수장의 시설물 및 장비의 이상 징후를 진단하는 것을 특징으로 하는 디지털 트윈 기반의 양배수장 진단 관리 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: DALIWORKS INC

title_en: Distribution network operation missing data filling method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a filling method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for operation missing data of a distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a mask matrix and a delay matrix corresponding to incomplete operation data of the operation of the power distribution network, wherein the incomplete operation data comprises voltage amplitude, voltage phase angle, current amplitude, active power and reactive power; performing data generation countermeasure training on an initial countermeasure generation network according to incomplete operation data, a mask matrix and a delay matrix to obtain an optimized countermeasure generation network, wherein the initial countermeasure generation network is constructed based on a bidirectional gating circulation unit; and generating missing data of the target missing data by adopting an optimized countermeasure generation network to obtain filling operation data. The method and the device can solve the technical problems that the existing data generation mechanism is low in efficiency, the influence of the data space-time effect is not considered, the model accuracy problem exists, and the actual data filling effect is poor.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Power monitoring operation data anomaly detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting abnormality of power monitoring operation data, which relate to the technical field of power system state estimation and comprise the steps of collecting power system data to construct a transformer fault data set and carrying out normalization processing; optimizing an ALO algorithm by adopting a Bayes algorithm and a chaotic sequence model, and optimizing an initial clustering center of a K-means clustering algorithm by using the improved ALO algorithm; performing K-means clustering iteration by using the power data point clustering center optimized by the improved ALO algorithm as an initial clustering center; and calculating the Euclidean distance from each power data point to the corresponding clustering center, and judging the abnormal value. The global optimizing capability of the ALO optimizing algorithm is strong, the K-means algorithm is prevented from sinking into local optimization, the clustering effect of the K-means clustering algorithm can be effectively improved, and the accuracy of detecting abnormal values in the electric power data is better guaranteed. The invention has better effects in the aspects of applicability, efficiency and accuracy.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power distribution network fault diagnosis system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system fault diagnosis, and discloses a power distribution network fault diagnosis system and method based on digital twin, wherein the power distribution network fault diagnosis system based on digital twin comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring environment information, basic operation data of the power distribution network and fault information; the data processing module is used for processing and analyzing the acquired basic operation data of the power distribution network and extracting useful information and characteristics, and is connected with the data acquisition module; the digital twin model building module is used for building a digital twin model of the power distribution network according to the processed data, and is connected with the data processing module; and the information pushing module is used for pushing the fault information of the power distribution network to the fault diagnosis module. The invention has reasonable design, and the digital twin model of the power distribution network is constructed to carry out comparative diagnosis and simulation processing on the power grid fault information, thereby ensuring the fault analysis accuracy.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGKE YUNMO VISION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-weather photovoltaic power generation power prediction digital twin system based on LSTM-MM model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-weather photovoltaic power generation power prediction digital twin system based on an LSTM-MM model, which comprises the following steps: the data collection module is used for collecting historical power generation data under different weather conditions as a data set; the data preprocessing module is used for preprocessing the collected data to obtain clustering result data including sunny days, cloudy days and rainy and snowy days; the model building and training module is used for building an LSTM-MM model and training based on clustering result data, and comprises an input layer, a sunny prediction module, a cloudy prediction module, a rainy and snowy prediction module and a shared task module, a sunny gating network, a cloudy gating network, a rainy and snowy gating network and an output layer; and the photovoltaic power generation prediction module is used for inputting real-time data to predict photovoltaic power generation power after training the model by using the historical data, and periodically evaluating the deviation between the prediction result and the actual power generation data. The invention can complete the photovoltaic power generation prediction task under different weather conditions and realize high-precision prediction.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Electric power energy optimizing and scheduling system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power energy optimization scheduling system based on a digital twin technology, which comprises an energy scheduling server, edge service nodes and data acquisition nodes, wherein the data acquisition nodes are used for acquiring electric power basic information of electric power equipment and transmitting the acquired electric power basic information to the corresponding edge service nodes in real time; the edge service node is used for integrating the acquired power basic information into the regional digital twin model, carrying out power equipment state analysis and prediction based on the acquired power basic information, and integrating the acquired power equipment state analysis result and state prediction result into the regional digital twin model; the energy scheduling server is used for carrying out aggregation according to the acquired regional digital twin model data, carrying out electric power energy scheduling analysis according to the global digital twin model and issuing scheduling tasks to the scheduling terminal according to an electric power energy scheduling analysis result. The invention can meet the requirements of global data acquisition and power energy scheduling of a large-scale power network.
assignees: XIAMEN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Water pipe network intelligent system using water digital twin abd apparatus performing thereof
title_ko: 상수도 디지털 트윈 적용을 통한 상수관망 지능화 시스템 및 이의 실행 방법
abstract_en: A water pipe network intelligent server, according to the present invention, includes: a data receiving unit which receives data from a waterworks headquarters server and an open information acquisition server; a leakage prediction data processing unit which processes a sensitivity status value of a leakage meter among the data to generate and provide leakage prediction processed data; a pipe life data processing unit which processes a pressure value and a flow rate value of a pipe among the data to generate and provide pipeline life prediction processed data; a water quality data processing unit which processes a water quality value of the pipe among the data to generate and provide water quality prediction processed data; a leakage prediction unit which determines whether a leakage is possible using the leakage prediction processed data generated by the leakage prediction data processing unit; a pipe life prediction unit which predicts a pipe life using the pipe life prediction processed data generated by the pipe life data processing unit; and a water quality prediction unit which determines the water quality status of the pipe using the water quality prediction processed data generated by the water quality data processing unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 상수관망 지능화 서버는 상수도 본부 서버 및 개방형 정보 취득 서버로부터 데이터를 수신하는 데이터 수신부, 상기 데이터 중 누수 계측기의 감도 현황 값을 가공하여 누수 예측 가공데이터를 생성하여 제공하는 누수 예측 데이터 가공부, 상기 데이터 중 관로의 압력 값 및 유량 값을 가공하여 관로 수명 예측가공 데이터를 생성하여 제공하는 관로 수명 데이터 가공부, 상기 데이터 중 상기 관로의 수질 값을 가공하여 수질 예측 가공 데이터를 생성하여 제공하는 수질 데이터 가공부, 상기 누수 예측 데이터 가공부에 의해 생성된 누수 예측 가공 데이터를 이용하여 누수 가능 여부를 판단하는 누수 예측부, 상기 관로 수명 데이터 가공부에 의해 생성된 관로 수명 예측 가공 데이터를 이용하여 관로 수명을 예측하는 관로 수명 예측부 및 상기 수질 데이터 가공부에 의해 생성된 수질 예측 가공 데이터를 이용하여 상기 관로의 수질 상태를 판단하는 수질 예측부를 포함한다.
assignees: EROUMTECH CO LTD

title_en: Water Supply Remote Meter Reading System and Method for Monitoring and Reading Abnormal Date of Water Supply Remote Meter Reading
title_ko: 상수도 원격 검침 시스템 및 이를 이용한 상수도 원격 검침 이상 데이터의 감시 및 교정하는 방법
abstract_en: A water supply remote meter reading system and a method for monitoring and correcting abnormal data of water supply remote meter reading using the same can detect and correct abnormal data, and monitor leakage in the supply pipes within the block by utilizing a method for correcting abnormal data of missing values of individual supply flow meters installed in the supply pipe in the remote meter reading installation area, a method for correcting abnormal data of missing values of individual water usage, flow meter abnormality monitoring technology, and individual time supply amount correction values. The present invention has the effect of enabling the expansion of reliable application technologies such as transparent fee charging, supply pipe leakage monitoring, indoor leakage monitoring, and real-time water network analysis by improving the reliability of big data collected through the expansion of remote metering.
abstract_ko:
상수도 원격 검침 시스템 및 이를 이용한 상수도 원격 검침 이상 데이터의 감시 및 교정하는 방법은 원격 검침 설치구역에 공급관로에 설치된 개별 공급 유량계의 결측값의 이상 데이터를 교정하는 방법과, 개별 수전 사용량의 결측값의 이상 데이터를 교정하는 방법과, 유량계 이상 모니터링 기술과, 개별 시간 공급량 교정값을 활용하여 해당 블록 내 공급관로의 누수를 모니터링하는 이상 데이터 검출, 교정, 공급관로의 누수 모니터링할 수 있다. 
본 발명은 원격 검침 확대로 수집된 빅데이터의 신뢰성 향상을 통해 투명한 요금 부과와 공급관로 누수 모니터링, 옥내 누수 모니터링, 실시간 관망 해석 등 신뢰성 있는 응용 기술의 확장이 가능하도록 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: SEOUL METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT

title_en: System and method for recommending components of energy simulation for digital twin-based virtual demonstration complex
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 가상 실증 단지용 에너지 시뮬레이션 구성요소 추천 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an energy simulation component recommendation system and method that allows components and data for energy technology research and development to be easily selected and appropriately used. As an energy simulation component recommendation system connected to a researcher terminal through a network, the energy simulation component recommendation system includes: a type recommendation unit; a resource recommendation unit; a data function recommendation unit; a virtual environment unit; and a usage analysis unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 에너지 시뮬레이션 구성요소 추천 시스템은, 연구자 단말기와 네트워크를 통해 연결되는 에너지 시뮬레이션 구성요소 추천 시스템에 있어서, 시뮬레이션 유형 정보를 저장하고, 시뮬레이션 유형 정보를 연구자 단말기에 전송하며, 연구자 단말기에 전송된 시뮬레이션 유형 정보의 선택에 따른 선택 시뮬레이션 유형 정보를 연구자 단말기로부터 전송받는 유형 추천부; 분산자원 정보 및 그리드 모델 정보를 저장하고, 분산자원 정보 및 그리드 모델 정보를 연구자 단말기에 전송하며, 연구자 단말기에 전송된 분산자원 정보의 선택에 따른 선택 분산자원 정보 및 연구자 단말기에 전송된 그리드 모델 정보의 선택에 따른 선택 그리드 모델 정보를 연구자 단말기로부터 전송받는 자원 추천부; 데이터 세트 정보 및 기능 모듈 정보를 저장하고, 데이터 세트 정보 및 기능 모듈 정보를 연구자 단말기에 전송하며, 연구자 단말기에 전송된 데이터 세트 정보의 선택에 따른 선택 데이터 세트 정보 및 연구자 단말기에 전송된 기능 모듈 정보의 선택에 따른 선택 기능 모듈 정보를 연구자 단말기로부터 전송받는 데이터 기능 추천부; 선택 시뮬레이션 유형 정보, 선택 분산자원 정보, 선택 그리드 모델 정보, 선택 데이터 세트 정보 및 선택 기능 모듈 정보를 바탕으로 하여 가상 환경을 생성하는 가상 환경부; 및 연구자 단말기에 의한 사용 로그를 연구자 단말기로부터 전송받아 저장하고, 사용 로그에 따른 분석 정보를 생성하며, 분석 정보를 바탕으로 하여 시뮬레이션 유형 정보에 따른 추천 정보를 생성하는 사용 분석부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 할 수 있다.
assignees: I ON COMMUNICATIONS CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance system and method for digital twin transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital simulation, in particular to an intelligent operation and maintenance system and method of a digital twin transformer substation. According to the invention, the interconnection relation between the devices can be deeply analyzed by the graph neural network algorithm when the device model is constructed, and the method is superior to the conventional method which is only based on surface data. The fusion of deep learning and time sequence analysis enables the prediction of future maintenance requirements to be more accurate, and the impending faults and performance degradation can be effectively identified. Through a multi-target genetic algorithm and constraint programming, the equipment layout is optimized, and the maximization of space utilization and the improvement of safety are realized. When the particle swarm optimization and dynamic scheduling model executes the maintenance strategy, the optimal configuration of resources is realized, and the efficiency and the cost benefit of the maintenance activity are obviously improved.
assignees: XUANCHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent early warning method and system for wind power tower based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning method and system for a wind power tower based on digital twinning, comprising the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of the whole wind turbine and the tower, and performing model deployment and display in a Web end; building a cloud server, and distributing operation data acquired by a fan in a cloud server database; publishing a digital twin system service of the wind turbine generator at the Web end; establishing a tower barrel mechanism model, and establishing a model based on the mechanism model; extracting node information through post-processing, setting a data set, establishing a high-efficiency agent model based on an integrated regression decision tree algorithm BDTR, and predicting; and monitoring and early warning the tower state, and when the predicted data exceeds a threshold value, automatically sending an alarm to a field operator by the system. According to the invention, a complete machine digital twin model of the wind turbine is built, a mechanism model and a finite element model of the wind turbine are built aiming at tower parts, and a proxy model and a deep learning algorithm are built by combining actually collected fan data to monitor the state of the tower and give an abnormal alarm.
assignees: DALIAN BLUESNOW INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Stability analysis method of grid-structured wind power grid-connected system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stability analysis method of a grid-structured wind power grid-connected system, which belongs to the technical field of wind power grid-connected systems and aims to solve the problems that the stability analysis of the existing wind power grid-connected system is mostly low in efficiency and not representative, and the stability analysis method comprises the following steps: based on N groups of operation information obtained by respectively carrying out real-time state monitoring on N existing grid-formed wind power grid-connected systems, establishing a digital twin model of the grid-formed wind power grid-connected systems, wherein N is an integer greater than 1; splitting the digital twin model into a wind turbine sub-model, a generator sub-model, a machine side converter sub-model and a net side converter sub-model; simulating the wind turbine sub-model, the generator sub-model, the machine side converter sub-model and the network side converter sub-model respectively to obtain small signal models of all sub-models; and obtaining stability parameters of the grid-structured wind power grid-connected system based on the particle swarm algorithm and the small signal model of each sub-model.
assignees: UNIV XINJIANG;NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH;STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method of processing electricity consumption data and server implementing thereof
title_ko: 전력 사용량 데이터를 처리하는 방법 및 이를 구현하는 서버
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for processing power consumption data and a server implementing the same, wherein the server for processing power consumption data according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a database storing collected data regarding power consumption; a data restoration processor that generates restored data by adding rows to correspond to missing data based on the collected data and stores the restored data in the database; an outlier detection processor that detects outliers among data rows having actual measurement values from the restored data, renders the data determined to be outliers as missing or adds information to identify the data determined to be outliers, and stores the data in the database; and a missing data interpolation processor that loads the data stored by the outlier detection processor in the database, applies two or more missing data generation models to the data having actual measurement values regarding power consumption, selects one missing data generation model, and applies the selected missing data generation model to the missing data or data rows rendered as missing or determined to be outliers to perform interpolation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력 사용량 데이터를 처리하는 방법 및 이를 구현하는 서버에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 의한 전력 사용량 데이터를 처리하는 서버는 전력 사용량에 관한 수집 데이터를 저장하는 데이터베이스와 수집 데이터를 기준으로 누락된 데이터에 대응하도록 행을 추가한 복원 데이터를 생성하여 데이터베이스에 저장하는 데이터 복원 프로세서와 복원 데이터에서 실측값을 가지는 데이터 행 중에서 이상치를 탐지하여 이상치로 판단된 데이터를 결측화시키거나 또는 이상치로 판단된 데이터를 식별할 수 있도록 정보를 추가하여 데이터베이스에 저장하는 이상치 탐지 프로세서와 이상치 탐지 프로세서가 데이터베이스에 저장한 데이터들을 로딩하여 전력 사용량에 대한 실측값을 가지는 데이터에 둘 이상의 결측치 생성 모델을 적용한 후 하나의 결측치 생성 모델을 선택하며, 선택된 결측치 생성 모델을 누락된 데이터 또는 결측화되거나 이상치로 판단된 데이터 행들에 적용하여 보간하는 결측치 보간 프로세서를 포함한다.
assignees: EXEM CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network planning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a power distribution network planning method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a power distribution network reliability assessment model of the power distribution network based on the virtual fault flow of the circuit breaker, the automatic operation virtual fault flow and the manual operation virtual fault flow; constructing a distribution automation equipment planning model of the distribution network by using the distribution network reliability evaluation model to obtain an optimal configuration of the distribution automation equipment meeting preset reliability conditions; and compressing the candidate measurement set by using a preset information matrix to optimize the optimal measurement configuration by using an ant colony algorithm based on the state estimation precision, and determining an optimal measurement configuration scheme meeting a preset observability condition. Therefore, the technical problems that in the related technology, the measurement optimization configuration requirement of the three-phase unbalanced active power distribution network system cannot be met, the number of meters is optimized, and the system observability requirement cannot be met are solved.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Heating management scheduling method and system based on renewable energy intelligent coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating management scheduling method and system based on renewable energy intelligent coupling, comprising the following steps: acquiring thermodynamic dynamic characteristics of a heating pipe network in a target heating area, and constructing a digital twin model of a heating system according to the thermodynamic dynamic characteristics and renewable energy stations to extract temperature distribution; a heat load prediction model is established to obtain the heat load demand of a target heat supply area; the method comprises the steps of utilizing space-time characteristics of renewable energy sources to represent output uncertainty, analyzing evaluation indexes of running performance, and obtaining influence on the running performance through heat distribution proportion under different working conditions; and constructing targets based on two factors of heat supply economy and carbon emission, and constructing a multi-target optimized scheduling model based on constraint conditions to realize coupling heat supply scheduling. The high-efficiency renewable energy multi-source cooperative heat supply scheduling method is obtained, the running cost of a heat supply system is obviously reduced, the carbon emission is reduced, and the low carbon property and the economy of the system are further optimized.
assignees: BEIJING GUANTIAN EXECUTIVE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind turbine generator data processing method and device
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of obtaining original data of a wind turbine, and constructing evaluation indexes so as to determine self-adaptive weight coefficients; obtaining an original data matrix, a random noise matrix and a mask matrix based on the original data, and constructing a self-adaptive attention mechanism model with an attention module; constructing a lightweight generation countermeasure network interpolation initial model of the self-adaptive attention mechanism based on the self-adaptive attention mechanism model; training an initial model based on an original data matrix, a random noise matrix and a mask matrix until the lightweight initial model converges to obtain a lightweight generation countermeasure network final model based on a self-adaptive attention mechanism; the final model is used for interpolating the missing data of the wind power data, and on the basis of optimizing the GAIN network structure, the self-adaptive attention mechanism is introduced, so that the efficiency and accuracy of wind power data interpolation are effectively improved.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power grid digital twin three-dimensional scene display system and method
