abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for displaying a digital twin three-dimensional scene of a power grid, which relate to the field of three-dimensional scene display, wherein the system for displaying the digital twin three-dimensional scene of the power grid comprises the following components: the system comprises a user terminal and a server connected with the user terminal; an intra-server cloud rendering engine program; the user terminal is used for sending a rendering task request of a target scene in the power grid to the server; the server is used for analyzing the rendering task request according to the load balancing strategy, so that a plurality of rendering nodes cooperatively complete the rendering task request to obtain a three-dimensional scene image of the target scene; the user terminal is also used for displaying the three-dimensional scene image of the target scene. The invention can reduce the demand of computer hardware resources, improve the loading speed of the model and realize high-quality rendering and presentation effects.
assignees: BEIJING GUOWANG FUDA SCIENCE & TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine digital twin model building method based on Bayesian network algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for establishing a digital twin model of a coal mine based on a Bayesian network algorithm, which relates to the technical field of machine learning and comprises the following steps: s1, determining a target mine and acquiring real-time data; s2, constructing an initial digital twin model; s3, determining disaster types and corresponding disaster causing factors of the target mine, further constructing and training to obtain a disaster causing factor analysis model, and outputting to obtain a topological relation of the disaster causing factors by using the disaster causing factor analysis model; s4, constructing a Bayesian model, and performing iterative training on the Bayesian model by utilizing superposition weight analysis; s5, embedding the disaster-causing factor analysis model and the Bayesian model into the initial digital twin model in series by utilizing the antagonism framework to obtain a final digital twin model. The invention is integrated with a Bayesian network algorithm, can analyze and predict input data to obtain the occurrence probability of mine disasters, and can take countermeasures or rectifying measures in advance for different disasters, thereby effectively improving the safety coefficient of the coal mine.
assignees: ORDOS CITY TENGYUAN COAL CO LTD;NANJING BEIDOU INNOVATION APPLICATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin electricity prediction method and system based on influence dimension analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power management, and discloses a digital twin power consumption prediction method and system based on influence dimension analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and carrying out functional classification on the regional historical power data according to the functional partition set to obtain a plurality of groups of classified power data, obtaining an electricity utilization influence dimension sequence corresponding to the functional partition, sequentially extracting electricity utilization influence dimensions in the electricity utilization influence dimension sequence, carrying out hierarchical classification on the classified power data according to the electricity utilization influence dimensions to obtain electricity utilization multidimensional gradient data, summarizing to obtain electricity utilization multidimensional gradient data sets, extracting target elevator data corresponding to the twin partition assembly, extracting reference electricity utilization data according to the current influence dimension data, carrying out electricity utilization prediction on the twin partition assembly according to the reference electricity utilization data, summarizing to obtain a prediction electricity utilization data set, and carrying out electricity utilization prediction management according to the prediction electricity utilization data set. The invention mainly aims to solve the problems of low electricity consumption prediction precision and poor early warning timeliness of the current industrial park.
assignees: SHENZHEN QIDONG IOT CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method of double-attention CNN-BiLSTM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state estimation method of double attentiveness CNN-BiLSTM, which combines a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a two-way long-short-term memory neural network (BiLSTM) and an attentiveness mechanism to form a double attentiveness CNN-BiLSTM neural network, so that the performance of a model is improved, the state estimation is performed under the condition of simulating actual measurement, and an accurate result can be obtained quickly. The method comprises two stages, namely, an off-line stage, a model setting parameter is built, a data processing input history measurement data set is trained on the built model, and an obtained state estimation model is stored; in the online estimation stage, inputting real-time measurement data into a trained model to perform state estimation to obtain a state estimation result; finally, verifying the effectiveness of the proposed method through simulation; and finally, detailed and objective experimental analysis is carried out through a test simulation model, so that the effective feasibility of the method provided by the technical scheme is shown.
assignees: POWERCHINA FUJIAN ELEC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine energy system on-demand regulation and control method based on digital twin and dynamic prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine energy system on-demand regulation and control method based on digital twin and dynamic prediction, which comprises the following steps: establishing an intelligent coal mine digital twin model; forming a coal mine energy management system data sample; respectively establishing a dynamic prediction model of the air quantity and the water discharge required by the coal mine by combining the dynamic change trend of the environmental data at the future moment, the personnel distribution situation under the coal mine and the coal mine operation process; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a coal mine required air quantity dynamic prediction sequence and a coal mine drainage quantity dynamic prediction sequence, taking the coal mine required air quantity dynamic prediction sequence and a coal mine ventilation drainage system data sample as input samples, establishing a coal mine required ventilation drainage power consumption dynamic prediction model, and outputting a coal mine ventilation drainage power consumption dynamic sequence; when the coal mine normally operates, an operation variable optimization model of the coal mine regulation equipment is established, and an operation variable optimal regulation instruction of the coal mine regulation equipment is obtained through calculation; when unknown disasters occur in the coal mine, a coal mine disaster optimization and adjustment model is established, and an optimal adjustment scheme is obtained through calculation.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Business self-driving method and system for mediation and land coordination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a business self-driving method and a system for cooperation of a medium-speed and a ground-speed, which are used for realizing resource sharing of a medium-speed system and a ground-speed system by splicing a medium-speed model and a ground-speed model, and providing data support for safety check of a main network dispatching, regulating and controlling self-driving operation. The ground regulation module is divided into groups according to the electric distance, and a plurality of groups are polled by a cooperative control module at the middle regulation side in a preset data period, so that the real-time updating of the ground regulation model and the splicing model is realized, on one hand, the timeliness of the data updating of the whole network model is realized, and on the other hand, the polling is only carried out in the current data period, and the model updating is only carried out in the polling period, so that the uploading of a large amount of data caused by the model data updating is reduced, and the occupation of data channel resources is reduced.

title_en: Big Data-Based Port Infrastructure Control System Data Linkage System For Port Infrastructure Disaster And Aging Digital Twin Construction
title_ko: 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후도 디지털 트윈 구축을 위한 빅데이터 기반 항만 인프라 관제 시스템 데이터 연계 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a big data-based port infrastructure control system data linkage system for port infrastructure disaster and aging digital twin construction, which can intuitively monitor the current state of the port infrastructure and the situation required for maintenance through virtual reality, and can monitor the port infrastructure through big data-based aging and disaster risk evaluation, analysis, and visualization by predicting the occurrence situation due to disaster occurrence and aging through digital twin-based simulation and establishing an immediate policy decision-making system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 항만인프라의 현재 상태 및 유지관리 필요 상황을 가상현실을 통해 직관적으로 모니터링 가능한 관제 시스템과, 디지털 트윈 기반 시뮬레이션으로 재해 발생 및 노후화에 의한 발생 상황을 예측하고 즉각적인 정책적 의사결정 시스템 구축하여, 빅데이터 기반 노후도 및 재해위험도 평가와 분석, 가시화를 통한 항만 인프라 모니터링할 수 있는, 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후도 디지털 트윈 구축을 위한 빅데이터 기반 항만 인프라 관제 시스템 데이터 연계 시스템을 제안한다.
assignees: KOREA LOGISTICS NETWORK CORP

title_en: Apparatus and Method for Constructing and Operating Digital Twin of Renewable Energy Resource System
title_ko: 재생에너지 자원 시스템의 디지털트윈을 구축 및 운영하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure is a device for constructing and operating a digital twin of a renewable energy resource system, which comprises: a sensor network unit that collects data from renewable energy resources; a database unit that stores data generated by processing the collected data; a digital twin modeling unit that creates a data-driven model and generates a digital twin of the renewable energy resource using the created data-driven model; a digital twin editing unit that edits the digital twin; a spatiotemporal visualization unit that visualizes four-dimensional spacetime based on at least one of the data of the database unit and the edited digital twin; and a digital twin operation unit that reproduces a simulation in the four-dimensional spacetime using the digital twin.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 실시 예에 따른 장치는, 재생에너지 자원 시스템의 디지털트윈을 구축 및 운영하는 장치에 있어서, 재생에너지 자원으로부터 데이터를 수집하는 센서 네트워크부; 수집된 데이터를 가공하여 생성한 데이터를 저장하는 데이터베이스부; Data-Driven 방식의 모델 생성하고, 생성된 Data-Driven 방식의 모델을 이용하여 재생에너지 자원 디지털트윈을 생성하는 디지털트윈 모델링부; 상기 디지털트윈을 편집하는 디지털트윈 편집부; 상기 데이터베이스부의 데이터 및 편집된 디지털트윈 중 적어도 하나를 기반으로 하여 4차원 시공간을 가시화하는 시공간 가시화부; 및 상기 디지털트윈을 이용하여 상기 4차원 시공간에서 시뮬레이션 재현을 실행하는 디지털트윈 운영부를 포함한다.
assignees: KERI KOREA ELECTROTECHNOLOGY RES INST

title_en: Apparatus and Method for Constructing Digital Twin of Renewable Energy Resource System Based on Data-driven Modeling
title_ko: Data-Driven 모델링 기반의 재생에너지 자원 시스템의 디지털트윈 구축 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, an apparatus for constructing a digital twin of a renewable energy resource system based on data-driven modeling comprises: a sensor network unit for collecting data from individual renewable energy resources; a database unit for storing data generated by processing the collected data; an individual model generation unit for generating a model of a data-driven method through machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques using the data of the database; an individual digital twin generation unit for generating an individual renewable energy resource digital twin by applying the individual data-driven model; an integrated model generation unit for generating an integrated model of a data-driven method through machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques using real-time, past, and future simulation data linked from the individual renewable energy resource digital twin; and an integrated digital twin generation unit for generating an integrated renewable energy resource digital twin by applying the integrated model of the data-driven method.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 실시 예에 따른 장치는, Data-Driven 모델링 기반의 재생에너지 자원 시스템의 디지털트윈 구축 장치에 있어서, 개별 재생에너지 자원으로부터 데이터를 수집하는 센서 네트워크부; 수집된 데이터를 가공하여 생성한 데이터를 저장하는 데이터베이스부; 상기 데이터베이스의 데이터를 이용하여 기계학습 및 인공지능 기법을 통해 Data-Driven 방식의 모델을 생성하는 개별 모델 생성부; 상기 개별 Data-Driven 모델을 적용하여 개별 재생에너지 자원 디지털트윈을 생성하는 개별 디지털트윈 생성부; 상기 개별 재생에너지 자원 디지털트윈으로부터 연동된 실시간, 과거 및 미래 시뮬레이션 데이터를 이용하여 기계학습 및 인공지능 기법을 통해 Data-Driven 방식의 통합 모델을 생성하는 통합 모델 생성부; 및 상기 Data-Driven 방식의 통합 모델을 적용하여 통합 재생에너지 자원 디지털트윈을 생성하는 통합 디지털트윈 생성부를 포함한다.
assignees: KERI KOREA ELECTROTECHNOLOGY RES INST

title_en: Photovoltaic power ultra-short-term multi-step prediction method, device and medium based on time series neural hierarchical interpolation model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photovoltaics, and discloses a photovoltaic power ultra-short-term multi-step prediction method based on a time sequence neural hierarchical interpolation model, which comprises the following steps: analyzing exogenous variables related to power output of the photovoltaic power station by calculating correlation coefficients, and only incorporating highly-related variables into a prediction model; reconstructing missing data of the photovoltaic power station by adopting a data processing strategy based on a K nearest neighbor algorithm and linear interpolation; constructing a time sequence neural hierarchical interpolation model based on a multi-scale signal sampling and hierarchical interpolation method, and determining the overall structure and evaluation index of the model; and predicting the photovoltaic power by adopting a time sequence neural hierarchical interpolation model to obtain a photovoltaic power ultra-short-term multi-step prediction result. The invention also discloses a device and a medium, which overcome the problems of insufficient attention of the photovoltaic power ultra-short-term multi-step prediction model to exogenous variable analysis and data preprocessing, high calculation complexity in processing long-time sequence prediction and weak model adaptability.
assignees: JINGMEN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HAINAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV;HUBEI JINGNENG POWER TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD;JINGMEN SHENGHE ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Pipe network data model driving system and method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipe network data model driving system and method based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the body information of the pipe network building according to the digital twin platform and the digital twin engine for simulation; the obtained analog information production data model is subjected to data reduction and transmitted to a digital twin platform control master station; detecting the pipeline network building body based on the control main station and comparing the pipeline network building body with original historical information; and displaying the simulated pipe network building body information on a screen according to the comparison result. The analysis and research function of the processing module is used for analyzing and research the pipe network building model data, judging whether the modified pipe network building model data are harmful or not according to analysis and research results, the processing module can transmit the existing acquired pipe network building model to a screen installed on the digital twin platform, and when the damage is judged, the digital twin engine and the control main station can amplify the modified data, so that the observation of workers is facilitated.
assignees: GUIZHOU GEOLOGICAL MINERAL SURVEYING AND MAPPING INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent operation and inspection platform of wind-solar coupled data center and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and detection platform of a wind-light coupling data center and a construction method thereof, belonging to the technical field of wind-light coupling, wherein the intelligent operation and detection platform comprises a field device sensing layer, a network layer, a data platform layer and a data application layer; the field device sensing layer is accessed to a database server of the data platform layer through the network layer; the data application layer establishes business scene application on the basis of a data platform; the functions of the data application layer comprise a basic service function and a high-level application function; the basic service functions comprise a data management application, a digital twin application, a data center model application, a unified report application, a visual display application and a mobile application; advanced applications include panoramic monitoring, intelligent engineering management, equipment asset management, personnel team management, intelligent patrol management, intelligent operation and maintenance management, intelligent operation management, intelligent emergency management, intelligent business management, intelligent material management, and intelligent administration. The invention can break the data barriers among all monitoring systems of the wind-light coupling data center.
assignees: POWERCHINA HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Optimization method for state estimation of energy management and control system
abstract_en: The application discloses an optimization method for state estimation of an energy management and control system, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring a circuit model of a traction network of a subway direct current traction power supply system, and numbering a traction substation and a train; s2, collecting real-time operation data of a subway traction power supply system, and considering errors in the measuring process; s3, calculating to obtain a node admittance matrix according to the real-time position information of the subway train ; S4, establishing a state estimation mathematical model according to a circuit model of the traction network, and writing a measurement equation to represent the relation between the measurement of the quantity and the error of each traction substation and each train node; s5, obtaining a mathematical model of the least square method according to the measurement equation Make the following Taking the minimum to obtain a nonlinear equation set ; S6, solving a nonlinear equation set by utilizing Newton-Laportson method Obtaining a linear correction equation; s7, carrying out iterative correction by using weighted least square method Until near global optimum.
assignees: TIANJIN HUAKAI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Perishable product supply chain real-time monitoring and management system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring and managing a perishable product supply chain in real time based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps of S1, deploying an Internet of things sensor at a key node of the perishable product supply chain; s2, transmitting the key data to a central processing unit in real time through network transmission; s3, carrying out real-time analysis and simulation on the created digital twin model; s4, analyzing the collected data by using an artificial intelligence algorithm, and optimizing a supply chain management strategy; s5, the system automatically adjusts a supply chain plan according to an analysis result to achieve loss minimization and efficiency maximization, and automatically takes preset response measures when problems in a supply chain are identified; s6, providing a user interface so that supply chain management personnel and consumers can access the state information of the perishable products in real time. The invention has the advantages of improving the efficiency of the supply chain, increasing the transparency, improving the trust of consumers and optimizing the quality and the safety of products.

title_en: Digital twinning-based numerical simulation system for wastewater treatment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based numerical simulation system of a wastewater treatment system, which comprises a data acquisition layer, a data processing layer and a data processing layer, wherein the data acquisition layer is used for acquiring modeling data for constructing a three-dimensional model of a wastewater treatment process and operating parameters in the wastewater treatment process; the network transmission layer is used for serving as data to the intelligent analysis layer and connecting to other digital twins, so that the data is transmitted and sent to the cloud repository; the intelligent analysis layer is used for providing an emergency optimization scheme and an overall plan for the physical entity through processing analysis, establishment of a prediction model and statistical analysis loading strategy on the collected data so as to form a full life cycle closed-loop control process of sensing, judging, deciding and executing; and the data visualization layer is used for more intuitively displaying the running state of each device and the change of the data in the sewage treatment process through a three-dimensional visualization technology. According to the invention, the automatic and intelligent real-time monitoring of the target data to be detected is realized by combining the mechanism model with the data model.
assignees: HEBEI XUYANG ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Heat supply system heat user regulation and control method based on graphic neural network and knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating system heat user regulation and control method based on a graph neural network and a knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps: establishing a heat portrait for each heat user; collecting heat utilization data of each heat user, and analyzing heat users with data loss and missing data attributes; calculating the similarity between the thermal image for the data missing thermal user and the thermal images for other thermal users, selecting the thermal data time sequence of a preset number of similar thermal users, and complementing the missing data by combining the association degree between the missing data type and the other data types; clustering and classifying and identifying the thermal data samples for each thermal user by using the thermal data for the thermal user after data completion, a clustering algorithm and a classifying and identifying model to obtain a plurality of thermal categories for the thermal user, modeling the related knowledge regulated and controlled by the thermal user, and constructing a knowledge graph of the regulating and controlling behavior of each thermal user; and inputting the knowledge graph of the regulation and control behaviors of each heat user into the built graph neural network model, and predicting the regulation and control strategy of the heat user in each period.
assignees: CHANGZHOU YINGJI POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel structure deformation three-dimensional visual monitoring method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a three-dimensional visual monitoring method for tunnel structure deformation based on a digital twin technology. The method comprises the following steps: building a building information model of a target tunnel structure, and associating actual arrangement information of monitoring equipment in the target tunnel structure to the building information model; and acquiring monitoring data of the monitoring equipment in real time, and dynamically adjusting the building information model according to the monitoring data. By establishing a building information model and linking with actual monitoring data in real time, three-dimensional digital twin of tunnel structure deformation is realized, the characteristics of visualization, parameterization, diagonability, coordination and the like of the building information model are combined, multi-source fusion of monitoring, operation and decision data can be realized, and the structure evolution under the disaster condition of a tunnel and high-efficiency and accurate simulation in the aspects of emergency rescue and the like can be carried out by combining specific disaster disturbance information, so that the problems faced in the traditional tunnel safety operation and maintenance are solved.
assignees: UNIV SHENZHEN

title_en: Method and device for constructing digital twin system of comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for constructing a digital twin system of a comprehensive energy system, and belongs to the technical field of energy systems. The method comprises the following steps: determining a physical system based on the pipe parameters, the heat source parameters, and the heat load parameters; the physical system comprises electric heating coupling equipment, a heat load and a flow regulating device which are connected through pipelines, a plurality of valves arranged on the pipelines, temperature sensors are arranged on the electric heating coupling equipment and the heat load, flow sensors are arranged on the pipelines, and state sensors are arranged on the valves; collecting flow and temperature of each node in a physical system and valve states of each valve through each sensor; constructing a digital twin system of the comprehensive energy system based on each flow, each temperature and each valve state; the digital twin system comprises an electrothermal coupling model, a heat supply network dynamic characteristic model, a heat load model and an electric power steady-state model. The invention can obtain more accurate virtual operation data and provide reasonable guidance for system operation.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Transaction optimization method, device, equipment, storage medium and product of virtual power plant
abstract_en: The application discloses a transaction optimization method, device, equipment, storage medium and product of a virtual power plant, wherein the transaction optimization method of the virtual power plant comprises the following steps: collecting real-time data of a distributed virtual power plant; and carrying out electric price prediction through a preset digital twin model based on the real-time data to obtain electric price trend information, and carrying out optimal transaction solving on the electric price trend information to obtain a target transaction strategy, wherein the digital twin model is obtained by carrying out iterative training on a preset model to be trained based on historical electric energy information of a distributed virtual power plant. According to the application, through the digital twin model which is finished through pre-training, the electricity price prediction is carried out on the real-time data of the distributed virtual power plant, the optimal transaction solution is carried out after the electricity price trend information of a period of time in the future is obtained, and the target transaction strategy is obtained, so that the accuracy of predicting market change and price fluctuation is improved, and the maximum economic benefit of energy transaction is realized.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS;SHENDIANNENG TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Urban heat supply full life cycle safe operation management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city heat supply full life cycle safe operation management method, which comprises the following steps: (1) Acquiring real-time data of an urban heating system through an IOT (Internet of things) network of an urban infrastructure; (2) Sequentially establishing a three-dimensional space model, a three-dimensional structure model and a functional model of the urban heating system by combining a GIS (geographic information system) and a BIM (building information modeling) with an intelligent building model; (3) The acquired data are correlated with a space model, a structure model and a functional model of the urban heating system by using an Apriori algorithm, and a digital twin model of the whole urban heating process is established; (4) Performing modeling optimization of mechanism and data dual driving on the whole process digital twin model by adopting cloud computing and edge computing; (5) Fusing the whole process digital twin model with other related city information models to form a unified city information model system; (6) Based on unified city information model system, each safe running state of the city heat supply system is monitored, analyzed and diagnosed in real time.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Integrated energy manageement device applying digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 적용한 에너지 통합 관리 장치
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is an integrated energy management device applied with a digital twin, which comprises: a measurement unit included in at least one facility driven by power to measure energy information on the facility; a digital twin for virtually implementing the facility in a virtual space implementing the same environment as the at least one facility driven by power in a digital environment to perform simulation based on the energy information measured by the measurement unit; and a derivation unit for analyzing data derived by performing the simulation to derive a standardized energy consumption pattern.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면, 전력에 의해 구동되는 적어도 하나 이상의 설비에 포함되어 상기 설비의 에너지 정보를 계측하는 계측부,력에 의해 구동되는 적어도 하나 이상의 설비와 동일한 환경을 디지털 환경에 구현한 가상공간에 상기 설비를 가상으로 구현하여 상기 계측부에서 계측된 상기 에너지 정보를 기반으로 시뮬레이션 하는 디지털 트윈 및 상기 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 도출된 데이터를 분석하여 정형화 에너지 소모 패턴을 도출하는 도출부를 포함하는 디지털 트윈을 적용한 에너지 통합 관리 장치를 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: GWEAN GI REANG

title_en: State estimation system, breaker, distribution board, state estimation method, and program
abstract_en: To enable coping depending on estimation of a state of an electric path or an estimated state at the time of occurence of power outage.SOLUTION: A state estimation system 1 comprises an acquisition unit, a specification unit, and an estimation unit. The acquisition unit executes acquisition processing for acquiring disaster related information from an external server 60. The disaster related information is information related to occurrence of a natural disaster. The specification unit executes cause specification processing at the time of occurrence of power outage. The cause specification processing is processing that on the basis of a measurement result from a measurement unit 15, specifies a cause of the outage and acquires cause information. The measurement unit 15 is used with breakers (10, 50) lying among electric paths (203a to 203c) between a power system 201 and a user's home load 202. The estimation unit estimates states of the electric paths (203a to 203c) on the basis of the disaster related information and the cause information and executes state estimation processing of acquiring state information on an estimation result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: PANASONIC HOLDINGS CORP

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent management system and method for pipeline maintenance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline maintenance management, in particular to a pipeline maintenance intelligent management system and method based on digital twinning, wherein the system comprises a leakage evaluation analysis module, and the leakage evaluation analysis module performs image recognition on each endoscopic detection characteristic information in a digital twinning model of a pipeline in a to-be-detected area through an image recognition technology to obtain a corresponding pipe network leakage evaluation report; and building a characteristic change trend analysis model of the pipeline in the region to be tested by combining the pipe network leakage evaluation report corresponding to each pipeline leakage point in the historical data. The invention can accurately screen the optimal inspection scheme by analyzing the leakage inspection intervention characteristic value corresponding to each pipeline leakage inspection line scheme, reduce the inspection area of the pipeline leakage inspection instrument, improve the inspection and maintenance efficiency of the pipeline under the condition of ensuring the inspection precision, and timely and effectively find the leakage area of the pipeline.
assignees: NANJING SUJING PIPELINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: CNN-BiGRU parallel feature fusion-based low-voltage user electricity stealing identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage user electricity stealing identification method and system based on CNN-BiGRU parallel feature fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining the station account of the station area and the recent daily line loss rate data; screening a radio station stealing area; acquiring low-voltage user accounts, recent daily electricity consumption, voltage, current and power data and normal/electricity stealing user labels; complementing the missing data in the low-voltage user data; extracting features from source data to form a sample set, and dividing the sample set; constructing a CNN-BiGRU-based parallel neural network model, inputting a training set into the CNN-BiGRU-based parallel neural network model for training until convergence to obtain an initial user electricity stealing identification model; inputting the verification set into an initial user electricity stealing identification model to obtain a user electricity stealing identification model; verifying a user electricity stealing identification model on the test set; the actual electricity stealing user is identified. The invention can be used for rapidly positioning the electricity stealing behavior of the low-voltage user and assisting the ground and city professional personnel to discover the electricity stealing problem in time.
assignees: JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Power grid rush repair risk assessment method and decision system based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid first-aid repair risk assessment method and a decision system based on data driving, and relates to the technical field of power grid operation and maintenance, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a power grid first-aid repair database through data driving acquisition, and analyzing and training the power grid first-aid repair database based on a power grid first-aid repair risk assessment index system to generate a power grid first-aid repair risk assessment network; the method comprises the steps of modeling a target rush-repair power grid region by utilizing a digital twin technology, constructing a power grid rush-repair region digital twin model, extracting risk elements from the power grid rush-repair region digital twin model based on the power grid rush-repair risk assessment index system to obtain power grid rush-repair risk element information, and carrying out risk assessment and risk rush-repair decision on the power grid rush-repair risk element information based on the power grid rush-repair risk assessment network. The technical effects of intelligently evaluating the power grid emergency repair risk by the multidimensional index, improving the comprehensiveness and accuracy of risk evaluation and further ensuring the emergency repair decision efficiency are achieved.

title_en: Data enhancement state estimation method and system for low-observability power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and control of power systems, and provides a data enhancement state estimation method and system of a low observable power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a low-rank measurement matrix of the power distribution network, wherein the low-rank measurement matrix comprises measurement variables of a plurality of nodes; based on the low-rank measurement matrix, obtaining a measurement matrix after data enhancement by solving a power flow embedded projection cone data enhancement optimization model; based on the measurement matrix after data enhancement, obtaining a state estimation value; the power flow embedded projection cone data enhancement optimization model adopts linear tide constraint. The accuracy of the state estimator is improved.

title_en: Power system state estimation method and system under denial of service attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state estimation method, a system, equipment and a storage medium under denial of service attack, wherein a power system model is reconstructed by utilizing a DoS attack compensation strategy, and a Kerck kernel minimum error entropy volume Kalman filtering algorithm is provided for dynamic state estimation of a power system. The proposed algorithm is based on an augmentation model constructed by a statistical linearization method, and utilizes minimum error entropy as an optimal criterion to combine the state error and the measurement error into the MEE cost function at the same time. Meanwhile, the Cauchy kernel insensitive to the kernel width is used for replacing the Gaussian kernel function in the MEE, so that the selection difficulty of the kernel width is greatly simplified, and the singularity of Cholesky decomposition is effectively avoided. The estimate is then recursively updated using a stationary point iterative algorithm. When the measured abnormal value exists in the measured data, the estimated accuracy of the power system is remarkably improved by using the Kexie kernel minimum error entropy volume Kalman filtering algorithm.
assignees: CHANGAN UNIV

title_en: Prediction method and system for ocean near-inertial flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method and a prediction system for ocean near-inertia flow, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source observation data, carrying out data preprocessing to obtain target data, constructing a first wind field predicted by a meteorological mode and a second wind field fused with a constructed tropical cyclone period, constructing a three-dimensional FVCOM model, generating a flow field simulation result, carrying out data assimilation processing on the flow field simulation result generated by the three-dimensional FVCOM model and the target data to obtain assimilated ocean current data, extracting the near-inertia flow according to the unassisted ocean current data and the assimilated ocean current data, extracting signal characteristics, extracting to obtain near-inertia wind stress, obtaining a pre-trained sequence diagram neural network TGCN model, analyzing the relevance between the near-inertia wind stress and the near-inertia flow, constructing a prediction system for constructing the near-inertia flow, and completing prediction of the ocean near-inertia flow. The invention improves the prediction efficiency and accuracy, and can be widely applied to the technical field of computers.

title_en: Electric power system complex domain full-distributed state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating the full distributed state of a complex domain of a power system, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a topological structure, line parameters, transformer parameters and measurement data of a power system; constructing a mixed measurement complex domain factor graph according to the acquired topological structure of the power system, the line parameters and the transformer parameters; constructing a robust data factor node according to the constructed mixed measurement complex domain factor graph to form a mixed measurement complex domain robust factor graph; and establishing a distributed convergence strategy to perform full-distributed state estimation calculation according to the constructed mixed measurement complex domain robust factor graph, and obtaining a state estimation result. The invention improves the estimation precision and the calculation efficiency of the state estimation of the power system, improves the robustness of the state estimation, and the proposed algorithm can be operated in a fully distributed mode, so that the state estimation implementation has higher flexibility and feasibility.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Digital twinning-based disaster analysis method and system for multi-scale water supply system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a digital twinning-based disaster analysis method and system for a multi-scale water supply system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on the multi-scale relation and layout of the water supply system plant stations and the pipe network in the physical space, sequentially establishing BIM information models of all levels of structures of the water supply system; the BIM information model is imported into FEM software, a mechanical response numerical analysis model is built according to the boundary and constraint conditions of each level of structures, and stress and deformation responses of each level of structures of a plant station and a pipe network of the water supply system under the action of earthquake are calculated; and extracting a calculation result of the numerical analysis model, decoding and converting the calculation result, and importing the calculation result after decoding and converting into the BIM information model for reconstruction to generate a cloud image of the earthquake motion response of the BIM information model. The invention realizes the digital conversion from the BIM model to the disaster scene analysis twin model in the operation and maintenance process, and provides a high-efficiency mapping and global visual display method for the earthquake response of a water supply system.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Start-stop machine group optimization method for responding to frequency modulation market demand in real time
abstract_en: The application provides a start-stop machine group optimization method for responding to frequency modulation market demands in real time, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting market demand, load electric quantity data and electricity price data in real time through mobile application, sensors and intelligent electric meters, establishing a demand prediction model and predicting future trends; training a plurality of optimization models, predicting electricity cost and income indexes according to different electricity utilization situations, and performing multi-objective optimization; acquiring unit health state monitoring data, and evaluating an optimal start-stop scheme under the constraints of power grid response, market participation and reliability guarantee; taking a start-stop unit and a friendly power grid as physical execution units, and building a closed-loop test platform based on multi-source system simulation in a digital twin environment; the rapid starting system is designed, and rapid response is allowed while safe operation of the power grid is ensured by limiting the maximum start-stop rate and the power slope index.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Wind farm dispatching optimization method based on cloud edge cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind farm dispatching optimization method based on cloud edge cooperation, which mainly relates to the technical field of wind power, and comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a full-field wake model; s2, updating a control system model; s3, carrying out algorithm optimization solution; according to the invention, the output power maximization and fatigue damage equalization of a wind power plant are used as optimization targets, a full-field wake model and a fatigue damage evaluation model which consider yaw working conditions are established, then a real-time updated unit control system model is established by utilizing an MRAN-RBF neural network, a wake model updating mechanism is designed, the execution capacity of the unit is evaluated, the evaluation result is used for a wind power plant dispatching optimization process, a field-level dispatching optimization problem is provided, and an artificial electric field algorithm is utilized to solve the optimal yaw angle and thrust coefficient.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;Jia Kangqiang

title_en: PMU (Power management Unit) point distribution method and system considering fault reconstruction and state estimation precision
abstract_en: A PMU (Power management Unit) dotting method and system considering fault reconstruction and state estimation precision utilizes pseudo quantity measurement, SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) quantity measurement and PMU and DULR (coordinated measurement and calculation) to calculate state estimation voltage and state estimation error covariance matrix; based on E-optimal design standard, taking the magnitude relation between the characteristic value of the state estimation error covariance matrix and the specified value as the state estimation precision index of the power distribution network; taking the minimum installation cost as an objective function of a PMU (Power management Unit) distribution model, taking the power flow operation constraint and the topology constraint of the power distribution network as basic constraint of the distribution model, and taking the fault propagation constraint and the load loss constraint of the power distribution network as relay protection characteristic constraint of the distribution model; and under the condition that the state estimation precision index of the power distribution network is met, carrying out joint solution on an objective function, basic constraint and relay protection characteristic constraint, and determining PMU joint optimization distribution points by taking the state estimation precision in a normal state and the load loss rates in a plurality of fault scenes as constraint conditions.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Urban area reservoir dam break flood evolution simulation method and system based on digital twin bottom plates
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood simulation, and discloses a digital twin-bottom-plate-based urban area reservoir dam break flood simulation method and a digital twin-bottom-plate-based urban area reservoir dam break flood simulation system, wherein the flood simulation method is measured and calculated through an evolution simulation system, the evolution simulation system comprises a multidimensional acquisition module, an evolution simulation module and an emergency early warning module, and the evolution simulation method comprises the following steps: step one, collecting hydrological weather, landform type and river basin data aiming at reservoirs in urban areas, and classifying and collecting a data set by a multidimensional collecting module; step two, the evolution simulation module builds a three-dimensional space terrain model ; Step three, setting dam breach data set by evolution simulation module And comprehensively calculate and generate a two-dimensional flood evolution model ; Step four, the evolution simulation module calculates the instantaneous flow For two-dimensional flood evolution model Verifying rationality; step five, the emergency early warning module judges a two-dimensional flood evolution model And the simulation degree is connected with an evolution simulation module or further analyzed according to the evaluation result.
assignees: NANJING HEHAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic data repair method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic data restoration method, a device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which take periodicity and seasonality of photovoltaic output data into consideration, adopt a K-means++ clustering algorithm to cluster photovoltaic data according to weather types, then independently train each clustered cluster, namely a data set of each class, to generate an anti-filling network to fill the class of missing data, and pre-fill an original photovoltaic historical output sequence containing the missing data by using the generated anti-filling network before clustering the photovoltaic data to obtain a complete pre-filling sequence, and then cluster the complete sequence after pre-filling by using the K-means++ algorithm, thereby improving the restoration accuracy and robustness of the missing data and solving the technical problems that the existing data restoration method does not take the seasonality and the periodicity of the photovoltaic data into consideration, and the restoration accuracy and robustness of the missing data are lower.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Main and auxiliary integrated power grid state estimation method considering measurement supplement correction
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a state estimation method of a main and auxiliary integrated power grid considering measurement, supplement and correction. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a topological structure of a main-distribution integrated power grid and power grid measurement data, and carrying out hierarchical topological analysis on the topological structure to obtain structural information; determining at least one pair of node pairs from the topology according to the structure information and the distribution network measurement data; for each of at least one pair of nodes, processing data of the processing nodes determined from the topological structure based on the switch measurement data and the load measurement data, and complementarily correcting distribution network measurement data according to the processing result; and updating the power grid measurement data based on the distribution network measurement data, and determining a state estimation result of the main distribution integrated power grid based on the structure information and the power grid measurement data. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the effective estimation of the power grid state of the main-distribution integrated power grid can be realized.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional health quantitative evaluation method and system for wind turbine generator based on degradation analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional health quantitative evaluation method and a system for a wind turbine generator based on degradation analysis, wherein a multi-element state estimation technology is utilized to construct an equipment degradation analysis model, monitoring data, historical data and real-time data in the running process of the wind turbine generator are collected to complete training of the model and output of a calculation result, degradation analysis of the running state of the equipment is carried out according to the calculation result, and a quantitative data reference is provided for equipment maintenance by constructing an equipment health quantitative evaluation system from degradation analysis, running indexes and equipment performance in a multi-dimension mode. The method and the system have the core functions that before the monitoring parameter reaches a threshold value for alarming, the degradation trend of the parameter can be identified in advance, and further the health level of the wind turbine generator set is quantitatively evaluated; the wind turbine generator system can be ensured to continuously run in a better health state, and powerful support is provided for efficient utilization of wind energy resources.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ZHANGJIAKOU SCENERY STORAGE AND TRANS NEW ENERGY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Electric power business control method based on intelligent brain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power service control and discloses a power service control method based on a digital intelligence brain, which comprises a service data control module and is used for service data control. According to the electric power business management and control method based on the intelligent brain, through setting the electric power business management and control method, manual guiding operation is not needed in the process of managing and controlling the electric power business, the electric power business management and control method is more convenient and rapid in the process of operation, a user can operate by himself, meanwhile, the phenomenon of data collection errors is not easy to occur in the process of operation, therefore, business handling efficiency can be improved, in the process of business handling, if business data are wrong, the phenomenon of data collection errors can be timely found, the phenomenon that a great amount of business process time is wasted due to resubmitting until the last of approval is avoided, meanwhile, in the process of business data handling, missing data and anomalies in the business data can be timely detected, the error rate of the business data is reduced, and the smoothness and the efficiency of the business process are guaranteed.
assignees: HANGZHOU ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD;HANGZHOU CITY YUHANG DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ZHEJIANG TRULY ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of photovoltaic power prediction digital twin system based on ABC optimized BSTS model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a photovoltaic power prediction digital twin system based on an ABC optimized BSTS model, which comprises the following steps: collecting and preprocessing historical data of photovoltaic power generation; establishing a Bayesian structure time sequence BSTS model, defining an observation node as the photovoltaic power generation capacity, determining probability distribution and parameters in a Bayesian network, and defining an observation equation and a state transition equation; using an initial parameter of an artificial bee colony algorithm ABC optimization model, carrying out global and local parameter search by using hiring bees, following bees and scout bees of the ABC algorithm, and updating prior distribution parameters of the model according to the result; performing Bayesian inference by using the BSTS model after initial parameter optimization, predicting and verifying photovoltaic power generation capacity, and correcting model parameters; and integrating the optimized BSTS model into a digital twin framework. The invention has higher flexibility, robustness and stability, integrates digital twin dynamic simulation and real-time feedback, and can more accurately predict photovoltaic power generation.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network operation and maintenance optimization method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network operation and maintenance optimization method and system based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of power distribution systems, and the method comprises the following steps: and determining a hierarchical power distribution network system, carrying out multistage digital twin construction and upper computer construction, and determining a power distribution network twin body. Based on the power distribution network twins, the monitoring training twins operation and maintenance module. And receiving multi-source power grid data of the physical entity end, and combining a preprocessing unit to perform multi-source heterogeneous fusion and redundancy elimination processing to determine an effective data stream. And carrying out mirror image twinning and verification decision optimization on the basis of the effective data flow in the twinning operation and maintenance module, and carrying out self-adaptive operation and maintenance management on the target power distribution network. And receiving a subjective operation and maintenance task, performing digital operation and verification decision optimization based on the twin operation and maintenance module, and performing task management on the target power distribution network. The method solves the technical problems of low operation and maintenance efficiency and poor operation and maintenance accuracy of the operation and maintenance management method of the power distribution network in the prior art.

title_en: Power system state estimation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state estimation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which are used for acquiring real-time power system transient twin data and carrying out normalization processing to obtain the power system transient twin data of a current section; and inputting the transient twin data of the power system of the current section into a pre-trained transient state estimation model to obtain the state estimation of the node voltage amplitude and the node phase angle of the power system. The data driving transient state estimator with better performance can be obtained by using a small amount of transient sample data, so that the universality of the transient state estimator is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for estimating the safety status of hazadous gas disaster prevention workers
title_ko: 유해가스 방재 작업자의 안전상태 추정 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided is the safety condition estimator of the toxic gas disaster prevention operator. The apparatus comprises: a sensor unit attached to chemical protective clothing for preventing harmful gas of a worker; a smart device provided by the worker collecting sensing data of the sensor unit; and a safety state analysis server receiving the sensing data from the smart device to generate real-time safety state estimation and monitoring results due to the harmful gas of the worker.
abstract_ko: 유해가스 방재 작업자의 안전상태 추정 장치가 제공된다. 상기 장치는 작업자의 유해가스 방지를 위한 화학보호복에 부착되는 센서부와, 상기 센서부의 센싱 데이터를 수집하는 작업자가 구비한 스마트 디바이스 및 상기 스마트 디바이스로부터 상기 센싱 데이터를 수신하여 상기 작업자의 유해가스로 인한 실시간 안전상태 추정 및 모니터링 결과를 생성하는 안전상태 분석 서버를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Big data-based digital twin control system for port infrastructure maintenance
title_ko: 항만 인프라 유지관리를 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a big data-based digital twin control system for port infrastructure maintenance, which comprises: a port data collection unit (100) for integrally managing information on a building, a road, and a bridge constituting a port; a digital twin platform (200) for implementing a digital twin and outputting the same as virtual modeling data of the digital twin; an object modeling unit (210) for performing 3D or 2D virtual modeling work; a simulator unit (220) for predicting a damage occurrence situation due to disaster occurrence and aging of the port building/facility/road/bridge; a state detection unit (230) for monitoring the state of a sensor and whether the sensor is malfunctioning in real time; a structure analysis server (300) for calculating each remaining lifetime through information data transmitted from the port data collection unit (100) and structure analysis data on the port/road/bridge; a digital twin DB (400) for storing data on other ports which are already implemented; and a display unit (500) for displaying the virtual modeling data on a monitor. According to the present invention, the aging degree of the port infrastructure can be visually and immediately checked through the display unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물의 층/구분공간(zone)/설비별로 에너지 소비량을 디지털 트윈의 가상 모델링 데이터로 출력하는 복합용도 대규모 다중건물의 에너지 관리 및 최적화를 지원하는 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에 관한 것이다.  
종래 항만의 유지보수를 위해 디지털 트윈 플랫폼이 적용된 바 없으므로, 본 발명은 항만을 구성하는 건물과 도로 및 교량에 대한 정보를 통합 관리하는 항만 데이터 취합부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터를 통해 객체 모델링부에 의해 디지털 트윈(Digital Twin)을 구현하고, 구조해석 서버에서 전달되는 항만건물/시설/도로/교량에 대한 구조 해석 데이터와 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 노후도 정보를 기반으로 디지털 트윈의 가상 모델링 데이터로 출력하는 디지털 트윈 플랫폼과; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부(100)에서 전달된 정보 데이터에 의해 3D 또는 2D의 가상화 모델링 작업을 진행하는 객체 모델링부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터를 통해 항만건물과 도로 및 교량에 대한 잔여 수명을 예측하는 시뮬레이터부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부의 정보 데이터에 포함된 센서의 상태 및 고장여부를 실시간을 감시하는 상태감지부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터와, 항만/도로/교량에 대한 구조 해석 데이터를 통해 각각의 잔여 수명을 연산하는 구조해석 서버와; 기존에 구현되어 있는 다른 항만에 대한 데이터가 저장되는 디지털 트윈DB와; 상기 디지털 트윈 플랫폼(200)에서 구현되는 가상 모델링 데이터를 모니터에 표출하는 디스플레이부를 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에서는 디지털 트윈DB에 저장된 동일 또는 유사한 항만의 빅데이터(Big Data)를 머신러닝(Machine Learning) 알고리즘과 AI(Artificial Intelligence)를 적용하여 디지털 트윈 구현의 효율성을 향상시키는 것을 특징으로 하는 항만 인프라 유지관리를 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템을 제안한다. 
본 발명에 의한 항만 인프라 유지관리를 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템은 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달되는 정보 데이터가 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에 전달되고, 객체 모델링부를 통해 각 구성요소에 대한 가상화 모델링 작업을 진행하며, 항만건물/시설/도로/교량의 노후도를 예측 및 시뮬레이션하여 디스플레이할 수 있으므로, 디스플레이부를 통해 시각적으로 항만 인프라의 노후도를 즉각 확인이 가능한 효과가 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반 시뮬레이션을 통한 재해발생 및 노후화에 의한 피해발생상황 예측 및 즉각적인 정책적 의사결정 시스템을 구축하고, 빅데이터(기본정보, 2내역/3내역 데이터 및 노후도/재해위험도 평가 데이터 등) 분석 및 가시화를 통한 항만 인프라 모니터링이 가능한 효과가 있다.
assignees: ROCKWONIT GLOBAL CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster prediction method and system based on data assimilation coupling physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster prediction method based on a data assimilation coupling physical information neural network, which comprises the following steps: s1, when a fire disaster occurs in a tunnel, positioning the position of a fire source; s2, arranging temperature sensors in the tunnel according to different arrangement modes, respectively obtaining system state parameters of fire smoke through data assimilation of time sequence temperature data acquired by the temperature sensors in the different arrangement modes, calculating a temperature prediction value of the fire smoke of the tunnel to obtain temperature prediction precision, and when the temperature prediction precision is smaller than or equal to a set threshold value, arranging the temperature sensors in an optimal arrangement mode; s3, predicting a temperature field, a speed field and a pressure field of tunnel fire smoke based on the data assimilation coupling physical information neural network according to time sequence temperature data and system state parameters acquired by the temperature sensors in an optimal arrangement mode. According to the invention, the flow field of the tunnel fire smoke whole field is rapidly, accurately and in real time predicted by a small amount of fixed temperature sensor data.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Power system state estimation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a power system state estimation method, a device, a computer apparatus, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: predicting the training set through an initial state estimation model to obtain a predicted state variable of the power system; the prediction state variables represent power related parameters of all branches in the power system; determining a theoretical loss based on the predicted state variables and the operating constraints of the power system; determining a prediction loss based on the training tag and the prediction state variable; determining a total loss based on the theoretical loss and the predicted loss; and adjusting parameters of the initial state estimation model according to the total loss, and continuing training until the preset iteration condition is met, and stopping to obtain a trained state estimation model. By adopting the method, the theoretical loss determined based on the operation constraint condition of the power system is added in the loss function of the state estimation model, so that the convergence speed of the state estimation model is effectively accelerated, and the state estimation accuracy can be improved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution fault warning method, device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose a power distribution fault alerting method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer readable medium. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a power distribution room historical operation data set and power distribution room modeling information; collecting distribution room environment parameter information and distribution room equipment parameter information set; carrying out digital twin processing on the modeling information of the power distribution room; constructing a power distribution fault detection model; performing fault detection processing on the distribution room environment parameter information and the distribution room equipment parameter information set to obtain a distribution fault detection result; in response to determining that the power distribution fault detection result characterizes the presence of a power distribution fault, performing the steps of: updating the three-dimensional twin model of the power distribution room; and visualizing the updated three-dimensional twin model of the power distribution room, and executing power distribution fault alarm operation corresponding to the power distribution fault detection result. According to the embodiment, the power distribution fault detection efficiency can be improved, and the real-time performance and the visual effect of power distribution room fault detection can be improved.

title_en: Micro-grid-based industrial park waste energy recovery energy regulation and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of energy management, in particular to an industrial park waste energy recovery energy regulation and control method based on a micro-grid. S1, installing residual energy recovery equipment; s2, deployment of complementary energy micro-networks; s3, deploying self-organizing network nodes; s4, preprocessing data; s5, digital twin construction; s6, energy micro-control in the micro-grid; s7, autonomous learning and optimizing control; s8, macro-control of energy sources among the micro-networks. Through the dynamic regulation and control of energy in the micro-grid and the macroscopic regulation and control of energy among the micro-grid, the secondary energy loss caused by long-distance transmission can be reduced, the overflow energy storage of the high-energy-storage micro-grid can be controlled to be supplied to the high-energy-utilization micro-grid, the commercial power access quantity of the high-energy-utilization micro-grid is reduced, and the overall energy supply and demand balance of an industrial park is promoted; the digital twin model is constructed, real-time simulation and prediction are carried out on the deployment, energy flow and energy consumption conditions of all micro-grid equipment in an industrial park, the optimization capacity and response speed of the system can be improved, and the accuracy, the instantaneity and the effectiveness of energy management and scheduling are improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN SENHUI INTELLIGENT AUTOMATIC CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based building fire control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control, in particular to a digital twinning-based building fire control method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: summarizing topographic images and establishing a rescue management and control road network digital twin model; quantitatively calculating the fire starting point controllability; dynamically evaluating a rescue risk value and a rescue effective value according to spatial information at a fire start point in a rescue control road network digital twin model; fusion judging whether a fire starting point in a building reaches an internal rescue risk threshold value or not, and determining a first-round management and rescue strategy; rescreening the number of fire transition points and fire end points in the building; dynamically deploying a next round of fire control and rescue according to the fire transition point controllability; the invention solves the problems of changeable and difficult quantification of fire behavior in the building, and greatly increased rescue risk due to less decision time when firefighters arrive at an actual fire control area in the prior art.

title_en: Wind power prediction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method, a system, equipment and a medium, comprising the following steps: carrying out missing data processing, abnormal wind power data inspection and abnormal wind power data correction on the original data of a wind power plant, dividing wind power data into three types of wind power generation season characteristic analysis, namely spring, summer and autumn and winter, carrying out correlation analysis on weather factors in different season types and wind power, screening weather factors with good correlation, carrying out cluster analysis on the data in different season types by adopting a SOM algorithm and a k-means++ algorithm, improving on the basis of a traditional converter model, constructing a converter model suitable for wind power prediction, determining model parameters and training modes, and obtaining a short-time wind power predicted value. The training process of the invention is more in line with the principle of wind power generation, the prediction precision is greatly improved, and short-time wind power prediction can be better realized.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Power grid operation risk prediction system and method based on graph convolution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operation risk prediction system and method based on a graph rolling network, comprising the following steps: the training data construction module is used for searching the static security analysis historical data in the power grid system state estimation historical section data according to the time nodes to obtain a training data set, and labeling the class of equipment in the training data set; the topological feature extraction module is used for establishing a grid system device adjacency matrix through connection between the nodes and edges of the graphic neural network and the real grid devices, establishing a grid system device feature matrix according to the marked training data set, fusing the grid system device adjacency matrix and the grid system device feature matrix, and extracting features to obtain feature vectors; the feature mapping module is used for inputting the feature vector into the deep neural network to obtain a matrix containing the load rate interval types, and obtaining the probability distribution vector of the load interval by using the matrix containing the load rate interval types. The method and the system can better predict the running risk of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel disaster simulation method, device and equipment based on three-dimensional digital twin model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a tunnel disaster simulation method, device and equipment based on a three-dimensional digital twin model. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring cable data of an actual cable tunnel and a cable tunnel disaster test case; inputting cable data and cable tunnel disaster test cases into a pre-established three-dimensional digital twin model of the tunnel to obtain a disaster state cable tunnel model; carrying out tunnel disaster scene detection on the disaster state cable tunnel model to generate a tunnel scene detection result; determining corresponding disaster processing information; calling a corresponding simulation tool to execute tunnel disaster processing operation; determining a tunnel scene detection result, disaster processing information and difference data between a called simulation tool and a test sample; and determining that the tunnel disaster simulation corresponding to the cable tunnel disaster test case is completed. This embodiment may reduce the damage of cable resources in case of disasters.

title_en: Digital twin visual model display method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a digital twin visual model display method, a digital twin visual model display device, digital twin visual model display equipment and digital twin visual model display media. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a digital twin visual model; the digital object corresponding to the power equipment and/or the power area with abnormal running state is marked with the object and/or the digital area; determining object operation event time line information; generating operation adjustment information and object operation simulation state information; adjusting the power equipment; performing running state simulation on the adjusted power equipment to generate equipment simulation state information; performing label removal processing on the first digital object to obtain a removed digital twin visual model; and displaying the removed digital twin visual model on target display equipment. According to the embodiment, the digital object with abnormal running state shown by the digital twin visual model can be quickly and accurately adjusted, and the state detection efficiency of the power grid equipment is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Underground infrastructure flood evacuation analysis method and system based on large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood evacuation analysis method and system for underground infrastructure based on a large model, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining flood image information, outputting disaster descriptions and risk grades corresponding to the flood image information through a large model flood analysis mode training system, inputting data output by the large model flood analysis mode training system into a large model-digital twin real-time deduction system for calling through an integrated system of the large model and a digital twin platform, carrying out data deduction through the large model-digital twin real-time deduction system, and outputting analysis results.

title_en: Power transmission line state evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a power transmission line state evaluation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of power transmission line evaluation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring line basic data and line operation data of a power transmission line; determining an initial theoretical line loss of the power transmission line based on the line operation data; extracting characteristics of line basic data and line operation data to obtain intrinsic characteristics of the power transmission line; fusing the intrinsic characteristics with the initial theoretical line loss to obtain fused characteristics, and inputting the fused characteristics into a theoretical line loss determination model to obtain theoretical line loss; and determining the statistical line loss of the power transmission line, and evaluating the state of the power transmission line based on the statistical line loss and the theoretical line loss. According to the invention, a theoretical line loss determination model is added, the intrinsic characteristics of the data depth are extracted, the calculation accuracy and reliability of the theoretical line loss are improved, and the state of the power transmission line is estimated through the theoretical line loss and the statistical line loss together, so that the accuracy of state estimation is further improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;WUHAN BRANCH OF CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent charging station network management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent charging station network management system, which is applied to the field of electric automobile control and comprises the following components: charging station distribution management module, charging position dispatch management module and electric automobile battery health monitoring module triplex. The charging station distribution management module can reasonably distribute charging station positions in the city, so that the electric automobile can efficiently find a charging station and intelligently monitor the charging station; the charging position scheduling management module can plan the optimal path and the optimal station and dynamically display the traffic flow data of each station in real time; the electric automobile battery health monitoring module can diagnose and monitor the battery in the electric car charging process, evaluate the fault and the service condition of the battery and feed back to the user. The whole intelligent charging station network management system based on digital twinning is displayed, supervised and controlled in real time through the digital twinning platform.
assignees: HANGZHOU ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD;HANGZHOU CITY YUHANG DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based charging pile monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of charging pile monitoring, and discloses a digital twinning-based charging pile monitoring method and a digital twinning-based charging pile monitoring system.
