The method comprises the following steps: constructing a corresponding charging pile power network topology static model, a charging pile equipment dynamic model and a charging pile fault detection data model; constructing a charging pile power network digital twin model according to the charging pile power network topology static model, the charging pile equipment dynamic model and the charging pile fault detection data model; constructing a corresponding charging pile fault positioning data model according to the charging pile power network digital twin model; and carrying out fault monitoring on the charging pile of the charging pile power network by using the digital twin model of the charging pile power network, and carrying out fault positioning on the fault charging pile by using the fault positioning data model of the charging pile. The invention solves the problems of high cost, poor diagnosis accuracy and low monitoring efficiency in the prior art.
assignees: BEIJING HAO RUI CHANG SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin distribution network fault scene generation system based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin distribution network fault scene generation system based on reinforcement learning, which comprises an abnormal research model construction module, wherein the abnormal research model construction module is used for constructing an initial abnormal research model by collecting historical data and real-time data of a power distribution network, and the model is used for carrying out preliminary judgment on the abnormal state of the power distribution network according to the topological relation, equipment parameters and voltage and current information of power users of the power distribution network; the beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the abnormal analysis model is optimized and applied to a real-time digital twin power distribution network, so that abnormal identification and diagnosis of a power distribution network station area in the aspect of wiring and topology are realized, and meanwhile, the overload risk is found in advance by utilizing the trend prediction capability of the digital twin power distribution network to predict the load rate; the probability and the influence range of faults are effectively reduced, and the stability and the reliability of the power system are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Distribution network scheduling method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network scheduling method and a distribution network scheduling system based on big data, which belong to the technical field of distribution network scheduling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a twin target according to the information of the power distribution network, and establishing a corresponding digital twin body based on the twin target; establishing a corresponding power distribution network scheduling model according to the digital twin bodies and the power distribution network information; acquiring an original scheduling plan, and extracting data of each original influence item in the original scheduling plan according to each influence item; acquiring real-time data from a power distribution network scheduling model based on each influence item to obtain real-time influence item data corresponding to each influence item; processing the original influence item data and the real-time influence item data according to a preset matrix template to obtain a corresponding planning matrix and an influence matrix; calculating a corresponding change matrix according to the plan matrix and the influence matrix, and adjusting the original scheduling plan based on the change matrix to obtain a real-time scheduling plan; and performing simulation verification on the real-time scheduling plan, and applying the corresponding real-time scheduling plan after the simulation verification is passed.
assignees: DONGTAI DALIANG NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Substation room visualization system and method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substation room visualization system and method based on a digital twin technology, and relates to the technical field of visualization. Compared with the prior substation room visualization system, the system solves the problems of high labor cost, equipment aging, nonstandard operation and maintenance management, insufficient real-time monitoring capability, insufficient safety precaution and low digitization degree of the conventional substation room; the digital twin model of the power distribution station room is built by fully utilizing data such as a physical model, sensor updating, operation history and the like, the three-dimensional visual display of the station room of the model and the Internet of things is realized based on an augmented reality technology, anomaly detection is performed based on a machine learning algorithm, safety precautions are perfected, and the detection capability and the digital degree of the power distribution station room are improved; and the augmented reality technology is combined with the AI intelligent inspection technology, so that the automatic inspection of the equipment in the power distribution station room is realized, the application condition of the power equipment is detected and analyzed at any time, and the future development and the running condition of the power equipment system are judged.
assignees: ANHUI JIYUAN SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for constructing multi-physics digital twin simulation model of power equipment
abstract_en: To provide a method and device for constructing a multi-physics digital twin simulation model of a power facility.SOLUTION: Determining a target simulation model according to the first parameter set of the electric power equipment in the same operating state, and constructing and training a second sample data set by combining the target neural network model and the original first parameter set to generate an improved target neural network model, so as to improve the accuracy and speed of model construction, and determining a multi-physics digital twin simulation model of the electric power equipment in the target neural network model and the improved target neural network model according to the second parameter set of the electric power equipment in different operating states, the multi-physics digital twin simulation model being used for multi-physics digital twin simulation of the electric power equipment.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES GROUP IND DEV BEIJING CO LTD;YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Deep learning driven power grid line loss dynamic prediction and optimization control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid line loss dynamic prediction and optimization control method driven by deep learning, which relates to the technical field of power system optimization and comprises the following steps of; data collection and pretreatment: collecting historical operation data, real-time data, meteorological data and geographic information data of a power grid, and cleaning, standardizing and characteristic engineering the collected data; the invention can learn the internal law of the power grid operation from the history and real-time data by adopting the deep learning technology, automatically identify the key factors influencing the line loss, and compared with the traditional prediction method based on the empirical formula and the static model, the deep learning model of the invention can more accurately capture the dynamic characteristics of the power grid operation, the method has the advantages that the accuracy of line loss prediction is remarkably improved, the model can be rapidly adapted to the change of the running state of the power grid through the self-adaptive network structure adjustment and element learning technology, and real-time update is realized, so that the adaptability and the prediction accuracy of the model are enhanced.
assignees: BEIJING ALONG GRID TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic reconstruction method and device of digital twin model for power distribution network service application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power information, in particular to a dynamic reconstruction method and a dynamic reconstruction device for a digital twin model for power distribution network service application, which are used for allocating data resources in a plurality of data storage areas based on power distribution network service call requirements, so that the dynamic reconstruction of the digital twin model is realized, the data resources in each data resource area can be updated along with the update of the data resource distribution along with service call requests, and the high matching performance of the data resources in each area and the service call requests is ensured. The method can solve the problem of model response performance bottleneck of the composite digital twin model in the power distribution network service application process, and improves the data response efficiency of the digital twin model by reducing the invalid query probability of data resources.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power grid line power loss data missing data recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy-oriented power system analysis, and particularly relates to a power grid line power loss data missing data recovery method and system, wherein a prediction algorithm data set is constructed according to original data of power grid line power loss; designing a forward and reverse prediction network according to the constructed prediction algorithm dataset data structure; training the forward and reverse prediction networks by using the constructed data set; predicting missing data by using the trained forward and reverse prediction networks; and carrying out weighted summation on the prediction results of the missing data by using the forward and reverse prediction networks, and recovering the missing line loss data. According to the invention, the data recovery is carried out on the missing power grid line loss data according to the data which are not missing in the power grid line power loss data. The method can improve the utilization efficiency of the computing resource, has less training parameter quantity, and has better prediction precision and shorter training time.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Power grid safety dynamic management and control method and system for power guarantee object
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid safety dynamic management and control method and a system for a power guarantee object, which relate to the technical field of power grid management and control, and can determine power demand peak and valley periods of a power grid in different periods by combining a power demand curve model and a space load density model of the power grid, and describe the coverage range and the density degree of the power grid; the specific influence of the newly added power guarantee object on the power supply stability can be evaluated by simulating the process of accessing the newly added power guarantee object into the power grid in the digital twin model and combining the power flow value; when the simulation result shows that the abnormal probability is larger than the set threshold value, the fact that the preliminarily determined first space address is not the preferable space address possibly causes unstable condition of the power grid is indicated, and the overall performance and stability of the power grid are optimized by adjusting the space address of the newly added power guarantee object; by adopting the embodiment of the invention, the operation efficiency and reliability of the power grid are effectively improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Processing method and system for alpha test data of stator coil bar of power generator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of power generator stator coil bar safety detection. Disclosed are a processing method and system for ALPHA test data of a stator coil bar of a power generator. The method comprise the following steps: acquiring ALPHA test data of a stator coil bar of a power generator on the basis of an ALPHA test unit, and calculating the acquired ALPHA test data; determining a health level of a stator of the power generator on the basis of an acquired calculation result; acquiring historical data, generating a curve trend chart on the basis of the determined health level of the stator of the power generator, and calculating a trend on the basis of the curve trend chart; and generating a maintenance scheme on the basis of the trend. The present invention can perform real-time updating on the basis of the change of data, and finally can more visually present a future state of the stator coil bar of the power generator on the basis of the generated curve trend chart, so that early-warning can be provided for workers, and compared with the prior art that a danger can be detected only when current occurs, and early-warning can be provided, the present invention can greatly reduce the occurrence of dangers.
assignees: HUANENG YAKESHI POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Knowledge fusion-based energy-saving and emission-reduction optimization method for cogeneration multi-unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cogeneration units, and discloses a knowledge fusion-based energy-saving and emission-reduction optimization method for cogeneration multi-unit, which comprises the following steps: and constructing a complete equipment mechanism model of the cogeneration unit. By adopting a dragging type code-free visual modeling technology, a digital twin model of core equipment based on heat transfer is developed, the performance of the cogeneration unit is calculated and analyzed in real time, high-quality and global performance indexes are provided for the operation of the unit, and meanwhile, a multi-element coupling analysis system comprehensively considering a steam energy flow, a heat transfer core link and economic benefits is constructed by combining machine learning, data mining and optimization technologies, so that real-time load distribution optimization can be provided according to indexes such as the current real-time heat supply requirement of a power plant, the real-time electric load requirement, the real-time environment temperature, the circulating water quantity of a heat supply network, the return water temperature of the heat supply network and the like, thereby improving the operation economy of the cogeneration unit, reducing carbon emission and improving the environmental protection competitiveness of enterprises.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHUDU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power production loss evaluation method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power production loss evaluation method based on digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of intelligent evaluation, and comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of the equipment, writing data in a power generation sample data set, a power transmission sample data set and a power distribution sample data set to obtain a full-flow digital twin model, and obtaining a power generation-power transmission loss index and a power transmission-power distribution loss index through model identification; and based on the first loss sample group of each power grid in the matched power grid library, comparing the power generation-transmission loss index and the power transmission-distribution loss index with the power generation-transmission loss sample and the power transmission-distribution loss sample respectively, and outputting a first loss evaluation result. The invention solves the technical problems of one-sided and low reliability of the power loss evaluation result obtained by using a direct measurement method in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of evaluating the power production loss based on a digital twin technology and improving the comprehensiveness and reliability of the evaluation result.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic data tampering detection method based on suspicious sample majority vote
abstract_en: The photovoltaic data tampering detection method based on suspicious sample majority voting can ensure the steady operation of a power grid and the accuracy of state estimation, and can reduce the false alarm rate and improve the detection reliability in a majority voting mode. Comprising the following steps: performing behavior feature analysis on suspicious samples, preprocessing sample data when the attacked system state vector has different behaviors from the latest historical data, and filtering out suspicious samples by F checking the equality of the current state vector and the mean variance of the latest historical data; identifying suspicious sample depth, and calculating vector difference between suspicious vectors and average values of most similar system state vector sets; suspicious vector majority voting, using three different outlier detection algorithms: FCM, IQR and MAD majority vote, if two or more outlier detection algorithms identify a state as an outlier, then that state will be detected as an attacked state.
assignees: JINZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;SHENYANG INST ENGINEERING;STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method and system for establishing data twin based on photovoltaic flexible support
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a method and a system for establishing a data twinning body based on a photovoltaic flexible support, which comprises the following steps: based on real-time meteorological information and material physical information of the photovoltaic flexible support, a multi-view three-dimensional matching algorithm is adopted to establish a data twin model, and environmental data are analyzed by combining a random forest algorithm and a gradient lifting tree algorithm to simulate the influence of various environmental factors on the performance of the support and generate environmental influence assessment information. According to the invention, a data twin three-dimensional model is constructed through a multi-view stereo matching algorithm, the gradient lifting tree algorithm is combined, the environmental influence is analyzed, the design safety is optimized by utilizing finite element analysis, the energy output and faults are predicted by utilizing a convolutional neural network and a cyclic neural network, the abnormal state is identified through a support vector machine and a K-nearest neighbor algorithm, the consumable life is optimized by adopting the gradient lifting model, the multi-layer perceptron neural network is combined, the maintenance strategy is adjusted, and the photovoltaic system efficiency is optimized.
assignees: JIAXING CHAOLIAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Throwing type lifeboat intelligent release system based on pool test and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a throwing type lifeboat intelligent release system based on a pool test and digital twin, which comprises a field control system, a digital twin system and a pool test system, wherein the field control system is used for acquiring field environment and real ship parameters and controlling the lifeboat to emit according to feedback data; the digital twin system is used for providing three-dimensional reproduction of the accident scene, so that the personnel can make decisions conveniently; the pool test system is used for simulating wind, wave and current environments of an accident site in a test pool and judging whether the on-site lifeboat is safe to launch. The invention establishes a set of intelligent release system of the throwing type lifeboat, which is formed by the complementary three of the actual physical environment, the digital model prediction and the scale test optimization, can realize the double reproduction of the digital and the physical model of the throwing type lifeboat, so that the life-saving personnel can accurately and effectively command the escape work in the disaster site, and the survival rate of the life-saving personnel is greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU SCIENCE & TECH;COSCO SHIPPING HEAVY IND YANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Water quality simulation method for integrated water supply of plant, net and river
abstract_en: A method for simulating the water quality of integrated water supply of a factory, a network and a river comprises the steps of river water source simulation, water intake water quality dynamic analysis, water supply network water quality prediction model construction, data interface development, one-dimensional network hydrodynamic water quality simulation, integrated model integration, automation and the like. According to the method, open source software OpenFOAM and EPANET-MSX can be utilized, and continuous simulation and real-time updating of water quality and hydrodynamic parameters from a river channel to a water supply network can be realized through an automatic script and a data interface. The model integrates the treatment effect of the water quality purifying plant, simplifies the treatment effect into treatment nodes on a pipeline system, and ensures the authenticity and accuracy of the simulation result. The method is easy to operate and implement, and can automatically generate the water quality parameter calendar graph, so that the simulation efficiency is greatly improved. The method can be applied to water supply enterprises and water conservancy departments to establish a water supply quality informationized management system, predict long-time sequences, optimize daily management and maintenance, and formulate water quality safety guarantee measures, and has remarkable practical value and wide application prospect.
assignees: TSINGHUA SHENZHEN INT GRADUATE SCHOOL

title_en: Power distribution network error data identification method and system based on graph signal processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for identifying power distribution network error data based on graph signal processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: estimating power distribution network error data based on an error estimation algorithm of the smoothness of the graph; according to the power distribution network error data, eliminating power distribution network error nodes based on the shannon sampling theorem of the graph smoothness, and obtaining a node set for state generation, wherein the node set for state generation is used for estimating the power distribution network state. The method and the device can realize the identification of the power distribution network error data and improve the accuracy of power distribution network state estimation.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Digital twinning-based anomaly detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anomaly detection method and system based on digital twinning, and belongs to the technical field of anomaly detection. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: acquiring state data aiming at power grid equipment, and generating a state space and a description view angle of the power grid equipment by the acquired state data in a parameter description mode; generating description contents of twin ecology of the power grid equipment according to the state space and the description view angle of the power grid equipment; and determining errors among the state space, the description view angle and the description content, acquiring an abnormal score value based on the errors, determining whether a detection sample is an abnormal sample based on the abnormal score value, and judging that the power grid equipment is abnormal if the detection sample is abnormal. The method detects the abnormality of the power grid equipment based on the description content of the twin ecology, has high efficiency, and meets the application requirements of system evolution analysis.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Intelligent prediction method for fire hazard change risk of reinforced concrete structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent prediction method for fire hazard change risk of a reinforced concrete structure, which comprises the following steps: establishing a fine and efficient numerical analysis model of the reinforced concrete structure; constructing a fire collapse simulation method of the reinforced concrete structure; acquiring a fire response data set of the whole reinforced concrete structure; establishing a fire damage evaluation model of the reinforced concrete structure, extracting residual bearing capacity of the target structural component and deformation data of the top and bottom among the layers of the target structural component, calculating to obtain the change rate of relative deformation among the layers of the target structural component, judging whether the target structural component collapses and the collapse direction, and further establishing a fire damage collapse behavior database of the reinforced concrete structure; and combining the neural network prediction model obtained by training with the reinforced concrete structure fine high-efficiency numerical analysis model to establish a reinforced concrete structure digital twin body for carrying out structural fire simulation analysis and prediction of structural fire behavior. The invention can realize the prediction of fire disaster high-temperature damage of the reinforced concrete structure.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Mine emergency escape system based on digital twinning and path planning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine emergency escape system based on digital twinning and a path planning method thereof. According to the invention, the BIM model, the Internet of things technology and the optimization algorithm are comprehensively utilized, and when disasters occur, the shortest escape route can be planned for personnel at different positions underground on the premise of personnel safety, so that the timeliness and rationality of evacuation guidance are improved; when the escape route is planned, not only the dangerous area of the roadway is considered, but also the position information of personnel in the roadway is considered, so that the optimized escape route has more pertinence; by utilizing the three-dimensional visual function of BIM technology, the three-dimensional phase expression of evacuation guidance is realized, and the guidance effect is improved.
assignees: FUJIAN MEIFANG SHIDAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment state monitoring method and system based on data twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power equipment state monitoring method and system based on data twinning, and relates to the technical field of equipment monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing real-time data monitoring on the running state of the power equipment based on a sensor monitoring endpoint network, and performing mapping matching on the monitored equipment node running data stream set and the power equipment edge computing end set to obtain edge data stream computing task information; and carrying out edge processing on the edge data stream calculation task information based on the power equipment edge calculation end set, determining an electric equipment operation characteristic information set, carrying out simulation modeling according to the electric equipment operation characteristic information set and the power equipment region distribution information, constructing a digital twin model of the electric equipment, and carrying out equipment operation state prediction based on the digital twin model to obtain an electric equipment operation state information set. The intelligent comprehensive monitoring of the power equipment is realized, the edge processing accuracy and the processing efficiency of the monitoring data are improved, and the technical effect of equipment state analysis accuracy is further ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent identification system and method for panoramic defects of blades of offshore wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent identification system and method for panoramic defects of blades of an offshore wind turbine, and the intelligent identification system and method comprise a modularized multi-sensor fusion scanning platform, an edge computing unit, a deep learning model, a three-dimensional digital twin model, a virtual maintenance training environment, a cloud central management system and other modules. The unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with a plurality of sensors to carry out panoramic scanning on the blades to collect heterogeneous data such as vision, thermal infrared and laser, and the heterogeneous data is fused and identified to various defects by a deep learning algorithm at the edge side. And the identification result is visualized in a three-dimensional way and combined with a virtual maintenance training environment, so that intelligent maintenance decision support is provided. The whole system realizes the full-flow intellectualization of detection, analysis, training and decision, represents the front level of the wind power detection and operation and maintenance field, can greatly improve the operation and maintenance quality and efficiency, and promotes the green sustainable development of the wind power industry.
assignees: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;SHENGDONG RUDONG OFFSHORE WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: PMU (Power management Unit) optimal configuration method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PMU (Power management Unit) optimal configuration method and a PMU optimal configuration system, which relate to the technical field of power distribution network optimization and comprise the steps of collecting actual running state data of a power distribution network, constructing a three-phase power distribution network model, and constructing a three-phase transformer model and a three-phase load model; selecting nodes to configure SCADA measuring devices according to the constructed three-phase power distribution network model; and selecting the configuration position of the PMU and the measured measurement type by utilizing a genetic algorithm to obtain a new measurement system, constructing a mathematical model, and screening an optimal combination according to the new measurement system. The invention considers the PMU configuration number and position and simultaneously optimizes and combines the measurement types input by the PMU, thereby obtaining an optimal measurement system. The method has good optimizing capability, saves cost in the quantity of configuration PMUs, improves the state estimation precision by optimizing configuration positions and measurement types, and reduces the input quantity of measurement so as to improve the response speed of state estimation.
assignees: UNIV GUIZHOU

title_en: Water conservancy sand table based on remote monitoring and digital twin method of sand table
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote monitoring-based water conservancy sand table and a digital twin method thereof, wherein a three-dimensional topographic map and a water conservancy state of a target mountain are displayed based on a sand table model, basic water conservancy information and dynamic water conservancy information of the target mountain are collected, real-time collection of water conservancy activity information is realized, communication connection between data collection and the sand table model is established based on a wireless network, the basic water conservancy information and the dynamic water conservancy information are transmitted to the sand table model, data connection between monitoring data and the sand table model is realized, characteristic marking is carried out on the sand table model based on the basic water conservancy information and the dynamic water conservancy information, a marking result is obtained, the sand table model is updated based on the marking result, and the latest sand table model is obtained, so that the water conservancy content displayed by the obtained sand table model is rich and comprehensive, and practical and powerful support is provided for decisions of flood disaster prevention work.
assignees: SHAANXI SHANQINGSHUIXIU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind farm SCADA data restoration method based on multiple correlation learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind farm SCADA data restoration method based on multiple correlation learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining a wind power plant standardized data set ; S2, obtaining a filling result under the global cross-correlation view angle ; S3, obtaining a filling result under the global autocorrelation view angle ; S4, obtaining filling results under the partial cross-correlation view angles ; S5, obtaining a filling result under the local autocorrelation view angle ; s6, using multiple linear regression 、 、 And Integrating, denoising and denoise the four filling results to obtain a final repair result . According to the invention, the self-correlation and the cross-correlation in the SCADA multidimensional data are analyzed from the global and the local at the same time, and the missing data are subjected to preliminary filling repair from multiple view angles; further, a residual network fine denoising model is constructed, and denoising and fine restoration are comprehensively carried out on the data after preliminary restoration, so that complete restoration of SCADA multidimensional data is realized.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin system and method for agricultural waterlogging disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin system and a digital twin method for farmland waterlogging disasters, and relates to the technical field of data analysis and processing. According to the method, the geographical data of a specific agricultural production area, the existing farmland flood control and drainage engineering data, the rainfall runoff and other observation data in the environment where the river basin is located and the general hydrologic and hydrodynamic model, the crop waterlogging model and the like are integrated to form a farmland waterlogging disaster analysis model, then the rainfall, channel runoff and other real-time environment observation data are combined with the analysis model, a digital twin method is adopted to establish a river basin-field scale agricultural waterlogging disaster digital twin model, the real-time environment observation data are brought into the river basin-field scale agricultural waterlogging disaster digital twin model, an agricultural waterlogging disaster early warning signal is generated, the disaster influence can be reduced to the maximum extent, the social and economic losses are reduced, and the life and property safety of people is guaranteed.

title_en: High-temperature pipeline monitoring and maintaining system based on cloud edge cooperation and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pipeline monitoring, and particularly relates to a high-temperature pipeline monitoring and maintaining system based on cloud edge cooperation and digital twin. The system realizes real-time state monitoring and visualization of the hot air pipeline by creating a digital twin model of the hot air pipeline and utilizing cloud computing and edge computing technologies. The system is mainly composed of four layers: the acquisition sensing layer is responsible for acquiring key index data; the cloud edge cooperative layer is responsible for distributing computing tasks and analyzing data; the physical modeling layer combines the data acquired in real time with the three-dimensional model to construct a digital twin model; the cloud monitoring layer displays real-time data and performs safety condition early warning. The system also adopts an optimized LSTM network to conduct intelligent prediction of key indexes, combines an ARIMA model and a physical information neural network to conduct residual life prediction of the high-temperature pipeline, effectively improves monitoring efficiency and risk assessment accuracy of the high-temperature pipeline, and provides scientific basis for maintenance of the pipeline.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-machine power system state estimation method based on self-adaption under unknown noise
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power system state calculation, in particular to a multi-machine power system state estimation method based on self adaption under unknown noise, which comprises the following steps: constructing a state space model of a random synchronous generator in a multi-machine power system, wherein the state space model comprises a state equation of the generator and a measurement equation of a generator phasor measurement unit; extracting unknown noise in the measured value of the phasor measurement unit, and establishing basic distribution for the unknown noise in the measured value of the phasor measurement unit based on a Gaussian mixture model; reducing the number of components of the basic distribution by adopting a clustering algorithm to obtain a simplified distribution; and constructing an adaptive state estimator, and realizing adaptive state estimation on the state of the synchronous generator by using the obtained real distribution of unknown noise of the phasor measurement unit and based on the model of the synchronous generator. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of accurately calculating the states of the multi-machine power system under the influence of unknown measurement noise, greatly reducing the calculation burden in practical application and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Large building energy management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large building energy management method and system, belongs to the technical field of large building energy conservation, and aims to solve the technical problems that the existing large building energy management mode is low in intelligent degree and single in management mode, reasonable balance between user experience and energy consumption cannot be achieved, and energy waste is caused. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a digital twin system based on electricity consumption data of each electricity consumption system in the target large building; constructing an electric energy consumption model of each power consumption system according to the power consumption principle of each power consumption system, and calculating the actual energy consumption value of each power consumption system according to the electric energy consumption model; generating an energy management and control strategy of each power consumption system according to the energy management influence index and the actual energy consumption value, and applying the energy management and control strategy to the digital twin system for comfort evaluation to obtain a simulation energy consumption value and simulation comfort; and after the simulation energy consumption value and the simulation comfort level reach the preset targets, applying the energy management and control strategy to the target large building.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR WISDOM BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-based convergence village-level microgrid operation system and method
title_ko: 디지털트윈 기반 융복합형 마을단위 마이크로그리드 운영 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A digital twin-based convergence village-level microgrid operation system and method, according to one embodiment, can enhance energy utilization efficiency and stability by analyzing electric power patterns of power generation sources and loads in villages or complexes with different peak hours. In addition, through one embodiment, it is possible to share electric power operation and surplus electric power by type at a demonstration site according to peak load and energy saving analysis, thereby reducing power purchase costs and connecting electric power operations between different types of demonstration complexes. Furthermore, through an embodiment, it is possible to provide a method for advancing the operation of microgrids through digital twins, such as contributing to improved energy utilization rates and stabilization of the electric power grid through internal electric power operations at small-scale demonstration sites and energy sharing between different types of complexes.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 디지털트윈 기반 융복합형 마을단위 마이크로그리드 운영 시스템 및 방법은 피크시간대가 상이한 유형별 마을이나 단지의 발전원 및 부하의 전력 패턴 분석하여, 에너지 이용 효율과 안정성을 향상할 수 있다. 또한, 실시예를 통해 피크부하 및 에너지절감 분석에 따른 실증사이트의 유형별 전력운영과 잉여전력을 공유할 수 있도록 하여, 전력 구매 비용을 절감하고 유형별 실증 단지 간의 전력 운영을 연계할 수 있다. 또한, 실시예를 통해, 소규모 실증 사이트의 내부 전력운영과 유형별 단지 간의 에너지 공유를 통한 에너지 이용률 향상 및 전력망 안정화 기여 등 디지털 트윈을 통한 마이크로그리드의 운영 고도화 방안을 제공한다.
assignees: GREEN ENERGY INST

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network energy allocation method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based low-voltage distribution network energy allocation method, which belongs to the technical field of distribution network energy adjustment and comprises the following steps: collecting topographic data and equipment data of a corresponding station area of the low-voltage power distribution network; modeling is carried out based on the topographic data and the equipment data to obtain a district geographic model corresponding to each district of the low-voltage distribution network; synchronizing the real-time operation data of each station area of the low-voltage power distribution network with the station area geographic model to obtain a station area synchronous geographic model; analyzing the energy distribution situation of each area based on the area synchronous geographic model; and preparing an energy allocation strategy based on the energy distribution condition and allocation priority of each area, and allocating energy to each area in the low-voltage power distribution network based on the energy allocation strategy. According to the method, the operation data of each platform area and the platform area geographic model are synchronized in real time to obtain the platform area synchronous geographic model, the obtained platform area synchronous geographic model can reflect the energy distribution condition of the platform area in real time, and the accuracy of energy allocation of the low-voltage distribution network is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG WUYI ELECTRIC INSTALLATION ENG CO LTD;WUYI COUNTY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention safety emergency evacuation guiding system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster prevention safety emergency evacuation guiding system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises a plurality of intelligent emergency marker lamps, a plurality of intelligent emergency illuminating lamps, a control host and a comprehensive operation control center; the intelligent emergency marker lamp is used for detecting personnel in a traffic channel and an evacuation channel and detecting the parking position of a vehicle accident, transmitting detected personnel movement data to the control host for analysis, and transmitting personnel distress information and flow density information obtained after analysis to the comprehensive operation control center to present a digital twin virtual reality scene so as to provide information support for rescue decisions; the intelligent emergency lighting lamp is used for detecting disasters in the traffic channel and the evacuation channel, transmitting detected disaster data to the control host for analysis, and transmitting disaster information obtained after analysis to the comprehensive operation control center to present a digital twin virtual reality scene so as to provide information support for rescue decisions. By implementing the invention, the intelligent degree is high, timely and comprehensive information support can be provided for emergency rescue workers, the emergency response speed is improved, and a reasonable rescue scheme is formulated.
assignees: XIJIAO HENGSHENG CHENGDU EMERGENCY TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power optimization method and system based on intelligent data processing analysis and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power optimization method and system based on intelligent data processing analysis and digital twin, and relates to the technical field of electric power system optimization, comprising the steps of collecting electric power system data and preprocessing; extracting features of the preprocessed data, identifying problems in the power system, classifying the problems, and matching solutions; a virtual model of the power system is built, and the priority of the solution is verified. According to the invention, the EMD algorithm is used for analyzing the data, so that the problems in the power system can be accurately identified and effectively classified. Improving the efficiency of problem diagnosis and providing reliable basis for selecting and matching the most suitable solution. By constructing a digital twin model of the power system, the invention enables the solution to be fully tested and validated prior to actual application. This step significantly improves the safety and reliability of the decision, avoiding potential risks and costs.

title_en: Flood disaster defending method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood disaster defending method, a flood disaster defending device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of flood disaster defending, wherein the flood disaster defending method comprises the following steps: obtaining basic data of a target water area, constructing a digital twin flood disaster defense model based on the basic data of the target water area to obtain the digital twin flood disaster defense model, inputting the basic data of the target water area to the digital twin flood disaster defense model to obtain flood disaster analysis data, matching the flood disaster analysis data with a preset disaster grade evaluation index to obtain a disaster grade corresponding to the flood disaster analysis data, and carrying out corresponding defense operation based on the disaster grade. According to the invention, the digital twin flood disaster defense model is constructed to analyze the disaster by acquiring the basic data of a small amount of target water areas, so that the cost of manpower and material resources for flood disaster defense is saved.
assignees: UNIV JINGCHU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Digital twinning-based low-voltage switch cabinet partial discharge detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based low-voltage switch cabinet partial discharge detection system, which comprises: a digital twin network, an edge network; the digital twin network is deployed at the user end, the edge network is deployed at the server end, and data interaction is carried out between the digital twin network and the edge network; the digital twin network is used for constructing a virtual entity of the low-voltage switch cabinet and judging whether partial discharge detection of the low-voltage switch cabinet is carried out or not according to the current state of the low-voltage switch cabinet; the edge network preprocesses the data uploaded by the digital twin network, performs partial discharge detection on the corresponding low-voltage switch cabinet, and can optimize a convolutional neural network model in the digital twin network. Compared with the traditional detection method, the method has higher precision, higher efficiency and strong data processing capability, improves the cognition, diagnosis, prediction, decision making and management capabilities of the low-voltage switch cabinet, and realizes visual display.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Short-coming early warning method and device for running risk of overhead transmission line under strong convection and strong wind
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of electric power natural disaster early warning, and particularly relates to a short-time early warning method and device for the running risk of an overhead transmission line under strong convection and strong wind, comprising the following steps: collecting relevant information of overhead lines in a target monitoring area; determining risk data corresponding to various overhead line risks caused by strong convection and strong wind by utilizing a pre-established digital twin model based on the related information of the overhead line; determining a risk level of overhead line risk caused by strong convection strong wind by using the risk data; and carrying out risk early warning on the overhead line in the target monitoring area according to the risk grade of the overhead line risk. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the risk early warning of strong convection strong wind disasters is realized, the capacity of coping with extreme conditions of the power grid is improved, the transition of the operation of the power grid from passive defense to active coping is promoted, and a critical supporting effect is achieved for the scheduling, operation maintenance and emergency treatment of the power grid to strong convection weather.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin technology-based regional distributed building energy equipment energy consumption digital quantization reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital quantitative reconstruction method of regional distributed building energy equipment energy consumption based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the steps of obtaining real-time energy consumption data of energy equipment in a target building; calculating heat energy consumption data among buildings of the target building; acquiring building image data of a target building; generating a multi-mode dataset based on the real-time energy consumption data, the thermal energy consumption data and the building image data; training a RTNN network which is created in advance by utilizing the multi-mode data set to obtain a prediction model so as to comprehensively predict the energy consumption of the target building by utilizing the prediction model. According to the scheme, real-time energy consumption data and heat energy consumption data are creatively calculated in real time, a Navier-Stokes equation and a thermodynamic first law are applied to generate heat energy consumption, multi-type data are fused to perform model training, dynamic updating of a digital twin model of regional distributed energy equipment is further accurately achieved, and energy consumption is predicted in real time.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY;SHANXI INSTALLATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A digital twin system for solar power plants and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a digital twin system (100) and method (500) for solar power plants. The digital twin system (100) comprises a plurality of measuring units (104) configured to measure one or more parameters of a solar power plant. The plurality of solar strings (106) configured to provide one or more inputs of a solar power plant to a virtual monitoring unit (102). The virtual monitoring unit (102) configured to obtain the one or more inputs from the plurality of measuring units (104) and the plurality of solar strings (106), wherein the virtual monitoring unit (102) predicts probability of at least one loss factor and provide remedial actions for improved performance of the solar plant. The virtual monitoring unit (102) mainly comprises a data collection module (202), an equipment monitoring module (204), an asset managing module (206), and a controller (208).
assignees: MUVVA KUMARASWAMY REDDY

title_en: Three-phase AC/DC power distribution network state estimation method based on load pseudo measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-phase AC/DC power distribution network state estimation method based on load pseudo measurement, which provides a node load pseudo measurement modeling method based on a load proportion model, and obtaining historical data of injection power measurement of each node based on historical load proportion and line loss calculation, simultaneously predicting current moment pseudo measurement by using an exponential smoothing method based on an adaptive coefficient, and finally carrying out three-intersection direct current power distribution network state estimation by combining real-time measurement. The invention fully uses the node load historical data and the real-time measurement information, reduces the error of pseudo measurement of the node load, is suitable for the AC/DC hybrid power distribution network with insufficient measurement, improves the pseudo measurement precision, improves the precision of the state estimation of the AC/DC hybrid power distribution network, and has better feasibility and practicability.
assignees: CSG EHV POWER TRANS CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Substation operation and maintenance management system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application discloses a transformer substation operation and maintenance management system and method based on digital twinning, which are used for constructing the transformer substation operation and maintenance management system by combining digital twinning and artificial intelligence technology so as to overcome the dependence on artificial inspection and improve the intelligence and flexibility of operation and maintenance management. Specifically, the digital twinning-based transformer substation operation and maintenance management system and method can identify potential faults of the power transformer by comparing the waveform semantics of the vibration signals of the power transformer with the vibration modes with normal working states, and realize real-time monitoring and accurate diagnosis of the running states of the power transformer, so that preventive or maintenance measures can be adopted early when potential problems and hidden trouble of faults are found, and the reliability and safety of equipment are improved.

title_en: Wind farm unit active power distribution strategy based on fan health state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power plant set active power distribution strategy based on fan health state estimation, which comprises fan fault degree estimation, health state level estimation and optimal scheduling control of power distribution; the method can adjust the active output of the single fan according to the health condition of the single fan, so as to optimize the total energy output of the wind power plant; adopting a data driving state monitoring method combined with an extreme learning machine algorithm of a Bonferroni interval to realize fault degree estimation; on the basis, the structural health condition of the wind turbine generator is evaluated by comprehensively considering the fault degree, the maintenance cost and the maintenance time by adopting an analytic hierarchy process; and the power scheduling control is performed based on the health state, so that the fatigue load of the fault unit is reduced, the operation efficiency of the healthy unit is maximized, the fault wind turbine is prevented from being developed into a harmful wind turbine, the operation and maintenance of the wind turbine are facilitated, and the cost of wind power generation is reduced.
assignees: RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY TAIZHOU

title_en: Power distribution network digital twin model mapping method and device integrating multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power information, and particularly provides a mapping method and device for a digital twin model of a power distribution network fusing multi-source data, wherein the mapping method comprises the following steps: performing complement processing on measured data values in the real-time measured data of the equipment; aligning and fusing the real-time measurement data of the equipment with the equipment management data based on the equipment ID to obtain equipment fusion data; and associating the equipment fusion data with an equipment description data structure corresponding to the digital twin model of the power distribution network based on the equipment ID. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the electrical topology dynamic and static data can be accurately mapped with the existing digital twin model of the power distribution network, so that the effective fusion of the electrical topology dynamic and static data with the power service is realized, and the applicability of the digital twin model of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power plant fusion management and control method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent power plant fusion management and control, the digital twinning technical field comprises: the method comprises the steps of carrying out data acquisition on power plant equipment and service system information through the Internet of things platform and the digital interface platform, carrying out overall integration and theme reconstruction on the acquired data through the data processing center, operating service application center to define prediction, alarming, analysis and processing services and rules, carrying out service management and service pushing, constructing a digital twin base, fusing the digital twin base and a digital visualization system, and synchronously simulating operation, virtual-real interaction and digital energization on a main and auxiliary machine process system through the digital twin base system by fusing the acquired data.
assignees: TONGLIAO HUOLINHE KENGKOU POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin center construction method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin center construction method, a digital twin center construction system, digital twin center construction equipment and a digital twin center storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of electric power data processing. According to the digital twin center construction method for electric power, a basic service layer, a sharing capability layer and a twin application layer are constructed, multi-element data are processed to obtain twin data, the twin data are processed to realize digital twin scene construction, then mirror image twin mapping is carried out on the digital twin scenes, one or more typical demonstration scenes are built, and therefore construction of a twin power grid in a certain area is completed. Meanwhile, the invention can realize multi-element data acquisition, technical component intercommunication and through Internet of things control, can carry out data intercommunication on related service environment models, the data base and the platform on which the twin application depends are ensured to be consistent, and full-period, full-direction and full-flow simulation, early warning, prejudgment and digital management and control of the intelligent power grid and the intelligent power plant can be realized.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Transformer management system and method based on RCM and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a transformer management system and method based on RCM and electronic equipment, and belongs to the field of transformer management. The system comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring operation data, address information and historical fault data of the transformer; the functional structure management module is used for modeling the transformer by adopting a digital twin model according to the operation data of the transformer; the system comprises a criticality grading management module, a failure mode and influence analysis configuration management module, a risk matrix configuration management module, a reliability related index calculation module and an address information management module, wherein the address information management module is used for managing address information, longitude and latitude information of a transformer. In the transformer management system, the application of the RCM strategy can realize the real-time monitoring and evaluation of the running state of the transformer, discover potential faults in time, and make a targeted maintenance plan, thereby not only reducing the unplanned downtime and the maintenance cost, but also improving the overall running efficiency of the power system.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH

title_en: Power time sequence data anomaly detection method, system, medium and processor
abstract_en: The application provides a method for detecting power time sequence data abnormality, which comprises the following steps: acquiring power time sequence data; detecting and processing missing data in the power time sequence data, and filling the missing data by adopting a prediction algorithm LSTM or a prediction algorithm LSTM combined average filling method, wherein the prediction algorithm LSTM combined average filling method can avoid the problem that the influence on the data prediction result of the prediction algorithm LSTM is larger when the power time sequence data set has larger time-space sequence fluctuation; detecting repeated data in the power time sequence data and removing the repeated data; detecting and processing out-of-limit data of the processed data; and detecting the data types of the rest anomalies and processing the processed data. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can help to process the missing value, the repeated data, the out-of-limit data and the abnormal value in the power time sequence data, ensure the quality and the reliability of the data, and facilitate subsequent analysis and application.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Weight acquisition method for online health evaluation index of power distribution terminal based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weight acquisition method of an online health evaluation index of a power distribution terminal based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring element basicity by using a Weibull distribution model; s2, constructing an index fault tree analysis model to determine fault rates of telemetry, remote signaling, remote control, battery, communication, protection and feeder automation; s3, obtaining index importance scores by using an analytic hierarchy process; s4, constructing an index reliability distribution model; s5, normalizing the reliability to obtain an initial weight; s6, introducing a variable weight theory to acquire variable weight. The method introduces a Weibull distribution model, a fault tree analysis model, an importance model and a reliability distribution model to obtain the initial weight of each index, and eliminates the negative influence caused by subjective color.
assignees: TRAINING AND EVALUATION CENTER OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Bathroom electric power early warning control system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning, and provides a bathroom electric power early warning control system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises an acquisition module for acquiring at least one target image of each electric power device in a monitoring area of a bathroom; the abnormality detection module is used for respectively carrying out equipment abnormality detection on each target image to obtain target detection results of each target image; the visualization module is used for adding the states of the electric power equipment in the digital twin map corresponding to the monitoring area according to the target detection result of each target image to obtain a visualization page; and the power early warning module is used for displaying the visual page and carrying out power early warning under the condition that the power equipment is displayed in the visual page. According to the invention, the management cost and the management complexity of manual early warning can be greatly reduced through a digital twin technology, and the visual page can enable a user to quickly locate the power equipment with potential safety hazard and timely maintain the power equipment, so that the potential safety hazard is greatly reduced.
assignees: DONGGUAN BENLUO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent energy storage system regulation and control and operation and maintenance method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent energy storage system regulation and control and operation and maintenance method and equipment, and relates to the field of intelligent management of energy storage systems. The intelligent regulation and control and operation method comprises the following steps: acquiring parameter data in a current time period; according to the parameter data in the current time period, predicting the parameter data in the future time period by utilizing an SOX intelligent algorithm; determining a charge and discharge regulation strategy for optimizing an objective function by utilizing a digital twin synchronization model of the energy storage system according to parameter data in a future time period; and formulating an operation and maintenance strategy of the energy storage system by using a digital twin synchronization model of the energy storage system. The method provided by the embodiment of the invention adopts a method combining the neural network model technology and the twin technology to formulate a charge-discharge regulation strategy and an operation-maintenance strategy, and improves the energy utilization efficiency, the safety and the economy of the energy storage system.

title_en: Water resource management method and system based on digital twin for realizing intelligent water affair
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water resource management, and provides a water resource management method and system based on digital twin for realizing intelligent water affair, wherein the method comprises the following steps: classifying the water resource data under the intelligent water service to obtain classified data so as to simulate a virtual application scene of the intelligent water service, analyzing the simulation effect of the virtual application scene, constructing a multi-area network under the intelligent water service, creating an information sharing interface of the multi-area network based on the classified data, and monitoring the water resource change data of the virtual application scene in real time after configuring an area static sensing network and an area dynamic monitoring network under the intelligent water service; analyzing water resource abnormality factors of the virtual application scene based on the water resource change data to create a virtual management scheme in the virtual application scene; and when the scheme feasibility of the virtual management scheme is larger than the preset feasibility, using the virtual management scheme as a final management scheme of the intelligent water service. The invention aims to improve the management efficiency of water resources.
assignees: SHENZHEN SHUANGYIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fine wind measuring method based on construction period
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power measurement, in particular to a method for finely measuring wind based on construction period, which comprises the following steps of analyzing terrain data based on the terrain data of a construction area through a geographic information system and a digital elevation model, and identifying and recording key topographic features affecting the wind flow mode, and calculating potential influences of the spatial distribution of the topographic features on the wind speed and the wind direction to obtain topographic influence analysis results. In the invention, the key terrain features affecting the wind flow mode are accurately identified at an early stage, the influence of wind speed and wind direction is more accurately predicted and simulated, the real-time updated wind field simulation result is utilized to directly guide the risk assessment and the adjustment of the construction plan, and the flexibility and the response speed of project management are enhanced. Resource waste and potential safety risk caused by estimation errors are reduced, synchronous improvement of construction efficiency and safety is ensured, and cost-effectiveness ratio of the whole project is optimized.
assignees: THREE GORGES NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION MILE CO LTD;GOLDWIND SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Geological health monitoring and early warning system and method based on multi-source heterogeneous information
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological health monitoring and early warning, and discloses a geological health monitoring and early warning system and method based on multi-source heterogeneous information, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a general sense integrated base station, a management scheduling center, a user terminal and a geological data monitoring and collecting unit; the geological data monitoring and collecting unit, the management scheduling center and the user terminal are all in communication connection with the sense integrated base station through the communication module, the management scheduling center comprises a data management analysis module and a digital twin module which are sequentially connected, the input end of the data management analysis module is in communication connection with the sense integrated base station, and the output end of the digital twin module is in communication connection with the user terminal. The technical scheme of the invention can effectively improve the efficiency and the precision of geological disaster monitoring and early warning.
assignees: NINGBO GUIBU MINE INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;CHINA INF TECHNOLOGY DESIGNING CONSULTING INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for estimating three-dimensional stress state of large-scale side slope in complex terrain area
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale slope three-dimensional stress state estimation method for a complex terrain area, which comprises the steps of obtaining data of a research area, constructing a global coordinate system of the research area, determining horizontal construction stress according to the data, determining construction stress tensors under the global coordinate system according to the horizontal construction stress, obtaining direction component vectors for each calculation point in the research area, calculating slope direction stress tensors under the global coordinate system according to the direction component vectors based on an algorithm for searching and analyzing the terrain, and calculating slope three-dimensional stress of each calculation point in the research area according to the slope direction stress tensors and the construction stress tensors under the global coordinate system by combining geological structure distribution of the research area. The method mainly solves the problem of a large-scale three-dimensional slope stress calculation method, and provides initial stress reference for comprehensively evaluating geological disaster risks related to slope stress instability.

title_en: Computer collaboration system for electric power multiparty real-time consultation and data processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system monitoring, and discloses a computer collaborative system of a power multiparty real-time consultation and a data processing method thereof, which comprises the steps of obtaining a target power coefficient, analyzing the target power coefficient to generate a first analysis result, constructing a corresponding digital twin model according to video stream data and real-time monitoring data, analyzing the digital twin model to generate a second analysis result, acquiring description text data about the power system, generating an event diagram according to the description text data, inputting the first analysis result, the second analysis result and the event diagram into a pre-constructed state monitoring model, the system state type is obtained, and the power system is analyzed through diversified data, so that a reliable fault diagnosis result can be provided when a complex environment and variable working conditions are processed.
assignees: BAIYIN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent water affair dynamic supervision method and platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent water service dynamic supervision method and a digital twinning-based intelligent water service dynamic supervision platform, which relate to the technical field of water service dynamic supervision, wherein the load degree of a water service pipe network is constructed by data obtained through monitoring, if the load degree of the water service pipe network exceeds an expected value, related data of the water service pipe network are collected, a digital twinning model of the water service pipe network is obtained through training, the communication state between the digital twinning model of the water service pipe network and the outside is monitored, and if the communication state is lower than the expected value, communication enhancement measures are adopted; performing simulation analysis on the water service pipe network, constructing the stability of the water service pipe network according to the test data, screening the output optimization scheme after the optimization knowledge graph of the water service pipe network gives an optimization scheme to the water service pipe network if the stability does not exceed the stability threshold, and optimizing the water service pipe network according to the screened optimization scheme; when the water service pipe network is optimized, the optimization effect can be guaranteed, and then the water service pipe network can be in a better running state all the time.

title_en: Layered aggregation method and device for energy internet-oriented distributed optical/storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a layering aggregation method and a layering aggregation device for an energy Internet-oriented distributed optical/storage system, which comprise the steps of establishing a five-dimensional digital twin model of the distributed optical/storage system of a target county area; and clustering the distributed light/storage systems in the aggregate of the distributed light/storage systems by a transverse federal learning method of the five-dimensional digital twin model according to the layering region sequence of the platform region-feeder region-power supply region-county region and the regulation and control demand of each layering region to obtain the aggregation result of the distributed light/storage systems of each layering region. The invention realizes the hierarchical and regional regulation and control of mass distributed optical/storage resources in the county energy Internet in an aggregation manner under the protection of privacy, and can provide accurate clustering results for group regulation and group control of distributed optical storage under the protection of privacy. The invention also relates to a device and a storage medium.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation system management platform and method based on digital twin and deep learning
