abstract_en: The invention provides a cloud edge cooperation-based power grid digital twin modeling method and a platform, which relate to the technical field of digital processing and comprise the following steps: the integrated distributed sensor network is in communication connection with a plurality of real-time monitoring units, and monitoring indexes comprise current, voltage and temperature; an edge computing server is deployed to upload real-time monitoring data and perform rapid fault location; the method comprises the steps of interacting an edge calculation server with a cloud processor, dynamically adjusting a scheduling strategy, and constructing a digital twin model of a power grid; performing local marking to establish a plurality of local update spaces; matching a plurality of independent update periods and priority mechanisms, and adaptively triggering a plurality of local update requests; and performing self-learning iteration reinforcement in the operation process to assist in operation and maintenance management of the target power grid. The invention solves the technical problems of resource waste and unstable system caused by the lack of an intelligent means because the power grid dispatching strategy in the prior art is difficult to adapt to dynamic change in power grid operation.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid equipment state monitoring method
abstract_en: The application provides a power grid equipment state monitoring method based on digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of equipment state monitoring and comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time operation data of power grid equipment; constructing an initial digital twin model, and fusing the initial digital twin model to obtain an updated digital twin model; acquiring health parameter data, analyzing the influence of health monitoring, and establishing an influence adaptability model; performing influence analysis on the health abnormal data and the service life of the equipment to generate health influence coefficients; performing presence evaluation of power grid equipment to generate a health evaluation coefficient; and performing verification evaluation on the power grid equipment to generate a power grid equipment state monitoring result. According to the method and the device for monitoring the health state of the power grid equipment, the technical problems that the monitoring efficiency of the power grid equipment is low and the accuracy of the health prediction is poor due to the fact that the health state of the power grid equipment is not monitored in real time in the prior art can be solved, the technical aim of monitoring the health state of the power grid in real time is achieved, and the technical effects of improving the monitoring efficiency and the accuracy of the health state prediction are achieved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Water conservancy informatization management method and management system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a water conservancy informatization management method and system based on a digital twin technology, comprising the following steps: acquiring multisource data of a water conservancy infrastructure and an environment of the water conservancy infrastructure; integrating and inputting the multi-source data into a digital twin system to generate a real-time dynamic water conservancy infrastructure digital model; the high-precision geographic information system is combined with the digital twin technology to monitor and analyze the real-time state of the water conservancy infrastructure; based on an artificial intelligence algorithm, carrying out predictive analysis on data in the digital twin model, and identifying potential risks and optimizing management strategies; and automatically adjusting the water resource allocation and the running state of facilities according to the real-time data and the prediction result through the intelligent scheduling system. The invention obviously improves the intelligent and automatic level of water resource management, ensures the safe operation of water conservancy facilities, solves the key problems in the prior art, and provides powerful technical support for water conservancy informatization management.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHISHUI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station operation and maintenance method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy, and discloses a photovoltaic power station operation and maintenance method and device, comprising the following steps: establishing a simulation database under different operation conditions; constructing an online monitoring database based on historical data of operation parameters of the photovoltaic power station; according to the simulation database and the online monitoring database, a training library is obtained, and characteristics of different operation conditions in the training library are extracted to obtain an operation and maintenance training model diagnosis library; and the on-line data is analyzed by utilizing an operation and maintenance training model diagnosis library, so that the fault diagnosis, early warning and life prediction of the photovoltaic power station are realized, a foundation is laid for multi-scale and multi-field fusion of simulation technology, and the data requirement in the subsequent construction of a digital twin system is met.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power distribution network fault monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault monitoring system and method based on digital twinning, comprising a data acquisition module, a digital model construction module, a fault detection module and a strategy output module; the digital model construction module comprises a first digital model construction module and a second digital model construction module; the fault detection module is used for predicting and alarming the power grid faults according to the digital model and an intelligent algorithm; and the strategy output module is used for outputting a fault processing scheme according to the power grid digital twin model and the electromechanical information model and carrying out maintenance dispatch by combining a fault priority judgment result. Based on the power grid digital twin model and the electromechanical information model, the invention performs double verification on fault information, improves fault detection precision, outputs an accurate fault processing scheme and adjusts dispatch priority, rapidly processes faults, and realizes the safety and stability of power grid operation.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Substation simulation method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of substation simulation, and provides a digital twinning-based substation simulation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring parameter information data of a transformer substation and equipment; the parameter information data are subjected to data cleaning and integration, and the format of the cleaned and integrated data is converted; constructing a three-dimensional structure model of the transformer substation according to the converted data; constructing a virtual model of the power system based on a digital twin technology, wherein the virtual model is used for reflecting the actual running state of the power system; and acquiring a simulation instruction input by a user in real time, and performing simulation on the transformer substation according to the three-dimensional structure model and the virtual model to generate a virtual simulation result corresponding to the simulation instruction. According to the invention, the simulation system is constructed based on the parameters of the transformer substation, and the judgment capability and the dispatching efficiency of a dispatcher in a dispatching process can be improved through the simulation system.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent load transfer system and method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load intelligent transfer system and method based on a digital twin technology, relates to the technical field of digital twin, and can solve the technical problems of long time consumption, easiness in error, numerous operation devices and low operation efficiency in manually making a transfer scheme. The system comprises: the data acquisition subsystem is connected with the physical model subsystem and is used for acquiring real-time data of the power distribution network; the physical model subsystem is connected with the optimization processing subsystem and is used for inputting real-time data of the power distribution network into the physical model, outputting real-time running conditions of the power distribution network, determining whether line faults exist according to the real-time running conditions of the power distribution network, and if yes, sending the real-time data of the power distribution network and target fault line information to the optimization processing subsystem; the optimizing processing subsystem is used for optimizing processing by utilizing an optimizing processing algorithm to obtain an optimal load transfer execution instruction so as to execute load automatic transfer according to the optimal load transfer execution instruction.
assignees: JINCHENG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Periodic digital twin auxiliary management platform for photovoltaic construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photovoltaic management platforms, in particular to a periodic digital twin auxiliary management platform for photovoltaic construction, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing and storage module, a digital twin modeling module, an analog and prediction module, a real-time monitoring and fault diagnosis module, a decision support and optimization module and a user interface module; the periodic digital twin auxiliary management platform for photovoltaic construction provided by the invention has the advantages that the construction and operation management level of a photovoltaic power station is obviously improved, the omnibearing management from data acquisition, modeling, prediction, monitoring and diagnosis to decision optimization of the photovoltaic power station is realized, and the accuracy, the intelligence and the reliability of the system are obviously improved.
assignees: HUATIAN POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster emergency simulation method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood disaster management, in particular to a digital twinning-based flood disaster emergency simulation method and system, comprising the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing, namely acquiring environmental data related to a flood disaster in real time; the method comprises the steps of S2, establishing a digital twin model of a flood disaster area, S3, simulating calculation, S4, optimizing a flood propagation path, identifying a mode and abnormality, S5, establishing an emergency plan by combining history flood disaster coping experience, S6, evaluating and improving, after flood disaster emergency response is finished, evaluating the execution effect of the emergency plan, summarizing experience teaching training, and optimizing the digital twin model and the emergency plan. The invention realizes accurate prediction and high-effect response to flood disasters.

title_en: Modeling method, device and equipment for digital twin tailing pond
abstract_en: The application discloses a modeling method, a device and equipment for a digital twin tailing pond, relates to the technical field of intelligent management and control of tailing ponds, and aims to realize the fine analysis of dam stability by carrying out fine flood simulation on the change process of Hong Shuiku water levels through a digital twin model of the tailing pond so as to ensure the safe operation of the tailing pond. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of the tailing pond, wherein the digital twin model of the tailing pond comprises a flood prediction early warning sub-model, a tailing dam stability simulation sub-model and a dam break simulation sub-model, carrying out different-time stability analysis on the tailing dam by using the tailing dam stability simulation sub-model according to the state parameters of the tailing pond in different time states, carrying out flood prediction by using the flood prediction early warning sub-model according to the predicted rainfall of weather prediction, and judging whether the predicted flood reaches the overtopping dam break condition, and if so, predicting the flood disaster influence condition of the downstream of the tailing pond by using the dam break simulation sub-model.
assignees: CHINA ENFI ENG CORP;CHINA NONFERROUS ENG CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent monitoring method and system for coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for a coal-fired power plant based on digital twinning, wherein the system comprises a coal-fired unit entity equipment layer, a coal-fired unit monitoring data transmission layer, a coal-fired unit monitoring data processing layer, a twinning model layer and a monitoring application layer, wherein the twinning model layer optimizes an LSSVM state prediction model by adopting a FWA parameter optimizing algorithm, so that the accuracy and precision of the LSSVM state prediction model are further improved, the automatic tracking of the running state of coal-fired unit equipment is realized, and the aim of monitoring and early warning the coal-fired unit equipment is fulfilled; the monitoring panel application layer can be used for macroscopic display of abnormal events of the coal-fired unit and automatic tracking of development trend, monitoring and early warning of vibration of a turbine of the coal-fired unit, monitoring and early warning of running state of a fan and monitoring and early warning of turn-to-turn short circuit of a rotor are realized, running state of equipment of the coal-fired unit can be mastered in real time, and equipment fault precursors can be found out in time and processed in time.
assignees: JIANGXI DATANG INT XINYU SECOND POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-based remote substation equipment overhaul and maintenance method, device and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a overhaul and maintenance method, a device and a medium based on digital twin remote power transformation equipment, which comprise the steps of obtaining data source integration information, generating real-time data of the power transformation equipment according to the data source integration information, obtaining real-time power transformation equipment operation condition information from the real-time data of the power transformation equipment, obtaining digital twin technology, wherein the digital twin technology is used for processing the power transformation equipment to generate virtual simulation environment information, generating real-time monitoring information of the power transformation equipment according to the virtual simulation environment information and the real-time power transformation equipment operation condition information, generating automatic repair and adjustment information according to the real-time monitoring information of the power transformation equipment, and obtaining fault diagnosis robot work information from the automatic repair and adjustment information. The application has the effect of improving the integration of the digital twin technology control power transformation equipment and the robot diagnosis equipment.
assignees: SHENZHEN MINGZE INTELLIGENT ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent decision management method for power grid load
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent decision management method of power grid load, which belongs to the field of intelligent power grids, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out digital twin modeling according to a power grid side, determining corresponding load lines when a plurality of concurrent load management requests are received by the power grid twin model, carrying out overlapping analysis on the plurality of load lines based on the power grid twin model, fitting the plurality of identification load lines to obtain a fitted load line network, determining a power load control device for carrying out power grid load adjustment, determining a load tolerance section according to the power load control device, inputting the load tolerance section into an intelligent path decision model, carrying out optimizing in the load line network, and carrying out load adjustment on the load line network according to an optimizing line by the power load control device. The method solves the technical problems of low power grid operation efficiency and insufficient stability caused by low power grid load management response speed, low prediction precision and limited adjustment capability in the prior art.

title_en: Digital twinning-based three-dimensional visual panoramic monitoring method and system for power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based three-dimensional visual panoramic monitoring method and a digital twinning-based three-dimensional visual panoramic monitoring system for a power transmission line. According to the method, three-dimensional data are generated by utilizing laser point cloud and oblique photography, noise and cluster analysis processing is carried out on the generated data, and then data of a power grid resource service center station are filled, so that a three-dimensional visual transmission line digital twin model is generated. The information, the image video, the on-line monitoring device and other operation and inspection data of the tower can be directly checked by clicking the line tower on the three-dimensional map. The invention can construct professional application scenes, realize the fine management and control of equipment, strengthen the visual scene simulation of the operation site, further improve the management and control level of the equipment, improve the monitoring capability of the power transmission line and greatly reduce the inspection cost of the power transmission line.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-driven power grid load transfer control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-driven power grid load transfer control method and device, and relates to the technical field of power systems and automation thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing load transfer demand characteristics of a target power grid, searching a collaborative transfer power grid; the method comprises the steps of collecting physical distribution and operation data of a target power grid and a collaborative transfer power grid, constructing a power grid twin model capable of reflecting an actual operation state based on a digital twin technology, establishing a model for connecting the target power grid and the collaborative transfer power grid by a data sharing mechanism, obtaining a predicted load, carrying out overload judgment on the predicted load of the target power grid, taking the overload load as a target, optimizing a load transfer strategy according to the predicted load of the collaborative transfer power grid, and obtaining a control strategy to realize overload load transfer. The method solves the technical problems that the prior art lacks of fine analysis of the load of the power grid, load transfer cannot be performed in time, and the running state of the power grid is affected, and achieves the technical effects of improving the running performance and economic and social benefits of the power grid.

title_en: Intelligent building scheduling algorithm, storage medium and equipment based on incremental reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent building scheduling algorithm, a system and a medium based on incremental reinforcement learning, wherein the method firstly uses a directed acyclic graph to model a task, and uses part of the change of a DAG structure to reflect the change of the task; secondly, a deep structure and dynamic characteristics of a graph neural network learning DAG are introduced, and real-time updated dependency relationship information is provided for task scheduling; finally, in the face of a dynamically changing environment, incremental learning and deep reinforcement learning are combined, real-time change of the environment and dynamic change of a dependent task are quickly self-adapted, an optimal scheduling decision is made by adjusting on an original scheduling strategy, and multi-objective optimization is realized while energy consumption is reduced.
assignees: UNIV SUZHOU SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Simulation calculation model construction, simulation evaluation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation calculation model construction and simulation evaluation method, a system, equipment and a medium, comprising the following steps: based on the obtained structure association information of each power grid facility in the region, constructing a digital twin model for connecting each power grid facility in series; establishing association between the disaster damage limit value of each power grid facility in the obtained region and the corresponding power grid facility in the digital twin model to obtain a disaster informatization model of the power grid facility in the region; performing grid subdivision on the disaster informatization model by using a finite element analysis method to form different grid units, so as to obtain a simulation calculation model of the power grid facilities in the region; according to the invention, the risk level of the power grid facility disaster is subjected to simulation evaluation by using the pre-established simulation calculation model, and the regional power grid facilities are taken as an integral evaluation unit, so that the relevance among various facilities in the regional power grid is improved, and the accuracy of the simulation evaluation result of the power grid facility disaster in the region can be improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Digital twin model construction method for dynamic security assessment and decision of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin model construction method for dynamic security assessment and decision of a power grid, belonging to the field of control of power systems, the method constructs a digital twin model for dynamic security assessment and decision of the power grid based on a five-dimensional framework comprising a physical entity, a virtual entity, twin data, connection and service, and expands the digital twin application of the power grid by utilizing the service dimension. When the power system of the round is running, data of several rounds in the future can be run in advance through the physical information neural network model, simulation results are output to dynamic safety evaluation and decision service, and finally safety analysis results are output. According to the safety analysis result, a power system regulator can take measures in advance to conduct risk management, potential safety hazards are reduced, the power grid fault handling and safety risk prediction capabilities are improved, and guidance is provided for power grid safe operation.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Intelligent pricing method and optimizing system for electric vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric vehicle charging, and particularly relates to an intelligent pricing method and an optimization system for an electric vehicle. The method comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition: acquiring data of a commercial power time-of-use electricity price and surrounding charging stations; s2, data processing: the captured data is transmitted to a central processing unit of the system for data processing; s3, data cleaning: performing data cleaning on the read data, including processing repeated data, processing missing data, checking abnormal values and the like, so as to ensure the integrity and accuracy of the data; s4, carrying out nonlinear programming modeling by adopting a genetic algorithm; s5, controlling the charging speed and the charging time of the charging facility to determine the actual charging cost. The pricing method in the invention helps the newly built charging station to determine the charging price by utilizing the time-of-use electricity price of the commercial power and the data around the charging station, so as to provide more economical and reasonable charging options, optimize the operation of the charging station, attract users and provide better charging experience of the electric vehicle.
assignees: SHANDONG HUIZE YUANXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network accident prediction method, device, system, equipment and medium combining microclimate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network accident prediction method, device, system, equipment and medium combining microclimate, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring microclimate data of a power distribution network, wherein the microclimate data are real-time weather data of an environment where the power distribution network is located; calculating weather change data based on the microclimate data, wherein the weather change data is a weather change value of an environment where the power distribution network is located in a preset time; and carrying out accident prediction on the meteorological change data input value in a preset digital twin scene to obtain a prediction result, wherein the preset digital twin scene is a scene generated by using equipment of a power distribution network and surrounding environment objects after modeling. According to the method, the future weather can be predicted according to the real-time microclimate data, the accident prediction is carried out in a digital twin scene according to the predicted future weather, the actual situation of the power distribution network can be attached, the prediction accuracy is improved, the delay is reduced, and the prompt is carried out in time, so that the prediction timeliness is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault prediction method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault prediction method based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: a digital twin model of a target power distribution network is called to obtain a plurality of fault update records; performing explicit index feature extraction on the plurality of fault update records to obtain a plurality of explicit index feature sets; performing similar fault aggregation, and performing attenuation accumulation analysis to generate K aggregate explicit index sets and K aggregate explicit index attenuation factor sets; performing device implicit association identification to obtain K implicit index sets, constructing a mapping relation, and generating an explicit-implicit index feature mapping relation; acquiring a real-time explicit index set and a real-time explicit index feature set; and carrying out real-time fault prediction on the target power distribution network to obtain a fault prediction result. The technical problems that in the prior art, the power distribution network fault prediction is inaccurate and timely are solved, and the technical effects of improving the accuracy and instantaneity of the power distribution network fault prediction are achieved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating power by using photovoltaic module model under actual irradiation, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: A method for calculating power by using a photovoltaic module model under actual irradiation comprises the following steps: step 1, determining a photovoltaic cell voltammetry curve of the solar photovoltaic cell, wherein the voltammetry curve is obtained by the following formula:  . The technical problem to be solved by the invention is to provide a method, a storage medium and an electronic device for calculating power by utilizing a photovoltaic module model under actual irradiation, when photovoltaic power prediction is carried out, based on photovoltaic power generation data and irradiance data in a historical period, retraining is carried out on a photovoltaic prediction model trained in advance, model parameters are updated, an updated photovoltaic prediction model is obtained, real-time update of the photovoltaic prediction model is realized, and photovoltaic prediction is carried out by using the updated photovoltaic prediction model, so that the influence of factors such as photovoltaic use conditions, weather mutation and the like is avoided, and real-time accurate prediction of photovoltaic power generation power is realized.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Supply tracking and monitoring system based on electric power material characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supply tracking and monitoring system based on electric power material characteristics, which comprises an electric power material warehouse production operation management unit, a park operation management unit, an intelligent storage control unit and a mobile application unit; the electric power material warehouse production operation management unit is used for responding to supply demands, improving material supply quality, analyzing material supply modes, business coordination and business overall process monitoring; the park operation management unit integrates the Internet of things perceived data resources by constructing an intelligent park platform and adopting an integrated bus and digital twin technology; the intelligent storage control unit is used for receiving tasks issued by the ERP system, and performing task decomposition and task scheduling locally in the warehouse. The monitoring system is provided with the production auxiliary management module and the business archiving management module for carrying out the adjustment of the receiving plan, so that the allocation of the electric power materials can be more accurately completed, and the whole electric power material allocation management operation is more convenient and accurate.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin system applied to operation management of urban-level virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin system applied to operation management of an urban virtual power plant, relates to the technical field of virtual power plant management, and solves the technical problem that in the prior art, the urban is not partitioned, so that the power resource distribution is unreasonable; the method collects and preprocesses power generation data of a power plant, historical power utilization data of a city and environmental data; constructing a virtual power plant twin model based on standard power generation data; according to the standard electricity consumption data and the standard environment data, predicting and acquiring predicted industrial electricity consumption data, predicted electric pile data and predicted domestic electricity consumption data, dividing the area in the city into an industrial area, a resident area and a charging pile area; the industrial area electricity sequence, the resident electricity sequence and the charging pile electricity sequence are input into a virtual power plant twin model to obtain a power plant power supply plan capable of reasonably supplying urban electricity, so that the energy utilization rate is improved, and the dynamic optimization distribution of power resources is realized.
assignees: HEFEI YUANLI ZHONGHE ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tou revenue calculation unit, and intelligent management system for photovoltaic tou mode
abstract_en: The present invention is applied to the field of photovoltaics and relates to a TOU revenue calculation unit, and an intelligent management system for a photovoltaic TOU mode. TOU control is performed on a photovoltaic power station according to configured TOU configuration information data. The TOU revenue calculation unit comprises a photovoltaic energy storage system model and a revenue management module, wherein the photovoltaic energy storage system model is formed according to a structural digital twin of the photovoltaic power station; and the photovoltaic energy storage system model simulates the work of the photovoltaic power station in a TOU working mode, and the revenue management module calculates TOU revenue of the photovoltaic power station in the TOU working mode. By means of the intelligent management system for a photovoltaic TOU mode that is provided with a TOU revenue calculation unit, when TOU configuration information data is adjusted, a corresponding TOU revenue calculation can be performed, such that the requirements of a user for autonomous TOU configuration can be better met; and the TOU setting and adjustment process is simple and efficient, such that the technical threshold for an operating user in photovoltaic energy management can be reduced, the user experience can be improved, and the management of a photovoltaic power station can be better realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI SIGEYUAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent interactive monitoring and early warning system for geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses an intelligent interactive monitoring and early warning system for geological disasters, which comprises the following components: the multi-source data fusion and enhancement module is used for fusing data of various data sources; the edge computing module is connected with the multi-source data fusion and enhancement module and is used for carrying out preliminary data processing and analysis at the front end of data acquisition; the digital twin geological model module is connected with the edge calculation module and is used for creating a digital twin geological model of the monitoring area and simulating and predicting the evolution process of geological disasters; and the blockchain data trusted management module is connected with the edge calculation module and is used for ensuring the authenticity and the non-tamper property of the geological disaster monitoring data. Through fusing a plurality of data sources such as satellite remote sensing, unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography, ground sensors, social media and the like, the data are enhanced and processed by adopting a machine learning algorithm, and the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the data are obviously improved.
assignees: SICHUAN TIANFU NEW AREA INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE SOUTHWEST UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Electric power construction engineering supervision and management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supervision and management system and method for electric power construction engineering, which relates to the technical field of electric power construction, wherein the system monitors comprehensive electric equipment and turbines of a hydroelectric power station in real time through an equipment detection module, a digital twin model is constructed through a digital twin module, the fusion enables the system to timely capture the changes of the turbines and the comprehensive electric equipment, real-time data of the turbines and the comprehensive electric equipment are displayed in real time through a visual platform, when the inspection and acceptance are carried out, the operation conditions and various parameters of the turbine and the comprehensive electrical equipment of the hydroelectric power station are observed in real time only according to the digital twin visual platform, the scene is not required to be reached, the inspection and acceptance are detected in the field, and meanwhile, after the inspection and acceptance of the turbine and the comprehensive electrical equipment are carried out by the digital twin visual platform, the digital twin visual platform provides more convenient and detailed parameter information when the equipment is operated and maintained by workers in the future.
assignees: SHANDONG CHENGXIN ENG CONSTRUCTION SUPERVISION CO LTD

title_en: Plant-level multi-unit scheduling and control method comprising digital twin and boundary condition quantization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plant-level multi-unit scheduling and controlling method with digital twin and boundary condition quantification, which comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of a plurality of units of the thermal power plant; performing dynamic boundary condition quantification of factory-level optimized scheduling; establishing a plant-level multi-unit multi-mode coal consumption prediction model; optimizing the operation combination mode of the plant-level multi-unit by taking the minimum coal consumption of the plant-level multi-unit as a target; on the basis of an optimal operation combination mode of multiple units and according to a quantification result of dynamic boundary conditions, a plant-level multiple unit optimal scheduling model is established by taking plant-level economy, environmental protection and quick response as targets under the condition of meeting the dynamic balance of electric load scheduling instructions and heat supply network supply and demand; on the basis of an optimal scheduling strategy of the multi-unit load, setting a multi-unit load control target, and establishing a device-level optimal control model according to the multi-unit load control target and the data index monitored in real time to obtain operation control parameters of each device at the plant level.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for improving digital twin mapping precision in power distribution network based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for improving digital twin mapping precision in a power distribution network based on GIS, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining geographic information data of a power distribution network by using a GIS system, and collecting operation data of the power distribution network in real time by using a sensor and intelligent equipment installed on site; according to the geographic information data, establishing a topological relation of the power distribution network in a digital twin platform, constructing a digital twin model, integrating operation data of the power distribution network into the digital twin model, and realizing real-time mapping of a physical space and a virtual space; the digital twin model corresponds to lines and equipment in the power distribution network one by one; and correlating the geographic information data in the GIS system with the operation data in the digital twin model to realize real-time synchronous updating of the geographic information data and the operation data. The invention realizes accurate mapping of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin management system for pumped storage power station engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin management system for a pumped storage power station engineering, which comprises the steps of carrying out data modeling on functional modules in the pumped storage power station, adding an independent data acquisition unit in all the functional modules, and providing real-time data for a modeled data model according to the data acquisition unit; after data cleaning is carried out on the data model, a digital twin model is built, the digital twin model is synchronously associated with a functional module of the pumped storage power station, and a module early warning interval is built in the digital twin model; after the synchronous association between the digital twin model and any functional module is closed, the data of the functional module in the digital twin model is adjusted to form the variable parameters of the non-adjusted modules in the digital twin model, and all the functional modules are debugged one by one in sequence; and adjusting a module early warning interval according to a debugging result, adding a relevancy parameter into the interval, and then presetting a standard data suggestion curve in the digital twin model.
assignees: SHANDONG BENLIU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional data visualization method for substation maintenance operation site based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional data visualization method of a power transformation overhaul operation site based on digital twinning, which belongs to the technical field of power transformation overhaul and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting real-time building data, real-time equipment data and real-time environment data of the power transformation overhaul operation site, determining the real-time multi-dimensional data based on the power transformation overhaul operation site, S2, preprocessing the real-time multi-dimensional data based on the power transformation overhaul operation site, determining characteristic multi-dimensional data based on the power transformation overhaul operation site, and S3, constructing a digital twinning model based on the power transformation overhaul operation site. The invention solves the problems that the prior multi-dimensional data of the power transformation overhaul operation site cannot be visually displayed and the multi-dimensional data condition of the power transformation overhaul operation site cannot be mastered in time, so that the power transformation overhaul effect is poor.

title_en: Timing sequence prediction reinforcement learning detection method for smart grid hidden attack
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic digital data processing, and particularly relates to a timing prediction reinforcement learning detection method for smart grid hidden attack. The intelligent power grid hidden attack detection method comprises the steps of firstly modeling an intelligent power grid to obtain instrument measurement data and preprocessing the data, secondly taking the preprocessed data as input of a long-period memory network to perform state estimation on the intelligent power grid, then modeling an attack detection problem in the intelligent power grid as a part of observable Markov decision problem, and finally solving the part of observable Markov decision problem by using a reinforcement learning method to realize intelligent power grid hidden attack detection. The invention can detect hidden attacks in the smart grid with lower delay and false detection rate.

title_en: Digital twinning-based large-scale electric heating load participating power distribution network planning method
abstract_en: A digital twinning-based large-scale electric heating load participating power distribution network planning method belongs to the technical field of power distribution network planning. The invention provides a digital twin frame of a power distribution network system with large-scale electric heating loads, and related research is carried out in a virtual twin body by carrying out re-engraving on an entity power distribution network, so that a research foundation is provided for subsequent power distribution network planning work. The invention introduces the characteristic that the distributed electric heating load has flexibility, controls the power consumption by adjusting the on-off state of the electric heating load group, is used for flexible resources on the demand side in the power grid planning work, and digs the adjustment potential of the distributed electric heating load group; thirdly, constructing a digital twin planning model of the electric heating distribution network with large scale by combining the adjustment capability of the electric heating load by polymerizing power with the original network parameters of the distribution network; finally, experimental simulation verifies that the method can obtain better economic benefit, and improves the new energy consumption rate and peak clipping and valley filling to a certain extent.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION COMMUNICATION COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent diagnosis system of power generation system based on big intelligent multi-fusion cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cloud platform comprehensive diagnosis systems, in particular to an intelligent diagnosis system of a power generation system based on a large intelligent multi-fusion cloud platform, which aims to realize comprehensive monitoring and intelligent management of power plant equipment through functional modules such as comprehensive display, equipment health evaluation, intelligent early warning, fault diagnosis and the like. The system utilizes advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithm, combines the professional knowledge and historical data of the power plant, constructs a high-fidelity digital twin model, monitors and analyzes the running state of the equipment in real time, provides accurate early warning and fault diagnosis information, helps management personnel to discover and process equipment faults in time, reduces the equipment fault rate, and improves the running efficiency and economic benefit of the power plant. The method can also carry out deep analysis on the operation data of the equipment, provide scientific decision support, help management personnel optimize the operation and maintenance strategies of the equipment, prolong the service life of the equipment, reduce the maintenance cost and realize the intellectualization and high efficiency of the equipment management of the power plant.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA DABAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network management method and system combined with electric energy exchange model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network transportation and management method and system combined with an electric energy exchange model, which relate to the technical field of power systems and comprise the following steps: generating a plurality of power nodes by analyzing the power system; performing node association on a plurality of power nodes, and drawing a power network topological graph; based on a digital twin technology, traversing a power network topological graph to construct an electric energy exchange model; performing real-time operation monitoring on the target power distribution network according to the electric energy exchange model, and determining a real-time monitoring data set; formulating a monitoring management scheme according to the real-time monitoring data set and the target power distribution network; and adopting a monitoring management scheme to perform intelligent operation management on the target power distribution network. The invention solves the technical problem that the running state and performance of the power system cannot be accurately reflected in the prior art, and achieves the technical effect of improving the efficiency and accuracy of power system management and running.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Distributed energy intelligent regulation and control method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed energy intelligent regulation and control method and system based on digital twin, and relates to the technical field of power grid regulation and control, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out twin simulation framework fusion on the distributed energy distribution attribute data and the distributed energy electricity data set by utilizing a digital twin technology, and constructing a plurality of distributed energy digital twin bodies; performing power supply task decomposition based on the distributed energy distribution attribute data and the external environment factor data, and determining distributed energy power supply parameters; and performing simulation on the distributed energy power supply parameters by utilizing a plurality of distributed energy digital twin bodies to obtain a distributed energy simulation power supply effect, and performing closed-loop optimization regulation and control on the distributed energy power supply parameters. The method achieves the technical effects of realizing the topological fusion construction of the digital twin model of the distributed energy, improving the model construction precision and construction efficiency, realizing reasonable decomposition regulation and control of the energy power supply task through the digital twin body of the distributed energy, and further improving the accuracy of the power supply regulation and control of the distributed energy.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: AVC (automatic Voltage control) regulating method based on reactive power balance of multiple substations
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AVC (automatic Voltage control) regulating method based on reactive power balance of multiple substations, which relates to the field of control of electric power systems and comprises the steps of receiving data of each substation through a central control unit and extracting feature vectors of the current voltage level, current condition and power factor of a power grid; based on the feature vector, integrating historical data to construct a digital twin model prediction electric parameter; each substation implements reactive power balance operation according to the optimal reactive power compensation strategy issued by the central control unit, and feeds back voltage change and reactive power flow data conditions to the central control unit in real time; and the self-learning mechanism is integrated, and the control algorithm and the model parameters are continuously adjusted and optimized according to the voltage change and reactive power flow data conditions fed back in real time. According to the invention, through the highly intelligent and self-adaptive AVC regulation strategy, the fine management of reactive power balance of multiple substations is realized, the response speed and control precision of the system are obviously improved, and a powerful technical support is provided for the efficient and stable operation of a modern power grid.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG FUJIANG HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Operation scheduling optimization method and system for energy storage power station based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides an operation scheduling optimization method and system of an energy storage power station based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of scheduling optimization and comprise the steps of decomposing the energy storage power station into four standard sub-models of a battery, a converter, energy management and environment, simplifying, collecting operation data, extracting typical working conditions, searching optimal parameter combinations, updating the standard sub-models, and carrying out integration and dynamic decoupling to obtain a digital twinning model; establishing a domain knowledge ontology, semantically associating a quantization index with an ontology concept, collecting engineering data to generate classical working condition data, converting the classical working condition data into semantic rules, adding the semantic rules into an initial knowledge base, determining novel association rules to obtain a health state assessment knowledge base, fusing to obtain a mixed intelligent body, mixing an enhanced learning model, establishing an environment model and an intelligent body model, performing interaction and online diagnosis to obtain an initial diagnosis result, optimizing the mixed enhanced learning model to generate an optimal scheduling strategy, and fusing to obtain a collaborative optimization scheduling scheme.

title_en: Pseudo measurement data generation method, device and medium based on countermeasure generation network and depth residual error network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pseudo measurement data of nodes of a power distribution network, and discloses a pseudo measurement data generation method, pseudo measurement data generation equipment and pseudo measurement data generation medium based on an countermeasure generation network and a depth residual error network, so as to realize power distribution network state estimation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical marketing data of each ammeter in power distribution network And preset random noise Training an countermeasure generation network; acquiring a preset multidimensional noise generation power sample set, inputting the power sample set into a countermeasure generation network after training to obtain a power sample set of nodes of the power distribution network; acquiring topological structure data of a power distribution network, and carrying out power flow calculation of the power distribution network by combining a power sample set of power grid nodes to obtain a training sample set and training a depth residual error network, so as to obtain trained depth residual error networks which respectively correspond to all real-time measurement nodes of the power distribution network; and acquiring real-time measurement values of all real-time measurement nodes in the power distribution network to output pseudo-measurement injection power of all non-real-time measurement nodes. The invention improves the generation accuracy of the pseudo measurement data.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Toad disaster management system based on digital twin using edge ai camera and method thereof
title_ko: 엣지 인공지능 카메라를 이용한 디지털 트윈 기반의 도로 재난 관리 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for managing a road disaster based on a digital twin using an edge artificial intelligence camera. The system of the present invention comprises a plurality of edge artificial intelligence cameras and a control server. The edge artificial intelligence cameras include a plurality of group network cameras separated from each other at constant intervals. Each of the edge artificial intelligence cameras acquires, analyzes, and recognizes an image of an object on a road based on artificial intelligence, detects an event occurrence situation of the road for the object, calculates attribute information on the object and location information on the object, and shares the object information between adjacent other group network cameras to determine the same object. The control server determines an event occurrence situation for the object, displays the event occurrence situation on a road as the digital twin, monitors and checks the same to rapidly take a measure and manage the event occurrence situation. According to the present invention, a road situation is detected by using an edge artificial intelligence camera, and an event occurrence situation is displayed when an event occurs by using a digital twin, such that an accurate position can be recognized and a measure can be taken.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 엣지 인공지능 카메라를 이용한 디지털 트윈 기반의 도로 재난 관리 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 도로 재난 관리 시스템은 복수 개의 엣지 인공지능 카메라와 관제 서버를 포함한다. 엣지 인공지능 카메라들은 일정 간격 이격되는 복수 개의 그룹 네트워크 카메라로 구성한다. 엣지 인공지능 카메라들 각각은 인공지능 기반으로 도로에서의 객체에 대한 영상을 획득, 분석 및 인식하고, 객체에 대한 도로의 이벤트 발생 상황을 감지하여 객체의 속성 정보와 객체의 위치 정보를 산출하여 인접하는 다른 그룹 네트워크 카메라들 간에 객체 정보를 상호 공유하여 동일한 객체를 판별한다. 관제 서버는 객체에 대한 이벤트 발생 상황을 판별하고, 도로에서의 이벤트 발생 상황을 디지털 트윈으로 표시, 모니터링 및 확인하여 이벤트 발생 상황을 신속하게 조치 및 관리할 수 있도록 처리한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 엣지 인공지능 카메라를 이용하여 도로 상황을 감지하여 이벤트 발생 상황 시, 디지털 트윈을 이용하여 이벤트 발생 상황을 표시하여 정확한 위치와 조치가 가능하게 한다.
assignees: SHINHWA NETWORKS CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin prevention method and system for geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin prevention method and a digital twin prevention system for geological disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an information perception network; the method comprises the steps of establishing a basic database, constructing an accumulated displacement prediction model, predicting the change trend and the maximum accumulated displacement of a geological disaster point, decomposing the accumulated displacement to obtain an accumulated displacement prediction result, constructing a multi-factor early warning model, calculating and pushing early warning grades in real time, judging the safety state of the geological disaster point, simulating the stable state and the deformation evolution trend of the geological disaster point under different working conditions, and pushing a geological disaster safety prevention and control scheme. The system comprises a monitoring sensing, predicting, early warning, previewing and planning module. The invention is based on digital twin technology, realizes on-line monitoring of ground disasters, predicts the development change of ground disasters in advance, early warns and pushes early warning information in time, previews simulated ground disaster deformation damage trend in real time and automatically pushes ground disaster plan response measures, can effectively improve the intelligent level of geological disaster prevention, and meets the requirements of intelligent prevention and management of geological disasters.

title_en: CAVE rescue scene construction method and system adopting digital twin and holographic technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster relief, and discloses a CAVE relief scene construction method of digital twin and holographic technology, which comprises the following steps: digital twin technology, 3D real-time rendering technology, holographic technology, cave virtual reality technology, real-time collaboration module, S1, digital twin technology: this is a technique that builds a digital simulation in an informationized platform by integrating physical feedback data, aided by artificial intelligence, machine learning, and software analysis, which simulation is updated as physical entities change according to feedback to ensure that the virtual model matches the real world counterpart. According to the CAVE rescue scene construction method and system based on the digital twin and holographic technology, through integrating the digital twin, real-time rendering and holographic Cave technology, not only are the disaster rescue efficiency and safety improved, but also the immersion sense and interactivity are enhanced, so that the disaster rescue training and exercise are more scientific, efficient and real.
assignees: NANFANG HOSPITAL

title_en: Active power distribution network PMU optimal configuration method considering weak node monitoring requirement
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active power distribution network PMU optimal configuration method considering weak node monitoring requirements, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring measurement data information of each node of a power distribution network; s2, aiming at the difference of voltage monitoring requirements of all nodes of the active power distribution network, selecting an optimal configuration point of the PMU by a method of weighting voltage offset on the basis of voltage sensitivity; s3, based on the principle of economy, the overall state estimation precision of the power distribution network is ensured to be optimal, and meanwhile, the overall state estimation precision of the power distribution network is configured at the node with higher monitoring requirements as much as possible, and a PMU multi-objective optimization configuration model considering the node voltage comprehensive sensitivity, the state estimation error and the configuration cost is established; s4, adopting an improved multi-objective gray wolf algorithm to solve an optimal configuration scheme for PMU configuration models in different scenes. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of accurately sensing and reinforcing monitoring the weak node of the system voltage.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Online estimation method, system and equipment for inertial center frequency of power system
abstract_en: The application discloses an inertial center frequency online estimation method, an inertial center frequency online estimation system and inertial center frequency online estimation equipment for an electric power system, and relates to the field of state monitoring of the electric power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a dynamic state estimation model of a power system, and initializing state variables of the power system; acquiring operation data of the power system in real time based on a dynamic state estimation model of the power system in a preset estimation period; based on a dynamic state estimation model of the power system, according to the operation data of the power system at each moment in an estimation period, adopting a volume Kalman filtering algorithm based on square root to predict and update the state of the power system; and determining the inertia center frequency of the power system according to the state prediction result of the power system at the last moment in the estimated period. The application improves the operation speed, precision and numerical stability of the inertial center frequency of the power system.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power distribution network PMU (power management unit) optimal configuration method based on precision analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network PMU optimal configuration method based on precision analysis, which comprises the following steps: 1. establishing a power distribution network model, and eliminating constraint conditions of nodes connected with zero power nodes only to obtain a simplified power distribution network model; 2. solving the simplified power distribution network model based on a 0-1 integer programming algorithm to obtain the optimal distribution number and all distribution schemes meeting observability; 3. the number of outgoing lines of nodes in the simplified power distribution network model is considered, a redundancy measurement index R is constructed, and a plurality of point distribution schemes with the maximum redundancy in all point distribution schemes are selected; 4, carrying out power distribution network state estimation on measurement data of the PMU device based on a plurality of point distribution schemes with the maximum redundancy; 5. and (3) carrying out precision analysis on the state estimation result of each point distribution scheme, and selecting an optimal point distribution scheme. The PMU configuration scheme with the highest power distribution network state estimation precision can be obtained by configuring the minimum number of PMU devices and restricting the PMU devices by various indexes.
assignees: HEFEI COMPREHENSIVE NATIONAL SCIENCE CENTER ENERGY RES INSTITUTE ANHUI ENERGY LABORATORY;UNIV HEFEI;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Wind farm disaster emergency system and method based on image recognition and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power plant disaster emergency system based on image recognition and unmanned aerial vehicles, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, wherein edge computing nodes are connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster data, the edge computing nodes are arranged on unmanned aerial vehicles of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, ground control stations are connected with the edge computing nodes data, and cloud computing platforms are connected with the ground control stations data. The system senses the state of the fan through multi-source heterogeneous data, intelligent analysis is realized by cloud edge cooperation, and an interpretable decision is generated by utilizing a knowledge graph and digital twinning; the invention also discloses a wind farm disaster emergency method based on image recognition, which comprises the steps of preprocessing based on the acquired real-time state data of the fan to obtain the real-time state data; constructing a real-time fault model based on the fan damage detection data and the acquired historical fault data of the wind turbine; analyzing the real-time fault model, making a disaster emergency plan, and developing emergency repair.
assignees: HUANENG HEZHANG WIND POWER CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Power distribution network fault self-healing and unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous inspection system based on digital twin
abstract_en: Power distribution network fault self-healing and unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous inspection system based on digital twinning comprises the following components: the system comprises a digital twin model construction module, a fault self-healing module, an unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous patrol module and a system interaction and decision support module; the distribution network fault self-healing and unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous patrol system based on digital twinning meets the following requirements: unmanned aerial vehicle in unmanned aerial vehicle independently patrols and examines the module will patrol and examine data transmission to data processing unit through wireless communication technology, and data processing unit adopts image recognition, data analysis method to patrol and examine data and handle and analyze. The invention has the following advantages: the fault self-healing speed is high, the inspection efficiency is high, the intelligent decision support function is provided, the optimal operation and maintenance strategy and suggestion can be given according to the user demands and the actual condition of the power distribution network, and the intelligent level of operation and maintenance is improved.
assignees: YINGKOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid inspection optimization method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twin-based power grid inspection optimization method and system, which relate to the technical field of data processing, acquire temperature information of a normal position in a target power grid through a sensor array to obtain a missing temperature information array and the missing position, conduct inspection data accuracy analysis to obtain overall accuracy, conduct complementary optimization on the temperature information of the missing position to obtain a temperature information array, conduct dimension reduction optimization on the temperature information array according to the overall accuracy to obtain an optimal dimension reduction proportion, conduct dimension reduction processing to obtain a dimension reduction temperature information array, and construct a temperature inspection twin-model of the target power grid based on digital twin to conduct inspection judgment, so that the technical problems that the data information of the power grid cannot be comprehensively monitored in real time, the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of inspection data are difficult to ensure are solved, the accuracy and the response speed of power grid data monitoring are improved, and the data processing efficiency and the intelligent level of inspection are effectively improved.

title_en: Cross-regional execution method and system based on dynamic library establishment of power enterprise
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-regional execution method and a system based on dynamic library establishment of an electric power enterprise, which relate to the technical field of intelligent electric power management and comprise the steps of establishing a unified office platform based on a modern internet technology, integrating electronic flow business through the office platform, automatically marking the document state of the dynamic library management platform, and carrying out secondary integration on the marked document state; and automatically matching the signature authority and the signature sequence of the document state after the secondary integration, and finishing the cross-region execution. The invention realizes high-efficiency management and real-time updating of data, reduces the access frequency to dynamic data sources, improves the system performance, automatically matches the signature authority and sequence of the document state after secondary integration, ensures the high efficiency and accuracy of cross-regional execution, effectively solves the problems of low data management efficiency and insufficient cross-regional execution flexibility in the prior art, and remarkably improves the office automation level and business processing efficiency of electric enterprises.
assignees: GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD HONGJIADU POWER PLANT

title_en: Power equipment fault early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based power equipment fault early warning method and system, and relates to the field of power. The method comprises the following steps: establishing data interaction with the power equipment, and acquiring operation data of the power equipment; mapping the operation data into a preset digital twin model; simulating based on the digital twin model to obtain real-time simulation data of the power equipment in a preset working time period; generating a real-time working curve graph based on real-time simulation data in a preset working time period; acquiring a standard curve graph based on historical operation data, and comparing a real-time working curve graph of the power equipment with the standard curve graph to acquire a difference value change; judging according to the difference value change and a set early warning threshold value, and acquiring abnormal parameters if the difference value change does not meet the early warning threshold value; and generating early warning information based on the abnormal parameters. The technical problem of the lower failure early warning efficiency in the prior art is solved, and the technical effect of timely early warning equipment failure is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Automatic detection method and system for loss of transmission tower components based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic detection method and system for loss of a power transmission tower component based on multi-source data, and relates to the technical field of power transmission tower detection. According to the invention, the structure of the iron tower is synchronously scanned in real time through a plurality of laser scanners and panoramic cameras, actual point cloud data and panoramic image data of the iron tower are obtained, a detailed view of the surface of the iron tower is provided, an actual point cloud model of the iron tower is created, and the actual point cloud model of the iron tower is imported into a spatial data model to be compared with an ideal point cloud model of the iron tower through an HBB algorithm, so that structural loss and damage of the iron tower are identified, and component loss data of the iron tower are obtained; the panoramic image of the rigid body component corresponding to the component missing data is found according to the synchronous coordinates, and secondary verification is carried out through a visible light identification algorithm, so that the tiny change and the missing of the iron tower structure can be accurately identified, a detailed analysis report is generated, the non-contact high-precision automatic detection of the power transmission iron tower structure is realized, and the detection speed and the safety are greatly improved.
assignees: JIANGSU XINGHU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid digital twin-based diversified storage method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-element storage method and system based on power grid digital twin, which relate to the technical field of power grid data storage and comprise the steps of optimizing azimuth elements of image data by adopting a self-adaptive beam adjustment method; preprocessing the power transmission line cloud data, and establishing a pole and tower independent coordinate scene in the power transmission line cloud data; and (3) completing the resolved dynamic mapping process, and constructing the diversified one-to-one storage of the power grid numbers. The invention realizes accurate positioning and real-time monitoring of the power grid data, solves the problems of data fragmentation and integration, enhances the system stability and response speed, not only improves the efficiency and precision of power grid management, but also lays a solid foundation for intelligent development of a power system, and effectively improves the reliability and safety of power supply.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon house damage risk prediction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a typhoon house damage risk prediction method, device, equipment and medium, which comprise the following steps: acquiring a typhoon event data set corresponding to a target area; identifying feature data of typhoon events occurring in a plurality of administrative areas based on the typhoon event data set, so as to construct a target sample data set according to the feature data; training the machine learning model by using the target sample data set to obtain a house damage risk prediction model, wherein the house damage risk prediction model is used for carrying out dynamic risk prediction on house damage conditions when typhoon events occur in a target area. The invention can realize the real-time updating and forecasting of the dynamic risk in the real-time disaster field evolution process.
assignees: NAT CLIMATE CENTRE;BEIJING HONGXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin deduction and dynamic visualization method for urban storm waterlogging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin deduction and dynamic visualization method for urban storm water logging, which comprises the following steps: integrating urban high-precision geospatial data, drainage facility data, underground space data and meteorological hydrologic data, and constructing a digital twin data platform; constructing a numerical model of coupling the one-dimensional drainage canal and the two-dimensional earth surface flood; driving dynamic simulation of a waterlogging process by utilizing rainfall forecast or rainfall monitoring data; based on the numerical simulation result and the digital twin data platform, the raindrop deduction analysis is realized. The numerical model for rainstorm and waterlogging constructed by the invention adopts diffusion wave approximation, realizes good balance of simulation precision and calculation efficiency, and can better meet the timeliness requirement of urban rainstorm simulation and forecasting. According to the invention, by utilizing weather forecast and an Internet of things sensing and digital twin technology, the dynamic distribution of urban flood depth is rapidly and accurately simulated, the dynamic deduction and visual display capability of urban flood are improved, and scientific basis is provided for urban flood risk management and early warning decision.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Method and device for repairing measurement data of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for repairing measurement data of a power distribution network, which can be applied to the technical field of power monitoring and the technical field of power data repair.
