The method comprises the following steps: under the condition that the missing data exists in the power distribution network measurement data set, determining the data type of the missing data and the data type of each of a plurality of measurement data in the power distribution network measurement data set; under the condition that the data types of the measurement data are different and only one missing data exists at the same monitoring time, determining first initial repair data of the missing data based on the measurement data and the electrical correlation function at the same monitoring time as the missing data; generating a power distribution network measurement data tensor based on the power distribution network measurement data set; performing tensor decomposition data restoration on the power distribution network measurement data tensor to obtain second initial restoration data matched with the missing data; and obtaining repair data matched with the missing data based on the first initial repair data and the second initial repair data.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power failure early warning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power failure early warning method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a digital twin body for the target area; carrying out multi-granularity scanning on the digital twin body to obtain first characteristic information of a target area; inputting the first characteristic information into the cascading forest model to obtain a first water immersion depth output by the cascading forest model; the cascade forest model is obtained by taking second characteristic information of a target area as a training sample and taking second water immersion depth of the target area as a training label through pre-training; and comparing the first water immersion depth with the rated water immersion depth of the power equipment in the target area so as to perform power failure early warning. According to the application, the possible water immersion depth of the power equipment can be rapidly and accurately judged according to the characteristic information of the digital twin body of the target area, and whether the power equipment has water immersion risk can be rapidly determined by comparing the water immersion depth with the rated water immersion depth, so that power failure early warning can be performed.
assignees: UNIV MACAU

title_en: Machine learning-based pot cover effect analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pot cover effect analysis method based on machine learning, which relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and is characterized in that a large amount of indoor and outdoor test data of the pot cover effect are collected, and a 'pot cover effect' digital twin model is established by using a physical mechanism and a machine learning method, and the time-space change rule of unsaturated soil moisture and temperature in the foundation is predicted. The invention adopts the pot cover effect analysis method based on machine learning, and can predict the time-space distribution change of the water content and the temperature of the soil body by collecting relevant test data and combining with physical mechanisms such as a water control equation, an energy control equation, a pot cover effect boundary condition and the like by combining with the machine learning method. The method simplifies the calculation, improves the prediction precision, and realizes the intellectualization of the digital twin of the unsaturated soil 'pot cover effect'. An effective early warning and predicting means is provided for engineering disasters induced by water vapor circulation or freeze thawing circulation caused by the pot cover effect.

title_en: Power plant equipment health management method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power plant equipment health management method based on digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of equipment management and comprises the following steps: connecting a power plant equipment management system to acquire power plant equipment information; combining a digital twin technology to perform three-dimensional simulation modeling to generate a twin model; collecting the operation parameters of the equipment in real time to obtain an operation parameter set; collecting real-time environmental data of a power plant; loading the equipment operation parameters and the real-time environment data into a twin model, and performing equipment simulation operation for a preset time period through the twin model; when the operation parameter triggering parameter early warning index is simulated, triggering early warning statistics is carried out to obtain triggering early warning times; and when the triggering early warning times are greater than the early warning threshold, carrying out abnormal identification on equipment corresponding to the triggering early warning times, and carrying out operation management. The invention solves the technical problems of incomplete data acquisition and inaccurate prediction in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the integrity of data acquisition and the accuracy of prediction.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic optimization scheduling method and system for flexible interconnection power distribution network
abstract_en: The dynamic optimal scheduling system of the flexible interconnection power distribution network is connected with a data acquisition and processing module, a state estimation and monitoring module, a load prediction module, an optimization and control module, a communication module, a user interface and visualization module and a safety and fault detection module, wherein the data acquisition and processing module is used for collecting, processing and preparing various data so that the system can perform tasks such as state estimation, load prediction, optimal control and monitoring. The invention can analyze and process a large amount of power system data in real time by utilizing technologies such as machine learning, an optimization algorithm, data analysis and the like through the data acquisition and processing module, can model and predict the behavior of the power system more accurately, and provides a more optimized scheduling strategy; the invention can find potential faults and potential safety hazards in time, and reduce a great deal of time for manual overhaul and thinking of countermeasures by implementing corresponding countermeasures.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Comprehensive energy service method and system based on distributed architecture
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive energy service method and system based on a distributed architecture, and relates to the technical field of energy, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving real-time working condition data of a plurality of distributed energy stations, wherein each distributed energy station is provided with distributed energy equipment and load equipment, inputting the real-time working condition data into a pre-established state estimation model, estimating the real-time running state of each distributed energy station, and generating state estimation data of the distributed energy station; based on the state estimation data, generating a collaborative optimization scheduling strategy of the distributed energy station and the power grid by using a multi-objective optimization algorithm and taking optimal demand response effect and power grid blocking management as optimization targets under the condition of meeting the real-time balance constraint of the power grid and the self operation constraint of the distributed energy station; and analyzing the collaborative optimization scheduling strategy into a control instruction, and respectively issuing the control instruction to the controllers of all the distributed energy stations and the power grid scheduling control center through an energy internet communication network.
assignees: CHANGZHOU RUIWU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hybrid neural network-based water-wind-solar power generation power joint prediction method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of power generation prediction, in particular to a water-wind-solar power generation power joint prediction method and device based on a hybrid neural network. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a multisource meteorological observation data set of a target area, obtaining a historical power generation data set of a water-wind-solar power station of the target area, building a GRU-CNN water-wind-solar power generation power combined prediction model according to the multisource meteorological observation data set and the historical power generation data set, training, obtaining meteorological prediction data of the target area in a time period to be predicted in real time, and transmitting the meteorological prediction data to the trained GRU-CNN water-wind-solar power generation power combined prediction model to predict power generation. According to the method, an initial field is improved through data assimilation, so that a numerical forecasting effect is improved, the space-time correlation and the load curve of the water-wind-light power generation power are fused, an improved GRU-CNN water-wind-light power generation power joint forecasting model is constructed, the water-wind-light power generation power joint forecasting is realized, and the accuracy of the water-wind-light power generation power forecasting is improved.

title_en: Smart instrumentation control system for water treatment facility
title_ko: 수처리시설용 스마트 계장계측제어 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a smart instrumentation measurement control system for a water treatment facility, which comprises: a water treatment facility composed of a raw sludge pump, a blower, a waste sludge pump, a flocculation and precipitant input pump, an external carbon source input pump, a chemical injection pump, a water supply pump, various valves, each actuator for controlling the various valves, various electric facilities, and a water treatment sensor to perform water treatment; a virtual digital twin unit constructed by simulating the water treatment facility; a data collection unit for collecting and storing measurement data; a control server for analyzing the measurement data and operating the water treatment facility through each plc controller; and a diagnostic monitoring server for remotely diagnosing whether the water treatment facility is abnormal or malfunctioning by analyzing the measurement data transmitted from the data collection unit. According to the present invention, measurement data collected from an IoT-based water treatment sensor is analyzed through a wireless network to integrate and remotely monitor a water treatment facility, and an optimal operation schedule is derived and applied through a digital twin unit to minimize operation costs and power consumption.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 생슬러지 펌프(A)와, 송풍기(B)와, 폐슬러지 펌프(C)와, 응집 및 침전제 투입 펌프(D)와, 외부탄소원 투입 펌프(E)와, 화학약품 주입 펌프(F)와, 송수 펌프(G)와, 각종 밸브(H)와, 각종 밸브(H)를 제어하는 각 액츄에이터(I)와, 각종 전기설비(J)와, 수처리 센서(K)로 구성되어 수처리하는 수처리시설(110), 디지털 트윈 기술을 통해, 수처리시설(110)을 모사하여 구축된 가상의 디지털 트윈부(120), 수처리 센서(K)로부터 무선네트워크를 통해 실시간으로 전송되는 계측데이터를 수집하여 저장하는 데이터 수집부(130), 데이터 수집부(130)로부터 전송된 계측데이터를 분석하고, 각 PLC 컨트롤러를 통해 수처리시설(110)을 운영하는, 분산제어기반의, 제어서버(140), 및 데이터 수집부(130)로부터 전송된 계측데이터를 분석하여 수처리시설(110)의 이상여부 또는 고장유무를 원격 진단하는 진단감시서버(150)를 포함하여, 무선네트워크를 통해 수집된 계측데이터를 분석하여 수처리시설(110)을 통합하여 원격 모니터링하는, 수처리시설용 스마트 계장계측제어 시스템을 개시한다.
assignees: NAMSUNG ENG CO LTD

title_en: Quality cooperative state estimation method for comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality cooperative state estimation method of a comprehensive energy system, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting measurement value vectors of a power system, a natural gas system and a thermodynamic system; s2, establishing a static quality cooperative state estimation model of the power system, and solving to obtain the power system Estimate the potential amplitude and phase angle, and obtain the electrical energy of the coupling node S3, establishing a flow hub model for the coupling nodes (energy stations), and correcting the air consumption of the coupling nodes; s4, establishing a natural gas system static quality cooperative state estimation model, and solving to obtain node air pressure and air load And obtain the gas load of the coupling node S5, gas load based on coupling node -A thermal power interaction relationship, modifying the coupling node thermal power; s6, establishing a thermodynamic system static quality cooperative state estimation model, and solving to obtain pipeline medium flow, water supply temperature, outlet temperature (unbalanced node), backwater temperature (balanced node) and thermodynamic unbalanced node An estimate of the stream.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Underground engineering grouting disaster control real-time management and control method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground engineering grouting, in particular to a digital twinning-based underground engineering grouting disaster control real-time management and control method and system, comprising the following steps: constructing a grouting engineering database; building an underground engineering disaster prediction model based on the grouting engineering database; constructing a grouting disaster control scheme optimization model based on a grouting engineering database; building a grouting disaster control monitoring model; establishing a digital twin model for underground engineering disaster grouting prevention and control based on an underground engineering disaster prediction model, a grouting disaster control scheme optimization model and a grouting disaster control monitoring model; inputting actual underground engineering early-stage data into a digital twin model for grouting prevention and control of underground engineering disasters, outputting predicted disaster types and disaster degrees, outputting an optimized grouting scheme, and visualizing a grouting disaster control process. The monitoring and visualization of the whole grouting process are realized, and the real-time prediction of underground engineering disasters and the real-time optimization of grouting disaster control and monitoring schemes are realized.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Power grid model data problem classification method and system based on graph convolution neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for classifying power grid model data problems based on a graph convolution neural network, and belongs to the technical field of neural networks. The power grid model data problem classification method comprises the following steps: performing problem positioning on equipment near the unqualified points to construct a subgraph; screening out parameter problem nodes in the subgraph to be used as training samples for problem classification; acquiring a pre-trained graph convolutional neural network problem classification model based on a training sample of problem classification; the power grid model data are screened based on the pre-trained model, different types of problem data are obtained, the pre-trained model is utilized to comprehensively screen the power grid model data, different types of problem data can be rapidly and accurately obtained, and the problem is concentrated and efficiently located. The invention combines a large amount of state estimation operation data and operation and maintenance experience, and can improve the data management efficiency of dispatching automation personnel and reduce the labor cost based on the graph neural network technology.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power grid model parameter estimation method and system based on physical information graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid model parameter estimation method and system based on a physical information graph neural network, which belong to the field of intelligent power grids and comprise the following steps: performing problem node positioning on equipment near the measurement failure point in the failure point of the state estimation, and constructing a subgraph; the method comprises the steps of marking the types of problem nodes, and screening out parameter problem nodes in a subgraph to serve as training samples of problem classification; training the graphic neural network parameter estimation model based on the training samples of the problem classification to obtain a pre-trained graphic neural network parameter estimation model; and screening the power grid mode data containing the problem nodes based on a pre-trained graph neural network parameter estimation model to obtain the parameter problem nodes. Based on a physical information graph neural network technology, a state estimation algorithm is constrained and added into a neural network by combining a large amount of state estimation operation data and operation and maintenance experience, accurate model data is provided for simulation calculation of a power dispatching control system, and intelligent estimation of parameter problem nodes is realized.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin model construction method, system and medium of smart power grid
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of digital twin, in particular to a method, a system and a medium for constructing a digital twin model of a smart grid, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining parameters of each grid of each unit in the grid at each moment; the method comprises the steps of determining distribution fluctuation degree of each power grid parameter of each unit at each moment, determining modal similarity of each power grid parameter of each unit at each moment, determining joint fluctuation characteristic values of each unit at each moment, determining cooperative action intensity of each unit at each moment, determining fault perception intensity at each moment, constructing a fault prediction model, respectively constructing a physical virtual model and a knowledge model of the power grid based on text data of physical structure relations and inherent properties of each device in the power grid, and combining the fault prediction models to perform model fusion to obtain a digital twin model of the power grid. According to the method, the digital twin model can be used for carrying out power grid monitoring and fault prediction on the intelligent power grid in real time, so that the fault prediction capability of the digital twin model of the power grid is improved.

title_en: Regional sluice system scheduling optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional sluice system scheduling optimization method and a regional sluice system scheduling optimization system, comprising the following steps: deep learning and graph neural network technology is adopted to perform multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and feature extraction, so as to realize multi-scale analysis of hydrodynamics features; generating an countermeasure network by using a dynamic Bayesian network and conditions, and generating a high-resolution hydrological scene set; constructing a multi-scale hydrodynamic model, and improving the accuracy and timeliness of the model by combining a self-adaptive grid technology and a data assimilation method; and (3) optimizing the sluice group cooperative scheduling by applying a deep reinforcement learning and game theory method to realize multi-objective intelligent scheduling. The method remarkably improves scientificity, efficiency and adaptability of sluice scheduling, and effectively balances flood control and disaster reduction, water resource utilization and ecological protection requirements.
assignees: NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST

title_en: Power system supply and demand balance control method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a digital twinning-based power system supply and demand balance control method, which relates to the technical field of power systems, and comprises the following steps: collecting real-time electricity data; acquiring real-time rigid load data and real-time flexible load data; establishing a clustered constant value load model; establishing a clustered variable load model; establishing an electric power energy storage and supply model; according to the upper layer scheduling unit and the lower layer scheduling unit, user comfort level evaluation is carried out, and a first balance decision factor is obtained; setting a power supply and demand digital twin model, and evaluating power supply and demand stability to obtain a second balance decision factor; and (5) performing balance control of the power system. The power supply and demand balance control system can solve the technical problem that in the prior art, the power supply and demand balance control efficiency and stability of a power system are low, so that the power supply and demand balance degree of the power system is poor, the aim of improving the power supply and demand balance control efficiency and stability of the power system is fulfilled, and the technical effect of improving the power supply and demand balance degree of the power system is achieved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power allocation method and system based on block chain calculation force
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power allocation method and a system based on block chain calculation power, and relates to the technical field of power systems, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of evaluating configuration computing power resources in an electric power block chain network to obtain block chain link point computing power resource distribution information, carrying out simulation on the block chain link point computing power resource distribution information and target electric power region information by utilizing a digital twin technology, generating an electric power node digital twin model to carry out electric power demand analysis, broadcasting the obtained node electric power distribution demand parameter information in the electric power block chain network, determining computing power resource response node information based on the block chain link point computing power resource distribution information, carrying out electric power distribution analysis on the node electric power distribution demand parameter information, and obtaining target electric power distribution parameter information to carry out electric power distribution management and control. The power dispatching decentralization and transparentization are achieved by utilizing the block chain computing resources, the power dispatching efficiency and the dispatching precision are improved through node response dispatching, and further the technical effect of the power dispatching management and control effect is guaranteed.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin navigation detection task simulation support system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a digital twinning navigation detection task simulation support system, which comprises: the environment state coding module collects dynamic data based on environment data in the navigation detection task, monitors the moving speed and the moving direction of the target in real time, processes the dynamic data through time sequence coding, inputs a graph convolution network, and updates the node state to obtain an environment state vector. According to the invention, through real-time monitoring of the target moving speed and direction and time sequence coding processing of dynamic data, the updating speed and precision of environment information are greatly improved, the instant information is imported into the depth Q network, and through systematic evaluation of risk and success probability, the accurate optimization of a flight path is realized, the adaptability to the complex navigation detection task environment is enhanced, the safety and efficiency in task execution are optimized, and the effective utilization of resources and the high adaptability of tasks are ensured through real-time adjustment of flight resources and task parameters.

title_en: State estimation and measurement distribution parallel optimization method for unobservable power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state estimation and measurement distribution parallel optimization method for an unobservable power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of: s1, constructing a first model based on a generated countermeasure network structure; the first model includes a generator and an estimator; the generator is used for generating measurement distribution of the power distribution network; the estimator is used for realizing data driving state estimation according to the measurement distribution; s2, generating first load data by combining the real load data of the power distribution network with the first data set, and obtaining training data according to the first load data; s3, performing offline training on the first model according to training data, and stopping training after the loss functions of the generator and the estimator are converged to obtain a model to be optimized; carrying out estimator parameter optimization on the model to be optimized to obtain a second model; and S4, obtaining first measurement distribution according to the second model, and performing on-line state estimation on the power distribution network according to the first measurement distribution through the second model to complete parallel optimization of state estimation and measurement distribution of the unobservable power distribution network.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD ZHAOQING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;UNIV HUNAN

title_en: Digital twin variable pitch control optimization method and system for wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of control optimization, and provides a digital twin pitch control optimization method and system for a wind turbine. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out digital twin modeling to obtain a twin model of the wind turbine generator; real-time monitoring is carried out on the target wind turbine generator to obtain blade angle data; acquiring wind power prediction data of preset time through a meteorological platform; inputting wind speed prediction sequences, wind direction prediction sequences and pitch angle data into the twin model of the wind turbine generator set to perform operation simulation to obtain a simulated generating capacity sequence; when the difference value between the simulated generating capacity sequence and the electricity consumption demand sequence meets a preset supply and demand difference value, not performing control; and when the preset supply and demand difference value is not met, performing pitch optimization on the blade angle data. The application solves the technical problems of lower power generation efficiency and poorer running stability of the wind turbine generator system in the prior art, and achieves the technical effect of improving the running efficiency of the wind turbine generator system.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Distributed task scheduling-based power grid topology real-time reconstruction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid topology real-time reconstruction method and system based on distributed task scheduling, which relate to the technical field of intelligent scheduling of power systems and comprise the following steps: collecting power grid operation data in real time, detecting topology changes and triggering a topology reconstruction task; according to a distributed data synchronization mechanism, updating and sharing the power grid topology information and the computing resource state in real time; and dynamically decomposing and distributing the topology reconstruction task to distributed nodes for execution through a self-adaptive task scheduler according to the power grid topology information and the computing resource state. The invention firstly provides a solid foundation for decision making by constructing the power grid topology model, and ensures the feasibility and safety of a reconstruction scheme. Secondly, through distributed state estimation and data synchronization, the perceptibility and response speed of the system to the dynamic change of the network are greatly improved. And finally, the execution efficiency, reliability and flexibility of the system are obviously improved through the self-adaptive task scheduling and multi-layer fault tolerance mechanism.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and system related to optimal scheduling and resource allocation of water conservancy flood prevention
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat map construction, in particular to a construction method and a construction system for optimal scheduling and resource allocation of water conservancy flood prevention. The method comprises the steps of obtaining regional remote sensing image data, carrying out data preprocessing on the regional remote sensing image data to generate standard regional remote sensing image data, and carrying out flood control resource site screening on the standard regional remote sensing image data to obtain flood control resource site screening data, wherein the flood control resource site screening data comprise weather monitoring site data, flood monitoring site data, hydrological water level site data and drainage pipe network monitoring data. According to the invention, through systematic data integration, dynamic comprehensive analysis, model optimization and coupling, accurate risk area identification and intelligent real-time updating, the accuracy, efficiency and intelligent level of the flood control resource allocation heat map system are improved.

title_en: Digital twinning-based wind power plant fault linkage early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power plant fault linkage early warning method and system based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of wind energy, wherein the method comprises the following steps: modeling a wind power plant based on a digital twin platform to obtain a model; obtaining a real-time data set according to an Internet of things monitoring platform; acquiring control scheme information, and predicting the state of the wind power plant by combining the model to obtain a prediction result; detecting faults based on the real-time data set and the prediction result to obtain a detection report; and activating a linkage early warning device and combining report early warning. The technical problem of current wind farm fault detection rate of accuracy is low is solved, and the technical effect of improving the safety and stability of wind farm operation is achieved.
assignees: HUANENG ANHUI HUAINING WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Satellite navigation-assisted planning method and device for power grid emergency repair path
abstract_en: The application provides a planning method and a planning device for an emergency repair path of a satellite navigation-assisted power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a regional risk assessment model, and inputting current parameter information and current meteorological parameter information into the model to obtain a risk prediction result; acquiring ground traffic flow and road information, and evaluating road traffic capacity by adopting a digital twin platform to determine trafficability priority of each road; based on the path selection rule base, generating a current power grid rush-repair path according to the risk prediction result, the trafficability priority and the rush-repair priority of each road; and sending the current power grid rush-repair path to a rush-repair vehicle team through satellite communication, so that the rush-repair vehicle team performs rush-repair on a power grid fault point according to the current power grid rush-repair path. The method can use a power grid rush-repair path selection system of power grid monitoring, weather prediction, traffic flow monitoring and other technologies, can provide accurate power grid rush-repair path selection advice, and ensures the rush-repair efficiency and safety.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Alternating current/direct current power distribution network prediction auxiliary state estimation method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alternating current/direct current power distribution network prediction auxiliary state estimation method based on deep learning. According to the method, a state prediction model based on a deep neural network is established according to a historical state, and a state prediction value is obtained; then, establishing a pseudo measurement model based on deep regression learning for the non-observable alternating current and direct current areas to obtain pseudo measurement of the non-observable areas; and finally, respectively establishing a set Kalman filtering model containing equality constraint for the AC/DC region based on the state predicted value, the real-time measurement, the pseudo measurement and the boundary information, and calculating to obtain a state filtering value. The algorithm provided by the invention is based on deep learning, can construct an accurate state transition model, enhance measurement redundancy and save calculation time, thereby being capable of tracking the state track of the system in real time.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Method, medium and system for constructing digital twin system of offshore embankment disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, medium and system for constructing a digital twin system of an offshore diffuse dike disaster, which belong to the technical field of image data processing or generation. And then, carrying out sea wave and hydrodynamic force simulation by using a real-time three-dimensional creation tool, and simultaneously carrying out real-time observation on a target area and inputting data into a system. And then constructing a sea wave model and a storm surge model based on the high-resolution numerical model or the artificial intelligence model, and forecasting sea waves and storm surge for at least 72 hours by using the models, and simulating disaster situations of histories and different reproduction periods and different disaster reduction measures. And finally, constructing a disaster prevention and reduction scene library based on the simulation result, and solving the problem that the three-dimensional dynamic characteristics of the sea area and the effects of various disaster reduction measures cannot be fully reflected in the prior art.

title_en: Regional power grid operation and maintenance management system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power grid operation and maintenance, and particularly discloses a regional power grid operation and maintenance management system based on digital twinning, wherein an acquisition data receiving module receives target detection data acquired by a sensor, a data analysis module receives and analyzes the target detection data, transmits the target detection data and an analysis result to a twinning model management module, sends an alarm signal to an alarm module when equipment abnormality is judged to exist according to the analysis result, the twinning model management module constructs a power grid digital twinning model according to power grid management elements, configures dynamic parameters of the power grid digital twinning model according to the target detection data and the analysis result, the alarm module alarms when the alarm signal is received, a large screen display module displays the power grid digital twinning model, the target detection data and the analysis result on a display screen, and a dispatching operation management module generates an operation and maintenance work order when the equipment abnormality exists. The invention realizes real-time monitoring, abnormal early warning and operation and maintenance decision support for the power grid.
assignees: CHENGDE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LTD

title_en: Distributed state estimation method of electric-gas comprehensive energy system based on deep learning pseudo measurement modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-gas comprehensive energy system distributed state estimation method based on deep learning pseudo measurement modeling. The method adopts the deep neural network to establish a pseudo measurement model of the load node flow of the natural gas system, and improves the measurement redundancy while ensuring the observability of the system. On the basis, the information barrier problem of the electric and gas subsystems is solved by adopting an alternate iterative estimation strategy, and the distributed solving of the state estimation problem of the electric-gas comprehensive energy system is realized. The invention can solve the problems of low real-time measurement redundancy and large measurement error of the natural gas system, protect the information privacy of the electric and gas subsystems, effectively improve the estimation precision of the natural gas system, has higher on-line calculation efficiency, and can provide accurate data for real-time monitoring of the running state of the electric-gas comprehensive energy system.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Data value discovery and risk assessment system and method based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data value discovery and risk assessment system and method based on a large language model, in particular to the field of data element markets and data asset operation, which extracts business data, management data and operation data in real time, establishes a predictive missing model to classify the extracted data according to the predictive missing result, remarkably improves the integrity of a dataset, reduces analysis errors caused by the missing data, extracts theme semantic information and corresponding business data, management data and operation data by applying an LDA model, ensures that data analysis is more focused and effective, helps enterprises to make more scientific strategic decisions, selects an LSTM unit to build a cyclic neural network model to output the predictive discovery result aiming at future trends and market opportunity values, constructs an isolated tree to calculate abnormal scores of the business data, the management data and the operation data, automatically generates reports by Tableau and displays the complex data in an intuitive manner, and is convenient for users to understand and analyze.
assignees: WANGJING BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin application method and related device for power distribution network power supply service command business
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of digital twin, and provides a digital twin application method and a related device for a power distribution network power supply service command service, which aim at the technical problems that a power distribution network monitoring computing platform of a traditional dependency database has insufficient computing capability, poor timeliness and difficulty in supporting high-performance analysis service and cannot meet the requirements of rapid computing and analysis, and comprises model construction, data fusion, scene classification, scene generation and scene application, the method can respectively extract the characteristics of different types of scenes, divide the power distribution network power supply service command business into various different scenes, complete scene generation based on a library in the power distribution network power supply service command digital twin model, execute the scenes, effectively improve the accuracy and convenience of data utilization, and realize intelligent fusion of the data, the business, the digital twin body and other elements in different practical application scenes.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twin visual data processing system for intelligent park
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin visual data processing system for an intelligent park, which relates to the technical field of equipment data processing, and is characterized in that an electric equipment operation digital twin model is generated by related data of electric equipment, the operation data of the electric equipment is subjected to anomaly recognition, a fault prediction instruction is sent to the outside when the quantity of anomaly values exceeds expectations, the electric equipment operation digital twin model is used for carrying out fault prediction on the electric equipment, a first-level alarm instruction is sent to the outside after a fault log is automatically generated, an alarm value is generated by receiving state data of the first-level alarm instruction, fault equipment is screened out from a plurality of pieces of equipment according to the alarm value, a maintenance path is planned for the fault equipment in the park, and visual processing is carried out on environmental condition data and operation state data where the fault equipment is located. By sending alarm instructions in multiple levels, the resolution of the operation faults of the power equipment is improved.

title_en: Electric power medium-long term market price prediction method based on digital twin algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting medium-long-term market electricity price of electric power based on a digital twin algorithm, which relates to the technical field of electricity price prediction and comprises the steps of collecting historical operation data to obtain a historical electric power data set; the method comprises the steps of carrying out real-time operation monitoring on a medium-and-long-term electric power market to obtain a real-time electric power data set, utilizing a digital twin algorithm to construct an electric price prediction model, synchronizing a historical electric power data set and the real-time electric power data set to the electric price prediction model to obtain electric price prediction data, extracting actual electric price data, comparing the actual electric price data with the electric price prediction data, carrying out feedback verification according to a comparison result to generate feedback optimization data, carrying out deviation correction on the electric price prediction model according to the feedback optimization data to generate the electric price prediction optimization model, and carrying out intelligent electric price prediction on the medium-and-long-term electric power market. The method solves the technical problem of low prediction precision in the prior art for predicting the electricity price, and achieves the technical effect of accurately predicting the electricity price of the medium-and-long-term market of the electric power.
assignees: POWERCHINA NEW ENERGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Wind resource representative year accurate correction method for mountain wind farm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind resource evaluation, in particular to a wind resource representative year accurate correction method of a mountain wind farm, which comprises the following steps: collecting historical observation data and reference station data of a wind measuring tower, correcting the wind speed of each wind direction quadrant respectively by adopting a quadrant correction method, removing abnormal values and filling missing data, training a machine learning model by using the historical observation data, further correcting the wind speed value, calculating weight factors according to the change of different wind directions and time periods, introducing the weight factors into the quadrant correction method, correcting by a weighted average method, carrying out sliding average on data after self-adaptive weight adjustment according to one year every 12 months continuously, verifying the corrected representative year data and outputting the final corrected representative year data, wherein the wind speed is influenced by smooth short-term climate change. The method improves the accuracy and reliability of wind resource assessment, and provides firm data support for planning, designing and running of mountain wind power plants.
assignees: SHANGHAI ENERGY TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Flow data differentiation analysis method applied to transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention provides a flow data differentiation analysis method applied to a transformer substation, which relates to the technical field of electric power and artificial intelligence and comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of the running process of the transformer substation in advance; the digital twin model comprises flow monitoring points, flow data acquired by the flow monitoring points which are arranged in a transformer substation and cover all the power equipment are acquired and imported into the digital twin model, power equipment abnormality information which characterizes abnormality of the power equipment monitored by the flow monitoring points is generated according to the flow data, target flow monitoring points which generate the power equipment abnormality information are acquired from the digital twin model, target flow data corresponding to the target flow monitoring points are acquired, and a differential analysis result is obtained by utilizing a differential evaluation model which is trained in advance based on deep learning to conduct differential analysis on the target flow data. The scheme can improve the accuracy of differential analysis of the flow data of the transformer substation, and further improve the monitoring accuracy of abnormal states of the transformer substation.
assignees: SHIZUISHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power plant visual information management system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power plant management, and provides a power plant visual information management system based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following components: based on the operation data, processing and analyzing to obtain an operation deviation representation value, judging whether a fault trend exists, based on the operation data, processing and analyzing to obtain an operation change value, judging the change type of the operation data, selecting a prediction model matched with the operation change value, continuously monitoring the operation voltage in real time in a prediction period, comparing and analyzing by combining the prediction voltage to obtain a change approach value, judging whether the operation voltage change approaches to the predicted operation voltage, obtaining a non-approach similarity value, and judging whether the operation voltage of the power plant equipment at different time points does not approach to the predicted operation voltage to a similar degree, thereby being beneficial to the stable operation management of the power plant.

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method integrating neural network and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network state estimation method integrating a neural network and an attention mechanism, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a power distribution network state estimation model integrating a neural network algorithm and the attention mechanism, then constructing input data for training, wherein the input data is divided into two types of processing, one type of processing is directly connected with a traditional DNN, the other type of processing needs to be added with a time sequence dimension to enable the processing to become a three-dimensional data set to be connected with an LSTM (link state machine) network, then combining output results of two parallel modules into an input of attention modules, and realizing accurate estimation of the power distribution network state by distributing weights through the method.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA

title_en: Automatic operation and maintenance method and system for electric power distribution network based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic operation and maintenance method and system of an electric power distribution network based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of electric power operation and maintenance and comprise the steps of collecting operation data of the electric power distribution network in real time through a distributed sensor network, transmitting the collected operation data to a cloud data center to design a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework, dividing the power distribution network into a plurality of subareas, and an intelligent operation and maintenance agent making an individualized fault treatment scheme by carrying out real-time monitoring and analysis on a digital twin model and making an optimal execution plan based on the fault treatment scheme and combining real-time road condition information and positions of maintenance personnel; and respectively issuing the optimal execution plan to mobile terminals of automatic equipment and maintenance personnel through a safe encryption channel, extracting preventive maintenance rules from the historical operation and maintenance records, and formulating a preventive maintenance plan based on the extracted preventive maintenance rules and combining a pre-trained equipment life prediction model.
assignees: ORDOS FANSHENG DATA TECH CO LTD;BEIJING QIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network resource optimal configuration method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a distribution network resource optimal allocation method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of establishing a virtual network corresponding to a power distribution network based on a digital twin technology, obtaining a power planning starting point and a power planning ending point selected by a resource allocation end, determining an initial planning route composed of the power planning starting point and the power planning ending point, intercepting a virtual corridor based on a relative position relation between the initial planning route and the virtual corridor to obtain a corridor planning section, segmenting the corridor planning section, updating the route of the initial planning route based on each obtained dividing sub-section of a corresponding idle attribute to obtain a current planning route, configuring route temperature control, sending circuit resource optimization data to the resource allocation end, responding to a configuration completion signal sent by the resource allocation end, obtaining temperature monitoring data, and updating the running state of the current planning route in the virtual network. The invention at least improves the planning efficiency.

title_en: Modularized photovoltaic device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, in particular to a modularized photovoltaic device and a control method thereof. The method comprises the steps of obtaining photovoltaic system data, extracting illumination parameter information of the photovoltaic system data to obtain photovoltaic illumination parameter information, carrying out intensity evaluation on the photovoltaic illumination parameter information to obtain photovoltaic illumination intensity data, carrying out intensity clustering on the photovoltaic illumination intensity data to obtain illumination intensity clustered data, extracting temperature data of the photovoltaic system data to obtain photovoltaic temperature data, carrying out photo-thermal cooperative analysis on the photovoltaic temperature data according to the illumination intensity clustered data, and generating photovoltaic photo-thermal cooperative data. Therefore, the photovoltaic array configuration self-adaptive adjustment method and device realize the photo-thermal collaborative analysis of the photovoltaic through the Internet of things technology, the data analysis technology, the self-adaptive control technology and the digital twin technology, so as to realize the self-adaptive adjustment of the photovoltaic array configuration and improve the photovoltaic power output performance.

title_en: Fire control vehicle-mounted information management and control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information management and control, in particular to a fire-fighting vehicle-mounted information management and control system. According to the invention, the traffic and emergency information are integrated in real time, the travel route of the fire engine is dynamically regulated, the navigation efficiency of the fire engine in a complex urban environment is remarkably improved, the generation of route information is optimized in real time, the fire engine can bypass a congestion point, the emergency response time is shortened, meanwhile, the self-adaptive regulation of signal frequency and transmission power is carried out on communication equipment, the transmission reliability of data in different network environments is enhanced, the timely and accurate transmission of key instructions is ensured, in addition, the real-time update and state synchronization of an execution command in a fire engine-mounted system are improved, the cooperative combat capability of fire troops is improved, and the consistent execution of the emergency instructions is ensured, so that the overall rescue efficiency and the safety are effectively improved.
assignees: POTEVIO PEACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind turbine generator system fault simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind turbine generator fault simulation, and discloses a wind turbine generator fault simulation method which comprises high-resolution environment simulation, real-time climate monitoring, virtual reality and augmented reality technology application, a self-adaptive simulation model based on deep learning, digital twin technology application and an open data sharing and crowdsourcing platform. According to the wind turbine generator system fault simulation method, through application of Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) technologies, operators can fully train without directly facing high-risk environments, training safety is improved, more visual and real-time teaching support is provided, fault diagnosis and repair training is more efficient and realistic, and a simulation system is helped to learn a large number of historical operation data and fault cases and forecast possible fault modes in the future by using artificial intelligence, convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and cyclic neural networks (RNNs).
assignees: GUODIAN POWER GUANGXI WIND POWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: AR (augmented reality) glasses-based power equipment inspection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intellectualization in the power industry, in particular to an AR (augmented reality) -glasses-based power equipment inspection method. According to the method, the device and the system, through the Internet of things technology and the multi-source data fusion algorithm, comprehensive collection and real-time updating of the running data of the device are realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of the data are improved. And the equipment state and the fault risk are deeply analyzed by combining a decision tree and a neural network algorithm, so that the fault prediction accuracy and the early recognition capability are improved. The fault mode influences analysis and the application of the convolutional neural network, accurately identifies a fault source and proposes effective maintenance suggestions, and maintenance cost and downtime are reduced. The genetic algorithm optimizes the routing inspection path and the work plan planning, and improves the routing inspection efficiency. Cloud computing and augmented reality technology are combined, inspection information is visually presented, and working efficiency and accuracy are improved.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP MENGDIAN INFORMATION COMMUNICATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation effective data screening and optimizing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power operation and data processing, in particular to a photovoltaic power generation effective data screening and optimizing method and a system, which aim at the problem of low screening accuracy of the photovoltaic power generation effective data of a new energy power plant in an extreme natural environment, according to the invention, the geographical image data of the photovoltaic power station is constructed by a digital twin technology, and the accurate screening of the data is realized by combining the comparison of the real-time plant natural environment data and theoretical natural environment information and a natural environment simulation model. Meanwhile, the operation data of the screened photovoltaic power station is optimized by utilizing a genetic algorithm, so that the photovoltaic power station of the new energy power station can efficiently and stably operate under the change of natural environment. The invention improves the accuracy of screening the effective data of the photovoltaic power generation and provides powerful support for the intelligent operation and maintenance of the photovoltaic power station.

title_en: Intelligent water conservancy inspection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses an intelligent water conservancy inspection method, device and equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of carrying out dynamic fusion processing on the obtained multi-dimensional water conservancy environment data of the preset target area to obtain a target digital twin body, carrying out intelligent collaborative analysis on the digital twin body to obtain a self-adaptive inspection strategy, carrying out multi-mode sensing data acquisition on the target area according to the self-adaptive inspection strategy to obtain multi-mode data, carrying out federal learning processing on the multi-mode data to obtain holographic situation awareness data, carrying out causal reasoning analysis on the holographic situation awareness data to obtain a dynamic risk map, and inputting the dynamic risk map into a preset depth Q network to carry out prevention and control strategy analysis to obtain an active prevention and control strategy and an inspection report. The intelligent water conservancy inspection system and the intelligent water conservancy inspection method improve the efficiency and the accuracy of intelligent water conservancy inspection.

title_en: Highway electric energy quality early warning system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a highway electric energy quality early warning system, and relates to the field of electric energy quality early warning. The system comprises a monitoring data acquisition module of each block of the expressway, a data cleaning module of each block of the expressway, a power quality prediction module of each block of the expressway, a power quality early warning module of each block of the expressway, a power quality assessment module and a power quality assessment module, wherein the monitoring data acquisition module of each block of the expressway comprises a block geographic environment query unit, a block weather data acquisition unit and a block power quality index acquisition unit, the data cleaning module of each block of the expressway is used for cleaning abnormal data, repeated data and missing data of data acquired by the monitoring data acquisition module of the same block, the power quality prediction module of each block of the expressway comprises a power quality prediction unit and a power quality early warning threshold making unit, the power quality early warning module of each block of the expressway comprises a monitoring data real-time warning unit and a predicted data early warning unit, and the power quality assessment module is used for assessing the power quality. The embodiment improves the accuracy and the difference of early warning.
assignees: HEBEI EXPRESSWAY GROUP CO LTD;JINGQIN BRANCH HEBEI EXPRESSWAY GROUP CO LTD;HEBEI PROVINCIAL COMMUNICATIONS PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: New energy power optimization scheduling method and system under digital twin platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy power systems, in particular to a new energy power optimal scheduling method and a new energy power optimal scheduling system under a digital twin platform, which firstly establishes a new energy power system optimal scheduling scene based on the digital twin platform, through the scene, a digital twin edge network model is established, and accurate modeling, real-time monitoring, optimal scheduling and decision support of a new energy power system are realized. In terms of power tasks, the intelligent terminal has the option to perform local calculations or offload tasks to an edge server. In addition, the invention builds an optimization model of intelligent terminal unloading decision and computing resource allocation so as to achieve the aim of minimizing the total energy consumption of the whole network. Finally, an on-policy Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithm is adopted to solve the unloading decision and the computing resource allocation strategy, so that the online instantaneity of the unloading decision and the computing resource allocation is greatly improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ocean digital twin platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean data application, in particular to an ocean digital twin platform which comprises a basic environment layer, a data layer, a platform layer and an application layer, wherein the data layer performs data interaction with an ocean data base, performs data processing on ocean data base data, acquires digital twin simulation ocean information by using an artificial intelligent model and processed ocean data base data, and displays the digital twin simulation ocean information by using the application layer. The invention realizes unified management and efficient processing of ocean data through integration with the ocean data base, breaks the island of the data and improves the utilization efficiency and accuracy of the data. The artificial intelligent model is utilized to carry out deep analysis and excavation on the processed ocean data, so that more accurate and comprehensive digital twin simulation ocean information can be obtained, and important decision support is provided for aspects such as ocean resource management, environment monitoring and disaster early warning.
assignees: SOUTHERN MARINE SCIENCE AND ENG GUANGDONG LABORATORY ZHUHAI

title_en: Wind power prediction method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind power prediction method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of wind power prediction, and firstly, a missing data filling method is provided to be combined with Cross Multiple Interpolation (CMI) so as to obtain a complete environment variable data set. And secondly, selecting characteristic variables based on the maximum information coefficient so as to simplify the data set and obtain required characteristic vectors. And finally, obtaining a wind power prediction model based on a data training Time Convolutional Network (TCN) of the characteristic variable set, inputting the operation data of the fan to be detected into the wind power prediction model, and outputting a wind power prediction value. Compared with other models, the method has better prediction performance, and provides data support for subsequent wind power total amount analysis and prediction.
assignees: UNIV JINAN

title_en: Power supply carbon emission adjusting method and system based on optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The application provides a power supply carbon emission adjusting method and system based on an optimization algorithm, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: loading a target power supply scheme corresponding to a target power supply demand, modeling according to a data twin system, obtaining a power supply simulation model, then carrying out simulated power supply to obtain simulated power supply data, obtaining a power supply carbon bank verification result through a power supply carbon bank verification model, generating a power supply carbon bank adjusting instruction and activating a power supply carbon bank optimizing algorithm when the power supply carbon bank is unqualified, then carrying out optimizing to obtain a carbon bank optimizing power supply scheme, and carrying out power supply control according to the optimizing power supply scheme. The application mainly solves the problems that the existing method is low in management efficiency and accuracy, lacks an effective carbon-emission adjusting mechanism, and cannot quickly generate corresponding adjusting instructions to perform carbon-emission optimization when the carbon emission exceeds the standard. Through the digital twin system and the simulation model, the running state and the carbon emission condition of the electric power system can be accurately simulated, and efficient carbon emission adjustment can be performed.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power construction wisdom construction analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building construction, and particularly discloses an analysis system for intelligent building construction of nuclear power construction, which comprises a data acquisition module, a big data analysis module, a digital twin module, an emergency response module, a logistics management module and an information sharing module; according to the invention, various data of a construction site are collected and analyzed in real time by arranging the sensor network and the data processing platform, so that a manager can master the construction progress in time, quickly make a decision, delay and downtime in construction are reduced, the construction data are predicted and optimized by a machine learning algorithm, the construction scheme is helped to be optimized, the construction efficiency is improved, the stress and deformation conditions of key structural parts are monitored in real time by the sensor network, the construction quality is ensured, potential structural problems are found and prevented in time, the digital twin technology can realize virtual and real linkage, the construction is ensured to be carried out according to design specifications, and the construction quality is improved.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution method, device and equipment based on photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution method, a device and equipment based on photovoltaic power generation, and relates to the technical field of power, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data of a photovoltaic system in a preset power generation time period; the method comprises the steps of estimating predicted power generation capacity of a photovoltaic system according to meteorological data through a preset photovoltaic power model, obtaining the preset photovoltaic power model through aggregation training of an initial photovoltaic model, obtaining sensitivity training of a power generation scene of the photovoltaic system through the initial photovoltaic model based on an AI algorithm and a digital twin model, determining the power utilization load capacity of the photovoltaic according to power capacity balance data of each power utilization area, and determining the power distribution result of each power utilization area according to the predicted power generation capacity. According to the application, due to the fact that the weather condition and the preset photovoltaic power model are combined, the generated energy can be accurately predicted in advance, so that the power consumption requirements of all power consumption areas are reasonably distributed in advance, the advantage of renewable energy sources is fully utilized, and the energy utilization efficiency of photovoltaic power generation is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ZHEMINGHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling algorithm optimization method and system based on power twinning
abstract_en: The application discloses a dispatching algorithm optimization method and a system based on electric power twin, which belong to the field of digital twin, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a power plant and establishing a device stability evaluation function; the method comprises the steps of acquiring power demand characteristics, monitoring environment data of clean power generation, establishing a real-time environment data set and a predicted environment data set, initializing a channel of an intelligent dispatching channel according to the power demand characteristics, predicting power generation parameters of clean equipment, generating running stability data according to a prediction result and an equipment stability evaluation function, generating a dispatching decision result, and completing supply dispatching optimization of a power plant. The application solves the technical problems of low power grid dispatching precision and poor coordination caused by the difficulty in accurately predicting and stably matching the clean power generation and the power grid load based on the traditional model in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the power grid dispatching precision and the coordination by constructing a digital twin and intelligent dispatching channel to cooperatively optimize the clean power generation and the power grid load in real time.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Circuit safety management method based on Internet of things low-voltage safety comprehensive protection module
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance of power equipment, and provides a circuit safety management method based on an Internet of things low-voltage safety comprehensive protection module. The method integrates the original prediction result and the time-sharing prediction result, periodically updates the data set and trains the prediction model so as to realize the real-time updated low-voltage safety comprehensive protection module circuit safety prediction. The invention improves the prediction accuracy, enhances the adaptability and the flexibility of the system, realizes comprehensive circuit safety management, and promotes the development of the operation and maintenance of the power system to a data driving decision.
assignees: GUANGZHOU NANWANG SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid fault emergency rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid fault repair, in particular to a power grid fault emergency rescue method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid topological structure data, key equipment parameters and real-time running state data, constructing a power grid digital twin model according to the power grid topological structure data, the key equipment parameters and the real-time running state data, performing real-time state evaluation to obtain fault risk early warning data and real-time fault condition data, performing fault point positioning and fault type determination based on deep learning according to the fault risk early warning data and the real-time running state data when the real-time fault condition data is displayed as faults, obtaining fault diagnosis data, and constructing a fault influence range model according to the fault diagnosis data and a preset FACTS and HVDC characteristic model. The method integrates deep learning, graph theory and multi-objective optimization technology, and achieves fault intelligent identification, influence range modeling and accurate emergency treatment scheme optimization.

title_en: High-voltage cable digital panoramic system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power systems, and particularly relates to a high-voltage cable digital panoramic system which comprises an IOT channel, a model fusion module, an equipment panoramic showing module and an equipment positioning and state sensing module, wherein the model fusion module is used for manually collecting a panoramic model and a laser point cloud model, realizing fusion of panoramic and laser point cloud data after processing operation of the panoramic model and the laser point cloud model, the equipment panoramic showing module is used for carrying out transformation processing on a three-dimensional platform on the basis of the model fusion module to realize loading showing of a model fusion result, meanwhile integrating state data of high-voltage cable equipment to realize panoramic showing, and the equipment positioning and state sensing module is used for carrying out comparison correlation with standing account information of the high-voltage cable equipment. The invention can realize the organic fusion of the laser point cloud and the panoramic image, construct the digital twin scene of the cable tunnel, and realize the panoramic display and the tour virtual display of the high-voltage cable tunnel.
assignees: BEIJING ZHUOYUE POWER CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;PIPELINE BRANCH BEIJING JINGDIAN POWER GRID MAINTENANCE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Electrical fault monitoring system for smart city
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric fault monitoring system for a smart city, which comprises an electric acquisition box, an edge gateway, an Internet of things platform and a local large model. The electric acquisition box can acquire environmental parameters and line current load characteristics, the edge gateway comprises a microcomputer and a communication module, the Internet of things platform can perform bidirectional interaction with a local large model, can analyze, aggregate and permanently store received data, is integrated with a data visualization module, can dynamically display an electrochemical corrosion process of a line interface, and performs dynamic interaction with a user through a data large screen. According to the invention, the load characteristic of the circuit is captured by using the current sensor, a mathematical model is established to predict the temperature change of the circuit in real time, the fire disaster caused by the circuit degradation is predicted, and the visualization is carried out through a digital twin technology.
assignees: HENAN LIGAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Resource scheduling method for power equipment fault handling in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource scheduling method for power equipment fault processing in extreme weather, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of embedding a power equipment topological point cloud model and a power equipment fault analysis function network by utilizing a digital twin technology, generating a power equipment operation twin model to analyze power equipment operation data flow and obtaining power equipment fault characteristic information; and carrying out influence analysis on the weather information of the power equipment area to obtain a multidimensional weather resource influence factor, transmitting the power equipment fault characteristic information and the multidimensional weather resource influence factor to an operation and maintenance resource cloud for carrying out scheduling analysis to obtain power equipment resource cooperative scheduling parameters for carrying out resource scheduling and equipment fault processing. The method has the advantages that the digital twin technology is utilized to realize power equipment fault analysis and operation and maintenance resource intelligent scheduling, the resource scheduling accuracy and scheduling efficiency are improved, the equipment operation and maintenance cost is reduced, and further the technical effect of timeliness of power equipment fault processing is ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD
