According to embodiments, a server generates a space connection matrix and a door-space table based on BIM information on a building, thereby efficiently determining an optimal evacuation route using the space connection matrix and the door-space table.
abstract_ko: 실시예들은 내부 시설 배치를 고려한 시멘틱 디지털 트윈 가상 모델의 공간 네트워크를 기반으로 화재 대피 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 방법 및 장치를 제공한다. 일 실시예에 따른 상기 방법은, 상기 건물에 대한 BIM(building information modeling) 정보에 기반하여 상기 건물에 대한 공간 시멘틱 정보를 생성하고, 상기 건물에 대한 공간 시멘틱 정보를 기반으로 상기 건물에 대한 3차원 가상 공간을 구현하고, 상기 건물에 대한 3차원 가상 공간은 적어도 하나의 계층을 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 계층은 N개의 출입문으로 상호 연결된 M개의 단위 공간을 포함하고, 상기 공간 시멘틱 정보는 M개의 단위 공간 각각을 형상화하기 위한 공간 폴리곤 정보, 외부 공간에 대한 정보, 상기 M개의 단위 공간과 연결되는 출입문을 나타내는 출입문 객체 정보, 상기 M개의 단위 공간 사이의 연결성을 나타내는 공간 연결 매트릭스 및 상기 N개의 출입문과 상기 M개의 단위 공간 사이의 매칭 관계를 나타내는 출입문-공간 테이블을 포함하고, 상기 공간 시멘틱 정보를 기반으로 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 대해 최단 대피 경로를 결정하고, 상기 최단 대피 경로는 해당 단위 공간이 출발 노드로 설정되고, 해당 단위 공간에서 가장 가까운 외부 공간으로 연결된 출입문이 포함된 단위 공간이 도착 노드로 설정되고, 상기 공간 시멘틱 정보 및 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 대한 구조물 정보를 기반으로 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 복수의 에이전트를 배치하고, 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 대한 구조물 정보 및 상기 최단 대피 경로를 기반으로 상기 복수의 에이전트 각각에 대한 최적 대피 경로를 결정하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 예를 들어, 상기 최적 대피 경로는 에이전트의 위치가 출발 위치로 설정되고, 상기 출발 위치가 포함된 단위 공간에서 가장 가까운 외부 공간으로 연결된 출입문이 도착 위치로 설정되고, 상기 출발 위치가 포함된 단위 공간의 최단 대피 경로를 구성하는 단위 공간마다 단위 공간 내부에 포함된 구조물을 제외한 영역을 지나는 경로로 결정될 수 있다.
assignees: SIMSYSGLOBAL INC

title_en: A system for intelligently exploring contextual information
title_ko: 상황정보 지능형 탐색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention solves the problem of improving the accuracy and speed of disaster response by automatically collecting, integrating, and analyzing contextual information from various sources, generating automatic reports, and providing real-time updates. The intelligent exploration system for contextual information comprises: an exploration base unit for collecting and structuring disaster-related data to accumulate it as big data; and a service model unit for automatically generating an analysis report by analyzing the big data according to a user query. The exploration base unit manages structured data as a knowledge graph and unstructured data as a vector DB, and the service model unit generates a suitable response through an LLM after NLP-based query analysis.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 상황 정보의 효율적인 수집 및 탐색을 지원하는 지능형 탐색 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 상황실에서 상황 파악 후 전파·보고를 위한 자동화된 정보 탐색 및 보고서 생성을 가능하게 하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 다양한 재난 상황에서 필요한 정보를 자동으로 탐색하고 분석하여, 상황 보고서나 대응 전략을 제안하는 인공지능 기반의 탐색 모델을 제공한다. 즉, 재난 상황 정보의 효율적인 수집 및 탐색을 지원하는 상황정보 지능형 탐색시스템에 있어서, 서버 컴퓨터는 상기 외부기관에서 전달된 각종 데이터들을 수집, 구조화하여 빅데이터로 축적하는 탐색 기반부와, 사용자의 질의응답이 접수되면 상기 탐색 기반부에 축적된 빅데이터를 이용하여 문제를 분석하고 답변 생성함으로써 분석보고서를 자동 생성할 수 있도록 하는 서비스 모델부로 구성되는데, 상기 탐색 기반부는 외부기관에서 전달된 각종 데이터들을 구조화된 정보(정형 데이터)와 비구조화된 정보(비정형 데이터)로 분류하여 처리하고, 수집, 구조화하여 빅데이터로 축적하고, 상기 서비스 모델부는 사용자의 질의응답이 접수되면 상기 탐색 기반부에 축적된 빅데이터를 이용하여 인공지능에 의해 문제 분석 및 답변 생성함으로써 분석보고서를 자동 생성할 수 있도록 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: NAT DISASTER MANAGEMENT RES INST

title_en: Energy storage resource scheduling optimization method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: A digital twin-based energy storage resource scheduling optimization method and system comprises the steps of 1, constructing a digital twin-based energy storage resource scheduling optimization platform, combining physical characteristics and historical data of an energy storage system to establish a digital twin model describing the running state of energy storage equipment, 2, carrying out joint modeling on a wind power generation system, a photovoltaic system and the energy storage system based on the constructed scheduling optimization platform to establish an equivalent model of the joint power generation system, 3, establishing physical and running constraint conditions of a multi-objective optimization function and a scheduling algorithm based on the established equivalent model of the joint power generation system to establish an energy storage system resource scheduling optimization problem, and 4, carrying out problem solving and dynamic adjustment by utilizing a differential evolution algorithm based on the established scheduling optimization problem. The method accurately reflects the running state of the energy storage system, improves the real-time response capability, remarkably improves the economy and stability of a dispatching scheme, and ensures the safety and feasibility of a dispatching strategy.
assignees: STATE POWER ZHEJIANG NINGHAI POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin simulation method and device for preventing seawater intrusion by pumping underground salt water
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin simulation method and a device for preventing seawater invasion by extracting underground salt water, which belong to the technical field of seawater invasion and comprise the following steps of S1, measuring corresponding values through a physical simulation device, utilizing a scaling factor and conversion to obtain physical basin information corresponding to nature, S2, constructing a digital twin model with multiple space-time dimensions, S3, constructing the digital twin model, S4, carrying out circular cross recombination on data characteristics based on a circular cross fusion mechanism, and carrying out fusion processing on the recombined characteristics by adopting a mixed Gaussian process, and S5, running the digital twin model in a virtual environment, simulating the seawater invasion condition under the real condition of nature, and realizing disaster monitoring in the physical basin range. The invention fully utilizes the digital twin technology to realize real-time synchronization of physical entities and virtual models, provides early warning for possible geological disasters, and provides decision support for orderly development and utilization of groundwater.
assignees: WATER RESOURCES RES INST SHANDONG PROVINCE

title_en: Reservoir flood control monitoring system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir flood control monitoring system and method based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of reservoir flood control monitoring and comprise a multi-source data acquisition module, wherein the digital twinning module is used for constructing and obtaining a digital twinning model according to real-time monitoring data of the multi-source data acquisition module, the coupling module is used for receiving a fusion data set provided by the digital twinning module and dynamically simulating the fusion data set to provide dynamic prediction results of dam seepage, deformation and flood evolution, the dynamic early warning module comprises a dynamic threshold adjusting unit and an early warning unit, dynamically optimizes the early warning threshold according to the real-time monitoring data and triggers early warning in real time, and compared with the traditional early warning system with fixed threshold, the system can adapt to the change of dam state and environmental conditions, identify potential abnormal events in advance, provide sufficient time for reservoir flood control to carry out emergency response and scheduling decision, so that disaster risk is effectively reduced, and safety of reservoir operation is ensured.
assignees: FUJIAN MEIFANG SHIDAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for building power distribution network planning digital twin system based on oblique photography technology
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for constructing a power distribution network planning digital twin system based on an oblique photography technology, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of 1 reconstructing a three-dimensional model of a power distribution area, 2 constructing a digital twin scene, and 3 optimizing a planning path of the power distribution network. The oblique photography technology can shoot ground images from multiple angles to generate a high-resolution three-dimensional model, and the point cloud data provides accurate terrain information, so that the combination of the two ensures high accuracy and detail richness of the model. Compared with the traditional manual measurement and paper map, the method greatly improves the efficiency of data acquisition and model construction, ensures the high consistency of the model and the actual environment, and improves the accuracy and feasibility of power distribution network planning.
assignees: SHAOXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: ERP and E-commerce platform bidirectional information flow integration method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for integrating two-way information flows of an ERP and an e-commerce platform, which relate to the technical field of information flow integration and ensure the non-tamper property and traceability of data through a block chain technology, an edge calculation module improves the data processing efficiency, an event driving module realizes loose coupling communication, a digital twin module maps the state of a supply chain in real time and predicts risks, a federal learning module jointly models and generates a sales strategy, a network slicing technology ensures the stability of the data flow, an Internet of things module enhances the real-time property of the data, a knowledge graph module solves the problem of data isomerism, the method realizes high-efficiency and safe two-way information flow integration through the steps of data recording, preprocessing, event abstraction, digital twin modeling, federal learning, network slicing, internet of things integration and the like, and an electronic device and a storage medium store a program to execute the method, thereby improving the management efficiency of the supply chain and the real-time property of data processing.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ZHIAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind power missing data complement method based on improvement WGAIN
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of wind power missing data completion. In order to solve the problem of wind power data missing, the invention provides a data complement method for generating an anti-interpolation network based on improvement. The method integrates a convolutional neural network, a long-short-time memory network and a self-attention mechanism in a generator so as to fully mine long-term dependence of time series data and potential correlation among multiple features. The discriminator optimizes the difference measurement between the generated data distribution and the real data distribution by introducing the Wasserstein distance, and remarkably improves the completion precision and the overall performance of the model on the missing data.

title_en: Navigation risk dynamic assessment method based on parallel acceleration
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of navigation risk assessment and flow field analysis, and particularly provides a navigation risk dynamic assessment method based on parallel acceleration, which comprises the following steps of data acquisition, drawing a two-dimensional unstructured grid, and carrying out terrain interpolation and numerical interpolation; setting up a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model based on CUDA parallel calculation, setting boundary conditions, carrying out model calculation on the set-up two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, deriving calculation data, drawing a virtual structure grid, carrying out spatial data interpolation, setting up a navigation risk assessment model, carrying out parallel calculation of spatial risks to obtain spatial risk ratings, setting up a risk assessment display platform based on a Cesium framework, dynamically updating navigation risk assessment results under different water flow conditions, and updating the spatial risk ratings after the flow and water level boundary conditions according to real-time updating of flow and water level boundaries. According to the method, the flow field simulation and navigation risk assessment efficiency is improved through a parallel computing technology, and a dynamic risk assessment result is displayed by combining a three-dimensional visual platform, so that powerful support is provided for safe navigation in complex water areas.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Coal preparation plant energy storage system and energy storage method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides an energy storage system and an energy storage method for a coal preparation plant based on digital twin, the energy storage system comprises a hybrid energy storage system, a battery management system, a high-voltage direct current protection system, a pre-charging/discharging loop, a high-voltage alternating current distribution system, a centralized PCS cluster and a power electronic interface of a power grid, and the battery energy storage is connected with power consumption equipment in a coal preparation plant in an integral row. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of power consumption equipment, acquiring a production scheduling plan of a coal preparation plant, determining power consumption equipment required by a process flow under the current production scheduling plan, simulating the work load of all the power consumption equipment under the current production scheduling plan through the digital twin model, predicting the electric quantity W required by a power price peak value under the current production scheduling plan according to the work load of the power consumption equipment, and configuring corresponding energy storage capacity. Through full flow efficiency management and control, production efficiency is improved, an electric energy storage system is established, and an optimal storage and discharge planning plan is given through a digital twin technology and local peak-valley electricity price, so that unit electricity consumption cost is reduced.

title_en: Multi-dimensional data fusion analysis method and device for digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides a multidimensional data fusion analysis method and device for a digital twin body, which relate to the technical field of data analysis and comprise the steps of constructing M fault prediction models in a target power plant; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-level data fusion modeling on a plurality of power plant systems, loading M fault prediction models to a plurality of system-level digital twin bodies, carrying out multi-level fault transfer analysis on a target power plant, carrying out fault conduction rendering on an initial twin body of the power plant according to a power plant fault state transfer diagram to obtain a digital twin body of the power plant, loading M real-time equipment operation data to the M fault prediction models to obtain M equipment operation states, and carrying out visualization on the M equipment operation states of the digital twin body of the power plant. The application can solve the technical problem of lower operation and maintenance efficiency of the power plant due to the lack of effective fusion of multidimensional data in the prior art, and the operation and maintenance efficiency of the power plant is improved by constructing the digital twin body of the power plant to realize the visualization of the operation state of the equipment.

title_en: GCB disassembly and assembly process auxiliary decision-making method based on measurement and digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GCB disassembly and assembly process auxiliary decision-making method based on measurement and digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of power generation equipment management. The method provided by the invention can guide the on-site maintainer to carry out the safe and efficient GCB dismounting process, and reduce the safety risk and human error in the GCB dismounting process, thereby improving the working efficiency and safety of the maintainer.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA RIVER YUNCHUAN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for searching unit grid-connected path
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine set grid-connected path searching method, which comprises the steps of dividing a machine set into a machine set by mutual exclusion, forming a connection strategy of mutual exclusion on each machine set in the machine set and different charged bus equipment, setting the machine set grid-connected constraint in the machine set by mutual exclusion, including constraint of whether automatic grid-connected path searching is carried out on a power-off machine set in the machine set and constraint of whether grid-connected path switching is carried out on a charged machine set or not, acquiring state estimation latest mode data, determining the charging state of the machine set, including the power-off machine set and the charged machine set, carrying out automatic grid-connected path searching according to the machine set grid-connected constraint in the state estimation, and carrying out grid-connected path switching according to the machine set grid-connected constraint in the state estimation. And the influence of mutual exclusion on the grid-connected paths among the units is considered, and the local adjustment is carried out on the grid-connected paths of the units by combining with the actual experience of scheduling operation, so that the load balance of the live bus equipment in the station is realized, and the reasonability of the future state operation mode of the power grid is improved.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for building energy management based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 건물 에너지 관리 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to perform occupancy estimation, energy waste diagnosis, and facility optimal operation by integrally analyzing energy-related data of a building, and to efficiently manage the use of building energy through a digital twin model. The present invention provides a digital twin-based building energy management device which performs occupancy estimation, energy waste calculation, and usage prediction for each zone based on energy-related data collected through a sensor, generates an air conditioner operation schedule and an optimal operating point for equipment, and optimizes energy management of a building by providing a digital twin model and a dashboard based on the data.
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 건물 에너지 관리 장치는 건물에 설치된 하나 이상의 센서를 이용하여 건물에 대한 실내 환경 데이터, 구역별 전력 사용량 데이터 또는 건물에 설치된 공조기의 공조기 운전 데이터 중 적어도 하나, 또는 이들의 조합을 포함하는 에너지 관련 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부, 구역별 전력 사용량 데이터에 기초하여 건물의 구역별 재실 추정 데이터를 생성하는 구역별 재실 추정부, 구역별 재실 추정 데이터에 기초하여 에너지 낭비량 데이터를 생성하는 에너지 낭비량 산출부, 및 에너지 낭비량 데이터 및 에너지 사용량 데이터에 기초하여 예상 에너지 권장량 데이터, 예상 에너지 낭비량 데이터 및 예상 에너지 사용량 데이터를 생성하는 에너지 사용량 예측부를 포함하는 에너지 낭비 진단부, 구역별 재실 추정 데이터, 실내 환경 데이터 및 공조기 운전 데이터에 기초하여 통계 데이터를 생성하는 통계 데이터 생성부 및 공조기 운전 데이터 및 기상 데이터에 기초하여 공조기의 최적화된 운전을 위한 공조기 운전 스케쥴 데이터를 생성하는 공조기 운전 스케쥴링부를 포함하는 공조기 운전 관리부, 구역별 재실 추정 데이터 및 실내 환경 데이터에 기초하여 건물의 실내 환경에 대한 실내 환경 진단 데이터를 생성하는 실내 쾌적도 진단부, 열원 시스템 운전 데이터 및 기상 데이터에 기초하여 상기 건물에 설치된 각 열원 시스템의 최적 운전점 데이터를 생성하는 설비 운전 관리부 및 건물의 구조 데이터, 데이터 수집부, 구역별 재실 추정부, 에너지 낭비 진단부, 공조기 운전 관리부, 실내 쾌적도 진단부 및 설비 운전 관리부 중 적어도 하나로부터 전달된 데이터에 기초하여 건물의 에너지 관리를 위한 디지털 트윈 모델을 생성 및 관리하는 디지털 트윈 관리부를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: SAMSUNG C&T CORP;EAN TECHNOTOSY CO LTD

title_en: Operational safety system for accident response of maritime autonomous surface ship
title_ko: 자율운항선박의 사고 대응을 위한 운항안전시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sailing safety system for responding to an accident of an autonomous sailing ship, which shares all accident situations and response situations occurring on a ship through real-time information sharing between a land control center and an autonomous sailing ship, and when the land control center requests the control authority of the accident ship, the control authority of the accident response system is automatically handed over to the land control center to perform an appropriate response in the event of a ship accident. The land control center includes: a digital twin bridge that shares the accident situation and response situation of the autonomous sailing ship based on a digital twin model; and the land accident response system that receives the accident situation and response situation of the autonomous sailing ship in real time through the digital twin bridge, implements a control item on a gui screen, simulates control equipment installed on the autonomous sailing ship with respect to a fire or flooding accident, and then controls a control device of the autonomous sailing ship through the simulation. The land accident response system receives the control authority of the autonomous sailing ship and responds to an accident of the autonomous sailing ship in real time.
abstract_ko: 육상제어센터와 자율운항선박 간에 실시간 정보공유를 통해 선박에서 발생하는 모든 사고상황 및 대응상황을 공유하며, 육상제어센터에서 사고선박의 제어권한을 요구할 경우 육상제어센터로 사고대응시스템의 제어권이 자동으로 인계되어 선박 사고시 적절한 대응이 이루어지도록 한 자율운항선박의 사고 대응을 위한 운항안전시스템에 관한 것으로서, 육상제어센터는 디지털 트윈 모델 기반으로 자율운항선박의 사고상황 및 대응상황을 공유하는 디지털 트윈 브릿지(Digital Twin Bridge), 디지털 트윈 브릿지를 통해 실시간으로 자율운항선박의 사고상황 및 대응상황을 수신하고, GUI 화면으로 제어항목을 구현하며, 화재 또는 침수 사고에 대하여 자율운항선박에 설치된 제어장비를 모사(MIMIC) 한 후, 상기 모사를 통해 자율운항선박의 제어장치를 제어하는 육상 사고대응시스템을 포함하여, 자율운항선박의 제어권한을 이양받아 육상 사고대응시스템에서 자율운항선박의 사고에 실시간 대응한다.
assignees: LEEYOUNG S&D CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-based factory energy management system
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 공장에너지 관리시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a digital twin-based factory energy management system comprises: a data collection unit for collecting modeling data of factory infrastructure including a plurality of distributed resources for producing renewable energy, a plurality of energy storage systems (esss) for storing the renewable energy, and process facilities installed in a factory; a modeling unit for generating a digital twin model of the factory infrastructure based on the modeling data and performing simulation of the digital twin model; and a maintenance determination unit for planning maintenance of the factory infrastructure based on operating parameters of the factory infrastructure calculated as a result of performing the simulation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 디지털 트윈 기반 공장 에너지 관리시스템은 재생에너지를 생산하는 복수의 분산자원, 상기 재생에너지를 저장하는 복수의 ESS(Energy Storage System) 및 공장 내 설치된 공정설비를 포함하는 공장 인프라의 모델링 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부; 상기 모델링 데이터를 기반으로 상기 공장 인프라의 디지털 트윈 모델을 생성하고, 상기 디지털 트윈 모델의 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 모델링부; 및 상기 시뮬레이션을 수행한 결과 산출된 상기 공장 인프라의 운영 파라미터를 기반으로 상기 공장 인프라의 유지 보수를 계획하는 유지보수 판단부를 포함한다.
assignees: HAEZOOM INC

title_en: Visualization method and apparatus for disaster spread prediction simulation
title_ko: 재난확산예측 시뮬레이션의 가시화 방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for visualizing a disaster spread prediction simulation and an apparatus thereof. The visualization device divides a target model of a virtual space into a grid structure, assigns an analysis value of a disaster spread prediction simulation for the target model to each grid, grasps a color corresponding to the analysis value assigned to each grid, visualizes the color of each grid, and displays the visualized color in a digital twin space.
abstract_ko: 재난확산예측 시뮬레이션의 가시화 방법 및 그 장치가 개시된다. 가시화장치는 가상공간의 대상모델을 격자 구조로 분할하고, 대상모델에 대한 재난확산예측 시뮬레이션의 분석값을 각 격자에 부여하고, 각 격자에 부여된 분석값에 해당하는 색상을 파악하고, 각 격자의 색상을 가시화하여 디지털트윈공간에 표시한다.
assignees: CMWORLD CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin previewing submerged disaster assessment method, device and program product based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-forward submerged disaster assessment method, device and program product based on deep learning, wherein the digital twin-forward submerged disaster assessment method comprises the following steps of collecting basic geographic data, natural resource investigation data, geological data, meteorological data, water conservancy basic data and rainwater condition monitoring data; the method comprises the steps of training a convolutional neural network deep learning model by using basic geographic data, natural resource investigation data, geological data, meteorological data, water conservancy basic data and rainwater condition monitoring data, creating a terrain three-dimensional model according to image data and terrain data, extracting key features from the image data and the terrain data, constructing a digital twin base three-dimensional model based on the extracted key features and the terrain three-dimensional model, performing submerged disaster simulation and previewing by using the hydrodynamic model, the digital twin base three-dimensional model and the trained convolutional neural network deep learning model, evaluating based on simulation and prediction results, and visually displaying simulation results and evaluation data.
assignees: NEWCAPEC ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source pregnancy and disaster data fusion preprocessing method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multisource pregnancy disaster data fusion preprocessing method, a multisource pregnancy disaster data fusion preprocessing system and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source disaster-pregnant data, including lightning monitoring data, satellite remote sensing data and radar observation data, carrying out data quality control processing on the lightning monitoring data, carrying out missing data processing on the satellite remote sensing data, carrying out interpolation on the processed satellite remote sensing data and radar observation data in space and time to obtain uniform space-time resolution, carrying out gridding processing on the processed lightning monitoring data, carrying out alignment on the processed lightning monitoring data and the interpolated satellite remote sensing data and radar observation data in space and time to obtain uniform space-time resolution, carrying out normalization processing on the multi-source disaster-pregnant data after obtaining the uniform space-time resolution, and storing the multi-source disaster-pregnant data after normalization processing according to a preset mode or format for lightning prediction. The method is applied to lightning prediction, and the accuracy and reliability of prediction are improved.
assignees: WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Campus fire monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a campus fire monitoring method and system, and relates to the technical field of fire monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring smoke values sent by all smoke sensors in a campus and image information sent by a camera device; the method comprises the steps of judging whether a fire disaster happens or not based on smoke values and image information, determining a fire disaster occurrence area based on position information of a corresponding smoke sensor and image information sent by a fire disaster camera after the fire disaster is judged to happen, dynamically simulating a fire disaster spreading trend based on a digital twin model and combining a smoke spreading prediction algorithm to generate a dynamic thermodynamic diagram, dividing an affected area and a safe area based on the dynamic thermodynamic diagram, controlling display equipment and broadcasting equipment in the affected area to broadcast first warning information, controlling the display equipment and the broadcasting equipment in the safe area to broadcast second warning information, and monitoring escape conditions of personnel in all areas and updating the first warning information in real time. The application has the effects of enabling personnel in different fire areas to acquire targeted information and improving the efficiency of the personnel in coping with the fire.
assignees: SICHUAN VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Event scheduling distributed estimation method of renewable micro-grid system under sensor network framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses an event scheduling distributed estimation method of a renewable micro-grid system under a sensor network framework, which comprises the following steps of firstly, establishing a dynamic model of the renewable micro-grid system under the sensor network framework; the method comprises the steps of constructing a distributed estimator, deriving one-step prediction of an ith sensor node at a kth moment, calculating an upper bound of one-step prediction error covariance of the ith sensor node at the kth moment, deriving a distributed estimator parameter of the ith sensor node at a kth+1 moment by minimizing a trace of the upper bound of the estimation error covariance, deriving state estimation of the ith sensor node at the kth+1 moment, and solving the upper bound of the estimation error covariance of the ith sensor node at the kth+1 moment. The invention solves the problem that the existing state estimation method can not simultaneously process the state estimation of the renewable micro-grid system under the sensor network frame with inaccurate occurrence probability loss measurement and dynamic event triggering mechanism.
assignees: UNIV HARBIN SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Energy efficiency grading and carbon emission evaluation method for communication base station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy management and discloses an energy efficiency grading and carbon emission evaluation method for a communication base station, which comprises the steps of acquiring real-time operation data through an Internet of things sensor deployed in the communication base station; the method comprises the steps of generating dynamic weight configuration parameters based on base station types and climate characteristics, constructing a digital twin model based on the verified dynamic weight configuration parameters and real-time operation data, simulating multidimensional energy consumption characteristic curves under different load rates through the digital twin model, performing space-time matching on the multidimensional energy consumption characteristic curves and regional power grid dynamic carbon emission factors to generate a carbon emission intensity matrix of a communication base station, inputting the multidimensional energy consumption characteristic curves and the carbon emission intensity matrix into a pre-trained energy efficiency grading model to output an energy efficiency grading result and a carbon emission evaluation report of the communication base station, and improving the accuracy of energy efficiency grading and carbon emission evaluation of the communication base station.

title_en: Power grid operation mode characteristic prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting the running mode characteristics of a power grid, which relate to the technical field of characteristic prediction and comprise the steps of collecting and storing historical data of the power grid and monitoring the data in real time; the method comprises the steps of analyzing historical data to identify and summarize key factors influencing the running mode characteristics of a power grid, predicting the future running mode characteristics of the power grid according to the identified key factors and real-time monitoring data, generating a prediction report, and using the generated prediction report in a power grid management to guide real-time scheduling and optimization of the power grid. The method ensures the comprehensiveness and real-time performance of the data, thereby providing an accurate prediction basis for the operation mode of the power grid. By further analyzing the data, key factors influencing the operation of the power grid are identified, and the prediction model capable of dynamically reflecting the state change of the power grid is constructed, so that not only is the accuracy of prediction improved, but also the rapid change of the power grid condition is adapted through real-time updating, and the scheduling flexibility and accuracy of the power grid in handling emergencies are enhanced.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based energy storage power station potential safety hazard analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage power station management, and discloses a digital twinning-based energy storage power station potential safety hazard analysis method and a digital twinning-based energy storage power station potential safety hazard analysis system. The data calculation module calculates the spatial gradient change trend of each index, and the potential safety hazard prediction module predicts the potential safety hazard level by combining a deep learning algorithm. The early warning module automatically triggers and sends early warning information according to the prediction result, and the user interaction module provides an intuitive display interface. The method can monitor the running state of the energy storage power station in real time, accurately forecast potential safety hazards, and timely send out early warning, so that the safety and stability of the energy storage power station are effectively improved, the risk of safety accidents is reduced, and powerful guarantee is provided for the stable running of the power system.
assignees: XILINGOL LEAGUE XINGNENG ENERGY STORAGE ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment data tracing method based on ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ant colony algorithm-based power equipment data tracing method which comprises the steps of determining correlation among data in an incomplete data set of power equipment, and tracing the power equipment data through the ant colony algorithm based on the complete data set constructed by the correlation among the data. The method and the device can be suitable for tracing the data of the power equipment of the incomplete data set with a large number of missing data, and can improve the tracing efficiency of the search data.
assignees: BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent digital dynamic water conservancy management and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent digital dynamic water conservancy management and control system and method based on the field of Hong Xun monitoring and early warning, comprising a digital twin module, an early warning module, a flood discharge buffer degree calculation module and a control module, wherein the digital twin module is used for constructing a digital ecological environment model in a region based on acquired water conservancy information, the digital ecological environment model comprises a single digital water area unit and digital ecological environment twin units, each unit comprises a plurality of fluctuation points, the fluctuation points are used as input and sent to the digital ecological environment model, the model outputs a single water area dynamic expected diagram, and the water area dynamic expected diagram comprises a water area change curve and an ecological simulation change diagram Flood discharge kurtosis of digital simulation body of water area And carrying out flood discharge early warning response by combining a plurality of water area dynamic expected graphs, wherein the flood discharge buffer degree is used for evaluating the influence of the environment on the water area, and the flood discharge kurtosis is used for evaluating the flood discharge trend.
assignees: ZHEJIANG WUXIN SHUKE INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent management method and system for water conservancy construction progress
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent management method and system for water conservancy construction progress. The method comprises the steps of collecting project planning of hydraulic engineering, obtaining dynamic changes in a life cycle through an integrated building information model technology to generate a hydraulic construction progress management frame, extracting multi-source heterogeneous data, integrating cross-modal information by using a multi-modal fusion network algorithm, evaluating specific influences of external environmental factors by using a causal forest technology to generate a hydraulic construction progress and risk early warning report, establishing a dynamic equation by using a graph neural differential equation algorithm, performing dynamic system simulation, constructing a virtual hydraulic construction environment by using an enhanced digital twin simulation technology to capture construction efficiency and resource utilization conditions to generate a hydraulic construction resource configuration optimization report, setting a lean improvement plan by introducing a lean six-sigma methodology, collecting project feedback, and generating a hydraulic construction progress intelligent management scheme. The technical scheme provided by the application obviously improves the intelligent level of water conservancy construction progress management.
assignees: CHONGQING HUAJIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mechanism model and digital twin double-feedback flood simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a method and a system for simulating flood based on a mechanism model and digital twinning double feedback, which comprises the following steps of S1, flood data conversion processing; S2, triangulation by an ear cutting method, S3, editing a programmed grid body, and S4, simulating flood evolution. Compared with the prior art, the method can realize accurate modeling of the flood in the flood simulation, and simultaneously ensures the real-time performance and accuracy of the simulation result. The application of the ear cutting method improves the rendering efficiency of the grid body and the simulation precision, and provides powerful technical support for flood simulation.
assignees: INSPUR SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based flood storage area risk-benefit dynamic game regulation and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood storage area regulation and control, in particular to a digital twinning-based flood storage area risk-benefit dynamic game regulation and control method. The method comprises the steps of dynamically simulating a real-time flood event based on a digital twin model to obtain probability distribution data, carrying out multi-objective iterative optimization solving on a historical flood diversion regulation strategy based on the probability distribution data to generate a multi-objective optimal balance set, generating a real-time controllable gate regulation instruction set based on the digital twin model and the optimal balance set, and carrying out quantitative evaluation on the risk and benefit regulated and controlled in a flood storage area in the process of regulating and controlling a gate in real time through the gate regulation instruction set. The invention realizes high precision, dynamic and intelligent regulation and control of the flood storage area, realizes accurate quantitative assessment of risk and benefit of the flood storage area, provides scientific basis for flood control decision, and effectively reduces flood disaster loss and ecological influence.
assignees: GUANGDONG RES INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER

title_en: Three-dimensional digital twin system and method for mining power equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional digital twin system and method for mining power equipment, wherein an equipment model is built according to structural data and operation data of the power equipment, data change information of the operation data is dynamically bound with the equipment model to obtain real-time model data, a plurality of real-time operation states of the power equipment are obtained through dynamic analysis, operation trends of the power equipment are analyzed through the real-time operation states, the equipment model is controlled to simulate the operation trends to obtain a plurality of fault presentation features of the power equipment, each fault presentation feature is respectively displayed through the equipment model, early warning is carried out on equipment fault items with abnormal fault grades, fault management information of the power equipment is generated and displayed, state analysis and fault prediction are carried out through a model technology, and visual monitoring, fault prediction and intelligent management work of the power equipment are realized.
assignees: BEIJING GUOLI ELECTRICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation analysis method and system for electric power engineering cost based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application discloses a simulation analysis method and a system for electric power engineering cost based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of simulation analysis; the method comprises the steps of processing a plurality of engineering task multi-modal data and task dependency relations based on a digital twin technology to construct an electric power engineering virtual model, inputting the electric power engineering virtual model into a graph neural network to extract task node characteristics corresponding to each engineering task virtual module through a message transmission mechanism, and defining an input state of a reinforcement learning model according to each extracted task node characteristic to generate task resource allocation actions aiming at each engineering task through reinforcement learning. Therefore, the digital twin technology, the graph theory feature extraction technology and the reinforcement learning technology are comprehensively applied to monitor and simulate and analyze the cost and the resource consumption of different links in the power engineering in real time, and the resource allocation is intelligently optimized.

title_en: Digital twin self-adaptive modeling method for data-driven comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin self-adaptive modeling method of a data-driven comprehensive energy system. The method is suitable for the field of digital twin modeling of the comprehensive energy system. The technical scheme includes that the digital twin self-adaptive modeling method of the comprehensive energy system driven by data comprises the steps of constructing a training data set based on actual operation data of the comprehensive energy system, dividing the training data set into a plurality of sub-data sets representing different operation conditions by means of a k-means clustering algorithm, carrying out data enhancement on the sub-data sets of different operation conditions by means of a generation countermeasure network so that sample number difference among the sub-data sets of the operation conditions is within a preset range, and training a digital twin model of the comprehensive energy system based on the training data set subjected to data enhancement.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Modeling quality evaluation method and device for digital twin model of power transmission engineering
abstract_en: The application relates to a modeling quality evaluation method and device for a digital twin model of a power transmission project. The method comprises the steps of determining an evaluation index of modeling quality of a digital twin model of the power transmission project, wherein the evaluation index comprises at least one of project geographic information quality, three-dimensional design model quality, document data quality and file format quality, obtaining modeling information of the digital twin model of the power transmission project and actual information of the power transmission project, the digital twin model of the power transmission project is obtained by modeling the power transmission project, determining qualitative detection results of the evaluation index according to the modeling information and the actual information, determining quantitative detection results of the evaluation index according to the modeling information and the actual information, and determining modeling quality detection results of the digital twin model of the power transmission project according to the qualitative detection results and the quantitative detection results. By adopting the method, the modeling effect of the digital twin in the field of power transmission engineering can be accurately estimated.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID ENERGY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power equipment maintenance method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power equipment, in particular to a digital twinning-based power equipment maintenance method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring running state data of the power equipment; the method comprises the steps of carrying out abnormality detection analysis on running state data to obtain an abnormality detection result, determining a health index of the power equipment based on the abnormality detection result, calculating a maintenance priority index of the power equipment according to the health index, determining a maintenance management strategy according to the maintenance priority index, and executing maintenance management measures on the power equipment based on the maintenance management strategy. The application can improve the maintenance accuracy of the power equipment and reduce the operation and maintenance cost.
assignees: SHANDONG DENENG IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power transmission line management and control method and system based on power distribution data feedback
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control method and system for a power transmission line based on power distribution data feedback, which relate to the technical field of power transmission line control and comprise the following steps: by integrating multi-source data, a historical environment-electric coupling characteristic matrix is constructed, a long-short-time memory network is utilized to extract time sequence characteristics, a convolutional neural network is combined to capture a spatial distribution rule, and a dynamic line loss prediction model is established to simulate minimum line loss values in different environment scenes. Detecting abnormal time periods through an isolated forest algorithm, screening key damage factors by combining Pearson correlation analysis and SHAP value analysis, dynamically generating and executing a damage reduction strategy priority event, and optimizing model parameters by utilizing error back propagation and reinforcement learning. And finally, generating a typical environmental scene loss reduction case library based on an optimization model, and simulating strategy effectiveness under extreme conditions through a digital twin technology to form a reusable decision rule set, so that the running efficiency and the power supply reliability of the power transmission line are improved.
assignees: KARAMAY PETROLOR ENERGY SERVICES CO LTD;XINJIANG PETROLOR ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: River basin digital twin construction method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The application provides a drainage basin digital twin construction method and system based on multi-source data fusion. The method is applied to the technical field of drainage basin digital twin construction, and comprises the steps of obtaining water level monitoring data, surface flood evolution path data, weather forecast rainfall data and terrain gradient change data, generating a runoff distribution relation by fusing the rainfall and the terrain gradient data, and identifying a high risk area by combining the water level abrupt change amplitude. And establishing a digital twin primary frame, and generating relevant characteristic parameters by utilizing reverse feedback of the flood path and the water level data. Inputting meteorological data, constructing a twin model based on boundary conditions of a water collecting area, and simulating abnormal flood direction and inundation early warning signals. And generating emergency schemes such as flood diversion gate scheduling, flood storage area starting and the like according to the pre-warning space-time distribution and the terrain elevation data, and realizing risk grading management and control. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the flood inundation prediction precision and emergency response efficiency, and provides accurate decision support for flood control in the river basin.
assignees: SHUIFA PLANNING & DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Carbon emission evaluation method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the field of carbon emission evaluation, and particularly provides a carbon emission evaluation method and system based on digital twinning, wherein in the evaluation method, a digital twinning model comprising an energy consumption behavior model is constructed; respectively taking building operation data, environment data and household behavior data as inputs of an LSTM (energy consumption behavior model) network, carrying out feature extraction to obtain feature vectors, carrying out splicing fusion on the feature vectors to obtain fusion feature vectors, carrying out feature screening on the fusion feature vectors based on an attention mechanism, inputting the attention feature vectors obtained by screening as inputs of an MLP (multi-level hierarchical) hierarchical model to obtain carbon emission energy consumption level of a target building, and carrying out carbon emission assessment on a digital twin model of the current target building based on the carbon emission energy consumption level. According to the invention, through the evaluation of the carbon emission energy consumption level, the carbon emission condition of the building can be comprehensively and accurately known, and the digital twin model can reflect the running state and the carbon emission condition of the building in real time.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY CONSTR GROUP CO;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION GROUP MECH AND ELECTRICAL INSTALLATION CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic sensing and analyzing processing method and system for supply and demand double-side high-frequency multidimensional load information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic sensing and analyzing processing method and a system for supply and demand double-side high-frequency multidimensional load information, wherein the method collects supply and demand double-side power load data, performs preprocessing operation on the data, identifies and corrects abnormal data, and fills missing data; and integrating and unfolding the acquired data information by adopting an ensemble empirical mode decomposition method and a variation modal decomposition method, and then stabilizing the data. The EEMD method is suitable for processing signals with nonlinear and non-stationary characteristics, the VMD method is more suitable for processing signals which need to accurately control frequency and reduce modal aliasing, and the improved transducer model is adopted for modeling short-term power load information so as to predict future development trend of the load information. The method can effectively reduce the calculated amount of the prediction model, improve the precision of power load prediction, and has stronger robustness and adaptability.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based transregional power scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based cross-regional power scheduling method and system, which comprise the steps of obtaining power equipment parameters, power scheduling parameters and environment parameters in each power supply region, building a digital twin model of each power supply region based on the power equipment parameters, the power scheduling parameters and the environment parameters, configuring different types of cross-regional power scheduling tasks in the digital twin model, pre-training a MMOE model of a multi-subtask network, predicting parameter values of different types of parameters in the digital twin model by using a trained MMOE model, obtaining differential data of the same type of parameters in the power supply region, obtaining the power equipment parameters, the power scheduling parameters and the environment parameters in the current corresponding power supply region, inputting the differential data, the power equipment parameters, the power scheduling parameters and the environment parameters into the trained MMOE model, and outputting the cross-regional power scheduling tasks through a task network of the trained MMOE model.
assignees: HUANENG ZHEJIANG ENERGY DEV CO LTD CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH;HANGZHOU PROAIM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for deciding emergency treatment of natural disaster damage of reservoir dam system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency treatment, and discloses a method and a system for determining natural disaster damage emergency treatment of a dam system, wherein the method comprises the steps of classifying preprocessed multi-source data by using a clustering algorithm and constructing a disaster information database based on a classification result; the method comprises the steps of constructing a risk assessment model to assess damage risk of natural disasters to a dam system, generating a plurality of emergency treatment strategies by combining a multi-objective optimization algorithm, screening out an optimal emergency treatment strategy by using a scene simulation technology, distributing resources by using a dynamic resource distribution algorithm, simulating the dam system in real time by using a digital twin technology to predict the damage risk, executing corresponding emergency treatment measures and recording emergency treatment effect data, assessing the emergency treatment effect data by using a data envelopment analysis algorithm, and optimizing the risk assessment model based on an assessment result. The invention enhances the data integration and processing capacity and improves the accuracy and stability of the prediction result.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;BEIJING IWHR KHL CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional digital intelligent monitoring system suitable for photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional digital intelligent monitoring system suitable for a photovoltaic power station, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power station monitoring and comprises a model construction unit, a hanging storage unit, a three-dimensional overview unit, an abnormality identification unit and a monitoring alarm unit, wherein the model construction unit is used for acquiring multi-dimensional electrical equipment attribute parameters and constructing an equipment model, the hanging storage unit is used for hanging the equipment model to real-time operation data and carrying out distributed storage on the real-time operation data, the three-dimensional overview unit is used for constructing a three-dimensional model of the photovoltaic power station and dynamically displaying the real-time operation state of each equipment model of the photovoltaic power station, the abnormality identification unit is used for constructing an abnormality identification model based on deep learning and analyzing potential abnormality existing in the photovoltaic power station, and the monitoring alarm unit is used for monitoring the operation parameters of the photovoltaic power station in real time and realizing alarm monitoring. According to the invention, through three-dimensional digital twin modeling and real-time data hooking, a comprehensive power station information display platform is constructed, dynamic monitoring of power station equipment can be realized, and the efficiency and the accuracy of monitoring the photovoltaic power station are improved.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGKE LIFON TECH CO LTD;ZHONGKE YUNSHANG NANJING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban pipe network intelligent water supply system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent water supply, and provides an intelligent urban pipe network water supply system and method based on the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of acquiring pipe network information in real time through a data acquisition module, uploading the pipe network information to a cloud platform through a data transmission module, analyzing the pipe network information and marking abnormal data through a data processing module, predicting pipe network state change by combining a digital twin model with the acquired real-time pipe network information, automatically generating a regulation and control scheme when pressure abnormality or water quality exceeding is detected, sending a regulation and control instruction to an execution module, adjusting output power of a variable-frequency water pump and opening of an electric regulating valve according to the regulation and control instruction by the execution module to realize dynamic balance of the pipe network, synchronously updating pipe network operation state through a visual interface, and solving the technical problems of lag of regulation and control decision of a water supply system, excessive dependence on manual experience and the like in the prior art.
assignees: LINYI HUANXIANG WATER METER CO LTD

title_en: Power network multi-error parameter identification method and device based on relaxation-regularization
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-error parameter identification method and device for an electric power network based on relaxation-regularization, the method comprises the steps of establishing a mixed integer nonlinear programming model of multiple measurement sections and regularized weighted least square estimation, which are used for considering the quantity constraint of error parameters, based on a state estimation model of a power system weighted least square, converting the mixed integer nonlinear programming model based on a residual equation, so that the quantity of variables is reduced and cannot be increased along with the quantity increase of the measurement sections, solving the converted model by IPOPT, sorting continuous variables s  i  of all parameters in descending order after solving, selecting the first k parameters as suspicious parameters, checking each suspicious parameter one by one, and identifying the wrong parameters by using a state augmentation method.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY;INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HEBEI UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY SHIJIAZHUANG

title_en: Power distribution network state evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network state evaluation method and a system, which relate to the technical field of power distribution network state evaluation, wherein, a plurality of measurement data of a power distribution network to be evaluated are obtained, each measurement data is screened based on a preset window length to obtain corresponding mutation measurement data and target measurement data, performing anomaly detection on each abrupt change measurement data based on a preset false data detection model to obtain corresponding target false measurement data, performing self-adaptive filtering processing on each target false measurement data to obtain corresponding target state values, and performing state evaluation on the power distribution network to be evaluated according to each target state value and the target measurement data. The method and the system solve the technical problems that in the prior art, the state of the power distribution network is mainly estimated through a robust state estimation method, but all fluctuation data are generally regarded as false data, so that erroneous judgment on real fluctuation data is caused, and the accuracy of the state estimation of the power distribution network is reduced.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: System and merhod for predicting power generation of solar power plants based on digital twin model
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 모델 기반 태양광 발전소 발전량 예측 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a method for predicting a photovoltaic power plant power generation amount based on a digital twin model. The method comprises the steps of: obtaining location information and weather information of a solar power plant; generating a digital twin model for cloud movement simulation based on area information where the solar power plant is located and weather conditions corresponding to the area information; modeling movement information of clouds by inputting area weather pattern information to the digital twin model; obtaining solar radiation amount prediction information for each time slot in the future by inputting the modeled movement information of the clouds to a pre-trained artificial intelligence model; and predicting the amount of power generation of the solar power plant by calculating thermal information of a solar panel corresponding to the solar radiation amount prediction information.
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈 모델 기반 태양광 발전소 발전량 예측 방법이 제공된다. 상기 방법은 태양광 발전소의 위치 정보 및 기상 정보를 획득하는 단계; 상기 태양광 발전소가 위치한 지역 정보 및 상기 지역 정보에 대응하는 기상 조건을 기반으로 구름 이동 모사를 위한 디지털 트윈 모델을 생성하는 단계; 상기 디지털 트윈 모델에 지역 기상 패턴 정보를 입력하여 구름의 이동정보를 모델링하는 단계; 상기 모델링된 구름의 이동 정보를 미리 학습된 인공지능 모델에 입력하여 향후 시간대별 태양광 일사량 예측 정보를 획득하는 단계; 및 상기 태양광 일사량 예측 정보에 대응하는 태양광 패널의 열 정보를 산출하여 태양광 발전소의 발전량을 예측하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Building integrated photovoltaic power generation potential prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building integrated photovoltaic power generation potential prediction method and system, which belong to the technical field of building photovoltaic power generation evaluation and comprise the steps of integrating space form prediction data, remote sensing images and GIS of buildings in a set area, constructing a three-dimensional set area digital twin model, adopting a deep learning algorithm to identify land property, dividing functional partitions, determining the total building area of the set area based on the three-dimensional set area digital twin model, determining the building integrated photovoltaic available area and the building integrated photovoltaic installation density by the partitions, determining the optimal installation angle and arrangement mode of building integrated photovoltaic modules by utilizing an optimization algorithm, respectively determining the radiation quantity and the effective surface area of the surfaces of the photovoltaic modules in different partitions, and predicting the photovoltaic developable installed capacity and annual power generation potential of the different partitions in the space form adjustment period of the building by constructing a fused decomposition strategy and a time sequence prediction model of a fused group intelligent optimization algorithm.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Medical instrument inventory prediction and optimization method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to a medical equipment inventory prediction and optimization method and system based on big data, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a dynamic unified representation vector through collecting hospital inventory, supply chain logistics, an Internet of things sensor and external environment data in real time, cleaning, standardization and modal alignment; the vector is input into a hybrid modeling system, future inventory demands are predicted by using a deep neural network, a confidence interval is calculated, meanwhile, a discrete event simulation logistics and storage process based on supply chain system dynamics is adopted, and bidirectional feedback is realized through a Bayesian updating algorithm, so that model parameters are updated in a self-adaptive mode. Finally, the digital twin simulation platform carries out discrete simulation on future inventory operation scenes and generates feedback signals for updating the hybrid modeling system on line, so that closed-loop self-adaptive updating of inventory prediction and optimization is realized, and the accuracy and response speed of inventory management are remarkably improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI BEITONG MEDICAL EQUIPMENT MAN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Damage detection method and system based on self-adaptive update digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damage detection method and a damage detection system based on a self-adaptive updating digital twin technology, which relate to the technical field of civil engineering and comprise the steps of receiving initial offline information, and generating a component information database based on a semi-automatic parameterized modeling method and the initial offline information; the method comprises the steps of updating information data of a component information database by adopting an adaptive damage identification method based on an L curve method, updating a pre-established digital twin model based on the updated component information database to obtain an updated digital twin model, and realizing damage prediction and reinforcement scheme damage verification before disaster based on the updated digital twin model and combining with elastoplastic damage nonlinear analysis based on a virtual model to realize cloud data driving and model driving digital twin model self-updating.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Power enterprise factory safety production monitoring method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring the safe production of a power enterprise factory based on a digital twin technology, comprising the following steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of the power enterprise factory and preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional virtual model of a power enterprise factory, dynamically mapping preprocessed multi-source heterogeneous data with the three-dimensional virtual model, constructing a multi-factor coupling simulation model, analyzing the influence degree of each factor in the power enterprise factory on safety production based on the multi-factor coupling simulation model, constructing a safety risk assessment model, assessing the influence degree of the safety production, comparing an assessment result with a preset safety threshold, and triggering an early warning mechanism when the preset safety threshold is exceeded. The method and the device realize timely discovery and elimination of potential safety hazards in the factory of the power enterprise, optimize the production operation strategy and effectively improve the intrinsic safety level.
assignees: HUANENG CHONGQING LIANGJIANG GAS TURBINE POWER GENERATION CO LTD;BEIJING LEVCN ELECTRIC TECH CORPORATION LIMITED

title_en: Urban underground security risk assessment method and device based on dynamic updating algorithm, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of urban underground safety management and discloses an urban underground safety risk assessment method, an urban underground safety risk assessment device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on a dynamic updating algorithm, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an urban underground safety risk assessment matrix and quantifying risk factors; optimizing the weight of the risk factors, dynamically adjusting the weight, constructing an improved Bayesian network model, utilizing the Bayesian network model to carry out reasoning, predicting the overall risk state of the underground system and identifying key risk factors, constructing a complex risk factor network model, determining the key risk factors, carrying out time sequence evolution modeling on the state of the risk factors, carrying out dynamic updating on the state of the risk factors by combining with real-time monitoring data, and finally outputting an evaluation result, wherein the evaluation result comprises the overall risk state, the key risk factors and the risk variation trend of the underground system. The application can realize scientific quantification, real-time updating and dynamic evaluation of urban underground safety risk, and provides high-efficiency and accurate technical support for safety management of an underground system.
assignees: HUACE DISASTER PREVENTION TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Distributed fire situation sensing and collaborative early warning method for building group
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed fire situation sensing and collaborative early warning method for a building group, which relates to the technical field of building groups and comprises the steps of collecting fire data through smoke sensing, temperature sensing and infrared imaging nodes, generating a fire feature vector by adopting a distributed preprocessing algorithm, and constructing a multidimensional fire correlation matrix; and training based on the graph structure neural network to generate a dynamic evolution model of the building group fire disaster, and calculating a fire disaster spread prediction result by combining with a digital twin platform of the building group to generate a differential early warning instruction. The intelligent sensing, dynamic prediction and collaborative early warning of the fire conditions of the building group are realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of fire early warning are improved.

title_en: Management method and system of integrated intelligent machine room
abstract_en: The invention provides a management method and a system of an integrated intelligent machine room, wherein a key factor identification result is obtained through a state information flow from a distributed sensing network, a dynamic risk assessment model is constructed to generate a region prediction report, a digital twin environment is obtained according to the region prediction report, an optimal adjustment instruction is generated by combining a security policy base and a self-adaptive learning algorithm, an intelligent regulation and control record is generated by utilizing a software-defined network controller, a virtual reality guidance tool is used for conducting on-site operation guidance to obtain a complete operation guidance log, an operation record chain is generated through an intelligent contract mechanism, an optimal candidate case base is generated based on the operation record chain, and an optimal candidate case is confirmed and learned according to the operation record chain and the optimal candidate case base by combining a group intelligent algorithm, so that an intelligent machine room alliance network is obtained.
assignees: TIANJIN YUANLIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Optical storage charging and discharging integrated power station energy intelligent management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy management exploitation, in particular to an optical storage, charging and discharging integrated power station energy intelligent management system based on digital twinning, which comprises the following components: the digital twin visualization module is used for establishing a data twin model for all data of each module and visualizing the data; the intelligent analysis and prediction module is used for determining the charging probability of each vehicle at each charging station in each time period and predicting the vehicle visit density of the corresponding charging station, and the energy optimization scheduling module is used for managing the number of V2G vehicles of the charging station according to the minimum required vehicle number and the vehicle visit density in each time period. The application aims to ensure that the charging requirement of an electric automobile user is not ignored when energy optimization scheduling is carried out, and avoid queuing and waiting.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Digital twin platform for disaster situation recognition data linkage support for national SOC safety management
title_ko: 국민 soc 안전관리를 위한 재난 상황인지 데이터 연계지원 디지털트윈 플랫폼
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital twin platform for supporting disaster situation recognition data linkage for national SOC safety management, in which various public SOC infrastructure and living infrastructure such as bridges, roads, and railways are formed, and accordingly, fire, flooding, and collapse are linked to areas exposed to the risk of collapse such as flooding and landslides due to heavy rain, thereby displaying complex disaster crisis rapid response and recovery key information on a digital twin and providing the same. input raw data information entering IoT sensors, CCTV, and OpenAPI is stored/managed through a data proxy server, and the disaster situation is analyzed through edges and AI servers with respect to the received data, and transmitted to a backup server to be composed of dashboards or digital twins.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 교량, 도로, 철도 등의 다양한 공공 SOC 인프라와 생활기반시설들이 형성되어 있고 그로 인해 폭우에 따른 침수, 산사태 등 붕괴 위험에 노출되는 지역에 대해서 화재, 침수, 붕괴를 연계하여 복합적 재난 위기 신속 대응 및 회복 중점 정보를 디지털트윈상에 표출시켜 제공하는 국민 SOC 안전관리를 위한 재난 상황인지 데이터 연계지원 디지털트윈 플랫폼에 관한 것으로, IOT 센서 및 CCTV, OpenAPI로 들어오는 입력 Raw 데이터 정보를 Data Proxy Server를 통해서 데이터를 저장/관리하고, 들어온 데이터에 대해서 Edge 및 AI Server를 통해서 재난 상황에 대한 분석을 진행하며 이를 Backend 서버에 전달하여 대시보드 또는 디지털 트윈으로 이루어질 수 있다.
assignees: MGEN SOLUTINS CO LTD

title_en: Optimal operation system for smart energy communities through digital twins
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 통한 스마트 에너지 커뮤니티의 최적 운영 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an optimal operating system of a smart energy community through a digital twin comprises: an energy community server collecting energy usage monitoring information of a community including usage power and accumulated power; and a digital twin server receiving the accumulated energy usage monitoring information from the energy community server to generate a digital twin model of the smart energy community, and simulating and analyzing a power system state of the smart energy community in real time through the digital twin model. The digital twin server monitors a power operating state of the smart energy community, predicts power consumption of the community after a predetermined time according to environmental information and a power usage history, and compares the predicted power consumption with a reserve power amount of the energy community to perform power saving control of the energy community as a result of the comparison.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 디지털 트윈을 통한 스마트 에너지 커뮤니티의 최적 운영 시스템에 있어서, 이용 전력 및 누적 전력을 포함하는 커뮤니티의 에너지 사용량 모니터링 정보를 수집하는 에너지 커뮤니티 서버; 상기 에너지 커뮤니티 서버로부터 누적된 에너지 사용량 모니터링 정보를 전달받아 상기 스마트 에너지커뮤니티의 디지털 트윈 모델을 생성하고, 상기 디지털 트윈 모델을 통해 스마트 에너지 커뮤니티의 전력 시스템 상태를 실시간으로 시뮬레이션하고 분석하는 디지털 트윈 서버; 를 포함하고, 상기 디지털 트윈 서버는 스마트 에너지 커뮤니티의 전력 운영상태를 모니터링하고 환경 정보와 전력 사용 이력에 따라 일정 시간 후의 상기 커뮤니티의 전력 소비량을 예측하고, 상기 예측된 전력 소비량과 상기 에너지 커뮤니티의 예비 전력량을 비교하여 상기 비교 결과에 상기 에너지커뮤니티의 전력 절약 제어를 수행할 수 있다.
assignees: POWER21 CORP

title_en: Nuclear power plant operation rule optimization method based on Sarsa algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear power simulation, and particularly relates to a nuclear power plant operation rule optimization method based on a Sarsa algorithm. Dividing the state of the application scene by taking the steam pipeline break fault in the containment as a research object to obtain a state space, making a decision by the reinforcement learning model according to the perceived environmental state, dividing the action of the application scene by taking the steam pipeline break fault in the containment as a research object to obtain an action space, constructing a simulation model and preparing data, namely constructing a simulation model capable of simulating the steam pipeline break fault in the containment, so that the simulation model simulates the break fault condition under different environmental states, and generating training data. The method can assist in improving personnel decision-making efficiency in the link of nuclear power station simulated accident handling, reduces resource waste at important moments, provides technical support for digital nuclear power and assists digital twin construction of the nuclear power station.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION TECHNOLOGY CORP LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic active distribution network-containing voltage out-of-limit problem tracing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a voltage out-of-limit problem tracing method for a photovoltaic active distribution network, which comprises the steps of receiving research data and carrying out multi-scale feature analysis to obtain a standardized multi-dimensional feature matrix and a space-time correlation matrix, constructing an initial causal graph based on basic research data and physical constraints of a power grid, constructing a multi-layer causal network by calculating causal strength, extracting dynamic feature sequences and analyzing propagation features to generate a propagation path set and a path weight matrix, carrying out tensor completion and state estimation on the research data to obtain a state estimation matrix and estimation uncertainty, and outputting out-of-limit source positions, out-of-limit risk scores and early warning information based on pattern matching analysis and risk assessment. According to the invention, through the combination of multidimensional feature analysis and multi-layer causal network, accurate positioning and risk early warning of a voltage threshold crossing source are realized, and the tracing accuracy and analysis efficiency are improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;Quanzhou Power Supply Company Of State Grid Fujian Electric Power Company;LONGYAN POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Operation management method and system of heat supply pipe network based on unmanned aerial vehicle
