abstract_en: The invention provides an operation management method and system of a heating network based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which belong to the technical field of heating networks and specifically comprise the steps of determining a suspected abnormal monitoring device in a monitoring device according to an identification result of image features of an associated heating network, determining the suspected abnormal monitoring device and other monitoring devices according to data abnormal probability, determining the associated monitoring device of the suspected abnormal monitoring device according to the set data of the suspected abnormal monitoring device when the reliability of the monitoring process of a digital twin model in a heating area is not met based on the type and the set data of the other monitoring devices, and determining whether verification processing is needed or not based on the monitoring data of the associated monitoring device and the identification result of the image features of the associated heating network, so that the accuracy of the monitoring data of the digital twin model of the heating network is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Voltage stability critical point acquisition method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for acquiring a voltage stability critical point, and relates to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining voltage and power of a power grid, obtaining a power flow equation through setting initial voltage and power injection values of nodes, linearizing a nonlinear problem of the power flow equation, carrying out iteration through power series expansion to obtain a power flow initial solution, carrying out power flow calculation on the power flow equation through a recursion algorithm, supplementing failure node voltage by adopting a data fitting compensation method until a voltage stability critical point is obtained when power flow calculation diverges due to power grid variation, wherein the data fitting compensation method is adopted to supplement the failure node voltage, and comprises the steps of marking the node voltage which cannot be calculated to form missing data, constructing a fitting function according to a voltage and power result calculated in the last time, and supplementing the missing node voltage by utilizing the voltage value calculated in the last time and a fitting coefficient of the fitting function.
assignees: NORTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Assimilation method for improving analysis precision of warm salt based on submarine pressure data
abstract_en: A method for improving the analysis precision of warm salt based on the data of the pressure of the sea bottom includes such steps as obtaining the observation data including the temp, salinity, sea surface temp, sea surface salinity and pressure of the sea bottom, increasing the altitude of sea surface, building the objective function of the space-time four-dimensional multi-scale data assimilation frame, setting the dynamic constraint condition of the space-time four-dimensional multi-scale data assimilation frame, inputting the prepared observation data, and assimilating the combined data to reconstruct the analysis field of warm salt. The invention can enhance the vertical structural precision of the thermal salt field, improve the data quality and reliability, and improve the overall precision of ocean state analysis, thereby improving the prediction precision of ocean disasters and improving the prediction and early warning of the ocean disasters.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Distributed dynamic state estimation method of electric-gas comprehensive energy system based on long-term and short-term memory neural network load prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-gas comprehensive energy system distributed dynamic state estimation method based on long-term memory neural network load prediction. The method takes a Kalman filtering algorithm as a framework, a state space model of an air network is established based on a finite difference model, a state space model of a power grid is established based on a two-parameter exponential smoothing method, air network load node flow is predicted based on a long-short-term memory neural network, flow prediction information is provided for an air network prediction step, a distributed estimation algorithm is adopted, the filtering steps of the power grid and the air network are iteratively corrected through information interaction of boundary coupling elements, and a collaborative state estimation result of an electric-air interconnection comprehensive energy system is obtained. The method can accurately predict the flow information of the load node of the gas network, dynamically track the running state of the electric-gas interconnection comprehensive energy system in real time, effectively solve the problem of information barriers between the electric subsystem and the gas subsystem and provide support for dynamic monitoring and running control of the electric-gas interconnection comprehensive energy system.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and optimizing system and method for energy-saving combustion of supercritical carbon dioxide coal-fired boiler
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring and optimizing system and method for energy-saving combustion of a supercritical carbon dioxide coal-fired boiler, comprising a data acquisition and transmission module, a digital twin modeling module, a fault diagnosis and early warning module and an energy efficiency optimizing module, wherein the data acquisition and transmission module is used for acquiring real-time data in the operation process of the supercritical carbon dioxide coal-fired boiler, the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a digital twin model according to the real-time data to realize the simulation of the combustion process of the coal-fired boiler, the fault diagnosis and early warning module is used for simulating the operation state of the coal-fired boiler according to the real-time data to diagnose and early warn faults of the coal-fired boiler, and the energy efficiency optimizing module is used for monitoring the energy efficiency of the coal-fired boiler according to the real-time data and simultaneously optimizing in real time according to monitoring results. The invention can acquire monitoring data in real time aiming at the large-capacity coal-fired power plant boiler from the aspects of intellectualization, economy, safety and operability, intelligently judges and sends out early warning, is beneficial to improving the safety and emergency response capability of the operation of the boiler, and effectively prevents possible safety accidents in the operation process.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Digital twinning and machine learning-based wharf facility health monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twin and machine learning-based wharf facility health monitoring method and system, which relate to the field of wharf facility health monitoring, and the method comprises the steps of establishing a weight coefficient of a monitoring point network topological graph according to the synchronicity change value of sensor data of the same type corresponding to adjacent monitoring points; the method comprises the steps of determining an abnormal transmission path based on a weight coefficient, determining an abnormal state transmission rule of each abnormal transmission path under each preset abnormal state according to historical monitoring data corresponding to each preset abnormal state, calculating parameter predicted values of other monitoring points in the corresponding abnormal transmission path based on the abnormal state transmission rule after detecting abnormal sensor data of any monitoring point, and generating early warning information if the parameter predicted values of the preset proportional quantity deviate from the corresponding actual monitoring values. By implementing the method, false alarms caused by single-point data fluctuation collected in the traditional health monitoring mode can be handled, and the accuracy and reliability of abnormal state early warning are improved.
assignees: ZHANGJIAGANG PORT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin construction method and related device of energy storage valve grid-connected system
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin construction method and a related device of an energy storage valve grid-connected system, and belongs to the technical field of power systems. According to the digital twin construction method of the energy storage valve grid-connected system, system data and operation states of the energy storage valve grid-connected system are obtained, the system data comprise data information of all elements in the energy storage valve grid-connected system, data files of a real-time digital simulator simulation model corresponding to the energy storage valve grid-connected system are obtained, a relational data table between the system data and all the elements in the data files is built, the data files are updated according to the relational data table, so that the system data are imported into the real-time digital simulator simulation model, and the operation states are sent to the real-time digital simulator simulation model. Therefore, a mirror image virtual system of the energy storage valve grid-connected system can be constructed to simulate the actual state of the energy storage valve grid-connected system in real time, so that the actual state of the energy storage valve grid-connected system can be perceived in real time.
assignees: NINGDE CONTEMPORARY FUTURE ENERGY SHANGHAI RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;NINGDE CONTEMPORARY AMPEREX TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin modeling method and system for power grid operation fault identification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power Internet of things, in particular to a digital twin modeling method and a digital twin modeling system for identifying operation faults of a power grid, which are characterized in that sensor data are collected to obtain one type of data and are subjected to primary processing, a data structure is simplified, a basis is provided for subsequent analysis, the primary processed data are used for constructing a second type of data set, real-time monitoring and secondary processing are performed to help monitor the operation state of the power grid equipment, fault prediction and early warning are realized through three-level analysis of the second type of data set, the extraction of data characteristics of various types of sensors of the power grid equipment is standardized, the physical entity and information model architecture of the different types of sensors of the power grid equipment are standardized, the digital twin model of the power grid equipment is formed, the operation state of the equipment is monitored, the multi-source characteristic quantity dimension reduction mapping method of a sample data set is designed, the complexity of data processing is reduced through the innovative means, the operation efficiency of the system is improved, and the high-efficiency monitoring and fault identification of the power grid equipment state are realized.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid typhoon area distribution map drawing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for drawing a distribution map of a typhoon area of a power grid. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a typhoon maximum/maximum wind speed time sequence based on wind speed observation data of a typhoon weather station and an electric microclimate station in an area to be analyzed, prolonging or/and supplementing missing data based on the wind speed time sequence, simulating typhoon average gradient wind speed spatial distribution at the height of a gradient layer based on an improved parameterized gradient wind field model by utilizing the typhoon path, the strength and the wind speed time sequence, converting the average gradient wind speed into an earth surface average wind speed based on an improved boundary layer vertical wind field model, converting the earth surface average wind speed with long time interval into the maximum/maximum wind speed with short time interval based on a gust factor model, and obtaining the maximum/maximum wind speed spatial distribution data of the area to be analyzed to obtain the distribution map of different reproduction periods. The typhoon area distribution diagram drawn by the invention can better reflect the influence degree of typhoons on the power transmission line of the area to be analyzed.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multi-terminal interconnected wind power plant stepping investigation and site selection method based on three-dimensional GIS technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of wind farm stepping investigation and site selection, in particular to a multi-terminal interconnected wind farm stepping investigation and site selection method based on three-dimensional modeling and GIS technology. According to the method, the multi-terminal interconnection platform is used for realizing real-time acquisition, synchronous uploading and automatic archiving of data, so that all project members can view the latest project information in real time. The method comprises the core steps of project creation and configuration, data synchronization and real-time updating, investigation scheme and information recording, three-dimensional display and analysis, data archiving and subsequent utilization, and offline data acquisition and rapid transmission. The application improves the efficiency and accuracy of data processing, optimizes the site selection decision process of the wind power plant, and improves the project success rate and benefit.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHONGQING ENG CORP LTD

title_en: New energy electric field intelligent scheduling method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy electric field intelligent scheduling method and system based on edge calculation, comprising the steps of constructing a digital twin scheduling network based on a physical entity network, and a cloud edge end cooperative data processing and scheduling optimization model based on edge calculation, which are used for supporting medium-long term planning and intelligent scheduling optimization of a power grid, constructing a multi-objective random optimization problem of data processing delay minimization and virtual-real synchronous delay error minimization, converting the random optimization problem into a deterministic optimization problem through a Lyapunov optimization technology, and finally acquiring an optimization strategy of data scheduling and resource allocation by adopting a non-dominant ordering genetic algorithm. According to the invention, through the fusion of the edge calculation and the digital twin technology, the automation of data scheduling in the new energy electric field is realized, the response speed and stability of a power grid system are improved, and technical support is provided for power grid planning and efficient operation of new energy power generation.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: State estimation method and system for polar electric heating comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state estimation method and a state estimation system of a polar electric heating comprehensive energy system, which are used for establishing the electric heating comprehensive energy system according to the actual power supply and heat supply topology of a polar scientific investigation station, determining state variables and quantity measurement of the system, identifying abnormal values in the quantity measurement by using a PS method with adjustable threshold, determining weight of the abnormal values, determining constraint conditions, establishing an objective function by using a Huber loss function with the minimum weighted residual sum of the system as a target, and carrying out state estimation on the state variables according to the quantity measurement and the weight of the objective function and the constraint conditions, so that the abnormal values and noise in measurement data can be effectively identified and processed, the robustness of the state estimation is obviously improved, the influence of the measurement noise can be effectively restrained by flexibly adjusting the precision and the calculation efficiency of the threshold, and the Huber loss function is effectively adapted to complex operation conditions in a polar severe environment, thereby improving the precision and the calculation efficiency of the state estimation in a polar scene.
assignees: SHANXI ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Gas coal mine goaf coupling disaster monitoring method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine disaster monitoring, in particular to a gas coal mine goaf coupling disaster monitoring method, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the gas coal mine goaf coupling disaster monitoring method comprises the following steps of acquiring comprehensive data of a goaf through a sensor network and preprocessing the data to obtain standardized data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model through a 3D modeling and geographic information system technology, carrying out data synchronization and model correction processing on the digital twin model, optimizing parameters and states of the digital twin model, constructing a fluid-solid-heat multi-field coupling model through a computational fluid mechanics and finite element analysis method, constructing a risk assessment model through a analytic hierarchy process and a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, training a disaster early warning model through a machine learning algorithm based on standardized data and the risk assessment model, integrating the digital twin model, the standardized data, the risk assessment model and the disaster early warning model, and constructing a visual interaction platform. The monitoring method can be used for coupling multiple disaster factors and dynamically evolving, so that the disaster prediction accuracy and timeliness are greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Intelligent building water system comprehensive monitoring and performance optimizing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent building water system comprehensive monitoring and performance optimizing system, belongs to the field of building water systems, and aims to improve safety, reliability and efficiency of the building water system. The system integrates advanced technologies such as a digital twin platform frame, an artificial intelligence technology, an intelligent identification model, a knowledge graph technology, an urban rainstorm waterlogging numerical model, an intelligent water supply system, an intelligent drainage system, an underground space waterlogging monitoring and early warning model and the like, acquires data such as water quality, water pressure and flow in real time through a sensor network, and realizes rapid data transmission and processing by utilizing the Internet of things technology. The system can simulate and forecast the performance of the water system under extreme conditions, early warn the risk of waterlogging in advance, optimize the water resource distribution and effectively prevent water quality pollution and odor from overflowing. The modularized design of the system improves the expandability and flexibility of the system, reduces the operation cost, enhances the user experience and promotes the sustainable development.
assignees: JIANGSU YANGTZE RIVER DELTA SMART WATER RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;XINJIANG WESTERN UNITED DIGITAL IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;ZHEJIANG EAST UNITED WATER ENV CO LTD;ZHEJIANG WEIPU ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD;NANJING WEIPU WATER ENG CO LTD;NANJING WEIGAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic generation amount forecasting method based on meteorological administration forecasts
title_ko: 기상청 예보를 활용한 태양광 발전량 예측방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for predicting solar power generation using a weather forecast from the Korea Meteorological Administration, and is characterized by comprising: a short-term solar radiation data extraction and preprocessing step (S11) in which short-term data is extracted from a database in which meteorological data and solar power generation data are stored and updated, and then data of different formats is unified and missing data is supplemented; a short-term solar radiation CNN learning information generation step (S12) in which training data obtained from the short-term solar radiation data extraction and preprocessing step (S11) is used to generate CNN learning information by region and time period through CNN algorithm learning; and a short-term solar radiation prediction step (S13) comprising a CNN prediction process (S131) for extracting principal components for prediction, a CatBoost learning process (S132) for selecting optimal CatBoost parameters, and a CatBoost prediction process (S133) for extracting solar radiation prediction values using the principal components for prediction and optimal CatBoost parameters in the CatBoost algorithm and storing the values.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기상청 예보를 활용한 태양광 발전량 예측방법에 관한 것으로서, 기상자료와 태양광 발전자료가 저장되고 업데이트되는 데이터베이스에서 단기 데이터를 추출한 다음 형식이 상이한 데이터를 통일하고 누락된 데이터를 보완하는 단기 일사량 데이터 추출 및 전처리단계(S11); 상기 단기 일사량 데이터 추출 및 전처리단계(S11)를 거친 학습용 데이터를 CNN 알고리즘 학습을 통해 지역별 시간대별 CNN 학습정보를 생성하는 단기 일사량 CNN 학습정보 생성단계(S12); 및 예측용 주성분을 추출하는 CNN 예측과정(s131), CatBoost 최적의 파라미터를 선정하는 CatBoost 학습과정(s132), CatBoost 알고리즘에 상기 예측용 주성분과 CatBoost 최적의 파라미터를 사용하여 일사량 예측치를 추출하고 이를 저장하는 CatBoost 예측과정(s133)을 포함하는 단기 일사량 예측단계(S13);로 이루어지는 단기 일사량 예측방법(S10)을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KOREA POWER EXCHANGE

title_en: Method for predicting missing power data through bidirectional prediction in a microgrid system
title_ko: 마이크로 그리드 시스템에서 양방향 예측을 통한 누락 전력 데이터 예측 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for predicting missing power data and, more specifically, to a method for predicting missing power data through bidirectional prediction in a micro-grid system, which predicts the entire missing power data by averaging a value predicted in a forward direction from data before the missing occurs and a value predicted in a reverse direction from data after the missing is terminated when the missing exists in the power data measured in the micro-grid system, thereby accurately predicting the missing data.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 누락 전력 데이터 예측 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는 마이크로 그리드 시스템에서 계측된 전력 데이터에 누락이 존재할 때, 누락이 발생하기 이전의 데이터로부터 정방향으로 예측한 값과 누락이 종료된 후의 데이터로부터 역방향으로 예측한 값을 평균하여 전체 누락 전력 데이터를 예측함으로써 누락된 데이터를 정밀하게 예측할 수 있는 마이크로 그리드 시스템에서 양방향 예측을 통한 누락 전력 데이터 예측 방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: GRIDA ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Mine regional disaster early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine early warning and discloses a digital twinning-based mine regional disaster early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of deploying a sensor network in a mine region, collecting environmental data of the mine region in real time and preprocessing the environmental data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a mine area by utilizing a three-dimensional modeling technology, mapping preprocessed environment data into the digital twin model, establishing a mine disaster risk assessment index system based on historical disaster data and an expert knowledge base, determining weights of all indexes, determining disaster risk values of the mine area according to the weights of all indexes and the digital twin model, comparing the disaster risk values with a preset threshold, and triggering an early warning mechanism according to the result to generate early warning information to give an alarm. The method can accurately reflect risks in real time, early warn in advance, overcome the limitation of the traditional method, effectively reduce disaster loss and ensure mine safety production.
assignees: INSPUR GENERAL SOFTWARE CO LTD;INSPUR HAITONG XIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine exploitation collapse prediction and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine exploitation collapse prediction early warning method and system, which comprise the steps of collecting multidimensional data, deep mining the collected multidimensional data by using a big data analysis technology, extracting key features related to mine collapse risk, carrying out fusion processing on the multidimensional data, removing redundant information among different data sources, estimating and filling missing data, organically combining the multidimensional data through a Bayesian network algorithm, carrying out quality inspection on the fused data by adopting a data quality assessment mechanism in the process of data fusion, dynamically adjusting the data fusion algorithm and parameters according to a data quality assessment result to form real-time mine state description, and carrying out collapse risk prediction by using a collapse prediction model based on the real-time mine state description. The method can accurately predict collapse risk and perform safety early warning in the mining process based on data acquisition, data analysis, data fusion and risk prediction.
assignees: ZIJIN CHANGSHA ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban rainfall flood process forecasting method based on data assimilation and multi-mode coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a city rainfall flood process forecasting method based on data assimilation and multi-mode coupling, which comprises the following steps of ⑴ collecting historical meteorological data, hydrological data, topographic data, soil texture data, vegetation data and city infrastructure data in an area, inputting all the data into a visual analysis and decision platform based on a GIS technology after quality control and format standardization, ⑵ establishing parameter transfer rules among WRF, SHUD and a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, ⑶ operating the WRF, obtaining area high-resolution rainfall forecast data, carrying out EnKF dynamic update and inputting the data into the platform, ⑷ driving SHUD, obtaining area surface runoff and groundwater forecast data, carrying out EnKF dynamic update and inputting the data into the platform, ⑸ driving the two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, obtaining flood propagation paths and space-time release data of a inundation area and inputting the data into the platform, and ⑹ utilizing a threshold automatic identification technology to form risk level assessment and inputting the risk level assessment into the platform. The invention has high practicability and can realize accurate forecasting.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Comprehensive energy efficiency analysis method for wind farm based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy efficiency analysis method for a wind farm based on a digital twin technology, which relates to the technical field of energy efficiency analysis and mainly adopts the following scheme: the method comprises the steps of obtaining geographic information, environment and fan running state data of different detection periods of a wind power plant, calculating corresponding wind power plant topographic energy efficiency indexes, wind power plant environment energy efficiency indexes and fan power generation energy efficiency indexes, taking the geographic information data, environment data and running state data of fan equipment of the wind power plant in different detection periods as input features, taking corresponding wind power plant comprehensive energy efficiency indexes as output features, constructing a digital twin model, inputting geographic information data, environment data and running state data of the fan equipment for a period of time in the future, calculating by using the model, outputting the wind power plant comprehensive energy efficiency indexes, presetting an energy efficiency threshold value set, comparing the future energy efficiency indexes to judge grades and adjusting correspondingly.
assignees: BEIJING JINGNENG CLEAN ENERGY POWER CO LTD INNER MONGOLIA BRANCH

title_en: Internet of things big data-based distributed energy intelligent allocation method in smart city
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of distributed energy, in particular to an intelligent allocation method of distributed energy based on big data of the Internet of things in a smart city, which comprises three steps of data acquisition, processing and output. Firstly, acquiring real-time data of photovoltaic, energy storage and charging piles through a multi-protocol analysis engine, and combining weather cloud pictures, traffic thermodynamic diagrams and building energy consumption historical data. And secondly, constructing a dynamic weight model by utilizing a space-time combined attention mechanism, generating a global wind-light output prediction network by federal learning, constructing an elastic scheduling strategy library by adopting a multi-target dynamic game algorithm, optimizing the scheduling model on a digital twin platform, and finally generating a real-time scheduling scheme by a two-stage increment optimizing framework. The method effectively improves the efficiency, economy, reliability and environmental protection of the energy system, provides a powerful tool for city managers, ensures stable, economical and clean energy supply for residents, and promotes sustainable development of smart cities.
assignees: CHEN SHIQI

title_en: Charging station depth defense protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station deep defense protection method, relates to the technical field of fire early warning and safety protection, and aims to solve the problems of high fire early warning false alarm rate, fire isolation delay and insufficient credibility of accident tracing data in the prior art. The method constructs a full-period protection system of 'monitoring-disposal-tracing', wherein a temperature field, electrical parameters and environmental data are collected through multi-source sensor fusion before disaster, a self-adaptive safety threshold is generated based on a dynamic game model, a digital twin deduction and prejudging risk path is combined, a three-level response mechanism is adopted in disaster, an operation log is stored in a slicing mode through a blockchain space-time anchoring technology after disaster, and a digital twin reverse reconstruction accident evolution chain is utilized to generate tamper-resistant judicial evidence. According to the invention, early warning precision is improved through dynamic threshold optimization, response time is shortened through multistage linkage control, traceability reliability is guaranteed through a quantum evidence storage technology, and a closed-loop optimization system for fire protection of the charging station is formed.
assignees: QUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Offshore wind power dispatching optimization method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data fusion-based offshore wind power dispatching optimization method and a multi-source data fusion-based offshore wind power dispatching optimization system, which relate to the field of power system dispatching, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source offshore wind power data streams; the method comprises the steps of performing mapping fusion and twin simulation on an operation distribution characteristic data set of a target offshore wind farm to generate an offshore wind farm digital twin body, constructing a multi-scale prediction time window according to offshore wind power dispatching requirements, predicting generated power, outputting the multi-scale window to predict wind power, performing dispatching evaluation on the multi-scale window to predict wind power according to power grid load requirements to obtain offshore wind power demand dispatching power, performing energy dispatching path optimization on the offshore wind farm digital twin body, determining an offshore wind power dispatching path, and performing wind power dispatching optimization control. The technical problem of the scheduling accuracy deficiency of the existing offshore wind power scheduling is solved, and the technical effect of efficient and accurate scheduling of offshore wind power is achieved.
assignees: JINAN ANXUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system operation data visualization method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for visualizing operation data of a power system based on digital twinning, which belong to the technical field of data transmission, and comprise the steps of S1, layering data nodes to generate a plurality of hierarchical structures, connecting parent data points in different hierarchical structures with each other to generate a transmission network, S3, repartitioning child data points in each hierarchical structure to generate a hierarchical structure based on a transmission delay value and a hierarchical delay estimated value, and S4, generating an update transmission network, and rapidly transmitting the operation data to a digital twinning model pre-constructed by a control platform based on the update transmission network so as to visualize the operation data of the power system. The invention can adjust the transmission mode of the sensor in real time and improve the data transmission rate, thereby avoiding display errors when the digital twin model is used for data visualization due to untimely data transmission in the operation of the power system.
assignees: NINGBO YONGYAO POWER INVEST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of information data processing technology, in particular to a mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining original slope real-time monitoring data, carrying out standardization processing to obtain standardized slope real-time monitoring data, constructing a digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data to obtain a preliminary slope digital twin model, and dynamically updating the preliminary slope digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data and slope history multi-source monitoring data to obtain a real-time updated slope digital twin model. According to the invention, by updating the digital twin model in real time and combining multi-physical field coupling analysis and nonlinear stability prediction, the dynamic monitoring, stability evaluation, risk prediction and emergency response of the slope can be ensured to reflect the actual conditions in time, so that the scientificity and timeliness of disaster prevention and control are improved.
assignees: SICHUAN EXPRESSWAY CONSTRUCTION AND DEV GROUP CO LTD;SHUDAO INVEST GROUP CO LTD;CHONGQING TONGNAN DISTR TRAFFIC AFFAIRS CENTER

title_en: Substation early warning method and system based on digital twin model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substation early warning method and a system based on a digital twin model, which relate to the technical field of data analysis and comprise the steps of dividing a range of a target substation into a plurality of power areas, the power areas are divided by considering the association condition of the power equipment and each other, and a reliable basis is provided for the follow-up adaptation of the spatial resolution. The spatial resolution is determined based on the basic information of the power equipment and the association information between the power equipment in each power area, a digital twin model of the target transformer substation is built, so that the suitability of the spatial resolution is improved, the change and the capacity of the transformer substation can be better represented, and a more perfect digital twin model is built. The abnormal condition of the target transformer substation is monitored through the template of the abnormal event, the abnormal condition is integrated and analyzed, the adaptability and the accuracy of the early warning of the transformer substation are improved, the normal and safe operation of the transformer substation is ensured, and the early warning can be performed in time before the abnormal event occurs.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE;UNIV EAST CHINA JIAOTONG;STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CONSTRUCTION BRANCH;HUBEI YUNZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based suspension structure construction full-period simulation optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin technology and suspension structure construction, and discloses a suspension structure construction full-period simulation optimization method based on digital twin, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-level nested graph to represent a suspension structure; the method comprises the steps of realizing a cross-layer attention mechanism, calculating the influence transfer of structural units among different layers, identifying multi-scale key paths in a structure, constructing a dual self-attention-enhanced space-time diagram neural network, identifying key nodes through node self-attention layers, capturing the structural state evolution of a long time scale by the time self-attention layers, learning the structural dynamic characteristics by using a time sequence diagram convolution network, predicting the structural bearing capacity change and dynamic response, generating a structural vulnerability heat map, identifying potential risk areas, and automatically adjusting the monitoring sampling frequency of the key nodes.

title_en: Cross-platform power transaction data interaction optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-platform power transaction data interaction optimization method, which particularly relates to the technical field of digital twin of power transaction data, and comprises the steps of generating simulation transaction data of market participants based on an antagonistic neural network model, identifying causal relations among market variables from the simulation transaction data of the digital twin through a causal discovery algorithm, constructing a causal graph, modeling space dependence and causal conduction paths among the market participants through a graph neural network model, performing anti-facts reasoning in a single external impact scene in the digital twin through intervention of key variables in the causal graph, simulating dynamic game behaviors of the market participants in an extreme weather parameter distribution scene, performing power market failure evaluation by combining the causal conduction paths to obtain power market failure evaluation indexes, performing early warning based on the power market failure evaluation indexes, and improving adaptability and stability of a power market in the extreme weather scene.
assignees: INF CT YUNNAN GRID POWER CO LTD

title_en: CT induction power supply system based on cooperative control and distributed optimization and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of CT induction power supplies, in particular to a CT induction power supply system based on cooperative control and distributed optimization and a control method. The technical scheme is that the CT induction power supply control method based on cooperative control and distributed optimization comprises the following steps of S1, deploying a multi-mode sensing array, synchronously collecting three-phase current harmonic spectra of power supply nodes, magnetostrictive vibration waveforms of an iron core and infrared thermal imaging of the surface of a radiator, generating a digital twin body with space-time correlation through multi-physical field coupling modeling, and S2, constructing a data fusion engine driven by a space-time attention mechanism at an edge computing node, and extracting LSTM features under physical constraints of output and historical operation logs of the S1. According to the invention, through collaborative innovation of multi-mode federal learning and physical embedded edge calculation, a multi-physical-field dynamic modeling mechanism under privacy protection is constructed, and the correlation precision and information safety of electromagnetic-vibration-thermal data are effectively balanced.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for identifying and repairing power grid faults
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for identifying and repairing power grid faults, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a power distribution network containing a doubly-fed induction generator; according to the digital twin model of the power distribution network, simulating fault conditions of different nodes in the power distribution network to generate real-time fault data, inputting the real-time fault data into a preset InceptionTime neural network model to perform fault identification to obtain a fault identification result, and according to the fault identification result, scheduling the maintenance unit to the fault node to perform fault repair by adopting a scheduling algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning. According to the application, the digital twin model, inceptionTime neural network, deep reinforcement learning algorithm and other technologies are introduced to identify and repair the power grid faults, so that the precision and robustness of fault identification are improved, the path planning of fault repair is optimized, the time of fault repair is further reduced, and the efficiency of fault repair is improved.
assignees: ZHUHAI HUAFA DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for constructing Tibetan zone ground disaster early warning model based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a Tibetan zone ground disaster early warning model based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning. The method comprises the main technical scheme of obtaining first geological data and second geological data, stage weather index data and stage disaster index data, constructing a first geological entity model and a second geological entity model corresponding to a target road section, integrating the stage weather index data into the first geological entity model to obtain a simulated geological entity model of the target road section, constructing a geological disaster early warning model based on the stage disaster index data and the simulated geological entity model, and optimizing parameters of the geological disaster early warning model based on differences between the second geological entity model and the simulated geological entity model. The model can simulate and forecast the influence of the extreme temperature difference on the property of the rock-soil body, and more accurately evaluate the geological disaster risk. The model can be continuously adapted to new environmental changes and geological disaster characteristics, and the prediction precision and long-term applicability of the early warning model are improved.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;SINOHYDRO ENGINEERING BUREAU 4 CO LTD

title_en: Substation inspection task planning management method and device and substation inspection task planning management program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a substation inspection task planning management method and device, and a computer program product, comprising the following steps: by integrating the three-dimensional digital twin scene and twin camera data, the automatic identification of the patrol points and the optimal path planning are realized; firstly, constructing a three-dimensional digital model of a transformer substation, automatically screening patrol points meeting the conditions according to camera parameters and patrol requirements, and calculating the optimal patrol gesture of a camera; in addition, the method can also detect and avoid the shielding of the obstacle in real time, and ensure the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the patrol task; finally, the execution device of the method generates patrol task management module data according to the information, and realizes the storage and the calling of the data; the method of the invention obviously improves the automation and intelligent level of the inspection work of the transformer substation, reduces the operation and maintenance cost and improves the safety and reliability of the operation of the power grid.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Atmospheric data assimilation method, apparatus, device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an atmosphere data assimilation method, device, equipment and storage medium. Relates to the technical field of computer science and atmospheric science fusion. The method comprises the steps of adding a cost function, prior estimation and a gradient of the cost function into a gradient-based descent algorithm, adding posterior estimation, constructing a four-dimensional variation and set Kalman filtering combination model based on Bayesian prior information, and carrying out data assimilation on atmospheric data based on the four-dimensional variation and set Kalman filtering combination model. The application combines artificial intelligence technology, in particular to deep learning and Bayesian optimization self-adaptive algorithm, enhances and optimizes the traditional data assimilation algorithm, and can be widely applied to prediction of extreme weather events such as high-temperature heat waves and the like. By assimilating the historical data and the real-time observation data, the prediction accuracy of the future climate change trend is remarkably improved, and more powerful support is provided for extreme weather early warning and decision making.

title_en: Energy network state sensing method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application discloses an energy network state sensing method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twinning, relating to the technical field of expressway energy network information monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time data of an energy network; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of the expressway energy network based on the real-time data of the energy network, simulating the expressway energy network by using the digital twin model to generate a state sensing result of the expressway energy network, monitoring the state sensing result to obtain a monitoring result, and dynamically adjusting and optimizing the energy gateway key nodes according to the state sensing result.
assignees: SHANDONG HI SPEED GROUP CO LTD;INNOVATION RES INSTITUTE OF SHANDONG HI SPEED GROUP CO LTD;SHANDONG ZHENGCHEN POLYTRON TECH CO LTD

title_en: Beidou-based power grid emergency wireless command system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system management, in particular to a Beidou-based power grid emergency wireless command system which comprises Beidou positioning communication, multi-source data fusion, intelligent decision, heterogeneous communication and a visual command terminal, wherein the Beidou positioning communication module accurately acquires the position of power equipment and transmits encryption instructions, the multi-source data fusion module integrates power, weather and geographic information, performs data cleaning and space-time correlation analysis to provide support for decision making, the intelligent decision module relies on a digital twin dynamic prediction library and a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to generate multi-target optimization decisions by using an improved multi-target genetic algorithm, the heterogeneous communication module integrates various communication units to realize mode dynamic switching and bandwidth aggregation to ensure stable communication, and the visual command terminal displays the situation of a power grid and gives the instructions efficiently by means of augmented reality and multi-level authority management. The invention greatly improves the emergency response and command efficiency of the power grid and powerfully ensures the stable power supply.
assignees: STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;HAIBEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Running state prediction method, device and terminal of digital twin body of micro-grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a running state prediction method, device and terminal of a digital twin body of a micro-grid, and belongs to the technical field of digital twin of the micro-grid. The method comprises the steps of obtaining performance data of a micro-grid, inputting the performance data into an operation state prediction model of a micro-grid digital twin body to obtain an operation state prediction result of the micro-grid digital twin body output by the operation state prediction model, wherein the operation state prediction model comprises a feature extraction layer and an output layer, the feature extraction layer is constructed based on a plurality of echo state networks connected in series and is used for carrying out feature extraction on the performance data to obtain operation state features, the output layer is used for carrying out feature conversion on the operation state features to obtain the operation state prediction result, and parameter optimization is carried out on model parameters of the output layer when the operation state prediction model is trained. The method solves the problem of how to realize light abstraction and clipping of the digital twin model of the micro-grid so as to adapt to efficient operation of the digital twin body of the micro-grid at the edge computing terminal.
assignees: BEIJING SMARTCHIP MICROELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban life body full period monitoring system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin technology-based urban life body full period monitoring system, which relates to the technical field of urban management, and integrates multi-source data such as GIS data, remote sensing information, surface permeability data, underground drainage pipe network structures and the like, quantifies a flood high-risk area, adopts extreme weather simulation to deduce the water accumulation range and drainage capacity under different rainfall situations based on historical rainfall trend, current meteorological conditions and drainage network states, dynamically adjusts a flood diffusion trend prediction model, enables flood risk to be identified more accurately, and an intelligent emergency scheduling module automatically matches flood control resources, combines flood high-risk areas, water accumulation points and traffic flow analysis, optimizes a drainage pump station start-stop strategy, remotely adjusts underground drainage gates, dynamically adjusts overflow adjustment capacity of a sewage treatment plant, combines an intelligent traffic management system to optimize an emergency refuge route, and improves the accuracy and execution efficiency of a flood control scheduling scheme.
assignees: BEIJING SINOTOON TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for constructing private network digital twin bodies of power production data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a digital twin body of a private network of electric power production data, which comprises the following steps of 1) establishing a geometric model, a physical model, a behavior model and a rule model according to geometric information, physical information, operation behaviors and operation rules of the private network of electric power production data, integrating the geometric model, the physical model, the behavior model and the rule model into a unified digital twin body model, 2) constructing a real-time data acquisition frame of the digital twin body of the private network of the electric power production data, comprising a perception layer, a transmission layer and a feedback layer, and 3) sending a control instruction to a physical entity according to decision instructions and feedback, and operating and adjusting the virtual model to realize the construction of the digital twin body of the private network of the electric power production data. The method provided by the invention realizes real-time monitoring of the system and optimizes the system decision strategy so as to meet the processing requirement of massive heterogeneous data under the smart grid background and improve the system efficiency.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Particle swarm optimization algorithm-based power production OTN resource scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power production OTN resource scheduling method based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm, which comprises the following steps of 1) constructing a digital twin model of an electric power production OTN network through a digital twin modeling method fused by multiple models, 2) modeling an electric power production OTN resource scheduling problem, designing a neighborhood searching strategy and a global searching strategy suitable for electric power production OTN resource scheduling by adopting the particle swarm optimization algorithm-based group intelligent optimization method, and realizing the electric power production OTN resource scheduling method based on the particle swarm optimization algorithm. The invention adopts an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, can dynamically adjust the position and speed of particles according to the real-time network state, realizes self-adaptive optimization and adapts to the changing network environment, and can simultaneously consider a plurality of optimization targets to comprehensively optimize the scheduling scheme, thereby having stronger global searching capability, rapid convergence speed and strong robustness.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for establishing business expansion installation digital twin model based on hybrid drive
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power, and provides a method and a device for establishing a digital twin model of business expansion and reporting based on hybrid driving, wherein the method comprises the steps of step-by-step multi-element data acquisition, preprocessing multi-element data based on an improved fractional order flexible space method, constructing a data driving model based on an improved TCN-BiGRU method, combining an improved semi-infinite method with the data driving model to obtain the hybrid driving model, constructing a digital twin platform area dynamic model, simulating and deducting a business expansion and reporting scheme and the like; the invention utilizes a digital twin technology to construct a power system model with real-time monitoring and optimizing capabilities. The model can accurately simulate the power grid state of the active station area, analyze the core parameter characteristics under different business expansion schemes, predict the influence of new energy access on the power grid operation, and provide more accurate and flexible scheduling and decision basis for power grid management.

title_en: Risk early warning method, device and system based on dynamic risk field with few samples
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk early warning method, a risk early warning device and a risk early warning system based on a dynamic risk field with few samples, which belong to the technical field of data network security, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining an initial risk field by the boundary of a first low-dimensional anchor node corresponding to the few samples, and mapping a second low-dimensional anchor node corresponding to the rest samples into the initial risk field to obtain a target risk field; and when any sample has data change, remapping the changed sample into the target risk field, and carrying out risk early warning according to the change amount between the current mapping position corresponding to the changed sample and the initial mapping position corresponding to the unchanged sample. The invention constructs high-efficiency risk field based on a small amount of marked data, thereby remarkably reducing the data acquisition cost. Meanwhile, in order to adapt to a highly dynamic social risk environment, the robustness and the practicability of the model can be effectively improved by adopting a dynamic risk field modeling and online updating mechanism.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Networking type energy storage remote management system and method based on Internet technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a networking type energy storage remote management system and method based on the Internet technology, which relate to the technical field of fault detection and analysis and specifically comprise the following steps of networking type energy storage equipment; integrating an energy storage converter and a plurality of sensors, acquiring historical fault data records, analyzing a fluctuation curve of sensor data when faults occur, constructing a fault positioning map according to the correlation, monitoring the network-structured energy storage device in real time, acquiring the sensor data, drawing a real-time evolution curve, judging whether potential faults exist in the network-structured energy storage device according to the fitting degree of the real-time evolution curve and the historical evolution curve, immediately giving an early warning, performing potential fault investigation according to the fault positioning map, and supporting remote operation through a digital twin modeling network-structured energy storage device relative position model. The invention judges potential faults by a unique fitting degree formula, realizes early warning and achieves the purpose of timely checking and maintaining.
assignees: NANTONG GUOXUAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: New energy power equipment state judging method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy power equipment state judging method and system based on digital twinning, which are used for classifying normal and abnormal state data of power equipment based on the equality of control parameters and external influence parameters, comparing similar data, extracting initial abnormal factor data sections to form an initial abnormal factor data section group, carrying out secondary classification based on the control parameters, the external influence parameters and the proximity of the initial abnormal factor data section group, carrying out validity interception on the initial abnormal factor data based on repeated characteristics to obtain effective abnormal factor data sections, combining the effective abnormal factor data sections into an effective abnormal factor data section group, analyzing real-time operation data by utilizing the effective abnormal factor data section group, constructing a virtual model by a digital twinning technology, comparing dynamic performance, realizing state judgment, solving the problems of abnormal factor extraction and real-time monitoring in a complex environment, improving the accuracy of state judgment, and being suitable for safe operation monitoring of the new energy power equipment.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI

title_en: Collaborative management method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative management method based on digital twinning, which relates to the field of power system management and comprises the following steps of collecting equipment account information, operation and maintenance data and geographic distribution data in a physical transformer substation, constructing a corresponding digital twinning transformer substation according to the equipment account information, the operation and maintenance data and the geographic distribution data in the physical transformer substation, setting a monitoring period, acquiring input electric energy and actual output electric energy in the monitoring period, judging whether the physical transformer substation is abnormal by combining the obtained digital twinning transformer substation, generating corresponding power transformation abnormal information if the physical transformer substation is abnormal, marking the corresponding physical transformer substation as an abnormal transformer substation, collecting operation parameters of connecting equipment in the abnormal transformer substation, judging whether the connecting equipment in the abnormal transformer substation is faulty or not based on the digital twinning transformer substation, marking the corresponding connecting equipment as fault equipment if the connecting equipment is faulty, and maintaining the corresponding fault equipment.
assignees: SHENYANG ZHENGFENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-time space scale data fusion power distribution network power outage time account number calculation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, discloses a multi-time space-scale data fusion power distribution network power failure time household number accounting method, and aims to solve the problems of isolated island data, coarse space-time granularity, false alarm and intelligent deficiency and the like in the traditional accounting method. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multisource data fusion framework, carrying out fine space-time grid modeling on a power distribution network, utilizing a time synchronization correction algorithm and a mutation point detection technology to accurately correct the time range and user influence of a power failure event, combining machine learning to predict the number of potential power failure users, filling missing data by using spatial interpolation, improving the accounting integrity and accuracy, and finally generating a multidimensional visual report to provide decision support for power grid operation and planning. The invention obviously improves the accuracy and efficiency of the accounting of the number of households in power failure through multisource data fusion, intelligent algorithm and spatial interpolation technology, provides important technical support for the reliability evaluation and optimization of the power distribution network, and has wide application prospect.
assignees: HONGHE POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent planning method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent planning method for a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: firstly, dividing a power distribution network into a plurality of functional blocks, collecting and classifying power consumer power consumption data, generating a change curve based on the data to predict power consumption requirements, and obtaining a power consumption data quantity prediction curve. Then, carrying out digital twin modeling and calculation force simulation on each functional block, and recording simulation calculation force indexes; the method can accurately grasp regional electricity utilization characteristics, evaluate system states and calculation power demands in advance, accurately evaluate communication matching degree, timely find potential problems, optimize resource allocation, improve operation stability and efficiency of the power distribution network, and realize reasonable utilization and efficient management of resources.
assignees: GUODIAN HUAYAN BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method and system for graph data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for estimating the state of a power system facing to graph data, comprising the steps of extracting characteristics according to state operation graph data of the power system to obtain characteristic description data; the method comprises the steps of establishing a corresponding information equation set according to the characteristic description data, carrying out state estimation on the electric power system by utilizing a conjugate gradient method based on the information equation set, and carrying out characteristic extraction on graph data in the operation process of the electric power system, so that the method is beneficial to fully utilizing computing resources, improving computing efficiency, reducing computing time of state estimation, carrying out state estimation on the electric power system by utilizing the conjugate gradient method, and reducing risk of sinking into a local optimal solution, thereby improving solving quality.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Kalman filter-based multi-element periodic grid power prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a Kalman filter-based multi-element periodic grid power prediction method, which relates to the field of new energy generated power prediction and mainly comprises four parts, namely a multi-element periodic grid establishment stage, an initialization stage, a prediction stage and an update stage. According to the method, historical power data and meteorological data of a new energy power station are used as input, a three-dimensional grid model covering power, periodic characteristics and time is constructed, a Kalman filter is used as a prediction tool, and weights among the power, the periodic characteristics and meteorological factors are continuously adjusted by combining the historical data and current real-time input data, so that the grid data is continuously subjected to dynamic rolling update. The method can well capture the periodic characteristics and dynamic changes of the grid data, has remarkable advantages in the aspects of multi-metadata fusion, noise suppression and real-time updating of the system state, has high prediction precision, and is suitable for power prediction scenes with complex periodic fluctuation and changeable environments.
assignees: UNIV NANJING NORMAL

title_en: Data fusion-based taxi electricity utilization abnormality early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rental house electricity consumption abnormality early warning system and method based on data fusion, and relates to the technical field of electricity consumption abnormality early warning; according to the invention, a non-invasive load decomposer, a distributed temperature sensor and a high-frequency current transformer are deployed at distribution boxes, sockets and cable nodes, space-time alignment of current, temperature and load data is realized through a sliding time window algorithm, LSTM model parameters are improved by adopting an optimization algorithm, the recognition accuracy of abnormal appliances is improved, a digital twin model is built, a distribution network topology is mapped into a graph structure, the abnormal propagation probability is dynamically calculated and a risk path is visualized, hierarchical early warning is realized through a dynamic weight model integrating current deviation degree, temperature rise gradient and load mutation, the recognition accuracy of complex abnormal modes is improved, the visual prejudgment of the risk propagation path is realized, and the complete closed loop from risk early warning to active protection is realized.
assignees: SHAOXING YUEDEAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Generating capacity prediction method and system based on digital twin model of photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: A power generation amount prediction method and a power generation amount prediction system based on a photovoltaic power station digital twin model are provided, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly generating photovoltaic power station operation data conforming to actual distribution, constructing the photovoltaic power station digital twin model, respectively inputting the generated photovoltaic power station operation data into a photovoltaic power station physical model and a photovoltaic power station data driving model constructed by adopting an improved LSTM algorithm to obtain a power generation amount prediction value, and obtaining a final photovoltaic power station power generation amount prediction result by fusing the power generation amount prediction value of the physical model and the power generation amount prediction value of the data driving model. According to the invention, through construction of the digital twin model of the photovoltaic power station, the operation condition of the photovoltaic power station in reality is mapped and simulated more accurately, and the improved LSTM algorithm is adopted to construct the data driving model, so that the adaptability of the model to different time scale fluctuation is enhanced, and through fusion of the prediction results of the physical model and the data driving model, more accurate photovoltaic power generation amount prediction is obtained, and reliable support is provided for power system scheduling decision.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for air port energy balance management
abstract_en: A method, a system, equipment and a medium for energy balance management of an airport relate to the field of energy management. The method comprises the steps of constructing an energy topology map according to multi-source data, predicting energy load demands of an airport in different time periods according to the energy topology map, determining supply amounts of renewable energy sources in different time periods according to predicted illumination intensity and wind power, determining time-sharing energy supply and demand balance probability according to the energy load demands and the supply amounts, determining a preliminary energy management plan according to cost parameters, the time-sharing energy supply and demand balance probability and equipment operation constraint, wherein the preliminary energy management plan comprises an energy storage system charging and discharging time sequence, a standby generator start-stop plan and a power grid electricity purchasing proportion, executing the preliminary energy management plan through a digital twin body of the airport to obtain first energy execution data, and adjusting the preliminary energy management plan according to differences between the first energy execution data and second energy execution data at the current moment. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the energy cost is reduced.
assignees: NANJING LUKOU INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel operation quality rapid detection method based on energy efficiency evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel quality detection and discloses a tunnel operation quality rapid detection method based on energy efficiency evaluation, which comprises the following steps of S1, multi-source data fusion acquisition and modeling, namely deploying an Internet of things sensor network and constructing a three-dimensional tunnel model; S2, dynamic energy efficiency evaluation and self-adaptive scoring, namely calculating a multidimensional energy efficiency ratio based on real-time data, training a lightweight LightGBM model, updating the model every 24 hours in an increment mode, S3, automatically switching to an emergency energy efficiency mode when traffic congestion exceeds a threshold value and a fire disaster occurs in an extreme scene mode, S4, digital twin simulation and real-time optimization, S5, block chain knowledge precipitation and closed-loop management. By monitoring the congestion index and the pollutant concentration in real time, injecting extreme scene data in a virtual environment, locally training LightGBM models of all tunnels, encrypting and uploading parameters to a center for aggregation, and running the equipment according to a decision to realize the dynamic and traceability of energy efficiency evaluation under congestion or fire.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGJIAO GUOTONG INTELLIGENT TRAFFIC SYSTEM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method integrating migration learning and generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state estimation method integrating transfer learning and generation of an countermeasure network, which comprises the steps of adding measurement noise to tidal current data of an original topology to obtain the original topology measurement data, preprocessing, building a DA-CNN-BiLSTM neural network, training by using the preprocessed original topology measurement data set to obtain a source domain model, adding the measurement noise to tidal current data of a new topology to obtain a small sample new topology measurement data set simulating actual measurement, carrying out data enhancement on the new topology measurement data set by using a CWGAN-div model to obtain an extended new topology measurement data set, carrying out transfer learning on the number of frozen part layers by using the source domain model and the extended new topology measurement data set, carrying out fine tuning training on an unfrozen part to obtain a target domain model, and inputting the new topology real-time section measurement information into the target domain model to predict the target domain model to obtain the current system state quantity during online estimation. The invention solves the problem of insufficient estimation precision of the original topology estimation model during topology change.
assignees: UNIV FUJIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: New energy storage power station with electric energy recovery function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy storage power station with an electric energy recovery function, which mainly comprises a control system module, a sensor module, a controller module, an acquisition system module, a compressor module, an air storage tank module, a heat exchange module, a turbine module, an energy storage module and an inverter module, wherein the sensor module, the controller module, the acquisition system module, the compressor module, the air storage tank module, the heat exchange module, the turbine module, the energy storage module and the inverter module are connected with the control system module. In the new energy storage power station, the control system fuses the equipment characteristics with the digital model, the equipment characteristic data are associated with corresponding equipment elements in the digital model, the real-time monitoring and control of the equipment state and performance are realized, and the equipment characteristics and the digital model are tightly combined through the steps of data acquisition, state estimation, optimization algorithm design and control strategy design, so that the monitoring and control capability of the energy storage station is further enhanced. Meanwhile, the method and the system also improve the accuracy of model prediction, the accuracy and the completeness of data, and further optimize the monitoring and control effects of the whole system.
assignees: CHINA ENERGY CONSTRUCTION GROUP GUANGXI ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Group-regulation group-control digital twin method for road surface distributed photovoltaic energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention provides a group-regulation group-control digital twin method for a road surface distributed photovoltaic energy storage system, which comprises the following steps of collecting environment data and system state data in real time, constructing a digital twin model based on a multi-level correlation regression network model, dynamically predicting the system state, predicting photovoltaic power generation capacity and energy demand in a future period based on a self-supervision learning framework, dynamically adjusting the operation mode of a power generation and energy storage unit according to a prediction result and the real-time environment data, and monitoring a scheduling execution result in real time based on a closed loop feedback mechanism to ensure stable operation of the system. The invention has important significance in realizing high-efficiency energy utilization, reducing energy waste and improving system flexibility and intelligent level, and is particularly suitable for the distributed photovoltaic energy storage system in complex environments such as pavement and the like.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Digital twin synchronization method supporting equipment state evolution modeling
