abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for diagnosing a power plant excitation system based on edge cloud and digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional data of the power plant excitation system through a sensor cluster deployed at an edge end, and carrying out data noise reduction and feature extraction on the multidimensional data by adopting a lightweight algorithm to obtain target data; the method comprises the steps of transmitting target data to a cloud, constructing a dynamic fault knowledge graph by combining historical data of a power plant excitation system and a digital twin model which are stored in the cloud in advance, carrying out fault prediction on the power plant excitation system by adopting a pre-trained fault diagnosis model based on the dynamic fault knowledge graph to obtain a prediction result, carrying out encryption storage on the prediction result by utilizing a blockchain technology, automatically triggering a maintenance work order of the prediction result through an intelligent contract, calling multidimensional data and historical data in the dynamic fault knowledge graph by utilizing a multi-mode interaction technology, and dynamically generating a fault tree, thereby realizing high real-time performance and high accuracy of fault diagnosis.
assignees: HUANENG YICHUN THERMOELECTRICITY CO LTD

title_en: Novel power system power flow analysis method based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power, and provides a novel power system trend analysis method based on data driving, which solves the problems of poor real-time performance, high calculation complexity and insufficient adaptability to dynamic change faced by the traditional physical model method in a novel power system. By utilizing the historical operation data to construct input and output characteristics and combining the self-adaptive incremental learning technology, the model can rapidly and accurately predict the power flow distribution and support online real-time updating, so that the model is suitable for dynamic scenes of new energy output fluctuation and load change. The method obviously reduces the calculation cost, improves the analysis efficiency, and provides more flexible and reliable technical support for power system dispatching and operation.
assignees: DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line tower state early warning method and device based on multi-technology fusion
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power grid data processing, in particular to a power transmission line tower state early warning method and device based on multi-technology fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of utilizing a tower state monitoring acquisition unit in a power transmission line tower state early warning device to acquire tower state data and microclimate monitoring data; the method comprises the steps of analyzing the change characteristics of microclimate monitoring data in a data processing unit, dividing a time interval for early warning analysis of the state of a tower of a power transmission line, analyzing wind deflection coefficients of the state data of the tower in the early warning analysis process through the divided time interval, establishing a digital twin model, acquiring early warning information of the state of the tower through the digital twin model, and generating alarm information according to the early warning information of the state of the tower by a state alarm. According to the application, a corresponding digital twin model is built through the power transmission line tower early warning device, so that accurate tower state early warning information is generated, and the state alarm is utilized to accurately early warn the tower state.

title_en: Micro-coordination cooperative low-voltage diagnosis method and system based on digital twin and associated mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-coordination cooperative low-voltage diagnosis method and a system based on digital twin and associated mining, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a micro-coordination cooperative power distribution network; analyzing the low-voltage space-time distribution characteristics, screening a treatment area, simulating the treatment area by using a digital twin body model, selecting a corresponding treatment strategy after excavating low-voltage causes to adjust the digital twin body model to simulate again, verifying the treatment effect of the selected treatment strategy based on simulation results, calculating a comprehensive score according to the corresponding simulation results aiming at the treatment strategy with the treatment effect meeting the requirements, and taking the treatment strategy with the highest comprehensive score as the low-voltage treatment strategy. According to the invention, the diagnosis and treatment of the low-voltage problem are carried out based on the digital twin and the associated excavation by constructing the micro-coordination digital twin, so that the voltage treatment level of the micro-coordination power grid is improved.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;CHANGDE POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network fault recovery method and device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The power distribution network fault recovery method, device, storage medium and computer equipment comprise the steps of obtaining running state data of a power distribution network, determining a fault detection result according to the running state data by combining a neural network algorithm and digital twin simulation, applying isolation measures corresponding to the fault region after determining the fault region based on the fault detection result, calculating a load transfer path based on topology information of the power distribution network, and carrying out load transfer according to the load transfer path by adopting a flexible interconnection system and a household energy management system so as to recover power supply of the fault region. Therefore, the cooperative scheduling of the flexible interconnection system of the power distribution network layer and the household energy system of the user side is realized, the self-healing capacity and the operation efficiency of the power distribution network are effectively improved, and the technical effects of rapid fault isolation and power supply recovery are achieved.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: State estimation method based on self-adaptive space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network state estimation method based on a self-adaptive space-time diagram neural network, which mainly comprises the following steps of S1, collecting historical and real-time measurement data of a power distribution network, and preprocessing the data to ensure the integrity of the data, thereby providing high-quality input data for a model and improving the estimation precision and stability of the model. S2, performing discrete wavelet transformation on the historical measurement data to achieve multi-scale decomposition and extract low-frequency and high-frequency components. And constructing a double-branch time sequence fusion module, capturing global trend and local fluctuation characteristics respectively through a dynamic attention mechanism and a time convolution network, and fusing the characteristics with high efficiency by means of self-adaptive weights. And S3, in the real-time data processing process, branch measurement features are extracted by using a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) and mapped to the whole network nodes, so that the dynamic integration of historical data and real-time data is realized, and the real-time performance and accuracy of power distribution network state estimation are improved.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive power distribution cabinet energy efficiency dynamic optimization method based on multi-mode data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive power distribution cabinet energy efficiency dynamic optimization method based on multi-mode data fusion, which relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, solves the problems of energy efficiency optimization model failure and poor long-term operation stability caused by multi-source sensor data time sequence misalignment and error accumulation in the prior art, dynamically corrects time offset through a self-adaptive time sequence deviation prediction model, adopts a non-uniform time step reconstruction algorithm and Kalman filtering to compensate missing data, detects error drift trend through an exponentially weighted moving average model and updates characteristic weight, suppresses long-term error accumulation, builds a self-adaptive time sequence attention fusion network model, fuses physical constraint and a data driving mechanism to generate optimization decisions, utilizes Bayesian optimization quantization parameter uncertainty and closed loop feedback execution data to dynamically update model parameters, and remarkably improves the accuracy, long-term stability and equipment safety of power distribution cabinet energy efficiency optimization, and ensures efficient and reliable operation under multi-physical field coupling constraint.
assignees: ZHONGJI YULIAN ELECTRICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mineral resource intelligent prediction method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intelligent prediction, in particular to a mineral resource intelligent prediction method and a mineral resource intelligent prediction system based on digital twinning, the hidden association features of all data parameters in a data twin model of petroleum safety space-time big data are mined by adopting a neural network model based on deep learning, and the petroleum outage risk level is accurately evaluated based on the change feature information based on the semantic understanding features of emergencies, so that the safety of petroleum is ensured.
assignees: JINAN CHANGWO NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent scheduling system for power grid safety guarantee of multi-source data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling system for power grid safety guarantee of multi-source data analysis, which comprises an air-ground sensing layer, a multi-source data fusion engine, an extreme weather decision closed loop module, a power grid immune engine and an intelligent execution terminal, wherein the air-ground sensing layer is used for collecting meteorological data, equipment state data and power grid operation data, the multi-source data fusion engine is used for carrying out space-time alignment and feature extraction on multi-source heterogeneous data to generate a power grid panoramic state matrix, the extreme weather decision closed loop module is used for deducing a disaster propagation path through federal learning based on the power grid panoramic state matrix and outputting a scheduling control instruction, the power grid immune engine is used for receiving the power grid panoramic state matrix, simulating a hidden fault chain through a digital twin body and dynamically generating a protection device correction strategy, and the intelligent execution terminal is used for executing the scheduling control instruction and the protection device correction strategy and feeding back a physical power grid state to the digital twin body. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and an intelligent algorithm, panoramic sensing, disaster pre-judgment, dynamic protection and strategy optimization of the power grid are realized, and the safety guarantee capability is improved.
assignees: GUONENG CHANGZHOU POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Coal conveying visual voice intercom system
abstract_en: The application discloses a coal conveying visual voice intercom system which comprises a central control module, a video acquisition module, an audio acquisition module, a voice intercom module, a video analysis module, a data storage module, a network communication module, an alarm module, a mobile terminal access module and a power management module. According to the application, the safety and the operation efficiency of the coal conveying system are obviously improved by fusing high-definition video monitoring, intelligent analysis and real-time voice intercom technologies. The system adopts a deep learning algorithm to monitor the belt state in real time, can recognize faults such as deviation, coal blockage, tearing and the like in advance, reduces sudden accidents, ensures high-efficiency communication between the site and a control center by a full duplex noise reduction voice intercom function, and greatly improves emergency response speed. In addition, the system supports mobile terminal access and digital twin technology, is convenient for remote monitoring and predictive maintenance, and effectively reduces operation and maintenance cost.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD CHANGCHUN THERMAL POWER PLANT

title_en: Submarine cable risk dynamic assessment method and system based on multi-modal deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a submarine cable risk dynamic assessment method and system based on multi-mode deep learning, and belongs to the field of marine infrastructure operation and maintenance. Aiming at the problems of incomplete data coverage, incomplete generation scene, low evaluation reliability and the like in the prior art, the method comprises the steps of 1) constructing a multi-source heterogeneous data set containing six types of data such as geology, ocean, ships and biology, adopting space-time grid coding to realize data alignment, 2) designing a physical constraint generation countermeasure network, generating risk scene data conforming to a hydrodynamic rule through Navier-Stokes equation constraint, 3) creating a layered space-time fusion network (HST-transform), combining CNN spatial feature extraction, a time sequence attention mechanism and a dynamic memory module to realize multi-mode fusion, 4) establishing a mixed uncertainty quantization frame to distinguish cognitive uncertainty and inherent data noise, and 5) integrating a digital twin platform to realize risk propagation simulation and inverse fact intervention analysis. According to the invention, the rare risk event detection rate is improved by 62%, the evaluation accuracy rate reaches 91.7%, and compared with the traditional method, the false alarm rate is reduced by 34%, so that submarine cable breakage accidents can be effectively prevented.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Building structure intelligent management method and system based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention relates to a building structure intelligent management method based on BIM, which comprises the following steps of dynamic monitoring factor mining and multi-modal sensing, namely collecting weather hydrology, geological conditions, micro environments and natural disaster historical data, step two, namely performing virtual-real fusion dynamic analysis driven by a nerve operator, namely converting and mapping the collected data format into a BIM model, integrating a virtual-real synchronous engine, pre-training a Fourier nerve operator through real-time displacement and strain data reverse calibration model boundary conditions in a construction stage, establishing a direct mapping relation between external load and structure response, step three, namely performing multi-modal data cooperation and hierarchical authority interaction, namely forming a multi-dimensional feature matrix through time stamp and space coordinate association, step four, namely performing multi-modal graph convolutional network damage identification, namely extracting damage sensitive features through dynamic association among nodes of a self-adaptive graph convolutional layer, and step five, performing dynamic life early warning of digital twin driving, namely predicting residual service life of a structure.
assignees: UNIV SHAOYANG;HUNAN NATURAL RESOURCES SURVEY INST

title_en: Distribution network elastic lifting method based on distributed new energy aggregation
abstract_en: A power distribution network elastic lifting method based on distributed new energy aggregation relates to the technical field of power systems and comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a three-level collaborative architecture of equipment-cluster-system, collecting running data of distributed energy nodes in real time through digital twin dynamic modeling, S2, dynamically adjusting virtual power plant aggregation boundaries based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, optimizing a resource response strategy, S3, adopting a multi-time scale optimization framework to achieve elastic enhancement of space-time collaboration in three stages before, during and after a disaster, S4, achieving trusted evidence storage and compensation clearing of resource scheduling instructions through block chains, and achieving full-chain elastic lifting of resource utilization rate and low recovery speed after the disaster by means of constructing the three-level collaborative architecture aiming at the problems of dynamic response delay and insufficient space-time dimension collaboration in the existing distributed energy aggregation technology.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent substation safety measure checking method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent substations and discloses an intelligent substation safety measure checking method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source real-time monitoring data of a target intelligent substation, carrying out edge federation aggregation on the multi-source real-time monitoring data to obtain cooperative characteristic data, constructing a dynamic topological graph of the target intelligent substation based on the cooperative characteristic data, carrying out short-circuit fault prediction on the target intelligent substation to obtain a short-circuit fault prediction result, carrying out probability reasoning on each short-circuit fault event according to a fault probability propagation model to obtain a cascading failure posterior probability of the corresponding short-circuit fault event, carrying out multi-target optimization sequencing on each safety measure strategy to obtain a safety measure priority sequence, and carrying out simulation verification on the safety measure priority sequence according to a digital twin body to obtain a verification report. The invention forms a complete closed loop from risk analysis, rapid verification to policy optimization, and provides efficient and intelligent technical support for safe and stable operation of the intelligent substation.

title_en: Cooperative control method for distributed nodes and power grid through full-dimensional perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative control method of a distributed node and a power grid of full-dimensional perception, and relates to the technical field of power grid control. The method is based on innovative means such as a full-dimensional sensing system, a layered hybrid management and control architecture, combination of an improved genetic algorithm and deep reinforcement learning, digital twin simulation verification, TSN technology, disaster recovery mechanism and the like, and the power grid state is monitored in real time by deploying multi-dimensional sensing equipment, the layered hybrid management and control architecture is constructed to achieve global strategy formulation and local rapid regulation, the improved genetic algorithm and the deep reinforcement learning are used for multi-objective optimization, the digital twin simulation verification regulation scheme is introduced, the TSN technology is adopted to ensure hard and real-time transmission of key data, the disaster recovery mechanism and standardized interfaces are designed to improve the reliability and compatibility of the system, and the problems that in the prior art, the data confidence assessment is insufficient, the communication mechanism is imperfect, the cloud server is excessively dependent, the multi-objective optimization effect is poor and the like are effectively solved.
assignees: SHENZHEN DINGSHENGFENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric automobile and building energy management optimization method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle and building energy management optimization method based on a digital twin technology, which belongs to the field of building energy management and electric vehicle integration, and comprises the steps of collecting real-time data related to a building energy system, carrying out short-term prediction, constructing an energy management optimization model by considering vehicle states, power prices and photovoltaic power generation factors, carrying out dynamic optimization solution on the energy management optimization model based on the real-time data and prediction results, sending the optimization results to charging equipment and a battery management system through a communication interface, and adjusting an operation strategy in real time through a feedback mechanism to obtain a final scheduling result.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Public institution energy consumption missing data estimation method based on improved BPNN
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved BPNN-based public institution energy consumption missing data estimation method which comprises the steps of obtaining public institution energy consumption multi-feature data and preprocessing, feature screening, integrity checking, separating missing data from complete data, constructing a missing data estimation model based on a BP neural network according to the complete data, optimizing a network structure by adopting a particle swarm optimization algorithm, optimizing an initial weight threshold by adopting an enhanced chaotic sparrow search algorithm, training the missing data estimation model, inputting the missing data into the trained missing data estimation model, and estimating the number of people using energy. The invention combines the particle swarm and the chaotic sparrow collaborative optimization mechanism to construct the BP neural network architecture, realizes reasonable estimation of the energy consumption number missing value of public institutions, breaks through the limitation of the traditional optimization method, and has remarkable advantages in the aspects of parameter space searching efficiency and global optimizing capability.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Novel low-voltage load prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel low-voltage load prediction method, and belongs to the field of power system optimization. The method is characterized in that 4 influence factors of input time sequence factors, economic factors, meteorological factors and topological factors are subjected to feature extraction, multi-modal feature fusion is carried out through a multi-head attention mechanism, and load prediction is carried out on the fused features through a prediction network. In the process of carrying out load prediction through a prediction network, the fused characteristics are also introduced into a dynamic impedance correction module to carry out real-time adjustment and optimization on input data so as to adapt to the change characteristics in different time periods. And efficient deployment and online updating of the model are realized through edge calculation and federal learning, and instantaneity and accuracy are ensured. The method improves the accuracy and the instantaneity of power load prediction.
assignees: ZHANGZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Dynamic environment-aware fire intelligent evacuation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic environment-aware fire intelligent evacuation system and a dynamic environment-aware fire intelligent evacuation method, which relate to the technical field of fire protection and safety protection and comprise the steps of collecting real-time data in a fire scene, dividing an evacuation area into a plurality of grid units by utilizing a two-dimensional rasterization technology to form a real-time updated environment map, combining dynamic modeling data, generating an optimal evacuation path by utilizing an improved path planning algorithm, transmitting the evacuation path to trapped people in real time in a visual and auditory mode, wherein the visual and auditory mode comprises the use of dynamic indicator lamps, marker lamps, an electronic screen and a voice broadcasting system, adjusting guide content by combining the real-time data, optimizing evacuation efficiency, linking fire-fighting equipment, optimizing the environment of the evacuation path, and monitoring evacuation states by a dynamic data feedback mechanism. According to the invention, through the integrated sensor network, the dynamic modeling of the fire scene and the intelligent path planning algorithm, the evacuation path is calculated and updated in real time, and a safe and efficient evacuation scheme is provided for trapped people in the fire.
assignees: ANHUI ZHENGHUA TONGAN FIRE PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-based multi-energy supply collaborative optimization system and method for building energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based multi-energy supply collaborative optimization system and method of a building energy storage system, wherein the system comprises a wind-solar power generation system, an energy storage system, a block chain space-time database, an intelligent driving system, an electric power system, a regional building electric power system and building unit electricity utilization which are connected with each other. According to the invention, the dependence on the traditional power grid can be reduced by dispatching the energy storage system, the resource allocation is optimized, the consumption of renewable energy sources is promoted, the running cost of the building area is reduced, and the carbon footprint of the intelligent area is reduced.
assignees: HUAIYIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Remote operation and maintenance system and method for power equipment based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and operation and maintenance of power equipment, and discloses a remote operation and maintenance system and method of power equipment based on a digital twin technology, wherein the remote operation and maintenance system and method of power equipment comprises a data acquisition module, a digital twin modeling module, a state monitoring and diagnosis module and an operation and maintenance decision module; the data acquisition module adopts a distributed grid architecture and optimizes sensor sampling by using a PPO algorithm, the digital twin modeling module fuses RLC voltage and a simplified heat dissipation equation, model parameters are corrected through scalar Kalman filtering and aging factors, the state monitoring and diagnosis module realizes fault early warning based on multi-threshold detection and Bayesian network, the operation and maintenance decision module generates an optimized operation and maintenance instruction by adopting a genetic algorithm, and the method comprises parameter adjustment, model updating, trigger calculation, maintenance instruction sending and model parameter correction. The invention realizes the full-flow intelligent management of the power equipment, optimizes the operation and maintenance cost and ensures the stable operation of the power system.
assignees: LIGUNA TECH GUANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic dispatching optimization and simulation method for drainage basin water resources based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic dispatching optimization and simulation method for water resources in a river basin based on digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of water resource dispatching and comprises the steps of constructing a dispatching relation network for water resources in the river basin; the method comprises the steps of simulating to obtain regional water demand and water consumption of a demand region, simulating to obtain a loss coefficient of water resources, forming a preparation optimization scheme, calculating demand satisfaction of the preparation optimization scheme, calculating scheduling excess amplitude of the preparation optimization scheme, calculating scheduling completion time consumption of the preparation optimization scheme, comprehensively obtaining an optimization coefficient of the preparation optimization scheme, and selecting the preparation optimization scheme with the largest optimization coefficient as the scheduling optimization scheme. The scheduling relation network of the water resources in the river basin is constructed, the loss coefficient of the water resources is obtained through simulation, the point to be optimized of the current scheduling scheme is obtained through simulation, the optimization coefficient of the preparation optimization scheme is obtained comprehensively, and the influences of various factors are fused, so that the scheduling scheme with a proper effect can be selected.
assignees: NANJING ZECHUN WATER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power plant operation adjustment method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power plants, in particular to an intelligent power plant operation adjustment method, an intelligent power plant operation adjustment device, intelligent power plant operation adjustment equipment and a storage medium. The digital twin three-dimensional model is subjected to simulation analysis based on the candidate operation adjustment scheme, the reliability of operation adjustment of the power plant is improved, invalid adjustment is reduced by performing simulation analysis on the digital twin three-dimensional model, and the technical problem that the operation of the power plant in the prior art lacks efficient adjustment scheme, and the thermal power generation efficiency and economic benefit are affected is solved.
assignees: XINJIANG ZHUNNENG INVEST CO LTD

title_en: AIoT construction site safety monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a AIoT construction site safety monitoring system, which comprises a multi-mode sensing array, an embedded lightweight neural network model, a digital twin engine, an adaptive decision module and a blockchain evidence storage unit, wherein the multi-mode sensing array comprises a millimeter wave radar, an infrared thermal imager, a UWB positioning tag and a voiceprint sensor, the edge computing node is internally provided with the lightweight neural network model and is used for processing sensor data in real time and generating a risk characteristic vector, the digital twin engine is used for dynamically constructing a three-dimensional construction scene model and mapping a physical entity state, the adaptive decision module is used for dynamically adjusting a risk judgment threshold according to historical accident data, and the blockchain evidence storage unit is used for encrypting and storing illegal event data and generating a tamper-proof timestamp.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 2ND ENG BUREAU

title_en: Security system for cross-domain communication and data sharing of network platform software
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer network security, in particular to a security assurance system for cross-domain communication and data sharing of network platform software, which comprises a data security transmission module, an identity authentication and access control module, an encryption module, a security audit and anomaly detection module and an anti-interference disaster recovery module. The invention realizes the cooperative guarantee of key safety and transmission continuity in cross-domain audio transmission by linking with AI risk prejudging, reinforcement learning path planning, digital twin preverifying and failure automatic switching technology through the equipment fingerprint end-to-end encryption, threat self-adaptive dynamic key updating and time stamp-random number replay prevention mechanism, so that the encryption strength is dynamically upgraded along with threat, the transmission path is optimized in advance, and the audio stream is ensured to resist various network attacks and interferences in low-delay transmission.

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous data access method and system for photovoltaic power generation digital twin platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power generation digital twin platform multi-source heterogeneous data access method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting original data from multisource sensors such as weather, environment, electricity and images, performing data cleaning, format standardization and abnormal elimination, then performing sampling, synchronization, feature extraction and structuring pretreatment on the data, and storing the data in a time sequence database, a relational database or object storage according to data types. The system also pushes the processed data to the digital twin platform in real time through the standardized interface, so that visual presentation and model driven simulation of the data are realized. The invention solves the problems of heterogeneous multi-source data, large precision difference, high real-time requirement and the like of the photovoltaic field station, has good system expansibility and engineering suitability, and is widely applicable to distributed and centralized photovoltaic power generation systems.
assignees: HUANENG JIANGSU COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Power distribution network state parameter joint estimation method based on double-extended Kalman filtering
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network state parameter joint estimation method based on double extended Kalman filtering, which relates to the technical field of power grid state prediction. For the condition that the state data and the parameter data in the power distribution network are inaccurate and have mutual influence, a state-parameter iterative estimation model is built by establishing prior estimation and posterior estimation interaction of two flows, and the model converts a traditional state and parameter segmentation model into a unified estimation model. And carrying out joint solution on the state estimation model and the parameter estimation model of the power distribution network so as to solve the problem of limited estimation precision caused by mutual independence of the models in the traditional method. Therefore, the real-time and accurate estimation of the running state and parameters of the power distribution network is realized, the observability of the power distribution network is more comprehensively improved, and powerful data support is provided for fault diagnosis and running optimization.

title_en: Intelligent diagnosis method and system for breaker fault identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent diagnosis method and system for breaker fault identification, and relates to the technical field of breaker fault diagnosis, wherein the method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting multi-source heterogeneous operation data of a target breaker through a high-precision sensing network; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a multi-scale space-time feature extraction network to process to obtain a breaker joint feature, inputting the breaker joint feature into a bidirectional LSTM-GAN hybrid model, driving a target breaker digital twin body based on a fault sample to obtain target breaker fault data, executing edge-cloud collaborative diagnosis of the target breaker fault data, and generating a breaker three-dimensional diagnosis report. The technical problems of single fault diagnosis means and low detection sensitivity to complex fault modes of the circuit breaker in the prior art are solved, so that the circuit breaker is low in fault diagnosis efficiency and insufficient in diagnosis result accuracy, and the technical effects of improving the circuit breaker diagnosis result accuracy and the fault diagnosis efficiency are achieved.
assignees: ZHENJIANG SIEMENS BUSBAR TRUNKING SYSTEMS CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent emergency tripping and fire-fighting interlocking system based on multistage linkage
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent emergency tripping and fire-fighting interlocking system based on multistage linkage, which relates to the technical field of test bench monitoring, and aims to realize rapid synchronous separation of mechanical, electrical and fluid systems through a multistage linkage mechanism, avoid secondary disasters, integrate various sensors, monitor environmental states in real time, trigger alarming and emergency measures in a grading manner, dynamically optimize escape paths and ensure personnel safety evacuation by combining a digital twin technology. Meanwhile, the energy recovery and blockchain storage function is achieved, and the green energy-saving performance and the data safety are improved. The test bench aims to solve the problems that an existing test bench depends on manual intervention under emergency working conditions, is long in response time and has potential safety hazards.
assignees: XIAMEN GUOCHUANG CENTER ADVANCED ELECTRIC DRIVE TECH INNOVATION CENTER;XIAMEN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION MOTOR VEHICLE POLLUTION CONTROL TECH CENTER

title_en: Vehicle annual examination reservation queuing intelligent scheduling and dynamic load prediction system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle annual inspection, and discloses an intelligent scheduling and dynamic load forecasting system for vehicle annual inspection reservation queuing, which comprises a user reservation module, an intelligent scheduling module and a dynamic load forecasting module, wherein the user reservation module is used for receiving vehicle annual inspection reservation information submitted by a user, the vehicle annual inspection reservation information comprises vehicle basic information, reservation time and reservation detection stations, the intelligent scheduling module is connected with the user reservation module and is used for intelligently scheduling reserved vehicles according to real-time load conditions, detection resource allocation conditions and user reservation information of each detection station to generate an optimal detection time and detection station allocation scheme, and the dynamic load forecasting module is connected with the intelligent scheduling module. According to the invention, annual audit full-flow intellectualization is realized through multi-module cooperation, data are acquired in real time by millimeter wave radars and the like, ST-GNN+LSTM dynamic prediction loads are predicted, and multi-target distribution is intelligently scheduled. The user conveniently reserves to receive the notification, the network voltage is reduced by 70% by the edge-cloud, and the digital twin visualization is realized. The benefit is that the waiting time ∈50%, the station utilization rate ∈30% and the satisfaction degree are improved.
assignees: HEFEI XINGRAN AUTOMOTIVE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network auxiliary decision-making method, system and medium considering source load fluctuation relevance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and automation thereof, in particular to a distribution network auxiliary decision-making method, a distribution network auxiliary decision-making system and a distribution network auxiliary decision-making medium considering source-load fluctuation relevance. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting relevant information of a distribution network area, quantifying the synchronicity and hysteresis association rule of multi-source heterogeneous data fluctuation, constructing a composite feature vector and a standardized risk perception data set, defining a state space and an action space of a reinforcement learning algorithm based on the composite feature vector, realizing distribution network auxiliary decision-making optimization, constructing a scene feature library, calculating fluctuation association similarity of a new scene and a historical scene, multiplexing a deep reinforcement learning model framework and migration learning, constructing a power grid digital twin simulation platform, designing evaluation indexes, generating candidate schemes and deducting, selecting a recommendation strategy and storing the recommendation strategy into a strategy knowledge base.
assignees: SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for deducting and evaluating digital twin situation of aircraft under complex meteorological environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for deducing and evaluating digital twin situations of an aircraft under a complex meteorological environment, which belongs to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of collecting and processing weather data and covering parameters such as wind direction, wind speed and the like; acquiring performance parameters of the aircraft, building a library, and inputting and analyzing a flight plan. By establishing a three-dimensional deduction model comprising dynamics, weather influence and environmental models, the situation of the aircraft under different weather is deduced, and flight safety, performance and task risks are evaluated. The method has the advantages of comprehensively and accurately analyzing weather factors, quantifying influences through data acquisition and processing and meteorological models, being applicable to various aircrafts, integrating navigation and control systems, realizing remote monitoring management, being scientific and reliable in risk assessment, integrating multiple factors, providing powerful support for flight decisions, and effectively improving the safety and task success rate of the aircrafts in complex weather.
assignees: CHENGDU FEIHANG ZHIYUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based distribution network equipment operation risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The digital twin-based distribution network equipment operation risk assessment method and system comprise the steps of calculating an overall potential risk assessment value of equipment according to weather data and historical operation data of each piece of equipment, judging whether the overall potential risk exists in the equipment according to a pre-established future risk analysis model based on weather prediction, judging whether the overall potential risk exists in the equipment according to a combined assessment model of the weather data, the overall potential risk assessment value of the equipment and the risk weight of the equipment in a network frame, judging whether the overall power distribution network is at risk according to a pre-established combined assessment model of the influence of the weather on the network frame risk, if the overall potential risk exists in the equipment and the overall power distribution network is free of risk, adjusting a risk level threshold of the equipment, otherwise, weighting a health state assessment model according to the weather data, the historical operation data of the equipment and the weight coefficient of the operation data to obtain a risk assessment result of the equipment, and improving accuracy and timeliness of risk assessment.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-reinforcement learning-based dynamic regulation and control method for safety domain of electro-hydrogen system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic regulation and control method of an electric hydrogen system safety domain based on digital twin-reinforcement learning, which belongs to the field of safe operation of a power grid and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-energy flow coupling model comprising new energy power generation, an electrolytic tank and a hydrogen storage tank, S2, decomposing a new energy original output sequence by adopting a method combining continuous wavelet transformation and an autoregressive moving average model to form a time-frequency characteristic, S3, modeling in a state space by considering space-time coupling, S4, generating a dynamic safety domain based on digital twin, S5, constructing a multi-objective rewarding function, solving by taking the dynamic safety domain as a constraint, and S6, performing closed-loop verification and model evolution. By adopting the dynamic regulation and control method of the safety domain of the electro-hydrogen system based on digital twin-reinforcement learning, the dynamic adaptation and intelligent control of the safety domain of the electro-hydrogen system under the fluctuation of new energy are realized, and the operation safety and economy of the system are obviously improved.

title_en: Intelligent factory energy efficiency optimization method, system and equipment based on industrial Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent factory energy efficiency optimization method, system and equipment based on an industrial Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of the industrial Internet of things; the method comprises the steps of establishing a factory digital twin model, determining equipment start-stop time sequence and energy distribution strategies, deploying edge computing nodes, monitoring equipment vibration frequency spectrums, generating a state prediction diagram in a time sliding window, performing self-adaptive compensation optimization, and simultaneously, setting up an energy source flow network based on the equipment start-stop time sequence and the energy distribution strategies to dynamically adjust energy. The intelligent factory energy efficiency optimization method solves the technical problems of low energy utilization efficiency and insufficient equipment operation stability of the intelligent factory in the prior art, achieves the technical effects of realizing intelligent factory energy efficiency optimization based on the industrial Internet of things, and improving the energy utilization efficiency and the equipment operation stability.
assignees: NANJING CHUANGHONGJING INTELLIGENT TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Enhanced power substation digital twins
abstract_en: Systems and methods for virtualizing power substations may include generating, for a first physical device of a power substation, a first virtual machine that models characteristics of the first physical device; generating, based on forecasted weather and operational parameters of the power substation, settings for the first virtual machine; generating, based on physical sensor data for the power substation, virtual sensors; generating, based on virtual sensor data from the virtual sensors and the settings, an asset digital twin model of the first physical device; generating, based on the virtual sensor data and the asset digital twin model, a cyber digital twin for the first physical device; generating, based on the virtual sensor data and the asset digital twin model, a physics-based digital twin for the first physical device; and generating a substation digital twin virtually representing the power substation, including the cyber digital twin and the physics-based digital twin.
assignees: GENERAL ELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY GMBH;GE INFRASTRUCTURE TECHNOLOGY LLC

title_en: Real-time visual power grid business demand planning intelligent auxiliary decision-making system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid business planning, and provides a real-time visualized power grid business demand planning intelligent auxiliary decision-making system which comprises a visual acquisition module, a power grid classification module, a classification prediction module and an assessment re-planning module, wherein multisource information of a power grid is acquired in real time, a visual platform is built and combined with a power grid digital twin model, the power grid is divided into sub-power grid scenes, sub-power grid load groups of the sub-power grid scenes are obtained through calculation according to the multisource information, the sub-power grid scenes are classified to obtain sub-power grid scene types, a prediction strategy is allocated for the sub-power grid scenes to predict the sub-power grid scenes to obtain a predicted sub-power grid load group, the predicted sub-power grid load group is sent to the visual platform, the comprehensive score of the current power grid planning is calculated, whether the current power grid planning is qualified or not is judged, and if the current power grid planning is disqualified, the power grid re-planning analysis is triggered.

title_en: Multi-time space scale situation awareness method for new energy operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy operation multi-time space-scale situation awareness method which comprises multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition and preprocessing, multi-time space-scale feature extraction and fusion, uncertainty quantification and probability prediction, edge cloud collaborative real-time situation assessment and multi-target collaborative optimization and feedback control. The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent power grids, in particular to a new energy operation multi-time space scale situation sensing method, which adopts multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition and preprocessing to determine data sources, preprocesses the data through space-time alignment and anomaly detection, captures complex anomaly modes by utilizing reconstruction errors of a variation self-encoder, and detects hidden equipment faults; and adopting edge cloud collaborative real-time situation assessment, adopting a knowledge distillation technology to side a lightweight anomaly detection model at the edge, adopting a local outlier factor algorithm to perform millisecond anomaly detection, and adopting cloud digital twin modeling to issue updated parameters so as to optimize communication efficiency.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-driven operation and maintenance prediction method and system for deep sea fan platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-driven remote-sea fan platform prediction operation and maintenance method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time multi-source heterogeneous data of a remote-sea target fan platform based on a sensor network, constructing a digital twin body of the target fan platform integrated by multiple physical fields, inputting the real-time multi-source heterogeneous data into the digital twin body for simulation processing to obtain fault probability distribution of the target fan platform, and executing an operation and maintenance strategy corresponding to the fault probability distribution. The method for predicting the operation and maintenance of the deep sea fan platform improves the efficiency of predicting the operation and maintenance of the deep sea fan platform.

title_en: Digital construction method, system, equipment and medium based on BIM tunnel construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering construction, and discloses a digital construction method, a system, equipment and a medium for constructing a BIM tunnel based on BIM tunnel construction, wherein a high-precision BIM construction model is constructed by integrating environmental data, so that visual simulation and accurate planning of a construction flow under complex geological conditions are realized; based on the multiparty collaboration platform, the real-time data sharing and synchronous change of the participants such as design, construction, supervision and the like are communicated, and the collaboration efficiency and decision scientificity are improved; the method comprises the steps of combining a digital twin technology and a deep learning algorithm, establishing a risk prediction model, generating an optimization scheme, dynamically correcting construction parameters and verifying adjustment effects by monitoring surrounding rock displacement, supporting stress and equipment operation data in real time, forming a closed-loop intelligent monitoring system, integrating an intelligent management module and a sensor network, supporting full-element dynamic optimization, realizing data acquisition and model interaction, and storing multidimensional construction data and algorithm models.
assignees: POWERCHINA CONSTR GROUP LTD

title_en: Power generation curve management and adjustment system of low-efficiency photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of management and control of photovoltaic power stations, in particular to a power generation curve management and adjustment system of a low-efficiency photovoltaic power station, which comprises a multi-source data acquisition unit, a power generation curve stability judgment unit, an internal and external interference factor analysis unit, a multi-dimensional information fusion unit and an intelligent adjustment decision unit; according to the invention, the stability state of the power generation curve is accurately screened through time-frequency domain joint analysis, the digital twin of equipment and the environment multisource data fusion technology are combined, internal and external interference factors are deeply decoupled, an analysis report with causal chain support is generated, accurate guidance is provided for an adjustment strategy, multisource data acquisition is taken as a starting point, and the complete closed loop is formed through power generation curve stability judgment, internal and external interference factor analysis, multidimensional information fusion, intelligent adjustment decision-making to closed loop execution and verification, so that the power generation stability and economy of the low-efficiency photovoltaic power station are facilitated to be improved.
assignees: BEIJING CHANGTIAN XINRONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid real-time optimal scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power grid real-time optimal scheduling system and method, and relates to the technical field of power grid scheduling. The environmental parameters of the key nodes are collected in real time through deployment of sensors, a dynamic environmental condition coefficient is constructed, the power grid state is analyzed by combining the frequency stability and the relative strength index, a multi-model fusion prediction mechanism is built, and space-time double-dimension accurate prediction of load and power generation is realized. And a multi-objective optimization model is adopted, new energy consumption maximization and scheduling cost minimization are taken as core targets, a genetic algorithm is introduced to solve an optimal scheduling scheme, and a digital twin model is combined to forward simulation screening of a feasible solution. And the scheduling strategy is dynamically adjusted through abnormal early warning triggering, environment association degree analysis and model iterative optimization, so that the power supply efficiency and emergency response capability under an extreme scene are improved. The method effectively fuses multi-source heterogeneous data, and achieves real-time sensing of the running state of the power grid, collaborative optimization of multi-energy resources and self-adaptive iteration of a scheduling model.

title_en: Energy digital twin platform and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy digital twin platform and a construction method, which relate to the technical field of digital twin, and collect multi-element perception data of each stage of an energy system through a distributed intelligent sensor network, and perform noise filtration, data reduction and feature extraction, wherein the method relates to the steps of grouping perception data of adjacent stages in pairs, extracting feature vectors through a feature extraction network, and the conversion matrix is utilized to convert the later stage data into the earlier stage data reference system to realize data merging, and finally, a digital twin model reflecting the full life cycle of the energy system is constructed through data fusion and optimization processing.
assignees: CHENGDU TURUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for quality management of power data for model training and method for operation thereof
title_ko: 모델 학습용 전력 데이터의 품질 관리 시스템 및 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an operation method of a learning data management system operated by at least one processor. The operation method of a learning data management system comprises the steps of: collecting a plurality of power usage data from an advanced metering infrastructure (ami) facility of an arbitrary generation; and analyzing at least one power usage pattern by analyzing the power usage data. A plurality of power usage data grouped in each power usage pattern are analyzed as training candidate data in a high volatility time zone, and training candidate data having missing values in the high volatility time zone is determined in each power usage pattern, and then training data except for the training candidate data having missing values is obtained.
abstract_ko: 적어도 하나의 프로세서에 의해 동작하는 학습용 데이터 관리 시스템의 동작 방법으로서, 임의의 세대의 AMI(Advanced Metering Infrastructure) 설비로부터 복수의 전력사용량 데이터들을 수집하고, 전력사용량 데이터들을 분석하여 적어도 하나의 전력사용 패턴을 분석한다. 각 전력사용 패턴으로 그룹핑 된 복수의 전력사용량 데이터들을 학습용 후보 데이터들로 고 변동성 시간대를 분석하고, 각 전력사용 패턴에서 고 변동성 시간대에 결측치가 있는 학습용 후보 데이터를 판별한 후, 결측치가 있는 학습용 후보 데이터를 제외한 학습용 데이터를 획득한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Automated in-patient medical emergency management system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a patient monitoring system (102) for monitoring health of hospitalized non-ICU patients. This system (102) includes a set of monitoring devices (104) for displaying a comprehensive set of vital parameters related to patients. Additionally, a set of cameras (106) is integrated into the system, continuously capturing images of each monitoring device (104). The system is powered by processors (202) that execute instructions for image analysis using an AI engine. Through seamless communication with computing devices, the processors (202) facilitate swift transmission of alert signals to healthcare professionals, offering real-time updates upon detection of critical patient conditions. These alert signals include essential information about the identified vital parameter, enabling healthcare professionals to promptly intervene and address the needs of hospitalized non-ICU patients.
assignees: DAS PURNENDU BHUSAN

title_en: Operation and maintenance data visualization method and system based on smart power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data visualization, and provides an operation and maintenance data visualization method and system based on a smart power grid, which are used for improving the efficiency and the intelligent degree of the operation and maintenance visualization of the power grid so as to improve the timeliness of operation and maintenance decision management of the power grid, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multisource heterogeneous operation and maintenance data sets in the smart power grid in real time; the method comprises the steps of performing cross-modal cleaning and time alignment processing on an operation and maintenance data set to generate a preprocessing data set, performing dynamic feature fusion and association analysis on the preprocessing data set to generate a device state feature set and a device-environment interaction feature set, generating an interactive visual element set through a multi-dimensional visual strategy based on the device state feature set and the device-environment interaction feature set, performing dynamic rendering and layout optimization on the interactive visual element set to output a real-time updated power grid operation and maintenance visual interface, wherein the power grid operation and maintenance visual interface is provided with a user operation priority response mechanism for processing interaction conflicts.

title_en: Algorithm model operation monitoring method and system for power industry
abstract_en: The invention provides an algorithm model operation monitoring method and system for the power industry, and relates to the field of model monitoring. The method comprises the steps of collecting physical quantity data of power equipment through a dynamic causal chain construction module, generating a causal chain after noise suppression and preprocessing, binding with algorithm model parameters, recording mutation events and associated parameter update logs, utilizing a four-dimensional space-time lock synchronization module to attach geographic coordinates and time stamps to ensure data space-time consistency, constructing an optimization strategy by a multi-target game strategy engine module based on historical misinformation events and resource consumption records and combining SLA time constraint of a real-time detection task, triggering emergency response by a DEED-Trigger anti-intuitionism triggering module according to deviation between real-time data and the optimization strategy, injecting compound fault test causal chain robustness by a digital twin technology through a verification platform, and dynamically adjusting causal chain structure and strategy.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Collaborative simulation method, system, equipment and medium for electric energy market and frequency modulation market
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative simulation method, a system, equipment and a medium for an electric energy market and a frequency modulation market, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a micro-service framework covering various micro-services according to the simulation function requirement of the electric energy market, utilizing the micro-service framework to carry out joint clearing of the electric energy market and a real-time frequency modulation market in the day, realizing collaborative optimization of the electric energy market and the frequency modulation market in the joint clearing process based on a pre-established two-stage optimization model, self-adaptively adjusting market parameters based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, dynamically switching clearing periods, establishing an electric power system model by adopting a digital twin technology, and simulating the running state of the electric power system according to the collaborative optimization result of the electric energy market and the frequency modulation market, the adjusted market parameters and the switched clearing periods, thereby realizing real-time closed loop simulation. The invention realizes the joint optimization of the electric energy market and the frequency modulation market, provides scientific decision basis for the operation and control of the electric power system, and improves the accuracy and reliability of simulation.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Standardized centralized DTU multi-level fault diagnosis and self-healing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a standardized centralized DTU multi-level fault diagnosis and self-healing method and a system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent power grid fault diagnosis and comprise the steps of establishing a dynamic topological graph according to unified coding rules, and extracting space-time characteristics through a graph convolution network to obtain a space-time characteristic power grid topological graph; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin environment of a power grid based on a multi-level standardized fault diagnosis result, generating a plurality of sets of self-healing strategy candidate sets by adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm, screening an optimal self-healing strategy, converting the optimal self-healing strategy into a control instruction conforming to an automatic standard protocol of a transformer substation, sending the control instruction to a DTU, analyzing the DTU, and controlling an intelligent power switch cabinet to execute self-healing operation. By automatically correcting the abnormal diagnosis result, false alarm and missing alarm are reduced, and the accuracy of fault diagnosis is improved. The intelligent level of power grid management is remarkably improved, the maintenance cost is reduced, and the operation efficiency and the service quality of the power system are optimized.
assignees: GUANGDONG RUICHUANG INTELLIGENT CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin data filling method, device, equipment and storage medium for power transmission and transformation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for filling digital twin data of power transmission and transformation equipment, which belong to the technical field of data processing and comprise the steps of obtaining operation parameter information of power transmission and transformation entity equipment, wherein the operation parameter information comprises current operation parameter information and historical operation parameter information; and determining trend associated information of each parameter, and filling the blank data based on the trend analysis result under the condition that the current operation parameter information is not abnormal based on the trend associated information and the trend analysis result. The invention effectively avoids model distortion caused by data blank, maintains real-time accurate reflection of the running state of the power transmission and transformation equipment, and provides more reliable support for fault diagnosis, state monitoring and predictive maintenance of the equipment.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle emergency control management method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency control management method and system based on digital twinning, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle data acquisition module, a virtual scene construction module, an emergency route analysis module, an execution scheme planning module and an operation visualization module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle data acquisition module acquires image data in an emergency area and parameter records of unmanned aerial vehicles, the virtual scene construction module builds a virtual scene by utilizing a digital twin technology, maps and divides a three-dimensional grid in real time, the emergency route analysis module plans a feasible route for each unmanned aerial vehicle in the virtual scene and screens out an important route, the execution scheme planning module analyzes each scheme according to the important route planning scheme so as to set a communication scheme, and the operation visualization module monitors each unmanned aerial vehicle to fly according to the communication scheme and displays the virtual scene in real time through a visual page of a command center. According to the invention, through digital twin-driven multisource perception fusion, dynamic grid adaptation and nonlinear anti-interference path planning, the environment modeling precision and the communication link reliability of the unmanned aerial vehicle group in a disaster environment are improved.
assignees: TAIZHOU CHENGFA DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: AIoT intelligent fire-fighting cooperative prevention and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent fire control and urban public safety, in particular to a AIoT intelligent fire control cooperative prevention and control method and system, comprising the following steps of S1, deploying a multi-mode sensing terminal array; the method comprises the steps of S2, deploying intelligent edge nodes in each partition of a building, S3, constructing a building digital twin body, S4, constructing a coalition chain network based on HYPERLEDGER FABRIC, S5, developing an AR panoramic command system, and integrating a UWB positioning module and SLAM live-action modeling. Compared with the prior art, the method can support visual command of the mobile terminal, realize scene navigation of the fire scene by fusing the AR technology, and remarkably improve fire prevention and control efficiency and emergency resource scheduling efficiency in a complex building environment.
assignees: INSPUR SMART SUPPLY CHAIN TECH SHANDONG CO LTD;SHANDONG HUAAN EMERGENCY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Fault response method and device for power distribution control cabinet
abstract_en: The application provides a power distribution control cabinet fault response method and device, and relates to the technical field of electric automation control, and the technical scheme is characterized in that a weighted directed graph model for representing the relationship between components in the power distribution control cabinet is constructed in advance; the method comprises the steps of mapping component fault information predicted by a digital twin system to attributes of corresponding nodes in a weighted directed graph model, identifying fault paths or fault clusters meeting preset conditions, calculating a composite risk index according to the predicted probability of each identified fault path or fault cluster containing the node, the weight of a connecting edge and the severity of influence on the system, and generating early warning information according to the composite risk index. The power distribution control cabinet fault response method and device provided by the application have the advantages that potential fault propagation paths or fault aggregation areas can be identified based on physical, electrical and influence relations among components, and composite risks formed by combining a plurality of potential faults are quantified, so that preventive maintenance decisions are guided.
assignees: TIANJIN MINGWANG ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment storage information tracing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for tracing storage information of power equipment, which belong to the technical field of storage management of the power equipment, wherein a space-time double-chain block chain structure is constructed by the method, and data decoupling and space-time association are realized through an equipment operation chain and an environment state chain; and synchronously calling double-chain data through a space-time index, generating a three-dimensional space-time track diagram containing a health degree prediction curve on a digital twin platform, and fusing a position migration path, an environmental thermodynamic diagram, residual life prediction and other visual layers. The system integrates a multi-mode intelligent sensing terminal, an edge computing gateway, a double-chain blockchain platform and a traceability visualization engine, and supports centimeter-level positioning, anti-interference data acquisition and AR traceability display. The scheme solves the problems of data splitting, perception hysteresis and the like of the traditional system, realizes high-precision information tracing, environment risk prejudgment and visual decision, and improves the warehouse management efficiency and reliability of the power equipment.
assignees: ORDOS INSTITUTE OF TECH

title_en: Smart power grid optimal scheduling system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence-based intelligent power grid optimal scheduling system and method. The intelligent power grid optimizing and dispatching system and method based on the artificial intelligence comprise a data acquisition and preprocessing module, an uncertainty evaluation and digital twin simulation module and a high-frequency dynamic optimizing and dispatching module, wherein the data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for acquiring real-time power grid data, a convolution-long-short-period memory network is adopted to generate short-term prediction results for wind power output, photovoltaic output and load demands based on the preprocessed real-time power grid data, and the high-frequency dynamic optimizing and dispatching module is used for generating a dispatching strategy which simultaneously meets the requirements of power balance, unit technology constraint and network safety stability. According to the intelligent power grid optimal scheduling system and method based on the artificial intelligence, the renewable energy access ratio is greatly improved, the wind and light discarding losses are reduced, the operation cost is reduced, the robustness to uncertainty is enhanced, and the intelligent power grid is promoted to develop in the efficient, green and reliable directions.
assignees: NANJING HANGJING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional digital supervision method for power grid engineering based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-dimensional digital supervision method of power grid engineering based on big data, which belongs to the technical field of digital supervision of power grid engineering and comprises the following steps of S1, real-time acquisition and fusion of multi-dimensional data, construction of a supervision system through four supervision layers and a digital twin body, S2, intelligent calculation of multi-dimensional supervision indexes, construction of a supervision dimension index system, S3, dynamic early warning and root cause tracing of risks, and S4, decision optimization and closed-loop control. According to the invention, the BIM model, GIS positioning, sensing data of the Internet of things, environmental monitoring and multidimensional data sources of service system data are fused to perform multi-source heterogeneous data integration, so that single data source deviation is avoided, information island is broken, multi-objective collaborative optimization is realized, a 'supervision-decision-execution' closed loop is realized, an optimal regulation strategy is convenient to calculate, the optimal regulation strategy can be generated based on the reinforcement learning model, and an early warning instruction is communicated with a field terminal, so that the monitoring and early warning efficiency of the power grid engineering can be effectively improved.
assignees: State grid shanghai electric power design co ltd

title_en: Communication power supply system evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method and device of a communication power supply system, which relate to the technical field of communication and comprise the steps of collecting dynamic operation data, static configuration parameters and historical maintenance records in real time through a multi-source heterogeneous data collection module; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-layer risk assessment architecture of a device level, a system level and a subsystem level, calculating subjective weights by adopting an improved fuzzy analytic hierarchy process, deploying an LSTM-GAN hybrid model to generate device degradation simulation data, establishing a deep residual convolution network, constructing a dynamic risk propagation matrix, establishing a virtual mirror image system based on a digital twin technology, generating a three-dimensional visual risk thermodynamic diagram, outputting a customized maintenance scheme, and updating a device health file through a blockchain intelligent contract. Therefore, multidimensional indexes such as voltage ripple, temperature rise rate, equipment aging curve and the like are integrated through the multisource data fusion architecture, and information island is eliminated, so that dynamic information stability under complex working conditions is ensured.
assignees: WEIFANG HANTING DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent scheduling method and system for virtual power plant
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a virtual power plant intelligent scheduling method, a system, a storage medium, electronic equipment and a computer program product based on digital twin, and belongs to the technical field of digital power grids. The method comprises the steps of constructing a corresponding action response training data set based on a digital twin agent matrix constructed by grid nodes corresponding to distributed power equipment participating in scheduling, generating constraint feedback information reflecting the feasibility of a current target control action based on a grid operation constraint response model, taking the constraint feedback information as coupling information of a pre-trained scheduling strategy model, executing scheduling strategy training based on the current target control action to obtain a scheduling strategy model with constraint awareness capability, and generating a corresponding scheduling control action based on the scheduling strategy model. The scheme of the invention improves the perceptibility and the response capability of the scheduling strategy to the operation constraint of the power grid, thereby dynamically optimizing the distributed resource scheduling efficiency and the decision intelligent level on the premise of meeting the stability of the power grid.
assignees: BEIJING SMARTCHIP MICROELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD
