title_en: Slope protection drainage reinforcement management system based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope protection drainage reinforcement management system based on cloud computing, which is characterized by comprising the steps of preprocessing multi-source slope data, transmitting the preprocessed multi-source slope data to a cloud computing module, receiving the processed multi-source slope data, carrying out filtering processing on the multi-source slope data by using an LMS least mean square algorithm, establishing a transform-XL slope space-time coupling prediction model, introducing PINN physical information neural networks into the model, embedding finite element analysis physical constraints into the model for training, inputting initial multi-source slope data into the slope space-time coupling prediction model for risk assessment, establishing a slope protection digital twin body based on a slope risk assessment state, synchronizing sensor data and a BIM model in real time, and simulating effects of different reinforcement schemes by HPC cloud high-performance computing, so as to generate a multi-objective optimization scheme. The intelligent and accurate management of slope protection drainage reinforcement engineering can be realized according to the real-time monitoring data dynamic adjustment scheme.
assignees: HUBEI LIJING GARDEN LANDSCAPE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent inspection method and system for consistency of power grid infrastructure construction and design process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid construction, in particular to an intelligent inspection method and system for consistency of power grid foundation construction and design process, the method constructs a digital twin body of the power grid foundation construction, determines the state evaluation index of the foundation construction, based on state evaluation index data of the digital twin body and the physical entity at different times in the construction process, calculating to obtain state evaluation index data errors at different times, and calculating to obtain linear characteristic value statistics according to the state evaluation index data errors, so as to realize consistency test of power grid infrastructure construction and design process. The invention can accurately capture the dynamic difference between the actual construction process and the design process, thereby realizing consistency test of the power grid infrastructure construction and the design process.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent canteen people flow scheduling and dish recommending system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent logistics, in particular to a canteen people flow intelligent scheduling and dish recommending system which comprises a people flow monitoring module, a dish database, a central processing unit and a user terminal, wherein the people flow monitoring module is used for collecting people flow data of each area of a canteen in real time, the dish database is used for storing dish components, tastes, nutrition data and historical sales, the central processing unit is used for dynamically analyzing the data and generating scheduling strategies, the user terminal is used for receiving recommended information and displaying navigation paths, the canteen people flow distribution is monitored in real time through a multi-mode sensing network, a dynamic queuing model and a collaborative filtering algorithm are combined, optimal allocation of window resources and personalized dish recommendation are realized, average waiting time is reduced, dining order in peak periods is ensured through a digital twin technology and an emergency response mechanism, the canteen operation efficiency and service quality are integrally improved, and meanwhile, user dining path selection is optimized through AR navigation, and the problem of local congestion is relieved.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUBO WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based three-dimensional visualized operation and maintenance management method and system for transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance management of transformer substations, in particular to a three-dimensional visual operation and maintenance management method and system of a transformer substation based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining equipment real-time working condition data, obtaining equipment distribution data and space electric field intensity distribution, inputting the equipment distribution data and historical operation data into a physical information neural network model to obtain health indexes and residual service life predicted values, when the real-time working condition data are abnormal or the health indexes are lower than a preset threshold value, carrying out message transmission and node updating in a substation graph neural network model, positioning a fault source, evaluating the probability of linkage faults, generating an operation and maintenance work order based on the fault source, the health indexes and the probability of linkage faults, and planning a safe operation and maintenance path by utilizing an A-star algorithm. The scheme of the invention can overcome the limitation of surface monitoring and experience judgment in the traditional operation and maintenance, improve the depth and breadth of fault diagnosis and enhance the safety of field operation.
assignees: XIAN TALI TECH CO LTD;YANAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel rock mass dynamic disaster monitoring system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based tunnel rock mass dynamic disaster monitoring system, which relates to the technical field of digital twinning-based tunnel rock mass dynamic disaster monitoring, and the invention realizes comprehensive and real-time monitoring of rock mass states by integrating a multi-mode sensing network, comprising a self-adaptive infrared structure light scanning, a distributed micro-seismic sensing array and a fiber bragg grating strain sensor; simultaneously introducing an intelligent analysis algorithm based on deep learning, automatically identifying abnormal conditions and generating a rock burst risk comprehensive index, and combining a physical entity with a virtual model through a dynamic digital twin modeling technology to realize visual analysis of rock mass state change; and finally, an edge-cloud cooperative communication technology is adopted to ensure low delay and reliability of data transmission, ensure that a monitoring system can respond quickly and timely carry out emergency measures.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI JIANZHU

title_en: Surface matrix map modification data processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geology, in particular to a surface matrix map modification data processing method which comprises the steps of data dynamic acquisition, intelligent pretreatment, three-dimensional modeling, multi-scale nested analysis, decision deduction and dynamic visualization; compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the periodic manual acquisition and static database updating scheme is adopted, the data updating period is long, sudden environmental change is difficult to capture, the scheme adopts the multi-source data real-time access and AI dynamic cleaning scheme, the method has the advantages of real-time updating capability and automatic abnormal value correction, the earth surface matrix model can dynamically respond to environmental change, the timeliness of disaster early warning and emergency decision is remarkably improved, the deep learning fusion multi-mode data and Bayesian uncertainty quantification scheme is adopted, the method has the advantages of high-resolution three-dimensional modeling and risk area visualization, and complex geological structures can be accurately depicted and clear priority guidance is provided for manual verification.
assignees: QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INSTITUTE QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL MINERAL RES INSTITUTE QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL REMO

title_en: Intelligent remote operation and maintenance method and system for photovoltaic power station based on relay protection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent remote operation and maintenance method and system of a photovoltaic power station based on relay protection, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode characteristic quantity of a relay protection device of a photovoltaic array area in real time through a distributed optical fiber sensing network so as to construct a dynamic protection characteristic matrix; the method comprises the steps of performing feature decoupling on a dynamic protection feature matrix by adopting a space-time convolution countermeasure encoder to generate a fault feature vector set, inputting the fault feature vector set into a physically constrained LSTM-GAN hybrid prediction model, predicting multi-dimensional failure probability tensors of key relay protection nodes in a preset time period in the future, generating an optimal operation and maintenance strategy decision tree based on the multi-dimensional failure probability tensors, analyzing the operation and maintenance strategy decision tree by a remote execution gateway driven by digital twin, and synchronously updating the topological connection relation of the digital twin of a power station. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the operation and maintenance efficiency and reliability of the photovoltaic power station protection can be improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YULONG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Underground water exploitation amount evaluation method and system based on coupling of physical mechanism and neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating underground water exploitation quantity based on coupling of a physical mechanism and a neural network, which relate to the technical field of water resource management, integrate meteorological data, surface water hydrologic monitoring data, geological survey data, underground water resource development and utilization data and hydrogeological parameter data, preprocess the data to obtain a basic data set, and construct a three-dimensional geological model of a heterogeneous structure by combining drilling geological data by utilizing a digital twin physical engine. According to the invention, the digital twin technology and the numerical model are introduced, so that the underground water flowing process can be simulated more accurately, the digital twin physical engine is utilized to construct the heterogeneous aquifer digital model, the dynamic interaction process of the surface water and the underground water is embedded, and the model is strengthened through the graph neural network and the physical information neural network, so that errors caused by the assumption of the aquifer homogeneity, neglecting of the surface water-underground water coupling process and the like in the traditional model are effectively reduced, and the accuracy of underground water exploitation amount evaluation is improved.
assignees: INST HYDROGEOLOGY & ENV GEOLOGY CAGS

title_en: Urban underground cable management network management method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a management method and a management system for an urban underground cable network based on digital twinning, which are characterized in that firstly basic attributes and real-time perception data of the urban underground cable network are integrated, a network digital twinning mapping model comprising physical entity digital reproduction and dynamic association relation among entities is constructed, a physical network real-time operation state data driving model is continuously input through a preset data interaction protocol to update, association coupling analysis is carried out based on the updated network digital twinning mapping model, key nodes and abnormal conduction links of an abnormal network are identified, the state diffusion process of the abnormal conduction links under different environments is simulated by the model, risk evolution simulation results are generated, a network maintenance instruction comprising a priority ordering and resource allocation scheme is generated according to the risk evolution simulation results and key node position information, and the network maintenance instruction is issued to an operation and maintenance execution system to trigger maintenance response, so that intelligent management is realized.
assignees: DAZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Hoisting construction safety monitoring and early warning system based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hoisting construction safety monitoring and early warning system based on BIM, which comprises a terminal perception layer, an edge calculation layer, a cloud coordination layer, a digital twin-generation pushing engine, a practical engineering model and a physical constraint generation countermeasure network, wherein the terminal perception layer is used for collecting environmental parameters and personnel behavior data in a closed space in real time, the edge calculation layer is used for cleaning, compressing and encrypting and transmitting original data by utilizing an explosion-proof edge calculation gateway, the cloud coordination layer is used for storing full data based on a BIM digital twin-generation platform, a 'dangerous mode-construction characteristic-disposal measure' three-dimensional element knowledge map is built by adopting a MAML++ algorithm, a physical mechanism data enhancement engine is coupled with a multi-physical field coupling model and physical constraint to generate countermeasure network, virtual data conforming to mass conservation and energy conservation is generated and is mixed with real data for training, and the intelligent decision layer is used for encoding space-time context by utilizing a depth reinforcement learning dynamic optimization alarm threshold, and the digital twin-generation pushing engine is used for calculating the shortest safety path in real time and optimizing rescue resource allocation.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: BMS integrated power management system and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of BMS integrated power management, in particular to a BMS integrated power management system and device, comprising an acquisition module, a data processing module, a battery protection module, a thermal management control module, a communication module, a data storage module and an emergency processing module; the method comprises the steps of analyzing and processing real-time data of a battery through a recurrent neural network, enabling a user to know the condition of the battery in real time, predicting the running condition of the battery in a future period of time through a digital twin model, and providing a reasonable user scheme for the user according to an analysis result; the emergency treatment module separates the vehicle from the battery, performs sealing and cooling treatment on the battery, ensures the safety of the vehicle and a user, improves the rescue of firefighters and the convenience of battery treatment, has a small overall structure, occupies less vehicle space, is positioned at the bottom of the frame of the vehicle, and ensures the cruising performance and stability of the vehicle.

title_en: Power distribution network running state estimation method, computer equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application relates to a power distribution network running state estimation method, computer equipment, medium and product. The method comprises the steps of constructing a third-order measurement state tensor of the power distribution network according to multi-source measurement data of the power distribution network in a historical time period, constructing a state estimation model of noise tensor completion of the power distribution network according to the multi-source measurement data, the third-order measurement state tensor and operation data of the power distribution network, converting the state estimation model of noise tensor completion to obtain a converted state estimation model, solving the converted state estimation model by using a direction alternation method to obtain an operation state estimation result of the power distribution network at the current moment, wherein the current moment is the ending moment of the historical time period. By adopting the method, the third-order measurement state tensor of the power distribution network can be constructed through the low-quality and limited-variety measurement data containing the measurement noise, and the state estimation is realized based on the third-order measurement state tensor, so that the observability of the power distribution network can be improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Multi-node real-time cooperative scheduling and emergency response system and scheduling method for supply chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dispatching and emergency response, in particular to a supply chain multi-node real-time collaborative dispatching and emergency response system and a dispatching method, wherein the system comprises a distributed data acquisition module, a control module and a dispatching module, wherein the distributed data acquisition module is used for acquiring inventory data, logistics states and equipment operation parameters of all nodes in real time; the system comprises a digital twin modeling engine, a collaborative decision center, an emergency response trigger, a multi-objective pareto optimization and a multi-objective pareto optimization, wherein the digital twin modeling engine is used for constructing a dynamic virtual mapping model of a supply chain network, the collaborative decision center is used for generating a multi-objective optimization scheduling scheme based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, the emergency response trigger is used for automatically starting a grading emergency plan through abnormal pattern recognition, second-level response is realized through millisecond-level data synchronization and edge calculation, so that decision timeliness is improved, multi-agent game and federal learning are adopted, cross-node collaborative efficiency is improved, and the time-consuming rate of orders and the toughness index of the network are improved on the premise of controllable cost through multi-objective pareto optimization.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUBO WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin power distribution network scheduling method and device based on cloud edge fusion, terminal equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dispatching method, a dispatching device, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium of a digital twin power distribution network based on cloud edge fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring edge equipment data in the digital twin power distribution network in real time; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction and iterative compression on edge equipment data to obtain target feature information, inputting the target feature information into a trained cloud computing sub-model to enable the model to predict fault point positions according to the target feature information, uploading the edge equipment data and the predicted fault point positions to a digital cloud to enable the digital cloud to count fault times in a preset time period, wherein the digital cloud receives the edge equipment data, the predicted fault point positions and the fault times in the preset time period, inputs the received data into a trained dispatching optimization sub-model to enable the model to determine a dispatching scheme of a power distribution network according to the edge equipment data, the predicted fault point positions and the fault times, and adjusting the digital twin power distribution network according to the dispatching scheme.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Management method for improving power generation capacity of photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent scheduling of photovoltaic power stations, in particular to a management method for improving the power generation capacity of a photovoltaic power station, which comprises the steps of analyzing power regulation policy texts, weather early warning data and power price historical fluctuation data to generate a three-dimensional dynamic constraint condition set; the method comprises the steps of generating a basic power generation output prediction sequence by using an LSTM time sequence model, superposing a three-dimensional constraint generation policy to adapt to schedulable capacity, screening adjacent reference power stations based on a digital twin model, correcting to obtain weather corrected schedulable capacity, starting in-station compensation when the power generation output of a target power station is insufficient, screening auxiliary power stations and generating an incremental power generation instruction set when the power generation output of the target power station is insufficient, storing evidence instructions and results by using a alliance chain, and realizing cross-power station collaborative training by using federal learning. The invention can effectively improve the power generation capacity of the photovoltaic power station and the dispatching efficiency of the power grid, and solves the problems of power generation loss and low cross-station cooperative efficiency caused by meteorological fluctuation.

title_en: Urban waterlogging rain and flood data assimilation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of urban flood control and drainage, and discloses an urban flood control and drainage data assimilation method, an urban flood control and drainage system and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining rainfall, flow and surface elevation data from multi-source hydrological observation data, obtaining a multi-source dataset after preprocessing, extracting hydrological parameters based on the dataset, determining the influence weight of the hydrological parameters on a submerged range by combining parameter sensitivity analysis, updating key hydrological parameters by a filtering algorithm to obtain a refined hydrological parameter set, combining topography gradient analysis and a prediction algorithm, establishing a prediction model of the submerged boundary change rate, dynamically adjusting inversion time intervals, correcting the surface elevation in real time by a finite element method, improving the submerged prediction precision, further optimizing the hydrological parameters according to real-time prediction results, and generating a drainage scheduling decision instruction. The method has higher accuracy and real-time performance, can provide scientific and effective decision support for the urban flood control and drainage system, and remarkably improves emergency response capability.
assignees: JIANGSU JUHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster real-time monitoring system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of real-time monitoring of geological disasters and discloses a real-time monitoring system of geological disasters, which comprises a sensor module, a data processing module, a multi-sensor data fusion module, a state estimation module and a communication module, wherein the sensor module is used for collecting geological deformation data, the data processing module is used for carrying out filtering processing and feature extraction on the collected geological deformation data, the multi-sensor data fusion module is used for fusing the geological deformation data collected by different sensors through a weighted least square method, the state estimation module is used for carrying out state estimation and dynamic update on the fused geological deformation data based on a recursion optimization algorithm, and the communication module is used for sending the geological deformation data after state estimation and dynamic update to a remote server in a wireless mode. According to the application, the real-time acquisition of the multidimensional deformation data of the geologic body is realized through the composite sensor module integrating the accelerometer, the inclination angle sensor and the strain sensor. The technical effect of stably outputting the monitoring signal under the conditions of multiple scenes and multiple media is achieved.
assignees: ZHONGJIAN GUOXIN BIG DATA GROUP CO LTD

title_en: DeepSeek-based power plant employee care service system and DeepSeek-based power plant employee care service method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power plant employee care service system and method based on DeepSeek, which are used for breaking through a traditional fragmentation management mode, realizing full-dimensional dynamic monitoring of employee physiology, psychology, behavior and life characteristics, effectively solving the problem of data islanding, realizing early recognition of psychological health risks, professional burnout and health hidden danger by means of a DeepSeek platform prediction model and a semantic analysis technology, converting passive response into active intervention, greatly improving service timeliness, generating a service scheme which is accurately matched with employee requirements through a reinforcement learning algorithm and a service resource intelligent matching mechanism, remarkably improving coverage and service pertinence of psychological health support, family care and professional development guidance, combining incremental learning and digital twin technology, continuously optimizing a prediction model and a service strategy, and tracking through a real-time effect and multi-channel feedback mechanism.
assignees: CHINA COAL HAMI POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-driven TBM tunnel construction surrounding rock collapse risk dynamic assessment method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geospatial information systems, and particularly discloses a dynamic evaluation method, equipment and storage medium for the collapse risk of TBM tunnel construction surrounding rock under digital twin driving, which comprises the steps of constructing a knowledge graph model layer of the collapse of TBM tunnel construction surrounding rock, wherein a primary concept comprises a disaster-bearing body, disaster factors and a disaster-tolerant environment; under the constraint of the mode layer, a knowledge graph data layer is built by utilizing advanced geological forecast data, TBM operation equipment parameter data and historical collapse event record data, a TBM tunnel construction surrounding rock collapse risk assessment model is built under the guidance of the knowledge graph and is continuously optimized, and finally, the trained risk assessment model is used for carrying out instant risk assessment. According to the invention, the knowledge graph is used for guiding the deep learning model, so that all surrounding rock collapse risk factors are comprehensively and deeply analyzed and evaluated, and the efficient, accurate and timely dynamic evaluation of the surrounding rock collapse risk in TBM tunnel construction is facilitated.
assignees: CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Intelligent slope health monitoring system and standardized information management equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent slope health monitoring system and standardized information management equipment, the device is applied to a system, and the system comprises a data processing module, a digital twin module, a network module and a prediction module. The network module adopts a multi-protocol transmission strategy to carry out data transmission among a plurality of modules so as to ensure the transmission efficiency and reliability of data in the system, the data processing module carries out real-time automatic acquisition and processing on the side slope data of the transmission line tower, so that the digital twin module carries out data mapping and fusion on the acquired and processed data to generate a side slope data twin model, the accuracy and timeliness of data monitoring can be ensured through a digital twin technology, and finally the prediction module carries out data visualization on the side slope data twin model, predicts the side slope deformation of the transmission line tower after the influence factors are extracted based on the side slope data twin model, and further realizes real-time and comprehensive automatic monitoring and early warning on the side slope health condition.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Method, system and medium for predicting health state of digital power-preserving distribution network equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system and a medium for predicting the health state of digital power-preserving distribution network equipment. The method comprises the steps of collecting characteristic information and operation characteristic data of target distribution network equipment, generating digital twin bodies of the distribution network equipment, virtually displaying the digital twin bodies, obtaining electric energy demand data of a target power supply system, virtually supplying power to the power supply system by combining the collected twin bodies, processing the operation data of the distribution network equipment to obtain first and second prediction data of the distribution network equipment and power supply performance indexes of the distribution network, comparing the first and second prediction data with corresponding thresholds to obtain first, second and third health state grades, and recording the first, second and third health state grades, so that a health prediction technology of the digital power-saving distribution network equipment in the virtual distribution network operation state is realized.
assignees: HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD WENCHANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Digital twin intelligent water saving system based on distributed optical fiber sensing network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin intelligent water saving system based on a distributed optical fiber sensing network, which belongs to the technical field of water saving management, and particularly comprises the distributed optical fiber sensing network, a water use event identification module, a water supply topology construction module, a hydraulic model generation module, an intelligent water saving control module and a centralized intelligent water saving management module, wherein the distributed optical fiber sensing network is paved along a water pipeline in a tree topology, the water use event identification module is used for acquiring optical fiber vibration signals, converting the optical fiber vibration signals into digital waveforms and identifying trigger points through amplitude threshold values, the water supply topology construction module is used for constructing a water supply dependent topological graph containing nodes and directed edges according to the space positions and time delays of the trigger points, the hydraulic model generation module is used for superposing the topological graph and the water pipeline digital map to generate a dynamic hydraulic balance model containing node water use intensity weight coefficients, and the intelligent water saving control module is used for sending periodic intermittent closing instructions to intelligent water valves of low weight nodes according to node weight changes, and instruction duration is in proportion to adjacent node weight differences.
assignees: FUJIAN ZHONGSHUI TIMES ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional remote control and scheduling system for intelligent charging pile at slot position
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote control and dispatch system of a multifunctional intelligent slot charging pile, in particular to the field of charging piles, which is used for solving the problems of low utilization rate of charging resources and large power grid load impact, is based on federal learning to collect and predict charging requirements of users and charging capacity of vehicles in real time, and provides an accurate basis for power distribution; the method comprises the steps of combining a prediction result with real-time load data of a power grid through a multi-objective optimization algorithm to generate a power distribution baseline value which gives consideration to user demands and peak clipping and valley filling of the power grid, effectively balancing charging resources and power grid stability, constructing a dynamic game model of the user and the power grid through a reinforcement learning algorithm, adjusting output power of a charging pile in real time, guiding user behaviors through an integral excitation strategy, dynamically coping with conflict between the demands and the loads, improving system adaptability, and finally carrying out full-link simulation verification on a charging pile group through a digital twin technology, comparing a continuous optimization scheduling strategy based on actual operation data, and ensuring continuous improvement of system performance.
assignees: CHENGDU HUAMAO NENGLIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin model construction method based on power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin model construction method based on a power system, which comprises the steps of collecting historical operation data of physical entities in the power system, screening normal operation data from the historical operation data to construct a minimum bounding ellipsoid of each physical entity, collecting the operation data of the physical entities in the power system in real time, respectively calculating the distance between the operation data of the physical entities and the center of the corresponding minimum bounding ellipsoid, deleting the operation data corresponding to the physical entities if the calculated distance is greater than 1, otherwise, reserving the operation data, carrying out missing value filling on the reserved operation data by using a tensor algorithm to obtain complete operation data of the physical entities in the power system, constructing the corresponding virtual entities in a virtual space by using the complete operation data of the physical entities in the power system, and driving the operation of the corresponding virtual entities to complete the construction of the digital twin model, thereby improving the precision of the digital twin model of the power system.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Natural gas hydrogen loading proportion dynamic control and safety evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural gas hydrogen loading proportion dynamic control and safety evaluation system and method, which belong to the technical field of clean energy transmission and distribution and safety control, and comprise the steps of collecting constraint data and real-time multi-mode sensing data, and performing fusion processing to generate a fusion initial data set; performing domain adaptation initialization and parameter optimization to generate an initial symbiotic decision framework, performing state synchronization and risk path exploration to generate a predictive state space, performing hierarchical reinforcement learning self-evolution training to generate an evolution control strategy group, calculating a reality gap residual as a feedback signal to generate a self-healing optimization model, performing multidimensional risk quantification and dynamic proportion regulation and control, and outputting a safety evaluation report. The self-evolution symbiotic architecture of multi-modal digital twin and layered reinforcement learning is adopted, so that the dynamic optimization of the hydrogen loading proportion and the real-time assessment of risks can be realized, and the control stability and the safety reliability of the natural gas pipe network under the complex working condition are obviously improved.

title_en: Comprehensive monitoring method and system for multi-dimensional data of offshore wind power
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive monitoring method and system for multi-dimensional data of offshore wind power, and the field of data monitoring comprises the steps of collecting and processing the multi-dimensional data of an offshore wind power plant and extracting data characteristics; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multidimensional data association network diagram of the wind power plant and optimizing the association network diagram, predicting the running state of the wind power plant and dynamically optimizing the prediction model parameters of the state, constructing a digital twin model of the offshore wind power plant for simulation, feeding back running information of the wind power plant in real time and optimizing the running strategy. The invention can reduce the burden of data transmission and processing, improve the efficiency of a data monitoring system, save the calculation cost, improve the real-time data processing performance, facilitate the overall monitoring and maintenance, ensure the comprehensive evaluation of the health state of the wind power equipment, flexibly cope with the change of the state of the wind power equipment according to the real-time monitored data, ensure the accuracy and the real-time performance of the health monitoring, and reduce the calculation time and the resource consumption.
assignees: HUANENG ZHEJIANG ENERGY DEV CO LTD CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH

title_en: Intelligent hoisting construction risk data processing system based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hoisting construction risk data intelligent processing system based on BIM, which comprises an Internet of things sensing layer, a BIM-IoT data fusion layer, a temporal-spatial feature extraction layer, a mixed reasoning decision layer, a digital twin execution layer and a construction process, wherein the sensing layer senses through deployment of a multi-mode sensor network, the BIM-IoT data fusion layer utilizes an IFC++ temporal-spatial expansion framework to directly embed sensor time sequence data into a BIM component attribute set and dynamically update the sensor time sequence data through a primary data pipeline, the temporal-spatial feature extraction layer adopts an ST-Encoder network framework, fuses and enhances BIM topological features and IoT time sequence features through double-flow feature extraction and cross-mode attention fusion mechanisms and combining prior information, the mixed reasoning decision layer fuses PINN-transducer coupling models and FEM-Neural joint mechanisms, and predicts stress through physical constraint enhancement and nonlinear constitutive modeling and alternate execution strategies, and the digital twin execution layer performs real-time rendering, historical playback, prediction simulation, component level information superposition and virtual security fence.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Statistical heat supply pipe network prediction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heat supply pipe network prediction method based on statistics, which comprises the steps of obtaining relevant data from a heat supply pipe network system, including meteorological data, user demand data, pipe network running state data and other factors possibly influencing heat supply load, setting a reference time period for each characteristic value with different acquisition time points, carrying out average value calculation on sampling data of all characteristics in the time period to obtain a representative value in the reference time period, eliminating data deviation caused by asynchronous acquisition time sequence, ensuring uniformity and consistency of each characteristic value in time dimension, checking and filling up missing values, namely filling up missing data points in original data by adopting an interpolation method, calculating and filling up specific values of the missing data based on the numerical variation trend or the characteristic value with higher correlation in the front and rear time periods, and storing the preprocessed data into a database for facilitating subsequent analysis and modeling.
assignees: QINGDAO ENERGY TECH CO LTD;UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Digital twinning-based flood control engineering virtual simulation and risk previewing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-based flood control project virtual simulation and risk prediction method, which comprises the steps of obtaining river basin multisource data collected by an air-space-earth integrated monitoring network, wherein the multisource data comprise satellite remote sensing images, unmanned plane LiDAR point clouds and ground sensor monitoring data, inputting the multisource data into a pre-built digital twin model, wherein the model comprises a space-time data fusion layer, a physical process modeling layer, a multiscale simulation deduction layer and a risk assessment decision layer which are sequentially connected, the space-time data fusion layer carries out space-time registration and feature fusion on the input multisource data to construct an all-element digital base plate, and realizing high-precision digital mapping of all elements of the river basin through an air-space-earth integrated monitoring network and space-time data fusion technology. Compared with the traditional single data source, the multi-source data fusion enables the space-time consistency of flood evolution simulation to be remarkably improved, and the prediction errors of key physical processes such as river channel flushing and the like are greatly reduced.
assignees: TIANJIN RENAI COLLEGE

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary control system of new energy power station based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary control system of a new energy power station based on digital twinning, which comprises a data acquisition layer, wherein the data acquisition layer acquires physical entity data of the new energy power station, the physical entity data comprises equipment operation data, environment data and power grid data, the equipment operation data is acquired through sensors deployed on equipment, the environment data is acquired through environment monitoring equipment, the power grid data is acquired through power grid side sensors, the data processing layer carries out preprocessing, feature extraction and data fusion on the acquired data, the preprocessing comprises denoising, missing value filling and outlier processing, the feature extraction comprises statistical features, frequency domain features and feature extraction based on a physical model, and the intelligent auxiliary control system has the advantages that real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance are realized through a digital twinning technology, fault response time is shortened, unplanned shutdown times are reduced, operation and maintenance cost is reduced, the application of a multi-source data fusion and deep learning model is realized, prediction errors are reduced, and scheduling margin power generation capacity is reduced.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Drainage basin hydrologic prediction method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a watershed hydrologic prediction method based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data, processing the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain a multi-source data set, constructing a multi-dimensional space feature set according to the multi-source data set, simulating a hydrologic cycle process by adopting a finite volume method based on the multi-dimensional space feature set, obtaining a hydrologic cycle simulation result, obtaining an error value of the hydrologic cycle simulation result and actual observation data, carrying out nonlinear relation mining on the multi-dimensional space feature set by a neural network algorithm based on the error value to obtain a data driving prediction result, fusing the hydrologic cycle simulation result and the data driving prediction result by adopting a weighted fusion algorithm to obtain a fusion prediction result, constructing a digital twinning model based on the digital twinning model according to the fusion prediction result, and predicting the hydrologic state in real time. The invention can provide more effective decision support for water resource management and flood control and disaster reduction.
assignees: UNIV LANZHOU JIAOTONG

title_en: Three-dimensional digital twin-based power grid construction control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional digital twin-based power grid construction control method, which relates to the technical field of power grid construction control and comprises the following steps of S1, a three-dimensional digital twin-model construction stage, a construction pre-modeling analysis, decision-execution and updating model construction process dynamic mapping stage, S2, a multi-source data acquisition module data real-time processing through an edge calculation node, S3, a construction control decision optimization stage, S4, a dynamic risk control stage and S5, a feedback stage, and a closed loop of 'three-dimensional digital twin-model construction-construction pre-modeling analysis-decision-execution-updating model' is formed. According to the three-dimensional digital twin-based power grid construction control method, the construction control process can be converted from extensive experience driving to data intelligent driving, and digital infrastructure support with high reliability and high adaptability is provided for novel power system construction.
assignees: State grid shanghai electric power design co ltd

title_en: Highway service area vehicle safety control method and system based on cloud control platform
abstract_en: A vehicle safety management and control system of an expressway service area based on a cloud control platform comprises a multi-mode sensing device, an edge computing node, a cloud management and control platform, an intelligent scheduling decision module, a digital twin early warning module and an execution terminal, wherein the multi-mode sensing device is used for collecting vehicle OBD data, driver biological characteristic data and environmental parameters in real time, the edge computing node is integrated with a lightweight AI reasoning engine and can be used for realizing vehicle type identification and preliminary risk scoring, the cloud management and control platform is provided with a dynamic risk assessment module which can integrate an improved D-S evidence theory and an LSTM neural network, the intelligent scheduling decision module is used for optimizing resource allocation based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, the digital twin early warning module is used for constructing a three-dimensional scene and mapping a physical space in real time, and the execution terminal comprises an LED induction screen, an automatic gate and emergency response equipment. The comprehensive, dynamic and intelligent level of safety control of the two-passenger one-danger vehicles in the expressway service area is obviously improved through full element risk identification, dynamic safety decision, intelligent resource scheduling, scene early warning and closed loop emergency response.
assignees: GUANGZHOU RAPID TRAFFIC CONSTR CO LTD

title_en: BIM-based pumping and storing station building foundation dangerous point management and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM-based system for managing and controlling basic dangerous points of a pumping and storing power station building, which comprises a data layer, an application layer, a model layer, a data layer and a disaster development path simulation layer, wherein the data layer organizes linear engineering monitoring data into a high-order tensor of 'pile number x time x sensor type x space position' by utilizing four-dimensional tensor modeling, dynamically identifies a strain rate mutation point in a compression process by combining sliding window anomaly detection and directly stores original data by utilizing a Tucker decomposition, and then implements a layered storage strategy on non-mutated data by utilizing a data value evaluation model driven by deep reinforcement learning, the model layer is used for fusing a physical information neural network, embedding a geotechnical constitutive equation into an LSTM network to construct a mixed loss function, combining project data to carry out small sample fine adjustment after pre-training a universal geological model by migration learning, and dynamically generating a dangerous source list and triggering instant early warning by utilizing a BIM model based on the output of the data layer, and simulating a disaster development path by combining a digital twin technology.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Intelligent grid-connected scheduling system and method for photovoltaic communication power supply cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent grid-connected dispatching system and method of a photovoltaic communication power cabinet, and relates to the technical field of intelligent dispatching of photovoltaic power generation, wherein the intelligent grid-connected dispatching system comprises the steps of acquiring operation data of the photovoltaic communication power cabinet in real time through a sensor, and preprocessing the acquired operation data to obtain multi-source data; the method comprises the steps of extracting multi-source data characteristics through time sequence analysis, establishing a digital twin model of a photovoltaic communication power cabinet, establishing a multi-target optimization model, calculating a Pareto optimal solution set by adopting an NSGA-II algorithm based on an optimization target, screening an optimal scheduling strategy, generating a control instruction based on the optimal scheduling strategy, and sending the control instruction to photovoltaic power generation equipment through a control management mechanism for real-time regulation. According to the invention, the characteristics are extracted through a time sequence analysis method, a prediction model based on STL decomposition and LSTM algorithm is constructed, so that the accurate prediction of photovoltaic power generation capacity and load demand is realized, and the accuracy of short-term prediction is remarkably improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POST & TELECOM EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Mine disaster risk assessment method based on Bayesian network and three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster risk assessment method based on a Bayesian network and a three-dimensional model, which comprises the steps of collecting first data of a preset position of a mine, including gas data, temperature data, rock stratum stress data, smoke concentration data and acoustic signal data, screening target data from the first data after preprocessing through historical disaster causing factors of the mine, constructing a Bayesian network through dependency relationship between the target data and different target data, three-dimensionally scanning in the mine to obtain point cloud data, constructing a digital twin three-dimensional model of the mine based on the point cloud data after preprocessing, acquiring second data of other positions based on the first data after preprocessing, integrating the first data and the second data according to different moments to obtain multidimensional data at different moments, inputting the multidimensional data into the Bayesian network to obtain a three-dimensional risk distribution map and a probability value, and carrying out space mapping and calculation on the three-dimensional risk distribution map and the probability value and the digital twin three-dimensional model to obtain a mine disaster risk value.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent water management method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent water management method and system based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field of intelligent water management, and the intelligent water management method comprises the steps of initializing a pipe network digital twin model, loading prestored pipe network GIS data, collecting pipeline pressure data, water quality parameters and user water consumption in real time, inputting a risk assessment model to calculate real-time risk probability, and generating a high-risk early warning signal when the real-time risk probability exceeds an early warning threshold value; based on the high-risk early warning signal, the differential order parameter and the integral gain parameter are calculated through the pipe state fractional order controller, a voltage stabilizing control instruction is generated and executed, meanwhile, a control error signal in the voltage stabilizing process is extracted, the control error signal and the water source type label are input into the meta reinforcement learning model, the differential order parameter and the integral gain parameter are dynamically optimized, and the water source risk coefficient is obtained.
assignees: HUNAN YUNZHIHUI WATER CONSERVANCY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon prediction and power grid maintenance system based on digital twin and AI cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid management, in particular to a typhoon prediction and power grid maintenance system based on digital twin and AI cooperation. According to the invention, continuous evolution judgment of typhoon influence areas can be realized through dynamic environment parameter extraction and path deviation trend analysis, the problem of insufficient change capture by static prediction is broken through, fine depiction and dynamic identification of vulnerable parts are realized, potential fault chains are identified and structured through node connection relation induction and load intensity partitioning, a risk link is represented by structuring, dynamic comparison analysis of resource allocation and risk priority is maintained, allocation logic can be calibrated, task sequence and risk level are ensured to be consistent, priority allocation trend tracking can screen continuous incremental links, efficient distribution execution of multi-stage rush-repair tasks is promoted, and response efficiency and scheduling accuracy are improved.
assignees: ANHUI ZHONGYE HUANYI INTELLIGENT ENG CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin airport oil depot based emergency drilling evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of digital twin technology and emergency management systems, and particularly relates to an emergency drilling evaluation system and method based on a digital twin airport oil depot. According to the multi-dimensional evaluation index system constructed by the comprehensive analysis and evaluation module based on the digital twin airport oil depot emergency exercise evaluation system and the method, the exercise effect is quantitatively evaluated from multiple aspects such as emergency response speed, resource utilization efficiency, loss control degree and the like by combining an analytic hierarchy process and a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, various problems in the exercise process can be deeply analyzed, the generated evaluation report not only contains detailed problem analysis, but also provides a targeted improvement suggestion, and meanwhile, historical data and industry standards can be compared, so that evaluation is more scientific and accurate, and powerful support is provided for emergency management decisions.
assignees: NANJING AIRPORT OIL CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent water flow monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water flow intelligent monitoring system and a method, which relate to the technical field of water flow intelligent monitoring, combine an actuator health degree evaluation and multi-objective prediction control method, and finely characterize a valve and a water pump by arranging a sensor and constructing a digital twin model; the method comprises the steps of carrying out model predictive control or multi-agent reinforcement learning, dynamically generating a reliable and efficient control instruction, further, accurately coping with delay, faults or communication anomalies of an actuator through real-time closed loop deviation detection and self-adaptive correction, quickly completing self-healing and fault-tolerant control by utilizing fault prediction and standby scheduling strategies to prevent failure diffusion, and taking scenes such as flood, fire protection, reclaimed water and the like into the same frame to realize comprehensive water resource management of multi-scene coupling, thereby effectively reducing the risk of water hammer impact and water leakage and obviously improving the safety of a water supply system under complex working conditions or equipment aging.
assignees: JIAXING JIAYUAN DETECTION TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid monitoring data visual interaction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, and discloses a digital twin-based power grid monitoring data visual interaction method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of monitoring the running state of a target power grid in real time and collecting the running data of the target power grid; the method comprises the steps of mapping operation data to a digital twin power grid model of a target power grid to conduct abnormality diagnosis, obtaining a power grid diagnosis result of the target power grid, judging occurrence states of each intermediate event and each bottom event based on the power grid diagnosis result through a fault tree model of the target power grid and a fault tree logic relationship, obtaining an abnormality diagnosis result, displaying abnormal equipment and fault areas in different colors, icons and flickering effects in a display interface of the digital twin power grid model based on the abnormality diagnosis result, and checking detailed information of the abnormal equipment and the fault areas through clicking operation. The method and the device realize quick and accurate positioning of the abnormal source and improve the running stability of the power grid.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent robot-based intelligent power plant joint inspection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power plant combined inspection system and method based on an intelligent robot, and relates to the technical field of circuit inspection, wherein the intelligent power plant combined inspection system and method is used for acquiring path information in an intelligent power plant area in real time, constructing an inspection network based on the acquired path information, setting a coordinate system and a reference point based on the constructed inspection network, and accurately positioning the intelligent robot in the running process in real time based on the set coordinate system and the reference point; after the positioning is finished, a real-time prediction digital twin model is established through a data simulation algorithm process based on the accurate positioning of the intelligent robot, a coordinate system and a reference point, meanwhile, a path planning algorithm is used for carrying out path planning on the constructed routing inspection network, a path planning result is input into the real-time prediction digital twin model, finally, the intelligent robot is controlled based on the established real-time prediction digital twin model, the path planning result and the accurate positioning of the current intelligent robot, and the routing inspection efficiency of a power plant is improved.

title_en: Energy Internet digital twin simulation system and method
abstract_en: The application provides an energy Internet digital twin simulation system which comprises a data transmission module, an instruction control module, a data simulation module and a display module, wherein the data transmission module acquires real-time data of an energy network, a plurality of data interfaces are correspondingly arranged according to energy types in the energy network, the instruction control module acquires data from the data interfaces and controls a data cache list according to time sequence, the data simulation module reads cache data in the data cache list and inputs the cache data into a preset simulation engine to output model parameters, and the display module receives the model parameters, generates and updates an energy Internet model in real time according to the model parameters and displays the model parameters in a display. By setting interfaces of different types of energy systems, performing time sequence control according to energy types, performing imitation modeling on data, unifying multi-type data is realized, and a global model can be constructed.
assignees: GUIGANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GRID COMPANY OF GUANGXI

title_en: Low-voltage topology tracking method for low-voltage distribution network state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage topology tracking method for low-voltage distribution network state estimation, which utilizes the acquired standing account information of a target area collection distribution information system, three-phase voltage and power measurement information of a secondary side public check ammeter of a distribution transformer, single-phase ammeter user voltage and power measurement information, three-phase ammeter user three-phase voltage and power measurement information respectively construct a multi-objective 0-1 variable optimization problem for minimizing power balance and maximizing voltage correlation, the multi-objective 0-1 variable optimization problem is integrated into a single-objective optimization problem by adopting a linear weighting method, the phase of each ammeter user is identified by adopting a branch and bound technology, the information of the area file is corrected based on the household-phase-change identification result, and accurate and complete low-voltage topology information is provided for subsequent state estimation and distribution network refined management.
assignees: SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SHUANGCHUANG CENTER

title_en: Photovoltaic power station remote monitoring method and system based on three-dimensional digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a photovoltaic power station remote monitoring method and system based on a three-dimensional digital twin technology, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional twin photovoltaic power station; the method comprises the steps of utilizing three-dimensional twin photovoltaic power station synchronous entity photovoltaic power station data, monitoring real-time operation parameters aiming at twin equipment, comparing the real-time monitoring operation parameters with corresponding preset twin equipment parameter thresholds, determining whether to trigger an initial alarm or not according to comparison results, combining a twin equipment fault propagation chain rule, determining that a fault source corresponds to the twin equipment, generating a fault alarm corresponding to the twin equipment or generating an independent twin equipment fault alarm, predicting independent twin equipment with fault risks or twin equipment belonging to the fault source aiming at the twin equipment operation parameters obtained by monitoring, automatically generating an inspection task, and obtaining an inspection path by utilizing an optimal path planning algorithm. The method and the device can improve the visual effect of remote monitoring of the photovoltaic power station and the positioning precision of fault equipment.

title_en: Full life cycle bridge carbon emission accounting method and system under multi-disaster coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full life cycle bridge carbon emission accounting method and system under multi-disaster coupling, and belongs to the field of carbon emission accounting, wherein the method comprises the steps of arranging a plurality of sensor clusters on a bridge, monitoring different mechanical responses of the bridge in real time, preprocessing acquired data through an edge gateway, and sending the preprocessed data to a cloud; the cloud end screens the data, builds a sensor database, correlates the data in the database with a digital twin model of the bridge, analyzes and processes the data in the database through a carbon emission dynamic calculation frame deployed by the cloud end to obtain the total carbon emission, and draws a carbon emission thermodynamic diagram of the bridge according to the total carbon emission. The method comprehensively considers various factors such as damage evolution, corrosion process, repair activity, carbon emission diffusion and the like, and can accurately reflect the carbon footprint change of the bridge in the whole life cycle in a complex environment.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY ENG CONSULT SUPERVISION COMPANY LTD

title_en: Railway tunnel portal geological disaster deformation early warning system based on SAR radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses a railway tunnel portal geological disaster deformation early warning system based on SAR radar, which comprises a digital twin body construction module, a digital twin body detection module and a data acquisition module, wherein the digital twin body construction module is used for constructing a digital twin body with initial parameters based on basic data; the system comprises a SAR deformation monitoring module, a digital twin body dynamic optimization module, a risk prediction and key region identification module and an intelligent early warning module, wherein the SAR deformation monitoring module is used for acquiring SAR deformation observation data, the digital twin body dynamic optimization module is used for inverting and updating parameters of the SAR data by an optimization algorithm to generate an optimized twin body, the risk prediction and key region identification module is used for predicting risks and identifying key risk regions based on the optimized twin body to deduce disaster-causing scenes, and the intelligent early warning module is used for generating early warning information based on the predicted risks and the key risk regions. According to the invention, the SAR data is adopted to dynamically optimize the geomechanical digital twin body, so that the accurate prediction, the key region identification and the intelligent grading early warning of the geological disaster at the railway tunnel portal are realized, and the initiative and the accuracy of risk cognition and early warning are remarkably improved.
assignees: SICHUAN JIUZHOU BEIDOU APPLICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid operation optimization method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based power grid operation optimization method, device, equipment and medium, and belongs to the technical field of power grids. The method comprises the steps of collecting power grid operation data, inputting the power grid operation data into a pre-built power grid digital twin body, carrying out power grid multi-state coupling analysis through a dynamic behavior simulation process to generate a twin data set of the power grid, comparing the data in the twin data set with corresponding preset safety thresholds, adjusting a power grid operation strategy according to comparison results, and sending control instructions to corresponding physical equipment. The invention realizes accurate simulation and prediction of the operation of the power grid by constructing the digital twin body with the height consistent with the actual power grid. The digital twin body not only can reflect the current state of the power grid, but also can predict the running condition of the power grid under different conditions in the future through the dynamic behavior simulation engine, thereby providing powerful support for the optimized running of the power grid.
assignees: ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic fine adjustment method, system, equipment and storage medium for power dispatching operation ticket auditing model based on gradient reinforcement strategy optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic fine tuning method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for an auditing model of a power dispatching operation ticket based on gradient reinforcement strategy optimization, wherein the method comprises the following steps of converting a power dispatching rule base into a differentiable loss function and integrating the differentiable loss function into a GRPO training frame; extracting text semantics and power grid topological graph characteristics, pre-training based on a Monte Carlo search tree MCTS by utilizing an improved GRPO training frame to generate a countermeasure sample model conforming to the physical constraint of a power grid, and introducing real-time updating rules on line into the countermeasure sample model.
assignees: INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Digital twin and peak shaving-based thermal power plant pressure-bearing heat storage tank optimal configuration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal configuration method of a pressure-bearing heat storage tank of a thermal power plant based on digital twin and peak regulation, which comprises the steps of carrying out system structural modification on the thermal power plant which originally comprises a thermoelectric unit and a peak regulation electrode boiler, configuring a plurality of pressure-bearing heat storage tanks, a heat accumulation booster pump, a heat release booster pump and peak heaters to form a thermal decoupling system of the pressure-bearing heat storage tank of the thermal power plant, setting a heat accumulation and release operation mechanism and a deep peak regulation and peak regulation mechanism of the thermal decoupling system of the pressure-bearing heat storage tank of the thermal power plant, analyzing the operation characteristics of the thermoelectric unit under different thermal and electrical loads in the full load range, quantitatively analyzing the influence of different pressure-bearing heat storage tank configuration schemes, different heat accumulation and release periods and different heat accumulation and release amounts on the thermal and electrical load curves of the thermoelectric unit, and establishing an optimal configuration model of the pressure-bearing heat storage tank with the aim of minimizing total economic cost, maximizing energy utilization and maximizing operation of the thermoelectric unit, and outputting the optimal configuration scheme of the pressure-bearing heat storage tank.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power station asset access monitoring management system based on alarm information
abstract_en: The invention provides a power station asset access monitoring management system based on alarm information, which comprises an intelligent sensing network module, a dynamic alarm management module, a digital twin auxiliary module, an expert knowledge base module, a mobile operation and maintenance module and a mobile operation and maintenance module, wherein the intelligent sensing network module is used for acquiring operation state data of power station equipment and preprocessing the operation state data to obtain target state data, the dynamic alarm management module is used for receiving the target state data and generating classified alarm information through multi-dimensional threshold comparison and relevance analysis, the digital twin auxiliary module is used for receiving the classified alarm information and the target state data to construct a three-dimensional virtual scene, performing fault simulation and influence range deduction in the three-dimensional virtual scene and outputting a visual alarm analysis report, the expert knowledge base module is used for receiving the alarm analysis report, generating a treatment suggestion through case matching and performing feedback learning on a treatment effect corresponding to the treatment suggestion, and the mobile operation and maintenance module is used for receiving the treatment suggestion and the visual alarm analysis report to realize the intellectualization and high efficiency of operation and maintenance management of the power station equipment.
assignees: DELINGHA HUANENG TUORI NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering operation and maintenance management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based hydraulic engineering operation and maintenance management system, which relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering operation and maintenance management and comprises an operation and maintenance management center, wherein the operation and maintenance management center is in communication connection with a sensor network module, the sensor network module is used for deploying multiple types of sensors on key equipment and links of hydraulic engineering to form an intelligent sensor network and acquiring equipment operation data and energy consumption data of hydraulic engineering equipment and links. According to the invention, the sensor network is used for collecting the operation data and the energy consumption data of hydraulic engineering equipment and links, the virtual model is combined for energy consumption simulation, and the energy consumption distribution and fluctuation conditions of the hydraulic engineering under different operation conditions are intuitively displayed, so that management staff can accurately grasp the energy consumption conditions of all the equipment and links, find abnormal points of the energy consumption in time, provide a powerful basis for formulating targeted energy-saving measures, effectively avoid energy waste and improve the energy utilization efficiency.
assignees: JIANGSU WATER CONSERVANCY SCI RES INST

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous data fusion pipe network intelligent scheduling decision system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipe network intelligent scheduling decision system for multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, which comprises a multi-mode data acquisition cabin module, a space-time alignment fusion central module, a digital twin deduction cabin module, a self-adaptive decision matrix module, an elastic execution feedback chain module and a credibility tracing platform module, wherein the multi-mode data acquisition cabin module comprises a heterogeneous protocol analysis unit, an unstructured processing engine and an edge pretreatment mechanism, and the space-time alignment fusion central module comprises a space-time reference mapping engine, a federal learning cleaning tower and a dynamic semantic association library. The method solves the problem that the traditional system data cannot be integrated effectively, realizes the fusion of multi-source heterogeneous data, breaks the data island, improves the response speed, enhances the dynamic response capability, improves the decision efficiency and accuracy, enhances the intelligence of the decision, can realize the optimal configuration of the pipe network energy efficiency, and greatly optimizes the energy efficiency of the pipe network.
assignees: HARBIN KAINA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin water plant cluster comprehensive visual management system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data management, and discloses a digital twin water plant cluster comprehensive visual management system. The system comprises a processing module, a modeling module, a construction module, a process flow topology self-adaptive visual management interface, an extraction module, a calculation module, a coding module, a prediction maintenance scheme and a control module, wherein the processing module is used for carrying out standardized processing on multisource parameter data of a water plant to generate a real-time data stream, the modeling module is used for constructing a three-dimensional digital twin model by using an oblique photography technology, the construction module is used for creating a process flow topology self-adaptive visual management interface, the extraction module is used for extracting space-time characteristics through multi-channel data fusion to obtain early warning information, the calculation module is used for diagnosing abnormality based on a ternary association network and an isomerism graph meaning algorithm, and the coding module is used for generating a digital watermark health state code to form the prediction maintenance scheme, so that panoramic display of the running state of the water plant, accurate identification of an abnormality mode and optimal configuration of maintenance resources are realized. The application realizes panoramic display of the running state of the water plant, precise identification of abnormal modes and optimal configuration of maintenance resources, thereby improving the overall running efficiency and management level of the water plant cluster.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU LITONG WATER CO LTD

title_en: Safety early warning method for under-construction penetrating existing important building based on digital twinning
