abstract_en: The invention provides a safety early warning method for a construction underpass existing important building based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of collecting historical engineering case data, constructing an engineering case database, predicting the environmental data and the construction parameters in the engineering case database through a risk prediction model to obtain a prediction result, determining the relation between risk grades according to the environmental data and the construction parameters in the engineering case database, constructing a risk evaluation system based on a neural network, inputting the prediction result into the risk evaluation system for safety early warning, and issuing early warning information if conditions corresponding to the risk grades are triggered. The method improves the accuracy of prediction and risk grade evaluation.
assignees: GUANGXI LIUWU RAILWAY CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY ENG CONSULTATION GROUP CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: New energy power generation equipment health management platform based on large model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to a new energy power generation equipment health management platform based on a large model, which comprises a data acquisition and perception layer, an edge calculation layer, a cloud processing layer and an application service layer; compared with the prior art, the method adopts static historical data or single equipment parameters as health detection references, has the defect that the influence of the dynamic change of the environment and the ageing of the equipment cannot be reflected, adopts a multi-dimensional simulation modeling technology, integrates equipment parameters, weather parameters and other real-time working condition data to construct a digital twin model, and generates dynamic health reference values comprising the generated energy, instantaneous current/voltage, equipment temperature and the like by simulating the running states of the equipment (such as the attenuation of photovoltaic efficiency at extreme temperature and the aerodynamic load of a fan in salt fog environment) under different scenes. The method can accurately capture the interaction effect of the environment and the equipment, so that the health detection threshold is dynamically adjusted along with the working condition, and the abnormality identification accuracy is improved by more than 35% compared with the traditional method.
assignees: SOUTHWEST ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP;CHENGDU BEST DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Combined cooperative scheduling method for heat storage tank and long-distance transmission heat supply pipe network of power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a joint collaborative scheduling method of a heat storage tank and a long-distance heat supply pipe network of a power plant, which comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a heat supply system of a long-distance heat supply source side thermal power plant joint long-distance heat supply pipe network of a heat storage tank and a thermoelectric unit, establishing an external heat supply and auxiliary service peak regulation mechanism of an electric power market of the long-distance heat supply source side thermal power plant, establishing an upper-layer source side thermal power plant optimization operation model aiming at the maximum comprehensive benefit of the thermal power plant to obtain a collaborative optimization operation strategy of the heat storage tank, the thermoelectric unit, establishing a multi-stage pump station variable frequency regulation mechanism of the long-distance heat supply pipe network linked with peak-valley electricity prices, establishing a long-distance heat supply pipe network electricity-consumption heat supply ratio prediction model, establishing a lower-layer long-distance heat supply optimization operation model aiming at the minimum electricity consumption heat supply ratio of the long-distance heat supply pipe network under the requirement of pipe network flow, and obtaining the collaborative optimal operation strategy of the source side thermal power plant and the long-distance heat supply multi-stage pump station through iterative interaction of an upper-layer model and a lower-layer model.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant control method and device for resource optimization
abstract_en: The application discloses a virtual power plant control method and device for resource optimization, and relates to the technical field of virtual power plant control. The method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional monitoring data of a virtual power plant, inputting a virtual power plant state prediction model, performing state prediction to obtain a virtual power plant state prediction result, inputting the virtual power plant state prediction result into a virtual power plant resource allocation optimization model, performing resource allocation scheme generation to obtain a virtual power plant resource allocation scheme, inputting the virtual power plant resource allocation scheme into a virtual power plant digital twin model, performing digital twin simulation verification to obtain a corrected virtual power plant resource allocation scheme, inputting the corrected virtual power plant resource allocation scheme into a virtual power plant cooperative control model, performing control instruction generation to obtain a virtual power plant control instruction, and transmitting the virtual power plant control instruction to an execution terminal. The method solves the problems of single data dimension, insufficient prediction precision, rough resource allocation, lack of closed loop verification and complex cooperative control in the prior art.

title_en: Power transmission line wind and ice risk early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for early warning wind ice risk of a transmission line based on digital twinning, which comprise the steps of establishing a three-dimensional digital model of the transmission line, constructing a digital twinning model, transmitting electric weather forecast information (wind speed, temperature and icing) of the transmission line to be early warned to the digital twinning model, outputting states of corresponding electricity and structure of the transmission line to be early warned, realizing digital quick evaluation, comparing the electric and structural states of the transmission line to be early warned output by an evaluation module with the designed electric gap of the transmission line, the design of a ground lead allows stress and the design of an iron tower rod member to be stressed, outputting a safety grade, and carrying out risk early warning.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Deep underground engineering construction optimization method and system based on intelligent support system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of construction optimization, in particular to a deep underground engineering construction optimization method and system based on an intelligent support system. The technical scheme includes that stress field, seepage field and deformation field data of surrounding rock are collected in real time, a digital twin model is built, model parameters are dynamically updated, support parameters are optimized by means of a multi-objective genetic algorithm, and self-adaptive control is executed. According to the invention, the stress field, seepage field and deformation field data of the surrounding rock are acquired in real time through the multi-physical field sensing network, so that the state change of the surrounding rock can be timely and accurately monitored, meanwhile, the model parameters are dynamically updated to enable the model to more accurately reflect the actual condition of the surrounding rock, and the supporting parameters can be adjusted in real time according to the actual condition of the surrounding rock through the injection control and the anchor rod compensation in the self-adaptive control, so that the reliability of the supporting structure is improved, the stability of the surrounding rock is enhanced, the safety risk in the construction process is reduced, and the construction safety is improved.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING SCI & TECH

title_en: Comprehensive elasticity assessment method for power distribution network
abstract_en: A comprehensive elasticity assessment method for a power distribution network relates to the technical field of power systems and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-source space-time cube model of the power distribution network, dividing a geographical area into hexagonal grid units, S2, establishing a multi-energy dynamic game model, distributing energy weights based on improved Shapley values, achieving multi-main-body collaborative optimization through a weight attenuation mechanism driven by output deviation, S3, deploying an edge-cloud collaborative digital twin system, compressing a device model by adopting a model pruning technology, S4, calculating a space heterogeneity base coefficient, a time persistence toughness index and energy substitution green elasticity equivalent, S5, outputting a dynamic decision support scheme based on a B/S framework visualization platform, and combining disaster event space-time evolution characteristics with multi-energy main-body contribution dynamic matching to solve the problems of elastic assessment static weight distribution defects and multi-energy collaborative scheduling response hysteresis in the prior art.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Hydropower plant edge calculation method and system with intelligent diagnosis function
abstract_en: A hydropower plant edge calculation method and system with an intelligent diagnosis function comprise the steps of estimating potential fault risks through a real-time state estimation module by combining with a degradation damping model output, adopting a Bayesian network algorithm to infer potential fault risks, obtaining fault probability distribution, triggering a maintenance strategy optimization module to generate an adjusted maintenance plan according to the fault probability distribution if the potential fault risks are higher than a preset risk threshold value, carrying out iterative optimization on the maintenance plan through the maintenance strategy optimization module by adopting a genetic algorithm, determining an optimal maintenance time point by combining with equipment service life constraint, obtaining the optimal maintenance time point, combining with a real-time state estimation result, updating degradation damping model parameters, obtaining a prediction model adapting to the current equipment state, and predicting equipment degradation trend and damping change rules again through the updated degradation damping model, so as to obtain new health state estimation data. The method realizes accurate monitoring of the state of the equipment in the hydropower plant, reliable prediction of the degradation trend and remarkable reduction of maintenance cost.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Remote sensing image three-dimensional reconstruction method based on nerve rendering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image three-dimensional reconstruction method based on nerve rendering, which uses an irradiance model to independently model sunlight and sky diffuse reflection light, uses sun correction rays to accurately learn a solar visibility function, and finally adds an attention mechanism to optimize a network architecture so that the network can dynamically allocate corresponding weights according to the importance of features. The method solves the problem of complex sampling and calculation by improving the sampling method, adopts an irradiance model, can capture the dynamic characteristics of transient objects and shadow areas more accurately, adds an attention mechanism into a network, fully utilizes key characteristic information in remote sensing images, improves reconstruction precision and optimizes detail expression. The invention can be applied to urban planning, digital twinning, ecological environment monitoring, disaster emergency response, cultural relic protection and other scenes, and provides more lifelike visual experience and more accurate shadow effect for users.
assignees: HUNAN XIGU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned conveying system for deep sea mineral lifting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep sea mineral lifting unmanned transportation system. The system constructs an unmanned carrier-intelligent execution-elastic scheduling framework, and comprises four modules, namely unmanned carrying equipment, a communication network system, a scheduling control center and a support and guarantee system. The unmanned carrying equipment realizes mineral transportation based on buoyancy driving, the communication network adopts a layered redundancy architecture of underwater sound OFDM and laser emergency links, high-reliability communication and centimeter-level positioning are guaranteed, the dispatching control center improves the working efficiency through intelligent task allocation and track planning, and a support and guarantee system integrates energy management, digital twin monitoring and emergency response mechanisms. The operation flow adopts an unmanned autonomous mode and a remote monitoring mode, and covers links such as ballast submergence, acousto-optic docking, buoyancy regulation and control, dynamic unloading of a mother ship and the like. The invention obviously improves the efficiency, the maneuverability and the reliability of deep sea minerals and provides a core technical support for deep sea resource development.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Method and system for observing earthquake response of existing building
abstract_en: The invention relates to an existing building earthquake response observation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting building vibration response data under micro vibration and strong vibration and high-definition video data under the strong vibration of a building in real time, carrying out second-level early warning and minute-level early warning based on the building vibration response data, calculating displacement of an observation floor relative to the ground based on the high-definition video data, constructing an adjacent matrix based on the building vibration response data, updating the adjacent matrix by utilizing real-time data and a graph convolution neural network when the minute-level early warning occurs, carrying out hour-level early warning based on edge characteristics of the updated adjacent matrix, and simultaneously updating a digital twin model of the existing building based on a finite element model based on the calculated displacement, and evaluating the earthquake resistance and the security of the structure after the earthquake. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of remarkably improving the state identification precision of the building strong earthquake response stage, the earthquake resistance evaluation efficiency after earthquake and the like.

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network fault analysis and maintenance system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power distribution network fault analysis and maintenance system based on the Internet of things, which belongs to the technical field of power distribution network fault analysis and maintenance, and comprises a multi-source data acquisition preprocessing module, a dynamic digital twin modeling module, an edge cloud fusion analysis module, an instantaneous fault topology positioning module, a self-healing control module and an intelligent maintenance scheduling module, wherein the invention extracts fault characteristics through edge side AI reasoning, combines cloud big data analysis to realize global anomaly detection, the dynamic balance coefficient is adapted to abnormal modes under different working conditions, the edge side real-time reasoning is used for quickly generating fault type labels through weighting and fusing feature vectors, the global abnormal scoring mechanism is used for greatly improving the fault classification accuracy, meanwhile, the node state is updated through injecting a dynamic digital twin model, the probability density function is combined with the topology weight, the fault influence function and the spatial attenuation coefficient, the distribution characteristics of faults in the spatial coordinates are quantized, and the fault high-incidence area is accurately identified.
assignees: HAIDONG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Vehicle to vehicle wireless charge method and system for green internet of vehicle network
title_ko: 그린 차량 인터넷 네트워크를 위한 v2v 무선 충천 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vehicle to vehicle (V2V) wireless charging method for a green internet of vehicle (IoV) network that: enables a digital twin of vehicle (DTV) of a vehicle to monitor a charging power state of the vehicle, and transmits a charging request message for purchasing insufficient power to the DTV of at least one adjacent vehicle when the monitored charging power state is less than a threshold value; enables the DTV of the at least one adjacent vehicle to verify by receiving the charging request message, and transmits a reply message corresponding to the charging request message to the DTV of the vehicle; enables the DTV of the vehicle to determine a supply vehicle to supply power among the at least one adjacent vehicle based on the response message, and sets a smart contract with the determined DTV of the supply vehicle; and enables the DTV of the vehicle to execute the set smart contract when the DTV of the supply vehicle and wireless charging start.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 그린 IoV(Internet of Vehicle) 네트워크를 위한 V2V(Vehicle to Vehicle) 무선 충천 방법에 대한 것으로, 차량의 DTV(Digital Twin of Vehicle)가 상기 차량의 충전 전력 상태를 모니터링하고, 상기 모니터링된 충전 전력 상태가 임계값 미만으로 부족할 경우 적어도 하나의 인접 차량의 DTV로 부족한 전력 구매를 위한 충전 요청(charging request) 메시지를 전송하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 인접 차량의 DTV는 상기 충전 요청 메시지를 수신하여 검증하고, 상기 충전 요청 메시지에 대응하는 응답(reply) 메시지를 상기 차량의 DTV로 전송하고, 상기 차량의 DTV는 상기 응답 메시지를 기반으로 상기 적어도 하나의 인접 차량 중 전력을 공급해줄 공급 차량을 결정하고, 상기 결정된 공급 차량의 DTV와 스마트 계약(smart contract)을 설정하고, 상기 차량의 DTV는 상기 공급 차량의 DTV와 무선 충전이 시작되면, 상기 설정된 스마트 계약을 실행한다.
assignees: FOUND RES & BUSINESS SEOUL NAT UNIV SCI & TECH

title_en: Digital twinning-based multi-source fusion power transmission line channel safety monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power transmission safety of power systems, and discloses a digital twinning-based multi-source fusion power transmission line channel safety monitoring method and device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining binocular vision image data and laser radar point cloud data, fusing by utilizing DeepFusion multi-mode fusion models, generating fusion models so as to conduct digital twin modeling on a transmission line channel and achieve intelligent safety monitoring on the transmission line channel, conducting semantic segmentation and target recognition on the obtained fusion model data, recognizing and positioning potential hidden danger targets such as construction vehicles, tree barriers, forest fires and artificial buildings below the transmission line channel, calculating the distance between the transmission line and the potential hidden danger targets, sending early warning to power grid operation staff if the potential danger is recognized, establishing a digital twin model on the transmission line channel, assisting the operation staff in judging dangerous situations quickly, formulating maintenance rescue schemes in time, and guaranteeing safe and stable operation of the transmission line. The intelligent safety monitoring system can realize intelligent safety monitoring of the transmission line channel, improve the operation and maintenance efficiency of the power grid and reduce the manual inspection cost.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH

title_en: Comprehensive energy management method and platform based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based comprehensive energy management method and a digital twinning-based comprehensive energy management platform. And collecting power grid operation data through a sensor network and transmitting the power grid operation data to edge computing equipment. The edge computing device pre-processes the data, builds a digital twin mapping strategy based on a Markov decision model, and adaptively maps the data to a visualization platform. The platform acquires a user abnormality detection instruction, and the edge equipment executes a detection task. The task comprises extracting topological space features and multi-period power utilization time sequence features, and combining the two features to perform abnormality detection by adopting an integrated learning algorithm. And finally, importing the result into a platform for display. The method and the device can quickly and accurately identify the abnormal electricity utilization problem in the electricity utilization data.
assignees: WUHAN ZHIWANG WEIYE TECH CO LTD;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: System for measuring and calculating carbon reduction investment intensity of typical low-carbon engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent management of carbon emission of low-carbon engineering, and discloses a typical low-carbon engineering carbon reduction investment intensity measuring and calculating system, which collects operation data of low-carbon engineering such as offshore photovoltaic and the like through multi-sensor redundancy, ensures the credible storage of the data by using a blockchain technology, and the deep learning model is adopted to predict environmental and market factors, the system power is dynamically distributed based on a multi-objective optimization algorithm, the investment cost and the carbon emission reduction amount are combined to automatically calculate the carbon reduction investment intensity, and the visual presentation and intelligent early warning are realized through a digital twin technology. The invention solves the technical problems of inaccurate evaluation of the carbon reduction benefit and difficult quantification of investment benefits of the existing low-carbon engineering, and improves the scientificity and the accuracy of investment decisions of the low-carbon engineering.

title_en: Multi-parameter intelligent monitoring and linkage control system for transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-parameter intelligent monitoring and linkage control system of a transformer substation, which is based on an intelligent transformer substation internet-of-things management and control platform, wherein a central control module is arranged in the management and control platform and comprises an intelligent power monitoring system, a linkage control system and a digital twin simulation engine, the intelligent power monitoring system comprises a multi-parameter sensing terminal group, an edge computing node and a cloud analysis center, which are arranged in a target area of the transformer substation, the multi-parameter sensing terminal group acquires electric parameters, environmental parameters and equipment state parameters in real time, the linkage control system comprises an instruction analysis module, a multi-stage execution mechanism and a feedback verification circuit, and the linkage control system receives an early warning signal of the intelligent power monitoring system through the internet-of-things management and control platform and drives the multi-stage execution mechanism to execute a preset linkage strategy. The intelligent control system of the transformer substation, which is integrated with multi-parameter real-time monitoring, dynamic fault early warning, digital twin simulation and hierarchical linkage control, is adopted by the invention, and is suitable for unmanned operation and maintenance of the intelligent transformer substation.
assignees: UNICA JIANGSU INTEGRATION ELECTRICAL CO LTD

title_en: BIM intelligent management platform and method for engineering generation full life cycle
abstract_en: The invention provides a BIM intelligent management platform for engineering generation full life cycle, which integrates a building information model, sensing data of the Internet of things and a blockchain certification mechanism through a multi-source data fusion technology, and associates planning, designing, constructing and operating and maintaining full-flow data chains. The platform adopts space optimization Huffman coding to realize the light weight of the model, combines constraint genetic algorithm to optimize the construction path, and applies the two-way long-short-term memory network to analyze the equipment state. The three-chain blockchain system is reconstructed on the framework, intelligent association of engineering quantity and payment nodes is realized through cooperation of a main chain, an accounting quantity side chain and an audit side chain, and meanwhile, offline interaction of a mobile terminal is supported based on a digital-analog separation technology. The platform comprises an intelligent design management unit, a block chain investment management unit, a dynamic deviation rectifying management unit, a quality safety responsibility tracing unit, an NLP risk management unit and a digital twin operation and maintenance unit. The units realize cross-system cooperation through a unified data bus to form a closed-loop management framework for covering the engineering generation and building the whole life cycle.
assignees: DONGGUAN DAYE BUILDING TECH CONSULTING CO LTD;GUANGDONG JIANQING ENG SURVEY AND DESIGN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin energy management method and system for source network and charge storage collaborative scheduling
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power dispatching, in particular to a digital twin energy management method and system for collaborative dispatching of source network and load storage, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional space-time operation data of the source network and load storage, and extracting space-time coupling characteristics through a graph convolution-long-short-time memory network; the method comprises the steps of establishing an analog model of a digital twin environment, simulating an uncertain operation condition by using a Monte Carlo scene generator, adopting a second order cone relaxation technology to process flow constraint, training an energy storage scheduling agent in the digital twin environment, learning an energy storage charging and discharging strategy by a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, designing a source network charge storage hierarchical collaborative optimization framework, optimizing power output and load distribution by adopting an improved particle swarm algorithm at the upper layer, solving flow distribution by adopting an alternate direction multiplier method at the lower layer, establishing a self-adaptive feedback correction mechanism, and dynamically adjusting the collaborative scheduling strategy. The application realizes intelligent collaborative scheduling of source network charge storage and improves the operation efficiency and stability of the power system.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd

title_en: Model-free state estimation method, system and storage medium for power distribution network based on model multiple linear decomposition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model-free state estimation method, a model-free state estimation system and a model-free state estimation storage medium for a power distribution network based on model multiple linear decomposition, and aims to solve the technical problem that the power distribution network cannot perform state estimation under the condition that real-time topology information of the power distribution network is lost. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical measurement data of a power distribution network, preprocessing the historical measurement data, constructing a three-dimensional tensor according to a time dimension, a node dimension and a measurement type dimension, decomposing the three-dimensional tensor by using an alternating least squares algorithm to obtain an optimal decomposition factor matrix, reconstructing the measurement tensor by using the optimal decomposition factor matrix to realize filtering of the historical measurement data in the original three-dimensional tensor and complement of missing measurement data, and finally extracting a voltage tensor in the reconstructed measurement tensor and performing inverse normalization processing to obtain a voltage amplitude estimated value. The method is applied to power distribution network state estimation, and stable and accurate state estimation calculation can be realized under the condition that topology information is not used.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Network security situation awareness and emergency response platform based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security situation awareness and emergency response platform based on digital twinning, which belongs to the technical field of network detection and comprises a data acquisition module, a data fusion and digital twinning modeling module, a situation awareness analysis module and a response module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires original data information related to network security, the data fusion and digital twinning modeling module preprocesses the original data information and constructs a digital twinning virtual model, the processed data are synchronously reflected on the digital virtual model, the situation awareness analysis module analyzes the data based on the virtual model environment, so that the network security state is detected, and the response module responds correspondingly and emergently based on a judgment result. The invention not only can comprehensively analyze a plurality of data under the same influence layer to improve the detection accuracy, but also can combine the data among a plurality of influence layers to perform fusion analysis, and judge the network security condition according to the correlation among the influence layers to further improve the detection accuracy.
assignees: GUANGDONG YITONG HENGRUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-parameter cooperative intelligent monitoring system for water conservancy gate
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to the technical field of big data analysis, and discloses a multi-parameter collaborative intelligent monitoring system for a water conservancy gate, which comprises a multi-parameter acquisition module, a multi-parameter processing module, a comprehensive analysis module, an intelligent decision module, an operation and maintenance early warning module and a man-machine interaction module, wherein the multi-parameter acquisition module is used for constructing a multi-dimensional data set of the water conservancy gate, the multi-parameter processing module is used for calculating a flood control and flood discharge index, a structural safety index and a device health index, the comprehensive analysis module is used for judging a gate risk level, the intelligent decision module is used for generating a gate optimal scheduling scheme, the operation and maintenance early warning module is used for constructing a multi-stage early warning mechanism, the man-machine interaction module is used for providing a visual interaction interface, comprehensive parameter coverage is realized, a gate digital twin model and a gate opening comprehensive evaluation model are constructed, the gate risk level is evaluated, the gate risk judgment accuracy of gate risk judgment is improved through dynamic adjustment and optimization strategies of the intelligent decision module, and the self-adaption capability of the system is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU PROVINCE TAIHU DISTRICT WATER CONSERVANCY PROJECT MAN OFFICE

title_en: County power distribution network resource collaborative optimization method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a county power distribution network resource collaborative optimization method and system based on digital twinning, which are used for constructing a county power distribution network digital twinning model; performing time-space dimension reduction processing on historical data, constructing a deep learning optimization framework, designing a double time scale algorithm, constructing a multi-resource collaborative optimization decision index system, and obtaining an optimal resource allocation scheme through a reinforcement learning algorithm. The method effectively solves the key technical problems of insufficient coordination capability, low calculation efficiency, missing space-time coupling consideration, poor adaptability and the like in the prior art. The scheme not only remarkably improves the resource utilization efficiency and the system reliability and reduces the calculation complexity and the economic cost, but also has flexible adaptability to the characteristics of distribution networks in different counties and domains, and provides brand-new technical support for planning and running the distribution networks in counties and domains.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Underground pipe network dynamic risk detection and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting and early warning dynamic risk of a subsurface pipe network, which comprises the following steps, firstly, constructing a multi-source heterogeneous database, integrating various data to form a core database, wherein the construction step comprises the step of collecting various data. And then data normalization processing is carried out, and various coding and normalization operations exist. A spatio-temporal feature matrix is then constructed. And constructing a mixed model containing a plurality of layers of perceptrons and a convolutional neural network for deep learning training, wherein the model input layer contains a plurality of characteristic tensors and has related strategies. And mapping the model scores to a geographic information system to generate a risk thermodynamic diagram, setting a threshold trigger early warning signal, and carrying out linkage and three-dimensional visual display with an emergency platform. The model can be used for inter-regional collaborative training and risk trend analysis, and can be embedded into a digital twin platform to realize dynamic simulation detection. The invention builds a comprehensive data base, digs complex relations, improves model performance, and provides decision support for management and control of pipe network risks and the like.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHIYUAN SPACE INNOVATION TECH CO LTD;SHENZHEN HUANSHUI PIPE NETWORK TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent micro-grid panoramic sensing system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based intelligent micro-grid panoramic sensing system, which relates to the technical field of micro-grid panoramic sensing and comprises a data acquisition layer, a data processing layer, a digital twinning model layer, an application service layer and a user interaction layer; the invention divides the sensor into a core layer, key equipment/nodes and an edge layer, common equipment/non-key nodes, and introduces a self-adaptive sampling frequency adjustment mechanism, dynamically adjusts the sampling frequency according to the running state of a micro-grid, reduces the frequency in the stable state, improves the frequency in the abnormal state, solves the problems of data redundancy and insufficient instantaneity of the traditional sensor network, and combines the high-precision acquisition of key data and the optimization of non-key data efficiency, the cooperative data processing of edge calculation and federal learning, and the edge calculation nodes deploy a lightweight deep learning model to realize real-time data preprocessing, filtering, denoising and feature extraction.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHIYUAN ENGINEERING MAN CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line assessment method, device and equipment based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a power transmission line assessment method, device and equipment based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of power transmission lines. The method comprises the steps of collecting environment data and operation data of power transmission lines in a target icing area, taking each power transmission line in the target icing area as an intelligent agent, determining icing risk level data of each power transmission line according to the environment data and the operation data corresponding to each power transmission line, adjusting monitoring frequency based on the icing risk level data of each power transmission line, and obtaining an evaluation result of the power transmission lines in the target icing area according to the environment data, the operation data, the icing risk level data and a pre-trained digital twin model, wherein the icing risk level data is used for adjusting the pre-trained digital twin model. According to the invention, the running states of the power transmission line under different working conditions and environments can be simulated through the model, and the power transmission line can be comprehensively simulated by combining multi-source data, so that operation and maintenance personnel can master the line state.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD HENGSHUI POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method and system for planning site selection and volume fixation of power grid side energy storage equipment and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system and electronic equipment for locating and sizing energy storage equipment at a power grid side, and relates to the technical field of energy storage planning at the power grid side, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after grid operation data and external environment data of a target area are acquired, processing the data by utilizing a grid-energy storage digital twin model to obtain site-capacity characteristic data, generating a candidate site set in the target area according to the site-capacity characteristic data, and synchronously mapping site selection variables and constant volume variables in a partitioning mode according to space and boundary constraint of each candidate site to form a plurality of candidate subsets; generating an initial site selection and volume determination scheme of a target area based on the site address in each candidate subset, carrying out simulation evaluation on annual time sequence operation data of the scheme to obtain a performance index data set, judging whether performance indexes are converged by combining a preset convergence rule, and determining the initial site selection and volume determination scheme at the moment as a final scheme if all the performance indexes are converged. The invention realizes synchronous consideration of site selection and constant volume.

title_en: Intelligent fire safety assessment system and closed-loop control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire safety intelligent evaluation system and a closed loop management and control method, which comprise the steps of analyzing national standard and local standard texts through natural language processing technology, decomposing clauses into a three-level quantifiable index system, constructing a dynamic index library containing at least 200 subdivisions, generating a dynamic rule library based on a BERT-NER model, automatically extracting standard parameter thresholds and supporting version difference comparison and real-time updating, deploying a fire-fighting special BERT model to analyze unstructured documents, extracting illegal events and converting the illegal events into structured evaluation factors, aggregating multi-source sensor data and video streams through an edge computing gateway, adding space-time labels to realize millisecond-level real-time monitoring, combining static weights and dynamic weights to generate comprehensive scores, constructing a risk prediction model based on an Attention-LSTM network, inputting historical hidden danger data, environment variables and enterprise operation data, and outputting future risk probability distribution.
assignees: SUIREN FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering data intelligent monitoring method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for hydraulic engineering data based on digital twinning, which comprehensively considers the actual physical structure, operation parameters and surrounding environment information of hydraulic engineering when a hydraulic engineering digital twinning model is constructed, breaks the limitation that the traditional monitoring means only pay attention to a single parameter or a few parameters, utilizes model associated data and visual display, enables management staff to visually check the state and parameter change of each part, improves the monitoring efficiency and the comprehensiveness, solves the limitation that the traditional monitoring means lacks effective analysis and excavation, adopts a risk assessment formula to convert the data into risk indexes, enables the management staff to intuitively know the safety condition, combines the model to simulate and analyze the risk development trend and the result when the risk assessment value exceeds the threshold value, finds out problems and risks in advance, triggers early warning, enables related staff to formulate corresponding measures according to the simulation result, such as adjusting flood discharge flow, reinforcing structures and the like, reduces disaster loss, and improves the safety and reliability of the hydraulic engineering.
assignees: ZHONGTOU DECHUANG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Depth scheduling method and system for depth peak shaving of coal-fired unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system resource optimization scheduling, in particular to a deep scheduling method and a deep scheduling system for deep peak shaving of a coal-fired unit, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional operation parameters of the unit, a deep peak shaving instruction and carbon price signals of a carbon emission right trading market, and realizing time stamp alignment; the method comprises the steps of establishing a five-dimensional safety constraint model associated with economic cost boundaries, establishing an objective function by integrating coal purchasing cost, carbon transaction cost and equipment maintenance cost with the aim of peak regulation income maximization, solving an economic scheduling scheme by adopting a dynamic programming algorithm, executing a cross-system cooperative strategy, predicting equipment life and digital twin simulation based on LSTM, and triggering the cross-system correction strategy. The invention solves the commercial synergy difficult problems of economy, environmental protection and equipment reliability in deep peak shaving, and realizes the peak shaving income maximization of the coal-fired unit in the electric power market environment.
assignees: WANGTING POWER GENERATION BRANCH SHANGHAI HUADIAN POWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Platform theoretical line loss calculation method based on photovoltaic digestion range identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating theoretical line loss of a platform region based on photovoltaic absorption range identification, which specifically relates to the field of line loss calculation of an electric power system, and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of S1 collecting topological structure, load, photovoltaic and platform area head end data according to preset frequency, S2 eliminating abnormal values, filling missing data and normalizing, S3 establishing a tide equation based on a node voltage method, iterating to obtain node voltage amplitude and phase angle, S4 calculating voltage sensitivity factors, S5 calculating power transmission distribution factors, combining the voltage sensitivity factors to obtain photovoltaic absorption comprehensive indexes, judging whether the nodes are in an absorption range, S6 constructing a topological graph data structure, dividing the sub-platform areas by a graph traversing algorithm, and S7 calculating equivalent resistance and theoretical line loss power of each sub-platform area, wherein the sum is the theoretical line loss of the whole platform area. According to the method, the photovoltaic absorption range is accurately identified, the calculation accuracy of the theoretical line loss of the photovoltaic-containing platform area is improved, the fine management requirement of the power system is met, and the method has high practicability.

title_en: Accident scenario construction method and system for accident scenario construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accident scenario construction method and a system for accident scenario construction, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out accident data acquisition and data preprocessing on disaster-bearing objects, respectively extracting common features and individual features, generating a space-time aligned feature vector matrix, loading the feature vector matrix in real time to generate a space-time synchronous digital twin body, carrying out accident process mechanism analysis on the disaster-bearing objects, determining disaster-causing factors possibly causing accidents, adopting reinforcement learning algorithm to simulate accident evolution paths, generating scenario construction element model libraries required by accident scenarios of the disaster-bearing objects, collecting risk data and emergency preparation data of the disaster-bearing objects, and carrying out accident scenario construction by matching with the element model libraries. By effectively integrating the multi-source data, the authenticity of the constructed accident scene is effectively ensured, and meanwhile, the constructed accident scene is more targeted and applicable by adopting a dynamic deduction mode.
assignees: CHENGDU CITY SAFETY AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Garden multisource intelligent water-saving regulation and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a garden multisource intelligent water-saving regulation and control method and system, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent irrigation of gardens. The method comprises the steps of collecting water quantity and water quality data of rainwater, reclaimed water and tap water in real time, generating a structured data set after space-time alignment and exception handling, adopting a parallel prediction model to fuse water quantity prediction and water quality trend analysis, outputting a water source available quantity sequence, generating a dynamic scheduling instruction based on a multi-objective optimization function and a quantum decision forest model, simulating, verifying and correcting risk instructions through a digital twin engine, issuing and executing the risk instructions, and finally feeding back optimized model parameters according to actual execution deviation. The intelligent cooperative scheduling system realizes intelligent cooperative scheduling of multiple water sources, remarkably improves the utilization rate of non-traditional water sources, reduces the running water dependency, ensures the running safety and stable water quality of a pipe network, and provides an efficient and energy-saving intelligent solution for garden irrigation.

title_en: Power distribution network neural network dynamic state estimation method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic state estimation method and a dynamic state estimation system for a power distribution network based on digital twin, which relate to the technical field of power system state estimation and comprise the steps of acquiring real-time sampled data from an actual power distribution network and uniformly transmitting the real-time sampled data to a control server; the method provided by the invention solves the problems of data transmission acquisition interference and deficiency, has the capability of screening and complementing the required accurate data as the basic data of dynamic state estimation, has faster calculation speed and robustness compared with the traditional Kalman filtering, can be adaptively replaced with different prediction models according to different topological structures, and has better prediction effect on the dynamic state estimation under new energy scenes such as photovoltaic and the like.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Multi-resource fusion planning method and system for power distribution network based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network multi-resource fusion planning method and system based on a graph neural network. Aiming at the problems that the conventional county power distribution network planning fails to fully consider the cooperative optimization of an alternating current-direct current hybrid system, a distributed energy source and an energy storage system and lacks accurate modeling of complex topological characteristics of the power distribution network, the county power distribution network resource digital twin model is firstly constructed, and comprises an accurate mathematical model of the alternating current-direct current hybrid system, the distributed energy source and the energy storage system, then a graph neural network is utilized to construct an abnormal composition structure and extract network topological characteristics, a multi-head self-attention mechanism is designed to realize the mapping of resource space distribution and electrical characteristics, and finally a hierarchical reinforcement learning algorithm is adopted to construct a double-layer decision frame comprising a resource planning layer and an operation control layer, so that the optimal configuration decision of multi-resource fusion is realized.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: AE-RBF data alignment-based electric-thermal comprehensive energy system state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AE-RBF data alignment-based electric-thermal comprehensive energy system state estimation method which comprises the specific steps of S1, extracting thermodynamic characteristics to generate a high-frequency thermodynamic data sequence, S2, inputting the high-frequency thermodynamic data and real-time data of an electric power system into a Ph-MCC-CNN-LSTM model for training, S3, monitoring a thermodynamic data update state in real time, triggering interpolation update when new measurement data are detected, S4, carrying out dynamic reasoning based on current electrothermal data and a trained model, outputting a state estimation result meeting a physical law, and updating a historical database to form closed-loop feedback. The state estimation method of the electric-thermal comprehensive energy system based on AE-RBF data alignment solves the problem of insufficient dynamic response capability caused by the measurement time scale difference of an electric system and a thermodynamic system in the prior art.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Automatic inspection method and system for intelligent fire-fighting equipment of LNG (liquefied Natural gas) station
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic inspection method and system for intelligent fire-fighting equipment of an LNG (liquefied Natural gas) station, in particular to the field of the intelligent fire-fighting equipment of the LNG station, which comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic drift model by collecting environmental parameters in real time, accurately quantifying the interference of severe conditions to a sensor, utilizing a time sequence prediction network to proactively capture drift trend, combining a digital twin technology to simulate the equipment state under an extreme scene, intelligently identifying an abnormal mode based on unsupervised clustering, dynamically optimizing multi-source data fusion weight, and finally continuously improving the system adaptability through reinforcement learning of a closed-loop iteration drift model and a fusion strategy, effectively eliminating misjudgment and omission caused by environmental interference in the whole process, remarkably enhancing the instantaneity and reliability of fire-fighting early warning, greatly reducing the risk of safety accidents, and providing all-weather, high-precision and self-evolution intelligent protection guarantee for the LNG station.
assignees: SHAANXI CITY MUNICIPAL GAS IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Robust observer-based power distribution network control input attack detection and state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system automation and information safety, and discloses a power distribution network control input attack detection and state estimation method based on a robust observer, which comprises the steps of constructing a power distribution network linear discrete dynamic model based on a Droop control, and improving the observability of a system by utilizing a multi-step observation structure and differential modeling; based on a disturbance propagation matrix and a zero space projection technology, the attack detection problem is converted into a sparse optimization problem, an Unknown Input Observer (UIO) is designed, the robustness is enhanced by combining a dynamic compensation matrix and feedback gain, and an online feedback mechanism is introduced to realize parameter self-adaptive update. The method can realize real-time identification of control instruction tampering attack and high-precision estimation of system state, and meets high requirements of power distribution network operation on safety, instantaneity and reliability.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Data monitoring early warning maintenance system of intelligent water service pipe network based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent water service pipe network data monitoring, early warning and maintenance system, which comprises a data acquisition module, a digital twinning model construction module, a data monitoring and analysis module, an early warning and maintenance decision module, a visual display interface and an execution unit. According to the digital twin-based intelligent water management network data monitoring and early warning maintenance system, through the arrangement of the data monitoring and analysis module, historical conductivity data are extracted to obtain the ion concentration in a pipeline and calculate the corrosion speed, various data at the initial end of a unidirectional pipeline are extracted to predict the pressure value at the tail end of the unidirectional pipeline for analysis, and corresponding abnormal results are generated for transmission when data are abnormal in the analysis process, so that corrosion conditions and pressure conditions in the pipeline are predicted in time, simulation early warning can be carried out in real time, and the safety of the water management network and the timeliness of early warning maintenance are improved.
assignees: NANJING ZHUOSHANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital village platform based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin and intelligent service adaptation and discloses a digital village platform based on digital twin, which comprises a multi-dimensional context awareness engine, a service component library and a configuration model, a context mapping model, a negotiation interaction mechanism and a security experience balancer, wherein the multi-dimensional context awareness engine is used for collecting and analyzing context information of user dimensions, environment dimensions, equipment dimensions and task dimensions, the service component library and the configuration model are used for providing corresponding functional components and interface elements, the context mapping model is used for mapping the context mapping model into specific service configuration through a neural network, the negotiation interaction mechanism is used for realizing balance of intelligent recommendation and user control of a system through implicit and explicit negotiations, and the security experience balancer is used for carrying out risk assessment and dynamically adjusting security strategies.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGCHUANG FANGWEI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line loss optimization method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twin-based power transmission line loss optimization method and a digital twin-based power transmission line loss optimization system, which relate to the technical field of power transmission management, and are characterized in that a line topology and a state vector are determined through a digital twin model, an energy consumption dependent inter-graph of a power transmission line is constructed, a multidimensional characteristic tensor is determined according to a current coupling relation between nodes in the energy consumption dependent inter-graph, local hot spot evolution is carried out on the energy consumption dependent inter-graph to obtain a loss diffusion subgraph, dynamic relaxation verification is carried out on state quantity of the power transmission line to obtain a variable synergistic factor, the digital twin model is optimally fed back according to the multidimensional characteristic tensor and the variable synergistic factor to obtain a scheduling feedback strategy, a multilevel control instruction set is determined according to the scheduling priority and the scheduling feedback strategy of the power transmission line, and the local loss correction is carried out on the power transmission line based on the multilevel control instruction set.
assignees: LEXINGKON BEIJING ENERGY SYSTEM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric automobile dispatching method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dispatching method, a dispatching device, dispatching equipment and a storage medium for electric vehicles, and belongs to the technical field of vehicle power conversion. The vehicle power conversion method comprises the steps of obtaining vehicle information and power conversion station information when a vehicle runs, carrying out twin simulation by using a digital twin model according to the vehicle information and the power conversion station information to generate a vehicle power conversion strategy and an in-station charging strategy, and carrying out dynamic scheduling on the vehicle according to the vehicle power conversion strategy and the in-station charging strategy, so that the twin simulation is carried out on the vehicle information and the power conversion station information through the digital twin model to generate a real-time vehicle power conversion strategy and an in-station charging strategy, and the power conversion efficiency is improved.
assignees: NINGDE CONTEMPORARY FUTURE ENERGY SHANGHAI RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;NINGDE CONTEMPORARY AMPEREX TECH CO LTD

title_en: Three-phase power distribution network harmonic source positioning method considering topology switching and new energy harmonic pseudo measurement
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-phase power distribution network harmonic source positioning method considering topology switching and new energy harmonic pseudo measurement, which is characterized in that a harmonic emission model is constructed based on harmonic emission characteristics of distributed new energy, harmonic characteristics of monitored nodes are migrated to unmonitored nodes through migration learning to generate harmonic pseudo measurement data, the harmonic pseudo measurement data are used for compensating unmonitored node measurement deficiency, harmonic state estimation is realized through a multi-layer perception topology self-adaptive graph rolling network by utilizing the harmonic pseudo measurement data and actual harmonic measurement data, the network adapts to topology switching through learning weights of a dynamic fusion multi-order adjacency matrix, a power distribution network harmonic transfer equation is used as a physical constraint embedding loss function, harmonic injection current estimated values of all nodes are output, continuous accumulation is carried out based on the harmonic injection current estimated values, statistical characteristics of harmonic injection currents of all nodes are analyzed through statistics, and harmonic source nodes in the power distribution network are comprehensively identified by combining preset criteria.

title_en: Virtual power plant resource scheduling method and system based on multi-source data and knowledge guidance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of virtual power plant resource scheduling, and provides a virtual power plant resource scheduling method and system based on multi-source data and knowledge guidance, which comprises the steps of carrying out coding fusion on a resource dimension reduction feature set generated by dimension reduction on a regional resource operation data set acquired in real time and data of the same flexible resource in a resource state mode set obtained by carrying out resource state and response mode identification based on a preset state mode rule base to obtain a semantic enhancement data set, according to the type of the event to be responded, which is obtained by carrying out regional autonomous abnormal event identification by adopting a preset machine learning model, an event cooperative response scheme is generated by combining a resource state mode set and a resource association matrix, and verification and optimization are carried out based on a digital twin technology to obtain a target cooperative response scheme which is used for executing regional resource response scheduling. The method can effectively improve the abnormal efficient collaborative response capability and the supply and demand self-balancing capability of the autonomous operation of the resource aggregation area, and provide reliable guarantee for the long-term stable operation of the virtual power plant.
assignees: STATE GRID BLOCK CHAIN TECH BEIJING COMPANY;STATE GRID COMMERCIAL BIG DATA CO LTD;GANSU SHINING SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD;BEIJING SMARTCHIP MICROELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Asset data updating method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an asset data updating method, an asset data updating device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of computer vision. The method comprises the steps of collecting image data of target objects with different angles, preprocessing the image data by using electric power communication network equipment, fusing the preprocessed image data through a fusion algorithm to obtain an image to be recognized, inputting the image to be recognized into a pre-trained image recognition model to obtain position information, category information, confidence coefficient and boundary frames of the target objects in the image to be recognized, which are output by the pre-trained image recognition model, of the target objects, recognizing tag information of the target objects in the boundary frames of the target objects based on OCR technology, and matching and updating asset data in an asset management database based on the position information, the category information, the confidence coefficient and the tag information of the target objects, so that real-time updating and dynamic management of the asset data can be realized.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Intelligent peak shaving method for energy storage and conventional peak shaving means optimization combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent peak shaving method for optimizing combination of energy storage and conventional peak shaving means, which comprises the following steps of constructing a holographic situation sensing layer, capturing power grid voltage, current phase angle and frequency offset, monitoring in-cylinder pressure fluctuation of a diesel engine, conducting data transmission and preprocessing, encrypting micro phasor measurement units and quantum sensor data by utilizing a quantum key distribution technology, conducting autonomous optimization control strategy by utilizing a federal reinforcement learning framework based on the state of a power generation/energy storage unit through a local Agent, conducting Nash equilibrium calculation by combining a digital twin platform, solving multi-objective conflicts of economy, reliability and carbon emission, generating a global optimal scheduling instruction, executing a control layer, tracking a resonance point and dispersing a harmonic energy spectrum, conducting dynamic topology reconstruction, utilizing a digital twin platform to position the harmonic source, automatically switching the topology of an energy storage system according to the harmonic frequency and the position, conducting continuous optimization by the digital twin platform, and conducting full-flow closed-loop feedback and self-learning.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Industrial park light storage collaborative optimization method based on multi-objective digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial park optical storage collaborative optimization method based on a multi-objective digital twin body, which comprises the steps of collecting dynamic data in real time through a data perception layer, transmitting the dynamic data to a digital twin modeling layer for fusion processing, constructing a high-precision digital twin model by utilizing a physical-virtual two-way mapping technology of the digital twin modeling layer, generating an optimal optical storage charging and discharging strategy based on a fishing optimization algorithm and aiming at minimizing a fishing ERE factor, transmitting the generated optical storage charging and discharging strategy to a dynamic control layer, carrying out real-time regulation and dynamic optimization on an optical storage system, evaluating the performance of the implemented system, feeding back an evaluation result to the digital twin model, and optimizing the model and the algorithm. The intelligent and fine energy management system can dynamically adjust the optical storage charging and discharging strategy in real time, is suitable for dynamic changes such as photovoltaic power generation, load demand and power grid interaction in an industrial park, realizes the intellectualization and fine energy management, and realizes the sustainable development of energy conservation and emission reduction and power assistance.
assignees: HUAIYIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Urban safety risk management and control system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application relates to a digital twin technology-based urban security risk management and control system which comprises a first dimension security risk prediction data, a second dimension security risk prediction data and a third dimension security risk prediction data corresponding to first multi-source urban data and corresponding risk prediction results obtained through an infrastructure digital twin model, a public security digital twin model and an ecological environment twin model, wherein when the risk prediction results are abnormal results, a time node obtaining module obtains a target time node according to a data collection time node of the first multi-source urban data and a result time node of the risk prediction results, and a city security risk detection module inputs second multi-source urban data corresponding to the target time node into the digital twin model of a target city to obtain multi-dimension security risk prediction data for city security risk management and control, so that calculation power resources consumed for obtaining the multi-dimension security risk prediction data for city security risk management and control can be reduced.
assignees: XINHEHE TECH MACAU CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel fire-fighting emergency linkage method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel safety and emergency management, and discloses a digital twinning-based tunnel fire-fighting emergency linkage method and a digital twinning-based tunnel fire-fighting emergency linkage system, wherein the digital twinning-based tunnel fire-fighting emergency linkage method comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode data of a fire environment through various sensors and constructing a global situation understanding model; the method comprises the steps of processing environmental states and crowd behavior features by a multi-head attention network, dynamically adjusting attention weights on crowd feature dimensions by applying a situation enhancement attention mechanism, constructing a psychological environment interaction model, predicting crowd behavior evolution under different fire scenes, generating a situation-adaptive multi-level evacuation guiding strategy tree, carrying out real-time effect evaluation, and realizing overall optimization of the system by a digital twin model.

title_en: Railway intelligent construction site safety penetration type management messenger platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway intelligent construction site safety penetration type management messenger platform which comprises a multi-mode data fusion processing module, an edge computing node cluster, a three-dimensional visual penetration type management interface, an intelligent early warning and emergency response module, a self-adaptive network transmission module and the like, wherein the multi-mode data fusion processing module integrates various data, a dynamic data calibration algorithm is utilized to realize real-time cleaning, alignment and association analysis, and break a data island, the edge computing node cluster performs localized preprocessing and the like on the data in a key area to reduce the load of a central server, the three-dimensional visual interface supports drilling type viewing based on a digital twin construction model to realize three-dimensional monitoring, the intelligent early warning system adopts a reinforced learning model to automatically trigger multi-channel early warning, and the self-adaptive network transmission module dynamically switches communication modes to ensure low-delay transmission of the key data. The platform realizes the real-time collection and integration of the construction site data, and reduces the manual intervention.
assignees: HUATIE SHANDONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY NO 10 ENG GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY TEN BUREAU GROUP EIGHTH ENG COMPANY;CR10G ELECTRIC ENG CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering scheduling method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy scheduling, in particular to a digital twinning-based hydraulic engineering scheduling method and system, which are characterized in that firstly, the water flow response time difference of a water inlet and a water outlet of a main tunnel is analyzed, and the continuous drainage time length and the water quantity of the main tunnel in historical flood discharge are combined, so that the drainage mission performance of the main tunnel for representing the drainage capacity of the main tunnel in different scenes is quantized; aiming at the serial type branch hole structure, the diversion importance of each branch hole is evaluated by combining the water discharge data in the flood discharge process through the cooperative relation of the height of the water inlet of the branch hole and the main hole, and finally comprehensive characterization of flood discharge scheduling risk values is performed more accurately by integrating the diversion importance of all branch holes, so that the finally selected optimal early warning scheduling strategy is lower in risk reflected on branch hole diversion reliability and main hole task allocation balance while pursuing high drainage efficiency, and the accuracy of the finally determined optimal early warning scheduling strategy of hydraulic engineering is improved.
assignees: FUZHOU MINJIANG XIAYOU FLOOD CONTROL ENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Zero-carbon park planning method, equipment, storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a zero-carbon park planning method, equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product, and relates to the technical field of carbon emission management. Dividing the three-dimensional digital twin model of the park into a plurality of grid cells, respectively calculating photovoltaic theoretical power generation capacity of the grid cells, generating a plurality of candidate zero-carbon park planning schemes according to the photovoltaic theoretical power generation capacity, carrying out economic cost measurement and carbon efficiency profit measurement on each candidate zero-carbon park planning scheme to obtain an economic carbon efficiency measurement result, and selecting an optimal zero-carbon park planning scheme from the candidate zero-carbon park planning schemes according to the economic carbon efficiency measurement result. According to the application, the zero carbon park quantitative simulation is carried out in the planning stage, so that the high cost of late park transformation is avoided, and the economic carbon efficiency ratio of the zero carbon park is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGTIAN BIMU TECH CO LTD;GUANGDONG HONGYE INVEST DEVELOPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Path optimization and resource intelligent scheduling method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path optimization and resource intelligent scheduling method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a digital twinning three-dimensional model of disaster area infrastructure to realize three-dimensional scene reconstruction; constructing an rush repair path optimization model based on a multi-objective function, and optimizing paths among all places in the digital twin three-dimensional model; the invention can realize the collaborative optimization of the rush-repair path and the resource scheduling, generate an optimal scheme by combining the topography and the risk constraint, and improve the rush-repair operation efficiency.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Beidou ground disaster displacement and image video monitoring fusion method and system based on high-reliability communication link
abstract_en: The application provides a Beidou ground disaster displacement and image video monitoring fusion method and system based on a high-reliability communication link, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting displacement, inclination angle and five-direction high-definition video in real time, accessing microclimate and wire clamp temperature data, and uniformly packaging through a data gateway; the method comprises the steps of adopting APN special line transmission and providing centimeter-level RTK differential service for an unmanned aerial vehicle, multiplexing a Beidou foundation enhanced station network based on a Beidou VRS virtual reference station and a long baseline monitoring and resolving technology, generating a virtual observation value for real-time dynamic RTK resolving, inverting a three-dimensional water vapor field based on inclined-path troposphere delay PWV, realizing tower-level rainfall prediction, generating a risk assessment report by fusing A I algorithm, superposing a displacement thermodynamic diagram, a real-time video and early warning labeling in a BIM+GIS digital twin scene, supporting 360-degree panoramic splicing and alarm triggering snapshot, and intelligently giving an early warning decision. According to the application, through high-precision Beidou monitoring, multi-mode data fusion and intelligent early warning, the instantaneity, precision and automation level of geological disaster monitoring are remarkably improved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Energy storage system operation and maintenance strategy optimization method based on digital twin
