abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic power big data reasoning platform and an electric power distribution system, and relates to the technical field of electric power systems, wherein the platform comprises a knowledge acquisition unit, a knowledge processing unit and a power distribution unit, wherein the knowledge acquisition unit acquires and preprocesses internal and external data of electric power, and the internal and external data are converted into structural data through the knowledge processing unit; the invention relates to a method for generating a power distribution scene, which comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic knowledge graph, organizing triple data to form an initial graph, monitoring new dynamic, correcting or adding graph content in real time by an updating unit, utilizing a fault diagnosis and demand prediction algorithm by an inference unit to realize accurate reasoning of power faults and future demand trend prediction based on the dynamic graph, realizing efficient integration and dynamic evolution of power knowledge through the construction and the real-time updating of the dynamic knowledge graph, ensuring timeliness and accuracy of the graph, providing reliable data for fault diagnosis, and generating a distribution scheme of an adaptation scene by a closed loop architecture of data acquisition, reasoning analysis, scheme formulation and execution control and combining an intelligent sensor and an optimization algorithm.

title_en: Virtual power plant regulation and control method and system for realizing new energy consumption
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of virtual power plants and discloses a virtual power plant regulation and control method and a system for realizing new energy consumption, wherein the system comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition module, an intelligent prediction analysis module, a resource aggregation modeling module, an optimization decision module, a block chain cooperation module and a digital twin evaluation module; the novel energy output and load demand are subjected to multi-time scale coupling prediction through the deep space-time convolutional neural network, the fluctuation and intermittence characteristics of the novel energy can be described, the short-term and ultra-short-term prediction accuracy is improved, the waste wind light rejection rate and the load reduction risk are reduced, the high matching of a virtual power plant scheduling plan and actual operation conditions is ensured, and a virtual machine set capable of efficiently scheduling can be formed by constructing a flexible resource characteristic matrix and carrying out fine modeling and aggregation on distributed energy storage, interruptible load and electric automobile multi-element resources, so that the resource utilization efficiency is improved, and the overall scheduling cost is reduced.

title_en: Multi-mode collaborative optimization method and system for intelligent micro-grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode collaborative optimization method and a multi-mode collaborative optimization system for a smart micro-grid, and belongs to the field of smart grids. The method comprises the steps of collecting electric data of a public connection point and a distributed unit, quantifying harmonic responsibility coefficients by using an improved complex independent component analysis and partial coherence method, constructing a dynamic electricity price game model, solving an optimal excitation coefficient by non-cooperative games, constructing a multi-objective optimization model, strengthening learning of agent correction model prediction control parameters by means of digital twin body training, rolling optimization, outputting scheduling instructions and achieving multi-mode switching. The system comprises four layers of data acquisition, regional collaboration, cloud computing and digital twin and intelligent optimization. The invention integrates the power quality and the economic dispatch, and improves the intelligent and safety of the micro-grid optimization.

title_en: Power transformer fault prediction method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power data processing, in particular to a power transformer fault prediction method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a focusing data set, constructing a reference model to be calibrated comprising multiple physical field couplings, adjusting preset uncertainty parameters through a Bayesian calibration method, outputting a digital twin model, selecting a fault anchor point through a filling space experiment design method, simulating the fault anchor point to generate a sample for training a proxy model, generating a virtual fault sample set through the proxy model, carrying out enhancement processing on the virtual fault sample set according to noise characteristics of a sensor to obtain an enhanced fault sample set, extracting spatial characteristics and time sequence characteristics to form a characteristic vector data set, and training a fault prediction model through a multi-task learning architecture as training data. According to the invention, a large number of fault samples are generated through the digital twin model and the proxy model, and comprehensive decision support is provided for the state maintenance and health management of the transformer.
assignees: JIANGSU DONGXISHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent checking method and system for power engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent checking method and system for electric power engineering, which relate to the technical field of electric power engineering checking and comprise the steps of generating an electric power engineering multidimensional checking data source containing space-time characteristics and association relations; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a key check item with a priority coefficient and a non-key check item based on a trained deep confidence network classification analysis model, carrying out bidirectional rule matching check on the key check item and the non-key check item to generate a preliminary check result containing a risk early warning coefficient, constructing a virtual check scene of an electric power engineering based on a digital twin technology, carrying out iterative dynamic correction on the preliminary check result by combining real-time feedback data, and generating an optimal check conclusion of the electric power engineering with a correction path planning. According to the invention, a closed-loop intelligent checking system is constructed through an intelligent algorithm, and the intellectualization, the precision and the high efficiency of the electric power engineering checking are realized by combining a dynamic self-adaptive checking rule and a weight mechanism and performing iterative correction and correction path planning driven by risks.
assignees: QUZHOU GUANGMING ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: GIS-based power distribution network years planning layer iteration updating method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for iterative updating of a power distribution network many-year planning layer based on GIS, and relates to the technical field of planning layer updating. According to the method for iteratively updating the multi-year planning layer of the power distribution network based on the GIS, the GIS initial planning layer is established by acquiring multi-source power distribution network data, the running state data is acquired by combining a digital twin model of the power distribution network, the area to be adjusted is determined through risk assessment, the layer is updated, real-time linkage of the planning layer and the running state of the power grid is realized, the planning scheme can be dynamically optimized based on data driving, the accuracy, adaptability and risk coping capability of the planning of the power distribution network are improved, the fact that the planning layer continuously fits actual requirements of the power grid is ensured, powerful support is provided for efficient running and scientific planning of the power distribution network, and the problems that planning and actual running are disjointed and power grid state changes and risk hidden hazards cannot be responded in time due to the fact that the data is isolated and a dynamic updating mechanism is lacked in the existing power distribution network planning are solved.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD AKSU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Method and system for estimating irrigation water consumption per unit area based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for estimating irrigation water consumption in a unit area based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the field of irrigation water consumption estimation and are used for estimating crop evaporation amount under the principle of energy balance by fusing multi-source heterogeneous data such as remote sensing images, meteorological data, soil humidity, crop growth information and the like and reducing errors of observation and models by utilizing data assimilation; and introducing a crop actual irrigation area identification model based on deep learning, effectively distinguishing the actual irrigation areas of different crop types, and dynamically reflecting the influence of space-time variation on irrigation efficiency. The invention can realize high-precision and rapid estimation of irrigation water in unit area of single crop and multiple crops on different area scales, remarkably improves timeliness and accuracy of irrigation water quota estimation, has strong adaptability to climate change, soil difference and crop diversity, and provides powerful technical support for precise irrigation and intelligent water conservancy management.

title_en: Enterprise climate risk prevention and control system applying big data and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of enterprise climate risk prevention and control, and provides an enterprise climate risk prevention and control system applying big data and artificial intelligence, which comprises a multi-source climate data acquisition module, a satellite, a ground station and enterprise Internet of things data are integrated through federal learning; the system comprises an enterprise asset digital twin module, an AI risk prediction engine, a dynamic risk assessment module, a self-adaptive response decision module, a hierarchical early warning and linkage insurance platform, wherein the enterprise asset digital twin module integrates BIM/GIS to construct a dynamic asset model, the AI risk prediction engine adopts a space-time convolutional neural network to analyze weather-asset relevance, combines physical simulation with generation of an countermeasure network quantification physical/transformation risk, the dynamic risk assessment module generates a risk thermodynamic diagram and calculates a supply chain interruption probability, and the self-adaptive response decision module outputs a hierarchical early warning and links the insurance platform to trigger automatic claim settlement. The system verifies the credibility of the data through the blockchain, utilizes the edge computing nodes to realize local disaster recovery decision when the network is interrupted, forms a closed loop control mechanism of 'monitoring-predicting-evaluating-responding-optimizing', and solves the problems of data island, responding delay and unknown risk prediction in the traditional scheme.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG WANLI

title_en: Support capability assessment method and system of flexible direct current transmission system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a support capacity assessment method and system of a flexible direct current transmission system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining operation data of the flexible direct current transmission system in an offshore wind power plant, constructing a support capacity assessment model comprising a physical model layer, a data driving layer and a model data fusion layer, inputting the operation data into the physical model layer to construct a physical model of the flexible direct current transmission system, obtaining a state prediction vector, inputting the state prediction vector into the data driving layer to construct an error correction model based on a deep learning model, obtaining a state prediction correction vector, carrying out weighted calculation on the state prediction vector and the state prediction correction vector by the model data fusion layer, obtaining a state estimation vector, establishing and calculating an assessment index value corresponding to a support capacity assessment index, judging the relation between each assessment index value and a corresponding preset threshold value, and obtaining an assessment result.
assignees: POWERCHINA FUJIAN ELEC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Energy digital management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy digital management method and system, the method comprises the steps of receiving multi-source heterogeneous energy data acquisition signals, generating initial energy feature patterns based on a space-time correlation feature extraction algorithm, conducting image neural network coding on the initial energy feature patterns, constructing an energy knowledge pattern vector set, decomposing high-dimensional vectors in the knowledge pattern vector set into a plurality of subspace vectors, conducting real-time scheduling decision on the subspace vectors by using an energy flow optimization model driven by reinforcement learning to generate an energy distribution strategy set, applying a digital twin verification algorithm to the energy distribution strategy set to conduct physical-digital space consistency verification to generate a trusted energy scheduling scheme, and conducting blockchain storage and intelligent contract execution on the trusted energy scheduling scheme to generate an untwistable energy transaction record. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the scheduling precision and the response speed of the energy system can be improved, and the full-link credible management from decision making to execution can be realized.
assignees: BEIJING YINHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Online assessment method and system for adjustable capacity of light storage direct-flexible power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of light Chu Zhi flexible power distribution systems, and provides an online assessment method and system for the adjustable capacity of a light storage direct flexible power distribution system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring historical operation data and real-time operation data of the light storage direct flexible power distribution system; the method comprises the steps of respectively constructing a photovoltaic power generation power output model, an energy storage charge-discharge dynamic model and a load adjustable range model, generating a multidimensional physical model of the light storage direct-soft system through a system-level electric coupling relation, calculating an initial adjustable capacity evaluation value of the system in a target time period through an optimization algorithm under a preset constraint condition based on the multidimensional physical model, carrying out online parameter correction on the multidimensional physical model through a time sequence deep learning model according to dynamic characteristic parameters in real-time operation data, and fusing corrected model output with the initial evaluation value to generate a real-time updated adjustable capacity prediction value. The flexibility and reliability of the system operation are effectively improved, the energy utilization efficiency is improved, and the operation cost is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power production loss evaluation method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a power production loss evaluation method and system based on digital twinning, relates to the technical field of power system energy efficiency management, and determines a comprehensive power loss score of a power grid to be evaluated in a first time period based on equipment loss score, power grid topology loss score, environmental loss score and management loss score of the power grid to be evaluated in the first time period. And if the comprehensive power loss score of the power grid to be evaluated in the first time period is smaller than or equal to the score threshold value, predicting the comprehensive power loss score of the power grid to be evaluated in the second time period. And if the difference between the comprehensive power consumption score of the power grid to be evaluated in the first time period and the comprehensive power consumption score of the power grid to be evaluated in the second time period is larger than a difference threshold value, prompting the first early warning information. And if the comprehensive power loss score of the power grid to be evaluated in the second time period is larger than the score threshold value, prompting second early warning information. According to the invention, accurate assessment, dynamic early warning and optimization of power loss are realized through multi-dimensional data fusion, and the power generation efficiency of a power grid is improved.
assignees: ANHUI ZHIHUI YUNZHOU TECH CO LTD;SMART YUNZHOU BEIJING SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Environment-friendly energy-saving building energy consumption real-time monitoring and intelligent optimizing system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent buildings, and relates to a system and a method for monitoring and intelligently optimizing energy consumption of a green energy-saving building in real time based on the Internet of things, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the sensing layer comprises an environmental sensor group, a sensing layer and a sensing layer, wherein the environmental sensor group is used for collecting temperature, humidity, illumination intensity and CO  2  concentration; the non-invasive electric energy monitoring module measures equipment current through a Rogowski coil with the precision of +/-0.5%, the equipment state acquisition terminal acquires the frequency and the lighting switch state of an HVAC compressor, the network layer comprises a multi-protocol edge gateway supporting ZigBee/LoRa/Modbus to MQTT protocol, the block chain storage module generates SHA-256 hash values for energy consumption data and links the SHA-256 hash values, the platform layer comprises a digital twin engine generating an energy consumption three-dimensional thermodynamic diagram based on a BIM model, and the optimization control core comprises an LSTM load prediction unit and an NSGA-II multi-objective optimization unit. The invention realizes the energy efficiency leap of 12-18% of comprehensive energy conservation (5-8% average level in far beyond industry) through the technology chain of accurate perception-intelligent decision-closed loop control.
assignees: SHANDONG WANYI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation hessian matrix method based on optimal control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state estimation hessian matrix method based on optimal control, and belongs to the technical field of power system state estimation. The invention establishes a node power equation for state estimation of an alternating current power distribution network, deduces a jacobian matrix and a hessian matrix of node power unbalance amount on node voltage and phase angle, establishes a state estimation optimization model aiming at the minimum square sum of node power measurement errors, and provides a power system state estimation hessian matrix method based on optimal control, which improves the state estimation convergence and ensures the calculation speed.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Intelligent comprehensive monitoring and management platform for forest ecosystem
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent comprehensive monitoring and management platform for a forest ecosystem, and belongs to the technical field of ecological system monitoring and management. The intelligent forest ecological system comprehensive management system comprises a multi-source data acquisition subsystem, a data processing and fusion subsystem, an intelligent analysis and prediction subsystem, a decision support subsystem, a comprehensive management subsystem and a comprehensive management subsystem, wherein the multi-source data acquisition subsystem is used for realizing all-round real-time data acquisition of each element of a forest ecological system through an air-space-ground integrated perception network, the data processing and fusion subsystem is used for cleaning, standardizing and evaluating quality of multi-source heterogeneous data, and extracting through space-time alignment and characteristics, the intelligent analysis and prediction subsystem is used for evaluating the health of the ecological system based on a deep learning model and carrying out early warning and prediction on plant diseases and insect pests, fire risks and ecological degradation trends through an intelligent algorithm, the decision support subsystem is used for providing intelligent decision suggestions for resource scheduling optimization, management measure formulation and emergency response, and the comprehensive management subsystem is used for realizing visual display and collaborative management of the forest ecological system through a 3D digital twin and visual display platform and supporting multi-azimuth task scheduling and resource management.
assignees: HENAN ZHONGWEI JIANYE CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Transportation risk optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic and road disaster early warning, in particular to a transportation risk optimization method and system, comprising the following steps of S1 multimode event-infrared-optical fiber data acquisition and synchronous generation of a unified index data packet; the method comprises the steps of S2, combining energy conservation and causal inference assimilation, outputting a digital twin state tensor, S3, performing forward noise scheduling and reverse denoising by a conditional diffusion model, generating an icing probability field and extracting a high-frequency attention spectrum, S4, calculating road structure factors according to the probability field and the attention spectrum, constructing a binary unconstrained optimization model, mapping to an optical coherence Ising machine for solving, forming an interference scheduling scheme by strategy network soft update and safety verification, and performing effect write-back cyclic update. The invention realizes sub-second risk identification and millisecond optimization decision, and reduces accident rate and salt spraying cost.
assignees: CHONGQING FEIHONG TRANSP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent water conservancy digital twin model construction method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based intelligent water conservancy digital twin model construction method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent water conservancy and comprises the following steps: establishing a project twin model based on intelligent water conservancy, and carrying out associated project analysis to obtain associated equipment; establishing a twin model network, and acquiring response conditions and response contents of each node; a response analysis model built by the response content of the real-time node; the method is used for solving the problem that in the existing intelligent water conservancy digital twin model construction method, when various types of water conservancy data exist and abnormal changes exist in certain types of water conservancy data, the digital twin model corresponding to the water conservancy equipment with large data fluctuation cannot be constructed in a targeted and real-time mode, and effective data monitoring cannot be conducted on the equipment with the abnormality in the water conservancy engineering in a targeted mode.
assignees: CHANGJIANG RIVER SCIENT RES INST CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Voltage data repair method and system for power distribution network fault detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a voltage data repair method and a system for power distribution network fault detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting voltage time sequence data of each node in a power distribution network; the method comprises the steps of screening collected voltage time sequence data of each node, reserving effective fault data, removing ineffective data to obtain cleaned voltage time sequence data, and repairing the cleaned voltage time sequence data based on topology relevance of a power distribution network. The intelligent power distribution system has the advantages that large-scale training data is not needed, the hardware compatibility is strong, the intelligent power distribution system can be embedded into the existing power distribution automation terminal, and key technical support is provided for real-time state estimation and self-healing control of the intelligent power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent system for early warning of leakage risk and emergency decision of mine water seal storage layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent system for early warning and emergency decision of leakage risk of a mine water seal storage layer, which is characterized in that a distributed sensor is used for collecting osmotic pressure gradient, microseismic event, tracer migration rate and rock stratum displacement data in real time, a standardized multi-parameter data set is generated through wavelet threshold denoising, variation modal decomposition and other processes, a fuzzy neural network model is utilized for outputting a leakage probability value P and a potential rupture azimuth angle theta, pore pressure is regulated and controlled according to the P value in three stages, when P is more than or equal to 0.3 and less than 0.6, the pore pressure is regulated and controlled, when P is more than or equal to 0.6 and less than or equal to 0.85, an optimal evacuation path is calculated, a grouting pressure gradient field is constructed according to theta and early warning grades, the proportion of plugging materials is dynamically matched, and online updating of model parameters is realized through closed loop control. The system realizes multi-physical field coupling monitoring and dynamic self-adaptive decision, and improves leakage risk assessment accuracy and emergency response efficiency.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHONGTAI ENERGY INVEST CO LTD;SCIMEE TECH CO LTD;GENERAL PROSPECTING INSTITUTE CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Flood disaster evolution method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a flood disaster evolution method and system based on digital twinning technology, the method comprises the steps of collecting all point cloud data of river basin topography, constructing a three-dimensional topography model, obtaining reflection intensity and elevation data of each point cloud, clustering all point clouds corresponding to the ground, and recording the area where the ground in each cluster corresponds to all point clouds as each local area; calculating a coplanar characterization value, an erosion evaluation value, a destabilization risk value, a soil fixation evaluation value and a terrain evolution factor of each local area, constructing a digital twin simulation platform of river basin terrain by combining a three-dimensional terrain model, and carrying out simulation on flood disasters. The application can avoid the defect that the static terrain model cannot respond to the terrain evolution caused by the flood disaster, effectively reduce the simulation error generated by the digital twin simulation platform in the flood disaster evolution process, and improve the accuracy of risk assessment on the flood disaster.
assignees: NANTONG DIANNAITE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent control method and system for lightning arrester of power transmission line based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control method and system for a transmission line lightning arrester based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the technical field of lightning arrester control and comprise the following steps of preprocessing acquired multi-source lightning arrester data to form a fusion data source; according to the method, a digital twin body with multiple physical fields coupled is constructed through a multi-physical-field collaborative modeling and dynamic mapping method, multiple physical-field distribution is dynamically simulated through an edge-cloud collaborative framework built in the digital twin body, physical state vectors are output, a first fault risk corresponding to the physical state vectors is deduced according to the acquired lightning arrester knowledge graph, multi-mode cross checking is conducted on the physical state vectors and the first fault risk through a three-dimensional evaluation space, a second fault risk is obtained, and a grading control strategy of a lightning arrester is dynamically generated and output through reinforcement learning based on the second fault risk. The method is used for solving the problems of modeling distortion of multiple physical fields of the lightning arrester of the power transmission line and insufficient dynamic performance of risk assessment and control strategies.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUHU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Energy storage power station operation safety assessment method, device, medium and program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage safety, and discloses an energy storage power station operation safety assessment method, an energy storage power station operation safety assessment device, an energy storage power station operation safety assessment medium and an energy storage power station operation safety assessment program product. Furthermore, the multi-time scale data are processed through stacked past decomposable mixing blocks, and the operation trend of the energy storage power station is predicted by combining a target deep learning model capable of understanding the relation between the upper level and the lower level and the mechanism relation, so that the prediction accuracy is remarkably improved. Furthermore, the multi-time scale optimization method and the digital twin-based lithium battery thermoelectric coupling model are combined for further optimization and verification, and the operation safety risk of the energy storage power station is evaluated by combining the preset safety domain model, so that the comprehensive and dynamic safety evaluation of the operation state of the energy storage power station is realized, the prediction precision and the safety evaluation reliability are improved, and the operation safety, reliability and economy of the energy storage power station are improved.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic power missing data restoration method based on similar matching and cross-domain associated modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic power missing data restoration method based on similar matching and cross-domain associated modeling, and belongs to the technical field of new energy and power systems. According to the method, a deep-layer similarity matching strategy is utilized, deep features of a historical irradiance sequence are extracted through a self-encoder, feature reconstruction is carried out, multidimensional similarity between a period to be repaired and a historical period is calculated, a similar power candidate set is constructed, an optimal matching sample is screened out, and a similar feature matrix is formed. On the basis, a depth crossover network model is introduced to perform association modeling on cross-time domain similar features, high-order nonlinear features are extracted through feature crossover, and accuracy and robustness of power data restoration are improved. The method can effectively relieve the problem of power data missing caused by abnormal acquisition, channel congestion or equipment failure, remarkably improve the input data quality of the power prediction model and support the safe and efficient operation of the distributed photovoltaic system.

title_en: Digital twinning-based real-time vulnerability early warning method for power terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based real-time vulnerability early warning method for an electric power terminal, which realizes quantitative evaluation of dynamic electricity utilization difference by constructing a physical layer current fluctuation curve and a network layer third-order peak fluctuation parameter analysis model. The method realizes a robustness threshold early warning mechanism, has a false alarm rate of <5%, response delay of <1 second, leak detection rate of 93.2%, system availability of 99.997%, annual operation and maintenance cost reduction of 62%, and comprehensive efficiency improvement of 3.4 times compared with the traditional scheme, and solves the problems that the existing electric power terminal leak detection method cannot respond to dynamic supercharging behaviors in real time, so that the false alarm rate is high, and a unified data processing frame is not established, so that continuous analysis data are difficult to fuse and analyze efficiently.

title_en: Distribution network engineering construction and transportation collaborative checking and management system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network engineering construction and transportation collaborative checking and management system based on multi-source data fusion, which belongs to the technical field of distribution network engineering construction and transportation collaborative checking and management and comprises a multi-source data acquisition module; the system comprises a multi-source data fusion engine, a transfer collaborative checking module, a dynamic decision support module and a dynamic decision support module, wherein the multi-source data fusion engine is used for generating a fusion data pool by correlation analysis of multi-source data of a deep learning model, the transfer collaborative checking module is used for synchronously executing quality deviation labeling in a construction stage, equipment transaction tracking in a handover stage and risk early warning in an operation and maintenance stage based on the fusion data pool. The invention relates to a method for real-time correlation of structured/unstructured data through a fusion engine, and solves the problems of data fracture and responsibility tracing fault caused by a traditional phasing system. Dynamic decision is driven by virtual-real mapping, namely the field physical state is synchronously mapped to a digital system based on a real-time updating mechanism of a GIS map, so that the problem that the field and system data are not synchronous is solved.
assignees: ZHUMADIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Digital twin of thermal power plant operation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of digital twin and energy industry intellectualization, and relates to a digital twin system for a three-dimensional running state of a thermal power plant, which solves the technical problems of island, visual deletion and prediction hysteresis of the traditional running data. The system builds a multi-source data fusion-dynamic physical deduction-virtual-real interaction control system, wherein a multi-source data fusion engine breaks through a DCS/SIS barrier to achieve 20 ten thousand+data points/second millisecond synchronization, a GPU drives a VFX Graph particle system and an LOD rendering technology to achieve 90fps@4K smoke flow simulation on RTX 4080, and an AR instruction is directly connected with a PLC to build a virtual-real bidirectional control chain to form a closed loop of monitoring-deduction-intervention. The key indexes are that the fault early warning is more than or equal to 72h, the fault positioning is 0.5 h/time, the data delay is less than or equal to 10ms, and the model precision is +/-2 cm. And adopting an edge-cloud cooperative architecture, and performing lightweight deployment on the Unity model. The actual measurement of the Beijing energy Chifeng power plant is that the emergency response is shortened to 4.3 minutes from 26 minutes, and an innovative paradigm foundation for 'predictive intervention' driving is laid for the digitization of thermal power.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA HUIBO TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Building energy consumption real-time monitoring and carbon emission assessment method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twin-based building energy consumption real-time monitoring and carbon emission assessment method, which comprises the steps of obtaining regional energy supply real-time data and building group load demand data, predicting energy supply fluctuation trend and load change trend to obtain a short-term supply and demand dynamic prediction result, adjusting an operation mode of a building group combined cooling heating and power system in real time according to an optimization scheme of mode switching, dynamically matching output change of distributed energy, feeding back the output change to a digital twin model, extracting carbon emission data from an optimized load distribution scheme, predicting carbon emission total amount and peak change trend by using the digital twin model, adjusting a carbon emission control threshold and constraint to generate a final energy scheduling scheme, obtaining the operation data according to the final energy scheduling scheme, and calculating energy utilization efficiency and carbon emission reduction of a building group by an energy efficiency assessment method preset in the digital twin model to obtain an execution effect assessment result of the scheduling scheme.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ZHONGKE ZHIXUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: E-commerce search service recovery method and device, equipment and medium thereof
abstract_en: Starting a local search service deployed by a current fault node, sending a missing data request to a remote search service of any healthy node, wherein the request comprises a latest timestamp of a latest log record in a local transaction log library, and the healthy node and the fault node are disaster recovery nodes; receiving a complete transaction log file generated after the latest timestamp returned by the remote search service, grouping log records in the complete transaction log file according to commodity identification, determining a target log record with the largest global version number in each group, constructing the target log record into an incremental transaction log file, writing the incremental transaction log file into a local transaction log library for playback to search engine index data, and re-registering the local search service to a service registration center after the playback is completed. The application can quickly recover the fault node and ensure that commodity data among the searching service nodes has high consistency.
assignees: GUANGZHOU SHANGYAN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin power prediction method and system based on adaptive multi-resolution wavelet filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin power prediction method and a digital twin power prediction system based on self-adaptive multi-resolution wavelet filtering, and relates to the technical field of power prediction; the method comprises the steps of obtaining multivariable power time sequence data, carrying out reversible instance normalization processing, inputting the normalized power time sequence data into an inverted embedding layer, mapping the normalized power time sequence data into a high-dimensional feature space to obtain an initial sequence, carrying out self-adaptive multi-resolution discrete wavelet transform on the initial sequence to extract low-frequency and multi-scale high-frequency components of the initial sequence, carrying out element-by-element multiplication on frequency domain components and a leachable filter core to complete self-adaptive wavelet filtering, reconstructing a filtered time domain sequence through the inverse wavelet transform, carrying out cross-channel aggregation and feature redistribution through a star aggregation-redistribution module, and inputting the extracted feature sequence into a feedforward neural network to obtain a power index prediction result of a future time step. The modeling method and the modeling system for the non-stationary power data effectively enhance modeling capability and prediction robustness of the non-stationary power data, are high in adaptability and easy to deploy.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN

title_en: Wind power probability prediction method integrating confidence triggering and missing data fault tolerance
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of wind power prediction and provides a wind power probability prediction method integrating confidence triggering and missing data fault tolerance, which comprises the steps of clustering a plurality of offshore wind farms to obtain a plurality of wind farm clusters; the method comprises the steps of inputting historical power data of offshore wind farms in a wind farm cluster into an improved transducer model to be processed, obtaining initial power probability prediction results of all the offshore wind farms, judging whether a target offshore wind farm with the initial power probability prediction results meeting a confidence triggering condition exists or not, taking the initial power probability prediction results as final power probability prediction results if the target offshore wind farms do not exist, interpolating the historical power data of the target offshore wind farms if the target offshore wind farms exist, and inputting the interpolated historical power data into the model again to be processed. The method can improve the wind power probability prediction precision, and is suitable for multi-step advanced power joint probability prediction under wind power plant clusters.

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent water conservancy pipeline section adjusting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, and particularly discloses an intelligent adjustment method for a section of a hydraulic pipeline based on digital twinning, which uses a sensor to collect entity operation data in the hydraulic pipeline; the method comprises the steps of collecting data, transmitting the data to a central processing system through a network, carrying out data modeling on the data based on a digital twin model through entity operation data, monitoring meteorological data of an initial section of a water conservancy pipeline by using a meteorological sensor, transmitting the monitored meteorological data to the central processing system, predicting the meteorological data by using big data analysis, and carrying out reducing regulation and control on the water conservancy pipeline according to the predicted meteorological data and pipeline supply real-time data. The automatic process from data acquisition, transmission and analysis to pipeline section regulation and control is realized, and the management efficiency is greatly improved by monitoring the real-time running state of the water conservancy pipeline without manually and frequently carrying out on-site inspection and manually regulating the pipeline section.

title_en: Coagulant addition prediction method for sparse coding and graph space-time attention fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coagulant addition prediction method for fusion of sparse coding and graph space-time attention, and relates to the technical field of time sequence data modeling prediction. The method effectively improves the missing data complement precision through the combination of a transducer coding-decoding architecture and a sparse self-attention and top-k sparsification strategy, provides high-quality and non-missing input data for subsequent predictive modeling, captures node association of multiple subsystems of a water production system by means of a graph attention network in a spatial feature expression level, improves the information entropy of the spatial features by dynamically calculating the association weights among the nodes and aggregating neighbor features, greatly enhances the expression capability of the spatial features on the multi-node coupling relationship, and can dynamically focus key time sequence nodes by a time attention mechanism in a time sequence predictive performance level, further improves the utilization rate of the key time sequence features and improves the accuracy rate of coagulant addition prediction.
assignees: CHENGDU QIANJIA TECHNOLOGY CO

title_en: Wind turbine generator performance dynamic evaluation method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The application discloses a wind turbine generator performance dynamic evaluation method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the wind turbine generator performance dynamic evaluation method based on multi-source data fusion comprises the steps of utilizing a quantum encryption algorithm and an edge gateway to synchronize multi-mode heterogeneous data, constructing a space-time semantic graph network through a deep semantic analysis technology to generate a precise space-time feature matrix, generating a physical enhancement feature vector based on an attention mechanism, constructing a cross-working condition health index map by using a machine learning algorithm, quantifying a cross-working condition comparable health index, generating a dynamic maintenance priority sequence by using a hierarchical increment learning architecture and utilizing a multi-target optimization algorithm, constructing a digital twin platform, performing closed-loop verification on the maintenance priority sequence, and generating a unit maintenance scheme. The method solves the problem of difficult fusion of multi-source data of the wind turbine generator, improves the quantitative accuracy of the health index under the complex working condition, optimizes the dynamic maintenance strategy and realizes the closed-loop optimization of the maintenance scheme.
assignees: NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic simulation and fault prediction method for power system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a dynamic simulation and fault prediction method of a power system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in a power system in real time based on a deployed sensor network, preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous data comprises power data and heat data, S2, calculating the preprocessed multi-source heterogeneous data based on a dynamic association model, analyzing a thermo-electric relation of power electronic equipment through a calculation result, and S3, establishing a dynamic mapping function of the thermo-electric relation in a digital twin model. According to the application, a digital twin model is adopted to fuse the thermal data characteristic of the power electronic equipment and the thermal-electric relation effect of the power data characteristic of the power grid, so that dynamic simulation is realized, the simulation precision is improved, and the prediction deviation caused by model mismatch is reduced. Meanwhile, virtual and real linkage is realized, and the two-way feedback of simulation results and fault prediction is realized.

title_en: Digital twinning-based energy-carbon integrated management method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin-based energy-carbon integrated management method, which relates to the technical field of energy-carbon management and comprises the steps of obtaining clean energy data, thermoelectric equipment data, outsourcing energy data, planned load data and production process flow data, predicting a supplied carbon emission transmission network by using a preset first carbon emission transmission model, obtaining a required carbon emission transmission network by using a preset second carbon emission transmission prediction model, calculating carbon emission factors according to the clean energy data, the thermoelectric equipment data and the outsourcing energy data, generating preliminary regulation and control instructions according to the carbon emission factors, the supplied carbon emission transmission network and the required carbon emission transmission network, performing simulation by combining equipment execution instructions and load regulation and control instructions to obtain simulation results and determining carbon deviation results, and performing instructions and load regulation and control instructions by using preset carbon integration system regulating equipment to obtain energy-carbon cooperative regulation and control instructions. The application can effectively improve the accuracy of carbon management.
assignees: WUHAN MAKER SCI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid dispatching training method and system based on panoramic digital twin simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid dispatching training method and system based on panoramic digital twin simulation, which relates to the technical field of power grid dispatching training, and comprises the steps of integrating a power grid topological structure, equipment operation data and historical fault data, constructing a three-level dynamic simulation model of equipment level, station level and regional level, based on acquired real-time operation data, after the data are subjected to dimension reduction and anomaly detection, the parameters and the states of the three-level dynamic simulation model are updated, the updated model is utilized to drive simulation, disaster scenes are generated by combining power flow analysis, load prediction and stability assessment, cognitive process data are collected, quantitative analysis is performed by combining preset assessment indexes, and personalized training feedback is generated. The invention highly restores the running state of the power grid, improves the data accuracy, enriches the training content, enhances the training effect, improves the capability of a dispatcher to cope with complex situations, breaks the regional limitation and improves the training efficiency and the resource utilization rate.
assignees: HUANENG LIANCHENG POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: System log data anomaly detection and management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system data processing and network security, in particular to a system log data anomaly detection and management system and method. The system comprises a map building module, an abnormality identification module and a feedback adjustment module. According to the invention, a global knowledge graph is constructed through a graph establishing module, deviation degree is calculated by combining with a historical baseline, direct association anomalies are judged, potential influence degree among nodes is calculated by an anomaly identification module based on a graph neural network propagation mechanism, indirect association anomalies are identified through feature vector cosine similarity, anomaly types are determined by combining with a multidimensional feature matching rule base, response measures are executed, a feedback adjustment module collects execution data through buried points, validity is quantitatively evaluated, feature backtracking and root cause positioning optimization schemes are adopted, iteration is carried out by depending on digital twin simulation and gray landing implementation schemes, accuracy of anomaly detection and dynamic adaptation capability of response measures are improved, and the method is suitable for log management and risk prevention and control of a complex system.
assignees: DALIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation device, computer program for power system state estimation device, and power system state estimation method
abstract_en: To provide a power system state estimation device capable of accurately grasping a state of a power system.SOLUTION: A power system state estimation device 1 includes: an observation object determination unit 201 which determines whether a power system 90 includes a measurement point where a measurement point is lost, on the basis of measurement values regarding electric quantities measured at a plurality of measurement points of the power system 90 which supplies power; an estimation AI model creation unit 205 which, when the observation object determination unit 201 has determined that the power system 90 has a measurement point where the measurement value has lost, creates an arithmetic model which estimates a missing value being a lost measurement value, on the basis of a measurement value measured at another measurement point related to a measurement point where a measurement value; and a missing value estimation unit 206 which calculates the missing value with the arithmetic model created by the estimation AI model creation unit 205.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: Rural new energy power generation and digestion method, system and medium based on storage and charging cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a rural new energy power generation and consumption method, system and medium based on storage and charging cooperation. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-objective rural new energy power generation and consumption model consisting of a rural new energy on-site consumption evaluation model, a distributed rural new energy load self-consumption model and a charge-discharge model of a storage and charge system, and finally solving the rural new energy power generation and consumption model based on storage and charge cooperation based on preset constraint conditions to obtain a final rural new energy power generation and consumption method. Through simulation analysis, the rural new energy power generation and consumption model based on storage and charging cooperation can not only meet the premise of on-site consumption of power load, but also ensure the minimum effect of waste energy, and realize the optimal energy storage loss under the condition that the fluctuation of the output power of the new energy is the flattest.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Communication-conduction-remote cooperative emergency processing method based on multi-source satellite data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency monitoring and discloses a general and remote cooperative emergency processing method based on multi-source satellite data fusion. The invention aims to solve the technical pain points of poor situation awareness timeliness and low precision caused by response lag, manual driving and link fracture in the existing emergency monitoring flow. According to the invention, multi-source heterogeneous data such as unified space-time reference and deep fusion communication and remote control are constructed, so that multi-star cooperation and air-ground integrated linkage is realized. The method is characterized by constructing a regional digital twin body fusing the deep learning and disaster physical model, planning observation in real time, fusing tracking data, and rapidly generating and sharing an emergency situation report. By constructing the closed-loop intelligent service system, the real-time performance and the accuracy of disaster monitoring and early warning are obviously improved, and the autonomy, the safety and the application efficiency of the key space information acquisition and service are greatly enhanced.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Interactive fusion method and system for seamless weather forecast product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather forecast, in particular to an interactive fusion method and system for a seamless weather forecast product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a forecasting background field to form a comprehensive data set containing different meteorological elements, loading and displaying background field data of a forecasting product according to a network geographic information system and the comprehensive data set, carrying out subjective and objective interaction form adjustment on the forecasting product, carrying out latticed post-processing to revise the forecasting product, setting association rules among the meteorological elements on the revised forecasting product to further revise the forecasting product, and fusing a meteorological disaster early warning signal, a streaming potential forecasting product and the revised forecasting product to obtain a seamless meteorological element forecasting product which is fused across time effects. According to the invention, through parameter limit value setting such as space-time fusion distribution of meteorological elements and association rules among the meteorological elements, and real-time updating and dynamic adjustment of fusion strategies, the consistency and consistency of each forecast product in time and space are ensured, and the forecast accuracy is improved.
assignees: JIANGXI METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY JIANGXI ENV METEOROLOGICAL FORECASTING CENTER

title_en: Power system voltage optimization control method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and provides a digital twin-based power system voltage optimization control method, which comprises the following steps of obtaining independent voltage constraint ranges of a main network and a power distribution network, constructing a transformer transformation ratio association model, and obtaining a main network compatible voltage sub-range and a power distribution network compatible voltage sub-range; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model to simulate dynamic operation conditions, and outputting a dynamic voltage range of a main distribution network through simulation analysis, wherein the dynamic voltage range of the main distribution network comprises the dynamic voltage range of the main network and the dynamic voltage range of the distribution network, the problem of effect offset caused by blind adjustment is optimized, the main network synchronous auxiliary adjustment is ensured to be executed when the main network is prioritized, and the contradiction between the main network depressurization and the distribution network pressurization is solved when the main network is prioritized.
assignees: BAIYIN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;BAIYIN YINZHU ELECTRIC POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy collaborative optimization energy saving and emission reduction system and method based on intelligent regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent regulation-based multi-energy collaborative optimization energy conservation and emission reduction system and method, comprising an intelligent sensing layer, a dynamic analysis layer, a collaborative decision layer, a flexible interaction layer and a flexible interaction layer, wherein the intelligent sensing layer monitors stress changes, preprocesses multi-source heterogeneous data and sends the multi-source heterogeneous data to the dynamic analysis layer, the dynamic analysis layer builds a digital twin model of coupling equipment based on the multi-source heterogeneous data, quantifies interaction effects among the equipment, simulates a linkage propagation path of a single fault, combines an equipment operation limit value and a vulnerability index to generate an anti-interference capability assessment report, the collaborative decision layer generates an initial scheduling scheme and sends the initial scheduling scheme to the flexible interaction layer, then triggers a fault response mechanism through the collaborative scheduling model, synchronously starts standby equipment, the flexible interaction layer responds to power grid auxiliary service requirements in real time, receives a user side load adjustment instruction, optimizes green electricity transaction quota through a bi-directional interaction mechanism, and finally rapidly calls regional standby resources when encountering faults.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: 3D visual medical rescue command system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rescue systems, discloses a 3D visual medical rescue command system, and aims to solve the problems of untimely information acquisition, incomplete information acquisition, low processing efficiency, insufficient decision support and the like in the traditional marathon event medical rescue command system, and provide an efficient and intelligent solution for modern medical rescue command. The system comprises an acquisition module, a synchronization module, an allocation module, a path module, an execution module, a 3D display terminal, a rescue path instruction, a control module and a control module, wherein the acquisition module acquires personnel positioning and on-site video streaming in real time and builds a three-dimensional digital twin model, the synchronization module performs time stamp alignment and space registration on multi-source data, the allocation module generates a resource allocation scheme, a disaster diffusion prediction graph and an unmanned aerial vehicle obstacle avoidance flight path according to unified coordinate data, the path module dynamically renders multiple layers on the 3D display terminal, and the execution module issues a rescue path instruction to control unmanned aerial vehicle bee colony to execute tasks and deliver materials. The invention realizes the intellectualization and visualization of medical rescue command of the marathon event, effectively improves the rescue efficiency and accuracy, and provides scientific and efficient decision support for emergency rescue.
assignees: JIANGSU YOUMAI SPORTS DEV CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power plant integrated monitoring management system of electric power Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power plant comprehensive monitoring management system of an electric power Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of monitoring control, and the intelligent power plant comprehensive monitoring management system comprises the steps of deploying Internet of things monitoring equipment in a power plant area required to be monitored and managed, constructing a monitoring network based on the deployed Internet of things monitoring equipment, collecting historical monitoring data in the power plant area, processing the collected historical monitoring data in a data processing mode after the collection is completed, and analyzing the processed historical monitoring data in a data analysis mode; after analysis, based on the analyzed historical monitoring data, a comprehensive monitoring management prediction model is built in a digital twin mode, finally monitoring data in a plant area are collected in real time and predicted through the comprehensive monitoring management prediction model, and meanwhile, the comprehensive monitoring management is carried out on the power plant area based on the comprehensive monitoring management prediction data, so that the accuracy of the comprehensive monitoring management of the power plant is improved.
assignees: CHN ENERGY LIAOCHENG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;ZHONGYING QINGCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cooperative development method for offshore wind power and ocean pasture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative development method of offshore wind power and ocean pasture, belonging to the field of comprehensive development and utilization of ocean resources. The method comprises the steps of acquiring ecological data of different depths, determining ecological adaptation parameters of a net cage and a wind power pile foundation, simulating the influence of pile foundation layout on hydrodynamic force by using a genetic algorithm, optimizing the space allocation proportion of the net cage, generating pile foundation and net cage differential design parameters by combining the water depth and tide characteristics, adopting modularized parallel construction flow to make a construction time cooperation plan, constructing a digital twin virtual interaction platform, optimizing operation parameters in real time, deploying a sensor network, acquiring real-time data of pasture management, analyzing biological attachment and water quality changes, designing an ecological coating of the pile foundation, generating ecological restoration parameters, and driving pasture water pumps and oxygenation equipment by using surplus wind power to realize power allocation of energy and ecological cooperation. The invention realizes multidimensional coordination of wind power and pasture in space, time, energy and ecology, and improves the utilization rate of resources.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG OCEAN

title_en: Power plant equipment intelligent coordination control method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent coordination control method and system for power plant equipment based on multi-source heterogeneous data, which belong to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and industrial automation, and comprise the steps of deploying a multi-mode sensor network in the power plant equipment, collecting the multi-source heterogeneous data in real time, and preprocessing the real-time data through an edge computing node; the method comprises the steps of carrying out collaborative modeling on preprocessing data by adopting a mixed analysis framework, predicting equipment state trend, identifying a fault propagation path, positioning a root cause and optimizing a maintenance decision scheme, evaluating equipment failure probability by a fault diagnosis result, triggering a hierarchical early warning mechanism and updating an optimization rule base by combining a dynamic knowledge base, constructing a three-dimensional model by utilizing a digital twin technology for virtual simulation and remote control, and carrying out maintenance guidance by an augmented reality auxiliary technology. The invention realizes high-efficiency real-time monitoring and fault prediction, combines a fault tree model and a digital twin technology, obviously reduces fault diagnosis time and operation and maintenance cost, and improves equipment operation safety and reliability.
assignees: HUANENG POWER INT INC YINGKOU POWER PLANT

title_en: Virtual power plant vehicle network resource optimal control method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual power plant vehicle network resource optimization control method and system based on digital twin, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent power network resource optimization, the method comprises the steps of collecting video stream data and battery state data, extracting physical connection stability characteristics, thermal stress characteristics and energy state characteristics, and carrying out dynamic clustering on the electric automobile to form a resource cluster, taking the resource cluster as an intelligent agent, constructing a digital twin collaborative optimization model based on a multi-intelligent-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm, and generating a charge and discharge control instruction. According to the invention, the physical connection reliability is assessed by introducing computer vision, the battery health state is assessed by combining with the network of the gate control circulation unit, the comprehensive perception of the vehicle state is realized, the problems of scheduling execution failure and accelerated decay of the battery life caused by incomplete state assessment in the prior art are solved by the collaborative optimization of dynamic clustering and multi-agent deep reinforcement learning, and the safety, accuracy and reliability of vehicle network resource optimization control are improved.

title_en: Digital twinning-based full life cycle management method and system for electric power project
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of engineering management, and particularly relates to a full life cycle management method and system of an electric power project based on digital twinning, which are used for solving the technical problems of digital twinning and construction plan disjointing, lack of real-time data-driven risk assessment and permanent data capitalization mechanism, and the management method comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring a construction plan of a task unit and a digital twinning model; S2, establishing an association relation between a task unit and a component, S3, calculating vector deviation between a field entity state and a digital twin model target state, calculating a risk coefficient of the component, forming a dynamic construction plan, S4, carrying out structured packaging and hash linking on the vector deviation, the risk coefficient, a quality acceptance result and resource consumption data, and generating construction process data bound with the component. The method overcomes the defect of the disjoint of the planning and the model in the traditional management, can predict and avoid the space and resource conflict possibly occurring in the future, and ensures the integrity and the authenticity of the process data.

title_en: Intelligent early warning and self-adaptive regulation and control platform driven by digital twinning of water affair system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy project intellectualization, and discloses an intelligent early warning and self-adaptive regulation and control platform for digital twin driving of a water service system, which comprises the following steps of collecting multi-source data related to the operation of the water service system through Internet of things equipment to generate a data set with a uniform format; the method comprises the steps of integrating multi-source data through a cross-domain data fusion engine to generate a fusion feature set, analyzing causal relations among variables in the multi-source data through a time sequence causal reasoning engine to generate a dynamic causal graph, optimizing a system operation mode through information interaction among nodes to generate distributed cognitive data, generating a state graph of a water service system through a synchronous state graph visualization engine based on a topological network and the dynamic causal graph, generating a regulation command according to a multi-target cooperative regulation strategy, and updating the data set. According to the invention, through the cross-domain data fusion engine and the time sequence causality reasoning engine, abnormal events in the water service system can be accurately identified.
assignees: LUOYANG JINGGENGTUO TECH CO LTD;BEIJING FANGXINGYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed power generation scheduling system and method for reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed power generation dispatching system and a method for reservoir groups, in particular to the technical field of water and electricity dispatching, comprising a water and electricity digital twin model construction module, a distributed power data acquisition module, a unit power generation regulation module, a photovoltaic energy storage power generation regulation module and a distributed power load early warning module, the method has the advantages that the running stability of the high-efficiency unit is maintained by combining the excessive flow of the water turbine, the power generation output of the low-efficiency unit is improved, the energy storage and power supply are carried out by calculating the photovoltaic energy storage schedulability index and using a capacity allocation algorithm, the stability and the efficiency of power generation scheduling of the reservoir group are improved, the line load rate of each monitoring subarea of the reservoir group is evaluated, the power generation scheduling grid load is prevented, the line pressure is reflected through the load rate by multi-source power superposition, and the grid safety is improved.

title_en: Multi-source data disaster prediction and simulation method based on AI and digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides an AI and digital twin-based multi-source data disaster prediction and simulation method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency management and comprises the steps of preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous data through an edge computing node to output a standardized data set; the method comprises the steps of generating a disaster prediction result through an AI disaster prediction model based on a standardized data set, combining the disaster prediction result with a digital twin model to form a disaster simulation, generating a rescue scheme report based on the disaster prediction result and the disaster simulation, and analyzing the rescue scheme report to form an optimal scheme.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU HUALIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: AI and big data-based intelligent power equipment inspection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent power equipment inspection method and system based on AI and big data, which comprises the steps of planning an optimal path of an inspection task based on a pre-built digital twin model of the power equipment, controlling the inspection equipment to collect multi-mode operation data of the power equipment according to the optimal path, carrying out de-duplication, normalization and labeling pretreatment on the multi-mode operation data to obtain fusion data, carrying out feature extraction to obtain a plurality of candidate operation features of the power equipment, screening the plurality of candidate operation features based on a pre-built knowledge graph to obtain a plurality of target operation features of the power equipment, inputting the plurality of target operation features into the pre-built anomaly monitoring model to carry out anomaly detection to obtain anomaly information of the power equipment, realizing collaborative processing on the multi-mode data, reducing the data dimension, improving the inspection efficiency and improving the reliability of inspection results.
assignees: HUANENG XINDIAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Large power grid operation real-time scheduling method based on model predictive control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large power grid operation real-time scheduling method based on model predictive control, which relates to the technical field of intelligent control and comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on historical operation data and weather predictive information of a power grid to generate fusion feature data, generating power grid load predictive data through a deep learning predictive model, calculating voltage phasors, line power flows and frequency deviations of power grid nodes based on the preprocessed power grid operation data to generate a power grid state estimation result, utilizing the power grid state estimation result to identify potential abnormal modes through a machine learning algorithm to generate a power grid early warning signal, evaluating complexity and constraint tensioning degree of scheduling problems according to the power grid early warning signal and the power grid state estimation result to generate an optimizer selection result, and carrying out preprocessing, deep learning load prediction, high-precision state estimation and model predictive control by fusing multi-source data to quickly generate reliable control instructions, so that comprehensive improvement of safety, instantaneity and adaptability is realized.
assignees: HUANENG YIMIN COAL & ELECTRICITY CO LTD;NORTHEAST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network state estimation method and system in the technical field of power distribution networks, and the method comprises the following steps of establishing a power distribution network state estimation model comprising a state equation and a measurement equation, carrying out state prediction based on the state equation to obtain a state prediction value and an error covariance prediction matrix, carrying out measurement prediction to obtain an error covariance measurement initial matrix and a cross covariance initial matrix, calculating an fading factor, updating the error covariance prediction matrix by using the fading factor to obtain an error covariance prediction adjustment matrix, carrying out measurement prediction based on the error covariance prediction adjustment matrix to obtain an error covariance measurement update matrix and a cross covariance update matrix, carrying out state estimation update, and updating an observation noise covariance based on an update result, thereby solving the problems that the existing power distribution network state estimation method cannot accurately model unknown noise, is difficult to effectively track the rapid change of a system, and the estimation accuracy and the robustness are obviously reduced.
assignees: KERUN INTELLIGENT CONTROL CO LTD
