The method comprises the steps of collecting environmental data and motion data of workers through a multi-mode sensing network deployed on a construction site, carrying out time synchronization and noise self-adaption fusion on the motion data and the environmental data at edge computing nodes to generate a three-dimensional space position, constructing a graph structure according to the three-dimensional space position by taking the workers as nodes and the space relation between the workers and environmental entities as edges, coupling a multi-head attention mechanism to capture a time sequence behavior evolution rule, outputting a behavior track of a preset period, mapping the real-time position and a predicted track to a digital twin platform, carrying out space matching with construction task nodes, rendering task progress, and calculating risk scores according to the behavior track and construction progress deviation. The method realizes a mechanism for separating the dynamic graph structure from the space-time characteristics, and reduces the prediction error of the behavior track.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR WISDOM BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power plant digital handover method based on three-dimensional digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital handover method of a power plant based on three-dimensional digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of power plant construction and operation and comprises the steps of utilizing three-dimensional laser scanning and photogrammetry technology to acquire all-dimensional data of the power plant in the power plant construction stage and constructing a three-dimensional digital twinning model; integrating and correlating the collected design drawing, equipment parameters and construction record data with a three-dimensional digital twin model to form a complete digital asset, checking the digital asset data to ensure the accuracy and the integrity of the data, optimizing the data according to the requirement, transferring the optimized digital asset data to an operator after the construction of a power plant is completed, realizing the real-time updating and sharing of the data through a data sharing platform, and carrying out equipment management, fault diagnosis and emergency plan formulation by utilizing the three-dimensional digital twin model in the operation stage of the power plant and maintaining and updating the model according to the requirement.
assignees: SOUTHWEST ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP;SICHUAN INVEST ZIYANG GAS POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Biomass power plant full life cycle optimization management system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application discloses a biomass power plant full life cycle optimization management system based on digital twin, which comprises a data acquisition module, a digital twin construction module, a full life cycle optimization module, a collaborative decision module and an edge calculation module, wherein the data acquisition module comprises a raw material component laser spectrometer and a boiler pipe wall acoustic emission sensor which are deployed on the power plant site. The method and the device can verify the rationality of equipment layout in the design stage, shorten the construction period, dynamically optimize combustion parameters through multi-source data fusion from raw materials to equipment to the environment in the operation stage, improve the power generation efficiency, predict faults in advance and reduce non-stop loss through the arrangement of the digital twin body construction module, the full life cycle optimization module and the collaborative decision module, integrate raw material traceability data and real-time emission monitoring, automatically generate a compliance carbon report, and further reduce the authentication cost.
assignees: NONGAN BIOMASS POWER PLANT OF HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power safety valve remote monitoring and fault diagnosis method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a nuclear power safety valve remote monitoring and fault diagnosis method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-modal data through a sensor array, preprocessing the multi-modal data and extracting characteristics to obtain multiple characteristics of the multi-modal data, predicting the fault type of the nuclear power safety valve based on the multiple characteristics and a CNN-LSTM hybrid model to obtain a preliminary fault type prediction result, carrying out fuzzy logic optimization on the preliminary fault type prediction result to obtain a final fault type prediction result and carrying out real-time warning according to the final fault type prediction result, acquiring relevant parameters of a parameterized three-dimensional digital twin model of the nuclear power safety valve in real time, updating the data of the parameterized three-dimensional digital twin model of the nuclear power safety valve through the relevant parameters, and visualizing operation and maintenance information of a fault position corresponding to the final fault type prediction result through the parameterized three-dimensional digital twin model of the nuclear power safety valve, so that accuracy and comprehensiveness of fault prediction and operation and maintenance assistance are improved.
assignees: HUANENG NUCLEAR ENERGY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;BEIJING AEROSPACE PETROCHEMICAL TECH & EQUIPMENT ENGINEERING CORP LTD;HUANENG GROUP TECH INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Sudden disaster deduction method by utilizing digital twin model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a sudden disaster deduction method by utilizing a digital twin model, which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data deduced from the sudden disaster, collecting each monitoring data in each time period, acquiring a characteristic sequence of each group of data, calculating a stepwise change characteristic value of each monitoring data, acquiring a significant data change characteristic value of each monitoring data in each time period, further acquiring similarity judgment distances among different monitoring data samples, carrying out clustering division on all monitoring data samples, carrying out filtering processing on the monitoring data in each clustering cluster by combining a filtering algorithm, constructing a three-dimensional solid model by using various monitoring data after the filtering processing through a modeling tool, and deducing the sudden disaster after correction. The application can improve the accuracy of deduction of sudden disasters.
assignees: SOUDAO INFORMATION TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating stability of roof of open pit coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method and system for stability of a roof of an opencast coal mine, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence and comprise the steps of generating a spiral flight path based on parameter configuration instructions and boundary coordinates of a goaf of the opencast coal mine, collecting point cloud and acoustic emission data, generating a three-dimensional digital twin model through coordinate conversion and geological drilling data fusion, dividing a dynamic monitoring grid based on the three-dimensional digital twin model, deploying multiple types of sensors, fusing stress, displacement and microseismic data, outputting a space-time fusion data set, reading the space-time fusion data set, inverting rock rheological parameters, extracting main stress deflection rate, fractal dimension and strain energy mutation index, predicting stability probability through a long-short term memory neural network, combining pre-stored early warning thresholds, and outputting final early warning level and dangerous area coordinate sets.
assignees: YANKUANG ENERGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Substation switching operation risk pre-control method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substation switching operation risk pre-control method and system based on deep reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of power system automation, and comprises the steps of collecting substation equipment data in real time, processing the collected data to generate a standardized time sequence data set, constructing a system topological structure represented by multiple graphs based on the processed data, integrating dynamic characteristics, based on a system topology structure, generating a switching operation decision sequence, dynamically adjusting a risk boundary threshold value, evaluating the safety of the decision sequence based on a real-time system state, intercepting the operation which does not accord with the safety boundary, attributing rewards to the contribution of operation sequence steps, constructing a digital twin environment, and improving the performance of a model through the interactive calibration of real data and analog data. According to the substation switching operation risk pre-control method based on deep reinforcement learning, high-precision risk prediction, sufficient early warning time and optimized operation sequence are achieved, and therefore safety of substation switching operation is remarkably improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Fault intelligent handling method and system based on multi-mode data fusion and power grid topology constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault intelligent treatment method and a fault intelligent treatment system based on multi-mode data fusion and power grid topology constraint, wherein the method comprises the steps of data acquisition, and comprehensive sensing of the running state of a power grid is performed through various data sources; the data preprocessing comprises text data processing, time sequence data processing and topology data processing, multi-mode feature fusion, multi-mode data fusion through a hierarchical attention mechanism, reinforcement learning strategy generation and rewarding function design, digital twin platform construction, real-time simulation and monitoring, strategy feedback and closed-loop optimization, wherein the system comprises a fusion history fault case, real-time monitoring data, equipment parameters and external environment information. The method improves the stability and the operation reliability of the power grid, realizes the deep mining of the operation information of the power grid, dynamically optimizes the power grid fault handling strategy, and ensures the reliability and the timeliness of the strategy in practical application.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Digital twinning-based charging pile power network fault monitoring and positioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based charging pile power network fault monitoring and positioning method, and relates to the technical field of power system fault diagnosis. The method comprises the steps of constructing a charging pile power network topology static model and a charging pile equipment dynamic model, simulating real-time running states of equipment, constructing a charging pile fault detection data model, and defining fault characteristics and data mapping. And the model is integrated to establish a digital twin body of the electric power network of the charging pile, so that dynamic virtual mapping of the physical network is realized. Based on the digital twin body, a charging pile fault positioning data model is constructed, and fault signals and topology positions are associated. And when the fault occurs, calling a fault positioning data model, and combining the network topological relation to rapidly and accurately position the fault charging pile. According to the invention, through a digital twin technology of multi-model collaboration, the real-time performance and the positioning accuracy of fault monitoring of the charging pile network are remarkably improved.
assignees: Marketing Service Center of State Grid Henan Electric Power Company;HEBI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent property electric power energy consumption analysis method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a smart property electric power consumption analysis method, a system and a medium, which comprise the following steps of S1, preprocessing multi-mode data, collecting 6-dimensional electric power data through a sliding window, extracting time sequence characteristics through 1-D-CNN, splicing with original data, generating 128-dimensional value embedding through GRAPHSAGE, simultaneously extracting text semantic embedding through RoBERTa, S2, performing cross-mode fusion modeling process, constructing a cross-attention distillation tower, aligning and fusing numerical value embedding and text embedding through a multi-head attention mechanism, outputting 128-dimensional unified embedding, normalizing through L2 and representing as a map node, S3, performing map persistence storage, establishing cosine similarity vector indexes, supporting efficient approximate nearest neighbor ANN query, S4, completing real-time updating and operation and maintenance, realizing millisecond-level embedding updating through dynamic threshold triggering increment updating, combining Flink stream processing and optimistic lock transactions, reserving a differential chain and a snapshot, and supporting quick rollback and a block chain.
assignees: CHONGQING JIUQI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for filling electric power and economic data missing value
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for filling electric power and economic data missing values, which comprise the steps of collecting electric power data of a power distribution network and economic data generated by market transaction of the electric power data, preprocessing the electric power data and the economic data, constructing a data sample of the preprocessed data based on a time stamp of continuous loss of the data, initializing the preprocessed data to obtain first data, presetting a missing data repair model, dynamically predicting missing values based on the first data and a time dimension and a variable dimension by the missing data repair model, and obtaining a final filling result through iterative optimization. Through the forward and backward dependency relationship of the synchronous modeling time sequence data of the improved bidirectional circulating neural network algorithm, the periodic fluctuation of the power load curve, the intermittent characteristic of new energy output and the abrupt correlation of economic indexes are dynamically captured, and missing values in the power and economic data are effectively processed, so that the accuracy and the integrity of the data are improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Escape method, device, equipment and storage medium for linkage of household equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for escape by linkage of household equipment. The household equipment is provided with a geomagnetic sensor, first geomagnetic data of the position of the household equipment detected by the geomagnetic sensor of the household equipment, a moving track detected by a mobile terminal of a user and second geomagnetic data of a plurality of positions corresponding to the moving track are obtained, a magnetic map of an indoor space of the user is constructed according to the first geomagnetic data, the second geomagnetic data and the moving track, and when a disaster event is detected, an escape scheme is generated according to the magnetic map of the indoor space of the user. The magnetic map is generated by combining geomagnetic data of household equipment, a user motion track and geomagnetic data of a user position, automatic construction and real-time updating of the magnetic map are achieved, comprehensive escape guidance is provided for family members, magnetic field environments are dynamically learned in a disaster process, and escape guidance with high-precision positioning is completed.
assignees: GREE ELECTRIC APPLIANCES INC ZHUHAI;ZHUHAI LEAYUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Health state evaluation method and system for power distribution control equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a health state evaluation method and a system of power distribution control equipment, which relate to the technical field of power distribution control equipment and comprise the steps of utilizing a space-time coding network to align cross-mode data and extracting characteristic parameters from the aligned multi-source data; the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model, analyzing different operation modes of equipment by combining characteristic parameters and a working condition simulation engine, establishing a multidimensional characteristic baseline matrix, establishing a health state reference standard according to design parameters, predicting a degradation track of the equipment by utilizing a deep learning network, acquiring a health state evaluation result by combining a multidimensional evaluation index fusion algorithm with the health state reference standard, mapping the health state evaluation result to the digital twin model, displaying the health state of the equipment in real time by using a visualization tool, and generating a health state evaluation report of the equipment based on the health state. The invention can effectively eliminate fusion deviation caused by sensor isomerism and provides more reliable technical support for equipment health management.
assignees: JIANGSU SEN HAI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Resource scheduling method and system based on water service data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent resource scheduling method and system based on water service data, which are characterized in that the real-time collection and pretreatment of multi-mode water service data are realized through edge computing nodes, the data quality and safety are ensured by adopting a self-adaptive sampling strategy and differential privacy protection, the non-falsification and evidence storage of water quality data are realized, the accurate prediction of water consumption in a partition is realized through a space-time rolling and gating attention mechanism by adopting a demand prediction model based on a space-time graph neural network, an improved multi-target particle swarm algorithm is adopted, the water supply stability, the energy consumption minimization and leakage loss inhibition are taken as targets, an optimal scheduling scheme is screened by combining dynamic inertia weight and fuzzy membership functions, virtual deduction is carried out by a digital twin system, the pressure abnormality is visualized, an intervention strategy is recommended, the operation of a pump set is optimized by combining a time-of-use electricity price strategy, and the addition of a medicament is dynamically adjusted based on the water quality prediction. The method can improve the water supply stability, reduce the energy consumption and the leakage rate, and obviously improve the reliability and the economy of the water service system.

title_en: Visual management method based on digital twin power distribution operation flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual management method based on a digital twin power distribution operation flow, which particularly relates to the technical field of digital twin, and is characterized in that variable characteristic data are generated by constructing a virtual three-dimensional scene of the power distribution operation flow, time sequence deviation data are generated based on time sequence consistency of an ideal state switching sequence and an actual state switching sequence of variable characteristic data detection equipment, time-space correspondence between an ideal moving track and an actual moving track of an operator is detected, time-space deviation data are generated, comprehensive matching degree between the virtual three-dimensional scene and an actual power distribution site is estimated according to the time sequence deviation data and the time-space deviation data, the virtual three-dimensional scene is dynamically adjusted, an updated visual management interface of the power distribution operation flow is output, high-precision dynamic matching between a digital twin model and the actual power distribution operation site is realized, and visual precision, risk management capability and decision instantaneity and reliability of the power distribution operation flow are effectively improved.
assignees: NANJING YADI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-driven multi-objective optimization urban water system monitoring network deployment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-driven multi-objective optimization urban water system monitoring network deployment method, which integrates GIS, real-time sensors, meteorological and historical hydrologic data, constructs a dynamic hydraulic-water quality coupling model, outputs pipe section hydraulic-water quality parameters and fault probability, generates a spectral clustering similarity matrix based on the dynamic hydraulic-water quality coupling model, fuses pipe section dynamic characteristics and fault probability weights, divides a risk level functional area, feeds clustering results back to a digital twin-model verification, re-calibrates the similarity matrix and iterates the clustering if the partition does not pass an extreme working condition, triggers NSGA-II multi-objective optimization if the partition does not pass the extreme working condition, and combines partition risk level allocation weights to output a sensor deployment scheme. And verifying the omission ratio through digital twin simulation, dynamically adjusting the target weight and re-optimizing until reaching the standard and outputting a final scheme. The invention forms a closed loop of 'simulation-dimension reduction-optimization-verification', realizes dynamic adjustment of the sensor layout, and can effectively reduce the deployment cost.

title_en: Power system bad data identification method and system suitable for multiple types of errors
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system state estimation, in particular to a method and a system for identifying bad data of a power system, which are suitable for multiple types of errors, and the method provided by the invention comprises the steps of initially screening measured and topological bad data based on a Lagrange multiplier method, screening out suspicious measured and topological bad data, the problem that the solving efficiency is low due to excessive model integer variables is solved, the identification of measurement and topology errors is realized based on an MINLP optimization model, the identification and correction of measurement standard inverse data are realized, the limitation of the traditional method in poor-tolerance performance is solved, and technical support is provided for realizing multi-source data checking and repairing of an electric power system. The bad data identification method of the electric power system can give consideration to processing measurement and topology errors, effectively avoid the problems of missed judgment and misjudgment possibly caused by the traditional method, correct and retain bad data with the quantity measurement standard reflection, avoid losing the observability of the system and ensure the operation safety and stability of the electric power system.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multistage anchoring and locking system of fire-fighting robot for high-rise building and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multistage anchoring locking system of a fire-fighting robot for a high-rise building and a control method thereof, wherein the multistage anchoring locking system comprises an intelligent sensing unit, an intelligent control unit, an energy supply communication redundancy unit, an integrated ground power supply, microwave power transmission, a super capacitor and a laser communication module, and is used for collecting surface resistivity, guided wave signals, anchoring pretightening force, temperature and robot gesture data of an operation wall surface in real time, a three-stage anchoring executing mechanism, which comprises an SMA dynamic anchor bolt, a magneto-rheological clamping piece lock and an gunpowder brake anchor, and realizing dynamic anchoring force adjustment through a grading triggering logic, an intelligent control unit, which is used for supporting multi-mode energy supply and anti-interference communication, and executing surface risk prejudgment, anchoring strategy decision and real-time safety monitoring based on a digital twin model and multi-sensor fusion algorithm. The invention realizes high reliability through three-level anchoring redundancy, multi-mode energy supply and double-channel fuze.
assignees: SUIREN FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for energy management platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for an energy management platform, which relate to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance and comprise the steps of using an NLP technology to analyze data and generate a multi-objective optimization function, constructing a user behavior portrait, using a reinforcement learning algorithm to combine with an Actor strategy network to adjust weight parameters of the multi-objective function, using an improved bald eagle searching algorithm and a hunting-object escape energy mechanism to obtain an energy scheduling scheme, constructing a digital twin model mapped by a physical space and a virtual space, and optimizing the energy scheduling scheme and implementing the energy scheduling scheme by combining the digital twin model with a soft constraint mechanism. Through the fusion of the NLP technology semantic analysis and the reinforcement learning algorithm, the multi-objective scheduling strategy is dynamically optimized, and the simulation verification and closed-loop feedback are realized by combining the improved hawk search algorithm and the digital twin model, so that the intelligent and optimization level of the operation of the energy system is improved, and the stability, the economy and the low-carbon operation capability of the system are also improved.

title_en: Situation awareness method, device, equipment and medium of electrochemical energy storage system
abstract_en: The application discloses a situation awareness method, a device, equipment and a medium of an electrochemical energy storage system, which relate to the field of power grid management and comprise the steps of collecting operation data of a battery in the electrochemical energy storage system in a charge-discharge period, and constructing a battery operation database by combining with local laboratory battery aging actual measurement data; the battery operation database comprises a state evolution data set, a feature mapping model from a single level to a module level is determined by extracting first aging feature information of a battery and inconsistent feature information of a battery module based on the battery operation database, a battery pack power state estimation model under multiple constraint conditions is determined based on a preset hybrid neural network model, second aging feature information of the battery module and an equivalent circuit model, and a situation sensing result is determined based on the feature mapping model and the battery pack power state estimation model. The method can realize accurate state sensing of the whole life cycle of the energy storage system aiming at the scene that the energy storage system frequently participates in power grid regulation and control.

title_en: Three-dimensional air-ground linkage reservoir inspection disposal system based on unmanned aerial vehicle and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional air-ground linkage reservoir inspection disposal system based on unmanned aerial vehicles and digital twins, which has the advantages that the adopted digital twins three-dimensional simulation, unmanned aerial vehicle omnibearing monitoring inspection and air-ground linkage inspection disposal closed-loop reservoir inspection disposal system utilizes unmanned aerial vehicles to return real-time pictures, realizes real-time sharing and display analysis of data based on digital twins reservoir area scenes, timely reports engineering hidden danger and illegal events and disposes the closed-loop, effectively solves the problems of the traditional inspection mode of short response speed, analysis lag and longer period, provides powerful technical support for reservoir operation management, and plays an important role in guaranteeing reservoir safe operation and timely handling various abnormal events.
assignees: NINGBO WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: 5G communication intelligent hydrant water taking bolt remote control system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the crossing field of communication technology and fire-fighting Internet of things, discloses a 5G communication intelligent fire hydrant water hydrant remote control system and method, and aims to solve the problems of high communication delay, limited bandwidth, emergency control failure and single state perception of the existing system. The method comprises the steps that a front-end terminal collects multidimensional state data and performs edge intelligent processing, a control instruction and a video stream are respectively transmitted through a 5G dual-network slice, a cloud platform performs simulation verification and predictive maintenance based on a digital twin model and issues an accurate positioning control instruction, and a terminal executing mechanism realizes millimeter-level valve adjustment through closed-loop servo control. The system comprises a multidimensional sensing module, a high-precision electro-hydraulic actuating mechanism, an edge computing unit, a 5G double-slice communication module and a cloud digital twin platform. The application realizes ultra-low time delay, high reliability, high precision remote control and comprehensive state sensing, and remarkably improves the safety and intelligent level of the fire-fighting water supply network.
assignees: SHANGHAI WEIYUAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-voltage area load identification method and system based on density self-adaptive clustering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-voltage area load identification method and system based on density self-adaptive clustering, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a low-voltage area digital twin body operation frame comprising a physical layer, a data layer and a service layer, wherein the physical layer is used for acquiring electric measurement data, environment monitoring data and user behavior data of an area in real time to obtain multi-source heterogeneous data; the system comprises a data layer, a service layer, a density self-adaptive K-means clustering algorithm, a power time sequence curve and an index analysis, wherein the data layer is used for carrying out fusion processing of multi-source heterogeneous data, the service layer is used for carrying out intelligent decision management of a platform region, carrying out multi-dimensional feature extraction on the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain high-dimensional features, carrying out cluster analysis according to the high-dimensional features by adopting the density self-adaptive K-means clustering algorithm, dividing load curves of a low-voltage platform region into different categories, and outputting power time sequence curves of various loads according to classification results to carry out index analysis. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of realizing intelligent decision management of the platform area, being stable and reliable and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Urban fire emergency linkage command system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency linkage and discloses a digital twinning-based urban fire emergency linkage command system and method, wherein the system comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition module for acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data of multiple departments in real time; the intelligent decision module is used for coupling a fire diffusion prediction result of a fluid dynamics equation and a building risk prediction result of a finite element analysis model to generate a fire control power dispatching instruction, a medical rescue distribution instruction and a traffic control instruction, and the multi-department linkage execution module is used for sending the fire control power dispatching instruction to a fire control terminal, sending the medical rescue distribution instruction to the medical terminal and sending the traffic control instruction to a traffic terminal so as to realize cross-department dynamic collaborative dispatching. The invention improves the emergency response speed and the decision accuracy, realizes the efficient coordination of urban fire emergency rescue, and remarkably enhances the rescue efficiency and the capability of coping with complex fire scenes.
assignees: ZHONGSHENG CHUANGTONG XINXIANG DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-carbon regulation and control method, system, equipment and storage medium for computing load of data center
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of low-carbon regulation of a data center, and finally achieves the aim of industrial carbon neutralization, and provides a low-carbon regulation method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for calculating load of the data center, which solve the problems of low accuracy and low effectiveness of low-carbon regulation. The method comprises the steps of collecting real-time computing power of enterprises and real-time carbon price data of a carbon transaction market, constructing a digital twin model based on the two types of data, mapping power consumption, cold consumption and carbon emission of a data center in real time, simulating carbon emission change under a pre-imputation force scheduling strategy to generate virtual environment characteristic data by means of the digital twin model, designing a double-layer game model, enabling an upper layer unit to receive basic data and the virtual environment characteristic data to determine a final carbon quota allocation proportion, and enabling a lower layer unit to dynamically adjust power supply voltage and frequency of electric equipment to achieve low-carbon regulation of computing load of the data center, and improving accuracy and effectiveness of low-carbon regulation of computing load of the data center.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE OF ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT PROT

title_en: Distribution network fixed value setting and checking method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for setting and checking a fixed value of a distribution network, and relates to the technical field of power automation and relay protection. The method comprises the steps of calculating action values of all sections of overcurrent according to the action values, determining zero sequence protection values of different grounding networks by combining topology parameters, setting differential delay parameters of a primary switch and a secondary switch, activating a short-time voltage-loss locking and switching-off function, constructing a digital twin model for checking, and finally issuing the checked values to a protection device to execute cooperative action. Through differential time delay, digital twin check and the like, the protection self-adaption and reliability are improved, the power outage range is reduced, and the stable operation of the power distribution network is ensured.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-oriented multi-source fusion substation fault detection method and system
abstract_en: A digital twinning-oriented multi-source fusion substation fault detection method and system belong to the technical field of power system fault detection. The invention collects basic data, including gas characteristic data, environment characteristic data and electric characteristic data of a transformer substation, carries out cross-modal characteristic fusion, adopts a time alignment mechanism to ensure data synchronization of different sampling rates, realizes time alignment through cubic spline interpolation, builds a CNN-LSTM neural network model based on a self-adaptive multi-modal attention mechanism, carries out training by utilizing a multi-source fusion transformer substation fault detection data set facing digital twinning to obtain a trained CNN-LSTM fault detection model based on the self-adaptive multi-modal attention mechanism, builds a digital twinning model, and carries out digital twinning-oriented multi-source fusion transformer substation fault detection, wherein the physical entity model comprises a 3D transformer entity model and a transformer mechanism model.
assignees: HEIHE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: AI-based real-time power quality control system and method for high-efficiency energy operation
title_ko: 고효율 에너지 운용을 위한 ai 기반 실시간 전력 품질 제어 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 고효율 에너지 운용을 위한 AI 기반 실시간 전력 품질 제어 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 
전압 안정성, 무효전력 흐름, 고조파 왜율(THD) 등 복수의 전력 품질 요소를 통합적으로 최적화하고, 에너지 손실을 최소화하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 
본 시스템은 신호 분석부를 통해 실시간 전압 및 전류 데이터를 수집하고, FFT 또는 DQ 변환을 수행하여 품질 요소를 추출하며, 확장형 칼만 필터(EKF)를 이용한 상태 추정을 통해 잡음 보정과 예측 기반의 신뢰도 높은 내부 상태 추정을 수행한다. 
분석된 품질 지표에 따라 제어 우선순위를 판단하고, 목적 함수 기반으로 다중 품질 요소를 통합 고려하여 실시간 최적 제어를 수행한다. 
이 제어 연산은 ADMM 기반 병렬 최적화 구조를 통해 구현되며, 분산형 시스템에서도 전체 시스템의 에너지 손실을 최소화하고 전력 품질을 향상시킨다. 
기존의 전압 유지 중심의 정적 제어 방식과 달리, 본 발명은 AI 기반 예측 제어를 통해 보다 지능적이고 통합적인 전력 에너지 운용 효과를 제공한다. 
(This invention relates to an AI-based real-time power quality control system and method for high-efficiency energy operation. 
It aims to comprehensively optimize multiple power quality factors-such as voltage stability, reactive power flow, and total harmonic distortion (THD)-while minimizing overall energy loss. 
The proposed system collects real-time voltage and current data through a signal analysis unit, performs FFT or DQ transformation to extract power quality indicators,and applies Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) techniques for noise compensation and predictive, high-confidence internal state estimation. 
Based on the analyzed quality metrics, the system determines control priorities and executes real-time optimal control using a multi-objective function that integrates multiple quality factors. 
This control logic is implemented using a parallel optimization structure based on the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM), 
minimizing energy losses and improving power quality even in distributed power systems. 
Unlike conventional voltage-centric static control methods, the present invention offers a more intelligent and integrated approach to power and energy management through AI-based predictive control.)
assignees: PQ TECH INC

title_en: Cascade reservoir flood control reservoir capacity collaborative optimization method and system based on dynamic game
abstract_en: The application relates to a cascade reservoir flood control reservoir capacity collaborative optimization method and system based on dynamic games, which belong to the technical field of flood control and regulation of hydropower stations and comprise the steps of collecting historical water level sequences of cascade reservoir groups, upstream flood discharge flow, drainage basin precipitation convergence data, radar flood measurement data, dam stress indexes and dynamic association parameters, inputting space-time risk fields into a space-time risk field model, constructing a space-time risk field, constructing a game model based on the space-time risk field, taking an upstream reservoir as a leader, dynamically adjusting a flood discharge scheme for a follower according to the leader policy, coordinating flood control targets with economic targets through time-varying game weights, solving the game model by adopting an improved distributed ADMM optimization algorithm to generate scheduling instructions, verifying the legitimacy of the scheduling instructions through blockchain intelligent contracts, pre-executing the scheduling instructions in a digital twin simulation platform, dynamically calibrating mapping parameters of a physical reservoir and a virtual mirror image through reinforcement learning, generating final scheduling instructions and performing down-delivery.
assignees: AOSTAR INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based source network load storage fault diagnosis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based source network load storage fault diagnosis method and system, which comprise the steps of S1, collecting source network load storage multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a panoramic synchronous time sequence database with a unified time scale by adopting a column storage and time partition combined architecture, S2, obtaining a SSTGNN physical enhancement digital twinning body with enhanced physical information by combining a space-time diagram neural network SSTGNN in the digital twinning body and embedding a physical loss constraint function based on the panoramic synchronous time sequence database, S3, obtaining a vulnerability map by calculating state prediction errors of all nodes based on the SSTGNN physical enhancement digital twinning body, S4, obtaining a fault source node by performing inverse facts reasoning based on the vulnerability map, and generating a predictive diagnosis report by performing fault diagnosis based on the fault source node.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHIYUAN ENGINEERING MAN CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based park micro-grid energy management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based park micro-grid energy management system and method, comprising a distributed power supply, an energy storage system, an environment updating module, an electricity price updating module, a charging pile and a grid connection point terminal, wherein the environment updating module is used for monitoring the environment in a park; the distributed power supply is responsible for supplying power to the power grid connection point terminals in the park, providing renewable energy power, and dynamically regulating the output by environmental parameters; the energy storage system stabilizes power fluctuation, realizes time shifting arbitrage, ensures system stability, combines power consumption data and power generation data in a park through substitution of the power consumption model, effectively improves the utilization rate of overall resources, simultaneously carries out coincidence analysis on the power consumption condition of each terminal, can carry out real-time monitoring and control on the electric terminals of each load, and effectively avoids waste of power resources through overall sheathing of a large model.
assignees: YANCHENG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Wind-solar equipment predictive maintenance system and method based on big data and layered weights
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind-solar equipment predictive maintenance system and method based on big data and layered weights. The system comprises a data acquisition and edge processing layer, a data management and storage layer, a layered weight analysis and model construction layer and a fault prediction and intelligent decision layer. The multi-source data are collected through deployment of various sensors, and are transmitted to a cloud for deep cleaning and storage after being preprocessed through edge calculation. And determining index weights of all levels by utilizing an improved algorithm, and building a fault prediction model by fusing a plurality of intelligent algorithms. The model combines real-time data and layering weight, predicts the fault probability, type and residual service life of equipment parts, and gives an alarm when the threshold value is exceeded. Meanwhile, a multi-objective optimization model is constructed according to the fault prediction result to formulate a maintenance strategy, and the maintenance strategy is executed after digital twin prediction, so that the operation and maintenance efficiency is improved. The invention realizes multi-source data fusion, accurate fault prediction and intelligent maintenance decision, and can effectively reduce operation and maintenance cost and improve equipment reliability and power generation efficiency.
assignees: HUADIAN XINNENG XINJIANG MULEI NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for measuring uncertainty of power distribution network data identification and state estimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for identifying power distribution network data and measuring uncertainty of state estimation, which comprises the steps of respectively constructing a power distribution network bad data identification model based on CNN-BiLSTM and a power distribution network running state estimation and uncertainty measurement model based on GCNN, then integrating the two modules of the bad running data identification and the state estimation and the uncertainty measurement, wherein CNN-BiLSTM is responsible for front-end data cleaning, identification and correction, and GCNN is responsible for carrying out high-precision state estimation and uncertainty quantification after the front-end data cleaning, identification and correction. According to the invention, by constructing a double-task collaborative work and joint optimization integral model, two problems of identification of operation key data and uncertainty measurement of state estimation of the power distribution network are comprehensively considered, and two core tasks are tightly combined to form a complete data processing and task execution link, so that the data quality, the state estimation reliability and the capability of coping with distributed power supply output fluctuation are effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;TIANSHUI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Active power distribution network pseudo measurement generation method based on information entropy weighting support vector machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active power distribution network pseudo-measurement generation method based on an information entropy weighting support vector machine, which comprises the steps of obtaining a historical measurement data set of a power distribution network, calculating multi-dimensional information entropy reflecting data fluctuation, generating self-adaptive weights according to multi-dimensional information entropy calculation results, constructing a support vector machine model adopting a weighting multi-scale kernel function, training the support vector machine model by using the historical measurement data set as input to generate pseudo-measurement data of a target node, performing probability density fitting on errors between the pseudo-measurement data and real load data by using a Gaussian mixture model, establishing a pseudo-measurement error model, and determining the final weight of each pseudo-measurement data according to the pseudo-measurement error model. The invention effectively improves the accuracy and reliability of the pseudo measurement data, solves the problem of incomplete state information caused by insufficient measurement equipment in the power distribution network, and provides accurate data support for power distribution network state estimation under the condition of incomplete information.

title_en: Power load prediction analysis system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load prediction analysis system and a power load prediction analysis method based on big data, which relate to the technical field of power load analysis and comprise a data statistics module, a period marking module, a power load data classification module, a response filling demand model construction module, a data type division module, a scene characteristic output module, a filling data set generation module and a real-time response filling module; by classifying the missing data according to the missing reasons and introducing three quantization indexes of the output data completion ratio, the output data stability ratio and the prediction accuracy value, the influence of different types of missing data on the prediction result can be accurately estimated, the 'one-cut' estimation blind area in the traditional technology is avoided, and a scientific basis is provided for the subsequent filling decision.

title_en: Industrial Internet power plant equipment predictive maintenance system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power plant equipment maintenance, in particular to a digital twin-based industrial Internet power plant equipment predictive maintenance system. The invention comprises a device data acquisition unit, a digital twin construction unit, a state prediction unit, a maintenance strategy generation unit and a dynamic adjustment unit. The equipment data acquisition unit acquires real-time operation data of multiple equipment, a multidimensional data set is formed through time alignment and space registration, the digital twin construction unit performs sparse reconstruction on the data set to obtain target data and abnormal indication data, the state prediction unit combines the target data, the historical maintenance record and the operation parameters to generate a health state prediction result containing residual service life and fault occurrence probability, the maintenance strategy generation unit generates a scheme containing maintenance priority and a time window according to the health state prediction result, and the dynamic adjustment unit adjusts the scheme according to the abnormal indication data. The system realizes comprehensive monitoring, accurate prediction and dynamic maintenance of equipment.
assignees: SHENZHEN PENGRUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based high-voltage isolation switch cabinet fault diagnosis method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of switch cabinet fault diagnosis, which solves the technical problems that the prior art lacks deep mining on historical data and real-time data and cannot realize early warning of faults and accurate fault diagnosis, in particular to a digital twinning-based high-voltage isolation switch cabinet fault diagnosis method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, collecting original data of a high-voltage isolation switch cabinet, and calculating a dimension reduction value for data feature fusion according to the original data; S2, reconstructing the space-time alignment data according to the dimension reduction value to obtain a reconstruction signal, and calculating a time-frequency value based on the reconstruction signal, wherein the invention not only can automate the convolutional neural network process through the optimal search of the sparrow search algorithm, the method can systematically search in a huge super-parameter space, improves the parameter adjustment efficiency, can jump out of local optimum, find super-parameter combinations which are closer to global optimum, and greatly improves the super-parameter optimization rate of the convolutional neural network.
assignees: SHAANXI HUI QI ELECTRIC TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant integrated management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power plant data processing, in particular to a virtual power plant comprehensive management system which comprises a data acquisition module for acquiring voltage fluctuation characteristics and power climbing rate parameters of energy equipment in real time, an equipment fingerprint library construction module for generating equipment fingerprint codes comprising dynamic response time lag coefficients and adjustment margin quantized values, a dynamic clustering module for dividing a simulation sub-model of regional topological constraint based on equipment geographic positions and power adjustment threshold values, a multi-time scale prediction module for generating source load prediction data by fusing meteorological parameters through a space-time diagram convolution network, a digital twin simulation module for outputting energy storage charging and discharging thresholds and demand response priority strategies, and a cross-domain coordination module for realizing safety verification and data integrity binding of federal learning characteristic parameters by adopting a double-chain block chain architecture. According to the method, the resource aggregation precision and the response instantaneity under the new energy strong fluctuation scene are improved through the digital modeling of the equipment characteristics, the regional collaborative simulation and the multi-energy flow coupling regulation and control.
assignees: Huaneng jinan huangtai power generation co ltd;XIAN TPRI POWER STATION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Off-grid operation control method of optical storage and charging micro-grid and computer program product
abstract_en: The invention provides an off-grid operation control method of an optical storage micro-grid and a computer program product, and relates to the field of data processing. The off-grid operation control method of the optical storage and filling micro-grid comprises the steps of collecting operation state data of the optical storage and filling micro-grid, simulating and predicting that the optical storage and filling micro-grid is switched to a power balance state after off-grid operation based on the operation state data by utilizing a micro-grid digital twin body pre-configured in an edge side controller, formulating a load regulation strategy according to the power balance state, and executing the load regulation strategy after an off-grid instruction is obtained. By utilizing the scheme of the invention, the optical storage micro-grid dynamically adjusts the load adjustment strategy after off-grid according to the running state data, so that the pertinence is stronger, the equipment impact caused by directly cutting off the load is avoided, and the satisfaction degree of electricity users is improved.
assignees: QINGDAO HAIER PHOTOVOLTAIC NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Underground space digital twin system of coal mine based on numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety monitoring, and discloses a coal mine underground space digital twin system based on numerical simulation, which comprises the following modules: the multisource sensor assembly is arranged in roadway surrounding rock and used for collecting stress, displacement, anchor rod axial force and vibration data in real time. The underground space digital twin system of the coal mine based on the numerical simulation realizes the dimension crossing from single index trend analysis to full-field stress and displacement continuous evolution process prediction, and provides more comprehensive stability cognition. The model parameters are continuously updated through a dynamic self-calibration mechanism, the traditional method of relying on fixed experience values is replaced, and the long-term fidelity and the prediction accuracy of the model under complex geological conditions are remarkably improved. The system provides a visual risk map based on simulation deduction and a multi-scene simulation function, reduces the dependence on manual experience, and provides visual and scientific basis for support scheme optimization and disaster emergency decision.
assignees: SHANXI INST OF ENERGY

title_en: Multi-level space-time data processing and visualizing method for power grid faults
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-level space-time data processing and visualizing method for power grid faults, which comprises unifying space-time references, including sliding window self-adaptive interpolation and interpolation result optimization, normalizing space references, including space quantization alignment and power grid-weather coupling modeling, managing data, removing redundancy and repairing missing, including dynamic time warping de-duplication, main component analysis dimension reduction and missing data repairing, and visualizing architecture design, including a physical power grid layer, an alarm signal layer and a treatment process layer. The invention accurately captures the running state and fault characteristics of the power grid equipment through a space-time data fusion technology, provides timely and accurate fault diagnosis support, designs a hierarchical visualization architecture, enables a user to go deep into a micro equipment hierarchy layer by layer from a macroscopic power grid state, helps fault positioning and analysis to be more accurate and efficient, enhances the understanding of power grid dispatching personnel on fault situations, and realizes quick response and decision.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Fire-fighting facility safety evaluation optimization system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting equipment safety evaluation optimization system and method based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of big data. The method comprises the steps of collecting image features through a contour detection algorithm, comparing feature data of a hydrant interface with feature data of a water hose interface, carrying out adaptation, monitoring appearance states when the hydrant interface is matched with the water hose interface, constructing a water pipe network digital twin model, marking abnormal positions, simulating fire scenes, combining water pipe network distribution and water source positions, triggering a preset hierarchical supply strategy, combining the abnormal positions, abstracting to be the top points and the edges of a graph structure, constructing a weighted directed graph model, carrying out path searching in the graph structure when a certain section of water pipe is judged to be blocked in water flow, screening a standby water supply path, sending control instructions to intelligent valves on the standby water supply path by using a reinforcement learning algorithm, opening corresponding valves according to path sequences, and closing independent branches to form a closed water supply channel from the water source to a target hydrant.

title_en: Power system scheduling optimization method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system dispatching optimization method and system based on deep reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid dispatching optimization. The method comprises the steps of receiving and synchronizing real-time operation data, meteorological data, equipment health indexes and renewable energy output data, constructing a power grid diagram, generating a node time sequence matrix, encoding the node time sequence matrix into a multi-space embedded vector, generating a short-term output predicted value and an uncertainty index based on the meteorological and renewable energy output data, converting the short-term output predicted value and the uncertainty index into compensation factors, calculating risk scores according to the equipment health indexes and the meteorological data, mapping the risk scores and the dynamic weights into dynamic weights, inputting the multi-space embedded vector, the compensation factors and the dynamic weights into a deep reinforcement learning model to generate a scheduling strategy, performing feasibility verification, and transmitting the result back to an online updating model after the verification passes. According to the invention, the safety and the robustness of power system dispatching are effectively improved by fusing the multi-source data and the risk perception mechanism.
assignees: SICHUAN KUNLUN ELECTRIC POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: River mouth delta water and sand ecology cooperative regulation and control system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river mouth delta water and sand ecological cooperative regulation and control system based on a digital twin technology, which comprises a physical layer, a data layer, a model layer and an application layer, wherein environmental data in a region are continuously collected by means of a sensor network, a remote sensing technology, an unmanned aerial vehicle system and the like, a digital model is constructed by using the digital twin technology, the water and sand condition of the river mouth delta, the dynamic biophysical process and the resource transfer path of an ecological system are simulated, and an optimal water and sand regulation and control method is determined through multi-objective optimization, so that ecological benefit and economic benefit are balanced.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER ENGINEERING CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent decision method and device for realizing flood simulation and prevention by combining Cesium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster prevention and management, and particularly provides a method and a device for realizing intelligent decision making of flood simulation prevention by combining Cesium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, geographic data access; the method comprises the steps of S2, realizing real-time monitoring and analysis of hydrologic conditions, S3, constructing a flood simulation model, including hydrodynamic model construction, model parameter setting and optimization and a real-time updating mechanism, S4, unrealEngine, wherein a Chaos physical engine processes physical interaction of water flow, physical data of the Chaos are associated through modularized logic, S5, an integrated LSTM time sequence prediction model is combined with hydrologic real-time rainfall to realize flood evolution trend, S6, heatMap shows important disaster areas and disaster water level conditions, S7, identifying nearby refuge points, and scientifically and reasonably arranging emergency paths. Compared with the prior art, the invention can provide intelligent decision management for disaster pre-simulated pre-disaster prevention and post-disaster rescue recovery.

title_en: Chemical early warning method and system based on big data processing
abstract_en: The application discloses a chemical early warning method and a chemical early warning system based on big data processing, which belong to the technical field of big data processing and comprise the steps of establishing a dynamic process parameter tuning model, taking real-time production data and historical data as the input of the model, and outputting working solution generation parameters and production data tuning parameters; the method comprises the steps of collecting data, analyzing components of working fluid, grading the working fluid after analysis, establishing a cross-process working fluid resource cooperative network, constructing a digital twin model based on physical parameters and historical operation data of a production line, and dynamically simulating and monitoring a working fluid generation link in the production process by combining an AI algorithm. In the implementation process of the technical scheme, a dynamic process parameter tuning model is established, the working fluid generation parameters and the production data tuning parameters are output, and a digital twin model is combined with the dynamic process parameter tuning model to form closed-loop control, so that the early warning and monitoring effects of a chemical production line are improved.

title_en: Digital twin-based wind power short-term prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a short-term wind power prediction method and system based on digital twin, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting operation data of wind power equipment, calling a simulation algorithm to process the operation data, constructing operation simulation models of all the equipment, and updating the operation simulation models in real time by utilizing an operation scheme of the wind power equipment; the method comprises the steps of obtaining wind power data of an updated operation simulation model, inputting the wind power data into a wind power short-term prediction model to obtain a wind power short-term prediction result, wherein the wind power short-term prediction model is obtained by training an LSTM prediction model through a training set, and the training set comprises original wind power data. The method can better adapt to different wind power equipment and operation scenes, improves the generalization capability of the model, and reduces the influence of equipment difference and operation environment change on the prediction precision.
assignees: JILIN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Boundary hierarchical grid physical constraint variation assimilation method embedded into deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boundary hierarchical grid physical constraint variation assimilation method for embedding a deep neural network, which comprises the steps of establishing a momentum equation containing boundary hierarchical grid turbulence friction items, simulating the boundary layer turbulence friction items through the deep neural network, constructing weak constraint items of a variation assimilation frame cost function by using the momentum equation, training the deep neural network by using a data set constructed by a historical numerical weather forecast mode simulation result, linearizing the trained deep neural network to obtain corresponding tangential operators and accompanying operators, embedding the tangential operators and accompanying operators into the variation assimilation frame cost function, acquiring multi-source remote sensing observation data and a numerical weather forecast mode background field, and solving an analysis field by taking the cost function as a target to complete data assimilation. The invention can improve the assimilation and numerical forecast level of disaster weather data such as typhoons, and the like, in particular to the observation assimilation level related to boundary layers.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system fault identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault identification method and system for a comprehensive energy system, and relates to the field of comprehensive energy. The comprehensive energy system fault identification method and system comprise the following steps of firstly constructing a digital twin model of a comprehensive energy system, secondly simulating operation states of the comprehensive energy system under different fault types based on the digital twin model, thirdly extracting characteristics of a fault sample data set, fourthly constructing a fusion fault identification model based on a deep belief network and a support vector machine, fifthly acquiring real-time operation data of the comprehensive energy system in real time, and sixthly inputting real-time fault characteristic vectors into the trained fusion fault identification model. According to the comprehensive energy system fault identification method and system, the fault identification precision can be improved, the feature extraction is carried out through an improved principal component analysis algorithm, the feature with high correlation degree with the fault type is highlighted by introducing the self-adaptive weight factor, and the interference of irrelevant features is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY PINGDU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Production management system for coal enterprises
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of enterprise production management, in particular to a coal enterprise production management system, which comprises a data acquisition module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires environmental data in real time based on an underground sensor network, the environmental data comprises gas concentration data, roof pressure data and constructor data, a dynamic region risk thermodynamic diagram is built based on a machine learning model, the underground construction management module dynamically adjusts safety measures of a construction region based on the region risk thermodynamic diagram built by the data acquisition module, a construction task list is generated by combining geological modeling data and is distributed to a working team, the underground equipment management module builds a digital twin model of a mining machine and conveyor belt equipment based on the construction task list of the underground construction management module, predicts equipment degradation trend by utilizing a CNN-LSTM fusion model and generates a maintenance work order by acquiring real-time parameters of equipment vibration, temperature and current parameters.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA MENGTAI BULIANGOU COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Trusted fusion method for supply chain carbon data based on edge calculation-blockchain-digital twin collaborative architecture
abstract_en: The invention provides a supply chain carbon data trusted fusion method based on an edge calculation-blockchain-digital twin collaborative architecture, which comprises the steps of deploying a carbon sensing terminal through an edge node to collect equipment-level carbon emission data in real time, performing light weight processing by utilizing an edge gateway and attaching a trusted identifier, constructing a layered blockchain network to achieve same-domain low-delay consensus and cross-domain intelligent contract verification, generating a space-time correlation hash chain in a blocking mode according to a process stage, constructing a carbon flow-process coupling model on a digital twin platform to dynamically load on-chain data, solving multi-objective optimization to generate a low-carbon process instruction and feeding the low-carbon process instruction back to an edge layer, and generating a verifiable carbon credential based on blockchain data. The method solves the problems of poor real-time performance, low reliability and difficult cross-domain verification of the carbon data of the supply chain, and realizes the whole-flow reliability traceability and dynamic optimization of the carbon footprint.
assignees: HAINAN INDUSTRY RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Wind-solar power prediction system and prediction method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind-solar power prediction and discloses a wind-solar power prediction system and a prediction method based on artificial intelligence, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition processing module, a feature extraction module, an intelligent prediction module, a dynamic correction module, a blockchain verification module and a man-machine interaction module; before wind-solar power prediction model training, the original data is cleaned and filled by adopting an abnormal data detection algorithm based on 3 sigma criterion and box diagram analysis and an improved KNN missing data filling algorithm, so that noise and errors in the data can be identified and corrected, the quality of a generated standardized wind-solar power training sample set is ensured, prediction deviation is reduced, and a reliable data base is laid for generating a high-precision prediction result.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA SCI & TECH

title_en: Data processing-based power inspection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power inspection method and a system based on data processing, and relates to the technical field of power inspection, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting real-time environmental data of an inspection area; the method comprises the steps of processing environment data by adopting a Kalman filtering state estimation algorithm, outputting fused environment state information, dividing three-dimensional grids with fixed sizes, constructing a three-dimensional dynamic risk field model, calculating an optimal inspection path from a starting point to target equipment based on the model, positioning a maximum heat source point by adopting a gradient ascending algorithm when an unmanned plane flies to the vicinity of the target equipment, acquiring an inspection image, setting a multi-level risk threshold, and monitoring three-dimensional grid risk values on the path in real time. According to the invention, the inspection data under the extreme environment can be acquired through the multi-type sensor, the real-time three-dimensional dynamic risk field model is constructed, the risk level of each power region can be quantified, unmanned aerial vehicle equipment is prevented from entering the high risk region, the probability of guiding the unmanned aerial vehicle to the high risk region in extreme weather is reduced, and the method is suitable for complex scenes.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH

title_en: Intelligent power grid equipment early warning system and method based on Internet of things sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning system and method for power grid equipment based on an Internet of things sensor network, and relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning.A piece of Internet of things equipment is installed in a power grid equipment monitoring area, historical operation data of the power grid equipment is collected based on the installed piece of Internet of things equipment, meanwhile, the collected historical operation data of the power grid equipment is processed in a data processing mode based on the historical operation data of the power grid equipment, training analysis is carried out on the processed historical operation data in a data analysis mode after the processing is finished, real-time operation data of the power grid equipment are collected, and fault positions and types of the real-time operation data of the power grid equipment are determined in an intelligent judgment mode based on the analyzed historical operation data; after the position and the type of the power grid equipment fault are determined, the power grid equipment is subjected to fault early warning in a digital twin mode, and the timeliness of the power grid equipment fault early warning is improved.
assignees: XIAMEN MINTOU TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Offshore wind power fault monitoring method based on knowledge graph and digital twin fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a knowledge graph and digital twin-based offshore wind power fault monitoring method, which aims at the problems that in the operation state monitoring of offshore wind power equipment, multisource data acquisition is scattered, transmission delay is high and real-time convergence and integration are difficult to realize; the intelligent early warning system comprises a knowledge map construction module, a digital twin modeling module, an intelligent early warning decision module, a visual interaction module and a third party interfacing support, wherein the knowledge map construction module solves the problems of extraction, fusion and storage of entity relationships of equipment, the digital twin modeling module achieves visual presentation and accurate simulation of physical equipment states, the fault monitoring reasoning module solves the problems of abnormal detection and root cause positioning, the intelligent early warning decision module clearly warns the grade and efficiently matches the solution, the visual interaction module solves the problems of information display dispersion and poor linkage, and the intelligent early warning decision module supports third party interfacing.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY;GUANGZHOU YUANSHENG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-factor analysis method for energy efficiency loss of photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-factor analysis method for energy efficiency loss of a photovoltaic system, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaics. The invention aims to solve the problem that the traditional operation and maintenance mode is difficult to accurately and uncoupling to quantify energy efficiency loss caused by various abnormal factors. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting multi-source heterogeneous data by using an unmanned plane, an intelligent robot and a station sensor network, and constructing a high-fidelity digital twin body model which is synchronous with a physical power station in real time in geometric form, electrical topology and running state. And then, accurately identifying and parameterizing various abnormal factors such as dirt, shielding, hot spots, performance attenuation and the like existing in the power station by fusion analysis of the multi-mode data. Finally, the system combines performance degradation prediction with a multi-objective optimization algorithm. The invention realizes accurate tracing from macroscopic total loss to microscopic cause, provides unprecedented data insight for operation and maintenance of the power station, and remarkably improves scientificity and economic benefit of operation and maintenance decision.
assignees: HUANENG HAINAN NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for predicting ultra-short-term wind power of long-short-term memory network of displacement entropy
