abstract_en: A method for deducing a digital twin substation power outage overhaul scene comprises the steps of 1, establishing a substation digital twin refined model through multi-source data fusion, 2, establishing and matching a power outage overhaul operation module and an operation mechanical library model, 3, intelligently identifying a space static safety distance, and 4, planning an operation route in real time by using a UE4 simulation space obstacle avoidance and NavMesh navigation algorithm through an overhaul operation dynamic safety deduction optimization method. And 5, performing light-weight display by a front-end and rear-end separation technology. According to the invention, through intelligent matching of the overhaul operation module and the operation machinery library, static safety distance intelligent identification is realized by combining space measurement, and construction operation path optimization is realized aiming at each construction task to be executed, so that light-weight construction flow display is realized through rapid analysis and smooth loading of the digital twin model.
assignees: POWERCHINA HENAN ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA CENTRAL CHINA ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Electric power energy optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin-based power energy optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium, which comprises the steps of performing data cleaning and standardization processing based on sensing data and metering data of a power grid physical node to generate a power grid running state data set; the method comprises the steps of extracting equipment capacity and line tide data of corresponding nodes from a high congestion risk node list, analyzing physical operation boundaries to generate capacity margin indexes, constructing an optimization model to generate a regulation strategy parameter set, dynamically updating the regulation strategy parameter set based on external condition changes, converting the regulation strategy parameter set into a control instruction, issuing and executing the control instruction to generate an execution result, fusing prediction data to update a power grid operation state data set to obtain an updated power grid operation state data set, and completing optimization scheduling. The method and the device can achieve the technical effects of improving node congestion risk identification precision, realizing dynamic balance of economy and safety and enhancing self-adaptability of the regulation and control strategy.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Intelligent booster station outdoor terminal positioning management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent booster station outdoor terminal positioning management system, which relates to the technical field of electric power facility management. The system comprises a collecting module, an analyzing module, a decision module and a decision module, wherein the collecting module is used for obtaining multi-source original data of a cooperative target and a non-cooperative target in a booster station, the analyzing module is used for carrying out fusion processing on the multi-source original data to obtain target state information and generating a multi-target optimal path according to a pre-constructed real-scene terrain model, the decision module is used for identifying a motion state according to the target state information through a preset strategy rule, self-adaptively adjusting and positioning sampling frequency and generating a real-time updated visual path. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and intelligent analysis, the positioning accuracy and reliability are improved, the real-time monitoring and dynamic path planning of a moving target are realized, and the safety management efficiency and the emergency response capability of the booster station are effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING CENTURY CONCORD OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE WIND POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cantilever bridge construction risk monitoring system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cantilever bridge construction risk monitoring system based on digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and comprises a construction module and an analysis module, constructing a crane construction spectrogram, obtaining construction parameters according to the current construction data and the crane construction spectrogram, analyzing the construction environment, and registering the crane parameters. According to the invention, a crane construction spectrogram is generated by using historical big data, experiences are converted into quantization boundaries, errors of manual subjective judgment are avoided, current operation parameters are compared with spectrograms in second level, an overrun trend is found in advance, pre-warning rather than post-remediation is realized, zero deviation of a pre-warning instruction and a real pose is guaranteed through VR, AR targets, point clouds and ICP, wind power and rainfall are written into a registration matrix in real time, the crane allows an operation interval to automatically stretch along with weather, the shutdown false alarm rate is reduced, four key parameters of distance, rotation, pitching and lifting are registered and locked at one time, and a driver does not need multi-system switching, so that the operation efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU ROAD & BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution cabinet health state predictive maintenance system based on digital twinning and intelligent sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution cabinet health state predictive maintenance system based on digital twin and intelligent sensing, which comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a causal degradation characteristic extraction module, a digital twin modeling module, a constraint fusion prediction module, a counterfactual maintenance simulation module, a scheduling and strategy generation module and an optimal scheduling and execution strategy, wherein the data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for acquiring multisource operation data to generate a normalized input data set, the causal degradation characteristic extraction module is used for constructing a causal degradation map to generate a degradation characteristic vector, the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a power distribution cabinet digital twin model to establish a power distribution cabinet diagram structure topology, the constraint fusion prediction module is used for outputting a component health index, a degradation parameter estimated value and a future state predicted result, and the counterfactual maintenance simulation module is used for introducing a counterfactual maintenance simulator to generate a risk change value and a maintenance cost value. According to the invention, through the combination of multi-mode intelligent sensing and digital twin modeling, the accurate prediction of the health state of the power distribution cabinet and the optimal generation of the maintenance strategy are realized.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGHANG RUOYI ELECTROMECHANICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic dynamic decision method and system based on digital twin and multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy management, and discloses a water conservancy dynamic decision method and a water conservancy dynamic decision system based on digital twin and multi-source heterogeneous data, wherein the method comprises the steps of capturing real-time information of a target water conservancy system, and generating a system operation information scheduling matrix based on a gridding geographic model and a time dislocation mark; the method comprises the steps of carrying out layered slicing on a system operation information scheduling matrix according to a multi-scale time window to form a multi-channel flow frame of regional hydrologic dynamic behavior, analyzing evolution trend of water level, flow and water quality by utilizing the multi-channel flow frame and a dynamic fusion analysis operator, defining river reach, reservoir and regulation facilities corresponding to potential risk events as candidate scheduling regions, dynamically optimizing scheduling strategies, pump gate operation sequences and data acquisition frequencies based on a local risk coupling network, and generating a real-time scheduling and emergency response scheme of the candidate regions. The invention has the advantages of improving the accuracy of flood early warning and the efficiency of water supply scheduling.
assignees: CHINA ICONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rural infrastructure risk assessment method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rural infrastructure risk assessment method and system based on a digital twinning technology, which belong to the field of infrastructure planning and comprise the steps of digital twinning modeling, dynamic weight distribution, coupling risk modeling, calculating dynamic risk values of four data respectively, combining the dynamic risk values of the four data, coupling the dynamic weights of the four data to obtain a comprehensive risk index, generating an optimal scheme, simulating different intervention measures on the digital twinning body, calculating the comprehensive risk index after implementation of the different intervention measures, and finally obtaining the optimal scheme.
assignees: GUANGDONG ENG POLYTECHNIC

title_en: Method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for updating distribution area model
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, a computer device and a storage medium for updating a distribution area model. Under the condition that a target updating event is detected, intelligent ammeter data, automatic terminal data, sensor data and geographic information data of a target power distribution station are obtained, wherein the target updating event comprises at least one event of equipment failure, line maintenance, load mutation and environmental disasters, the intelligent ammeter data, the automatic terminal data, the sensor data and the geographic information data are integrated into a digital twin model corresponding to the target power distribution station, and finally, according to new data integrated into the digital twin model, the changed part of the digital twin model is updated through an incremental updating algorithm. The model update is driven by an event mechanism, so that the dynamic synchronization of the digital twin model and the physical equipment is realized, the update efficiency of the model is improved, the local change area is updated by using an incremental update algorithm, and the update speed of the model is accelerated.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Power distribution network transmission and distribution cooperative power flow control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power flow control method for power distribution network transmission and distribution coordination, which comprises the following steps of collecting data and constructing a basic data matrix; the method comprises the steps of constructing a network loss allocation model based on line share, constructing a power flow network and a carbon flow network, estimating the state of transmission and distribution coordination, and constructing a transmission and distribution coordination power flow model according to a transmission network and a distribution network model. Based on principal and subordinate characteristics, a principal and subordinate split iterative format is constructed, local and global convergence is proved according to a principal of a fixed point, the power transmission network coordinates error loss of each power distribution network, the power distribution network determines a projection function and a scope according to boundary state estimation, the fineness of carbon emission metering is improved, and the responsibility division of a carbon emission main body is refined.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD PINGHU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Full life cycle digital collaboration method and system for power engineering construction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power engineering construction, and discloses a full life cycle digital collaboration method and a full life cycle digital collaboration system for power engineering construction, wherein key collaboration node rules are defined based on a blockchain intelligent contract to realize business data hash certification and flow automatic execution; and (3) merging the multisource perception data and the BIM model to construct a lightweight digital twin, and controlling the data center to form standard data assets so as to provide data and certificate storage service for an application layer. The system comprises an edge perception layer, a platform layer and an application layer which are respectively responsible for data acquisition, function module integration and service application realization. The method effectively breaks the information island at each stage of power engineering construction, ensures the credibility of data, realizes accurate management and intelligent upgrading, improves the flexibility and expansibility of the system through a layered decoupling architecture, and can meet the diversified requirements of different power engineering construction projects.
assignees: STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CONSTRUCTION BRANCH

title_en: Ultra-short-term wind power prediction method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-based ultra-short-term wind power prediction method, belongs to the technical field of wind power prediction, and aims at solving the problem that wind power prediction is not fully considered for physical characteristics of a fan and meteorological characteristics of a wind power plant. And a physical information neural network fused with a fan physical model is introduced into the model to process the data set, a digital twin prediction model comprising a digital physical model and a parallel Ctransformer-BiGRU model is constructed, the space-time characteristics of the data are captured by utilizing the deep learning module, and the prediction process is coupled with the actual physical scene of the wind power plant by utilizing the digital physical model, so that the prediction precision is improved.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Three-dimensional dynamic safety control system for power transmission and transformation hoisting operation
abstract_en: The invention particularly discloses a three-dimensional dynamic safety management and control system for power transmission and transformation hoisting operation, and relates to the technical field of power engineering construction safety. The system comprises a multi-source data perception layer, a space-time data processing layer, a digital twin modeling layer, an intelligent decision layer and an application output layer. The multi-source data perception layer acquires space-time positioning and visual image data, the space-time data processing layer realizes data standardization processing and space-time unification, the digital twin modeling layer constructs a static digital twin and dynamic target 4D model, the intelligent decision layer carries out risk assessment and early warning decision, and the application output layer displays information and outputs alarm. The system solves the defects of the existing hoisting safety control means, realizes active and intelligent safety control, improves the safety protection precision and reliability of hoisting operation in complex scenes, and can be applied to hoisting operation of high-voltage and extra-high voltage power transmission and transformation engineering.
assignees: STATE GRID CO LTD SPECIAL HIGH VOLTAGE CONSTRUCTION BRANCH;BEIJING POWER TRANS AND DISTRIBUTION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent processing method and system for secondary system of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of transformer substations, and particularly relates to an intelligent processing method and system for a secondary system of a transformer substation. The processing method comprises the following steps of carrying out intelligent recognition on a secondary drawing based on deep learning, automatically constructing a digital model based on a recognition result, carrying out multi-dimensional loop analysis based on the digital model, and carrying out visual interaction application based on mobile interconnection, wherein the analysis result and model data generated in the step S3 are released through mobile micro application based on an i national network platform, so that safe, efficient and immersive access and interaction of site personnel on the digital twin model of the secondary system are realized, and intelligent analysis of the secondary drawing, automatic construction of the digital model, deep analysis of a multi-dimensional topological relation and immersive interaction of the analysis result at a mobile end are realized through fusion of computer vision, deep learning and power system modeling and mobile interconnection technologies, and the design, operation and management efficiency of the secondary system are comprehensively improved.
assignees: NANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent management method and system for coal storage and transportation
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent management method and system for coal storage and transportation, relates to the technical field of intelligent management systems, and aims to solve the problems of environmental monitoring deficiency, delayed scheduling decision, rough safety response and serious data island in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of collecting physical state, environmental parameters and operation behavior data of a coal yard in real time through a distributed sensing network, constructing a three-dimensional dynamic digital twin model, inputting a time sequence neural network to predict future spontaneous combustion, collapse or dust explosion risks, generating a dynamic scheduling instruction by combining task priority and equipment state, and triggering a multistage safety response mechanism. The system comprises a sensing network, a data fusion modeling module, a risk prediction module, a scheduling optimization module, a closed-loop control module and a safety response module. By the scheme, the intelligent optimization of safety pre-warning and scheduling decision and the collaborative promotion of resource energy efficiency in the storage and transportation process are realized, and the response capability and the operation reliability of a coal supply chain are obviously enhanced.
assignees: SHAANXI DINGHONG EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Wind power prediction method and device based on self-adaptive cascade mixed expert framework
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power generation and discloses a wind power prediction method and device based on a self-adaptive cascade mixed expert framework, wherein the method comprises the steps of adaptively selecting expert model combinations from a multi-type expert model sub-library; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-model fusion by using a cascade mixed expert framework to obtain a wind power prediction model, wherein the cascade mixed expert framework comprises a meteorological data assimilation module, a multi-dimensional feature fusion module and a power time sequence analysis module, the meteorological data assimilation module, the multi-dimensional feature fusion module and the power time sequence analysis module are connected in a cascade mode, training the wind power prediction model to obtain a wind power prediction model after training, and predicting wind power of a target wind power plant by using the wind power prediction model after training to obtain a wind power prediction result of the target wind power plant. According to the invention, the optimal expert model is selected in a self-adaptive manner aiming at different input data, and the multi-model prediction result is effectively fused, so that the prediction precision and the robustness are improved.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Dynamic monitoring and evaluating method for load demand of smart power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic monitoring and evaluating method for load demands of a smart grid, which comprises the following steps of synchronous data acquisition and structuring treatment of a multi-protocol sensing network, normalization and abnormal filtering to enhance data quality, analyzing and dynamically quantifying the influence of external factors on the load by utilizing a sliding window and a correlation coefficient, and realizing self-adaptive modeling of multiple factors on load change by analyzing and reducing dimensions and dynamically adjusting weights by principal components. The incremental learning algorithm supports real-time optimization and compression of model parameters, improves online updating efficiency, combines a prediction deviation feedback and calibration mechanism to realize model self-correction, and supports subsequent initialization optimization by a knowledge base. The method remarkably improves the response capability of the load prediction model to external environment changes, the prediction precision and the stability of engineering application.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JIANLI IND CO LTD

title_en: Power grid state estimation method based on Hammerstan nonlinear filtering of maximum correlation entropy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid state estimation method based on Hammerstan nonlinear filtering of maximum correlation entropy, which comprises the steps of obtaining measurement signals of all monitoring points of a power grid according to a preset sampling period; the method comprises the steps of inputting a measurement signal into a pre-built Hammerstan nonlinear filtering structure to obtain a state space model corresponding to the measurement signal, optimizing parameters of the state space model according to a maximum correlation entropy strategy to obtain an optimized state space model, synchronizing the measurement signal, and inputting the synchronized measurement signal into the optimized state space model to obtain a power grid state estimation result at the current moment. The invention combines the Hammerstan nonlinear filtering structure with the maximum correlation entropy optimization strategy, solves the technical problem that the traditional filtering algorithm is difficult to consider nonlinear modeling and non-Gaussian noise suppression, and provides an efficient and robust solution for accurate state estimation of a modern complex power grid.
assignees: UNIV XIDIAN

title_en: Extreme weather elastic scheduling strategy previewing system, method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of disaster prevention, disaster reduction and intelligent scheduling of an electric power system, and provides a system, a method, equipment and a medium for previewing an extreme weather elastic scheduling strategy, wherein the system comprises a meteorological-GAN modeling module, a reinforcement learning training module and a digital twin test platform which are connected in sequence; the method comprises the steps of generating an extreme weather power grid fault sequence with space-time correlation characteristics by a meteorological-GAN modeling module, training a power failure recovery decision model by a reinforcement learning training module based on the generated fault sequence, performing pressure test and robustness verification of a disaster evolution path on the decision model by a digital twin test platform, forming a closed-loop optimization framework by three modules through a bidirectional data channel, and breaking through the difficult problems of data dependence bottleneck and robustness verification of a power grid scheduling strategy under extreme weather by a collaborative mechanism of high-fidelity disaster scene generation, self-adaptive decision training and extreme pressure test.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power transmission line fault characteristic and risk analysis method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power transmission and discloses a digital twinning-based power transmission line fault characteristic and risk analysis method, which comprises the steps of collecting cable environment data, cable displacement data and cable operation data through a plurality of data collecting sensors and mapping the cable environment data, the cable displacement data and the cable operation data into a pre-constructed cable pipe gallery digital twinning model; the method comprises the steps of generating a power transmission line fault characteristic, generating a power transmission line risk analysis result, generating a patrol task and a corresponding virtual patrol task according to the power transmission line risk analysis result, executing the virtual patrol task in a cable duct corridor digital twin model through digital patrol equipment to verify the virtual patrol task, sending the patrol task to the patrol equipment to execute the patrol task if the virtual patrol task passes the verification, and correcting the power transmission line risk analysis result according to a patrol image of the patrol equipment to obtain a power transmission fault judgment result. Thereby, the safety risk of personnel and equipment in the inspection process is reduced.
assignees: BEIJING QIJING TECH CO LTD;ORDOS FANSHENG DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance platform of new energy power station based on digital twin driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-drive-based intelligent operation and maintenance platform for a new energy power station, and particularly relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance of the new energy power station. The method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model to reflect a dynamic mapping relation between operation behaviors and model behaviors, training a response reference system for identifying behavior deviation based on historical data, carrying out behavior simulation comparison before firmware upgrading, identifying control strategy drift and generating a check logic and control strategy plug-in, guaranteeing operation stability in the upgrading process through a behavior comparison mechanism, realizing virtual mapping of operation behaviors of a new energy power station by constructing a multi-module digital twin model, and realizing drift prejudgment before firmware upgrading and track comparison monitoring in the upgrading process by combining a controller behavior map and the response reference system.
assignees: XUANJIN SMART ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional lithium battery mine visualization system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional lithium battery mine visualization system based on digital twinning, which comprises a physical sensing layer, a data interaction layer and a data interaction layer, wherein the physical sensing layer is deployed on a lithium battery mine site and comprises a plurality of sensor networks for collecting geologic bodies, production equipment, environmental parameters, personnel positions and vehicle states, and the data interaction layer comprises a data integration platform and edge computing nodes and is used for cleaning, fusing, protocol conversion and edge side preliminary analysis of multi-source heterogeneous data uploaded by the physical sensing layer and uploading the multi-source heterogeneous data to a cloud. According to the invention, by integrating the slope monitoring sensor and the professional analysis model, real-time evaluation and advanced early warning of the slope stability and the safety of the tailing pond are realized, important accidents such as collapse, dam break and the like are effectively prevented, meanwhile, the migration paths of fluoride dust, radioactive substances and potential leakage pollutants in the atmosphere and water are dynamically simulated by utilizing the harmful element diffusion model, so that accurate decision support is provided for environmental risk emergency response, and the influence on the surrounding ecology is reduced to the greatest extent.
assignees: JIANGXI LITHIUM BATTERY IND DIGITAL TRANSFER PROMOTION CENTER

title_en: Distribution network line running state evaluation method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network line running state evaluation method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a distribution network line multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition system and acquiring electric measurement, equipment state, environmental weather and historical operation and maintenance data in real time; the method comprises the steps of establishing a data pretreatment mechanism based on edge calculation, realizing data quality assessment and space-time alignment, adopting a multi-mode deep learning network to extract deep association relation of electrical, mechanical and environmental characteristics, constructing a line health state digital twin model, establishing a fault evolution reasoning mechanism based on a dynamic knowledge graph technology, realizing running state advanced early warning, constructing a self-adaptive assessment strategy library, dynamically adjusting assessment parameters according to line types and running environments, and generating a differential operation and maintenance strategy through a man-machine collaborative decision mechanism. The invention realizes comprehensive sensing, accurate assessment and intelligent early warning of the state of the distribution network line, and remarkably improves the operation safety and reliability of the distribution network.
assignees: WANZAI COUNTY POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: New energy station cluster generating capacity multi-task collaborative prediction method based on NILM thought expansion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel energy station cluster generating capacity multitask collaborative prediction method based on NILM thought expansion, and belongs to the technical intersection field of novel energy power generation prediction and artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data and preprocessing, constructing a three-level progressive multi-task collaborative prediction model, integrating multi-source heterogeneous features through a feature fusion and abstraction layer, utilizing a shared feature to extract and implicitly decompose layer to learn station power generation potential distribution, synchronously outputting total power generation amount and station power generation amount prediction results by means of the multi-task prediction layer, introducing physical consistency loss in the training process to ensure energy conservation, and enhancing robustness of a missing data scene through a mask mechanism. The method effectively solves the problems that the prediction precision is reduced and the total power generation amount is inconsistent with the prediction result of the power generation amount of each station when part of station data is lost in the traditional method, and can provide high-precision and strong-robustness power generation amount prediction support for fine scheduling and station operation and maintenance management of the power grid.
assignees: BEIJING YIDIAN ZHITONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network running state sensing and predicting method, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, medium and equipment for sensing and predicting the running state of an intelligent power distribution network, which relate to the technical field of intelligent power grids and specifically comprise the following steps: and acquiring and preprocessing data to obtain a data set, establishing a holographic digital twin model of the power distribution network, executing a passive empirical learning closed loop, establishing a dynamic knowledge base, executing an active exploration cognitive closed loop, updating the dynamic knowledge base, and performing power distribution network running state sensing and prediction based on the updated dynamic knowledge base. According to the invention, a heuristic reasoning chain in a dynamic knowledge base is continuously evolved through a double-ring driving mechanism of passive experience learning and active exploration cognition, and a prediction result is output by using the modified digital twin model, so that the accuracy, the foresight and the self-adaptive capacity of power distribution network state sensing and prediction are remarkably improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Urban underground space emergency drainage control method under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban underground space emergency drainage control method under flood disasters, which comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional real-time data through a multisource heterogeneous digital twin drainage intelligent management and control platform, inputting a 1D-2D dynamic bidirectional coupling model to simulate the dynamic coupling relation between pipe network water flow and regional ponding to obtain water flow pressure distribution and ponding diffusion trend data, starting a space-time characteristic driving drainage scheduling algorithm to extract space-time correlation characteristics and construct a decision variable set, combining emergency drainage control parameters to screen variables, inputting the screened variables into the model for feedback verification, adjusting algorithm parameters if the screened variables do not meet the requirements, and sending control instructions to execution equipment through the platform if the screened variables meet the requirements. The method can improve the prediction precision of the ponding and water flow state, improve the adaptability and the reliability of a scheduling scheme, accelerate the response speed of emergency drainage, comprehensively improve the coping capacity of underground space flooding, and ensure the operation safety of the underground space.
assignees: CHENGDU CITY SAFETY AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Multi-scale meteorological data assimilation and space-time reconstruction method for regional wind farm group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional wind power plant group multi-scale meteorological data assimilation and space-time reconstruction method, and aims to solve the problems that the existing wind power plant is insufficient in meteorological prediction precision, difficult in multi-source data fusion and the like. According to the method, the depth convolution variation self-encoder is constructed to realize effective assimilation of multi-source heterogeneous meteorological data, the space-time reconstruction of a high-resolution three-dimensional wind field is realized by combining an abnormal composition network and a neural ordinary differential equation technology, and physical constraint conditions are introduced to ensure the physical consistency of output results. Experimental results show that the method can remarkably improve the weather prediction precision of the wind power plant, and provides reliable weather data support for the fine operation management of wind power plant groups.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Dynamic forecasting method for ice water surface elevation along water return area of reservoir in flood season
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, and discloses a dynamic forecasting method for the elevation of an along-process ice water surface of a reservoir return area in a flood season, wherein characteristic factors and adjacent section target factors affecting the elevation of the ice water surface of a target section of the reservoir along-process are screened out according to the annual monitoring data of the reservoir return area in the flood season; and carrying out multi-round prediction on the ice water surface elevation of more than one target section along the reservoir water return area in the target time sequence through the ice water surface elevation dynamic prediction model until the elevation error between two adjacent rounds is lower than a set error threshold value. The method has the advantages of high mutation identification precision, strong cyclic prediction stability, flexible deployment and the like, and has good popularization value and engineering application prospect in various scenes such as ice evolution monitoring, intelligent scheduling auxiliary decision and digital twin system construction in the flood season of reservoirs in cold regions.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;YELLOW RIVER WANJIAZHAI HYDRO JUNCTION CO LTD;YELLOW RIVER ENGINEERING CONSULTING CO LTD;YUNHE HENAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster source emergency treatment system for underground space bottom plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground space disaster source monitoring, in particular to an underground space bottom plate disaster source emergency treatment system which comprises a data acquisition module, a preprocessing module, an analysis operation module and an emergency treatment module. The system can identify potential disaster risks in early stage, take emergency treatment measures in advance, greatly improve the safety of underground space, effectively supplement missing geophysical parameters and hydrogeological parameter data through an innovative data preprocessing method, and repair data of different degrees according to the severity of the missing data, thereby ensuring the integrity and accuracy of the data.
assignees: UNIV SUZHOU;THE THIRD EXPLOR TEAM OF ANHUI PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF COAL GEOLOGY;NO 1 SURVEYING TEAM OF ANHUI CHARCOAL FIELD AND GEOLOGY BUREAU;THE SECOND EXPLOR TEAM ANHUI NO 2 COAL GEOLOGY BUREAU;HYDROLOGY PROSPECTING TEAM OF ANHUI PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF COAL GEOLOGY;ANHUI HENGYUAN COAL & ELECTRIC CO LTD;HUAIBEI MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line state simulation and prediction method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based power transmission line state simulation and prediction method which comprises the following steps of accessing meteorological data, electrical data, space and asset data and historical state data for preprocessing to generate a multi-source space-time characteristic sequence set, constructing a double-domain cross-coupling time convolution twinning model, obtaining corresponding characteristic representation through a quick response path and a slow response path, generating physical consistency state representation through a physical constraint cross-gating layer, outputting a prediction result set through a simulation engine, obtaining online observation data, correcting the model based on virtual and real residual errors, generating a current prediction result set by using the corrected model, and converting the current prediction result set into a scheduling and operation and maintenance strategy set. The invention adopts a double-domain cross-coupling time convolution twin model and a virtual-real closed loop correction mechanism to realize multi-scale state simulation prediction of the power transmission line, and has the advantages of high precision, high robustness and strong executable.
assignees: LIAOCHENG URBAN AND RURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Energy gallery forest fire risk prediction method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy gallery forest fire risk prediction method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a fusion data set and determining risk evolution parameters; triggering a vegetation difference analysis function if the risk evolution parameter exceeds a preset threshold value to obtain a section heterogeneity label, carrying out space-time heterogeneity compensation correction on historical data through a time sequence change tracking method after the section heterogeneity label is obtained, calculating the risk transition probability of each section, judging potential critical points, activating a difference early warning mechanism if the potential critical points are judged to be high probability, generating a targeted risk grade map according to the section heterogeneity label and the risk transition probability to obtain a dynamic early warning signal, carrying out iterative verification on the dynamic early warning signal by adopting a real-time update flow in a fusion data set, and combining the prediction output of a long-term and short-term memory network to adjust the risk grade to determine a final risk prediction result. The method and the device improve the timeliness and accuracy of fire risk prediction.
assignees: UNIV JIANGXI NORMAL

title_en: Digital twin monitoring and fault early warning system for hydraulic junction engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin monitoring and fault early warning system for hydraulic hub engineering, and relates to the technical field of intelligent water conservancy. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing and storage module, a hydraulic semantic dictionary and a data storage module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring hydraulic data, the data processing and storage module is used for carrying out standardized cleaning on the hydraulic data to obtain standard hydraulic data, the hydraulic semantic dictionary is established, the standard hydraulic data are unified into a hydraulic event label, and the standard hydraulic data are stored according to space-time and service attributes in a separated mode, and full life cycle metadata are recorded. According to the invention, by constructing a virtual complex scene laboratory, an extreme disaster scene which rarely occurs in the history is generated and previewed, the defect of insufficient historical data of the digital twin is fundamentally overcome, the emergency response capability of the hydraulic junction engineering to the extreme disaster scene is enhanced, and the accuracy of the digital twin prediction is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU XIANGTONG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: AI and digital twin-based intelligent planning simulation platform for power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent planning simulation platform for a power grid based on AI and digital twin, which relates to the technical field of power grid planning. The multi-source data fusion module adopts wavelet transformation to fuse multi-source data of the power grid, the topology representation module adopts a graph convolution neural network to learn the topology characteristics of the power grid, the event-driven twin module adopts an event-driven mechanism to realize synchronization, the power grid state prediction module adopts a space-time graph convolution neural network to generate a power grid state prediction sequence, the intelligent planning generation module adopts a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to generate a power grid planning scheme, and the simulation verification module adopts a Monte Carlo method to carry out multi-scene verification and optimization on the planning scheme. The method solves the problems of difficult multi-source data fusion and insufficient state prediction precision in power grid planning, and improves the intelligent level of a planning scheme.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHENGTU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and system for multi-agent collaborative operation platform of thermal power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method of a multi-agent collaborative operation platform of a thermal power plant, which comprises the steps of collecting whole plant time sequence and static data, preprocessing the data, sending the data into a digital twin body, utilizing a neural network model to conduct data feature fusion, generating a high-dimensional feature vector, sending the high-dimensional feature vector into the digital twin model for prediction, constructing specialized agents, training in the digital twin body, conducting multi-step time sequence prediction by using a built-in prediction model to obtain local optimization decisions, constructing a collaborative brain based on a large model, receiving the local optimization decisions, generating global state codes, constructing a decision planner, receiving the global state codes, outputting collaborative strategy instructions, integrating the digital twin body, the specialized agents, the collaborative brain and a domain knowledge base, constructing a unified collaborative operation platform, and conducting iterative optimization on the digital twin prediction model and the collaborative brain. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantage of high synergistic treatment efficiency.
assignees: HUANENG POWER INT INC SHANGHAI SHIDONGKOU FIRST POWER PLANT;NODE INTERCONNECTION BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed state estimation method and system for power distribution network containing multi-source heterogeneous measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed state estimation method and a distributed state estimation system for a power distribution network containing multi-source heterogeneous measurement, wherein the method comprises the steps of executing multi-source measurement data synchronous processing on heterogeneous measurement data; the method comprises the steps of distributing measurement data after synchronous processing to each sub-area control center to which the measurement data belong, independently executing local state estimation in each sub-area to obtain state preliminary estimated values of all nodes in the sub-areas, transmitting state estimated information of overlapped boundary nodes and influence characteristic information of non-boundary nodes on the boundary nodes to adjacent sub-areas by each sub-area, updating a power flow calculation model of the boundary nodes by each sub-area according to the received adjacent area information, and executing local state estimation again, and carrying out iterative coordination until global convergence is achieved to obtain an optimal state estimated result. The method and the device effectively solve the problems of data incompatibility and boundary inconsistency in distributed estimation, and ensure the rapid convergence and accuracy of global state estimation.
assignees: UNIV NANJING NORMAL

title_en: Photovoltaic array fault diagnosis and positioning method and system based on digital twin and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic array fault diagnosis and positioning method and system based on digital twin and deep learning. The method comprises the steps of constructing a photovoltaic array digital twin body, synchronously collecting multi-source monitoring data and converting the multi-source monitoring data into a time spectrum, constructing a twin network model, performing feature learning through a triplet loss function, extracting high-discriminant depth features, introducing an anti-migration learning mechanism, realizing cross-working condition domain invariant feature extraction through a feature generating unit and a domain discriminant anti-training, improving diagnosis robustness, adopting a multi-source domain generalization strategy, extracting domain invariant features and domain private features through a dual-branch network, applying differential constraint and self-adapting fusion, constructing a generalization diagnosis model oriented to unknown working conditions, integrating the model into the digital twin body, and realizing accurate positioning and visualization of a fault component. The invention solves the problems of low fault diagnosis precision and poor generalization capability of the photovoltaic array under the conditions of scarce data, variable working conditions and unknown environments.

title_en: Highway construction risk prediction method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk prediction, in particular to a highway construction risk prediction method and system based on big data, comprising the following steps: acquiring a construction safety regulation and equipment fault tree, constructing a management-fault coupling logic tree, determining initial risk probability by combining a digital twin state vector and a regulation defect, analyzing a real-time instruction to update the digital twin state, and finally updating the instantaneous occurrence probability of a basic event on a discrete time step by using a Bayesian network to generate a risk probability evolution sequence. According to the invention, through constructing the logical association between management and faults, revealing the failure induced by rule defects, forming a risk tracing path, discarding isolated risk assessment, utilizing the real-time data quantization equipment state to replace expert scoring, realizing objective assessment, analyzing instructions in real time to dynamically adjust risks, generating a probability evolution sequence based on a Bayesian network, and supporting trend prejudgment and prospective intervention.

title_en: Gate station flood control cooperative control method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering flood control and discloses a digital twin-based gate station flood control cooperative control method and system. The digital twin-based floodgate station flood control cooperative control method comprises the steps of constructing a federal learning platform to protect data privacy by embedding and analyzing historical data through space-time knowledge, realizing quick adaptation of a newly built floodgate station by using meta-learning, applying progressive knowledge migration optimization control strategies, realizing self-adaptive incremental learning, solving the technical problems of efficient sharing and migration of floodgate knowledge among floodgates in different watercourses, improving cooperative flood control efficiency, improving cooperative flood control capability among floodgates in different watercourses, and realizing efficient and intelligent water resource management and disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: JILIN YUGANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: LES ultra-high resolution TC atmospheric air flow field numerical simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a numerical simulation method and a numerical simulation system for an LES ultra-high resolution TC atmospheric flow field, and relates to the fields of atmospheric observation, numerical assimilation and high resolution numerical simulation. According to the method, three-dimensional power-thermal information is obtained by cooperatively implementing airship platform radar observation and downward projecting sounding observation in a tropical cyclone core area, radar radial wind and profile observation operators are preprocessed and constructed, multi-source observation is fused in a multiple nested grid numerical mode by adopting a data assimilation strategy, and a three-dimensional initial/analysis field adapting to large vortex simulation is generated. And then, configuring a large vortex simulation solver on an innermost grid covering a tropical cyclone boundary layer, adopting fine horizontal grids and boundary layer encryption vertical layering, explicitly analyzing boundary layer vortex, small-scale convection and turbulence structures, and outputting an ultrahigh-resolution three-dimensional flow field product for fine evaluation of strong wind and disaster risks.

title_en: Wind-solar resource deviation rectifying system based on ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar resource deviation correcting system based on integrated learning, which comprises a data acquisition layer, an edge calculation layer, a cloud intelligent layer, an integrated learning deviation correcting model and a physical constraint generation module, wherein the data acquisition layer is used for constructing an original data acquisition network, the edge calculation layer is used for carrying out streaming processing and incremental learning based on an edge equipment integrated Flink real-time data engine, the cloud intelligent layer is used for carrying out numerical mode and real-time data time-space alignment through a multi-source data fusion module and combining a quality evaluation system to repair abnormal values, the integrated learning deviation correcting model is used for combining LightGBM + random forest hybrid architecture and an error compensation algorithm, the physical constraint generation module is used for introducing hydrodynamic equation constraint to generate topographic data conforming to a physical rule so as to calculate microscale characteristics, the spatiotemporal characteristic extraction module is used for automatically extracting spatiotemporal characteristics through a ConvLSTM network, and the digital twin verification platform is used for pushing simulation verification deviation correcting strategy effectiveness and continuously optimizing model parameters, and the application layer is used for outputting short-time prediction results through a wind speed and irradiance data after integrated deviation correcting.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;ZHANGYE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Thermal power plant fault early warning diagnosis method and system based on star cloud system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thermal power plant fault early warning diagnosis method based on a star cloud system, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-dimensional operation time sequence data of the thermal power plant, carrying out feature extraction and orthographic conversion on the multi-dimensional operation time sequence data by using an encoder to obtain a unified equipment state metasequence, constructing a dynamic star map representing the operation state of the whole thermal power plant based on the equipment state metasequence, inputting the dynamic star map into a space-time fusion backbone network, carrying out iterative processing on the dynamic star map by the space-time fusion backbone network and generating a health degree attenuation track, triggering dynamic early warning and system diagnosis and generating a natural language diagnosis report comprising a causal reasoning chain when the slope of the health degree attenuation track exceeds a preset threshold, collecting new multi-dimensional operation time sequence data in real time, and carrying out online updating on the encoder by using an incremental learning algorithm.
assignees: HUANENG POWER INT INC SHANGHAI SHIDONGKOU FIRST POWER PLANT;NODE INTERCONNECTION BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive transmission method for broadband satellite communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive transmission method for a broadband satellite communication system, which relates to the technical field of broadband satellite emergency communication, and the self-adaptive transmission capacity of the broadband satellite communication system in an emergency scene is remarkably improved by integrating a multi-index anomaly detection and meta-learning rapid adaptation mechanism; the method has the advantages that the method can timely capture flow fluctuation by adopting a sliding window and a parallel judgment strategy in an anomaly detection link, avoid misjudgment or delay caused by historical data dependence, ensure that a system can trigger response at the initial stage of sudden flow, lead a model to complete online updating by only needing a small amount of real-time data on the basis of offline pre-training by introducing a meta-learning process, effectively overcome the problems of slow convergence and poor generalization of the traditional machine learning model, and further quickly generate an optimized routing strategy, and the mechanism not only reduces the hysteresis of routing adjustment, but also reduces the cost of a control surface and avoids network oscillation by incremental updating and decentralization coordination.
assignees: KONGTIAN WEILAI SHANGHAI AEROSPACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Green tide disaster macroscopic situation day scale prediction method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a green tide disaster macroscopic situation day scale prediction method, device and equipment, and relates to the field of disaster prediction; extracting macroscopic dynamic parameters of green tide according to historical satellite remote sensing data and establishing a stage-latitude mapping model, splitting the historical environmental factor data stage by stage and constructing a macroscopic parameter prediction model of each stage, extracting macroscopic dynamic parameters according to the satellite remote sensing data of a prediction day in a research area, determining a prediction day stage by adopting the stage-latitude mapping model, determining macroscopic dynamic parameter reference values of three days in the future of the prediction day by adopting the macroscopic parameter prediction model of the prediction day stage according to the environmental factor data of the prediction day in the research area, and correcting the macroscopic dynamic parameter reference values by adopting a real-time data assimilation algorithm. The method can accurately match the growth and evolution rules of the green tide, and can realize the accurate prediction of the macroscopic situation of the green tide disaster on a daily scale.

title_en: Digital twinning-based substation equipment fault early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based substation equipment fault early warning method and a digital twinning-based substation equipment fault early warning system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining equipment data in a substation and electricity utilization data of a plurality of conveying areas associated with the substation; the method comprises the steps of analyzing data association characteristics of equipment data and any conveying area according to electricity utilization data, establishing a digital twin model of the transformer substation and all conveying areas according to the equipment data and the data association characteristics, and generating fault early warning information corresponding to the transformer substation and any conveying area according to the digital twin model and a preset fault prediction model. Therefore, the method can realize accurate fault early warning based on multi-source data association and digital twin modeling, improve the operation safety and maintenance efficiency of the transformer substation and the conveying area, and reduce the power supply interruption risk caused by failure unpredicted.

title_en: Pseudo measurement set optimization selection method for power distribution network state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pseudo measurement set optimization selection method for power distribution network state estimation, which comprises the steps of obtaining a set containing M candidate pseudo measurement data, topology parameters of a power distribution network and K real-time physical measurement data, constructing an optimization model taking pseudo measurement selection as a decision variable, solving the optimization model by adopting a football team training element heuristic algorithm (FTTA), aiming at solving the obtained pseudo measurement selection scheme, obtaining an optimal pseudo measurement selection scheme through iterative optimization of the FTTA algorithm, screening an optimal pseudo measurement subset from the candidate set according to the optimal pseudo measurement selection scheme, and combining the optimal pseudo measurement subset with the real-time physical measurement data for executing final power distribution network state estimation. The invention can accurately identify the pseudo measurement combination with the largest contribution to the improvement of the estimation precision and the lowest redundancy, and reduces the calculation burden while obviously improving the state estimation accuracy.
assignees: UNIV NANJING NORMAL

title_en: Power grid early warning and decision system based on digital twinning and big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid early warning and decision system based on digital twinning and big data, and belongs to the technical field of power grid digitization. The system comprises a digital twin three-dimensional technical platform for constructing a virtual mirror image, a power grid line visualization module for realizing asset transparency monitoring, a management and intelligent early warning module for generating early warning information, a big data intelligent engine module for driving intelligent decision and business closed loop according to the early warning information, and a system management module for providing unified operation and maintenance support.
assignees: QINHUANGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Hydrogen production system flexibility improving method based on multi-source cooperation and self-adaptive regulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen production system flexibility improving method based on multi-source cooperation and self-adaptive regulation and control, and belongs to the technical field of new energy. The method is implemented by taking a digital twin body as a global decision center and comprises the steps of obtaining prediction data of wind-solar power generation power, real-time frequency deviation signals of a power grid and operation states of all electrolytic tanks in a hydrogen production system, generating global optimization scheduling instructions based on the prediction data of the wind-solar power generation power and the frequency deviation signals and aiming at improving system flexibility and economy, cooperatively controlling dynamic reconfiguration of the electrolytic tanks and applying Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control on hydrogen production load according to the global optimization scheduling instructions, collecting actual operation data after cooperative control and feeding back to a fatigue loss analysis model and a wind-solar power output prediction model, and dynamically correcting fatigue damage assessment and power prediction of the next period. The method of the invention greatly improves the flexibility of the new energy hydrogen production system while effectively reducing the running cost of the system.

title_en: Ammeter data report supplementing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ammeter data reporting method, which aims to solve the problems of incomplete data and missing data reporting existing in the existing data reporting process. The method comprises the steps of collecting ammeter data, writing collected data items into a database, marking data item storage time, checking whether the data items are empty and reporting the data items, marking the empty part of the data items as missing report data items, building a missing report list, calculating the priority score of each missing report data item according to a priority scoring model, determining a benefit report sequence based on the priority score, and carrying out benefit report on the missing report data items in the missing report list based on the benefit report sequence by using the idle time in the current reporting period. Through a missing report identification and marking mechanism, all abnormal data items are ensured not to be missed, the integrity and reliability of reported power data are improved, and a more accurate data basis is provided for monitoring and decision making of a power system.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGCHEN MICROELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle airport inspection management and control system based on digital twin and intelligent switch cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based unmanned aerial vehicle airport inspection management and control system and an intelligent switch cabinet, and relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of electric power facilities. The digital twin-based unmanned aerial vehicle airport inspection management and control system and the intelligent switch cabinet realize dynamic priority grading of self-diagnosis information of the intelligent switch cabinet and real-time overhead response of high-risk tasks through transformation of a medical emergency model of a fault quantitative diagnosis engine, effectively improve the timeliness of abnormal handling of critical power equipment of an airport, and avoid redundant detection steps by combining a fault-detection action knowledge graph strong binding mechanism of a task precision generator, ensure precise matching of unmanned aerial vehicle scanning instructions and fault characteristics and optimize inspection resource utilization efficiency.
assignees: XUZHOU NEW POWER HI TECH ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Big data-based power grid optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid optimization method and a system based on big data, which relate to the technical field of power grid operation management and comprise the following steps: S1, constructing a digital twin model for target key equipment in a power grid, wherein the digital twin model is used for representing physical properties, operation mechanisms and state evolution rules of the target key equipment. According to the invention, a digital twin model integrating a physical model and a data driving model is constructed for target key equipment, a future load curve under multiple situations is generated by combining multiple source heterogeneous data, accurate prediction of the change trend of the future aging speed of the equipment is realized through deduction type risk assessment, the problems that the existing assessment system cannot predict future aging acceleration and scheduling decision delay are solved, the aging acceleration risk of the equipment can be avoided in advance, and measures such as load adjustment, output plan optimization or maintenance period are adopted in advance.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HAOTAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent mine mining method, equipment and medium based on industrial cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent mine mining method, equipment and medium based on an industrial cloud platform, which relate to the technical field of intelligent mining and comprise the steps of mutually communicating a digital twin analysis module with a data management fusion module through a data service bus, receiving mine comprehensive state data output by the data management fusion module, constructing a three-dimensional geological model, detecting abnormal behaviors through a deep learning algorithm, outputting an abnormal detection result, associating an intelligent decision optimization module with the digital twin analysis module through an algorithm collaborative interface, establishing a disaster prediction model based on the abnormal detection result and the mine comprehensive state data, carrying out disaster risk assessment, optimizing a mining strategy through a reinforcement learning algorithm, acquiring an optimal mining scheme, and transmitting the optimal mining scheme back to a data acquisition upper cloud module through a feedback control link to guide on-site acquisition and scheduling. The overall safety, the running efficiency and the intelligent level of the mine system are improved.
assignees: CHANGCHUN GOLD DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent supervision method and system based on data visualization platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an intelligent supervision method and system based on a data visualization platform, comprising the steps of collecting multi-source water conservancy data through double-channel redundancy check and converting the multi-source water conservancy data into a standardized space-time matrix, adopting a containerized adaptation and variation self-encoder to clean the data and marking confidence coefficient; the method comprises the steps of storing data in a layered mode based on a confidence threshold, generating routing strategy distribution data fragments through reinforcement learning, calculating a flood peak evolution prediction result through space-time diagram convolution, calculating an output risk assessment value through combining a Bayesian network and long-term memory, activating federal learning parameter updating when the confidence is insufficient, loading a physical constraint parameter to deduce a flood prevention scene by a digital twin model, generating a scheduling instruction set and a pre-modeling animation through multi-objective optimization, dynamically rendering to generate an interactive visual interface and associating a causal deduction path, triggering federal model parameter updating through user feedback, and realizing dynamic cooperation of a forecasting and early warning pre-modeling function chain.

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid automatic dispatching system
abstract_en: The invention relates to power grid dispatching, in particular to a digital twin-based power grid automatic dispatching system, which comprises a data sensing and fusion module, a digital twin modeling module, an optimal dispatching module, a decision executing and feedback module and an AGC/AVC system, wherein the data sensing and fusion module is used for acquiring power grid multi-source heterogeneous data in real time and constructing a unified data lake and knowledge map, providing high-quality input for digital twin modeling, the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a device level, unit level and system level three-layer digital twin model of a power grid, realizing real-time synchronous mapping of a physical power grid and a virtual model, the optimal dispatching module is used for solving the power grid dispatching model by adopting a cordyceps sinensis optimization algorithm to generate an optimal power grid dispatching strategy, the decision executing and feedback module is used for converting the optimal power grid dispatching strategy into a corresponding dispatching instruction and transmitting the corresponding dispatching instruction to the AGC/AVC system, and real-time verifying a dispatching effect by the digital twin model to form closed-loop control.
assignees: MAANSHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Power distribution network scheduling optimization method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network scheduling, in particular to a power distribution network scheduling optimization method and device, comprising the steps of acquiring a space-time associated multi-energy flow data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic digital twin body of a power distribution network to be scheduled, reversely correcting line impedance parameters and equipment efficiency coefficients by combining a twin body simulation result, previewing a plurality of scheduling strategies in parallel, selecting an optimal scheduling strategy by weighting scores, generating a multi-energy flow cooperative scheduling instruction set according to the optimal scheduling strategy, dynamically distributing control tasks by utilizing edge nodes, and classifying and executing differential load response by combining user electricity utilization behaviors. According to the invention, space-time synchronous acquisition of electric-heat-gas data is realized by deploying the multi-energy flow sensor group, the multi-energy flow cooperative scheduling instruction is generated by combining reverse parameter correction and scene preview optimization of the dynamic digital twin body, and the dynamic allocation of resources is realized based on the dynamic allocation control task and load classification response of the edge nodes, so that the new energy consumption rate capability is remarkably improved, and the carbon emission intensity is reduced.
assignees: ALTAY POWER COMPANY OF STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Robust state estimation-based power distribution network operation weak point evaluation index system and comprehensive identification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robust state estimation-based power distribution network operation weak point evaluation index system and a comprehensive identification method, and belongs to the field of power distribution network operation weak point identification. The method comprises the steps of constructing an evaluation index system of the operation weak points of the power distribution network, achieving weak identification of elements in the power distribution network, constructing an identification method for reactive power/voltage weak nodes of the power distribution network, achieving weak node identification in the power distribution network, constructing a line weakness evaluation index system of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network, and constructing an identification method based on weak lines of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network, so that weak lines in the power distribution network are identified. The method can accurately identify and quantify the weak links in the power grid, improve the resistance of the power grid to various disturbance and abnormal conditions, and enhance the reliability and stability of the system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;SANMING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;Quanzhou Power Supply Company Of State Grid Fujian Electric Power Company

title_en: Digital twin-based system and method for disaster management
abstract_en: A system (100) and a method (1000) for rescue management are disclosed. The system (100) includes at least one input device (102), at least one analysis unit (104), and at least one output device (106). The at least one input device (102) is configured to receive disaster data input and location tracking data input from at least one user. The at least one input device (102) is associated with the at least one user. The at least one analysis unit (104) is configured to analyze the disaster data input and the location tracking data input from the at least one input device (102) to generate data output comprising visual data and route guidance data. The at least one output device (106) is configured to indicate the visual information and guidance information to the at least one user.
assignees: 10D DESIGN SERVICES OPC PRIVATE LTD

title_en: Intelligent Distribution Panel System With AI-based Predictive Preservation Function and Fire Prevention Function
title_ko: Ai 기반 예지 보전 기능 수행 및 화재 예방 기능을 갖춘 지능형 분전반 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실시간 데이터 수집, 통신 기능, 자동 제어 기능이 미비하여 고장 진단 및 에너지 최적화 운영에 한계AI 기반 예지 보전 알고리즘, SiC 기반 고속 차단 기술, 디지털 트윈 연동 시각화, 엣지 컴퓨팅 로컬 분석, 자연어 이해 기반 사용자 인터페이스(NLU UI)를 포함하는 차세대 지능형 분전반 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 지능형 분전반 시스템은 전력 라인의 상태를 실시간으로 모니터링하고, 고장 징후를 사전에 판단하여 사고를 예방할 수 있으며, 직관적인 사용자 명령 기반 제어가 가능하고, 디지털 트윈, 산업 현장, 지능형 빌딩, 데이터센터, 공공시설 등 다양한 응용 분야에 적용 가능한 AI 기반 예지 보전 기능 수행 및 화재 예방 기능을 갖춘 지능형 분전반 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: AWON CO LTD

title_en: Electricity price execution and bill risk combined prepositive intelligent early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electricity price execution and bill risk combined prepositioned intelligent early warning method, which relates to the technical field of electric power charging wind control, and comprises the steps of constructing rate digital twinning, managing atom change according to a version directed acyclic graph, generating an interpretation path of a trigger condition-calculation expression-bill line item, mapping the interpretation path with a metering object, a client object and a bill object, realizing executable traceability, obtaining bill difference, uncertainty, exposure and identifying a difference hot area by replaying new and old rules in sandboxes on double tracks based on layered samples and boundary samples, generating a version binding condition Jing Yu bill after passing through a semantic structure, a coverage boundary, performance budget and a compliance entrance guard, providing a substitution scene and collecting a receipt, carrying out gray monitoring, rolling back and secondarily checking according to TariffID subgraph when triggered to form evidence fingerprints, and improving caliber consistency and boundary coverage, supporting accurate rollback and auditable verification.
assignees: CHUXIONG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Low-carbon virtual power plant collaborative optimization method based on digital twin and deep reinforcement learning
