abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid relay protection method based on a digital twin model and related equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining protection function logic inside relay protection devices of different protection types, constructing a digital twin model of the protection devices of the relay protection devices based on the protection function logic and intelligent electronic equipment capacity description files of the relay protection devices, determining a digital twin model of target protection devices matched with the field protection devices in the configuration description files of the field intelligent substations in the digital twin model of the protection devices, carrying out instantiation configuration on the digital twin model of the target protection devices based on the configuration description files of the field intelligent substations and field fault data, and determining protection action behaviors of the field protection devices by using the digital twin model of the target protection devices after the instantiation configuration. The method realizes standardized modeling of the digital twin model of the protection device, completes instantiation of the digital twin model of the protection device and remarkably improves power grid fault diagnosis.
assignees: EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Industrial park power demand optimization scheduling method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power dispatching and discloses an industrial park power demand optimization dispatching method based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the steps of obtaining regional distribution and historical energy consumption data of an industrial park, dividing the industrial park into a plurality of nodes, determining key characteristics of each node, and constructing an industrial park digital twin model based on the key characteristics; the method comprises the steps of collecting power data and equipment data of each node in an industrial park in real time, predicting power demand and trend characteristics of equipment in the industrial park in the next time period according to the power data and the equipment data based on a digital twin model, generating an optimal scheduling strategy, scheduling the power of the industrial park according to the optimal scheduling strategy, monitoring the operation effect after scheduling, and adjusting the optimal scheduling strategy based on the operation effect to obtain an adjustment scheduling strategy. The invention reduces unnecessary loss through reasonable scheduling of the power resources and improves the overall utilization rate.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;CRRC QIHANG NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wide-area measurement intelligent resource regulation and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a wide-area measurement intelligent resource regulation and control system and a method, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a state estimation and data analysis module, a regulation strategy generation module, a safety evaluation module and a regulation execution and feedback module which are connected in sequence in a data interaction mode. According to the invention, through the collaborative operation of the multiple modules, wide area measurement data is accurately acquired and efficiently processed, the operation state of the power system is deeply analyzed, the regulation and control strategy is intelligently generated and optimized, the regulation and control effect is monitored in real time, the optimal allocation of the power system resources is realized, and the safe, stable and economic operation of the power system is ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Intelligent safety monitoring and dynamic risk management and control system and method for polyvinyl chloride polymerization working section
abstract_en: An intelligent safety monitoring and dynamic risk management and control system and method for a polyvinyl chloride polymerization working section comprise a sensing and executing layer, a reliable transmission and safety network layer, a digital twin and intelligent central layer, an algorithm and service center and a business application layer, and an intelligent digital twin body which is in deep interaction and fusion with a physical working section is constructed according to the intelligent digital twin body, so that the fundamental transition from passive response to active early warning, from experience driving to data and model driving and from single-point monitoring to global synergy is realized. The invention realizes autonomous intelligent closed loop of perception-mapping-diagnosis-decision-control, thereby comprehensively improving the safety production level of the working section.
assignees: Shandong lutai chemical co ltd

title_en: Digital twinning-integrated urban power distribution network whole-process scene chain closed-loop monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart grids, in particular to a digital twinning-integrated urban power distribution network whole-process scene chain closed-loop monitoring method and system. The method comprises the steps of six-step closed loop control, collecting multi-source data through fusion of a weighted evidence theory and a dynamic time bending algorithm, constructing a physical mechanism-data driving hybrid enhanced digital twin model, based on the model, researching and judging abnormality through an improved isolated forest algorithm, generating a hierarchical alarm, carrying out simulation deduction through Monte Carlo-Latin hypercube sampling, screening an optimal strategy through a non-dominant ordering genetic algorithm III containing uncertainty, carrying out landing execution instruction after topological verification of a graph neural network, forming feedback through acquisition results, and optimizing a calibration model and an optimization strategy through element learning and Bayesian. The system comprises six cooperative units, integrates an intelligent algorithm and a digital twin technology, improves the abnormal identification precision, decision scientificity and self-adaptive capacity of the power distribution network, and ensures safe and efficient operation.
assignees: LUOYANG MENGJIN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Cross-season rock-soil heat storage system based on multi-source waste heat and intelligent regulation
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of geothermal energy storage, and discloses a multi-source waste heat and intelligent regulation-based cross-season rock-soil heat storage system which comprises a physical layer, a multi-source waste heat access and pretreatment unit, an underground heat exchange pipe network, an energy intelligent allocation unit, an information and control layer, an information and control system and an intelligent decision and dispatch center, wherein the physical layer comprises a rock-soil heat storage body, the multi-source waste heat access and pretreatment unit is connected with the underground heat exchange pipe network, the information and control layer comprises a multi-physical-field sensing network which is arranged in the rock-soil heat storage body, a digital twin and multi-physical-field coupling simulation engine which is connected with the multi-physical-field sensing network, and the intelligent decision and dispatch center is communicated with the physical layer and the digital twin and multi-physical-field coupling simulation engine. By introducing the geological stress health index as a key quantization index and utilizing the digital twin and multi-physical field coupling simulation engine to perform real-time calculation and prospective safety check, potential structural damage can be predicted and avoided, and the structural safety and operation reliability of the system are improved.
assignees: WANJIANG NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for realizing digital twin of offshore photovoltaic power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of offshore power generation, in particular to a method for acquiring marine environment data and motion state data of an offshore photovoltaic power generation system in real time, preprocessing the acquired data, then completing space-time feature fusion, outputting a fusion feature matrix with a time stamp and a space coordinate label, realizing multidimensional feature extraction, mechanical property evaluation and power generation efficiency association analysis based on the fusion feature matrix, constructing a core feature set and attaching a reliability label, constructing a high-fidelity virtual mapping model of the offshore photovoltaic power generation system based on the fusion feature matrix and the core feature set, and simulating real-time dynamic interaction of a physical entity and a virtual model through the high-fidelity virtual mapping model, multi-physical field coupling simulation and full life cycle visual management.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Autonomous investigation and decision-making method and system for distribution network uninterrupted operation unmanned aerial vehicle group
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous investigation and decision-making method and system for an unmanned aerial vehicle group for distribution network uninterrupted operation, and mainly relates to the field of distribution network uninterrupted operation. The system comprises a step from task issuing to report generation, a step of acquiring and AI processing through multi-sensor fusion, a step of providing objective and quantized data base for safety analysis, and a step of quickly and automatically converting a physical site into an interactive and analyzable digital twin body, so that the system has the capability of coping with environmental changes, and can optimize own investigation strategy through history data learning, thereby realizing the crossing from 'automation' to 'intellectualization'. The invention has the beneficial effects that the invention can solve the technical problems of insufficient flexibility and larger subsequent data processing capacity in the exploration of the existing unmanned aerial vehicle, improves the flexibility of the route in the exploration process, and reduces the difficulty and the workload of subsequent data processing.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;SHANDONG WUZHOU HEXING DESIGN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Offshore wind power environment element coupling forecasting method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coupling forecasting method and device for elements of an offshore wind power environment, which belong to the technical field of offshore wind power environment forecasting, are based on a wind-wave-current deep coupling mechanism of an MCT coupler and a power dependent design of sea ice and storm surge on a coupling result, realize full-chain coupling of five elements of wind, wave, current, ice and tide from data assimilation and cooperative calculation to result output, remarkably improve the integral precision and physical consistency of multi-element association forecasting in a complex marine environment, realize the design of a customized output module aiming at multi-scene requirements of the offshore wind power, realize the precise adaptation of forecasting data and practical application, creatively establish the sea ice and storm surge forecasting on a power frame driven by wind-wave-current coupling, and overcome the limitations of a traditional experience model.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for hierarchical and regional visual modeling of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for visual modeling of layering and partitioning of a power distribution network, which comprise the steps of obtaining multi-source data of the power distribution network and unifying space-time references, dynamically partitioning the area where the power distribution network is located, constructing digital twin layering models of all the partitions by utilizing the multi-source data of the power distribution network and the unified space-time references and a power distribution network component library aiming at all the partitions, splicing the digital twin layering models of all the partitions, and adopting a deduction technology to render working condition scenes of the power distribution network to construct the digital twin layering models of the power distribution network. The method unifies the multi-source data to the same space-time coordinate system, eliminates the reference difference of the multi-source data, improves the positioning precision, builds a layered model by utilizing the multi-source data with the unified space-time reference, solves the problem of splitting the geographic coordinate and electrical connection relation of equipment, builds a standardized component library, improves modeling flexibility and multiplexing capacity under different scenes, builds a seamless splicing mechanism of the partitioned model, and breaks through the limitation that the local update of the large-scale power distribution network model needs integral reconstruction.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Multidimensional information fusion processing system for photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The multi-dimensional information fusion processing system for the photovoltaic power station is characterized in that processing of massive operation data of the photovoltaic power station is achieved through a cooperative framework of an edge computing layer, a fog computing layer and a cloud platform layer, accurate real-time accounting of carbon emission of the full life cycle of the power station is achieved through construction of a dynamic carbon intensity model, indirect influences such as indirect power grid replacement emission are taken into consideration, and accordingly reliable basis is provided for carbon transaction income calculation, a digital twin body is constructed through the cloud platform layer, a randomness optimization model is operated, economic value and carbon footprint of different operation strategies in long-term operation can be evaluated in a simulation environment, comprehensive influences of various uncertainty factors in the future are fully considered, finally comprehensive balance and fusion decisions are conducted on multiple dimensions such as economy, risk and environmental protection through a multi-attribute value function model, comprehensive optimal operation and maintenance strategies are output, and collaborative optimization of economic benefit, operation safety and carbon emission reduction benefit is achieved.
assignees: LONGYUAN BEIJING NEW ENERGY ENGINEERING DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;LONGYUAN BEIJING SOLAR ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid engineering planning scheme optimization management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid engineering planning scheme optimization management system based on digital twinning, in particular to the technical field of power system planning, which comprises a data perception and fusion module, the system comprises a dynamic interactive digital twin module, an uncertainty quantization and scene generation module, a multi-target self-adaptive robust optimization module and a cross-stage collaborative management module. According to the invention, the digital twin body is driven by real-time data to carry out multi-time scale dynamic deduction, an uncertainty scene set is constructed by utilizing a depth generation model, a distributed robust optimization model aiming at minimizing the worst expected cost is further adopted to generate a robust optimal planning scheme with strong adaptability, and finally, lossless transmission and closed-loop feedback of planning results to a design and construction stage are realized through a digital passport mechanism, so that the robustness, economy and full life cycle management efficiency of the planning scheme are remarkably improved.

title_en: Underground space fire-fighting early warning method, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twinning-based underground space fire-fighting early warning method, equipment and medium, and relates to the technical field of intelligent fire fighting; the method comprises the steps of judging fire state of a node network to obtain fire state parameters, deducing change conditions of the fire state parameters in real time through fire trend analysis to determine tunnel fire evolution trend data, dynamically rendering through smoke and thermodynamic diagram based on the fire evolution trend data to obtain simulation scenes of tunnel fire evolution, and carrying out personnel evacuation simulation on a tunnel according to the simulation scenes to determine real-time personnel evacuation planning under tunnel fire. The method solves the technical problem that fire prediction is inconvenient in fire-fighting early warning of the tunnel underground space in the prior art.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR WISDOM BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-based power distribution network multi-target intelligent scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a digital twin-based power distribution network multi-target intelligent scheduling method and system, and relates to the technical field of power distribution networks. The scheduling method comprises the steps of obtaining physical information data of a power distribution network to form multi-source data, constructing a digital twin model according to the multi-source data, processing the multi-source data to obtain scheduling tasks, and carrying out optimizing scheduling in the digital twin model according to the scheduling tasks to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme of the scheduling tasks. According to the method, the multi-target intelligent scheduling of the power distribution network is realized, the comprehensive economic cost of power grid operation is minimized, the resource allocation is optimized, the voltage deviation of all nodes is minimized, the voltage is ensured to be in a stable and safe range, the equipment damage is avoided, and the cost is saved.
assignees: BEIJING STATE GRID INFORMATION TELECOMMNICATION GROUP ACCENTURE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent water management system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent water management system based on deep learning, which comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a topology modeling module, a state initialization module, a state evolution calculation module, a multi-objective decision module, a physical constraint projection module, a dynamic simulation feedback module and a dynamic simulation feedback module, wherein the data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for acquiring water supply network data and constructing a standardized water supply network input tensor, the topology modeling module is used for generating a water supply network graph structure and graph structure representation thereof, the state initialization module is used for fusing the input tensor and the graph structure to generate an initial state vector, the state evolution calculation module is used for establishing an augmented state evolution equation and carrying out self-adaptive integration to generate a predicted state sequence and source sink estimation, the multi-objective decision module is used for constructing a comprehensive cost function and generating a pump station and valve control instruction, the physical constraint projection module is used for executing water pressure, flow velocity and water age constraint projection and outputting an executable scheduling instruction, and the dynamic simulation feedback module is used for carrying out digital twin simulation and updating a model and sparse estimation weight. The invention realizes fine control and dynamic feedback optimization of the water affair system, and improves the operation efficiency and the dispatching intelligence level.
assignees: CHONGQING AIPAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system safety risk prediction method based on digital twinning and related device
abstract_en: The application provides the technical field of power systems, and particularly provides a digital twinning-based power system security risk prediction method and a related device. The application can acquire the operator data, tool data, planning ticket data and system environment data related to the operation of the electric power system in real time, and accordingly update the twin body state of the electric power safety digital twin body, so that the electric power safety digital twin body can be linked with the real situation of the physical world in real time, and the multi-source heterogeneous data of operators, operation plans, operation tools, system environment and the like are deeply fused, thereby providing comprehensive data support for risk analysis. The risk coupling model can be based on the updated twin body state to carry out real-time deduction on the security risk which is continuously changed in the operation process, so that advanced early warning and quantification of the security risk can be realized, and potential security risks possibly related in the field operation process of the electric power system can be comprehensively and accurately predicted.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINGKAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Thermal power plant dispatching optimization method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a thermal power plant dispatching optimization method based on multi-source data fusion, which belongs to the technical field of operation and control of power systems and comprises the steps of accessing multi-source data through a containerized micro-service cluster and a mixed communication protocol, generating a high-precision space-time feature matrix through cubic spline interpolation optimized by combining sub-millisecond clock synchronization and genetic algorithm, constructing a mixed model integrating data driving and thermodynamic mechanisms, extracting deep features through wavelet and improved empirical mode decomposition, realizing cooperative optimization of economy and safety through a multi-target optimization algorithm and an intelligent evolution strategy, deploying a hierarchical fault-tolerant architecture and a simulation environment based on a high-speed distributed computing platform and a digital twin technology, and introducing a Kalman filtering closed-loop feedback and online self-learning mechanism to enable the model to have self-evolution capability. The method can remarkably improve the prediction precision, the adjustment performance and the operation economy of the dispatching of the thermal power generating unit, and simultaneously ensure the safety and the stability of the system.
assignees: BAOTOU NO 1 THERMAL POWER PLANT OF BEIFANG UNITED ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based system and method for improving toughness of distribution network under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based system for improving toughness of a power distribution network under typhoon disasters, which comprises a physical model layer, a data interaction layer, a simulation model layer and an application service layer, wherein the physical model layer is used for acquiring geographical information of the power distribution network, equipment account data of the power distribution network, topological structures of the power distribution network, user load information and historical typhoon scene libraries, the data interaction layer is used for accessing data acquired by the physical model layer, the simulation model layer is used for simulating typhoon fields, equipment failure rate calculation, typhoon scene simulation, load loss calculation, equipment toughness calculation and equipment vulnerability sequencing, and the application service layer is used for providing a reinforcement strategy for the power distribution network to cope with typhoon disasters. The utility model also discloses a method for improving the toughness of the distribution network under typhoon disasters based on digital twinning. According to the invention, real-time synchronization of a physical entity and a digital model is realized, multi-source heterogeneous data are deeply fused, and the reinforcement requirements of power distribution network equipment in two different reinforcement modes facing typhoon disasters are met by embedding two different toughness promotion models.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Oil product degradation intelligent analysis and operation and maintenance evaluation system of power plant host equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil product degradation intelligent analysis and operation and maintenance evaluation system of power plant host equipment, which relates to the technical field of power plant key equipment state monitoring and fault prediction, and comprises a multi-mode sensing module, an edge preprocessing unit, a dynamic reference model construction module, a residual analysis engine, a mirror image diagnosis engine, a fault tracing module and a self-evolution digital twin platform, the multi-mode sensing module is deployed in a lubrication loop of a power plant host device and is used for collecting physical characteristic parameters, pollution state parameters, electrochemical characteristic parameters and abrasion information parameters of oil in real time. The intelligent analysis and operation and maintenance evaluation system for oil degradation of the power plant host equipment realizes high-precision real-time monitoring of multiple parameters of oil states, effectively identifies and filters environmental interference data, ensures accuracy and reliability of fault diagnosis, ensures that the identification time of abnormal states of the equipment is advanced, and effectively controls false alarm conditions.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHENENG YUEQING POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment fault maintenance and debugging system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution equipment maintenance, in particular to a power equipment fault maintenance debugging system and method, wherein the system comprises a multi-mode data fusion acquisition module, a digital twin fault simulation positioning unit, a self-adaptive debugging execution module, a maintenance safety linkage control unit and a full life cycle data closed-loop management module; the method comprises the steps of multidimensional data acquisition, digital twin simulation positioning, self-adaptive strategy debugging, safety linkage monitoring and data closed-loop optimization. According to the invention, the problem of single traditional data is solved through multi-mode data fusion, the 1:1 simulation positioning of a fault scene is realized by combining digital twinning, the self-adaptive module can be automatically matched with various fault debugging strategies, the safety linkage unit interacts with the power grid dispatching system in real time through an IEC61850 protocol, the automatic early warning/power failure of the electric parameter of the overhaul region is realized, the data closed loop module optimizes the strategy library based on historical overhaul data, so that the overhaul efficiency is improved, and the debugging period is shortened.
assignees: UNIV NORTHWEST MINZU

title_en: Urban rail transit emergency command method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of urban rail transit emergency command, and in particular relates to a digital twinning-based urban rail transit emergency command method, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data and setting emergency triggering conditions; the invention provides a track traffic command method, which solves the problems of how to estimate the flow direction of people and give an evacuation strategy when a camera is shielded by smoke or powered off in the scene of urban track traffic, and can realize the estimation of the flow direction of people without line of sight and give an evacuation command according to the estimated flow direction.
assignees: HANGZHOU CHUANGMING ZHICAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment state monitoring system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power equipment state monitoring system based on a digital twin technology, and relates to the technical field of crossing of the digital twin technology and power equipment. The invention constructs the digital twin model of the power equipment by layering, combines geometric simplification and feature preservation to realize model optimization, and adapts different terminal performances by a dynamic loading mechanism to cooperate with feature extraction and visual display, thereby bringing multiple benefits. The hierarchical management ensures that the model accurately reflects the equipment structure and parameters, simplifies the processing balance precision and resource requirements, improves the adaptability and efficiency of the system by dynamic loading, and facilitates the rapid identification of anomalies by visually presenting the equipment state through color mapping by feature visualization. The standardized display logic reduces the learning cost, and the whole scheme improves the equipment monitoring accuracy and the management efficiency, ensures the safe and stable operation of the power equipment, and has strong practicability.
assignees: JINING XINNENG THERMAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: System and method for providing optimal digital twin operation platform for improving reliability of smart energy community
title_ko: 스마트 에너지커뮤니티 신뢰성 향상을 위한 디지털트윈 최적 운영 플랫폼 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and method for providing an optimal digital twin operation platform, according to an embodiment, secure system stability for an industrial complex target operation platform, thereby improving power quality reliability. In addition, the system and method for providing an optimal digital twin operation platform for improving the reliability of a smart energy community, according to an embodiment, can quickly respond to the operation and management of the smart energy community by using a digital twin. In addition, in an embodiment, it is possible to simulate various situations by using the same data as an actual operating situation through modeling using the digital twin.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 디지털트윈 최적 운영 플랫폼 제공 시스템 및 방법은 산업단지 대상 운영 플랫폼을 위해 계통 안정도를 확보하여, 전력품질 신뢰성을 향상시킨다. 또한, 실시예에 따른 스마트 에너지커뮤니티 신뢰성 향상을 위한 디지털트윈 최적 운영 플랫폼 제공 시스템 및 방법은 디지털 트윈을 통해 스마트 에너지 커뮤니티의 운영과 관리에 빠르게 대응할 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 실시예에서는 디지털 트윈을 통한 모델링을 통해 실제 운영 상황과 동일한 데이터를 이용하여, 다양한 상황에 대한 시뮬레이션을 가능하게 한다.
assignees: POWER21 CORP

title_en: Method for managing energy using digital twin and electronic device performing the same
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 사용하여 에너지를 관리하는 방법 및 이를 수행하는 전자 장치
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따른 에너지 관리 방법은 제1 물류 센터에서 제1 전력 정보를 수신하는 단계; 제2 물류 센터에서 제2 전력 정보를 수신하는 단계; 및 상기 제1 전력 정보 및 상기 제2 전력 정보에 기초하여 상기 제1 물류 센터 및 상기 제2 물류 센터의 에너지 분배를 제어하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: INS CO LTD

title_en: Power plant flue gas carbon emission real-time prediction and calibration method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon emission real-time prediction, and relates to a method for predicting and calibrating the carbon emission of power plant smoke in real time based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the steps of constructing a real-time simulation model by collecting operation, fuel, equipment state, environment and historical data, analyzing time sequence data by adopting an ARIMA model to obtain an input and output data set, training the input and output data set by using an LSTM network, optimizing the super parameters of the prediction model through cross verification and whale optimization algorithm, adding mass conservation penalty items into the loss function, outputting a CO2 emission curve through inputting load plans, weather forecast data and a fuel schedule, automatically executing an optimization instruction to generate an operation optimization strategy through setting a carbon optimization mode button, and minimizing predicted carbon emission on the premise of meeting the load demands of a power plant and environmental protection standards.
assignees: UNIV NANJING NORMAL

title_en: Tunnel landslide body morphology analysis system and method based on multidimensional data fusion
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of pipeline construction monitoring and discloses a tunnel landslide body form analysis system and method based on multidimensional data fusion. The method corresponds to the system. The method for predicting the deformation of the landslide body by adopting the decomposition prediction method of displacement components improves the accuracy and the reliability of the deformation prediction of the landslide body, enables a stability assessment result to have high accuracy of machine learning and strong interpretation of a physical model through weighted fusion of a multi-modal neural network model and an intensity folding subtraction method, improves the accuracy and the reliability of a digital twin body through establishing joint inversion of multi-source exploration data and real-time monitoring data, and realizes collaborative monitoring and early warning of the stability of the landslide and the safety state of a pipeline by constructing a complete technical chain from data acquisition, fusion analysis to early warning release, thereby providing an overall process and integrated safety guarantee for the construction of a gas pipeline tunnel.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 5 ENG GROUP;CHINA RAILWAY NO 5 ENG GROUP SOUTH CHINA ENG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-level supply chain service ecological digital twin network collaborative optimization system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of supply chain cooperation, in particular to a multi-level supply chain service ecological digital twin network cooperation optimization system which comprises a system and is used for constructing, optimizing and executing a supply chain digital twin network, wherein the system comprises a physical sensing layer, a physical sensing layer and a control layer, wherein the physical sensing layer is used for acquiring physical entity data and business state data of a whole link of a supply chain in real time through an interface of Internet of things equipment and an information system; the system comprises a physical perception layer, a data fusion and twinning construction layer, a multi-attribute utility theory and a block chain intelligent contract, wherein the physical perception layer is in communication connection with the data fusion and twinning construction layer and is used for carrying out fusion and standardization processing on acquired multi-source heterogeneous data and based on a unified supply chain knowledge graph, realizing full-flow accurate mapping and real-time visualization of a supply chain by constructing a multi-level digital twins, automatically optimizing among multiple targets such as cost aged carbon emission and the like by using an intelligent optimization algorithm, dynamically scheduling third party service resources based on the multi-attribute utility theory, realizing cross-organization credible cooperation by means of the block chain intelligent contract, and forming a complete intelligent closed loop for executing optimization of perception decisions.
assignees: UNIV NANNING NORMAL

title_en: Power grid emergency material intelligent supply chain dynamic allocation and priority ordering method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of power grid emergency management and intelligent supply chains, in particular to a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, comprising the steps of constructing a digital twin environment model integrating geographic information, real-time traffic, inventory status and fault prediction; defining a reinforcement learning framework, wherein a state space covers stock, in-transit materials, demand urgency and traffic states, an action space comprises material allocation instructions and task priority ordering, a reward function synthesizes shortage relief, delivery timeliness and cost, and a strategy network capable of outputting optimal dynamic allocation strategies is obtained through training an intelligent agent. The invention realizes intelligent dynamic allocation and priority optimization of emergency materials, and effectively improves the emergency response efficiency and resource utilization rate of the power grid.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based supply chain data risk identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of supply chain risk management and control, in particular to a digital twinning-based supply chain data risk identification method and a digital twinning-based supply chain data risk identification system, which are characterized in that humidity, static electricity and temperature parameters of each level of a shelf are collected through deployment of a layered environment monitoring sensor network, the loss of electronic components of each level is calculated by combining a position differential loss model, the actual residual inventory of each level is updated, the number of days of local support of a bottom layer is calculated through a priority consumption simulation engine, acquiring an upstream supplier delay risk level through a supply chain risk interface, adopting a time window overlap matching algorithm to perform association analysis, triggering a outage alarm, the system comprises a layered environment monitoring unit, a position binding loss calculating unit, a layered inventory updating unit and a local risk analysis unit, solves the problems of inaccurate inventory loss, deviation of supporting days and early warning delay of outage, and improves the accuracy of risk identification.
assignees: ZIBO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fire-fighting early warning method, fire-fighting early warning equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire-fighting early warning method, equipment and medium, which comprises the steps of collecting fire-fighting equipment operation data, determining the operation state of the fire-fighting equipment operation data through signal analysis and parameter comparison, preprocessing environment sensor monitoring data to obtain standard monitoring data, determining fusion weights of sensors according to scene fire risk characteristics, constructing a space-time diagram model, inputting the space-time diagram model into a space-time diagram neural network, optimizing the weights through reinforcement learning, extracting dynamic fusion characteristics, inputting a characteristic into a time sequence prediction model, outputting a future preset period risk prediction sequence, inputting the dynamic characteristics and the prediction sequence into a digital twin model for simulation verification, outputting an early warning result, and generating a treatment instruction by using a causal inference screening cooperative agent according to the early warning and the space-time diagram. The application greatly reduces false alarm rate and improves early warning efficiency through cognitive closed loop of sensing, fusion, prediction and verification.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR WISDOM BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based virtual power plant demand response optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based virtual power plant demand response optimization method and a digital twinning-based virtual power plant demand response optimization system, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a user side digital twinning model according to historical state information of household loads of a user, defining an action set and applying the action set to the user side digital twinning model to obtain current moment state information of the user side digital twinning model, setting a comfort barrier function and calculating comfort; and carrying out iterative updating on the corresponding values of the environment input and the action set by combining the rewarding value through a deep Q network to obtain a dynamic adjustment strategy for realizing the power demand response.
assignees: HUBEI CHUZHIYI NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;CHINA NUCLEAR HUINENG HUBEI NEW ENERGY CO LTD;UNIV HUBEI EDUCATION;HUBEI HUACHEN KAILONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;XIAOGAN GUANGYUAN ELECTRIC POWER GROUP CO LTD;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD QIANJIANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Power grid panoramic self-driving control method, system, equipment and medium based on source network charge storage cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid panoramic self-driving control method, a system, equipment and a medium based on source network charge storage coordination, which belong to the technical field of power grid intelligent control and comprise the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of source, network, charge and storage sides for preprocessing, calculating through a state estimation model, and generating a power grid panoramic real-time operation situation; the method comprises the steps of predicting through a multi-resource self-adaptive assessment model to obtain the joint adjustment capability of source network charge storage, assessing the adjustable reserve capacity in combination with the operation situation, calculating and outputting risk indexes through a first algorithm, calculating through a second algorithm to obtain operation risk values, classifying the operation risk values, and solving through an optimization model aiming at risk relief to generate the self-adaptive scheduling instruction. According to the invention, by combining a dynamic scheduling mechanism of source network load storage coordination and risk level self-adaptive matching scheduling resources, the defects of lack of coordination and passive risk coping in the traditional scheduling mode are overcome, and the running safety and economy of the power grid are improved.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation efficiency loss evaluation method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power generation loss evaluation, in particular to a photovoltaic power generation efficiency loss evaluation method and system based on multi-source data fusion, comprising the steps of acquiring an original data sequence through a plurality of sensor groups distributed on a photovoltaic module array; the method comprises the steps of carrying out localized preprocessing on an original data sequence to generate a standardized data packet, fusing the standardized data packet to generate a high-quality fused data set, inputting the fused data set and space topology information of a photovoltaic array into a pre-trained space-time diagram neural network model together, carrying out deduction in a digital twin virtual environment constructed based on a photovoltaic power station, outputting theoretical generated energy under the current environment and a dust accumulation state, calculating a power generation efficiency loss value, generating a loss distribution cloud image, generating a visual chart and a cleaning strategy suggestion, and sending a cleaning instruction to an external cleaning execution system through a decision interface, so that the power generation efficiency prediction accuracy is effectively improved, and the accurate suggestion is provided for the cleaning instruction.
assignees: WUSHI HUANENG NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Cloud-edge cooperation-based thermal power plant risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of risk early warning of thermal power plants, and relates to a thermal power plant risk early warning method and system based on cloud edge cooperation, wherein the method realizes risk early warning by the following steps that S1, a multi-source sensor deployed through an edge node is used for collecting vibration, temperature, oil pressure data and equipment logs of a steam turbine; the method comprises the steps of S2, constructing a blockchain network, encrypting, slicing and storing acquired data, executing multi-node consensus verification, S3, carrying out semantic annotation and feature fusion on the verified data to generate a structural feature matrix, S4, constructing a digital twin model based on the fusion features, simulating the running state of a steam turbine in real time, and S5, generating a three-dimensional visual early warning report when abnormal features are monitored. The invention can realize the omnibearing monitoring of the running state of the steam turbine, can obviously improve the safety and the running efficiency of the steam turbine and ensure the long-term stability and the high-efficiency running of the equipment.
assignees: QINGDAO HUAFENG WEIYE ELECTRIC POWER TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Full life cycle management method and system of digital twin-based energy storage power supply
abstract_en: The invention provides a full life cycle management method and a full life cycle management system of an energy storage power supply based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of life cycle management, and are used for establishing a digital twinning model for the energy storage power supply, acquiring periodic acquisition data, synchronizing the data, acquiring a power supply monitoring model, and respectively carrying out different working condition state prediction and periodic state prediction according to the power supply monitoring model to acquire different working condition state data and periodic state prediction data; carrying out the change analysis of the acquired data of the next period of the energy storage power supply to obtain period change analysis data and determine the abnormal factor information of the period change, abnormal factor early warning and adjustment are carried out until full life cycle data are obtained, and linkage intelligent life cycle analysis and management of the energy storage power supply are realized through the intelligent life cycle analysis and management method.
assignees: HUNAN JUSHEN ELECTRONICS CO LTD;HUNAN PENGYAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, device and system for providing optimization solution of solar power generation system based on digital twin with environment variable applied
title_ko: 환경 변수가 적용된 디지털 트윈 기반 태양광 발전 시스템의 최적화 솔루션 제공 방법, 장치 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 일실시예에 따르면, 장치에 의해 수행되는, 환경 변수가 적용된 디지털 트윈 기반 태양광 발전 시스템의 최적화 솔루션 제공 방법에 있어서, 제1 구역에서 태양광 발전 시스템이 운영되고 있는 경우, 상기 제1 구역 내에 설치된 시설 중에서 태양광 패널을 제1 그룹으로 분류하고, 상기 제1 구역 내에 설치된 시설 중에서 태양광 패널 이외에 나머지 기타 구조물을 제2 그룹으로 분류하는 단계; 상기 제1 구역 내에 설치된 시설을 상기 제1 구역의 실제 공간과 대응하는 가상 공간에 배치하여, 상기 제1 구역을 디지털 트윈으로 구현한 제1 가상 공간을 생성하는 단계; 상기 제1 구역의 기상 정보를 기반으로, 미리 설정된 제1 기간 동안 상기 제1 구역의 기상 상태를 나타내는 제1 기상 정보를 생성하는 단계; 상기 제1 기상 정보를 환경 변수로 적용한 상태에서, 상기 제1 기간 동안 상기 제1 가상 공간 상에 구현되어 있는 상기 제1 구역의 태양광 발전 시스템의 가동에 대한 시뮬레이션을 수행하여, 제1 시뮬레이션 결과를 생성하는 단계; 상기 제1 시뮬레이션 결과를 기반으로, 상기 제1 구역의 태양광 발전 시스템에 대한 최적 가동 시간을 분석하는 단계; 및 상기 제1 구역의 태양광 발전 시스템이 상기 제1 기간 동안 상기 최적 가동 시간에만 가동되도록 제어하는 단계를 포함하는, 환경 변수가 적용된 디지털 트윈 기반 태양광 발전 시스템의 최적화 솔루션 제공 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: SEONG CHI JUN

title_en: Hydrogen convergence microgrid integrated energy management system based on digital twin and operation method thereof
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 수소 융복합 마이크로 그리드 통합 에너지 관리 시스템 및 이의 운용 방법
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 수소 융복합 마이크로 그리드 통합 에너지 관리 시스템 은 물을 전기 분해하여 수소를 생산하는 수전해 장치, 상기 수소를 저장하는 수소 탱크, 상기 수소 탱크에 저장된 수소의 량을 추산하는 수소 탱크 상태 추정 장치, 상기 수소를 이용하여 전력을 생산하는 연료 전지, 태양광, 풍력, 수력, 지열, 바이오 에너지, 해양 에너지 중 어느 하나 이상을 이용하여 전력을 생산하는 신재생 발전 장치, 상기 연료 전지 또는 상기 신재생 발전 장치로부터 생산된 상기 전력을 저장하는 배터리, 상기 수소 탱크 및 상기 배터리에 저장되는 수소 및 전력 량의 분배를 결정하는 수요 분배 제어부 및 상기 수소 탱크 상태 추정 장치 및 상기 수요 분배 제어부로부터 수집된 데이터를 기반으로, 상기 저장된 수소 및 전력량을 시뮬레이션하여 최적의 유지보수 타이밍을 생성하는 가상물리시스템부를 포함한다.
assignees: UPTEC

title_en: Urban flood real-time dynamic risk assessment method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city flood real-time dynamic risk assessment method based on multi-source data fusion, belonging to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of smart cities; the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting physical perception data, virtual perception data and forecast data in parallel, then generating a dynamic flood deep water field with high space-time resolution through fusion and simplification of hydrodynamic model simulation, data assimilation correction and video and social multimedia ponding information identification, further carrying out real-time dynamic risk assessment by combining multidimensional disaster-bearing body data such as population, infrastructure and traffic to generate a comprehensive risk index, and finally visualizing the result and issuing early warning. The method effectively solves the problems of lag evaluation and low space precision of the traditional method, realizes accurate and dynamic sensing and evaluation of urban flood risk minute-level updating by introducing a multi-source data fusion and feedback learning mechanism, and remarkably improves urban flood prevention emergency response capability.
assignees: SUZHOU JIUZHANG TONGSUAN INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Household photovoltaic fault state estimation method based on multidimensional data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional data fusion household photovoltaic fault state estimation method, wherein construction operation of a household photovoltaic three-dimensional distribution electronic map can be carried out through a three-dimensional modeling component, household photovoltaic can be partitioned through position information of the household photovoltaic, weather conditions and output of the household photovoltaic in a subarea are consistent, a photovoltaic current value of the household photovoltaic component can be calculated through set power of the household photovoltaic component and actual generated energy data of the household photovoltaic component, so that preliminary judgment of the faulty household photovoltaic is achieved, then a preset power generation normal coefficient is determined based on marked historical generated energy data of the household photovoltaic through a normal distribution algorithm and a gradient descent method, a preset power generation interval of the household photovoltaic component is calculated according to the preset power generation normal coefficient, and finally the preset power generation interval is compared with an actual generated current value, so that final judgment of the faulty household photovoltaic is achieved.
assignees: XUCHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Real-time monitoring and early warning method and system for hoisting operation of wind generating set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring and early warning method and a system for hoisting operation of a wind turbine generator, and relates to the technical field of wind turbine generator construction, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a hoisting operation site, collecting state data in real time for dynamic coupling, and constructing a virtual monitoring network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out short-time Cheng Chaoqian parallel simulation in the network to obtain future state track clusters under different potential interferences, extracting key safety index time sequences from the track clusters, calculating future instability risk probability, generating multi-level early warning information and triggering active intervention when the risk probability exceeds an adaptive early warning threshold value. The invention solves the technical problems that the instability risk is difficult to identify and intervene in time due to the lack of real-time prediction of the system state in the complex environment in the existing hoisting operation of the wind generating set, and achieves the technical effects of real-time early warning and effective intervention in the hoisting process by constructing a digital twin monitoring network and performing risk propagation prediction.
assignees: ZHONGWEI MAIDUOSHAN NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Real-time monitoring and risk early warning system for hazardous waste storage environment based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence environment monitoring, and particularly discloses a digital twinning-based real-time monitoring and risk early warning system for dangerous waste storage environment, which is used for acquiring multi-modal environment data in real time through an intelligent sensor network deployed in a dangerous waste storage facility and constructing a digital twinning model synchronous with a physical entity; the method comprises the steps of calculating virtual risk parameters of an unmuted area based on environmental evolution rules by adopting a multi-mode data fusion and physical embedding technology, analyzing and identifying abnormal association modes between the measured data and the virtual risk parameters through a dynamic association network, realizing risk level judgment and early warning signal triggering, dynamically adjusting a sensor monitoring strategy according to an early warning result to form closed loop control, breaking through the sensor limitation of a traditional monitoring system, realizing advanced accurate early warning of hidden risks, and remarkably improving monitoring efficiency through self-adaptive resource allocation.
assignees: SHANDONG CHAOHUA ENVIRONMENTAL PROT INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD;HANGZHOU YUEHUA YUNTU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Diffusion model-based intelligent simulation assimilation method and device for water accumulation depth
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for intelligently simulating and assimilating a water accumulation depth based on a diffusion model, wherein the method comprises the steps of fully utilizing the advantages of the diffusion model based on Bayesian theory and data assimilation thought to realize efficient correction of the state of the flood model by means of limited real-time water accumulation monitoring data, effectively fusing priori distribution and real-time observation information by solving the logarithmic gradient of a posterior distribution function and guiding a sampling process, stabilizing the estimated regional water accumulation state under the condition of sparse monitoring points, obviously inhibiting error accumulation in model rolling calculation, and improving the business accuracy and practicability of urban flood deduction. Therefore, the problems that a systematic intelligent simulation-assimilation fusion system is not formed in the prior art, error accumulation in model rolling calculation is difficult to suppress and the like are solved.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Heat supply pipe network inspection decision method integrating multi-agent cooperation and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat supply pipe network routing decision method integrating multi-agent cooperation and digital twinning, which comprises the steps of establishing a heat supply pipe network digital twinning model through cooperative interaction of a model-level agent, an equipment-level agent and a logic-level agent, carrying out pipe network anomaly analysis through the digital twinning model to generate a pipe network temporary routing task, receiving routing total task requirements comprising the pipe network temporary routing task and a preset pipe network conventional routing task through a routing management agent, extracting routing key parameters, splitting and distributing the total task requirements through a routing task planning agent according to the routing key parameters and the resource capability characteristics of each routing equipment, enabling the routing equipment to obtain distributed routing subtask planning, outputting a scheduling action sequence of each routing equipment executing routing subtask through the routing task scheduling agent, issuing the routing equipment, executing a feedback routing report through the routing task execution feedback agent to generate a heat supply pipe network routing report and feeding back.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation amount analysis method based on multisource data analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic power generation amount analysis method based on multi-source data analysis, which comprises the steps of dividing a photovoltaic power station to be analyzed into M areas, respectively acquiring photovoltaic power generation multi-source data, periodically acquiring sub-area multi-source data, filling missing data based on a filling model for the missing data, further extracting features of the data formed after filling to obtain analysis features F1-Fn of multi-source complete data, and carrying out photovoltaic power generation amount analysis based on a mixed improved deep learning model. The method and the device realize accurate analysis of the generated energy under the condition of missing photovoltaic sensing data, and improve the accuracy and reliability of photovoltaic power generation operation monitoring.
assignees: JIANGSU POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA ENERGY ENG GROUP;HUANENG POWER INT JIANGSU ENERGY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH;JIANGSU ZINIE NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Embankment underwater piping detection positioning system integrating distributed optical fiber acoustics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dyke underwater piping detection positioning system integrating distributed fiber acoustics, which relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering safety monitoring and comprises a voiceprint signal perception primary screening module, a primary filtering module and a secondary filtering module, wherein the voiceprint signal perception primary screening module is used for acquiring original acoustic vibration signals in a strong noise environment, primarily purifying and separating the original acoustic vibration signals to acquire eigenmode functions of different frequency bands, and separating weak piping suspected signals submerged in background noise. According to the invention, by introducing a digital twin technology, the inferred seepage network is mapped into a high-precision fluid-structure coupling model, and the evolution process of water level abrupt change and other extreme working conditions is simulated in a virtual space, so that the system can calculate the final form, size and position of a burst, the consequences of piping disasters are pushed from fuzzy qualitative judgment to precise quantitative prediction, and the dynamic deduction and quantitative prediction of the piping disaster process based on a physical mechanism are realized.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Mechanism digital twin construction method and system for marine disaster safety analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a mechanism digital twin construction method and system for marine disaster safety analysis, the method comprises the steps of constructing two three-dimensional space-time digital twin bases to form two three-dimensional space-time data sets, determining a target area and influence factors causing storm tide in the target area, constructing a storm tide disaster prediction mechanism model matched with characteristics of the target area based on ADCIRC and a SWAN coupling model to predict water level and flow velocity data of each grid point, constructing a virtual meteorological model by combining terrain and meteorological data of the target area, extracting key airflow change points based on the virtual meteorological model, calculating adjustment coefficients corresponding to a current position area according to airflow change characteristics of the key airflow change points, optimally adjusting and controlling the water level and flow velocity data of each grid point at corresponding positions based on the adjustment coefficients corresponding to each key airflow change point, and embedding the prediction mechanism model into the two three-dimensional space-time digital twin bases to realize mechanism digital twin of marine disaster safety analysis.
assignees: STARGIS TIANJIN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent scaffold leveling method and system based on digital twin and space-time prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building construction safety monitoring and automatic control, and discloses an intelligent scaffold leveling method and system based on digital twinning and space-time prediction. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin body and a graph structure of a scaffold, collecting sensor data and outputting a deformation prediction sequence through a space-time graph convolution network, injecting the prediction sequence into the digital twin body to simulate and evaluate various leveling strategies, selecting an optimal strategy based on leveling precision and structural stability, executing leveling through an electromechanical executing mechanism, and updating model parameters and training the prediction network through the leveled data. The invention realizes the technical span from passive response to active prediction through the deep fusion of digital twin and space-time prediction, effectively solves the problems of response lag and control oscillation existing in the traditional leveling method, remarkably improves the leveling precision, efficiency and structural safety, and has self-adaptive optimization capability.
assignees: FIRST CO CHINA 8TH ENG BUREAU LTD

title_en: Intelligent substation state evaluation method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent substation state evaluation method and system, and relates to the technical field of state evaluation. And then introducing mass real-time fast data streams into the map frame, and dynamically mapping the node states by using a time sequence feature coding technology. And then, a complex message transmission and aggregation mechanism is carried out in the map structure through the relational awareness map neural network, so that node embedding characterization with local individuality and global commonality is generated. Finally, equipment risk prediction on a microscopic level and total station comprehensive evaluation on a macroscopic level are synchronously completed based on the high-dimensional characterization, and path backtracking and cause analysis are carried out on the high-risk state based on map relevance. Therefore, the problems of equipment health and system running state splitting can be solved, and intelligent substation panoramic state sensing and risk early warning with interpretability are realized.
assignees: HANGZHOU PENGTAI ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Reservoir area dynamic flooding assessment method based on DEM and digital twin
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of reservoirs, in particular to a reservoir area dynamic flooding assessment method based on DEM and digital twinning, which comprises the steps of obtaining reservoir multisource data to be measured, generating an initial DEM based on topographic data, carrying out depression correction and hydrologic analysis on the initial DEM, obtaining corrected DEM and depression-free water flow direction data, comparing grid elevation and forecast water level data with the corrected DEM as minimum judging units to define a preliminary flooding area, further screening an effective flooding range hydraulically communicated with a reservoir area main body to be measured from the preliminary flooding area based on depression-free water flow direction data through a seed propagation growth algorithm, carrying out spatial correlation and analysis on the effective flooding range and basic geographic information data, automatically identifying a flooded object, quantifying risk loss, and triggering early warning according to a preset grading early warning rule. The application can improve the evaluation precision and quantify the risk high-efficiency early warning.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SUPCON INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Real-time anti-misoperation verification method for switching of transformer fused with ground wire state
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent misoperation prevention, in particular to a real-time misoperation prevention verification method for a transformer switching gate fusing a grounding wire state, which comprises the steps of traversing the grounding wires in an electric power system, creating a grounding wire digital twin body for each grounding wire, and synchronizing physical hooking positions, numbers and state information of the grounding wires to an misoperation prevention verification system in real time; and fusing the digital twin body data of the grounding wire with multi-source heterogeneous data of the power grid, which comprises the power grid equipment standing book, the equipment state and the scheduling instruction. According to the invention, the digital twin bodies are created for each grounding wire and the state information of the digital twin bodies are synchronized in real time, so that the hanging position, the number and the state of the grounding wire can be comprehensively checked before switching operation, the operation object is ensured to be in a safe state, serious accidents such as live hanging of the grounding wire or closing of the grounding wire due to the unknown state of the grounding wire are avoided, and the operation safety is remarkably improved.
assignees: ZIYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORPORATION

title_en: Intelligent sensing and optimizing control method, system, equipment and medium for adjustable resources of power distribution network based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for intelligent sensing and optimizing control of an adjustable resource of a power distribution network based on data driving, which belong to the technical field of resource sensing optimization and comprise the steps of collecting operation data of the adjustable resource, and preprocessing to obtain a preprocessed data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a resource feature vector based on a preprocessing data set by using a multi-dimensional feature extraction method, carrying out feature recognition on resources through an intelligent clustering algorithm, realizing state recognition of resource adjustment capability based on obtained resource features and label information, constructing a dynamic model of an adjustable resource according to a state recognition result, carrying out online updating on model parameters based on a recursive least square method, taking the dynamic model of the adjustable resource as an environment basis, realizing multi-objective optimization regulation and control, and carrying out distributed consistency control based on a generated control strategy. The invention improves the accuracy of the adjustment capability identification, the optimization level of the control strategy and the stability and response efficiency of the system operation.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Energy storage electric intelligent system with self-adaptive control strategy
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy storage electric intelligent system with a self-adaptive control strategy, and relates to the technical field of power grids. The invention collects multisource operation data of a power grid, load, new energy and an energy storage system in real time through a sensing layer, a decision layer realizes accurate synchronization and updating of the operation state of the system by utilizing a digital twin model, integrates intelligent distributed optimization and extreme scene test of counterdeduction of groups, dynamically generates and screens out optimal control instructions which are robust under various working conditions, and finally an execution layer accurately controls the energy storage system to form a self-adaptive closed loop of sensing, decision-execution and feedback, so that the control strategy of the energy storage system can be automatically and accurately adjusted along with fluctuation of the operation state of the power grid, the rigidifying defect of a fixed strategy is overcome, the capability of the power grid for coping with source load fluctuation and sudden faults is enhanced, the self-adaptive matching of the control strategy of the energy storage system and the operation state of the power grid is realized, and the dynamic stability and operation safety of the power grid are improved.
assignees: GUOSHUN TECH GROUP CO LTD;GUANGDONG SMART GUOYUAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent collaborative supporting and recycling method for incomplete mining of special-shaped ore pillars in limited space
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent collaborative supporting and recycling method for incomplete mining of special-shaped ore pillars in a limited space, and belongs to the technical field of mining engineering. Aiming at the problems of narrow space, complex stress, high safety risk and the like faced by the recovery of the special-shaped ore pillars in a limited space, the method constructs an intelligent closed loop system of perception-decision-execution-feedback. The method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic digital twin model by utilizing LiDAR and GPR fusion detection, carrying out extraction-support collaborative optimization design based on numerical simulation and AI algorithm, carrying out accurate segmented extraction by adopting low-disturbance blasting and miniature intelligent equipment, synchronously implementing 'extraction-support-charge' cyclic operation, quickly constructing an artificial key layer by utilizing quick-setting expansion materials, and finally realizing multistage intelligent early warning and dynamic regulation through a multi-element sensing network. The invention can obviously improve the recovery rate of the residual mine resources to more than 90%, effectively control the ground pressure disasters and realize the green, safe and efficient recovery of the mine resources.
assignees: GANNAN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Dynamic health evaluation and predictive maintenance method for power equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic health degree assessment and predictive maintenance method for power equipment, and belongs to the technical field of operation and maintenance of railway power systems. The method comprises the steps of constructing a parameterized digital twin body of the power equipment, collecting real-time operation data, historical data and environment data, calculating equipment health components through a multi-model cooperation method based on the parameterized digital twin body and the collected data, fusing and generating comprehensive health indexes, generating equipment life prediction and maintenance decision according to the comprehensive health indexes, outputting an optimal maintenance strategy, and performing visual virtual previewing and augmented reality auxiliary execution on the optimal maintenance strategy to form a closed-loop maintenance system. The invention solves the problems of data and model fracture, model static stiffness and health assessment deficiency in the prior art, realizes dynamic perception, accurate assessment and predictive maintenance of equipment states, and improves operation and maintenance efficiency and system reliability.
assignees: SUN NANJING AUTOMATIC EQUIPMENTS CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin power plant capital construction multi-source heterogeneous data real-time fusion method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers, in particular relates to a digital twin real-time fusion method for multi-source heterogeneous data of a power plant capital construction, and aims to solve the problems of high data fusion delay, semantic rupture and poor system adaptability in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of constructing a unified space-time reference frame to achieve nanosecond time synchronization and space coordinate normalization, accessing and preprocessing multi-source data such as a building information model, an Internet of things sensor, a construction log and a video stream to generate a standardized unit with space-time metadata, carrying out semantic analysis and cross-modal feature alignment based on a power plant infrastructure ontology knowledge base, and achieving millisecond dynamic fusion by adopting an event-triggered streaming engine. The scheme realizes real-time fusion within 100 milliseconds, semantic alignment precision of more than 98 percent and state confidence of more than 90 percent, and improves 3 times of system throughput by relying on cloud edge collaborative architecture, thereby comprehensively supporting accurate twin mapping and intelligent decision of the whole power plant infrastructure process.
assignees: HUANENG SHANTOU HAIMEN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent landslide rainfall simulation system and method based on AI historical rainfall data drive
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent landslide rainfall simulation system and method based on AI historical rainfall data driving, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning. Through automatic fusion of multisource monitoring data and space-time feature extraction and combination of deep learning and physical mechanism modeling, dynamic coupling analysis and high-precision simulation of rainfall process and slope stability are realized. The system can sense rainfall, soil moisture content and slope deformation multi-class data in real time, intelligently identify landslide induction risk, output grading early warning information and support digital twin and self-adaptive risk optimization decisions. The landslide hazard risk assessment and early warning accuracy and response timeliness are remarkably improved, the landslide hazard risk assessment and early warning method has good intelligence, expansibility and practical application value, and is widely applicable to the fields of geological disaster prevention and control and engineering safety monitoring.
assignees: KUNMING COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY CENTER CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Digital twin river basin geological disaster early warning prevention and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-basin geological disaster early warning prevention and control system which comprises monitoring data such as rainfall, soil humidity, air temperature, earthquake, landslide, debris flow and the like, a risk judging module, a digital twin modeling module and a simulation system, wherein the monitoring data is used for collecting geological structures, land utilization conditions and vegetation coverage data in a current basin, the risk judging module is used for analyzing the collected data to judge whether geological disaster risks exist, the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a virtual basin geological disaster model by utilizing various collected data, simulating various disaster scenes occurring in the current basin and comprising landslide, debris flow and flood.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Flood disaster risk intelligent early warning method integrating multi-source information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent flood disaster risk early warning method integrating multi-source information, and relates to the technical field of flood disaster prediction, wherein the method acquires multi-source data such as meteorological, hydrology, topography, remote sensing, ground monitoring terminals and the like, and a unified data set is constructed through time synchronization, space resampling, outlier rejection and missing data filling; the method comprises the steps of constructing multidimensional space-time characteristics based on elements such as rainfall process, terrain characteristics, earth surface coverage, drainage capacity, river network structure and soil humidity, inputting the space-time characteristics into a multisource information fusion model, predicting flood occurrence probability in future time period, generating flood risk indexes according to the prediction probability, real-time monitoring and historical samples, dividing regional risks into different grades, automatically generating and releasing early warning information according to the risk grades, and carrying out feedback correction on early warning results through on-site monitoring and inspection data to achieve self-adaptive updating of early warning parameters and model structures.
assignees: GUANGXI VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF WATER RESOURCES AND ELECTRIC POWER;Jiangsu Climate Center

title_en: Energy storage power station health state early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for early warning of the health state of an energy storage power station based on digital twinning.
