The method comprises the steps of continuously collecting multi-dimensional time sequence operation data of key components of a battery cluster, a power conversion system and a temperature control system through a sensor network deployed in an entity power station, processing and extracting characteristics, calculating real-time quantitative indexes representing the health states of all subsystems, driving a digital twin body model to conduct data assimilation and parameter calibration by the indexes, realizing dynamic synchronization of the model states and physical entities, comprehensively evaluating the overall health states of the power station by adopting a weighted scoring rule based on the updated model states, generating health scores, and realizing hierarchical early warning by comparing the health scores with multilevel thresholds. The application realizes early perception and accurate early warning of performance degradation of the energy storage power station, and improves the intelligent level of operation and maintenance and the running reliability of the system.
assignees: HUANENG ENERGY TRAFFIC IND HOLDING CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission and transformation equipment maintenance and overhaul decision generation system, method, product and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission and transformation equipment maintenance and overhaul decision generation system, a method, a product and equipment, and relates to the technical field of power equipment state monitoring and operation and maintenance management, wherein the system comprises a perception layer, an intelligent brain layer and an application layer, and the perception layer acquires multi-source heterogeneous monitoring data; the intelligent brain layer extracts characteristic indexes through data fusion, a digital twin model fused with a multi-physical-field mechanism is constructed, fault prediction and health assessment are realized by adopting an AI algorithm, an overhaul strategy is generated based on multi-objective optimization, and the application layer provides a panoramic cockpit for visual interaction. The invention breaks through the limitations of data island, early warning lag and decision isolation in the traditional operation and maintenance through the technical chain of multi-source data fusion, digital twin, AI prediction and multi-target optimization, realizes the normal form transition from passive response to active prediction and from local optimization to global optimization, remarkably improves the accuracy, safety and economy of the operation and maintenance of the power transmission and transformation equipment, and has wide engineering application value.
assignees: STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ULTRAHIGH PRESSURE CO OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method integrating edge feature learning and graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network state estimation method integrating edge feature learning and graph neural network, and belongs to the field of power distribution network state estimation. The method comprises the steps of collecting measurement data covering various potential operation scenes of a power distribution network and constructing a data set, carrying out normalization processing on data in the data set, dividing a training set from the normalized data set, constructing a topological graph aiming at a researched power distribution network, constructing an initial node embedded feature matrix and an initial edge embedded feature matrix by using the data in the training set based on the constructed power distribution network topological graph, modeling a power distribution network state estimation problem as a state vector estimation problem, constructing a power distribution network state estimation model NEF-GRAPHSAGE, training the model by using the node embedded feature matrix and the edge embedded feature matrix, estimating the state of an actual power distribution network by using a trained NEF-GRAPHSAGE model, and obtaining a state estimation result of the actual power distribution network.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Digital twin platform mass homologous heterogeneous data loading and rendering method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin and multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, and discloses a method for loading and rendering massive homologous heterogeneous data of a digital twin platform. The method aims to solve the problems of low loading efficiency, large rendering fluctuation, data semantic splitting and the like in the prior art. The technical scheme includes that data preprocessing and associated index establishment are carried out, network state loading basic data is adapted during initialization, unified abstract layer standardized layer management is constructed, loading on demand and multi-level caching are achieved through an intelligent dispatcher, fusion rendering pipelines are configured to ensure 60FPS stable output, a service binding engine is operated to achieve bidirectional linkage, and measurement, model import, file preview, layer linkage and data maintenance are supported. The method and the system improve the loading efficiency of mass data, avoid memory overflow, strengthen service coordination and system stability, and are suitable for urban planning, industrial simulation, emergency command and other scenes.
assignees: CHONGQING ZIYOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Substation three-dimensional digital twin modeling system based on Beidou and laser radar fusion
abstract_en: The application relates to a transformer substation three-dimensional digital twin modeling system based on Beidou and laser radar fusion, which comprises a data acquisition module, a detection model construction module, an equipment fault detection module and an equipment fault positioning module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring an RGB image of electric equipment in a transformer substation to be inspected and laser radar point cloud data, the detection model construction module is used for introducing an SPD-Conv convolution module with depth separable convolution into a main network of a first fault detection model, updating a C2f module in the main network and a C2f module in front of a PAN-FPN structure in a neck network into an MSC2f module to construct a second fault detection model, the equipment fault detection module is used for inputting the RGB image of the electric equipment into the second fault detection model to determine equipment component fault types corresponding to the electric equipment in the transformer substation to be inspected, and the equipment fault positioning module is used for positioning the equipment component fault types corresponding to the electric equipment in the electric equipment three-dimensional model. The application can solve the problems of low inspection efficiency, poor precision, fuzzy positioning and the like of the existing transformer substation.
assignees: BEIJING ANXIN YIWEI TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG KEYI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network prediction auxiliary state estimation method and related device based on CNN-DBN pseudo measurement modeling
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network prediction auxiliary state estimation method and a related device based on CNN-DBN pseudo measurement modeling, which are used for constructing an input vector after preprocessing data by collecting historical data, meteorological data, date data and economic data of power distribution network node injection power; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on input vectors by using a pre-constructed convolutional neural network to obtain data after feature extraction, inputting the data after feature extraction into a pre-trained deep belief network to obtain predicted data of power distribution network node injection power, taking the predicted data as pseudo measurement data, and estimating a predicted auxiliary state of the power distribution network by adopting an unscented particle filtering algorithm in combination with real-time measurement data. According to the invention, the false measurement data is generated through CNN-DBN modeling, and the state estimation is performed by adopting unscented particle filtering in combination with the real-time measurement data, so that the accuracy and reliability of the real-time state estimation of the power distribution network are improved.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Photo-thermal power generation management method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a photo-thermal power generation management method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twin, which comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model corresponding to a photo-thermal power generation system according to the physical state of the photo-thermal power generation system, the dynamic characteristics of the photo-thermal power generation system and preset logic rules, inputting real-time data and/or prediction data into the digital twin model to obtain simulation operation information and/or simulation prediction information output by the digital twin model, analyzing the operation condition of the photo-thermal power generation system according to the simulation operation information, and predicting the power generation condition of the photo-thermal power generation system according to the simulation prediction information, so that the technical problems of complex management mode and low power generation efficiency of the photo-thermal power generation system in the prior art are solved, and the technical effects of simply and efficiently analyzing the operation condition of the photo-thermal power generation system and predicting the power generation condition of the photo-thermal power generation system are achieved.
assignees: STATE POWER INVEST GROUP QINGHAI PHOTOVOLTAIC INDUSTRY INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD;PHOTOVOLTAIC INDUSTRY TECH BRANCH OF QINGHAI HUANGHE HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;QINGHAI HUANGHE HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;SPIC HUANGHE HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;QINGHAI XIANJIN ENERGY STORAGE LABORATORY CO LTD

title_en: Rail transit turnout group autonomous cooperative operation and maintenance decision method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a method and a device for autonomously and cooperatively operating and maintaining a track traffic turnout group, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a turnout group digital twin body, mapping physical world states of turnout group equipment, respectively modeling into heterogeneous independent intelligent bodies, storing global states through a state space and storing different action sets through an action space, outputting proposal actions through the heterogeneous independent intelligent bodies, analyzing the global states and the proposal actions in real time by using a large language model LLM finely tuned by domain knowledge to evaluate the proposal actions of the heterogeneous independent intelligent bodies, generating a reward signal, training each intelligent body strategy network by adopting a multi-intelligent body near-end strategy optimization MAPPO algorithm, operating the trained intelligent body strategy network on line, and finally outputting an optimal cooperative decision scheme under multiple constraints by designing a parameterized action space for maintenance actions, evaluating and rewarding rationality of operation parameters by using the reward signals of the LLM.
assignees: TRAFFIC CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin irrigation area full life cycle intelligent management system oriented to grain safety
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grain safety, in particular to a digital twin irrigation area full life cycle intelligent management system oriented to grain safety, which comprises a data establishment end, a scheme generation end and a management execution end; the system comprises a data establishing end, a scheme generating end, a management executing end and a system data storage end, wherein the data establishing end is used for data acquisition and preprocessing of acquired data and provides data support for a subsequent module, the scheme generating end is used for establishing a digital twin model based on the acquired data and completing deduction of a scheme in the digital twin model, the management executing end is used for executing a scheme selection optimal scheme based on the scheme generating end and performing fine adjustment in an executing process to achieve an optimal effect, meanwhile, the system data is stored, and the system modules are in efficient data interaction linkage, and the traditional experience dependence is replaced by a data-driven prediction model and an intelligent optimization method, so that the system has the capabilities of accurate disaster response, risk benefit quantitative assessment and data safety multiplexing.

title_en: Space-time dual-channel-based method, equipment and medium for preprocessing district voltage data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time dual-channel-based platform region voltage data preprocessing method, equipment and medium, which are characterized in that obvious noise and missing values in original data are removed through non-supervision cleaning, input quality is ensured, space-time data processing is performed through construction of a space-time dual-channel model, wherein progressive anomalies of single-point equipment are captured by a time sequence channel, full scene coverage of independent anomalies and group anomalies can be realized through graph channel based on power grid topology identification relevance faults, noise and false anomalies can be effectively removed through state estimation physical verification and space-time continuity screening dual quality control, rationality of anomaly data captured through the space-time dual-channel model is verified through a state estimation correction loop, full scene coverage of independent anomalies and group anomalies can be realized, original single-point, single-time and single-machine low-precision cleaning is performed, the quality of the power quality data is improved, and the precision of data preprocessing is improved.
assignees: ZHUMADIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fire emergency management system based on digital twinning and intelligent sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency management system based on digital twinning and intelligent perception, which comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a fire digital twinning modeling module, a fire identification and evaluation module, a fire modeling module, a strategy generation and deduction module, a strategy execution module and a feedback updating module, wherein the data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for acquiring fire monitoring data and preprocessing, the fire digital twinning modeling module is used for constructing a fire digital twinning model, the fire identification and evaluation module is used for carrying out fire identification and risk evaluation through an improved EfficientFormer network, the fire modeling module is used for mapping a fire identification and risk evaluation result to the fire digital twinning model, judging a traffic state and a reachability state, the strategy generation and deduction module is used for deducting in the fire digital twinning model to generate a fire scheduling strategy, the strategy execution module is used for issuing the fire scheduling strategy and executing a fire emergency task, and the feedback updating module is used for updating an improved EfficientFormer network. According to the invention, the fire disaster identification precision and the emergency dispatching reliability under a complex scene are improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU HUAXIAO CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent safety control method and system for gas station based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twinning-based intelligent safety control method and a digital twinning-based intelligent safety control system for a gas station, which relate to the field of digital twinning and artificial intelligence; the method comprises the steps of extracting multidimensional characteristic data from a digital twin body, inputting the multidimensional characteristic data into a pre-trained long-short-period memory network model to predict the future state of equipment to obtain a prediction result, simulating the development process of at least one preset processing scheme in a virtual environment corresponding to the digital twin body based on the prediction result and a preset initial accident scene to obtain a drilling result corresponding to each preset processing scheme, and determining an optimal treatment scheme corresponding to the initial accident scene based on drilling scores. By implementing the method, the safety control level and emergency preparation capability of the gas station can be improved.
assignees: BEIJING ZHIDAKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power line operation and maintenance method and system based on digital twin body, medium and terminal
abstract_en: The application discloses a power line operation and maintenance method and system based on a digital twin body, a medium and a terminal, and the technical field of power line operation and maintenance, and mainly aims to solve the problem that the operation and maintenance efficiency and the power supply reliability are not effectively improved because the digital twin body is not deeply applied to the power line operation and maintenance at present. The method comprises the steps of obtaining hardware geometric data and current time physical data of a target power line to construct a current time digital twin body, carrying out simulation deduction operation on the target power line by utilizing the current time digital twin body to obtain a current time simulation deduction result, constructing a multi-target optimization decision model based on the current time simulation deduction result, and solving to obtain an optimal operation and maintenance strategy set to carry out operation and maintenance according to the optimal operation and maintenance strategy set.
assignees: WUHU FANCHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-based equipment fault diagnosis and insulation degradation prediction system
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 설비이상 진단 및 절연열화 예측 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반 또는 빌딩제어시스템 내부에서 아크카운터 및 새그카운터로 부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 계통고장 검출장치류;와 화재 및 지진(진동)발생시 상황을 검출하여 재난상황을 예측, 진단할 수 있도록 센서로부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 방재감시용 센서류; 상기 계통고장 검출장치류, 방재감시용 센서류로부터 생성된 데이터를 수집하여 DB에 저장하고, 필요 정보를 현장 모니터에 표시하는 설비이상 진단장치; 상기 설비이상 진단장치를 통해 고장원인을 포함하는 고장 데이터를 통신으로 전송받아 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템에 정보를 제공하는 가상시스템 통신모듈;을 포함하고 상기 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템은 센서 데이터 처리 모듈에서 제공하는 데이터를 기반으로, 열화경향 예측, 화재감시 및 예측 그리고 설비이상 진단을 위한 시뮬레이션을 시행하는 가상 시뮬레이션 모듈; 상기 시뮬레이션 모듈에서 시뮬레이션을 시행할 시 조건값, 경계값을 설정하는 파라미터 셋업모듈; 시뮬레이션을 통해 이미지를 디스플레이 하도록 데이터를 가공처리하여 현장 설비운영자에게 정보를 전달하는 디지털 트윈 그래픽 생성모듈;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 디지털 트윈 기반 설비이상 진단 및 절연열화 예측 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: GOLDTECH CO LTD

title_en: Camer with auto focus and light image stabilization function
title_ko: 자동 초점 및 광 이미지 안정화 기능을 갖는 카메라
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반 또는 빌딩제어시스템 내부에서 아크카운터 및 새그카운터로 부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 고장검출장치;와 화재 및 지진(진동)발생시 상황을 검출하여 재난상황을 예측, 진단할 수 있도록 센서로부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 방재감시장치; 상기 고장검출장치, 방재감시장치로부터 생성된 데이터를 수집하여 DB에 저장하고, 필요 정보를 현장 모니터에 표시하는 설비이상 진단장치; 상기 설비이상 진단장치를 통해 고장원인을 포함하는 고장 데이터를 통신으로 전송받아 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템에 정보를 제공하는 통신모듈;을 포함하고 상기 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템은 센서 데이터 처리 모듈에서 제공하는 데이터를 기반으로, 열화경향 예측, 화재감시 및 예측 그리고 설비이상 진단을 위한 시뮬레이션을 시행하는 가상 시뮬레이션 모듈; 상기 시뮬레이션 모듈에서 시뮬레이션을 시행할 시 조건값, 경계값을 설정하는 셋업모듈; 시뮬레이션을 통해 이미지를 디스플레이 하도록 데이터를 가공처리하여 현장 설비운영자에게 정보를 전달하는 디지털 트윈 그래픽 생성모듈;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 디지털 트윈 기반 설비이상 진단 및 절연열화 예측 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: GOLDTECH CO LTD

title_en: Voltage portrait construction method, system and medium based on multi-dimensional new energy enhanced characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voltage portrait construction method, a system and a medium based on multi-dimensional new energy enhancement type characteristics, which relate to the technical field of power data mining, and are characterized in that the method is improved based on the traditional voltage portrait construction technology, new energy output data is filled by considering new energy output missing data, when a characteristic vector is constructed, the characteristics related to the new energy are added to construct a multi-dimensional new energy enhancement type time sequence characteristic vector, cluster analysis is carried out based on the multi-dimensional new energy enhancement type time sequence characteristic vector, and central users of each typical voltage behavior category are extracted to construct representative voltage portraits, so that the voltage portraits method is better suitable for special requirements of high-proportion new energy access, and more accurate decision support is provided for platform planning, operation control and new energy absorption.
assignees: ZHUMADIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power distribution network bidirectional power flow coordination control method based on V2G aggregation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bidirectional power flow coordination control of power distribution networks and discloses a bidirectional power flow coordination control method of a power distribution network based on V2G aggregation, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a logic energy storage unit consisting of a plurality of V2G charging piles and vehicles supporting reverse discharge; and S2, aggregating the logic energy storage units into virtual power plant nodes which can be scheduled by a power grid through an Information Communication Technology (ICT), and S3, performing bidirectional tide sensing and real-time state estimation by using a smart electric meter, a sensor and a topology identification algorithm. According to the method, a logic energy storage unit consisting of a plurality of V2G charging piles and vehicles supporting reverse discharge is constructed, the logic energy storage unit is aggregated into virtual power plant nodes which can be scheduled by a power grid through an Information Communication Technology (ICT), specific charging and discharging actions are decomposed and executed, and therefore the method can effectively integrate dispersed V2G resources and cooperatively optimize the operation states of the power distribution network such as voltage, tide and the like.
assignees: HUBEI HANWEI ELECTRIC POWER CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based gas explosion building risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based gas explosion building risk assessment method and system, and particularly relates to the technical field of building risk assessment, wherein a unified time reference, a quality label and a semantic caliber base line are constructed at first, and traceable features are generated according to zoning rolling; on the basis, a ventilation and diffusion twin body is established, observation and assimilation are carried out, two normalization indexes, namely, the ignition readiness and the hazard focal power, are extracted, a continuous risk score is calculated according to the two normalization indexes, the discrete level is mapped through a multi-level uplink threshold, a downlink delay and a minimum residence time, critical threshold jitter is restrained, an atomic instruction is combined with a linkage and constraint table to complete issuing and receipt checking, the consistency acceptance and small step correction are carried out on site measurement and twin prediction through a fixed verification window, and the whole-flow parameters, the caliber and the timestamp are written into an invariable log to realize evaluation, linkage and audit closed loop.
assignees: CHONGQING ZHENGDA NENGKE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent photovoltaic power generation evaluation system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, in particular to a digital twin-based intelligent photovoltaic power generation evaluation system, which comprises a microscopic-macroscopic coupling modeling module, a three-dimensional microscopic shielding topological graph and a cross-scale feature fusion technology, wherein the microscopic-macroscopic coupling modeling module is used for establishing a dynamic fouling probability field model of the surface of a photovoltaic module, the dynamic fouling probability field model simulates a non-uniform deposition process of pollutants on the surface of the photovoltaic module through a discrete element algorithm to generate the three-dimensional microscopic shielding topological graph, and the three-dimensional microscopic shielding topological graph and macroscopic meteorological data are subjected to space-time alignment by adopting the cross-scale feature fusion technology. According to the invention, through a microscopic-macroscopic coupling modeling module, the discrete element algorithm is utilized to simulate the non-uniform deposition of pollutants and generate the three-dimensional microscopic shielding topological graph, and the cross-scale feature fusion technology is combined to align the three-dimensional microscopic shielding topological graph with macroscopic meteorological data, so that the problem that the conventional model cannot quantify the shielding effect of microscopic pollutants is solved.
assignees: POWERCHINA JIANGSU ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Land utilization planning intelligent decision method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of land use planning. The intelligent decision method, the intelligent decision device and the intelligent decision device for land utilization planning are provided, and the intelligent decision device for land utilization planning is characterized in that the method comprises the steps of carrying out space association analysis on a dynamic risk assessment index system through a graphic neural network to construct a land risk conduction topological network, carrying out simulation deduction processing on a planning plan called from a plan library in a digital twin sand table by utilizing the land risk conduction topological network based on a preset multi-condition Jing Raodong factor, outputting a risk thermodynamic diagram and a key failure node coordinate set, carrying out three-dimensional decision matrix analysis processing on the basis of the risk thermodynamic diagram and the key failure node coordinate set to generate a plan sequence meeting preset constraint conditions, so that the accuracy of space planning decision is improved, the miss-report rate of cross-land risk conduction is reduced, and the failure probability of the plan under cooperative disturbance is reduced.
assignees: UNIV GANSU AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Charging pile automatic detection operation and maintenance method, system and medium based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application relates to an automatic detection operation and maintenance method, a system and a medium for charging piles based on the Internet of things, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent power grid operation and maintenance; the method comprises the steps of carrying out wavelet packet decomposition processing on a multi-source data set through an edge computing node, generating a compressed feature vector, inputting a pre-trained residual error self-encoder model, computing a reconstruction error, carrying out association reasoning by combining a historical fault knowledge graph, outputting a fault mode and a confidence coefficient set, dynamically generating an operation and maintenance strategy instruction by combining a device health index attenuation rate, positioning a charging pile to be operated and maintained, calling a digital twin body to carry out residual life prediction, generating a maintenance work order through a path optimization algorithm, and driving an execution terminal to finish operation and maintenance operation. The application can improve the reliability and stability of the charging pile equipment and effectively meet the dual requirements of a modern charging system on high availability and low operation and maintenance cost.
assignees: LONGRUI SANYOU NEW ENERGY AUTOMOBILE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and geological disaster early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning method and a geological disaster early warning system, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and the method comprises the steps of setting a geological disaster monitoring area, arranging a data terminal and a plurality of monitoring sensors in the set geological disaster monitoring area, setting a collection period at the same time, periodically collecting historical geological disaster data in the geological disaster monitoring area, processing the collected historical geological disaster data in a data processing mode, and analyzing the processed historical geological disaster data in a data analysis mode after the processing is completed; meanwhile, a geological disaster simulation prediction model is constructed based on the analyzed historical geological disaster data in a data fusion and digital twin mode, finally, the geological disaster data in the geological disaster monitoring area are collected in real time and input into the geological disaster simulation prediction model, and geological disaster early warning is carried out according to an output result, so that accuracy of the geological disaster early warning is improved.
assignees: NUCLEAR INDUSTRY SOUTHWEST SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent diagnosis and collaborative tour method and system for power equipment based on digital twin and multi-mode data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent diagnosis and collaborative tour method and system for electric equipment based on digital twin and multi-modal data fusion, comprising the steps of acquiring multi-modal tour data of the electric equipment by multiple sources, and constructing a high-fidelity digital twin model based on the multi-modal tour data; carrying out fusion analysis and semantic understanding on the multi-mode patrol data through a large language model, generating a state vector representing the health state of equipment, and updating a digital twin model to reflect the state vector; the invention utilizes a large language model to realize intelligent fusion and interactive diagnosis of multi-mode data, solves the defects of the prior system in terms of interpretation, interactivity and decision support, and improves the diagnosis accuracy and operation and maintenance efficiency.
assignees: SICHUAN HUIYUAN OPTICAL COMMUNICATIONS CO LTD

title_en: Multi-objective collaborative intelligent control method and system for electric power materials in multi-scheduling scene
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of material full-flow control and provides a power material multi-target cooperative intelligent control method and system under a multi-scheduling scene, wherein the method comprises a power material multi-stage omni-directional inventory step, namely, self-adaptive ordering of the power material is performed by considering signal intensity, phase stability, polarization matching degree and misreading compensation factors, and hierarchical scanning is realized; the storage bin position accurate allocation step comprises the steps of determining a bin position allocation scheme according to various scheduling scene requirements, the electric power material digital twin coupling verification step comprises the steps of identifying electric power materials, determining the space coordinates of the corresponding electric power materials in a digital twin model, carrying out coupling verification by combining the identification result, the space coordinates and the bin position allocation scheme, and updating storage management and control information, and the multi-objective collaborative optimization scheduling step comprises the steps of comprehensively considering multi-source data of the electric power materials to carry out risk assessment and carrying out multi-objective collaborative optimization. The invention improves the efficiency of the whole process of electric power material detection, storage and distribution.
assignees: STATE GRID INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: DT-RL iteration-based power grid asset retirement selection sequential optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid asset retirement model selection sequential optimization method based on DT-RL iteration. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin body model of a core power grid asset, integrating multi-source heterogeneous data in real time by the digital twin body model, embedding an asset health degradation model and a dynamic operation and maintenance carbon emission model, designing and training a high-level reinforcement learning intelligent body to determine optimal low-carbon decommissioning time of the power grid asset, designing and training a low-level reinforcement learning intelligent body to optimize a model selection scheme and configuration of new equipment, and establishing a sequential decision iteration mechanism between the high-level reinforcement learning intelligent body and the low-level reinforcement learning intelligent body to enable a decommissioning decision result of the high-level reinforcement learning intelligent body to serve as a starting signal of the low-level reinforcement learning intelligent body, and feeding back the new equipment selection result of the low-level reinforcement learning intelligent body to the digital twin body model for updating and modeling. The invention obviously improves the dynamic property, the synergy and the self-adaptability of the power grid asset management strategy.
assignees: HUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin adjustment method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a digital twin body adjustment method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining each digital twin corresponding to a power distribution system and electrical parameters of each node in each digital twin, determining adjustment indicating parameters according to the electrical parameters of each node, wherein the adjustment indicating parameters comprise internal polymerization degrees of each digital twin, or the adjustment indicating parameters comprise coupling indexes between a first digital twin and a second digital twin in a digital twin group, the digital twin group is any two digital twin in each digital twin, and adjusting each digital twin according to the adjustment indicating parameters to obtain a plurality of new digital twin. The method can improve the accuracy of digital twin body adjustment.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Rapid emergency decision method and system for sudden natural disasters of electric power
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid emergency decision method and system for sudden natural disasters of electric power, and belongs to the technical field of emergency decision of electric power disasters. The method comprises the steps of deducing disaster intensity through superposition of early warning information and real-time states of a power grid, obtaining a predicted fault probability set, obtaining experience data through a matching history case, generating a defensive plan, carrying out feature extraction on multi-source heterogeneous monitoring data collected in real time, obtaining a confirmed fault equipment set based on evidence fusion, constructing the real-time states of the power grid by combining a CIM model, carrying out plan primary selection on the defensive plan and the real-time states of the power grid through multidimensional quantitative comparison, carrying out processing decision based on a matching result, and outputting an emergency disposal plan after simulation verification. Based on digital twin and multi-source data fusion, the method realizes equipment-level disaster damage prediction, minute-level situation awareness and second-level scheme generation, and continuously improves the disaster prevention and quick recovery capacity of the power grid through self-adaptive optimization.
assignees: DONGFANG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Landslide surge prediction method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge prediction method based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster related fields. The method comprises the following steps of 1, realizing a digital model of a physical entity by a physical layer L1, 2, calculating the stability of a landslide and landslide surge by the model layer based on related data of the physical layer, 3, carrying out early warning prediction decision on a calculation result of a decision layer base model layer, and 4, carrying out new prediction calculation to evaluate an updated plan and disaster prevention measure effect. According to the invention, the physical layer is used for sensing the states of the rock mass and the water body of the landslide surge hidden danger point in real time, and the model layer is updated in real time by utilizing the information interaction capability of the digital twin model, so that the calculation model can perform simulation calculation according to the real working condition of the landslide surge hidden danger point, and further, the landslide surge hidden danger point can be more accurately early-warned and predicted. The invention also relates to a landslide surge prediction system based on digital twinning.
assignees: CHANGJIANG GEOTECHNICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment hidden state predictive maintenance method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a predictive maintenance method for hidden states of power equipment, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of power equipment. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode information such as SCADA data, acoustic vibration data, infrared thermal image data and partial discharge data, carrying out time-space alignment and attention mechanism fusion, extracting hidden state codes representing the internal health state of equipment, constructing a dynamic state deduction model combining physical constraint and data driving, realizing the prediction of the future state evolution track of the equipment, carrying out virtual maintenance experiments in a digital twin body based on a prediction result, and generating an optimal maintenance strategy through multi-objective optimization. The invention solves the problems that the prior art cannot sense the hidden state of the equipment and lacks the prediction capability, realizes the transition from passive maintenance to predictive maintenance, and improves the accuracy and the foresight of the operation and maintenance of the power equipment.
assignees: SUN NANJING AUTOMATIC EQUIPMENTS CO LTD

title_en: New energy development area planning method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a new energy development area planning method based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps of collecting area multisource data, constructing an area information model based on the digital twin technology, collecting area power grid data, constructing new energy development capacity constraint based on the area power grid data, collecting forest data of areas around the areas, overlapping three-area three-line vector data of a homeland space to generate new energy development avoidance constraint, constructing a new energy development area through the constrained area information model after the new energy development avoidance constraint is acted on the area information model, carrying out building available surface assessment on the constructed new energy development area to obtain an assessed new energy development area, and setting equipment capacity in each assessed new energy development area based on the new energy development capacity constraint.
assignees: PUTIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;MEIZHOU ISLAND POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power state estimation method and related device of energy storage equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a power state estimation method and a related device of energy storage equipment, which can be used in the field of energy storage system control; then, based on the influence degree of the health degree of the energy storage equipment on the state of charge, obtaining a correction parameter; the method comprises the steps of correcting parameters, updating a pre-stored initial power state table based on the corrected parameters, establishing the initial power state table based on a functional relation between the state of charge and the power state of an energy storage system, and finally obtaining the current power state of the energy storage device through a table lookup method based on the acquired real-time state of charge and the updated power state table. Therefore, under the condition that the health degree of the energy storage equipment is reduced, the power state table can be updated in time, and dynamic adjustment of the power state table is realized. The SOP estimated by the updated power state table is closer to the actual performance state of the energy storage device, so that the accuracy of the SOP estimation result can be improved.
assignees: SUNGROW POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent power consumption dynamic optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based intelligent electricity consumption dynamic optimization method and a digital twin-based intelligent electricity consumption dynamic optimization system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent energy management and construct a digital twin system of physical entity virtual model bidirectional mapping, wherein the digital twin system adopts a quantum classical mixed architecture, and comprises a quantum enhanced twin body, a nerve differential equation dynamic modeling, a causal intervention twin module and cross-domain quantum classical collaboration to complete model training; the edge calculation and lightweight federal learning reduces data transmission quantity and cloud load, and the multi-protocol self-adaptive switching ensures transmission stability. The quantum classical mixed architecture reduces the computational complexity, and the neural differential equation modeling improves the dynamic scene adaptation capability and the prediction accuracy. AR virtual-real linkage reduces the operation threshold, and temporary instruction simulation verification improves the use safety and convenience.
assignees: WUHAN DEFA ELECTRONIC INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Building structure earthquake resistance evaluation system adopting deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building structure earthquake resistance evaluation system adopting deep learning, which relates to the technical field of building structure safety monitoring, and comprises a twin body construction module, a simulation module and a simulation module, wherein the twin body construction module is used for fusing geological investigation data and building structure information to construct a high-fidelity geological-structure digital twin model; and the damage peeling quantification module is connected with the twin body construction module. According to the invention, a geological-structural model capable of reflecting soil-structure interaction is constructed by fusing digital twin and deep learning technologies, microseismic monitoring data is processed by utilizing a deep neural network of an encoder-decoder structure, short-period earthquake motion background noise is intelligently filtered from a composite vibration signal, low-frequency slowly-varying components related to long-term non-uniform settlement of a foundation are effectively separated, and then a purified time sequence damage component representing non-uniform settlement rate is reconstructed, so that accurate identification and quantification of building hidden and accumulated damage are realized.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING JIAOTONG

title_en: Electric power logistics field group scheduling optimization method, system and device based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based power logistics field group scheduling optimization method, a digital twinning-based power logistics field group scheduling optimization system and a digital twinning-based power logistics field group scheduling optimization device, and relates to the technical field of power logistics management. The method comprises the steps of processing the multi-source heterogeneous data based on a space-time diagram neural network, constructing a field group dynamic diagram, constructing a supervision system based on the space-time characteristic representation to obtain an SEE comprehensive score, realizing resource collaborative scheduling of a cross-field group task based on the SEE comprehensive score, constructing a digital twin processing framework, and realizing real-time calculation of the field group dynamic diagram and the supervision system. The power logistics management and optimization scheduling method has the advantages that the scheduling efficiency, the energy consumption management and the safety of the power logistics field group are improved through the combination of a digital twin technology, a graphic neural network and a reinforcement learning and optimization algorithm, so that efficient and intelligent power logistics management and optimization scheduling are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Transformer operation and maintenance management method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a transformer operation and maintenance management method and system based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of operation and maintenance of power equipment and comprise the steps of carrying out multi-source integration on transformer sampling data, obtaining traceable state monitoring data by combining a distributed blockchain technology, carrying out band self-adaptive decomposition on the monitoring data, extracting time-varying characteristics, introducing a cross-frequency domain characteristic fusion device based on mutual information maximization to analyze different frequency bands to obtain a state index matrix, constructing a transformer part state evolution diagram, adopting dynamic causal reasoning to analyze state propagation characteristics among parts, extracting multi-scale time sequence characteristics, carrying out layered interactive coupling, realizing space-time joint analysis, calculating reliability indexes of all parts based on probability distribution, tracing degradation time nodes and influence factors, and formulating a maintenance strategy. The invention realizes the omnibearing monitoring and accurate prediction of the state of the transformer and improves the operation and maintenance efficiency and the equipment reliability.
assignees: APOWER SUBSTATION EQUIPMENT SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic state estimation method, system, equipment and medium based on power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic state estimation method, a system, equipment and a medium based on a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining initial state variable data of power distribution network equipment; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time-frequency analysis and feature extraction on initial state variable data, obtaining state variable data, constructing an objective function based on the state variable data, carrying out initial state prediction of a power distribution network based on the objective function, obtaining a first predicted value of the power distribution network state, calculating noise parameters of a dynamic process according to the first predicted value, judging whether the noise parameters exceed a preset threshold value or not, and dynamically updating the noise parameters to obtain a second predicted value of the power distribution network state. The method comprises the steps of carrying out data fusion on preprocessed state variable data, carrying out initial dynamic state prediction on the fused data, calculating noise parameters in a dynamic process based on a first predicted value, judging whether the noise parameters exceed a preset threshold value, carrying out dynamic update on the noise parameters to obtain a second predicted value, calculating the noise parameters in the dynamic process according to the first predicted value, realizing quantitative evaluation on a prediction model error, carrying out dynamic update on the noise parameters, and improving the accuracy and reliability of the dynamic state estimated value.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Full-chain simulation method and system for storm flood of coupled data assimilation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-chain simulation method and a full-chain simulation system for storm flood of coupled data assimilation, which comprise the steps of acquiring and preprocessing multi-source data of a target area, innovatively integrating a WRF-DA data assimilation system after constructing a WRF atmospheric model, carrying out multi-source data fusion and optimization on an initial field of the model by introducing weather radar observation data with high space-time resolution to generate an analysis field, generating a hydrological model driving file based on the optimized initial field, coupling the WRF-Hydro hydrological model and carrying out parameter calibration to determine the optimal parameter combination, and finally driving the optimized atmospheric-hydrological model to simulate and carry out multidimensional diagnosis on the full process of storm flood. Aiming at the storm flood process caused by strong convection weather such as typhoons, the invention embeds the assimilation depth of the WRF-DA data into the coupling chain of the WRF and the WRF-Hydro, forms an assimilation-simulation-feedback-diagnosis integrated closed loop, and solves the problems of large initial field error and chain transmission distortion of the traditional method in typhoon scenes.
assignees: UNIV CHANGSHA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Intelligent low-altitude emergency monitoring system for heritage area of canal sky road
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-altitude intelligent emergency monitoring system for a canal sky road heritage area, belonging to the technical field of cultural heritage protection. The system comprises a flight corridor construction module, a planning route of + -20 meters along the central line of a main channel of a canal, a height of 50-120 meters, an emergency mode route adjustment response time of less than or equal to 30 seconds, an elastic take-off and landing module (avoiding cultural relics is more than or equal to 20 meters), a service station layout module (distance is 5-10 km, integrated is multifunctional), an intelligent monitoring and response module (heterogeneous communication network realizes global coverage and supports dual-mode seamless switching), and a reversible assembly facility module. The system realizes unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation by utilizing a digital twin technology, can finish daily heritage inspection and ecological monitoring, can rapidly deliver materials and detect disaster situations when extreme disasters, solves the problems of low protection efficiency, insufficient emergency response and the like in the prior art, has reversible and residue-free facilities, supports autonomous navigation of the unmanned aerial vehicle in a complex heritage environment, effectively avoids an object body, and realizes seamless combination of heritage protection and emergency rescue.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING CIVIL ENG & ARCHITECTURE

title_en: Regional grid safety evaluation method, equipment and medium based on intelligent fuel gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional grid safety evaluation method, equipment and medium based on intelligent gas, which belong to the technical field of gas safety supervision, and solve the technical problems of overcoming the defects of insufficient grid division and gas facility characteristic matching and delayed leakage risk prediction in the prior art, realizing full-flow intellectualization from risk identification to closed-loop management, and improving supervision efficiency and early warning precision; the three-level Internet of things data are acquired, sensor data of an unmanned plane, pipe network pressure equipment and leakage monitoring equipment are integrated, a full-link data system of a terminal sensing layer, an edge computing layer and a cloud storage layer is covered, a double-engine evaluation model is constructed, digital twin visualization is achieved, and moment array scheduling can be achieved.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent decision-making method, system, equipment and medium for intelligent cooperation of intelligent agents for environmental control of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for intelligent decision making by intelligent agent cooperation for environmental control of a transformer substation, which belong to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance and comprise the steps of collecting historical data of the transformer substation, building an intelligent agent interaction environment, modeling decision problems, carrying out state estimation according to local observation and the historical data of the transformer substation, constructing a global objective function, predicting individual contribution degree through a neural network model, defining individual reward signals according to the individual contribution degree, calculating a return index through a first-level algorithm, carrying out strategy training and optimization according to the return index, executing decision making, carrying out normalization processing on the individual reward signals, introducing regularization items into a global objective function, calculating convergence indexes and monitoring convergence. The invention carries out state sensing and decision making, solves the problems of low operation and maintenance efficiency and poor cooperativity in transformer substation control, realizes automatic decomposition and high-efficiency decision making of a global optimization target, and improves the self-adaptive capacity and the overall energy efficiency of the system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based multi-terminal collaborative modularized power operation and maintenance method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based multi-terminal collaborative modularized power operation and maintenance method and system, comprising the following steps of constructing a global power topological graph of a power energy station, mapping power equipment, sensors and connecting lines into graph nodes and graph edges, and binding static properties of the equipment with a topological structure; and acquiring real-time operation data of the power equipment, and distributing a unified time tag for the multi-source heterogeneous data. According to the invention, the unified twin model of the voltage class, the region and the equipment type is built in the digital twin platform, and the operation data of different equipment such as the photovoltaic, the battery energy storage, the inverter, the protection device, the electric energy meter and the temperature control equipment are expressed in a unified data semantic mode.
assignees: TUANTUANYUN INFORMATION TECH HENAN CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent storm disaster early warning method and system based on risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm disaster intelligent early warning method and system based on risk assessment, which relates to the technical field of storm early warning, and comprises the steps of 1. Data acquisition, 2. Evacuation strategy generation and 3. Linkage control and optimization, wherein a ponding converging path and a water inlet source are traced back by acquiring multisource information of key areas of stations along the line of a motor car and utilizing a three-dimensional digital twin model along the line of the motor car and a hydrodynamic simulation engine thereof, the evacuation channel plugging risk is evaluated, a real-time optimal personnel personalized evacuation path and an emergency guiding instruction are generated and issued, the operation mode and the flood control equipment operation along the line are adjusted in a linkage mode, the evacuation efficiency is evaluated, the follow-up strategy is optimized, the problems that the plugging risk is inaccurate in research and judgment, personalized evacuation and closed loop optimization are lacking in the prior art are solved, and the storm disaster early warning and emergency handling capacity of each station along the line of the motor car is effectively improved.
assignees: Xining Meteorological Bureau

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting hydraulic power calculation system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting hydraulic calculation system and a method thereof, belonging to the technical field of fire protection, wherein the system comprises a hydraulic network digital twin modeling module, a self-adaptive hydraulic calculation engine module, a reinforcement learning multi-point cooperation optimization module and a real-time monitoring and dynamic feedback adjustment module, a high-fidelity water supply network model is constructed through a digital twin technology, the topological characteristics of a pipe network are captured through a graph neural network, the hydraulic calculation parameters are adaptively adjusted according to fire scene real-time parameters, the water supply demand is accurately calculated, the intelligent cooperation and load optimization of multi-point water supply are realized through multi-agent reinforcement learning, the closed-loop control is formed through the real-time monitoring and the dynamic feedback, the abnormal response and the repeated optimization are quickly responded, the excellent effect is remarkably improved in high-rise building and long-distance water supply scenes, and the water source support of fire fighting is effectively ensured.
assignees: XUNYANG FIRE RESCUE BRIGADE

title_en: Power grid equipment differential inspection planning method and system combining meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for planning differential inspection of power grid equipment by combining meteorological data, which belong to the technical field of operation and maintenance of power systems and comprise the steps of acquiring equipment information of the power grid equipment and meteorological data of a target area; the method comprises the steps of determining basic risk scores based on equipment information, constructing a space-time coupling weather risk field by combining weather data, extracting weather influence intensity values according to the geographical position of the equipment, calculating comprehensive risk scores, formulating a patrol arrangement according to the comprehensive risk scores, fusing patrol resource constraints and road traffic weather constraints, solving a multi-target patrol path optimization model to generate a patrol task sequence and a resource allocation scheme, inputting the scheme into a power grid digital twin simulation platform for simulation under a matched weather scene, outputting a power supply reliability index and a task completion rate, and adjusting model target parameters and performing iterative optimization until reaching standards if a preset patrol efficiency threshold is not met. The invention obviously improves the inspection accuracy, the resource utilization efficiency and the power supply reliability guarantee capability.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Energy consumption monitoring system for energy platform of distributed energy coupling park
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy consumption monitoring system of an energy platform of a distributed energy coupling park, which is used for constructing an energy consumption acquisition-distributed energy operation-energy management three-in-one closed-loop energy consumption monitoring system, realizing park low-carbon zero-carbon operation by data driving, wherein an energy consumption acquisition module acquires energy consumption data and operation condition parameters of a park boiler, water equipment, a lighting system, production line equipment and an air conditioning system, eliminates abnormal values based on3 sigma criteria, ensures data accuracy, the distributed energy operation module acquires operation data of waste heat power generation, wind power, photovoltaic, heat pump and hydrogen energy storage equipment, receives regulation and control instructions through a control module comprising a PID and an MPC sub-module, an energy management module outputs a 1h-24h load prediction result through an LSTM neural network, an optimal scheduling unit combines an absorption rate formula and a carbon emission formula, generates regulation and control instructions comprising equipment target parameters, and finally realizes the park digital twin-in-three-dimensional visual monitoring module.
assignees: CHINA CHANG JIANG ENERGY CORP

title_en: Multi-virtual power plant optimal scheduling method for distributed flexible resource aggregation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-virtual power plant optimized scheduling method for distributed flexible resource aggregation, which relates to the technical field of power systems and energy management, and comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model for each distributed flexible resource; the method comprises the steps of establishing a layered communication structure, generating an aggregate capacity curve of each virtual power plant, constructing a mixed integer and continuous variable optimization model in a rolling time window, generating load, renewable output and resource availability scenes based on historical operation data and short-term prediction results, compressing the scenes through a clustering method, adopting an alternate direction multiplier method ADMM for the mixed integer and continuous variable optimization model, solving sub-problems locally at each virtual power plant and resource nodes, calculating total income according to the multi-virtual power plant optimization results, and distributing the total income. According to the invention, through a layered communication structure and a distributed solving method, the calculation complexity of optimal scheduling is reduced, the real-time performance of rolling time window scheduling is improved, and the maximization of economic benefit is realized.
assignees: CHAOYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Park comprehensive energy system low-carbon scheduling method combining demand response and carbon emission flow
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-carbon scheduling method of a park comprehensive energy system combining demand response and carbon emission flow, belongs to the technical field of low-carbon scheduling of energy systems, and aims to solve the technical problems that carbon emission responsibility is difficult to reasonably allocate due to the fact that a park comprehensive energy system cannot accurately track the carbon emission transfer path when electric heating gas multi-energy flow coupling is considered, because a graph theory-based directional weighted carbon flow network model is established, a maximum flow minimum cutting theorem and a proportion allocation principle are adopted to track a carbon emission transfer path, a space-time coupling dynamic carbon flow state space model is constructed, a Kalman filtering algorithm is adopted to perform state estimation, carbon emission responsibility is allocated based on a Shapley value method, a stepped carbon transaction cost function is established, and an optimal scheduling strategy is solved through a double-layer iteration optimization framework.
assignees: XUJI GROUP CORP;CHINA ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT GROUP

title_en: Data processing method, device, equipment, medium and product for power generation system
abstract_en: The present application relates to a data processing method, apparatus, device, medium and product for a power generation system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining operation key data and structure related data of all equipment in a power generation system, establishing a virtual physical model according to the structure related data, performing association synchronization on the operation key data and the virtual physical model to obtain a digital twin model, inputting the operation key data into a multi-modal risk assessment model, and combining basic importance weights and trend deterioration degree weights to obtain a risk assessment result, wherein the risk assessment result comprises comprehensive risk scores, current risk grades and/or characteristic dimension contribution degrees. Therefore, operation and maintenance personnel can be effectively helped to grasp the equipment risk priority and formulate an accurate maintenance strategy, the unplanned shutdown probability is reduced, and meanwhile, the operation reliability and operation and maintenance efficiency of the whole life cycle of the equipment are improved.
assignees: BEIJING QIMU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent early warning and positioning method and device for leakage risk of urban gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of public safety of smart cities, and particularly provides an intelligent early warning and positioning method and device for leakage risk of urban gas pipelines, wherein a digital twin body construction and dynamic coupling module constructs and drives a virtual image of a gas pipeline network, a multi-mode data acquisition and fusion module comprehensively perceives the state of the pipeline network, and finally an intelligent early warning and positioning decision module realizes a core intelligent algorithm; the cloud-side-end collaborative architecture is adopted, a terminal sensor is responsible for data acquisition, an edge computing node is deployed at a regional voltage regulating station to perform data preliminary processing and local real-time alarm, and a cloud center is deployed with a digital twin platform and a core AI algorithm model to perform big data analysis, simulation deduction and global decision. Compared with the prior art, the method can realize early and accurate identification and prediction of gas leakage and potential risks (such as stress abnormality) of the pipeline.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cause identification method for distribution network terminal voltage abnormality under distributed photovoltaic access
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cause identification method for terminal voltage abnormality of a distribution network under distributed photovoltaic access, which relies on four major core innovations of multisource data fusion, AI-electric power theory fusion modeling, distributed collaborative diagnosis with enhanced communication toughness and verification iteration of digital twin driving, breaks through the technical limitations of conventional distributed photovoltaic access distribution network terminal voltage abnormality cause identification, realizes the transition from fragmentation to systemization, from statics to dynamics and from centralization to distribution, greatly improves the accuracy, reliability and adaptability of cause identification, and provides solid technical support for large-scale absorption of distribution network photovoltaic and voltage abnormality target treatment.
assignees: SUQIAN ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Optical storage and charging integrated power distribution network access method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical storage and charging integrated power distribution network access method and system, which adopt a digital twin technology to construct a power distribution network model, and combine a query perception partition frame based on learning and a dual-adaptation mechanism driven by a graph structure to realize rapid state search and energy optimization distribution in a large-scale power distribution network environment. According to the invention, through collecting the operation parameters and topological connection relation of the photovoltaic power generation, the energy storage equipment and the charging station, the state search is performed by dynamically dividing the network area by using the deep neural network, then the topological characteristics are analyzed by using the graph neural network to generate an energy distribution strategy, and finally, the control instruction is executed and the distribution effect is evaluated. The invention solves the problems of real-time optimal configuration and energy self-adaptive distribution of the traditional power distribution network system in a large-scale equipment access scene, and improves the stability and the resource utilization efficiency of the power distribution network system.
assignees: YANCHENG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHEYANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHEYANG ELECTRIC IND CO LTD

title_en: Electric power training knowledge graph construction method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for constructing an electric training knowledge graph based on multi-source heterogeneous data, and relates to the technical field of knowledge graphs. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous post training data to obtain structured post description data and course description data, respectively extracting post feature vectors and course feature vectors, calculating semantic similarity between the post feature vectors and the course feature vectors, comparing the semantic similarity with a preset matching threshold value, screening candidate courses matched with target posts, generating triples, constructing and updating a post training knowledge graph based on the triples, and generating new triples to update the knowledge graph when new posts or courses are added. According to the application, through unified processing, post-course semantic matching and dynamic triplet updating of multi-source heterogeneous data, the accurate, structured and real-time updating of post training content is realized, and training pertinence and management efficiency are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-disaster-coupling emergency drilling simulation system and method for chemical industry park
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical emergency management, and discloses a multi-disaster coupling emergency exercise simulation system for a chemical park. The system comprises a digital twin model, a multi-disaster coupling model, a VR/AR interaction device, a data acquisition module, an intelligent evaluation system and a report generation system, wherein the digital twin model is used for constructing a three-dimensional scene of a park through laser scanning and aerial mapping, the multi-disaster coupling model is used for simulating linkage evolution of fire, explosion and toxic gas leakage based on hydrodynamics, combustion and toxicology theory, the VR/AR interaction device is used for providing an immersive exercise environment and supporting fire-fighting equipment operation simulation, the data acquisition module is used for recording action tracks and operation data of participants in real time, and the intelligent evaluation system is used for carrying out quantitative evaluation based on multidimensional indexes and generating the report. The invention realizes the high-simulation multi-disaster coupling scene simulation, reduces the drilling cost by more than 60%, shortens the emergency response time by 40%, improves the operation accuracy by 25%, and remarkably improves the emergency management capability of a chemical industry park.
assignees: JINCHUAN GROUP CO LTD;JINCHUAN GROUP CHEMICAL NEW MAT CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention and reduction decision method and system for natural disasters and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency, and discloses a disaster prevention and reduction decision method, a system and electronic equipment for natural disasters, wherein the decision method comprises the steps of constructing a prediction set, a training set and a condition vector; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first prediction set corresponding to real-time data based on a training set and a stacked long-short-time memory network, generating an countermeasure network by using conditions, obtaining a second prediction data set by combining a condition vector, carrying out weight fusion on the second prediction data set by using a self-adaptive deep convolutional neural network to obtain a fused space-time data sequence, and generating a future N-hour disaster risk distribution map by combining a multi-scale space-time convolutional neural network based on the fused space-time data sequence. The decision method and the decision system disclosed by the application have the advantages that the accuracy and the adaptability of filling the missing data are improved, the occurrence and the development of disasters are precisely matched in the space dimension and the time dimension, and the recognition and prediction accuracy of disaster situations is improved.
assignees: Zhangjiajie Meteorological Bureau

title_en: Accident early warning method based on dynamic deduction of physical information risk field
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of industrial Internet, safety early warning and artificial intelligence intersection, in particular to an accident advanced early warning and active intervention method and system for complex industrial systems (such as energy sources, chemical industry and traffic) by integrating digital twin, physical information neural network and deep reinforcement learning, comprising the following steps of multi-physical field coupling sensing and data assimilation; the method comprises the steps of constructing and initializing a physical information risk field, dynamically inverting and deducting the risk field, identifying a risk fission point, generating an intervention path, early warning and strategy simulation feedback, realizing the interpretability insight of the risk generation, conduction and evolution path, and finally generating an active intervention strategy to form an intelligent early warning and risk management and control closed loop.
assignees: LUOHE POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Mine multi-disaster collaborative early warning method and system based on multi-model fusion
abstract_en: The application provides a mine multi-disaster collaborative early warning method and system based on multi-model fusion, and relates to the field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource monitoring data of a deep stope, overlying surrounding rock and a large-scale goaf, forming a multisource monitoring data set through spatial registration and time alignment, constructing and inverting to correct a three-dimensional digital twin body, deducing stable evolution behavior in the twin body to obtain a virtual precursor track set, respectively forming a physical prediction state and a statistical prediction state by combining a physical prediction model and a statistical prediction model, performing difference mapping on the virtual track and the real observation track to construct multidimensional difference features and performing spatial clustering to obtain a silence abnormal cluster, further combining a multisensory coupling relation to construct a multisensory risk map, fusing reasoning, identifying a silence disaster high risk area, and outputting a collaborative early warning result according to spatial connectivity and time persistence. By implementing the technical scheme, the accuracy of the multi-disaster collaborative early warning of the mine is improved conveniently.
assignees: HUBEI YUNTIAN CONSTRUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: User electricity charge archive diagnosis method and system based on typical scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user electricity charge archive diagnosis method and system based on a typical scene, and belongs to the technical field of electricity charge accounting.
