The method combines decision intelligence of deep reinforcement learning with prospective risk assessment and deterministic safety check, obviously improves predictability, self-adaptability and operation reliability of energy storage frequency modulation, and solves the application bottleneck of the advanced intelligent algorithm in key power grid control.
assignees: HUADIAN GUIZHOU NEW ENERGY DEV CO LTD;DAFANG WUJIANG HYDROPOWER ENERGY STORAGE CO LTD

title_en: State evaluation method and system for substation equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a state evaluation method and system of substation equipment, the method comprises the steps of constructing a bidirectional mapping relation between the equipment and a digital twin body, collecting real-time data of the equipment, updating the digital twin body according to the real-time data, determining an equipment state evaluation value according to the real-time data and a preset state evaluation rule, judging whether the equipment state evaluation value is smaller than a state threshold value, determining equipment overhaul urgency according to the equipment state evaluation value and the preset overhaul urgency rule, generating an overhaul pre-selection scheme according to the equipment overhaul urgency, a power grid scheduling plan and available overhaul resources, simulating and executing the overhaul pre-selection scheme by the digital twin body, judging the effect of the overhaul pre-selection scheme, taking the overhaul pre-selection scheme as a final overhaul scheme if the effect of the overhaul pre-selection scheme reaches an expected effect, and overhauling the equipment according to the final overhaul scheme. The invention improves the scientificity and efficiency of equipment overhaul.
assignees: SHANGHAI BOBAN DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for selecting address of underground gas storage chamber of compressed air energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground gas storage chamber location method of a compressed air energy storage system, which comprises the following steps of integrating multi-source data of a target area, establishing a digital twin body of the target area, constructing a multi-field coupling model based on the digital twin body, optimizing by adopting multi-target particle swarm, maximizing a carbon sink synergy coefficient, minimizing construction operation cost and minimizing geological risk, generating a pareto optimal reservoir site set through rapid non-dominant sequencing and crowding degree calculation, outputting a dynamic risk threshold corresponding to the target area through a deep confidence network, eliminating reservoir site with risk exceeding standard in the reservoir site set according to the risk probability based on risk probability, obtaining an optimized reservoir site set, constructing an adaptive correction model based on a DQN network, automatically correcting simulation parameters of the digital twin body, constructing a comprehensive energy efficiency evaluation index system based on the digital twin body after parameter correction, calculating a comprehensive energy efficiency value and determining an optimal location result.
assignees: BEIJING NORTH STAR TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake disaster search and rescue robot control system based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a multi-sensor fusion-based earthquake disaster search and rescue robot control system. The method comprises the steps of carrying out preliminary fusion on IMU and wheel type odometer data by adopting EKF, carrying out contrast correction by utilizing absolute pose observation obtained by LiDAR scanning and matching, carrying out real-time interpolation and maintaining smooth and continuous state estimation by an LSTM network in a LiDAR updating interval, ensuring the continuity of positioning data, eliminating state jump or delay caused by sensor asynchronism, carrying out space-time coordinate alignment of multi-mode features based on EKF, ensuring feature time consistency by using time alignment constraint, carrying out multi-mode confidence degree fusion, effectively integrating recognition results of different modes and improving recognition accuracy.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INST OF SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECHNOLOGY TRAINING CENTER

title_en: System and method for three-dimensional reconstruction of air gap of steam turbine generator and intelligent optimization of spare parts
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional reconstruction of an air gap of a turbo generator and intelligent optimization system and method for spare parts, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of power equipment. The method solves the problems of insufficient three-dimensional measurement precision and lack of data support for spare part configuration in the traditional air gap maintenance method of the turbonator in the prior art, acquires data in real time through a data acquisition module, aligns the data, screens and processes the data to obtain processed data, builds a three-dimensional digital twin model, outputs an air gap simulation result of the turbonator, builds an inventory optimization model through a spare part optimization module, outputs spare part demand, provides a visual man-machine interaction interface for displaying the air gap simulation result and inventory state of the turbonator through an intelligent operation and maintenance module, and generates and adopts a remote data transmission channel to output a three-level maintenance scheme. The invention effectively improves the measurement precision and the intelligent optimization effect of spare parts, and can be applied to the operation and maintenance of the power equipment.
assignees: HARBIN ELECTRIC MACHINERY CO LTD

title_en: Gas pipe network safety on-line monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas pipe network safety on-line monitoring system and method, which relates to the technical field of on-line monitoring, the invention installs the Internet of things equipment in a gas pipe network area to be monitored, builds an aggregation local area network based on the installed Internet of things equipment, configures the operation mode of the Internet of things equipment, and acquires and processes the gas state data in the gas pipe network area in real time through the operated Internet of things equipment, so as to analyze the gas state data in the gas pipe network area acquired in real time, after analysis is completed, a fault risk identification model is built based on the analyzed gas state data, a gas pipe network safety system is built based on the built fault risk identification model, finally, prediction is performed in a digital twin mode based on the analyzed gas state data, and meanwhile, according to a prediction result and the gas pipe network safety system, the fault position is positioned, the gas pipe network safety monitoring mode is adjusted, and the real-time performance of gas pipe network monitoring is improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU GELUNBU ROBOT CO LTD

title_en: Data integration analysis method for power dispatching control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data integration analysis method for a power dispatching control system, which comprises the following analysis steps of S1, collecting power dispatching control data based on a plurality of power application systems, S2, formulating a data conversion rule based on service logic of the power dispatching control system, converting data names and formats in an information copying mode, reorganizing data with unified names and formats, S3, carrying out consistency check on the reorganized data with unified names and formats, filling missing data, obtaining complete power dispatching control data, S4, carrying out abnormal data identification and elimination on the complete power dispatching control data based on an isolated forest algorithm, S5, carrying out clustering analysis on the power dispatching control data based on a Gaussian mixture clustering algorithm, and completing data integration of the power dispatching control system.
assignees: XIAYI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: AR-based drainage pipe network maintenance operation guiding method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drainage pipe network maintenance operation guiding method and system based on AR, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent water affairs. The method comprises the steps of (1) data monitoring, collecting multi-dimensional operation parameters of a drainage pipe network, transmitting the multi-dimensional operation parameters to an edge terminal, (2) preprocessing, preprocessing acquired data by the edge terminal, uploading the preprocessed data to a server, (3) data processing, deep processing after server data are extracted, a multi-sensor fusion high-precision positioning and registration algorithm is used as a base, a pipeline defect real-time identification and segmentation algorithm, a digital twin dynamic hydraulic model and a fault prediction algorithm are mutually driven, multi-mode man-machine cooperative interaction and instruction understanding algorithm converging information and outputting intelligent guidance to form a closed loop, and (4) visual display and interaction are carried out through a network platform, a mobile APP and an AR/VR immersion interface.
assignees: SHANDONG HUATE WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Site three-dimensional digital twin modeling method based on power grid infrastructure power transmission and transformation project
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-dimensional digital twin modeling method based on a power grid infrastructure power transmission and transformation project site, which relates to the technical field of digital twin, and comprises the following steps of: when the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for oblique photography on a power transmission and transformation project site needing to be photographed, if the unmanned aerial vehicle is located in a preset track adjusting point, photographed modeling data are obtained, a target photographing track of the unmanned aerial vehicle is determined based on the modeling data and the track adjusting point, oblique photography is carried out on the power transmission and transformation project site, the obtained target modeling data are added into the photographed modeling data, and a digital model of the power transmission and transformation project site is built based on the photographed modeling data. Since the subsequent path planning is determined based on the photographed modeling data, the missing part is compensated by the target data of the target photographing path, and digital twin can be performed by the complete modeling data, so that the accuracy of the established digital model is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SIJI POSITION SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant cooperative scheduling test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual power plant collaborative scheduling test method which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a simulation test platform, 2, designing a multi-dimensional test scene based on the layered fusion test environment to cover extreme and typical working condition scenes, 3, obtaining resource parameters of the physical simulation layer, market environment parameters of the market simulation layer and grid constraint parameters, deploying a collaborative scheduling algorithm on the digital twin layer, driving the physical simulation layer and the market simulation layer to cooperatively operate according to scene sequences of the multi-dimensional test scene by the simulation test platform to acquire operation data, and 4, quantitatively evaluating the operation data according to technical advancement dimension and engineering touchdown dimension. The comprehensive quantitative evaluation is realized through the technical advancement dimension and the engineering touchdown dimension, and the core problem of single evaluation dimension of the existing test method technology and market direction fracture is effectively solved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HUADIAN EQUIPMENT TESTING RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Marine wind power operation and maintenance method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin technology-based offshore wind power operation and maintenance method and system, which relate to the technical field of offshore wind power operation and maintenance methods and comprise the steps of calculating the maximum theoretical power of a fan according to the definition of a Betz limit; converting the dynamic ratio of wind energy efficiency conversion into a differential equation by adopting forward Euler discretization, constructing a state space model by adopting Kalman filtering to update the wind energy conversion efficiency of each sampling point, and constructing a dynamic threshold of the wind energy conversion efficiency by adopting an exponential weighting moving method. The method comprises the steps of dynamically correcting air density through a temperature compensation method, enabling theoretical power calculation to be more fit with the real atmospheric environment where a fan is located, solving a discretized state space model through Kalman filtering, optimally fusing a prediction value and an actual observation value of a mechanism model, and generating a dynamic threshold through an exponential weighting moving method, wherein the threshold can be adaptively adjusted along with long-term trend and short-term fluctuation of wind energy conversion efficiency.
assignees: CCCC SHANGHAI THIRD HARBOR ENGINEERING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power distribution facility and forest fire observation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control and discloses a digital twinning-based power distribution facility and forest fire observation system and method, wherein the digital twinning-based power distribution facility and forest fire observation system and method comprise a sensor digital twinning construction and correction module, physical sensors are deployed along a power distribution facility line, a corresponding digital twinning body is constructed for each sensor, and a high-credibility observation value and dynamic weight thereof are generated; the system comprises an assimilation module, a risk assessment module, an edge decision module and a hierarchical execution module, wherein the assimilation module inputs a high-confidence observed value into a fire digital twin layer, the risk assessment module generates a risk score of each line section or tower based on fire prediction distribution and real-time physical sensor data, and the edge decision module performs an active defense strategy in a layered manner on an edge calculation node according to a comparison result of the risk score and a preset threshold. According to the invention, by constructing the sensor and the fire digital twin body and fusing the edge intelligent decision, the dynamic assessment of the power distribution facilities and forest fire risks is realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of fire early warning are obviously improved.
assignees: ZHANJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent management method for full life cycle of equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent management method for a full life cycle of equipment, relates to the technical field of power equipment, and solves the problems that in the prior art, a dynamic coupling mechanism is lacking between a prediction module and a decision module, and a prediction error cannot be effectively transmitted to a decision layer to carry out parameter self-adaptive adjustment. The invention realizes tight coupling and bidirectional feedback of prediction-decision by embedding the residual service life and fault probability of the prediction output into the constraint right-end term and the objective function coefficient of the optimization model in real time, wherein the prediction error directly drives the decision parameter to adjust in a self-adaptive manner, and the decision execution effect in turn guides the online update of the model to form a complete closed loop of perception-prediction-decision-feedback. The dynamic coupling mechanism enables the maintenance strategy to be optimized in real time along with the evolution of the health state of the equipment, and compared with a traditional loose coupling architecture in offshore wind power application, the dynamic coupling mechanism avoids invalid out-of-sea or missing windows caused by inaccurate prediction.
assignees: GUANGXI GUANGTOU BEIBU GULF OFFSHORE WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering scheduling previewing method, system and medium based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin and water conservancy informatization, and discloses a water conservancy project scheduling previewing method, a system and a medium based on the digital twin technology, comprising the following steps of S1, constructing an integrated water conservancy project digital bottom plate model; the method comprises the steps of S2, generating a dynamic three-dimensional river surface model, S3, constructing a three-dimensional river cross section model, S4, optimizing scene materials and effects, S5, generating an underwater topography elevation thermodynamic diagram, S6, simulating a gate opening flood discharging process, S7, simulating downstream river flood peak evolution, and S8, realizing real-time flood flooding simulation. The method comprises the steps of integrating hidden data of underwater topography, river section and the like with high-altitude visual data for the first time, constructing a land-water-worker integrated digital base plate, solving the defect of heavy land and light water of the existing scene, realizing the linkage visualization of flood peak diffusion and river surface change, making up the short plates of the river change preview deletion in the existing four-pre application, and realizing the synchronous rendering of a hydrodynamic model and the scene through data format optimization and real-time interaction technology.
assignees: GUANGXI YOUJIANG WATER RESOURCES DEV CO LTD;PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC RESEARCH INST OF PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Multi-reactive-source static and dynamic optimization control method and system based on source network coordination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a source network cooperation-based multi-reactive-source static and dynamic optimization control method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing and solving a unified optimization model for fusing multiple reactive sources at a power grid side and a power source side based on ultra-short-term prediction data, and generating a switching plan, a reference curve and a voltage optimization target interval in a future time period; and S2, performing simulation check on the optimization plan by using a power grid digital twin model, triggering re-optimization taking transient safety as a constraint if the transient voltage safety standard is violated, S3, based on the optimization target and real-time measurement, performing a tracking adjustment mode or an emergency cooperative control mode in a self-adaptive manner according to the disturbance level, and S4, performing and feeding back updating by equipment. According to the invention, through static and dynamic closed loop cooperation and source network resource global optimization, the problems of static and dynamic fracture and insufficient source network cooperation in traditional control are solved, and the economical efficiency, safety and self-adaptive capacity of a high-proportion renewable energy power grid are remarkably improved.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Medical personnel protection articles wholesale supply chain collaborative management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical personnel protective product wholesale supply chain collaborative management system, relates to the field of supply chain management, solves the problems of low collaborative efficiency, opaque tracing, slow emergency response, insufficient full chain wind control of a protective product supply chain, comprises a central cloud brain platform, regional edge collaborative nodes, station-level edge execution nodes, a supply chain heterogeneous communication network system, federal digital twin decision, block chain tracing, deep learning wind control, space-time diagram neural network inventory optimization and other components, and realizes multisource data fusion prediction, agV cluster collaborative scheduling, emergency distribution, full chain carbon tracing, reverse logistics classification and the like based on a hierarchical network formed by 5G slice+satellite links, block chain alliance chains, TSN+WiFi6E and the like, wherein the response speed of the supply chain is more than 30 percent, the trusted circulation and distribution are realized, and the demands of the wholesale dynamic collaboration and the risk management of the medical protective product can be met.
assignees: SHANDONG JUNKANGLIN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for establishing disaster recovery plan based on digital twin using disaster resilience index evaluation
title_ko: 재난회복력 지표 평가를 이용한 디지털 트윈 기반 재해 복구 계획 수립 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 디지털 트윈 기반 재해 복구 계획 수립 시스템은 재난 피해 지역의 위치 정보와 피해 현황을 포함하는 피해 정보를 입력받아 상기 피해 지역의 3차원 디지털 트윈 모델을 생성하는 디지털 트윈 생성부; 상기 디지털 트윈 모델로부터 피해 시설물의 물리적 제약 조건을 추출하고, 복구 공법 데이터베이스를 조회하여 적용 가능한 복수의 복구 공법을 자동으로 추출하며, 각 복구 공법을 적용한 복수의 복구 시나리오를 자동으로 생성하는 시나리오 생성부; 상기 복수의 복구 시나리오 각각에 대하여, 재난 저항성, 복구 속도, 탄력성 및 유지보수 용이성을 포함하는 재난회복력 지표와, 안정성, 경제성, 시공성을 포함하는 일반 평가 지표를 이용하여 정량적 평가를 수행하는 시나리오 평가부; 및 상기 평가 결과에 기초하여 최적의 복구 시나리오를 추천하는 추천부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: CORETEC

title_en: Multi-disaster comprehensive identification method and system for high-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-disaster comprehensive identification method and system for a remote sensing power grid of a high-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring of power systems. The method comprises the steps of carrying out risk clustering and quantitative evaluation on a power transmission line corridor based on risk distribution output by a digital twin model to obtain a risk level quantitative matrix, obtaining a differential acquisition strategy parameter table according to the risk level quantitative matrix, carrying out unmanned aerial vehicle group task parameterization optimization by utilizing the differential acquisition strategy parameter table to obtain a collaborative observation scheme, and scheduling unmanned aerial vehicle groups to acquire multi-source remote sensing data streams according to the collaborative observation scheme. The invention realizes the efficient intelligent comprehensive identification and treatment of multiple disasters of the power grid by constructing a full-flow closed loop of digital twinning, risk driving acquisition, multi-source data fusion, parallel disaster identification and intelligent decision response.
assignees: POWER EMERGENCY CENTER OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Big data monitoring method based on power operation and maintenance
abstract_en: The invention provides a big data monitoring method based on power operation and maintenance, which relates to the technical field of power system automation and comprises the steps of constructing a space-time alignment unified data portrait for power grid equipment and topology nodes, calculating real-time health degree scores and running risk scores of all monitoring objects based on the unified data portrait, predicting risk evolution tracks and potential fault probabilities of all the monitoring objects in a future preset period based on time sequence changes of the real-time health degree scores and the running risk scores, synchronously mapping the unified data portrait, the real-time health degree scores, the running risk scores and the risk evolution tracks to a power grid digital twin three-dimensional scene to generate a multi-level visual monitoring interface, and generating a comprehensive auxiliary decision report by utilizing a decision rule base and a reinforcement learning model. According to the invention, an auxiliary decision report comprehensively considering safety and economy can be automatically generated, and the monitoring early warning is directly converted into an operable strategy suggestion, so that the intelligent closed loop of the operation and maintenance flow is realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI WAIGAOQIAO POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin body virtual method and system of power distribution terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin body virtual method and a digital twin body virtual system of power distribution terminal equipment. The physical model adopts a tree-shaped recursion nested structure to describe the physical properties from the chassis, the plug-in units to the components, the behavior model adopts a tree-shaped recursion nested structure to describe the input and output information and algorithm rules of logic functions such as protection, measurement and monitoring of the equipment, and the relation model adopts a single structure to describe the association relation between the physical objects and the behavior functions. The model is defined in standardized terms by specific XML elements and their attributes. The invention solves the problem that the digital twin body model of the power distribution terminal lacks standardization and completeness, provides a core model foundation for real-time monitoring of equipment states, accurate fault positioning and intelligent operation and maintenance, and remarkably improves operation and maintenance efficiency.
assignees: NARI RELAYS ELECTRIC CO LTD;NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH;CHANGZHOU NR ELECTRIC POWER ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for constructing digital twin model of power equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for constructing a digital twin model of power equipment, and relates to the technical field of digital twin; the method comprises the steps of performing pseudo-color coding based on target multi-source characteristics to obtain dynamic color thermodynamic diagrams aiming at the power equipment, constructing a static three-dimensional model of the power equipment, and performing model construction based on a preset anomaly identification algorithm, the dynamic color thermodynamic diagrams and the static three-dimensional model to obtain a target digital twin model of the power equipment. The method solves the problems that errors are easily introduced due to manual operation in the prior art, data input delay is caused, timeliness of digital twin simulation is reduced, and real-time accurate reflection of the running state of the power equipment is difficult to realize.
assignees: ANHUI ZHIHUI YUNZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic conversion method, system, computer equipment and storage medium for electric power system model data to ETAP software
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a computer device and a storage medium for automatically converting electric power system model data into ETAP software, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing and loading CIM/E XML and an associated SVG file; extracting element entities and association relations of the element entities of the power system, mapping CIM/E entity attributes into element parameters corresponding to ETAP software according to a predefined mapping rule base, processing compatibility problems of model differences and missing data, and finally generating data files which can be directly identified and imported by the ETAP software. The invention realizes seamless data butt joint between the general standard of the power grid and the professional simulation software, and greatly improves the efficiency and accuracy of simulation modeling of the power system.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based wharf safety intelligent monitoring method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a digital twin-based wharf safety intelligent monitoring method apparatus, devices, and media. The method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out space-time alignment fusion on multi-source heterogeneous original data of a wharf site to generate a dynamic digital twin scene, carrying out entity relation and event extraction matching on the basis of the dynamic digital twin scene and a pre-constructed wharf operation knowledge graph to generate a dynamic knowledge situation subgraph, carrying out graph neural network coding processing on the dynamic knowledge situation subgraph to obtain coding characteristics of nodes in the graph, carrying out risk and conflict analysis on the basis of the coding characteristics to generate a current risk list and a potential conflict prediction list, and generating safety alarm information on the basis of the current risk list. By adopting the method, the safety monitoring is improved from a perception level based on simple rule matching to a cognition level integrating semantic understanding and context correlation reasoning, so that false alarm and missing report are remarkably reduced, and accurate early warning of potential risks in a complex operation environment is realized.
assignees: UNIV LUDONG

title_en: Urban waterlogging resident emergency evacuation path guiding method for intelligent community
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city waterlogging resident emergency evacuation path guiding method for a smart community, and relates to the technical field of smart cities and emergency management; the method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a community digital twin substrate integrating geographic information, building information, sensing data of the Internet of things and a hydrodynamic model, realizing dynamic inversion and prediction of waterlogging situation by assimilating a multisource observation data driving model, calculating space-time dynamic risks of an evacuation road network based on prediction results and generating a risk map, adopting a double-layer optimization model combining macroscopic flow distribution and microscopic path planning to calculate a space-time evacuation scheme comprising optimal departure time and a specific path sequence for residents or families by combining resident personalized constraint, and finally issuing instructions through multiple channels such as intelligent terminals, broadcasting and the like and dynamically adjusting based on real-time monitoring.
assignees: SUZHOU JIUZHANG TONGSUAN INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Electric power plant preventive maintenance monitoring system based on digital twin and equipment state prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preventive maintenance monitoring system for an electric power plant area based on digital twin and equipment state prediction, which relates to the field of predictive analysis and comprises a real-time data acquisition module, a deviation calculation module and a system, wherein the real-time data acquisition module is used for periodically acquiring real-time operation parameters of the current state of each operation part of electric equipment through a sensor, the deviation calculation module is used for comparing the real-time operation parameters with standard operation parameters of corresponding operation parts, acquiring deviation values of the real-time operation data and the standard operation parameters of each state of the operation parts through calculating difference values and generating a deviation value sequence, and the system can accurately predict the probability of a specific deterioration event in the future before the parts have substantial faults, so that maintenance personnel can obtain early warning when the health condition of the equipment is critical to a safety threshold value, thereby having sufficient time planning and executing targeted preventive maintenance measures, and avoiding the impact of sudden shutdown on the stability of the electric power grid and economic benefit of the plant area.
assignees: XINJIANG INST ENG

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance method of sodium ion battery energy management system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of sodium ion batteries, and provides an intelligent operation and maintenance method of an energy management system of a sodium ion battery based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of constructing and operating a virtual model corresponding to the sodium ion battery system in a cloud digital twinning platform based on acquired multi-source heterogeneous operation data; the virtual model simulates the internal state and evolution trend of the sodium ion battery system by coupling the electrochemical model, the thermal model and the life model, tracks and predicts the state of charge and the state of health of the sodium ion battery system, generates a charge and discharge power instruction and a thermal management strategy by a dynamic optimization control algorithm and issues and executes the charge and discharge power instruction and the thermal management strategy, carries out anomaly detection by an unsupervised learning algorithm, and generates a predictive maintenance suggestion by combining the prediction result of the state of health. Through constructing digital twin body and multi-model coupling, multidimensional accurate perception and multi-objective dynamic optimization of the sodium ion battery system are realized, and the full life cycle value and the safety level of the energy storage system are improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin management system and method applied to petrochemical wharf
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin, in particular to a digital twin management system and method applied to a petrochemical wharf, comprising S1, collecting physical state parameters of a port area, a pipe area and a tank area in the petrochemical wharf in an operation flow, constructing an asynchronous time sequence modeling network, establishing a digital twin mirror image body in the three-area operation process, and outputting a three-area state evolution frame set; S3, combining the acquired real-time state input, comparing the twin prediction track sets, triggering a difference feedback module, outputting a scheduling correction amount, reversely mapping the corrected actions to a three-domain twin mirror body, updating a twin evolution path and forming a three-domain linkage prediction-control closed loop. The invention improves the agility of three-domain collaborative scheduling and the steady-state operation capability of the whole system.
assignees: ANHUI ZHIHUI YUNZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for constructing digital twin model of power distribution network and generating toughness improvement measures
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of intelligent power grids, and particularly relates to a method and a system for constructing a digital twin model of a power distribution network and generating toughness improvement measures. The toughness improvement measure generation method comprises the steps of constructing and training a toughness decision model of the power distribution network based on a standardized multi-source data set and a digital twin model of the power distribution network, determining an estimated value of node evaluation time operation data under the meteorological hydrologic data to be predicted by using the digital twin model of the power distribution network, inputting the estimated value and the hydrologic state into the trained toughness decision model of the power distribution network to obtain a corresponding rewarding value and an optimized decision action mapping strategy, and generating flood toughness improvement measures of 'structure reinforcement + operation optimization + emergency deployment' through action-measure mapping rules based on the corresponding relation and vulnerability indexes of the meteorological hydrologic data to be predicted and the optimized decision action mapping strategy. The digital twin technology and the reinforcement learning technology are fused and applied to the power distribution network and are combined with a flood scene, so that toughness improvement measures of the power distribution network can be generated.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN JINGHAI POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Evaluation method and system for new energy and energy storage planning implementation path of block power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating new energy and energy storage planning implementation paths of a block power grid, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data of a target area, constructing a power grid digital twin base through multi-source heterogeneous data analysis, dividing a planning period based on the base, carrying out multi-stage capacity expansion planning and safety margin calculation by adopting macro-micro bidirectional coupling optimization to obtain a staged implementation path scheme set, introducing an opposite game mechanism, constructing a virtual pressure test scene evaluation path adaptability, screening to form an optimized implementation path set, constructing an evolution topological graph by adopting dynamic network analysis based on the optimized implementation path set, generating a path evolution correlation map through node centrality analysis and track mining, and finally, combining real-time power grid data, carrying out path performance deviation degree evaluation and root cause diagnosis, realizing rolling optimization and dynamic adjustment, generating an optimization scheme and pushing. The invention realizes the dynamic evaluation and optimization of the full life cycle of the planned path.
assignees: XUANCHENG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster risk assessment method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of disaster monitoring, and particularly discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for evaluating urban waterlogging disaster risk, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring hydrologic and environmental parameters of a target area through an empty, ground and water triphibian multi-mode unmanned monitoring cluster; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-source data dynamic fusion processing on acquired parameters at an edge computing node to obtain grid-level fusion data, wherein the multi-source data dynamic fusion processing comprises abnormal value elimination, space-time alignment and dynamic weight fusion, calibrating a pre-constructed space-time coupling digital twin evaluation model based on the grid-level fusion data, comparing the fusion data with model initial output, dynamically adjusting model parameters when deviation exceeds a preset threshold value, carrying out risk calculation, and outputting a risk prediction evaluation result. The method can effectively ensure the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the risk assessment basic data, and effectively improve the adaptability and prediction accuracy of the model.
assignees: WUHAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY ZHONGNAN GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOV

title_en: Construction method and system of digital twin system controlled by parallel poles
abstract_en: A construction method of a digital twin system for parallel control of a pole comprises the steps of S1, constructing a digital twin geometric model of the pole based on pole work sites and pole structure data, constructing a knowledge graph of the pole based on pole related data, fusing the knowledge graph and the digital twin geometric model of the pole to deduce a construction plan flow scheme, S2, respectively carrying out simulation of pole operation according to different working conditions based on the digital twin geometric model of the pole, constructing an intelligent pole parallel controller, carrying out intelligent prediction based on simulation results by utilizing an extremely random tree algorithm in combination with a tyrannosal optimization algorithm, and constructing a multi-objective optimization solution model, and S3, integrating the multi-objective optimization solution model into the pole parallel controller to achieve parallel control of the pole with the construction plan flow scheme as a target. The design deduction result is used as a control target of a physical system, so that parallel control of the physical system and a manual system is realized, and further digital management and control of power grid tower construction are realized.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Pharmaceutical risk prediction and correction system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk prediction, in particular to a pharmaceutical risk prediction and correction system based on digital twinning, which comprises an acquisition module, an analysis module, an evaluation module and a verification module, wherein the acquisition module is used for acquiring pharmaceutical room characteristic parameters of a historical period of a target pharmaceutical factory and risk characteristic parameters of a network; the method comprises the steps of analyzing a characteristic representation value of a pharmacy room through an analysis module, analyzing a risk characteristic representation value, judging whether pharmaceutical stability meets a standard or not through an evaluation module based on the characteristic representation value of the pharmacy room, judging whether network safety is abnormal or not based on the risk characteristic representation value, and judging reasons for the fact that the pharmaceutical stability does not meet the standard and corresponding processing strategies of the reasons based on the difference between the risk characteristic representation value and a preset risk characteristic representation threshold through a verification module. The accuracy and the efficiency of pharmaceutical risk prediction are improved through the verification module.
assignees: BEIJING XINCHUANG DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster intelligent patrol collaborative operation system for wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle inspection and wind field intelligent management, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster intelligent inspection collaborative operation system for a wind power field, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and a server, the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is loaded with a multi-source sensor, and the server comprises a digital twin modeling module, a cluster cooperative control module, a data processing module, an analysis detection module and a risk reporting module, and can also comprise a communication adaptation module. The system comprises a wind field three-dimensional digital twin body, a cluster cooperative control module, a data processing module, an analysis detection module, a risk reporting module, a data processing module, a fault analysis module and a fault analysis module, wherein the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a wind field three-dimensional digital twin body, the cluster cooperative control module is used for distributing an inspection subtask through a weighted optimization function, combining a rapid exploration random tree optimization algorithm to plan a low-resistance path, dynamically reassigning the task when in fault, the data processing module is used for preprocessing and fusing multi-source sensor data into a feature vector, the analysis detection module is used for outputting a defect detection result through a pre-training model, and the risk reporting module is used for calculating a risk coefficient and generating an evaluation report. The communication adaptation module guarantees stable data transmission.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIZHOU ENG CO LTD

title_en: Industrial equipment cloud edge end collaborative decision-making response system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The cloud side collaborative decision-making response system and the cloud side collaborative decision-making response method for the industrial equipment based on digital twinning adopt a three-layer collaborative framework of an industrial equipment layer, an edge server layer and a cloud digital twinning layer, integrate advantages of the edge server and the cloud server, introduce equipment information crisis index, ensure quick screening of the crisis information by quantifying the crisis degree of the equipment information, greatly shorten response and disposal time of emergency, reduce equipment fault spreading risks, powerfully ensure safe and stable operation of the industrial equipment, remarkably improve emergency response capability of the system, construct a high-fidelity digital mirror model based on global equipment information by means of a digital twinning module, develop equipment state prediction and long-term optimization decision-making by combining historical data, optimize resource allocation and scheduling strategies of the industrial system from a macroscopic level, realize intelligent management of the whole life cycle of the equipment, and strengthen adaptability and global optimization capability of the system to complex industrial scenes.
assignees: BIANYUAN INTELLIGENT TECH YANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method based on multi-criterion partition and WLS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network state estimation, in particular to a power distribution network state estimation method based on multi-criterion partitioning and WLS. The technical scheme includes that partition structure indexes, partition measurement indexes and partition performance indexes are built according to a power distribution network topological structure, multiple objective functions are built in a weighting mode by integrating the partition structure indexes, the partition measurement indexes and the partition performance indexes, and the multiple objective functions are converted into single objective optimization functions. According to the invention, a multi-criterion optimization partition system integrating network structure, measurement configuration and estimation performance is constructed, and distributed weighted least square state estimation is implemented based on the multi-criterion optimization partition system, so that the overall accuracy of power distribution network state estimation is improved, and meanwhile, the calculation efficiency and instantaneity are remarkably improved; the method has good system adaptability and expandability, can effectively cope with the complex power distribution network operation scene containing high-proportion distributed energy sources, and enhances the local fault tolerance and the overall robustness of the system through a distributed architecture.
assignees: HEFEI COMPREHENSIVE NATIONAL SCIENCE CENTER ENERGY RESEARCH INST ANHUI ENERGY LABORATORY;UNIV HEFEI

title_en: Power transmission and transformation engineering optical cable connection information operation and maintenance system based on logic model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin and computer simulation, in particular to a power transmission and transformation project optical cable connection information operation and maintenance system based on a logic model, which comprises a model fusion module, a power transmission and transformation project optical cable connection information operation and maintenance module and a power transmission and transformation project optical cable connection information operation and maintenance module, wherein the model fusion module is used for constructing a digital twin anchor point set by fusing a three-dimensional physical model of the power transmission and transformation project and a secondary system logic model; and the augmented reality module realizes the spatial registration of the three-dimensional physical model and the field reality by a spatial calculation technology, and visually presents the information of the logic loop and the risk point. According to the invention, by constructing the space-time twin anchor points and driving the simulation operation of the physical field, the diagnosis result and the operation and maintenance instruction are overlapped on the scene live through the augmented reality technology, the intelligent operation and maintenance closed loop of the connection information of the optical cable of the power transmission and transformation project is realized, and the efficiency and the accuracy of fault investigation are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CONSTRUCTION BRANCH

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and system based on multisource meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and a system based on multi-source meteorological data, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation prediction, comprising the following steps of acquiring meteorological data sequences through synchronous acquisition based on multiple data sources; filtering a meteorological data sequence and supplementing missing data, acquiring the quality weight of each data source, fusing the meteorological data sequence based on the quality weight, establishing a data-driven prediction model based on fused meteorological data to predict power, reading the predicted required power generation power in the next time period, comparing the predicted required power generation power with a prediction result, periodically judging whether the data-driven prediction model needs to be corrected, and re-executing the data-driven prediction model if the data-driven prediction model needs to be corrected. The method has the advantages that the model calculation and maintenance complexity is not excessively increased while the accuracy of the prediction model is ensured.
assignees: HUANENG BAOTOU WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG BEIJING COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY TECH SERVICE CO LTD;BEIJING JINFENG HUINENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground displacement three-dimensional measurement sensing array state observation and digital twin method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state observation and digital twin method for an underground displacement three-dimensional measurement sensing array. The method comprises the steps of collecting and analyzing operation data of the underground displacement three-dimensional measurement sensing array in real time, obtaining basic physical parameters of the sensing array according to the analyzed operation data, determining absolute space positions of sensing units in the sensing array, drawing a three-dimensional twin body model, transmitting physical motion states to the front end by utilizing the rear end of observation software, and realizing real-time rendering and mapping of the digital twin visualization model of the sensing array in a front-end page of the observation software. The method is aimed at the technical scheme that the three-dimensional measurement sensing array for underground displacement is universal in the process of monitoring the deep displacement of the rock and soil hidden danger body, is compatible with the current mainstream browser/server architecture monitoring software system, and is beneficial to remotely, dynamically and intuitively obtaining the deformation condition of the rock and soil layer in the process of monitoring the disaster of the rock and soil environment.
assignees: UNIV JILIANG CHINA

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic-oriented 5G private network scheduling communication and data transmission control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system dispatching communication and discloses a 5G private network dispatching communication and data transmission control method oriented to distributed photovoltaic, which comprises the steps of obtaining photovoltaic site distribution information and dispatching service requirements, designing a dynamic slice arrangement scheme based on power grid topology awareness, and establishing a private network direct acquisition direct control communication architecture; the method comprises the steps of deploying intelligent fusion terminal equipment, establishing a three-layer data model, carrying out hierarchical classification, monitoring and evaluating network quality, constructing a network digital twin model, carrying out encryption and identity authentication, obtaining operation data and meteorological data, training a hierarchical prediction model and an anomaly diagnosis model, establishing a dispatching optimization model, solving a dispatching scheme, carrying out multi-agent game cooperative control by the fusion terminal, feeding back data of an acquisition control process to a dispatching master station, and generating a control execution record and an effect evaluation report.
assignees: SHANDONG ZHUOYANG ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Efficient identification method for connection rigidity of steel pipe pole of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency identification method for connection rigidity of a steel pipe pole of a power transmission line, which relates to the field of structural health monitoring and comprises the steps of constructing a multi-scale finite element model of the steel pipe pole, acquiring displacement and frequency response of the structure, carrying out parameter sensitivity analysis, and screening key correction parameters; and constructing a Bayesian correction framework, solving posterior probability distribution by adopting TMCMC algorithm, and realizing probabilistic identification of connection rigidity and systematic correction of a finite element model. By constructing a local refined contact model, a corresponding relation between the bolt pretightening force and the connecting rigidity is established, and an effective means is provided for verifying whether the rigidity of the corrected model is matched with the rigidity of the actual structure. The method can accurately identify the structural rigidity damage position and quantify the rigidity degradation degree, and provides a high-reliability model foundation for safety evaluation, digital twin construction and operation and maintenance decision of engineering structures such as power transmission line steel pipe rods.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Digital twin body construction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a device for constructing a digital twin body, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing an initial digital twin, obtaining a power service form, determining a seed form corresponding to the initial digital twin from the power service form, wherein data items and data relations belonging to the corresponding initial digital twin exist in the seed form, determining the data items and the data relations belonging to the initial digital twin from the seed form through traversing the seed form, and adding the data items and the data relations into the initial digital twin to obtain a target digital twin.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA POWER INF TECH

title_en: Multi-source data fusion type digital twin modeling method and system for power grid equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin modeling method and a digital twin modeling system for power grid equipment with multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1 collecting original sensing data, sensing node work load power, power grid harmonic frequency, each order harmonic amplitude ratio and equipment equivalent load power of power grid equipment, S2 calculating dynamic error factors of sensing node aging, correcting the original sensing data by the factors, S3 calculating dimensionless harmonic accumulated interference coefficients, correcting aged and corrected data by the coefficients, S4 calculating temperature rise space-time coupling correction based on coupling action of the harmonic accumulated interference coefficients and equivalent load power, introducing reference temperature to construct dimensionless temperature ratio corrected harmonic corrected data, obtaining real fusion data and inputting twin model iteration update parameters. According to the invention, the problem of model precision drift is solved through progressive linkage correction logic, and the stability and accuracy of twin modeling are improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINYUAN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent node integration and dynamic management method and system for emergency communication network
abstract_en: The invention provides a node intelligent integration and dynamic management method for an emergency communication network, and the system comprises a plurality of ground mobile nodes consisting of a mobile command center truck, a communication relay truck and a logistics transportation truck, and an air mobile node consisting of an unmanned aerial vehicle base station and a material delivery unmanned aerial vehicle carried by the ground mobile nodes. The system realizes intelligent integration and management of nodes through a software defined network controller, creates virtual mapping for new nodes by adopting a digital twin technology, solves an optimal role allocation strategy through a multi-objective optimization algorithm, and establishes a progressive resource opening mechanism based on trust level. The invention also introduces a distributed cooperation rule and a local AI route prediction model, so that the nodes can automatically cooperate to maintain network service under the condition of disconnection. The system can quickly construct a flexible communication network, realize cooperative optimization of communication recovery and material delivery, and remarkably improve disaster rescue efficiency.
assignees: YUKUAICHUANGLING INTELLIGENT TECH NANJING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method based on dynamic capability assessment of thermal power plant flue gas system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring method based on dynamic capability assessment of a thermal power plant flue gas system, and aims to solve the problems that the traditional constant value alarm has a large number of false alarms, the static alarm can not reflect the fault development process, operators have insufficient response experience and the like. The system divides the wind and smoke equipment into six modules including a motor bearing, a motor winding, a fan bearing, fan vibration, a lubricating oil system and a hydraulic oil system, wherein each module comprises a state judging function and a fault diagnosing function. Modeling historical normal data by a multiple regression and multiple state estimation method, monitoring the deviation degree of parameters in real time, and combining the fluctuation value, the reference value and the predicted value function to realize the early recognition of the abnormality. The fault diagnosis module fuses expert rules and accident cases, and automatically sends out early warning and pushes processing suggestions when specific conditions are met. The invention effectively discovers the hidden trouble of equipment in advance, reduces the operation and maintenance cost and improves the safe, economic and environment-friendly operation level of the unit.
assignees: JIANGSU NANTONG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;NANTONG TIANSHENGGANG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG NANTONG POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Wind farm road intelligent line selection method based on multidimensional constraint dynamic modeling
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of construction roads, and provides an intelligent wind power plant road line selection method based on multidimensional constraint dynamic modeling, which comprises the steps of obtaining multidimensional constraint conditions of wind power plant road line selection and constructing a constraint model; generating a gradient grid graph based on a digital elevation model, fusing constraint layers reflecting geological stability and earth surface coverage types to generate a dynamic cost surface, adopting an improved heuristic search algorithm to search parallel paths from a road starting point to each target fan position to generate a plurality of initial feasible paths, calculating a comprehensive cost value, screening a candidate line set according to a comparison result of the comprehensive cost value, receiving real-time update data in a construction process and environment monitoring, inputting the real-time update data into a constraint model to trigger model update, carrying out iterative optimization on the candidate line set based on the updated constraint model, and outputting a final line selection scheme, thereby effectively improving line selection efficiency, economy and reliability.
assignees: GUANGXI MAIDU ENERGY CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode intelligent inspection and early warning method and system for new energy line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode intelligent inspection and early warning method and system for a new energy line, belongs to the technology of inspection and intelligent operation and maintenance of the new energy transmission line, and is suitable for state sensing and risk identification of new energy transmission lines such as wind power, photovoltaic and the like. The method comprises the steps of multi-mode data acquisition, unified time space alignment, physical priori modeling, feature fusion, defect identification, health scoring, dynamic threshold generation, worksheet feedback and the like. The fusion robustness is enhanced by introducing physical consistency priori, dynamic early warning is realized by adopting generalized pareto distribution and confidence set mechanism, and closed loop treatment is completed by combining knowledge graph and digital twin. The invention improves the inspection identification accuracy, early warning adaptability and operation and maintenance response efficiency.
assignees: HUANENG BAOTOU NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent geological disaster emergency response and decision support system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent geological disaster emergency response and decision support system, and particularly relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and emergency management. The method aims to solve the problems of insufficient multi-source data cooperation, loss of dynamic risk quantification, stiff emergency decision and communication interruption in an extreme environment of the traditional system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a geological deformation dynamic field through a multi-source data fusion module, generating a risk partition based on a machine learning model coupling parameter dynamic range and a disaster chain rule, optimizing a resource scheduling path by combining a self-adaptive decision engine with digital twin deduction, and realizing instruction transmission and situation presentation by means of multi-channel communication and three-dimensional visualization. Finally, a full-flow closed loop control is formed, and the disaster response timeliness, the accuracy and the system toughness are improved.
assignees: LIU WEIYI

title_en: Digital twinning technology-based intelligent early warning system and method for forest fire hidden danger of power transmission channel
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent early warning system and method for mountain fire hidden danger of a power transmission channel based on a digital twin technology, relates to the technical field of power transmission lines, and aims to improve disaster early warning capability of the power transmission line. The system comprises an air-ground integrated inspection unit, a remote unified platform and a remote monitoring center, wherein the air-ground integrated inspection unit consists of an unmanned aerial vehicle device, a ground monitoring device and an unmanned aerial vehicle nest and is used for collecting real-time multidimensional data of a power transmission channel, the remote unified platform is used for fusing the data collected by the air-ground integrated inspection unit, constructing and dynamically updating a four-dimensional digital twin model of the power transmission channel and carrying out mountain fire risk assessment and deduction based on the model, and the remote monitoring center is connected with the remote unified platform and is used for visually displaying risk assessment results and executing early warning. According to the invention, by constructing the dynamic evolution digital twin model, the predictive analysis and active early warning of the mountain fire risk are realized.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Energy-saving production scheduling analysis method for die heat treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy-saving scheduling of molds, and discloses a method for scheduling and analyzing energy-saving production of heat treatment of molds, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining basic parameters, dynamically reconstructing a process window by digital twin previewing and coupling multiple physical fields, dynamically balancing multiple factors, performing self-evolution decision based on reinforcement learning, performing real-world execution and feedback evolution closed loop, improving load rate by means of waste heat accurate matching, eliminating waste of energy consumption, realizing energy saving and cost reduction, dynamically switching a real-time pricing and scheduling strategy by a power grid carbon factor, realizing carbon emission optimization, evaluating and dominating quality risk cost by coupling multiple physical fields, realizing quality improvement, eliminating waiting conflict and reinforcement learning dynamic priority adjustment by virtual previewing, realizing cross-period guarantee, performing incremental learning and predictive maintenance early warning by an attenuation model, realizing operation, maintenance and synergy, and realizing knowledge precipitation by means of temperature response gene library and cross-workpiece transfer learning.
assignees: JIANGSU WEILAN INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Coal preparation plant power outage and transmission management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal preparation plant power and electricity interruption management method and system, which break the limitation of the traditional management mode through the advanced technologies such as a fusion edge computing unit, digital twin modeling, AI risk decision and the like, realize the remote, intelligent and visual of power and electricity interruption operation and further improve the operation efficiency and the safety management and control level. The method comprises the steps of constructing a four-layer architecture of a perception layer, an edge layer, a platform layer and an application layer, wherein the perception layer is responsible for collecting data such as equipment states, personnel positions and environmental parameters, the edge layer is used for realizing data preprocessing and real-time control, the platform layer is used for carrying out simulation analysis and decision making based on a digital twin model, the application layer is used for providing functional modules such as power outage and transmission management, equipment operation and maintenance and emergency treatment, and the layers are used for realizing data intercommunication through a 5G/industrial Ethernet.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECH & ENGINEERING GROUP INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring personnel on-site positioning and behavior compliance analysis based on UWB and IMU fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring personnel on-site positioning and behavior compliance analysis based on UWB and IMU fusion, which relate to the technical field of engineering management and intelligent sensing, wherein positioning, movement, myoelectricity and touch data are acquired through multi-mode wearable equipment, UWB and IMU data are fused by adopting an error state Kalman filtering tight coupling algorithm, a filter noise covariance matrix is dynamically adjusted by combining a lightweight NLOS recognition network, robust positioning is realized, a spatial gesture, a hand movement unit and head-sight line characteristics are extracted to construct micro-motion vectors, a TP-LSTM-CRF model is input to generate time-position-motion semantic behavior streams, a standard operation flow digital twin model is built, position omission and motion violations are detected by dynamically matching the behavior streams, operation quality is deduced by combining action parameters, and finally a visual report containing positioning tracks, compliance rates and regulation suggestions is generated by combining an integration result.
assignees: BEIJING HAICE ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based network construction type energy storage system evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage systems, in particular to a network-structured energy storage system evaluation method based on digital twinning, which aims to solve the problems of incomplete scene coverage, low precision and insufficient consideration of multi-physical domain coupling and component performance attenuation in the existing evaluation method. The method comprises the steps of constructing a full-dimensional digital twin model containing multi-physical domain coupling, component level degradation and power grid interaction, collecting real-time operation, environment and historical data of a system, preprocessing, adopting a self-adaptive dynamic calibration algorithm to ensure that the model is consistent with the state of the physical system, establishing a multi-dimensional evaluation index system which covers networking capacity, operation economy and the like, carrying out multi-scene parallel simulation based on the calibration model, quantifying indexes and carrying out trend prejudgement through a bidirectional LSTM neural network, generating a report containing evaluation conclusion, risk early warning and optimization suggestion, and carrying out simulation verification on an optimization scheme. The method improves the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of evaluation and supports trend prejudgment.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SHIYOU

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent irrigated area channel river flow measurement algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of digital twinning-based intelligent irrigation district channel flow measurement algorithms, in particular to a digital twinning-based intelligent irrigation district channel flow measurement algorithm. The invention has the advantages that through a digital twin technology, comprehensive historical experience and basic data, the data monitored in real time are drawn into a curve and a model, and the corresponding change occurs under the induction of the data monitored in real time through the model and the curve, and the model continuously evolves, so that the flow of water in a future river channel can be predicted according to the current objective information in the evolution, whether disaster occurs or not and the probability and degree of the disaster can be found according to the comparison of the flow and the reference information, and people can prevent, reduce or avoid the influence of the disaster on crops in the river region in advance, and reduce the property loss.
assignees: ANHUI GANGCHAN ELECTROMECHANICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-transducer cooperative intelligent water supply method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-transducer cooperative intelligent water supply method, and belongs to the technical field of automatic control. The method comprises the steps of acquiring pressure signals of a water supply network and operation data of each water pump frequency converter in real time, synchronously acquiring time, weather and historical water usage rule data, integrating the data into an original data set, constructing a water supply digital twin model, predicting future water demand through the model, carrying out parallel simulation on a combined start-stop and frequency distribution scheme of the water pumps, evaluating and screening an optimal cooperative control strategy by combining a preset energy efficiency evaluation function, a pressure interval and a load standard, distributing the strategy as a reference instruction, comparing actual operation parameters of the frequency converters, dynamically adjusting the actual operation parameters, forming an executable instruction through a distributed negotiation protocol, and finally monitoring the pressure change and the overall energy consumption of the network, and feeding back to the model to correct the prediction parameters and optimize simulation evaluation standards. The water demand of the water supply system is accurately predicted, the cooperative control of multiple devices is realized, the pressure stability of a pipe network is effectively improved, and the load of the water pump is balanced.
assignees: WOLU SHANGHAI TRANS SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Pump station power fine scheduling method and system based on GIS and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin, and discloses a pump station power fine scheduling method and system based on GIS and digital twin, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin body of a pump station area according to GIS geographic data and hydrologic real-time data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out power load analysis on a pump station area based on a digital twin body to obtain space-time correlation entropy, constructing load traceability maps of different space units in the pump station area, identifying key dominant sensitive units aiming at preset total power demand fluctuation in the pump station area, calculating dynamic influence weight of each key dominant sensitive unit, constructing a prospective power scheduling strategy of the pump station area based on the dynamic influence weight, executing the prospective power scheduling strategy, carrying out advanced simulation on a pump station power scheduling result by utilizing the digital twin body, and carrying out feedback optimization on the prospective power scheduling strategy based on the simulation result until the pump station power scheduling result reaches a power fine scheduling condition. The invention can improve the accuracy of the power scheduling of the pump station.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Heat supply pipe network Internet of things monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a monitoring method and a system of a heat supply pipe network Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting pipe network physical signals, extracting characteristics and obtaining a characteristic matrix; the method comprises the steps of establishing a heating network digital twin body, updating in real time, detecting abnormality by using a threshold rule and machine learning double-verification mechanism to obtain an abnormality detection result, and locating the abnormality to obtain abnormality locating information. The digital twin body driving dynamic threshold generation method reduces the false alarm rate of false alarm, fuses a pipe network topology and virtual characteristics to accurately position an abnormal source, adopts LSTM time sequence prediction to strengthen abnormal pre-judgment capability, integrates related scores, deviations and trends, outputs a comprehensive positioning score after correction, and presents abnormal distribution and positioning results through a three-dimensional visual interface to form a 'detection-positioning-verification-optimization' closed-loop monitoring system, so that monitoring accuracy is improved.
assignees: YANTAI 500 HEAT SUPPLY CO LTD;HUANENG SHANDONG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;YANTAI POWER PLANT HUANENG SHANDONG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Low-voltage equipment management system and method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-voltage equipment management system and a method for a power distribution network, A low-voltage equipment management system for a power distribution network comprises a terminal perception layer, edge computing nodes and a cloud management platform. The intelligent sensing terminal at least comprises a voltage sensor, a current sensor, a temperature sensor and a vibration sensor, wherein the RFID tag is an ultrahigh frequency passive tag and is used for writing equipment identity information, the Bluetooth gateway is used for collecting environment temperature and humidity and dust concentration data, the edge computing node comprises an embedded edge gateway, a local database and an edge algorithm module which are used for carrying out multi-interface communication, and the cloud management platform comprises a digital twin engine, a health evaluation module, an operation and maintenance scheduling module and a visual interface which are used for constructing a three-dimensional digital twin body of the equipment.
